```as
// echo-networking.as
// Networking utilities for Echo Backend
// Part of Echo Reverse - Game Cheat Framework

// ============================================================================
// IMPORTS
// ============================================================================

import "echo-backend-extensions.as";

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

// HTTP methods
const string HTTP_GET = "GET";
const string HTTP_POST = "POST";
const string HTTP_PUT = "PUT";
const string HTTP_DELETE = "DELETE";
const string HTTP_PATCH = "PATCH";

// HTTP status codes
const uint HTTP_STATUS_CONTINUE = 100;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_SWITCHING_PROTOCOLS = 101;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_OK = 200;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_CREATED = 201;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_ACCEPTED = 202;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_NO_CONTENT = 204;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_MULTIPLE_CHOICES = 300;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_MOVED_PERMANENTLY = 301;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_FOUND = 302;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_SEE_OTHER = 303;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_NOT_MODIFIED = 304;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST = 400;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_UNAUTHORIZED = 401;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_FORBIDDEN = 403;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_NOT_FOUND = 404;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED = 405;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 408;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR = 500;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED = 501;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_BAD_GATEWAY = 502;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE = 503;
const uint HTTP_STATUS_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT = 504;

// Content types
const string CONTENT_TYPE_JSON = "application/json";
const string CONTENT_TYPE_XML = "application/xml";
const string CONTENT_TYPE_FORM_URLENCODED = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded";
const string CONTENT_TYPE_MULTIPART = "multipart/form-data";
const string CONTENT_TYPE_TEXT = "text/plain";
const string CONTENT_TYPE_HTML = "text/html";

// WebSocket opcodes
const uint WEBSOCKET_OPCODE_CONTINUATION = 0x0;
const uint WEBSOCKET_OPCODE_TEXT = 0x1;
const uint WEBSOCKET_OPCODE_BINARY = 0x2;
const uint WEBSOCKET_OPCODE_CLOSE = 0x8;
const uint WEBSOCKET_OPCODE_PING = 0x9;
const uint WEBSOCKET_OPCODE_PONG = 0xA;

// ============================================================================
// HTTP REQUEST
// ============================================================================

/// HTTP request class
class HTTPRequest {
    private string method;
    private string url;
    private dict<string, string> headers;
    private dict<string, auto> queryParams;
    private dict<string, auto> formData;
    private string body;
    private uint timeout;
    
    // Response
    private uint statusCode;
    private string statusText;
    private dict<string, string> responseHeaders;
    private string responseBody;
    private bool success;

    // Callbacks
    private func@ onSuccessCallback;
    private func@ onErrorCallback;
    private func@ onCompleteCallback;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    HTTPRequest(string method = HTTP_GET, string url = "") {
        this.method = method;
        this.url = url;
        headers = {};
        queryParams = {};
        formData = {};
        body = "";
        timeout = 30000; // 30 seconds
        
        // Default headers
        setHeader("Content-Type", CONTENT_TYPE_JSON);
        setHeader("Accept", CONTENT_TYPE_JSON);
        setHeader("User-Agent", "EchoReverse/1.0");
        
        // Initialize response
        statusCode = 0;
        statusText = "";
        responseHeaders = {};
        responseBody = "";
        success = false;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // REQUEST CONFIGURATION
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set method
    void setMethod(string method) {
        this.method = method;
    }

    /// Get method
    string getMethod() {
        return method;
    }

    /// Set URL
    void setUrl(string url) {
        this.url = url;
    }

    /// Get URL
    string getUrl() {
        return url;
    }

    /// Set timeout
    void setTimeout(uint timeout) {
        this.timeout = timeout;
    }

    /// Get timeout
    uint getTimeout() {
        return timeout;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // HEADERS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set header
    void setHeader(string name, string value) {
        headers[name] = value;
    }

    /// Get header
    string getHeader(string name) {
        if (headers.exists(name)) {
            return headers[name];
        }
        return "";
    }

    /// Remove header
    void removeHeader(string name) {
        headers.remove(name);
    }

    /// Get all headers
    dict<string, string> getHeaders() {
        return headers;
    }

    /// Clear headers
    void clearHeaders() {
        headers.clear();
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // QUERY PARAMETERS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set query parameter
    void setQueryParam(string name, auto value) {
        queryParams[name] = value;
    }

    /// Get query parameter
    auto getQueryParam(string name) {
        if (queryParams.exists(name)) {
            return queryParams[name];
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// Remove query parameter
    void removeQueryParam(string name) {
        queryParams.remove(name);
    }

    /// Get all query parameters
    dict<string, auto> getQueryParams() {
        return queryParams;
    }

    /// Clear query parameters
    void clearQueryParams() {
        queryParams.clear();
    }

    /// Build query string
    string buildQueryString() {
        string query = "";
        for (uint i = 0; i < queryParams.size(); i++) {
            string key = queryParams.keys()[i];
            auto value = queryParams[key];
            
            if (i > 0) {
                query += "&";
            }
            
            query += urlEncode(key);
            query += "=";
            query += urlEncode(toString(value));
        }
        return query;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // FORM DATA
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set form data
    void setFormData(string name, auto value) {
        formData[name] = value;
    }

    /// Get form data
    auto getFormData(string name) {
        if (formData.exists(name)) {
            return formData[name];
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// Remove form data
    void removeFormData(string name) {
        formData.remove(name);
    }

    /// Get all form data
    dict<string, auto> getFormData() {
        return formData;
    }

    /// Clear form data
    void clearFormData() {
        formData.clear();
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // BODY
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set body
    void setBody(string body) {
        this.body = body;
    }

    /// Get body
    string getBody() {
        return body;
    }

    /// Set JSON body
    void setJSONBody(dict@ data) {
        body = json::encode(data);
        setHeader("Content-Type", CONTENT_TYPE_JSON);
    }

    /// Set form URL encoded body
    void setFormUrlEncodedBody(dict@ data) {
        body = buildFormUrlEncodedString(data);
        setHeader("Content-Type", CONTENT_TYPE_FORM_URLENCODED);
    }

    /// Build form URL encoded string
    string buildFormUrlEncodedString(dict@ data) {
        string result = "";
        for (uint i = 0; i < data.size(); i++) {
            string key = data.keys()[i];
            auto value = data[key];
            
            if (i > 0) {
                result += "&";
            }
            
            result += urlEncode(key);
            result += "=";
            result += urlEncode(toString(value));
        }
        return result;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // RESPONSE
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get status code
    uint getStatusCode() {
        return statusCode;
    }

    /// Get status text
    string getStatusText() {
        return statusText;
    }

    /// Get response headers
    dict<string, string> getResponseHeaders() {
        return responseHeaders;
    }

    /// Get response body
    string getResponseBody() {
        return responseBody;
    }

    /// Get JSON response
    dict@ getJSONResponse() {
        if (responseBody != "") {
            try {
                return json::decode(responseBody);
            } catch (exception e) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// Check if successful
    bool isSuccess() {
        return success;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // SEND REQUEST
    // ============================================================================

    /// Send request synchronously
    bool send() {
        // Build final URL
        string finalUrl = url;
        string queryString = buildQueryString();
        if (queryString != "") {
            finalUrl += (url.find("?") >= 0) ? "&" : "?";
            finalUrl += queryString;
        }

        // Build request data
        dict requestData = {
            {"method", method},
            {"url", finalUrl},
            {"headers", headers},
            {"timeout", timeout}
        };

        if (method == HTTP_GET || method == HTTP_DELETE) {
            requestData["body"] = "";
        } else {
            requestData["body"] = body;
        }

        print("[HTTPRequest] Sending " + method + " request to " + finalUrl + "\n");

        // Use platform-specific HTTP request
        dict@ response = platform::http_request(requestData);
        
        if (response == null) {
            success = false;
            statusCode = 0;
            statusText = "Request failed";
            responseBody = "";
            
            if (onErrorCallback) {
                onErrorCallback.call(this, "Request failed");
            }
            return false;
        }

        // Parse response
        statusCode = response.exists("statusCode") ? response["statusCode"].toInteger() : 0;
        statusText = response.exists("statusText") ? response["statusText"].toString() : "";
        responseHeaders = response.exists("headers") ? response["headers"].toDict() : {};
        responseBody = response.exists("body") ? response["body"].toString() : "";
        success = statusCode >= 200 && statusCode < 300;

        print("[HTTPRequest] Response: " + statusCode + " " + statusText + "\n");

        // Call callbacks
        if (success && onSuccessCallback) {
            onSuccessCallback.call(this, responseBody);
        } else if (!success && onErrorCallback) {
            onErrorCallback.call(this, "HTTP " + statusCode + ": " + statusText);
        }
        
        if (onCompleteCallback) {
            onCompleteCallback.call(this);
        }

        return success;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CALLBACKS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set success callback
    void setOnSuccess(func@ callback) {
        onSuccessCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set error callback
    void setOnError(func@ callback) {
        onErrorCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set complete callback
    void setOnComplete(func@ callback) {
        onCompleteCallback = callback;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // UTILITY FUNCTIONS
    // ============================================================================

    /// URL encode
    static string urlEncode(string str) {
        string result = "";
        for (uint i = 0; i < str.length(); i++) {
            char c = str[i];
            
            if (isAlnum(c) || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == '.' || c == '~') {
                result += c;
            } else if (c == ' ') {
                result += "+";
            } else {
                result += "%" + toHexString(uint8(c), 2);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    /// Check if alphanumeric
    static bool isAlnum(char c) {
        return (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9');
    }

    /// Convert to hex string
    static string toHexString(uint value, uint digits = 2) {
        string hex = "0123456789ABCDEF";
        string result = "";
        for (uint i = 0; i < digits; i++) {
            result = hex[(value >> (4 * (digits - 1 - i))) & 0xF] + result;
        }
        return result;
    }

    /// Convert value to string
    static string toString(auto value) {
        if (value is bool) {
            return value ? "true" : "false";
        } else if (value is int8 || value is int16 || value is int32 || value is int64) {
            return string(value);
        } else if (value is uint8 || value is uint16 || value is uint32 || value is uint64) {
            return string(value);
        } else if (value is float || value is double) {
            return string(value);
        } else {
            return "";
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// HTTP CLIENT
// ============================================================================

/// HTTP client for making requests
class HTTPClient {
    private string baseUrl;
    private dict<string, string> defaultHeaders;
    private uint defaultTimeout;
    
    // Cookie jar
    private dict<string, string> cookies;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    HTTPClient(string baseUrl = "") {
        this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
        defaultHeaders = {};
        defaultTimeout = 30000;
        cookies = {};
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CONFIGURATION
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set base URL
    void setBaseUrl(string url) {
        baseUrl = url;
    }

    /// Get base URL
    string getBaseUrl() {
        return baseUrl;
    }

    /// Set default header
    void setDefaultHeader(string name, string value) {
        defaultHeaders[name] = value;
    }

    /// Set default timeout
    void setDefaultTimeout(uint timeout) {
        defaultTimeout = timeout;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // COOKIES
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set cookie
    void setCookie(string name, string value) {
        cookies[name] = value;
    }

    /// Get cookie
    string getCookie(string name) {
        if (cookies.exists(name)) {
            return cookies[name];
        }
        return "";
    }

    /// Remove cookie
    void removeCookie(string name) {
        cookies.remove(name);
    }

    /// Clear cookies
    void clearCookies() {
        cookies.clear();
    }

    /// Get all cookies
    dict<string, string> getCookies() {
        return cookies;
    }

    /// Parse cookies from header
    void parseCookies(string cookieHeader) {
        // Split by semicolon
        array<string> parts = splitString(cookieHeader, ";");
        
        for (uint i = 0; i < parts.size(); i++) {
            string part = trimString(parts[i]);
            if (part.find("=") >= 0) {
                array<string> kv = splitString(part, "=", 1);
                if (kv.size() == 2) {
                    string key = trimString(kv[0]);
                    string value = trimString(kv[1]);
                    cookies[key] = value;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Build cookie header
    string buildCookieHeader() {
        string result = "";
        for (uint i = 0; i < cookies.size(); i++) {
            string key = cookies.keys()[i];
            string value = cookies[key];
            
            if (i > 0) {
                result += "; ";
            }
            
            result += key + "=" + value;
        }
        return result;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // REQUESTS
    // ============================================================================

    /// GET request
    HTTPRequest@ get(string path, dict<string, auto> queryParams = {}) {
        HTTPRequest@ request = HTTPRequest(HTTP_GET, buildUrl(path));
        applyDefaults(request);
        
        for (uint i = 0; i < queryParams.size(); i++) {
            string key = queryParams.keys()[i];
            request.setQueryParam(key, queryParams[key]);
        }
        
        return request;
    }

    /// POST request with JSON body
    HTTPRequest@ post(string path, dict@ data = {}) {
        HTTPRequest@ request = HTTPRequest(HTTP_POST, buildUrl(path));
        applyDefaults(request);
        request.setJSONBody(data);
        return request;
    }

    /// POST request with form data
    HTTPRequest@ postForm(string path, dict@ data = {}) {
        HTTPRequest@ request = HTTPRequest(HTTP_POST, buildUrl(path));
        applyDefaults(request);
        request.setFormUrlEncodedBody(data);
        return request;
    }

    /// PUT request
    HTTPRequest@ put(string path, dict@ data = {}) {
        HTTPRequest@ request = HTTPRequest(HTTP_PUT, buildUrl(path));
        applyDefaults(request);
        request.setJSONBody(data);
        return request;
    }

    /// DELETE request
    HTTPRequest@ delete(string path, dict<string, auto> queryParams = {}) {
        HTTPRequest@ request = HTTPRequest(HTTP_DELETE, buildUrl(path));
        applyDefaults(request);
        
        for (uint i = 0; i < queryParams.size(); i++) {
            string key = queryParams.keys()[i];
            request.setQueryParam(key, queryParams[key]);
        }
        
        return request;
    }

    /// PATCH request
    HTTPRequest@ patch(string path, dict@ data = {}) {
        HTTPRequest@ request = HTTPRequest(HTTP_PATCH, buildUrl(path));
        applyDefaults(request);
        request.setJSONBody(data);
        return request;
    }

    /// HEAD request
    HTTPRequest@ head(string path) {
        HTTPRequest@ request = HTTPRequest(HTTP_PUT, buildUrl(path));
        applyDefaults(request);
        return request;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // UTILITY FUNCTIONS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Build URL
    string buildUrl(string path) {
        if (baseUrl == "") {
            return path;
        }
        
        if (baseUrl[baseUrl.length() - 1] == '/') {
            baseUrl = baseUrl.substr(0, baseUrl.length() - 1);
        }
        
        if (path.length() > 0 && path[0] == '/') {
            path = path.substr(1);
        }
        
        return baseUrl + "/" + path;
    }

    /// Apply default settings to request
    void applyDefaults(HTTPRequest@ request) {
        request.setTimeout(defaultTimeout);
        
        // Apply default headers
        for (uint i = 0; i < defaultHeaders.size(); i++) {
            string key = defaultHeaders.keys()[i];
            request.setHeader(key, defaultHeaders[key]);
        }
        
        // Apply cookies
        string cookieHeader = buildCookieHeader();
        if (cookieHeader != "") {
            request.setHeader("Cookie", cookieHeader);
        }
    }

    /// Split string
    static array<string> splitString(string str, string delimiter, uint limit = 0) {
        array<string> tokens;
        string current = "";
        uint count = 0;
        
        for (uint i = 0; i < str.length(); i++) {
            if (str.substr(i, delimiter.length()) == delimiter) {
                tokens.push(current);
                current = "";
                i += delimiter.length() - 1;
                count++;
                
                if (limit > 0 && count >= limit - 1) {
                    // Include the rest of the string
                    current = str.substr(i + 1);
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                current += str[i];
            }
        }
        
        if (current != "") {
            tokens.push(current);
        }
        
        return tokens;
    }

    /// Trim string
    static string trimString(string str) {
        uint start = 0;
        uint end = str.length();
        
        while (start < end && isWhitespace(str[start])) {
            start++;
        }
        
        while (end > start && isWhitespace(str[end - 1])) {
            end--;
        }
        
        return str.substr(start, end - start);
    }

    /// Check if whitespace
    static bool isWhitespace(char c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\n';
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// WEBSOCKET MESSAGE
// ============================================================================

/// WebSocket message class
class WebSocketMessage {
    private string type;
    private string data;
    private dict<string, auto> metadata;
    private uint64 timestamp;
    private uint64 messageId;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    WebSocketMessage(string type = "", string data = "", dict<string, auto> metadata = {}) {
        this.type = type;
        this.data = data;
        this.metadata = metadata;
        this.timestamp = platform::time();
        this.messageId = 0;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // GETTERS/SETTERS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set type
    void setType(string type) {
        this.type = type;
    }

    /// Get type
    string getType() {
        return type;
    }

    /// Set data
    void setData(string data) {
        this.data = data;
    }

    /// Get data
    string getData() {
        return data;
    }

    /// Set metadata
    void setMetadata(dict<string, auto> metadata) {
        this.metadata = metadata;
    }

    /// Get metadata
    dict<string, auto> getMetadata() {
        return metadata;
    }

    /// Set timestamp
    void setTimestamp(uint64 timestamp) {
        this.timestamp = timestamp;
    }

    /// Get timestamp
    uint64 getTimestamp() {
        return timestamp;
    }

    /// Set message ID
    void setMessageId(uint64 id) {
        messageId = id;
    }

    /// Get message ID
    uint64 getMessageId() {
        return messageId;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // SERIALIZATION
    // ============================================================================

    /// Convert to dictionary
    dict toDict() {
        dict result = {
            {"type", type},
            {"data", data},
            {"timestamp", timestamp},
            {"messageId", messageId}
        };
        
        // Add metadata
        for (uint i = 0; i < metadata.size(); i++) {
            string key = metadata.keys()[i];
            result[key] = metadata[key];
        }
        
        return result;
    }

    /// Convert to JSON string
    string toJSON() {
        return json::encode(toDict());
    }

    /// Create from dictionary
    static WebSocketMessage@ fromDict(dict@ data) {
        if (data == null) {
            return null;
        }
        
        string type = data.exists("type") ? data["type"].toString() : "";
        string dataStr = data.exists("data") ? data["data"].toString() : "";
        
        WebSocketMessage@ message = WebSocketMessage(type, dataStr);
        
        if (data.exists("timestamp")) {
            message.setTimestamp(data["timestamp"].toInteger());
        }
        if (data.exists("messageId")) {
            message.setMessageId(data["messageId"].toInteger());
        }
        
        // Add metadata
        for (uint i = 0; i < data.size(); i++) {
            string key = data.keys()[i];
            if (key != "type" && key != "data" && key != "timestamp" && key != "messageId") {
                message.getMetadata()[key] = data[key];
            }
        }
        
        return message;
    }

    /// Create from JSON string
    static WebSocketMessage@ fromJSON(string json) {
        dict@ data = json::decode(json);
        return fromDict(data);
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // UTILITY FUNCTIONS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get data as dictionary
    dict@ getDataAsDict() {
        if (data != "") {
            try {
                return json::decode(data);
            } catch (exception e) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// Set data from dictionary
    void setDataFromDict(dict@ dataDict) {
        data = json::encode(dataDict);
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// WEBSOCKET CLIENT
// ============================================================================

/// WebSocket client for real-time communication
class WebSocketClient {
    private string url;
    private bool connected;
    private bool connecting;
    private uint64 connectTime;
    private uint reconnectAttempts;
    private uint maxReconnectAttempts;
    private uint reconnectDelay;
    
    // Callbacks
    private func@ onConnectCallback;
    private func@ onDisconnectCallback;
    private func@ onMessageCallback;
    private func@ onErrorCallback;
    private func@ onCloseCallback;
    
    // Message queue
    private array<WebSocketMessage@> messageQueue;
    private array<func@> pendingCallbacks;
    
    // Statistics
    private uint64 messagesSent;
    private uint64 messagesReceived;
    private uint64 errors;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    WebSocketClient(string url) {
        this.url = url;
        connected = false;
        connecting = false;
        connectTime = 0;
        reconnectAttempts = 0;
        maxReconnectAttempts = 10;
        reconnectDelay = 5000; // 5 seconds
        
        messageQueue = {};
        pendingCallbacks = {};
        
        messagesSent = 0;
        messagesReceived = 0;
        errors = 0;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CONNECTION MANAGEMENT
    // ============================================================================

    /// Connect to WebSocket server
    bool connect() {
        if (connected) {
            print("[WebSocketClient] Already connected\n");
            return true;
        }
        
        if (connecting) {
            print("[WebSocketClient] Already connecting...\n");
            return false;
        }

        connecting = true;
        connected = false;
        reconnectAttempts = 0;
        
        print("[WebSocketClient] Connecting to " + url + "...\n");

        // Platform-specific WebSocket connection
        bool result = platform::websocket_connect(url);
        
        if (result) {
            connected = true;
            connecting = false;
            connectTime = platform::time();
            reconnectAttempts = 0;
            
            print("[WebSocketClient] Connected\n");
            
            // Process queued messages
            processQueue();
            
            // Call onConnect callback
            if (onConnectCallback) {
                onConnectCallback.call(this);
            }
            
            return true;
        } else {
            connecting = false;
            reconnectAttempts++;
            
            print("[WebSocketClient] Connection failed, attempt " + reconnectAttempts + "/" + maxReconnectAttempts + "\n");
            
            // Attempt reconnection
            if (reconnectAttempts < maxReconnectAttempts) {
                platform::sleep(reconnectDelay);
                return connect();
            }
            
            // Call onError callback
            if (onErrorCallback) {
                onErrorCallback.call(this, "Connection failed");
            }
            
            return false;
        }
    }

    /// Disconnect from WebSocket server
    void disconnect() {
        if (!connected && !connecting) {
            return;
        }

        print("[WebSocketClient] Disconnecting...\n");
        
        // Platform-specific disconnect
        platform::websocket_disconnect();
        
        connected = false;
        connecting = false;
        
        // Call onDisconnect callback
        if (onDisconnectCallback) {
            onDisconnectCallback.call(this);
        }
    }

    /// Reconnect
    bool reconnect() {
        disconnect();
        return connect();
    }

    /// Check if connected
    bool isConnected() {
        return connected;
    }

    /// Check if connecting
    bool isConnecting() {
        return connecting;
    }

    /// Get connection time
    uint64 getConnectionTime() {
        return connectTime;
    }

    /// Get reconnect attempts
    uint getReconnectAttempts() {
        return reconnectAttempts;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // MESSAGE HANDLING
    // ============================================================================

    /// Send message
    bool send(string message) {
        if (!connected) {
            // Queue the message
            print("[WebSocketClient] Not connected, queuing message\n");
            WebSocketMessage@ msg = WebSocketMessage("", message);
            messageQueue.push(msg);
            
            // Attempt to connect
            connect();
            return false;
        }

        // Platform-specific send
        bool result = platform::websocket_send(message);
        
        if (result) {
            messagesSent++;
        } else {
            // Connection lost
            connected = false;
            errors++;
            
            // Try to reconnect
            reconnect();
        }
        
        return result;
    }

    /// Send WebSocket message
    bool sendMessage(WebSocketMessage@ message) {
        return send(message.toJSON());
    }

    /// Send JSON data
    bool sendJSON(dict@ data) {
        return send(json::encode(data));
    }

    /// Send ping
    bool sendPing() {
        return send("PING");
    }

    /// Send pong
    bool sendPong() {
        return send("PONG");
    }

    /// Process queued messages
    void processQueue() {
        if (!connected) {
            return;
        }

        while (messageQueue.size() > 0) {
            WebSocketMessage@ msg = messageQueue[0];
            messageQueue.removeAt(0);
            
            bool result = send(msg.toJSON());
            if (!result) {
                // Put it back in the queue
                messageQueue.insertAt(0, msg);
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    /// Handle incoming message
    void handleMessage(string message) {
        messagesReceived++;
        
        print("[WebSocketClient] Received: " + message + "\n");
        
        // Parse as WebSocketMessage if it's JSON
        WebSocketMessage@ wsMessage = null;
        try {
            wsMessage = WebSocketMessage.fromJSON(message);
        } catch (exception e) {
            // Not JSON, just pass the raw message
        }
        
        // Call onMessage callback
        if (onMessageCallback) {
            if (wsMessage != null) {
                onMessageCallback.call(this, wsMessage);
            } else {
                onMessageCallback.call(this, message);
            }
        }
        
        // Handle pending callbacks
        if (pendingCallbacks.size() > 0) {
            func@ callback = pendingCallbacks[0];
            pendingCallbacks.removeAt(0);
            callback.call(this, wsMessage != null ? wsMessage : message);
        }
    }

    /// Handle error
    void handleError(string error) {
        errors++;
        
        print("[WebSocketClient] Error: " + error + "\n");
        
        if (onErrorCallback) {
            onErrorCallback.call(this, error);
        }
        
        // Reconnect if needed
        if (connected) {
            connected = false;
            reconnect();
        }
    }

    /// Handle close
    void handleClose(int code, string reason) {
        connected = false;
        connecting = false;
        
        print("[WebSocketClient] Closed: " + code + " - " + reason + "\n");
        
        if (onCloseCallback) {
            onCloseCallback.call(this, code, reason);
        }
        
        // Attempt to reconnect
        reconnect();
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // REQUEST/RESPONSE
    // ============================================================================

    /// Send request and wait for response
    bool sendRequest(string type, dict@ data, func@ callback) {
        uint64 requestId = platform::time();
        
        dict@ request = {
            {"type", type},
            {"data", data},
            {"requestId", requestId},
            {"timestamp", platform::time()}
        };
        
        // Store callback
        if (callback) {
            pendingCallbacks.push(callback);
        }
        
        return sendJSON(request);
    }

    /// Send request with timeout
    bool sendRequestWithTimeout(string type, dict@ data, func@ callback, uint timeout) {
        // Would need async implementation
        return sendRequest(type, data, callback);
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CALLBACKS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set connect callback
    void setOnConnect(func@ callback) {
        onConnectCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set disconnect callback
    void setOnDisconnect(func@ callback) {
        onDisconnectCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set message callback
    void setOnMessage(func@ callback) {
        onMessageCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set error callback
    void setOnError(func@ callback) {
        onErrorCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set close callback
    void setOnClose(func@ callback) {
        onCloseCallback = callback;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // STATISTICS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get messages sent
    uint64 getMessagesSent() {
        return messagesSent;
    }

    /// Get messages received
    uint64 getMessagesReceived() {
        return messagesReceived;
    }

    /// Get errors
    uint64 getErrors() {
        return errors;
    }

    /// Get statistics
    dict getStatistics() {
        return {
            {"connected", connected},
            {"connecting", connecting},
            {"messagesSent", messagesSent},
            {"messagesReceived", messagesReceived},
            {"errors", errors},
            {"reconnectAttempts", reconnectAttempts},
            {"connectionTime", connectTime},
            {"queueSize", messageQueue.size()},
            {"pendingCallbacks", pendingCallbacks.size()}
        };
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CLEANUP
    // ============================================================================

    /// Clear message queue
    void clearQueue() {
        messageQueue.clear();
    }

    /// Clear pending callbacks
    void clearPendingCallbacks() {
        pendingCallbacks.clear();
    }

    /// Reset statistics
    void resetStatistics() {
        messagesSent = 0;
        messagesReceived = 0;
        errors = 0;
        reconnectAttempts = 0;
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// WEBSOCKET SERVER (CONCEPTUAL)
// ============================================================================

/// WebSocket server for hosting connections
class WebSocketServer {
    private uint port;
    private bool running;
    private array<WebSocketClient@> clients;
    
    // Callbacks
    private func@ onClientConnectCallback;
    private func@ onClientDisconnectCallback;
    private func@ onClientMessageCallback;
    private func@ onErrorCallback;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    WebSocketServer(uint port = 8080) {
        this.port = port;
        running = false;
        clients = {};
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // SERVER CONTROL
    // ============================================================================

    /// Start server
    bool start() {
        if (running) {
            print("[WebSocketServer] Already running\n");
            return true;
        }

        print("[WebSocketServer] Starting on port " + port + "...\n");
        
        // Platform-specific server start
        running = platform::websocket_server_start(port);
        
        if (running) {
            print("[WebSocketServer] Started\n");
        } else {
            print("[WebSocketServer] Failed to start\n");
        }
        
        return running;
    }

    /// Stop server
    void stop() {
        if (!running) {
            return;
        }

        print("[WebSocketServer] Stopping...\n");
        
        // Platform-specific server stop
        platform::websocket_server_stop();
        
        running = false;
        
        // Clear clients
        for (uint i = 0; i < clients.size(); i++) {
            WebSocketClient@ client = clients[i];
            client.disconnect();
        }
        clients.clear();
        
        print("[WebSocketServer] Stopped\n");
    }

    /// Check if running
    bool isRunning() {
        return running;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CLIENT MANAGEMENT
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get clients
    array<WebSocketClient@> getClients() {
        return clients;
    }

    /// Get client count
    uint getClientCount() {
        return clients.size();
    }

    /// Get client by ID
    WebSocketClient@ getClient(uint id) {
        if (id < clients.size()) {
            return clients[id];
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// Remove client
    void removeClient(WebSocketClient@ client) {
        for (uint i = 0; i < clients.size(); i++) {
            if (clients[i] == client) {
                clients.removeAt(i);
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    /// Broadcast message to all clients
    void broadcast(string message) {
        for (uint i = 0; i < clients.size(); i++) {
            WebSocketClient@ client = clients[i];
            if (client.isConnected()) {
                client.send(message);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Broadcast WebSocket message
    void broadcastMessage(WebSocketMessage@ message) {
        broadcast(message.toJSON());
    }

    /// Send to specific client
    bool sendToClient(uint clientId, string message) {
        WebSocketClient@ client = getClient(clientId);
        if (client != null && client.isConnected()) {
            return client.send(message);
        }
        return false;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CALLBACKS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set client connect callback
    void setOnClientConnect(func@ callback) {
        onClientConnectCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set client disconnect callback
    void setOnClientDisconnect(func@ callback) {
        onClientDisconnectCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set client message callback
    void setOnClientMessage(func@ callback) {
        onClientMessageCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set error callback
    void setOnError(func@ callback) {
        onErrorCallback = callback;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // HANDLERS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Handle client connection
    void handleClientConnect(WebSocketClient@ client) {
        clients.push(client);
        
        print("[WebSocketServer] Client connected\n");
        
        if (onClientConnectCallback) {
            onClientConnectCallback.call(this, client);
        }
    }

    /// Handle client disconnection
    void handleClientDisconnect(WebSocketClient@ client) {
        removeClient(client);
        
        print("[WebSocketServer] Client disconnected\n");
        
        if (onClientDisconnectCallback) {
            onClientDisconnectCallback.call(this, client);
        }
    }

    /// Handle client message
    void handleClientMessage(WebSocketClient@ client, string message) {
        print("[WebSocketServer] Received from client: " + message + "\n");
        
        if (onClientMessageCallback) {
            WebSocketMessage@ wsMessage = null;
            try {
                wsMessage = WebSocketMessage.fromJSON(message);
            } catch (exception e) {
                // Not JSON
            }
            
            if (wsMessage != null) {
                onClientMessageCallback.call(this, client, wsMessage);
            } else {
                onClientMessageCallback.call(this, client, message);
            }
        }
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // STATISTICS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get statistics
    dict getStatistics() {
        return {
            {"running", running},
            {"port", port},
            {"clientCount", clients.size()}
        };
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// ECHO BACKEND NETWORK MANAGER
// ============================================================================

/// Network manager for Echo Backend
class EchoNetworkManager {
    private HTTPClient@ httpClient;
    private WebSocketClient@ wsClient;
    private WebSocketServer@ wsServer;
    
    private bool useHTTPS;
    private string backendHost;
    private uint backendPort;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    EchoNetworkManager(string host = "127.0.0.1", uint port = 9000, bool https = false) {
        backendHost = host;
        backendPort = port;
        useHTTPS = https;
        
        // Initialize clients
        string protocol = https ? "https://" : "http://";
        string baseUrl = protocol + host + ":" + port;
        
        httpClient = HTTPClient(baseUrl);
        wsClient = WebSocketClient("ws://" + host + ":" + port + "/agent-ext");
        wsServer = WebSocketServer(0); // Disabled by default
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CONFIGURATION
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set backend host
    void setBackendHost(string host) {
        backendHost = host;
        httpClient.setBaseUrl((useHTTPS ? "https://" : "http://") + host + ":" + backendPort);
        wsClient = WebSocketClient("ws://" + host + ":" + backendPort + "/agent-ext");
    }

    /// Set backend port
    void setBackendPort(uint port) {
        backendPort = port;
        httpClient.setBaseUrl((useHTTPS ? "https://" : "http://") + backendHost + ":" + port);
        wsClient = WebSocketClient("ws://" + backendHost + ":" + port + "/agent-ext");
    }

    /// Set HTTPS
    void setHTTPS(bool https) {
        useHTTPS = https;
        httpClient.setBaseUrl((https ? "https://" : "http://") + backendHost + ":" + backendPort);
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // HTTP CLIENT
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get HTTP client
    HTTPClient@ getHTTPClient() {
        return httpClient;
    }

    /// Send HTTP request
    bool sendHTTPRequest(string method, string path, dict@ data = {}, func@ callback = null) {
        HTTPRequest@ request = null;
        
        switch (method) {
            case HTTP_GET:
                request = httpClient.get(path, data);
                break;
            case HTTP_POST:
                request = httpClient.post(path, data);
                break;
            case HTTP_PUT:
                request = httpClient.put(path, data);
                break;
            case HTTP_DELETE:
                request = httpClient.delete(path, data);
                break;
            case HTTP_PATCH:
                request = httpClient.patch(path, data);
                break;
            default:
                request = httpClient.get(path, data);
        }
        
        if (request == null) {
            return false;
        }
        
        if (callback) {
            request.setOnComplete(callback);
        }
        
        return request.send();
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // WEBSOCKET CLIENT
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get WebSocket client
    WebSocketClient@ getWebSocketClient() {
        return wsClient;
    }

    /// Connect WebSocket
    bool connectWebSocket() {
        return wsClient.connect();
    }

    /// Disconnect WebSocket
    void disconnectWebSocket() {
        wsClient.disconnect();
    }

    /// Send WebSocket message
    bool sendWebSocketMessage(dict@ message) {
        return wsClient.sendJSON(message);
    }

    /// Send WebSocket request
    bool sendWebSocketRequest(string type, dict@ data, func@ callback) {
        return wsClient.sendRequest(type, data, callback);
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // WEBSOCKET SERVER
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get WebSocket server
    WebSocketServer@ getWebSocketServer() {
        return wsServer;
    }

    /// Start WebSocket server
    bool startWebSocketServer(uint port) {
        wsServer = WebSocketServer(port);
        return wsServer.start();
    }

    /// Stop WebSocket server
    void stopWebSocketServer() {
        wsServer.stop();
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // ECHO BACKEND INTEGRATION
    // ============================================================================

    /// Send Echo Backend request via HTTP
    bool sendEchoRequest(string category, string type, dict@ data, func@ callback = null) {
        string path = "/api/" + category + "/" + type;
        return sendHTTPRequest(HTTP_POST, path, data, callback);
    }

    /// Send Echo Backend request via WebSocket
    bool sendEchoWebSocketRequest(string category, string type, dict@ data, func@ callback = null) {
        dict@ message = {
            {"category", category},
            {"type", type},
            {"data", data}
        };
        return sendWebSocketRequest(category + "." + type, message, callback);
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // STATUS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get network status
    dict getNetworkStatus() {
        return {
            {"backendHost", backendHost},
            {"backendPort", backendPort},
            {"useHTTPS", useHTTPS},
            {"httpClient", httpClient != null},
            {"wsClientConnected", wsClient != null && wsClient.isConnected()},
            {"wsServerRunning", wsServer != null && wsServer.isRunning()},
            {"wsClientStats", wsClient != null ? wsClient.getStatistics() : {}},
            {"wsServerStats", wsServer != null ? wsServer.getStatistics() : {}}
        };
    }

    /// Check connection
    bool checkConnection() {
        // Try to send a ping
        HTTPRequest@ request = httpClient.get("/ping");
        return request.send();
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// GLOBAL INSTANCES
// ============================================================================

/// Global network manager
EchoNetworkManager@ g_networkManager = null;

/// Global HTTP client
HTTPClient@ g_httpClient = null;

/// Global WebSocket client
WebSocketClient@ g_wsClient = null;

// ============================================================================
// INITIALIZATION
// ============================================================================

/// Initialize global network system
void initNetworkSystem() {
    if (g_networkManager == null) {
        g_networkManager = EchoNetworkManager("127.0.0.1", 9000, false);
    }
    if (g_httpClient == null) {
        g_httpClient = HTTPClient("http://127.0.0.1:9000");
    }
    if (g_wsClient == null) {
        g_wsClient = WebSocketClient("ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext");
    }
}

/// Get global network manager
EchoNetworkManager@ getNetworkManager() {
    initNetworkSystem();
    return g_networkManager;
}

/// Get global HTTP client
HTTPClient@ getHTTPClient() {
    initNetworkSystem();
    return g_httpClient;
}

/// Get global WebSocket client
WebSocketClient@ getWebSocketClient() {
    initNetworkSystem();
    return g_wsClient;
}

// ============================================================================
// CONVENIENCE FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

/// Send HTTP GET request
bool httpGet(string url, func@ callback = null) {
    HTTPRequest@ request = HTTPRequest(HTTP_GET, url);
    if (callback) {
        request.setOnComplete(callback);
    }
    return request.send();
}

/// Send HTTP POST request
bool httpPost(string url, dict@ data, func@ callback = null) {
    HTTPRequest@ request = HTTPRequest(HTTP_POST, url);
    request.setJSONBody(data);
    if (callback) {
        request.setOnComplete(callback);
    }
    return request.send();
}

/// Connect to WebSocket
bool wsConnect(string url = "ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext") {
    WebSocketClient@ client = WebSocketClient(url);
    return client.connect();
}

/// Send WebSocket message
bool wsSend(string message, string url = "ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext") {
    WebSocketClient@ client = WebSocketClient(url);
    return client.send(message);
}
```
