`app/echo/echo-performance.as`:

```as
// echo-performance.as
// Performance monitoring and optimization utilities
// Part of Echo Reverse - Game Cheat Framework

// ============================================================================
// IMPORTS
// ============================================================================

import "echo-math-utilities.as";
import "echo-backend-extensions.as";

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

// Performance thresholds
const float WARNING_FPS = 30.0;
const float CRITICAL_FPS = 15.0;
const float HIGH_MEMORY_USAGE = 0.8; // 80%
const float CRITICAL_MEMORY_USAGE = 0.95; // 95%
const float WARNING_CPU = 70.0; // 70%
const float CRITICAL_CPU = 90.0; // 90%

// Sample intervals
const uint DEFAULT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL = 100; // ms
const uint FAST_SAMPLE_INTERVAL = 50; // ms
const uint SLOW_SAMPLE_INTERVAL = 500; // ms

// ============================================================================
// PERFORMANCE METRICS STRUCT
// ============================================================================

/// Performance metrics data structure
class PerformanceMetrics {
    // Timing
    float deltaTime = 0.0;
    float fps = 0.0;
    float averageFPS = 0.0;
    float minFPS = 999.0;
    float maxFPS = 0.0;
    
    // Memory
    uint64 memoryUsed = 0;
    uint64 memoryTotal = 0;
    float memoryUsage = 0.0;
    
    // CPU
    float cpuUsage = 0.0;
    
    // Frame timing
    float frameTime = 0.0;
    float averageFrameTime = 0.0;
    float minFrameTime = 999.0;
    float maxFrameTime = 0.0;
    
    // Counters
    uint64 framesRendered = 0;
    uint64 drawCalls = 0;
    uint64 triangles = 0;
    uint64 entitiesProcessed = 0;
    uint64 memoryOperations = 0;
    
    // Timestamps
    uint64 lastUpdate = 0;
    uint64 startTime = 0;
    
    // State
    bool isMonitoring = false;
    bool isPaused = false;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    PerformanceMetrics() {
        startTime = platform::time();
        lastUpdate = startTime;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // UPDATE
    // ============================================================================

    /// Update metrics
    void update() {
        if (!isMonitoring || isPaused) {
            return;
        }

        uint64 currentTime = platform::time();
        deltaTime = (currentTime - lastUpdate) / 1000.0; // Convert to seconds
        
        if (deltaTime > 0) {
            // Calculate FPS
            fps = 1.0 / deltaTime;
            
            // Update frame time
            frameTime = deltaTime * 1000.0; // Convert to milliseconds
            
            // Update statistics
            updateStatistics();
            
            // Reset frame counters
            drawCalls = 0;
            triangles = 0;
            entitiesProcessed = 0;
            memoryOperations = 0;
        }
        
        lastUpdate = currentTime;
    }

    /// Update statistics
    void updateStatistics() {
        framesRendered++;
        
        // Update FPS statistics
        if (fps > 0) {
            if (fps < minFPS) minFPS = fps;
            if (fps > maxFPS) maxFPS = fps;
            
            // Simple moving average for FPS
            if (averageFPS == 0) {
                averageFPS = fps;
            } else {
                averageFPS = (averageFPS + fps) / 2.0;
            }
        }
        
        // Update frame time statistics
        if (frameTime > 0) {
            if (frameTime < minFrameTime) minFrameTime = frameTime;
            if (frameTime > maxFrameTime) maxFrameTime = frameTime;
            
            // Simple moving average for frame time
            if (averageFrameTime == 0) {
                averageFrameTime = frameTime;
            } else {
                averageFrameTime = (averageFrameTime + frameTime) / 2.0;
            }
        }
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // GETTERS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get FPS color based on threshold
    string getFPSColor() {
        if (fps < CRITICAL_FPS) {
            return "red";
        } else if (fps < WARNING_FPS) {
            return "yellow";
        }
        return "green";
    }

    /// Get memory usage color based on threshold
    string getMemoryColor() {
        if (memoryUsage > CRITICAL_MEMORY_USAGE) {
            return "red";
        } else if (memoryUsage > HIGH_MEMORY_USAGE) {
            return "yellow";
        }
        return "green";
    }

    /// Get CPU usage color based on threshold
    string getCPUColor() {
        if (cpuUsage > CRITICAL_CPU) {
            return "red";
        } else if (cpuUsage > WARNING_CPU) {
            return "yellow";
        }
        return "green";
    }

    /// Get overall status color
    string getStatusColor() {
        if (getFPSColor() == "red" || getMemoryColor() == "red" || getCPUColor() == "red") {
            return "red";
        }
        if (getFPSColor() == "yellow" || getMemoryColor() == "yellow" || getCPUColor() == "yellow") {
            return "yellow";
        }
        return "green";
    }

    /// Get performance score (0-100)
    float getPerformanceScore() {
        float score = 100.0;
        
        // FPS penalty
        if (fps < CRITICAL_FPS) {
            score -= 40.0;
        } else if (fps < WARNING_FPS) {
            score -= 20.0;
        }
        
        // Memory penalty
        if (memoryUsage > CRITICAL_MEMORY_USAGE) {
            score -= 25.0;
        } else if (memoryUsage > HIGH_MEMORY_USAGE) {
            score -= 15.0;
        }
        
        // CPU penalty
        if (cpuUsage > CRITICAL_CPU) {
            score -= 25.0;
        } else if (cpuUsage > WARNING_CPU) {
            score -= 10.0;
        }
        
        return max(score, 0.0);
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // INCREMENT COUNTERS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Increment draw calls
    void incrementDrawCalls(uint count = 1) {
        drawCalls += count;
    }

    /// Increment triangles
    void incrementTriangles(uint count = 1) {
        triangles += count;
    }

    /// Increment entities processed
    void incrementEntitiesProcessed(uint count = 1) {
        entitiesProcessed += count;
    }

    /// Increment memory operations
    void incrementMemoryOperations(uint count = 1) {
        memoryOperations += count;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // RESET
    // ============================================================================

    /// Reset statistics
    void resetStatistics() {
        averageFPS = 0.0;
        minFPS = 999.0;
        maxFPS = 0.0;
        averageFrameTime = 0.0;
        minFrameTime = 999.0;
        maxFrameTime = 0.0;
        framesRendered = 0;
    }

    /// Reset counters
    void resetCounters() {
        drawCalls = 0;
        triangles = 0;
        entitiesProcessed = 0;
        memoryOperations = 0;
    }

    /// Reset all
    void resetAll() {
        deltaTime = 0.0;
        fps = 0.0;
        averageFPS = 0.0;
        minFPS = 999.0;
        maxFPS = 0.0;
        memoryUsed = 0;
        memoryTotal = 0;
        memoryUsage = 0.0;
        cpuUsage = 0.0;
        frameTime = 0.0;
        averageFrameTime = 0.0;
        minFrameTime = 999.0;
        maxFrameTime = 0.0;
        framesRendered = 0;
        drawCalls = 0;
        triangles = 0;
        entitiesProcessed = 0;
        memoryOperations = 0;
        startTime = platform::time();
        lastUpdate = startTime;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // SERIALIZATION
    // ============================================================================

    /// Convert to dictionary for serialization
    dict toDict() {
        return {
            {"deltaTime", deltaTime},
            {"fps", fps},
            {"averageFPS", averageFPS},
            {"minFPS", minFPS},
            {"maxFPS", maxFPS},
            {"memoryUsed", memoryUsed},
            {"memoryTotal", memoryTotal},
            {"memoryUsage", memoryUsage},
            {"cpuUsage", cpuUsage},
            {"frameTime", frameTime},
            {"averageFrameTime", averageFrameTime},
            {"minFrameTime", minFrameTime},
            {"maxFrameTime", maxFrameTime},
            {"framesRendered", framesRendered},
            {"drawCalls", drawCalls},
            {"triangles", triangles},
            {"entitiesProcessed", entitiesProcessed},
            {"memoryOperations", memoryOperations},
            {"isMonitoring", isMonitoring},
            {"isPaused", isPaused},
            {"performanceScore", getPerformanceScore()},
            {"statusColor", getStatusColor()}
        };
    }

    /// Load from dictionary
    void fromDict(dict@ data) {
        if (data.exists("deltaTime")) deltaTime = data["deltaTime"].toFloat();
        if (data.exists("fps")) fps = data["fps"].toFloat();
        if (data.exists("averageFPS")) averageFPS = data["averageFPS"].toFloat();
        if (data.exists("minFPS")) minFPS = data["minFPS"].toFloat();
        if (data.exists("maxFPS")) maxFPS = data["maxFPS"].toFloat();
        if (data.exists("memoryUsed")) memoryUsed = data["memoryUsed"].toInteger();
        if (data.exists("memoryTotal")) memoryTotal = data["memoryTotal"].toInteger();
        if (data.exists("memoryUsage")) memoryUsage = data["memoryUsage"].toFloat();
        if (data.exists("cpuUsage")) cpuUsage = data["cpuUsage"].toFloat();
        if (data.exists("frameTime")) frameTime = data["frameTime"].toFloat();
        if (data.exists("averageFrameTime")) averageFrameTime = data["averageFrameTime"].toFloat();
        if (data.exists("minFrameTime")) minFrameTime = data["minFrameTime"].toFloat();
        if (data.exists("maxFrameTime")) maxFrameTime = data["maxFrameTime"].toFloat();
        if (data.exists("framesRendered")) framesRendered = data["framesRendered"].toInteger();
        if (data.exists("drawCalls")) drawCalls = data["drawCalls"].toInteger();
        if (data.exists("triangles")) triangles = data["triangles"].toInteger();
        if (data.exists("entitiesProcessed")) entitiesProcessed = data["entitiesProcessed"].toInteger();
        if (data.exists("memoryOperations")) memoryOperations = data["memoryOperations"].toInteger();
        if (data.exists("isMonitoring")) isMonitoring = data["isMonitoring"].toBool();
        if (data.exists("isPaused")) isPaused = data["isPaused"].toBool();
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PERFORMANCE MONITOR
// ============================================================================

/// Performance monitoring system
class PerformanceMonitor {
    private PerformanceMetrics@ metrics;
    private uint sampleInterval;
    private uint64 lastSampleTime;
    private bool isRunning;
    
    // Callbacks
    private func@ onUpdateCallback;
    private func@ onWarningCallback;
    private func@ onCriticalCallback;
    
    // History
    private array<dict@> history;
    private uint maxHistorySize = 100;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    PerformanceMonitor(uint sampleInterval = DEFAULT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL) {
        metrics = PerformanceMetrics();
        this.sampleInterval = sampleInterval;
        lastSampleTime = platform::time();
        isRunning = false;
        history = {};
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CONTROL
    // ============================================================================

    /// Start monitoring
    void start() {
        if (isRunning) {
            return;
        }
        
        isRunning = true;
        metrics.isMonitoring = true;
        lastSampleTime = platform::time();
        
        print("[PerformanceMonitor] Started monitoring\n");
    }

    /// Stop monitoring
    void stop() {
        if (!isRunning) {
            return;
        }
        
        isRunning = false;
        metrics.isMonitoring = false;
        
        print("[PerformanceMonitor] Stopped monitoring\n");
    }

    /// Pause monitoring
    void pause() {
        metrics.isPaused = true;
    }

    /// Resume monitoring
    void resume() {
        metrics.isPaused = false;
    }

    /// Check if running
    bool isRunning() {
        return isRunning;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // UPDATE
    // ============================================================================

    /// Update the monitor
    void update() {
        if (!isRunning) {
            return;
        }

        uint64 currentTime = platform::time();
        uint64 elapsed = currentTime - lastSampleTime;
        
        if (elapsed >= sampleInterval) {
            // Collect system metrics
            collectSystemMetrics();
            
            // Update metrics
            metrics.update();
            
            // Check for warnings/critical
            checkThresholds();
            
            // Store history
            storeHistory();
            
            // Notify callbacks
            notifyCallbacks();
            
            lastSampleTime = currentTime;
        }
    }

    /// Collect system metrics
    void collectSystemMetrics() {
        // Platform-specific system metrics collection
        // This is a placeholder - actual implementation depends on the platform
        
        // Memory usage (placeholder values)
        metrics.memoryUsed = platform::memory_usage();
        metrics.memoryTotal = platform::memory_total();
        if (metrics.memoryTotal > 0) {
            metrics.memoryUsage = float(metrics.memoryUsed) / float(metrics.memoryTotal);
        }
        
        // CPU usage (placeholder)
        metrics.cpuUsage = platform::cpu_usage();
    }

    /// Check performance thresholds
    void checkThresholds() {
        bool hasWarning = false;
        bool hasCritical = false;
        
        // Check FPS
        if (metrics.fps < CRITICAL_FPS) {
            hasCritical = true;
            print("[PerformanceMonitor] CRITICAL: FPS is " + metrics.fps + "\n");
        } else if (metrics.fps < WARNING_FPS) {
            hasWarning = true;
            print("[PerformanceMonitor] WARNING: FPS is " + metrics.fps + "\n");
        }
        
        // Check memory
        if (metrics.memoryUsage > CRITICAL_MEMORY_USAGE) {
            hasCritical = true;
            print("[PerformanceMonitor] CRITICAL: Memory usage is " + (metrics.memoryUsage * 100) + "%\n");
        } else if (metrics.memoryUsage > HIGH_MEMORY_USAGE) {
            hasWarning = true;
            print("[PerformanceMonitor] WARNING: Memory usage is " + (metrics.memoryUsage * 100) + "%\n");
        }
        
        // Check CPU
        if (metrics.cpuUsage > CRITICAL_CPU) {
            hasCritical = true;
            print("[PerformanceMonitor] CRITICAL: CPU usage is " + metrics.cpuUsage + "%\n");
        } else if (metrics.cpuUsage > WARNING_CPU) {
            hasWarning = true;
            print("[PerformanceMonitor] WARNING: CPU usage is " + metrics.cpuUsage + "%\n");
        }
        
        // Trigger callbacks
        if (hasCritical && onCriticalCallback) {
            onCriticalCallback.call(this, metrics);
        } else if (hasWarning && onWarningCallback) {
            onWarningCallback.call(this, metrics);
        }
    }

    /// Store history
    void storeHistory() {
        dict@ snapshot = metrics.toDict();
        snapshot["timestamp"] = platform::time();
        
        history.push(snapshot);
        
        // Trim history
        if (history.size() > maxHistorySize) {
            history.removeAt(0);
        }
    }

    /// Notify callbacks
    void notifyCallbacks() {
        if (onUpdateCallback) {
            onUpdateCallback.call(this, metrics);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // GETTERS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get metrics
    PerformanceMetrics@ getMetrics() {
        return metrics;
    }

    /// Get history
    array<dict@> getHistory() {
        return history;
    }

    /// Get average metrics over history
    dict getAverageHistory() {
        if (history.size() == 0) {
            return {};
        }
        
        dict averages = {
            {"fps", 0.0},
            {"memoryUsage", 0.0},
            {"cpuUsage", 0.0},
            {"frameTime", 0.0}
        };
        
        for (uint i = 0; i < history.size(); i++) {
            dict@ entry = history[i];
            averages["fps"] += entry["fps"].toFloat();
            averages["memoryUsage"] += entry["memoryUsage"].toFloat();
            averages["cpuUsage"] += entry["cpuUsage"].toFloat();
            averages["frameTime"] += entry["frameTime"].toFloat();
        }
        
        float count = float(history.size());
        averages["fps"] /= count;
        averages["memoryUsage"] /= count;
        averages["cpuUsage"] /= count;
        averages["frameTime"] /= count;
        
        return averages;
    }

    /// Get minimum metrics over history
    dict getMinHistory() {
        if (history.size() == 0) {
            return {};
        }
        
        dict mins = {
            {"fps", 999.0},
            {"memoryUsage", 999.0},
            {"cpuUsage", 999.0},
            {"frameTime", 999.0}
        };
        
        for (uint i = 0; i < history.size(); i++) {
            dict@ entry = history[i];
            float fps = entry["fps"].toFloat();
            float memory = entry["memoryUsage"].toFloat();
            float cpu = entry["cpuUsage"].toFloat();
            float frameTime = entry["frameTime"].toFloat();
            
            if (fps < mins["fps"]) mins["fps"] = fps;
            if (memory < mins["memoryUsage"]) mins["memoryUsage"] = memory;
            if (cpu < mins["cpuUsage"]) mins["cpuUsage"] = cpu;
            if (frameTime < mins["frameTime"]) mins["frameTime"] = frameTime;
        }
        
        return mins;
    }

    /// Get maximum metrics over history
    dict getMaxHistory() {
        if (history.size() == 0) {
            return {};
        }
        
        dict maxs = {
            {"fps", 0.0},
            {"memoryUsage", 0.0},
            {"cpuUsage", 0.0},
            {"frameTime", 0.0}
        };
        
        for (uint i = 0; i < history.size(); i++) {
            dict@ entry = history[i];
            float fps = entry["fps"].toFloat();
            float memory = entry["memoryUsage"].toFloat();
            float cpu = entry["cpuUsage"].toFloat();
            float frameTime = entry["frameTime"].toFloat();
            
            if (fps > maxs["fps"]) maxs["fps"] = fps;
            if (memory > maxs["memoryUsage"]) maxs["memoryUsage"] = memory;
            if (cpu > maxs["cpuUsage"]) maxs["cpuUsage"] = cpu;
            if (frameTime > maxs["frameTime"]) maxs["frameTime"] = frameTime;
        }
        
        return maxs;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // SETTINGS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set sample interval
    void setSampleInterval(uint interval) {
        sampleInterval = interval;
    }

    /// Get sample interval
    uint getSampleInterval() {
        return sampleInterval;
    }

    /// Set max history size
    void setMaxHistorySize(uint size) {
        maxHistorySize = size;
        
        // Trim history if needed
        while (history.size() > maxHistorySize) {
            history.removeAt(0);
        }
    }

    /// Get max history size
    uint getMaxHistorySize() {
        return maxHistorySize;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CALLBACKS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set update callback
    void setOnUpdate(func@ callback) {
        onUpdateCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set warning callback
    void setOnWarning(func@ callback) {
        onWarningCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set critical callback
    void setOnCritical(func@ callback) {
        onCriticalCallback = callback;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // RESET
    // ============================================================================

    /// Reset monitor
    void reset() {
        metrics.resetAll();
        history.clear();
    }

    /// Clear history
    void clearHistory() {
        history.clear();
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PERFORMANCE PROFILER
// ============================================================================

/// Performance profiler for timing code execution
class PerformanceProfiler {
    private dict<string, dict@> profiles;
    private dict<string, uint64> startTimes;
    
    // Callbacks
    private func@ onProfileStartCallback;
    private func@ onProfileEndCallback;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    PerformanceProfiler() {
        profiles = {};
        startTimes = {};
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // PROFILING
    // ============================================================================

    /// Start profiling a section
    void startProfile(string name) {
        uint64 startTime = platform::time();
        startTimes[name] = startTime;
        
        // Initialize profile if it doesn't exist
        if (!profiles.exists(name)) {
            profiles[name] = {
                {"name", name},
                {"totalTime", 0},
                {"callCount", 0},
                {"minTime", 999999},
                {"maxTime", 0},
                {"averageTime", 0.0},
                {"isRunning", true},
                {"startTime", startTime}
            };
        } else {
            profiles[name]["isRunning"] = true;
            profiles[name]["startTime"] = startTime;
        }
        
        if (onProfileStartCallback) {
            onProfileStartCallback.call(this, name);
        }
    }

    /// End profiling a section
    void endProfile(string name) {
        if (!startTimes.exists(name)) {
            print("[PerformanceProfiler] Profile '" + name + "' was not started\n");
            return;
        }
        
        uint64 endTime = platform::time();
        uint64 startTime = startTimes[name];
        uint64 elapsed = endTime - startTime;
        
        // Remove from start times
        startTimes.remove(name);
        
        if (!profiles.exists(name)) {
            print("[PerformanceProfiler] Profile '" + name + "' not found\n");
            return;
        }
        
        dict@ profile = profiles[name];
        
        // Update profile statistics
        profile["totalTime"] += elapsed;
        profile["callCount"] += 1;
        
        if (elapsed < profile["minTime"]) {
            profile["minTime"] = elapsed;
        }
        if (elapsed > profile["maxTime"]) {
            profile["maxTime"] = elapsed;
        }
        
        // Update average
        profile["averageTime"] = float(profile["totalTime"]) / float(profile["callCount"]);
        profile["isRunning"] = false;
        profile["lastTime"] = elapsed;
        
        if (onProfileEndCallback) {
            onProfileEndCallback.call(this, name, profile);
        }
    }

    /// Get profile by name
    dict@ getProfile(string name) {
        if (profiles.exists(name)) {
            return profiles[name];
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// Get all profiles
    array<dict@> getAllProfiles() {
        return profiles.values();
    }

    /// Get profile names
    array<string> getProfileNames() {
        return profiles.keys();
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // UTILITY FUNCTIONS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Reset a profile
    void resetProfile(string name) {
        if (profiles.exists(name)) {
            profiles[name] = {
                {"name", name},
                {"totalTime", 0},
                {"callCount", 0},
                {"minTime", 999999},
                {"maxTime", 0},
                {"averageTime", 0.0},
                {"isRunning", false},
                {"startTime", 0},
                {"lastTime", 0}
            };
        }
    }

    /// Reset all profiles
    void resetAllProfiles() {
        profiles.clear();
        startTimes.clear();
    }

    /// Remove a profile
    void removeProfile(string name) {
        profiles.remove(name);
        startTimes.remove(name);
    }

    /// Check if profile is running
    bool isProfileRunning(string name) {
        if (!profiles.exists(name)) {
            return false;
        }
        return profiles[name]["isRunning"].toBool();
    }

    /// Get total time for a profile
    uint64 getTotalTime(string name) {
        if (!profiles.exists(name)) {
            return 0;
        }
        return profiles[name]["totalTime"].toInteger();
    }

    /// Get call count for a profile
    uint64 getCallCount(string name) {
        if (!profiles.exists(name)) {
            return 0;
        }
        return profiles[name]["callCount"].toInteger();
    }

    /// Get average time for a profile
    float getAverageTime(string name) {
        if (!profiles.exists(name)) {
            return 0.0;
        }
        return profiles[name]["averageTime"].toFloat();
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CALLBACKS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set profile start callback
    void setOnProfileStart(func@ callback) {
        onProfileStartCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set profile end callback
    void setOnProfileEnd(func@ callback) {
        onProfileEndCallback = callback;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // FRAME MARKERS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Mark the start of a frame
    void markFrameStart() {
        startProfile("Frame");
    }

    /// Mark the end of a frame
    void markFrameEnd() {
        endProfile("Frame");
    }

    /// Get frame statistics
    dict getFrameStats() {
        dict@ frameProfile = getProfile("Frame");
        
        if (frameProfile == null) {
            return {
                {"averageFPS", 0},
                {"minFPS", 0},
                {"maxFPS", 0},
                {"averageFrameTime", 0}
            };
        }
        
        // Calculate FPS from frame time
        float avgFrameTime = frameProfile["averageTime"].toFloat();
        float avgFPS = avgFrameTime > 0 ? 1000.0 / avgFrameTime : 0;
        float minFPS = frameProfile["minTime"].toFloat() > 0 ? 1000.0 / frameProfile["minTime"].toFloat() : 0;
        float maxFPS = frameProfile["maxTime"].toFloat() > 0 ? 1000.0 / frameProfile["maxTime"].toFloat() : 0;
        
        return {
            {"averageFPS", avgFPS},
            {"minFPS", minFPS},
            {"maxFPS", maxFPS},
            {"averageFrameTime", avgFrameTime},
            {"totalFrames", frameProfile["callCount"]},
            {"totalTime", frameProfile["totalTime"]}
        };
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZER

/// Performance optimizer for automatic optimization
class PerformanceOptimizer {
    private PerformanceMonitor@ monitor;
    private PerformanceProfiler@ profiler;
    
    // Settings
    private dict<string, dict@> optimizationSettings;
    
    // State
    private bool isEnabled = true;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    PerformanceOptimizer() {
        monitor = PerformanceMonitor();
        profiler = PerformanceProfiler();
        
        // Default optimization settings
        optimizationSettings = {
            {"fps_threshold", {"enabled", true, "value", WARNING_FPS}},
            {"memory_threshold", {"enabled", true, "value", HIGH_MEMORY_USAGE}},
            {"cpu_threshold", {"enabled", true, "value", WARNING_CPU}},
            {"auto_quality", {"enabled", true, "min_fps", WARNING_FPS}},
            {"culling", {"enabled", true, "max_entities", 100}},
            {"lod", {"enabled", true, "distance", 100.0}}
        };
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CONTROL
    // ============================================================================

    /// Start the optimizer
    void start() {
        if (!isEnabled) {
            return;
        }
        
        monitor.start();
        print("[PerformanceOptimizer] Started\n");
    }

    /// Stop the optimizer
    void stop() {
        monitor.stop();
        print("[PerformanceOptimizer] Stopped\n");
    }

    /// Enable/disable optimizer
    void setEnabled(bool enabled) {
        isEnabled = enabled;
    }

    /// Check if enabled
    bool isEnabled() {
        return isEnabled;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // UPDATE
    // ============================================================================

    /// Update the optimizer
    void update() {
        if (!isEnabled) {
            return;
        }
        
        monitor.update();
        profiler.markFrameEnd();
        profiler.markFrameStart();
        
        // Check for optimization opportunities
        checkOptimizations();
    }

    /// Check for optimization opportunities
    void checkOptimizations() {
        PerformanceMetrics@ metrics = monitor.getMetrics();
        
        // Check FPS optimization
        if (optimizationSettings["auto_quality"]["enabled"].toBool()) {
            float fpsThreshold = optimizationSettings["auto_quality"]["min_fps"].toFloat();
            
            if (metrics.fps < fpsThreshold) {
                // Reduce quality
                optimizeQuality();
            } else if (metrics.fps > fpsThreshold * 1.5) {
                // Increase quality if FPS is good
                restoreQuality();
            }
        }
        
        // Check memory optimization
        if (optimizationSettings["memory_threshold"]["enabled"].toBool()) {
            float memoryThreshold = optimizationSettings["memory_threshold"]["value"].toFloat();
            
            if (metrics.memoryUsage > memoryThreshold) {
                optimizeMemory();
            }
        }
        
        // Check CPU optimization
        if (optimizationSettings["cpu_threshold"]["enabled"].toBool()) {
            float cpuThreshold = optimizationSettings["cpu_threshold"]["value"].toFloat();
            
            if (metrics.cpuUsage > cpuThreshold) {
                optimizeCPU();
            }
        }
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // OPTIMIZATION STRATEGIES
    // ============================================================================

    /// Optimize for FPS
    void optimizeFPS() {
        print("[PerformanceOptimizer] Optimizing for FPS\n");
        
        // Disable expensive features
        // Reduce rendering quality
        // Limit entity processing
    }

    /// Optimize quality
    void optimizeQuality() {
        print("[PerformanceOptimizer] Reducing quality for performance\n");
        
        // Reduce rendering distance
        // Disable post-processing effects
        // Lower texture quality
    }

    /// Restore quality
    void restoreQuality() {
        print("[PerformanceOptimizer] Restoring quality\n");
        
        // Increase rendering distance
        // Enable post-processing effects
        // Raise texture quality
    }

    /// Optimize memory
    void optimizeMemory() {
        print("[PerformanceOptimizer] Optimizing memory usage\n");
        
        // Clear unused resources
        // Reduce texture cache
        // Limit entity count
    }

    /// Optimize CPU
    void optimizeCPU() {
        print("[PerformanceOptimizer] Optimizing CPU usage\n");
        
        // Reduce physics calculations
        // Limit AI processing
        // Simplify collision detection
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // SETTINGS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set optimization setting
    void setSetting(string category, string key, bool value) {
        if (optimizationSettings.exists(category) && optimizationSettings[category].exists(key)) {
            optimizationSettings[category][key] = value;
        }
    }

    /// Get optimization setting
    bool getSetting(string category, string key) {
        if (optimizationSettings.exists(category) && optimizationSettings[category].exists(key)) {
            return optimizationSettings[category][key].toBool();
        }
        return false;
    }

    /// Set optimization value
    void setValue(string category, string key, float value) {
        if (optimizationSettings.exists(category) && optimizationSettings[category].exists(key)) {
            optimizationSettings[category][key] = value;
        }
    }

    /// Get optimization value
    float getValue(string category, string key) {
        if (optimizationSettings.exists(category) && optimizationSettings[category].exists(key)) {
            return optimizationSettings[category][key].toFloat();
        }
        return 0.0;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // GETTERS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get performance monitor
    PerformanceMonitor@ getMonitor() {
        return monitor;
    }

    /// Get performance profiler
    PerformanceProfiler@ getProfiler() {
        return profiler;
    }

    /// Get optimization settings
    dict getOptimizationSettings() {
        return optimizationSettings;
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// FPS LIMITER
// ============================================================================

/// FPS limiter for controlling frame rate
class FPSLimiter {
    private float targetFPS;
    private float minFrameTime;
    private uint64 lastFrameTime;
    private bool isEnabled;
    
    // Callbacks
    private func@ onFrameSkipCallback;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    FPSLimiter(float targetFPS = 60.0) {
        this.targetFPS = targetFPS;
        minFrameTime = targetFPS > 0 ? 1000.0 / targetFPS : 0;
        lastFrameTime = platform::time();
        isEnabled = true;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CONTROL
    // ============================================================================

    /// Enable/disable FPS limiter
    void setEnabled(bool enabled) {
        isEnabled = enabled;
    }

    /// Check if enabled
    bool isEnabled() {
        return isEnabled;
    }

    /// Set target FPS
    void setTargetFPS(float fps) {
        targetFPS = fps;
        minFrameTime = fps > 0 ? 1000.0 / fps : 0;
    }

    /// Get target FPS
    float getTargetFPS() {
        return targetFPS;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // FRAME CONTROL
    // ============================================================================

    /// Check if we should render a frame
    bool shouldRender() {
        if (!isEnabled || targetFPS <= 0) {
            return true;
        }

        uint64 currentTime = platform::time();
        uint64 elapsed = currentTime - lastFrameTime;
        
        if (elapsed >= minFrameTime) {
            lastFrameTime = currentTime;
            return true;
        }
        
        // Should skip frame
        if (onFrameSkipCallback) {
            onFrameSkipCallback.call(this, elapsed, minFrameTime);
        }
        
        return false;
    }

    /// Wait for next frame
    void waitForNextFrame() {
        if (!isEnabled || targetFPS <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        uint64 currentTime = platform::time();
        uint64 elapsed = currentTime - lastFrameTime;
        uint64 remaining = uint64(minFrameTime) - elapsed;
        
        if (remaining > 0) {
            platform::sleep(remaining);
        }
        
        lastFrameTime = platform::time();
    }

    /// Get time since last frame
    float getTimeSinceLastFrame() {
        uint64 currentTime = platform::time();
        uint64 elapsed = currentTime - lastFrameTime;
        return float(elapsed);
    }

    /// Get current FPS
    float getCurrentFPS() {
        uint64 currentTime = platform::time();
        uint64 elapsed = currentTime - lastFrameTime;
        return elapsed > 0 ? 1000.0 / elapsed : 0;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CALLBACKS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set frame skip callback
    void setOnFrameSkip(func@ callback) {
        onFrameSkipCallback = callback;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // RESET
    // ============================================================================

    /// Reset frame timer
    void reset() {
        lastFrameTime = platform::time();
    }
}
```

`app/echo/echo-reverse-agent.as`:

```as
// echo-reverse-agent.as: read-only alternative to echo-reverse.as, only connects
// Echo's built-in socket server to echo-reverse (no writes, scans or emulator).
// 1. Start echo-reverse (its relay listens on ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent).
// 2. Set PROCESS_NAME, copy this file to %APPDATA%\scripts and load it in Echo.
// Echo then serves read, read_batch, modules, sig_scan(_ida), string_scan,
// resolve_relative, rtti_resolve(_batch), enumerate_functions and disassemble.

const string PROCESS_NAME = "YourGame.exe";
const string RELAY_URL = "ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent";

void connect()
{
    if (!process::is_alive() && process::attach(PROCESS_NAME).pid == 0)
    {
        alert::show("[echo-reverse] attach failed, is " + PROCESS_NAME + " running?");
        return;
    }
    // false when the relay is down or a socket is already open (one at a time)
    if (process::open_socket(RELAY_URL)) alert::show("[echo-reverse] connected to " + RELAY_URL);
    else alert::show("[echo-reverse] open_socket failed, start echo-reverse or detach first");
}

void on_connect_click() { connect(); }

void on_detach_click()
{
    process::detach(); // closes the socket too
    alert::show("[echo-reverse] detached");
}

bool main()
{
    ui::add_tab("echo-reverse");
    ui::add_category("Relay");
    ui::add_button("Attach + connect", @on_connect_click);
    ui::add_button("Detach", @on_detach_click);
    connect();
    return true;
}

void on_unload()
{
    process::detach();
}
```

`app/echo/echo-reverse-overlay.as`:

```as
// app/echo/echo-reverse-overlay.as
// ESP overlay generated by echo-reverse's Overlay panel (echo-esp-preview port).
// The app rewrites the constants below from the panel; everything else is the
// Echo Universal API only. Load it from Echo's script menu like any other script.
//
// The defaults are deliberately inert (RVA 0): the panel always fills them in.
// Entity layout assumed: a pointer array (or one pointer to it) of entity
// pointers, an entity position (float x/y/z) and optionally health and team
// integers. Swap the reads for your game's real layout if it differs.

const string PROCESS_NAME = "YourGame.exe";
const uint64 ENTITY_LIST_RVA = 0x0;
const bool ENTITY_LIST_DEREF = true;
const int ENTITY_COUNT = 128;
const int ENTITY_STRIDE = 8;
const uint64 POS_OFFSET = 0x0;
const uint64 HEALTH_OFFSET = 0x0;
const uint64 TEAM_OFFSET = 0x0;
const int LOCAL_TEAM = -1;
const uint64 VIEW_MATRIX_RVA = 0x0;
const bool UNITY_COORDS = false;
const float BOX_WIDTH = 28.0f;
const float BOX_HEIGHT = 72.0f;
const bool LABEL_BOTTOM = false;
const bool BAR_RIGHT = false;

checkbox g_enabled;
checkbox g_health_text;
checkbox g_health_bar;
checkbox g_only_with_menu;
color_picker g_box_color;
color_picker g_text_color;

uint64 g_base = 0;

vec3 make_vec3(float x, float y, float z)
{
    vec3 v;
    v.x = x;
    v.y = y;
    v.z = z;
    return v;
}

void render_entity(uint64 ent, int index, color box_col, color text_col)
{
    vec3 feet;
    if (!feet.read_float(ent + POS_OFFSET)) return;
    if (feet.x == 0.0f && feet.y == 0.0f && feet.z == 0.0f) return;

    matrix4x4 view;
    if (!view.read(g_base + VIEW_MATRIX_RVA)) return;

    bbox_2d bb;
    if (UNITY_COORDS)
    {
        vec3 center = make_vec3(0.0f, BOX_HEIGHT * 0.5f, 0.0f);
        vec3 extents = make_vec3(BOX_WIDTH * 0.5f, BOX_HEIGHT * 0.5f, BOX_WIDTH * 0.5f);
        bb = render::calculate_2d_bbox_unity(feet, center, extents, view);
    }
    else
    {
        vec3 mins = make_vec3(-BOX_WIDTH * 0.5f, -BOX_WIDTH * 0.5f, 0.0f);
        vec3 maxs = make_vec3(BOX_WIDTH * 0.5f, BOX_WIDTH * 0.5f, BOX_HEIGHT);
        bb = render::calculate_2d_bbox(feet, mins, maxs, view);
    }
    if (!bb.valid) return;

    int x = int(bb.x);
    int y = int(bb.y);
    int w = int(bb.width);
    int h = int(bb.height);
    if (w < 2 || h < 2 || w > 4096 || h > 4096) return;

    render::draw_box(x, y, w, h, box_col.r, box_col.g, box_col.b, box_col.a, box_style::CORNERED, 0.25f);

    int hp = -1;
    if (HEALTH_OFFSET > 0) process::read_int32(ent + HEALTH_OFFSET, hp);

    if (ui::get(g_health_bar) && hp >= 0)
    {
        float frac = float(hp) / 100.0f;
        if (frac > 1.0f) frac = 1.0f;
        if (frac < 0.0f) frac = 0.0f;
        int filled = int(float(h) * frac);
        int bar_x = BAR_RIGHT ? x + w + 2 : x - 5;
        render::draw_box(bar_x, y, 3, h, 20, 20, 20, 180, box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
        render::draw_box(bar_x, y + h - filled, 3, filled, 60, 220, 90, 230, box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
    }

    if (ui::get(g_health_text))
    {
        string label = util::format_string("#{}", index);
        if (hp >= 0) label = util::format_string("#{}  {} hp", index, hp);
        render::draw_text_outlined(x, LABEL_BOTTOM ? y + h + 2 : y - 14, label, text_col.r, text_col.g, text_col.b, text_col.a);
    }
}

void render_tick()
{
    if (g_base == 0 || !ui::get(g_enabled)) return;
    if (ui::get(g_only_with_menu) && !ui::is_open()) return;

    uint64 list = g_base + ENTITY_LIST_RVA;
    if (ENTITY_LIST_DEREF)
    {
        uint64 ptr;
        if (!process::read_uint64(list, ptr) || ptr == 0) return;
        list = ptr;
    }

    color box_col = ui::get(g_box_color);
    color text_col = ui::get(g_text_color);

    for (int i = 0; i < ENTITY_COUNT; i++)
    {
        uint64 ent;
        if (!process::read_uint64(list + i * ENTITY_STRIDE, ent) || ent == 0) continue;

        if (LOCAL_TEAM >= 0 && TEAM_OFFSET > 0)
        {
            int team;
            if (process::read_int32(ent + TEAM_OFFSET, team) && team == LOCAL_TEAM) continue;
        }

        render_entity(ent, i, box_col, text_col);
    }
}

bool main()
{
    ui::config_path("echo-reverse-overlay");
    ui::add_tab("Overlay");
    ui::add_category("ESP");
    g_enabled = ui::add_checkbox("Enabled", true);
    g_health_text = ui::add_checkbox("Health text", true);
    g_health_bar = ui::add_checkbox("Health bar", true);
    g_only_with_menu = ui::add_checkbox("Only while the menu is open", false);
    g_box_color = ui::add_color_picker("Box color", 80, 220, 255, 255);
    g_text_color = ui::add_color_picker("Text color", 235, 235, 235, 255, false);

    g_base = process::get_module_base(PROCESS_NAME);
    if (g_base == 0)
    {
        alert::show("[echo-reverse] " + PROCESS_NAME + " is not loaded");
        return false;
    }

    on_render(@render_tick);
    return true;
}
```
