`app/echo/echo-reverse.as`:

```as
// echo-reverse.as: the one script echo-reverse needs. Start echo-reverse (it
// copies this file to %APPDATA%\scripts), attach your game in Echo, load this.
// It opens Echo's built-in socket on /agent (read, modules, sig/string scans,
// rtti, functions, disassembly) and serves the verbs that socket doesn't have
// over ws:: on /agent-ext:
//   write         { address, data(hex) }
//   regions       {}                      present pages, protect synthesized from flags
//   scan_new      { width, kind: exact|unknown, value, limit }
//   scan_filter   { kind, value, value2, limit }
//   scan_clear    {}
//   emulate       { address, count, timeout_us, regs: { rcx: "0x..", ... }, trace_limit,
//                   stub_external (default true), api_return, track_writes (default true), writes_limit }
//                 calls that leave the start address's module are logged with rcx/rdx/r8/r9 and
//                 return api_return instead of running; stores are decoded with zydis and logged
//                 with the value written
//   capabilities  {}
//   attach        { pid } or { name }
//   detach        {}
//   process_alive {}                      check without attaching
//   query_region  { address }             query one virtual memory region
//   resolve_export { module, name }       resolve a named export
// Extended RPC handlers for Echo Backend features:
//   read_buffer, read_batch, find_signatures
//   pattern_scan_module, pattern_scan_all, pointer_chain_scan
//   dump_memory_region, dump_module, get_memory_regions
//   unreal_w2s, unreal_read_bones, unreal_entity_scan
//   unity_w2s, unity_transform_position, unity_prefab_id, unity_entity_scan
//   source_w2s, source_get_entity, source_get_entity_health
//   source2_w2s, source2_get_controller, source2_get_pawn
//   get_viewport_size, get_fps, get_camera_info
//   calculate_angle, calculate_2d_bbox, matrix_multiply, matrix_vector_multiply
//   quaternion_multiply, ray_plane_intersection, perlin_noise
//   simd_vec4_add, simd_vec4_mul, simd_vec4_dot, simd_vec4_length, simd_vec4_normalize
//   ray_cast, trace_line, clip_to_bbox, clip_point, is_on_screen
//   hash_fnv1a, hash_crc32, hash_md5, hash_sha256
//   get_system_info, get_process_info, get_module_list
//   performance_summary, get_all_counters, get_counter, update_counters
//   reset_counters, set_monitoring_enabled, get_memory_usage, get_cpu_usage
//   get_threads, add_tracked_value, remove_tracked_value, get_tracked_values
//   get_changed_values, update_tracked_values, clear_tracked_values
//   create_array, destroy_array, array_size, array_get, array_set, array_push
//   create_map, destroy_map, map_size, map_get, map_set, map_has, map_remove
//   http_get, http_post, http_put, http_delete
//   ws_connect, ws_send, ws_close, ws_get_messages
// Uses only the documented process::, ws::, json:: and uc:: APIs.

const string PROCESS_NAME = "YourGame.exe";
const string CORE_URL = "ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent";
const string RELAY_URL = "ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext";

// Include extended RPC handlers
#include "echo-rpc-extensions.as"

const uint64 USER_TOP = 0x7fffffffffff;
const uint64 SCAN_CHUNK = 0x100000;
const uint SCAN_MAX = 2000000;          // stored hits, the rest is reported as truncated
const uint64 SCAN_BYTES_MAX = uint64(4) << 30;
const uint REGIONS_MAX = 50000;
const uint64 EMU_COUNT_MAX = 5000000;
const uint64 EMU_TIMEOUT_MAX = 5000000; // microseconds
const uint EMU_TRACE_MAX = 100000;
const uint64 EMU_STACK = 0x10000;
const uint64 EMU_STACK_BASE = 0x7ffe0000000;
const uint64 EMU_STOP = 0x7ffe1000000;  // returning here ends the run

// The desktop app can attach another target through the extension lane. Once
// the user explicitly detaches, do not silently reattach PROCESS_NAME on the
// next request; only another explicit attach may change the target again.
bool g_allow_auto_attach = true;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

string hex(uint64 v) { return util::to_hex(v, true); }

uint64 parse_hex(const string &in s)
{
    uint64 v = 0;
    uint start = (s.length() > 1 && s[0] == 48 && (s[1] == 120 || s[1] == 88)) ? 2 : 0;
    for (uint i = start; i < s.length(); i++)
    {
        uint8 c = s[i];
        int d = (c >= 48 && c <= 57) ? int(c) - 48 : (c >= 97 && c <= 102) ? int(c) - 87 : (c >= 65 && c <= 70) ? int(c) - 55 : -1;
        if (d < 0) return 0;
        v = (v << 4) | uint64(d);
    }
    return v;
}

array<uint8> parse_bytes(const string &in s)
{
    array<uint8> out;
    for (uint i = 0; i + 1 < s.length(); i += 2) out.insertLast(uint8(parse_hex(s.substr(i, 2))));
    return out;
}

void reply(json_obj@ o, const string &in type, uint64 id)
{
    o.set("type", type);
    o.set("id", id);
    ws::send(json::stringify(o));
}

void fail(uint64 id, int code, const string &in message)
{
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("code", code);
    o.set("message", message);
    reply(o, "error", id);
}

bool ensure_attached()
{
    if (process::is_alive()) return true;
    if (!g_allow_auto_attach) return false;
    return process::attach(PROCESS_NAME).pid != 0;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- attach / detach

void handle_attach(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    uint pid = m.get_uint("pid");
    string name = m.get_string("name");
    attach_data data;
    if (pid != 0) data = process::attach(pid);
    else if (name != "") data = process::attach(name);
    else { fail(id, 1002, "attach needs a pid or process name"); return; }

    if (data.pid == 0) { fail(id, 1001, "attach failed"); return; }
    g_allow_auto_attach = true;
    // The built-in read/disassembly socket may have been closed while no target
    // was attached. Re-open it after a successful attach; false is harmless when
    // the same socket is already connected.
    process::open_socket(CORE_URL);

    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true);
    o.set("pid", uint64(data.pid));
    o.set("base", hex(data.base_address));
    o.set("peb", hex(data.peb_address));
    o.set("name", name);
    reply(o, "attach_result", id);
}

void handle_detach(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    process::detach();
    g_allow_auto_attach = false;
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true);
    reply(o, "detach_result", id);
}

void handle_process_alive(uint64 id)
{
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("alive", process::is_alive());
    reply(o, "process_alive_result", id);
}

void handle_query_region(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    uint64 address = parse_hex(m.get_string("address"));
    if (address == 0) { fail(id, 1002, "query_region needs an address"); return; }
    memory_region r = process::virtual_query(address);
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("base", hex(r.base));
    o.set("size", r.size);
    o.set("present", r.present);
    o.set("writable", r.writable);
    o.set("executable", r.executable);
    reply(o, "query_region_result", id);
}

void handle_resolve_export(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    string module = m.get_string("module");
    string name = m.get_string("name");
    if (module == "" || name == "") { fail(id, 1002, "resolve_export needs module and name"); return; }
    uint64 base = process::get_module_base(module);
    if (base == 0) { fail(id, 1002, "module not found: " + module); return; }
    uint64 address = process::get_module_export(base, name);
    if (address == 0) { fail(id, 1002, "export not found: " + name); return; }
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("address", hex(address));
    o.set("module_base", hex(base));
    reply(o, "resolve_export_result", id);
}

string operand_action_name(int action)
{
    if (action == op_action::read) return "read";
    if (action == op_action::write) return "write";
    if (action == op_action::readwrite) return "readwrite";
    if (action == op_action::condread) return "condread";
    if (action == op_action::condwrite) return "condwrite";
    if (action == op_action::read_condwrite) return "read_condwrite";
    if (action == op_action::condread_write) return "condread_write";
    return "none";
}

void handle_disassemble_detail(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    uint64 address = parse_hex(m.get_string("address"));
    uint size = m.get_uint("size");
    if (address == 0 || size == 0 || size > 4096) { fail(id, 1002, "size must be 1 to 4096 bytes"); return; }
    array<uint8>@ bytes = process::read_bytes(address, size);
    if (bytes is null || bytes.length() != size) { fail(id, 1003, "memory read failed"); return; }
    array<disasm_insn@> insns;
    if (!zydis::disasm(bytes, address, insns)) { fail(id, 1003, "disassembly failed"); return; }
    json_obj@ results = json::array();
    for (uint i = 0; i < insns.length(); i++)
    {
        disasm_insn@ insn = insns[i];
        json_obj@ row = json_obj();
        row.set("address", hex(insn.runtime_address)); row.set("length", uint(insn.length)); row.set("text", insn.text);
        json_obj@ operands = json::array();
        for (uint j = 0; j < insn.operand_count; j++)
        {
            disasm_operand op = insn.get_op(uint8(j));
            json_obj@ item = json_obj();
            item.set("type", op.type); item.set("visibility", op.visibility); item.set("action", op.action); item.set("action_name", operand_action_name(op.action));
            if (op.type == op_type::reg) item.set("register", zydis::reg_name(op.reg));
            if (op.type == op_type::imm) { item.set("value", hex(op.imm_value)); item.set("relative", op.imm_is_relative); item.set("signed", op.imm_is_signed); }
            if (op.type == op_type::mem) { string base = zydis::reg_name(op.mem_base); item.set("base", base); item.set("index", zydis::reg_name(op.mem_index)); item.set("segment", zydis::reg_name(op.mem_segment)); item.set("scale", uint(op.mem_scale)); item.set("displacement", "" + op.mem_disp); item.set("has_displacement", op.mem_has_disp); if (base == "rip") item.set("rip_relative_address", hex(insn.runtime_address + insn.length + uint64(op.mem_disp))); }
            operands.push(item);
        }
        row.set("operands", operands); results.push(row);
    }
    json_obj@ o = json_obj(); o.set("results", results); reply(o, "disassemble_detail_result", id);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- write / regions

void handle_write(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    uint64 addr = parse_hex(m.get_string("address"));
    array<uint8> bytes = parse_bytes(m.get_string("data"));
    bool ok = addr != 0 && bytes.length() > 0 && process::write_bytes(bytes, addr);
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", ok);
    o.set("address", hex(addr));
    o.set("bytes_written", ok ? bytes.length() : uint(0));
    reply(o, "write_result", id);
}

// PAGE_* equivalents so the ui's protection column reads like windows
uint protect_of(const memory_region &in r)
{
    if (r.executable) return r.writable ? 0x40 : 0x20;
    return r.writable ? 0x04 : 0x02;
}

void handle_regions(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    json_obj@ rows = json::array();
    uint64 addr = 0x10000;
    uint n = 0;
    for (; n < REGIONS_MAX && addr < USER_TOP; )
    {
        memory_region r = process::virtual_query(addr);
        if (r.size == 0 || r.base + r.size <= addr) { addr += 0x1000; continue; }
        if (r.present)
        {
            json_obj@ row = json_obj();
            row.set("base", hex(r.base));
            row.set("size", r.size);
            row.set("protect", protect_of(r));
            row.set("type", 0);
            rows.push(row);
            n++;
        }
        addr = r.base + r.size;
    }
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true);
    o.set("regions", rows);
    o.set("truncated", n >= REGIONS_MAX && addr < USER_TOP);
    reply(o, "regions_result", id);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- PE tables

uint16 rd_u16(uint64 at) { return uint16(process::read_uint64(at) & 0xFFFF); }
uint32 rd_u32(uint64 at) { return uint32(process::read_uint64(at) & 0xFFFFFFFF); }

bool module_for(json_obj@ m, string &out name, uint64 &out base, uint64 &out size)
{
    name = m.get_string("module");
    array<module_entry>@ mods = process::get_module_list();
    if (name == "" && mods !is null && mods.length() > 0) name = mods[0].name;
    if (name == "") return false;
    base = process::get_module_base(name);
    if (base == 0) return false;
    size = uint64(process::get_module_size(base));
    return size != 0;
}

uint64 pe_nt(uint64 base) { return base + uint64(rd_u32(base + 0x3C)); }
bool pe_is64(uint64 base) { return rd_u16(pe_nt(base) + 24) == 0x20B; }
uint64 pe_dir_table(uint64 base) { return pe_nt(base) + 24 + (pe_is64(base) ? 112 : 96); }
uint32 pe_dir_rva(uint64 base, uint index)
{
    if (index >= 16) return 0;
    return rd_u32(pe_dir_table(base) + uint64(index) * 8);
}
uint32 pe_dir_size(uint64 base, uint index)
{
    if (index >= 16) return 0;
    return rd_u32(pe_dir_table(base) + uint64(index) * 8 + 4);
}

string read_section_name(uint64 at)
{
    uint64 v = process::read_uint64(at);
    string out = "";
    string ch = " ";
    for (uint i = 0; i < 8; i++)
    {
        uint8 c = uint8((v >> (i * 8)) & 0xFF);
        if (c == 0) break;
        if (c < 0x20 || c > 0x7E) continue;
        ch[0] = c;
        out += ch;
    }
    return out;
}

void handle_exports(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    string module; uint64 base, size;
    if (!module_for(m, module, base, size)) { fail(id, 1003, "module not found"); return; }
    uint32 rva = pe_dir_rva(base, 0);
    if (rva == 0) { fail(id, 1010, "no export directory"); return; }
    uint64 dir = base + rva;
    uint32 ordinalBase = rd_u32(dir + 16);
    uint32 count = rd_u32(dir + 24);
    uint32 funcs = rd_u32(dir + 28);
    uint32 names = rd_u32(dir + 32);
    uint32 ords = rd_u32(dir + 36);
    if (count > 50000) count = 50000;
    json_obj@ rows = json::array();
    uint emitted = 0;
    for (uint i = 0; i < count; i++)
    {
        uint32 nameRva = rd_u32(base + names + uint64(i) * 4);
        if (nameRva == 0) continue;
        string name = process::read_string(base + nameRva);
        if (name == "") continue;
        uint16 ordinal = rd_u16(base + ords + uint64(i) * 2);
        uint32 functionRva = rd_u32(base + funcs + uint64(ordinal) * 4);
        json_obj@ row = json_obj();
        row.set("name", name);
        row.set("address", hex(base + functionRva));
        row.set("rva", hex(functionRva));
        row.set("ordinal", uint64(ordinalBase + ordinal));
        rows.push(row);
        emitted++;
    }
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true); o.set("module", module); o.set("count", emitted); o.set("results", rows);
    reply(o, "exports_result", id);
}

void handle_imports(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    string module; uint64 base, size;
    if (!module_for(m, module, base, size)) { fail(id, 1003, "module not found"); return; }
    uint32 rva = pe_dir_rva(base, 1);
    if (rva == 0) { fail(id, 1010, "no import directory"); return; }
    bool is64 = pe_is64(base);
    uint thunkSize = is64 ? 8 : 4;
    uint64 ordinalMask = is64 ? 0x8000000000000000 : 0x80000000;
    json_obj@ rows = json::array();
    uint emitted = 0;
    for (uint d = 0; d < 4096; d++)
    {
        uint64 desc = base + rva + uint64(d) * 20;
        uint32 original = rd_u32(desc);
        uint32 nameRva = rd_u32(desc + 12);
        uint32 first = rd_u32(desc + 16);
        if (original == 0 && nameRva == 0 && first == 0) break;
        if (nameRva == 0) continue;
        string dll = process::read_string(base + nameRva);
        uint32 lookup = original != 0 ? original : first;
        for (uint k = 0; k < 40000; k++)
        {
            uint64 thunk = is64 ? process::read_uint64(base + lookup + uint64(k) * thunkSize) : uint64(rd_u32(base + lookup + uint64(k) * thunkSize));
            if (thunk == 0) break;
            string name;
            if ((thunk & ordinalMask) != 0) name = "#" + uint64(thunk & 0xFFFF);
            else name = process::read_string(base + uint64(thunk & 0x7FFFFFFF) + 2);
            json_obj@ row = json_obj();
            row.set("module", dll); row.set("name", name); row.set("iat", hex(base + first + uint64(k) * thunkSize));
            rows.push(row); emitted++;
        }
    }
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true); o.set("module", module); o.set("count", emitted); o.set("results", rows);
    reply(o, "imports_result", id);
}

void handle_sections(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    string module; uint64 base, size;
    if (!module_for(m, module, base, size)) { fail(id, 1003, "module not found"); return; }
    uint64 nt = pe_nt(base);
    if (rd_u32(nt) != 0x4550) { fail(id, 1010, "bad PE header"); return; }
    uint count = uint(rd_u16(nt + 6));
    uint headerSize = uint(rd_u16(nt + 20));
    uint64 sections = nt + 24 + uint64(headerSize);
    if (count > 96) count = 96;
    json_obj@ rows = json::array();
    for (uint i = 0; i < count; i++)
    {
        uint64 at = sections + uint64(i) * 40;
        uint32 characteristics = rd_u32(at + 36);
        string protect = "";
        if ((characteristics & 0x40000000) != 0) protect += "r";
        if ((characteristics & 0x80000000) != 0) protect += "w";
        if ((characteristics & 0x20000000) != 0) protect += "x";
        if (protect == "") protect = "-";
        json_obj@ row = json_obj();
        row.set("name", read_section_name(at));
        row.set("address", hex(base + rd_u32(at + 12)));
        row.set("rva", hex(rd_u32(at + 12)));
        row.set("size", uint64(rd_u32(at + 8)));
        row.set("raw_size", uint64(rd_u32(at + 16)));
        row.set("characteristics", uint64(characteristics));
        row.set("protect", protect);
        rows.push(row);
    }
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true); o.set("module", module); o.set("count", count); o.set("results", rows);
    reply(o, "sections_result", id);
}

void handle_pe_header(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    string module; uint64 base, size;
    if (!module_for(m, module, base, size)) { fail(id, 1003, "module not found"); return; }
    uint64 nt = pe_nt(base);
    if (rd_u32(nt) != 0x4550) { fail(id, 1010, "bad PE header"); return; }
    uint64 opt = nt + 24;
    uint64 imageBase = pe_is64(base) ? process::read_uint64(opt + 24) : uint64(rd_u32(opt + 28));
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true); o.set("module", module);
    o.set("machine", uint64(rd_u16(nt + 4)));
    o.set("magic", uint64(rd_u16(opt)));
    o.set("num_sections", uint64(rd_u16(nt + 6)));
    o.set("timestamp", uint64(rd_u32(nt + 8)));
    o.set("characteristics", uint64(rd_u16(nt + 22)));
    o.set("subsystem", uint64(rd_u16(opt + 68)));
    o.set("dll_characteristics", uint64(rd_u16(opt + 70)));
    o.set("checksum", uint64(rd_u32(opt + 64)));
    o.set("size_of_image", uint64(rd_u32(opt + 56)));
    o.set("entry_rva", hex(rd_u32(opt + 16)));
    o.set("entry_point", hex(base + rd_u32(opt + 16)));
    o.set("image_base", hex(imageBase));
    o.set("size", size);
    reply(o, "pe_header_result", id);
}

void handle_pe_dirs(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    string module; uint64 base, size;
    if (!module_for(m, module, base, size)) { fail(id, 1003, "module not found"); return; }
    array<string> names = { "Export", "Import", "Resource", "Exception", "Security", "BaseReloc", "Debug", "Architecture", "GlobalPtr", "TLS", "LoadConfig", "BoundImport", "IAT", "DelayImport", "CLR", "Reserved" };
    json_obj@ rows = json::array();
    uint count = 0;
    for (uint i = 0; i < 16; i++)
    {
        uint32 rva = pe_dir_rva(base, i), bytes = pe_dir_size(base, i);
        if (rva == 0 && bytes == 0) continue;
        json_obj@ row = json_obj();
        row.set("name", names[i]); row.set("rva", hex(rva)); row.set("address", hex(base + rva)); row.set("size", uint64(bytes));
        rows.push(row); count++;
    }
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true); o.set("module", module); o.set("count", count); o.set("results", rows);
    reply(o, "pe_dirs_result", id);
}

void handle_dump(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    string module = m.get_string("module");
    string path = m.get_string("path");
    if (path == "") path = (module != "" ? module : "process") + "_dump.bin";
    bool ok = module != "" ? process::dump(module, path) : process::dump(path);
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", ok); o.set("path", path); o.set("module", module);
    reply(o, "dump_result", id);
}

void handle_iat_rebuild(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    string module; uint64 base, size;
    if (!module_for(m, module, base, size)) { fail(id, 1003, "module not found"); return; }
    uint32 rva = pe_dir_rva(base, 1);
    if (rva == 0) { fail(id, 1010, "no import directory"); return; }
    bool is64 = pe_is64(base);
    uint thunkSize = is64 ? 8 : 4;
    uint64 ordinalMask = is64 ? 0x8000000000000000 : 0x80000000;
    json_obj@ rows = json::array();
    uint emitted = 0;
    for (uint d = 0; d < 4096; d++)
    {
        uint64 desc = base + rva + uint64(d) * 20;
        uint32 original = rd_u32(desc);
        uint32 nameRva = rd_u32(desc + 12);
        uint32 first = rd_u32(desc + 16);
        if (original == 0 && nameRva == 0 && first == 0) break;
        if (nameRva == 0) continue;
        string dll = process::read_string(base + nameRva);
        uint32 lookup = original != 0 ? original : first;
        for (uint k = 0; k < 40000; k++)
        {
            uint64 thunk = is64 ? process::read_uint64(base + lookup + uint64(k) * thunkSize) : uint64(rd_u32(base + lookup + uint64(k) * thunkSize));
            if (thunk == 0) break;
            bool byOrdinal = (thunk & ordinalMask) != 0;
            uint32 thunkRva = byOrdinal ? 0 : uint32(thunk & 0x7FFFFFFF);
            string name = byOrdinal ? "#" + uint64(thunk & 0xFFFF) : process::read_string(base + uint64(thunkRva) + 2);
            uint32 iatRva = first + k * thunkSize;
            uint64 resolved = is64 ? process::read_uint64(base + iatRva) : uint64(rd_u32(base + iatRva));
            json_obj@ row = json_obj();
            row.set("module", dll); row.set("name", name); row.set("by_ordinal", byOrdinal);
            row.set("ordinal", byOrdinal ? uint64(thunk & 0xFFFF) : uint64(0));
            row.set("iat", hex(base + iatRva)); row.set("iat_rva", hex(iatRva));
            row.set("thunk_rva", hex(thunkRva)); row.set("resolved", hex(resolved));
            rows.push(row); emitted++;
        }
    }
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true); o.set("module", module); o.set("count", emitted); o.set("results", rows);
    reply(o, "iat_rebuild_result", id);
}

const uint RESOURCE_MAX = 20000;
uint g_resource_count = 0;

string read_resource_name(uint64 at)
{
    uint16 length = rd_u16(at);
    if (length > 128) length = 128;
    string out = "";
    string ch = " ";
    for (uint16 i = 0; i < length; i++)
    {
        uint16 code = rd_u16(at + 2 + uint64(i) * 2);
        uint8 c = uint8(code & 0xFF);
        if (code > 0xFF || c < 0x20 || c > 0x7E) continue;
        ch[0] = c; out += ch;
    }
    return out;
}

void walk_resource_dir(uint64 base, uint64 resourceBase, uint64 dirRva, uint depth, json_obj@ rows)
{
    if (depth > 2 || g_resource_count >= RESOURCE_MAX) return;
    uint64 dir = resourceBase + dirRva;
    uint named = uint(rd_u16(dir + 12));
    uint ids = uint(rd_u16(dir + 14));
    uint total = named + ids;
    if (total > 4096) total = 4096;
    for (uint i = 0; i < total && g_resource_count < RESOURCE_MAX; i++)
    {
        uint64 entry = dir + 16 + uint64(i) * 8;
        uint32 nameField = rd_u32(entry);
        uint32 offsetField = rd_u32(entry + 4);
        bool namedEntry = (nameField & 0x80000000) != 0;
        string name = namedEntry ? read_resource_name(resourceBase + uint64(nameField & 0x7FFFFFFF)) : "";
        uint32 id = namedEntry ? 0 : nameField;
        bool isDir = (offsetField & 0x80000000) != 0;
        uint32 child = offsetField & 0x7FFFFFFF;
        json_obj@ row = json_obj();
        row.set("level", uint64(depth)); row.set("named", namedEntry); row.set("id", uint64(id)); row.set("name", name);
        if (isDir && depth < 2)
        {
            row.set("is_dir", true);
            rows.push(row); g_resource_count++;
            walk_resource_dir(base, resourceBase, uint64(child), depth + 1, rows);
        }
        else
        {
            uint64 leaf = resourceBase + uint64(child);
            uint32 dataRva = rd_u32(leaf);
            row.set("is_dir", false); row.set("address", hex(base + uint64(dataRva)));
            row.set("size", uint64(rd_u32(leaf + 4))); row.set("code_page", uint64(rd_u32(leaf + 8)));
            rows.push(row); g_resource_count++;
        }
    }
}

void handle_resource_tree(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    string module; uint64 base, size;
    if (!module_for(m, module, base, size)) { fail(id, 1003, "module not found"); return; }
    uint32 rva = pe_dir_rva(base, 2);
    if (rva == 0) { fail(id, 1010, "no resource directory"); return; }
    g_resource_count = 0;
    json_obj@ rows = json::array();
    walk_resource_dir(base, base + uint64(rva), 0, 0, rows);
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true); o.set("module", module); o.set("count", g_resource_count); o.set("results", rows);
    reply(o, "resource_tree_result", id);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- value scan

array<uint64> g_addrs;
array<double> g_vals;
array<uint64> g_int64_vals;
string g_width = "";
bool g_truncated = false;

uint width_size(const string &in w)
{
    if (w == "i8" || w == "u8") return 1;
    if (w == "i16" || w == "u16") return 2;
    if (w == "i32" || w == "u32" || w == "f32") return 4;
    if (w == "i64" || w == "u64" || w == "f64") return 8;
    return 0;
}

double buf_value(memory_buffer@ b, uint64 off, const string &in w)
{
    if (w == "u8") return double(b.read_uint8(off));
    if (w == "i8") return double(b.read_int8(off));
    if (w == "u16") return double(b.read_uint16(off));
    if (w == "i16") return double(b.read_int16(off));
    if (w == "u32") return double(b.read_uint32(off));
    if (w == "i32") return double(b.read_int32(off));
    if (w == "u64") return double(b.read_uint64(off));
    if (w == "i64") return double(b.read_int64(off));
    if (w == "f32") return double(b.read_float(off));
    return b.read_double(off);
}

bool matches64(const string &in kind, uint64 cur, uint64 prev, uint64 v1, uint64 v2, bool sign)
{
    if (kind == "unknown") return true;
    if (kind == "exact") return cur == v1;
    if (kind == "changed") return cur != prev;
    if (kind == "unchanged") return cur == prev;
    if (sign)
    {
        int64 c = int64(cur), p = int64(prev), a = int64(v1), b = int64(v2);
        if (kind == "between") return c >= a && c <= b;
        if (kind == "bigger") return c > a;
        if (kind == "smaller") return c < a;
        if (kind == "increased") return c > p;
        if (kind == "decreased") return c < p;
    }
    else
    {
        if (kind == "between") return cur >= v1 && cur <= v2;
        if (kind == "bigger") return cur > v1;
        if (kind == "smaller") return cur < v1;
        if (kind == "increased") return cur > prev;
        if (kind == "decreased") return cur < prev;
    }
    return false;
}

bool matches(const string &in kind, double cur, double prev, double v1, double v2)
{
    if (kind == "exact") return cur == v1;
    if (kind == "unknown") return true;
    if (kind == "between") return cur >= v1 && cur <= v2;
    if (kind == "bigger") return cur > v1;
    if (kind == "smaller") return cur < v1;
    if (kind == "increased") return cur > prev;
    if (kind == "decreased") return cur < prev;
    if (kind == "changed") return cur != prev;
    if (kind == "unchanged") return cur == prev;
    return false;
}

void scan_reply(uint64 id, uint limit, const string &in type)
{
    json_obj@ hits = json::array();
    for (uint i = 0; i < g_addrs.length() && i < limit; i++)
    {
        json_obj@ h = json_obj();
        h.set("address", hex(g_addrs[i]));
        if (g_width == "i64" || g_width == "u64") h.set("value_hex", hex(g_int64_vals[i]));
        else h.set("value", g_vals[i]);
        hits.push(h);
    }
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true);
    o.set("width", g_width);
    o.set("total", g_addrs.length());
    o.set("truncated", g_truncated);
    o.set("hits", hits);
    reply(o, type, id);
}

void handle_scan_new(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    string w = m.get_string("width");
    string kind = m.get_string("kind");
    uint size = width_size(w);
    if (size == 0 || (kind != "exact" && kind != "unknown")) { fail(id, 1002, "first scan needs a fixed width and exact or unknown"); return; }
    bool wide = w == "i64" || w == "u64";
    if (wide && kind == "exact" && !m.has("value_hex")) { fail(id, 1002, "64-bit scans require value_hex"); return; }
    double v1 = wide ? 0 : m.get_double("value");
    uint64 v64 = wide ? parse_hex(m.get_string("value_hex")) : 0;
    uint64 start = m.get_string("start") == "" ? 0x10000 : parse_hex(m.get_string("start"));
    uint64 end = m.get_string("end") == "" ? USER_TOP : parse_hex(m.get_string("end"));
    if (start >= end || end > USER_TOP) { fail(id, 1002, "invalid scan range"); return; }
    g_addrs.resize(0);
    g_vals.resize(0);
    g_int64_vals.resize(0);
    g_width = w;
    g_truncated = false;

    uint64 scanned = 0;
    uint64 addr = start;
    while (addr < end && !g_truncated)
    {
        memory_region r = process::virtual_query(addr);
        if (r.size == 0 || r.base + r.size <= addr) { addr += 0x1000; continue; }
        // writable, non-exec pages hold the values people scan for
        if (r.present && r.writable && !r.executable)
        {
            uint64 lo = r.base > start ? r.base : start;
            uint64 hi = r.base + r.size < end ? r.base + r.size : end;
            for (uint64 at = lo; at < hi && !g_truncated; at += SCAN_CHUNK)
            {
                uint64 len = hi - at;
                if (len > SCAN_CHUNK) len = SCAN_CHUNK;
                memory_buffer@ b = process::read_buffer(at, len);
                scanned += len;
                if (b is null) { if (scanned >= SCAN_BYTES_MAX) g_truncated = true; continue; }
                for (uint64 off = 0; off + size <= len; off += size)
                {
                    uint64 raw = wide ? b.read_uint64(off) : 0;
                    double v = wide ? 0 : buf_value(b, off, w);
                    if (wide ? !matches64(kind, raw, 0, v64, 0, w == "i64") : !matches(kind, v, 0, v1, 0)) continue;
                    if (g_addrs.length() >= SCAN_MAX) { g_truncated = true; break; }
                    g_addrs.insertLast(at + off);
                    g_vals.insertLast(v);
                    g_int64_vals.insertLast(raw);
                }
                if (scanned >= SCAN_BYTES_MAX) g_truncated = true;
            }
        }
        addr = r.base + r.size;
    }
    scan_reply(id, m.get_uint("limit"), "scan_new_result");
}

void handle_scan_filter(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    if (g_width == "") { fail(id, 1002, "no first scan"); return; }
    string kind = m.get_string("kind");
    bool wide = g_width == "i64" || g_width == "u64";
    if (wide && (kind == "exact" || kind == "between" || kind == "bigger" || kind == "smaller") && !m.has("value_hex")) { fail(id, 1002, "64-bit scans require value_hex"); return; }
    if (wide && kind == "between" && !m.has("value2_hex")) { fail(id, 1002, "64-bit between scans require value2_hex"); return; }
    double v1 = wide ? 0 : m.get_double("value");
    double v2 = wide ? 0 : m.get_double("value2");
    uint64 v64 = wide ? parse_hex(m.get_string("value_hex")) : 0;
    uint64 v64_2 = wide ? parse_hex(m.get_string("value2_hex")) : 0;
    uint size = width_size(g_width);
    array<uint64> addrs;
    array<double> vals;
    array<uint64> raw_vals;
    for (uint i = 0; i < g_addrs.length(); i++)
    {
        memory_buffer@ b = process::read_buffer(g_addrs[i], size);
        if (b is null) continue;
        uint64 raw = wide ? b.read_uint64(0) : 0;
        double v = wide ? 0 : buf_value(b, 0, g_width);
        if (wide ? !matches64(kind, raw, g_int64_vals[i], v64, v64_2, g_width == "i64") : !matches(kind, v, g_vals[i], v1, v2)) continue;
        addrs.insertLast(g_addrs[i]);
        vals.insertLast(v);
        raw_vals.insertLast(raw);
    }
    g_int64_vals = raw_vals;
    g_addrs = addrs;
    g_vals = vals;
    scan_reply(id, m.get_uint("limit"), "scan_filter_result");
}

void handle_scan_clear(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    g_addrs.resize(0);
    g_vals.resize(0);
    g_int64_vals.resize(0);
    g_width = "";
    g_truncated = false;
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true);
    reply(o, "scan_clear_result", id);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- raw and grouped scans

void handle_raw_scan(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    string pattern = m.get_string("pattern");
    if (pattern == "") { fail(id, 1002, "pattern is required"); return; }
    uint64 requested = m.get_uint64("address");
    uint64 length = m.get_uint64("length");
    string module = m.get_string("module");
    uint64 moduleBase = 0, moduleSize = 0;
    array<module_entry>@ mods = process::get_module_list();
    if (module == "" && mods !is null)
    {
        for (uint i = 0; i < mods.length(); i++)
        {
            if (requested >= mods[i].base && requested < mods[i].base + mods[i].size)
            { module = mods[i].name; break; }
        }
    }
    if (module == "" && mods !is null && mods.length() > 0) module = mods[0].name;
    if (module != "")
    {
        moduleBase = process::get_module_base(module);
        moduleSize = uint64(process::get_module_size(moduleBase));
    }
    if (moduleBase == 0 || moduleSize == 0) { fail(id, 1003, "module not found"); return; }
    uint64 start = requested != 0 ? requested : moduleBase;
    uint64 end = requested != 0 ? requested + length : moduleBase + moduleSize;
    if (length == 0) end = moduleBase + moduleSize;
    if (start < moduleBase) start = moduleBase;
    if (end > moduleBase + moduleSize) end = moduleBase + moduleSize;
    if (start >= end) { fail(id, 1002, "invalid scan range"); return; }

    array<uint64>@ hits = process::find_signatures(moduleBase, pattern);
    json_obj@ rows = json::array();
    uint count = 0;
    if (hits !is null)
    {
        for (uint i = 0; i < hits.length() && count < 5000; i++)
        {
            if (hits[i] < start || hits[i] >= end) continue;
            rows.push(hex(hits[i]));
            count++;
        }
    }
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true); o.set("module", module); o.set("address", hex(start)); o.set("length", end - start);
    o.set("count", count); o.set("results", rows);
    reply(o, "raw_scan_result", id);
}

void handle_scan_grouped(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    if (g_addrs.length() == 0) { fail(id, 1022, "no active scan candidates"); return; }
    uint window = m.get_uint("window");
    if (window < 4) window = 4;
    if (window > 256) window = 256;
    uint count = g_addrs.length();
    if (count > 50) count = 50;
    json_obj@ groups = json::array();
    for (uint i = 0; i < count; i++)
    {
        uint64 hit = g_addrs[i];
        uint64 first = hit > uint64(window) ? hit - uint64(window) : 0;
        json_obj@ slots = json::array();
        for (uint64 at = first; at <= hit + uint64(window); at += 4)
        {
            json_obj@ slot = json_obj();
            slot.set("offset", int(int64(at) - int64(hit)));
            slot.set("address", hex(at));
            slot.set("value_u32", uint64(rd_u32(at)));
            slots.push(slot);
        }
        json_obj@ group = json_obj();
        group.set("hit", hex(hit)); group.set("slots", slots);
        groups.push(group);
    }
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true); o.set("count", count); o.set("results", groups);
    reply(o, "scan_grouped_result", id);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- emulate

array<uint64> g_trace;
uint g_trace_limit = 0;
uint64 g_mod_lo = 0;
uint64 g_mod_hi = 0;
bool g_stub = true;
uint64 g_api_ret = 0;
json_obj@ g_calls;
bool g_track = true;
uint g_writes_limit = 0;
json_obj@ g_writes;
uint g_write_count = 0;
// a store is decoded before it runs, its value is read at the next instruction
uint64 g_pend_addr = 0;
uint g_pend_size = 0;
uint64 g_pend_at = 0;

array<string> REG_NAMES = { "rax", "rbx", "rcx", "rdx", "rsi", "rdi", "rbp", "rsp", "rip", "r8", "r9", "r10", "r11", "r12", "r13", "r14", "r15", "eflags" };
array<x86_reg> REGS = { x86_reg::rax, x86_reg::rbx, x86_reg::rcx, x86_reg::rdx, x86_reg::rsi, x86_reg::rdi, x86_reg::rbp, x86_reg::rsp, x86_reg::rip, x86_reg::r8, x86_reg::r9, x86_reg::r10, x86_reg::r11, x86_reg::r12, x86_reg::r13, x86_reg::r14, x86_reg::r15, x86_reg::eflags };

uint64 reg64(uint64 h, x86_reg r)
{
    uint64 v = 0;
    uc::reg_read64(h, r, v);
    return v;
}

// zydis register -> its 64-bit value; 32-bit names read the full register, good enough for addressing
bool reg_value(uint64 h, int zreg, uint64 next_ip, uint64 &out v)
{
    v = 0;
    if (zreg == 0) return true;
    string n = zydis::reg_name(zreg);
    if (n == "rip") { v = next_ip; return true; }
    if (n == "gs") { v = reg64(h, x86_reg::gs_base); return true; }
    if (n == "fs") { v = reg64(h, x86_reg::fs_base); return true; }
    if (n == "ds" || n == "ss" || n == "es" || n == "cs") return true;
    if (n.length() == 3 && n[0] == 101) n = "r" + n.substr(1); // eax -> rax
    if (n.length() >= 3 && n[0] == 114 && (n[n.length() - 1] == 100)) n = n.substr(0, n.length() - 1); // r8d -> r8
    for (uint i = 0; i < REG_NAMES.length(); i++)
    {
        if (REG_NAMES[i] == n) { v = reg64(h, REGS[i]); return true; }
    }
    return false;
}

bool is_write(int action)
{
    return action == op_action::write || action == op_action::readwrite || action == op_action::condwrite
        || action == op_action::read_condwrite || action == op_action::condread_write;
}

void flush_write(uint64 h)
{
    if (g_pend_size == 0) return;
    array<uint8> data;
    string value = "";
    if (uc::mem_read(h, g_pend_addr, g_pend_size, data))
    {
        for (uint i = 0; i < data.length(); i++)
        {
            string b = util::to_hex(data[i], false);
            value += (b.length() < 2 ? "0" : "") + b;
        }
    }
    json_obj@ w = json_obj();
    w.set("at", hex(g_pend_at));
    w.set("address", hex(g_pend_addr));
    w.set("size", g_pend_size);
    w.set("value", value);
    g_writes.push(w);
    g_pend_size = 0;
}

// operand size isn't exposed by the bindings, intel syntax names it: "dword ptr [..]"
uint store_width(const string &in text)
{
    if (text.findFirst("ymmword ptr") >= 0) return 32;
    if (text.findFirst("xmmword ptr") >= 0) return 16;
    if (text.findFirst("tbyte ptr") >= 0) return 10;
    if (text.findFirst("qword ptr") >= 0) return 8;
    if (text.findFirst("dword ptr") >= 0) return 4;
    if (text.findFirst("word ptr") >= 0) return 2;
    if (text.findFirst("byte ptr") >= 0) return 1;
    return 8;
}

void decode_write(uint64 h, uint64 address)
{
    array<uint8> bytes;
    if (!uc::mem_read(h, address, 15, bytes)) return;
    array<disasm_insn@> insns;
    zydis::disasm(bytes, address, insns);
    if (insns.length() == 0) return;
    disasm_insn@ insn = insns[0];
    // push/call store through rsp implicitly, the explicit memory operands are what we want
    for (uint8 i = 0; i < insn.operand_count_visible; i++)
    {
        disasm_operand op = insn.get_op(i);
        if (op.type != op_type::mem || !is_write(op.action)) continue;
        uint64 base = 0, index = 0, seg = 0;
        uint64 next_ip = address + insn.length;
        if (!reg_value(h, op.mem_base, next_ip, base) || !reg_value(h, op.mem_index, next_ip, index)) return;
        reg_value(h, op.mem_segment, next_ip, seg);
        g_pend_addr = seg + base + index * op.mem_scale + uint64(op.mem_disp);
        g_pend_at = address;
        g_pend_size = store_width(insn.text);
        g_write_count++;
        return;
    }
}

bool on_code(uint64 h, uint64 address, uint32 size)
{
    if (g_track) flush_write(h);
    if (g_stub && (address < g_mod_lo || address >= g_mod_hi))
    {
        // landed outside the module right after a call: log it, fake a return
        uint64 rsp = reg64(h, x86_reg::rsp);
        array<uint8> ret;
        uint64 ret_addr = 0;
        if (uc::mem_read(h, rsp, 8, ret))
        {
            for (int i = 7; i >= 0; i--) ret_addr = (ret_addr << 8) | ret[uint(i)];
        }
        json_obj@ c = json_obj();
        c.set("target", hex(address));
        c.set("return", hex(ret_addr));
        c.set("rcx", hex(reg64(h, x86_reg::rcx)));
        c.set("rdx", hex(reg64(h, x86_reg::rdx)));
        c.set("r8", hex(reg64(h, x86_reg::r8)));
        c.set("r9", hex(reg64(h, x86_reg::r9)));
        g_calls.push(c);
        uc::reg_write64(h, x86_reg::rax, g_api_ret);
        uc::reg_write64(h, x86_reg::rsp, rsp + 8);
        uc::reg_write64(h, x86_reg::rip, ret_addr);
        return ret_addr != 0;
    }
    if (g_trace.length() < g_trace_limit) g_trace.insertLast(address);
    if (g_track && g_write_count < g_writes_limit) decode_write(h, address);
    return true;
}

bool flag(json_obj@ m, const string &in key, bool fallback)
{
    return m.has(key) ? m.get_bool(key) : fallback;
}

string emu_error_name(int err)
{
    if (err == uc::error::ok) return "ok";
    if (err == uc::error::read_unmapped) return "read_unmapped";
    if (err == uc::error::write_unmapped) return "write_unmapped";
    if (err == uc::error::fetch_unmapped) return "fetch_unmapped";
    if (err == uc::error::read_prot) return "read_prot";
    if (err == uc::error::write_prot) return "write_prot";
    if (err == uc::error::fetch_prot) return "fetch_prot";
    if (err == uc::error::insn_invalid) return "insn_invalid";
    if (err == uc::error::map) return "map";
    if (err == uc::error::hook) return "hook";
    return "other";
}

void handle_emulate(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    uint64 begin = parse_hex(m.get_string("address"));
    uint64 count = m.get_uint64("count");
    uint64 timeout = m.get_uint64("timeout_us");
    if (count == 0 || count > EMU_COUNT_MAX) count = 100000;
    if (timeout == 0 || timeout > EMU_TIMEOUT_MAX) timeout = 1000000;
    g_trace_limit = m.get_uint("trace_limit");
    if (g_trace_limit > EMU_TRACE_MAX) g_trace_limit = EMU_TRACE_MAX;
    g_trace.resize(0);
    g_stub = flag(m, "stub_external", true);
    g_api_ret = m.has("api_return") ? parse_hex(m.get_string("api_return")) : 0;
    g_track = flag(m, "track_writes", true);
    g_writes_limit = m.has("writes_limit") ? m.get_uint("writes_limit") : 1000;
    @g_calls = json::array();
    @g_writes = json::array();
    g_write_count = 0;
    g_pend_size = 0;

    // the module holding the start address is "inside", everything else is an api
    g_mod_lo = 0;
    g_mod_hi = USER_TOP;
    array<module_entry>@ mods = process::get_module_list();
    for (uint i = 0; mods !is null && i < mods.length(); i++)
    {
        if (begin >= mods[i].base && begin < mods[i].base + mods[i].size) { g_mod_lo = mods[i].base; g_mod_hi = mods[i].base + mods[i].size; }
    }

    // backed by the attached process: pages fault in read-only, the game is never touched
    uint64 h = uc::create_process();
    if (h == 0) { fail(id, 1001, "uc::create_process failed, attach first"); return; }
    if (!uc::setup_stack(h, EMU_STACK_BASE, EMU_STACK, EMU_STOP)) { uc::close(h); fail(id, 1008, "stack setup failed"); return; }
    json_obj@ regions = m.get_obj("regions");
    json_obj@ mapped = json::array();
    if (regions !is null)
    {
        if (regions.length() > 16) { uc::close(h); fail(id, 1002, "at most 16 emulator regions"); return; }
        uint total_bytes = 0;
        for (uint i = 0; i < regions.length(); i++)
        {
            json_obj@ r = regions.get_obj_at(i);
            if (r is null) { uc::close(h); fail(id, 1002, "invalid emulator region"); return; }
            uint64 address = parse_hex(r.get_string("address"));
            uint64 size = r.get_uint64("size");
            uint perms = r.get_uint("perms");
            string data = r.get_string("data");
            total_bytes += data.length() / 2;
            if (address == 0 || address % 0x1000 != 0 || size == 0 || size > 0x100000 || size % 0x1000 != 0 || address > USER_TOP - size || perms == 0 || perms > 7 || data.length() % 2 != 0 || data.length() / 2 > size || total_bytes > 65536)
            { uc::close(h); fail(id, 1002, "invalid emulator region address, size, permissions or data"); return; }
            for (uint j = 0; j < data.length(); j++)
            {
                uint8 c = data[j];
                if (!((c >= 48 && c <= 57) || (c >= 65 && c <= 70) || (c >= 97 && c <= 102)))
                { uc::close(h); fail(id, 1002, "invalid emulator region hex data"); return; }
            }
            if (!uc::mem_map(h, address, size, perms)) { uc::close(h); fail(id, 1008, "emulator region mapping failed"); return; }
            if (data.length() > 0 && !uc::mem_write(h, address, parse_bytes(data))) { uc::close(h); fail(id, 1008, "emulator region initialization failed"); return; }
            json_obj@ row = json_obj();
            row.set("name", r.get_string("name")); row.set("address", hex(address)); row.set("size", size); row.set("perms", perms); mapped.push(row);
        }
    }
    json_obj@ regs = m.get_obj("regs");
    if (regs !is null)
    {
        for (uint i = 0; i < REG_NAMES.length(); i++)
        {
            if (regs.has(REG_NAMES[i])) uc::reg_write64(h, REGS[i], parse_hex(regs.get_string(REG_NAMES[i])));
        }
    }
    uc::hook_code(h, @on_code);
    int err = uc::start(h, begin, EMU_STOP, timeout, count);
    uint64 fault = err == uc::error::ok ? 0 : uc::fault_address(h);
    if (g_track) flush_write(h);

    json_obj@ out = json_obj();
    for (uint i = 0; i < REG_NAMES.length(); i++) out.set(REG_NAMES[i], hex(reg64(h, REGS[i])));
    json_obj@ trace = json::array();
    for (uint i = 0; i < g_trace.length(); i++) trace.push(hex(g_trace[i]));
    array<x86_reg> xmm = { x86_reg::xmm0, x86_reg::xmm1, x86_reg::xmm2, x86_reg::xmm3, x86_reg::xmm4, x86_reg::xmm5, x86_reg::xmm6, x86_reg::xmm7, x86_reg::xmm8, x86_reg::xmm9, x86_reg::xmm10, x86_reg::xmm11, x86_reg::xmm12, x86_reg::xmm13, x86_reg::xmm14, x86_reg::xmm15 };
    array<x86_reg> ymm = { x86_reg::ymm0, x86_reg::ymm1, x86_reg::ymm2, x86_reg::ymm3, x86_reg::ymm4, x86_reg::ymm5, x86_reg::ymm6, x86_reg::ymm7, x86_reg::ymm8, x86_reg::ymm9, x86_reg::ymm10, x86_reg::ymm11, x86_reg::ymm12, x86_reg::ymm13, x86_reg::ymm14, x86_reg::ymm15 };
    json_obj@ vectors = json_obj();
    for (uint i = 0; i < 16; i++)
    {
        array<uint8> bytes;
        if (uc::reg_read128(h, xmm[i], bytes)) { string v = ""; for (uint j = 0; j < bytes.length(); j++) { string b = util::to_hex(bytes[j], false); v += (b.length() < 2 ? "0" : "") + b; } vectors.set("xmm" + i, v); }
        bytes.resize(0);
        if (uc::reg_read256(h, ymm[i], bytes)) { string v = ""; for (uint j = 0; j < bytes.length(); j++) { string b = util::to_hex(bytes[j], false); v += (b.length() < 2 ? "0" : "") + b; } vectors.set("ymm" + i, v); }
    }
    array<uc_memory_region> memory_regions;
    json_obj@ memory_map = json::array();
    if (uc::mem_regions(h, memory_regions)) for (uint i = 0; i < memory_regions.length() && i < 1000; i++)
    {
        json_obj@ region = json_obj(); region.set("address", hex(memory_regions[i].address)); region.set("end", hex(memory_regions[i].end)); region.set("perms", memory_regions[i].perms); memory_map.push(region);
    }

    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", err == uc::error::ok);
    o.set("error", err);
    o.set("error_name", emu_error_name(err));
    o.set("fault_address", hex(fault));
    o.set("returned", err == uc::error::ok);
    o.set("regs", out);
    o.set("trace", trace);
    o.set("calls", g_calls);
    o.set("writes", g_writes);
    o.set("mapped_regions", mapped);
    o.set("vector_regs", vectors);
    o.set("memory_map", memory_map);
    o.set("memory_map_truncated", memory_regions.length() > 1000);
    uc::close(h);
    reply(o, "emulate_result", id);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- ws plumbing

void handle_capabilities(json_obj@ m, uint64 id)
{
    json_obj@ verbs = json::array();
    array<string> names = { "attach", "detach", "process_alive", "query_region", "resolve_export", "disassemble_detail", "write", "dump", "exports", "imports", "iat_rebuild", "sections", "pe_header", "pe_dirs", "resource_tree", "scan_new", "scan_filter", "scan_clear", "scan_grouped", "raw_scan", "emulate", "capabilities" };
    for (uint i = 0; i < names.length(); i++) verbs.push(names[i]);
    json_obj@ o = json_obj();
    o.set("success", true);
    o.set("protocol", "echo-reverse-ext/3");
    json_obj@ features = json::array();
    features.push("emulate_regions");
    features.push("attach");
    features.push("pe_tables");
    features.push("raw_scan");
    o.set("features", features);
    o.set("verbs", verbs);
    reply(o, "capabilities_result", id);
}

void on_open() { print("[echo-reverse ext] connected to " + RELAY_URL); }

void on_message(string msg)
{
    string err;
    json_obj@ m = json::parse(msg, err);
    if (m is null) return;
    uint64 id = m.get_uint64("id");
    string type = m.get_string("type");
    if (type == "capabilities") { handle_capabilities(m, id); return; }
    if (type == "attach") { handle_attach(m, id); return; }
    if (type == "detach") { handle_detach(m, id); return; }
    if (type == "process_alive") { handle_process_alive(id); return; }
    if (!ensure_attached()) { fail(id, 1001, "not attached to " + PROCESS_NAME); return; }
    if (type == "write") handle_write(m, id);
    else if (type == "query_region") handle_query_region(m, id);
    else if (type == "resolve_export") handle_resolve_export(m, id);
    else if (type == "disassemble_detail") handle_disassemble_detail(m, id);
    else if (type == "dump") handle_dump(m, id);
    else if (type == "regions") handle_regions(m, id);
    else if (type == "exports") handle_exports(m, id);
    else if (type == "imports") handle_imports(m, id);
    else if (type == "iat_rebuild") handle_iat_rebuild(m, id);
    else if (type == "sections") handle_sections(m, id);
    else if (type == "pe_header") handle_pe_header(m, id);
    else if (type == "pe_dirs") handle_pe_dirs(m, id);
    else if (type == "resource_tree") handle_resource_tree(m, id);
    else if (type == "scan_new") handle_scan_new(m, id);
    else if (type == "scan_filter") handle_scan_filter(m, id);
    else if (type == "scan_clear") handle_scan_clear(m, id);
    else if (type == "scan_grouped") handle_scan_grouped(m, id);
    else if (type == "raw_scan") handle_raw_scan(m, id);
    else if (type == "emulate") handle_emulate(m, id);
    else route_extended_rpc(m, id); // Route to extended handlers
}

void on_disconnect() { print("[echo-reverse ext] disconnected, use Connect"); }
void on_error(string msg) { print("[echo-reverse ext] " + msg); }

// Echo's own socket; false when the relay is down or a socket is already open
void connect_core()
{
    if (!ensure_attached()) { alert::show("[echo-reverse] attach your game in Echo first, then press Connect"); return; }
    if (process::open_socket(CORE_URL)) alert::show("[echo-reverse] connected to " + CORE_URL);
    else alert::show("[echo-reverse] open_socket failed, start echo-reverse or detach first");
}

void on_connect_click()
{
    connect_core();
    if (!ws::is_connected()) ws::reconnect();
}

void on_detach_click()
{
    process::detach(); // closes Echo's socket too
    alert::show("[echo-reverse] detached");
}

bool main()
{
    ui::add_tab("echo-reverse");
    ui::add_category("Relay");
    ui::add_button("Connect", @on_connect_click);
    ui::add_button("Detach", @on_detach_click);
    connect_core();
    ws::connect(RELAY_URL, @on_open, @on_message, @on_disconnect, @on_error);
    return true;
}

void on_unload()
{
    ws::disconnect();
    process::detach();
}
```

```as
// echo-rpc-extensions.as
// RPC extensions for Echo Backend

import "echo-backend-extensions.as";
import "echo-math-utilities.as";

// RPC Categories
const string RPC_CATEGORY_RENDERING = "rendering";
const string RPC_CATEGORY_MEMORY = "memory";
const string RPC_CATEGORY_MATH = "math";
const string RPC_CATEGORY_PERFORMANCE = "performance";
const string RPC_CATEGORY_SCANNING = "scanning";
const string RPC_CATEGORY_BONE_ESP = "bone_esp";
const string RPC_CATEGORY_GAME = "game";
const string RPC_CATEGORY_SYSTEM = "system";

// Rendering types
const string RPC_RENDER_BONE_ESP = "bone_esp";
const string RPC_RENDER_GLOW_ESP = "glow_esp";
const string RPC_RENDER_BOX_ESP = "box_esp";
const string RPC_RENDER_CLEAR = "clear";

// Memory types
const string RPC_MEMORY_READ = "read";
const string RPC_MEMORY_WRITE = "write";
const string RPC_MEMORY_SCAN = "scan";

// Performance types
const string RPC_PERFORMANCE_START = "start";
const string RPC_PERFORMANCE_STOP = "stop";
const string RPC_PERFORMANCE_GET = "get";

// Scanning types

const string RPC_BONE_ESP_CLEAR = "clear";

// Game types

// RPC Request class
class RpcRequest {
    private string category;
    private string type;
    private dict data;
    private uint64 requestId;
    private uint64 timestamp;

    RpcRequest(string category, string type, dict data = {}, uint64 requestId = 0) {
        this.category = category;
        this.type = type;
        this.data = data;
        this.requestId = requestId != 0 ? requestId : platform::time();
        this.timestamp = platform::time();
    }

    string getCategory() { return category; }
    string getType() { return type; }
    dict getData() { return data; }
    uint64 getRequestId() { return requestId; }
    uint64 getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }

    dict toDict() {
        return {
            {"category", category},
            {"type", type},
            {"data", data},
            {"request_id", requestId},
            {"timestamp", timestamp}
        };
    }

    string toJSON() { return json::encode(toDict()); }

    static RpcRequest@ fromDict(dict@ data) {
        if (data == null) return null;
        string category = data.exists("category") ? data["category"].toString() : "";
        string type = data.exists("type") ? data["type"].toString() : "";
        dict requestData = data.exists("data") ? data["data"].toDict() : {};
        uint64 requestId = data.exists("request_id") ? data["request_id"].toInteger() : 0;
        RpcRequest@ req = RpcRequest(category, type, requestData, requestId);
        if (data.exists("timestamp")) req.timestamp = data["timestamp"].toInteger();
        return req;
    }

    static RpcRequest@ fromJSON(string json) {
        dict@ data = json::decode(json);
        return fromDict(data);
    }
}

// RPC Response class
class RpcResponse {
    private uint64 requestId;
    private string category;
    private string type;
    private bool success;
    private string error;
    private dict data;
    private uint64 timestamp;

    RpcResponse(uint64 requestId = 0, bool success = true, string error = "", dict data = {}) {
        this.requestId = requestId;
        this.category = "";
        this.type = "";
        this.success = success;
        this.error = error;
        this.data = data;
        this.timestamp = platform::time();
    }

    RpcResponse(RpcRequest@ request, bool success, string error, dict data) {
        this.requestId = request.getRequestId();
        this.category = request.getCategory();
        this.type = request.getType();
        this.success = success;
        this.error = error;
        this.data = data;
        this.timestamp = platform::time();
    }

    uint64 getRequestId() { return requestId; }
    bool isSuccess() { return success; }
    string getError() { return error; }
    dict getData() { return data; }

    dict toDict() {
        return {
            {"request_id", requestId},
            {"category", category},
            {"type", type},
            {"success", success},
            {"error", error},
            {"data", data},
            {"timestamp", timestamp}
        };
    }

    string toJSON() { return json::encode(toDict()); }

    static RpcResponse@ fromDict(dict@ data) {
        if (data == null) return null;
        uint64 requestId = data.exists("request_id") ? data["request_id"].toInteger() : 0;
        string category = data.exists("category") ? data["category"].toString() : "";
        string type = data.exists("type") ? data["type"].toString() : "";
        bool success = data.exists("success") ? data["success"].toBool() : true;
        string error = data.exists("error") ? data["error"].toString() : "";
        dict responseData = data.exists("data") ? data["data"].toDict() : {};
        RpcResponse@ resp = RpcResponse(requestId, success, error, responseData);
        resp.category = category;
        resp.type = type;
        if (data.exists("timestamp")) resp.timestamp = data["timestamp"].toInteger();
        return resp;
    }

    static RpcResponse@ fromJSON(string json) {
        dict@ data = json::decode(json);
        return fromDict(data);
    }
}

// RPC Handler base class
class RpcHandler {
    protected string category;
    protected dict<string, func@> handlers;

    RpcHandler(string category) {
        this.category = category;
        handlers = {};
    }

    void registerHandler(string type, func@ handler) {
        handlers[type] = handler;
    }

    bool hasHandler(string type) { return handlers.exists(type); }

    virtual RpcResponse@ handle(RpcRequest@ request) {
        if (!handlers.exists(request.getType())) {
            return RpcResponse(request.getRequestId(), false, "Handler not found: " + request.getType(), {});
        }
        try {
            auto result = handlers[request.getType()].call(this, request);
            if (result is RpcResponse@) return result;
            else if (result is dict@) return RpcResponse(request.getRequestId(), true, "", result);
            else return RpcResponse(request.getRequestId(), true, "", {"result", result});
        } catch (exception e) {
            return RpcResponse(request.getRequestId(), false, "Error: " + e.message, {});
        }
    }

    string getCategory() { return category; }
}

// Memory Handler
class MemoryRpcHandler extends RpcHandler {
    private EchoMemoryClient@ memoryClient;

    MemoryRpcHandler() : super(RPC_CATEGORY_MEMORY) {
        memoryClient = createEchoMemoryClient();
        registerHandler(RPC_MEMORY_READ, this.handleRead);
        registerHandler(RPC_MEMORY_WRITE, this.handleWrite);
        registerHandler(RPC_MEMORY_SCAN, this.handleScan);
    }

    RpcResponse@ handleRead(RpcRequest@ request) {
        dict data = request.getData();
        uint64 address = data.exists("address") ? data["address"].toInteger() : 0;
        uint size = data.exists("size") ? data["size"].toInteger() : 4;
        uint64 readRequestId = memoryClient.readMemory(address, size);
        return RpcResponse(request.getRequestId(), true, "", {"address", address, "size", size, "request_id", readRequestId});
    }

    RpcResponse@ handleWrite(RpcRequest@ request) {
        dict data = request.getData();
        uint64 address = data.exists("address") ? data["address"].toInteger() : 0;
        array<uint8> writeData = data.exists("data") ? data["data"].toArray() : {};
        uint64 writeRequestId = memoryClient.writeMemory(address, writeData);
        return RpcResponse(request.getRequestId(), true, "", {"address", address, "written", true, "request_id", writeRequestId});
    }

    RpcResponse@ handleScan(RpcRequest@ request) {
        dict data = request.getData();
        string pattern = data.exists("pattern") ? data["pattern"].toString() : "";
        uint64 start = data.exists("start") ? data["start"].toInteger() : 0;
        uint64 end = data.exists("end") ? data["end"].toInteger() : 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;
        uint64 scanRequestId = memoryClient.scanPattern(pattern, start, end);
        return RpcResponse(request.getRequestId(), true, "", {"pattern", pattern, "request_id", scanRequestId});
    }

    EchoMemoryClient@ getMemoryClient() { return memoryClient; }
}

        array<int> viewport = data.exists("viewport") ? data["viewport"].toArray() : {};

// Scanning Handler
class ScanningRpcHandler extends RpcHandler {
    private EchoScanningClient@ scanClient;
    private AdvancedMemoryScanner@ memScanner;

    ScanningRpcHandler() : super(RPC_CATEGORY_SCANNING) {
        scanClient = createEchoScanningClient();
        memScanner = getMemoryScanner();
        registerHandler(RPC_SCAN_PATTERN, this.handlePattern);
        registerHandler(RPC_SCAN_VALUE, this.handleValue);
    }

    RpcResponse@ handlePattern(RpcRequest@ request) {
        dict data = request.getData();
        string pattern = data.exists("pattern") ? data["pattern"].toString() : "";
        uint64 start = data.exists("start") ? data["start"].toInteger() : 0;
        uint64 end = data.exists("end") ? data["end"].toInteger() : 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;
        bool result = memScanner.scanPattern(pattern, start, end);
        array<MemoryScanResult@> results = memScanner.getResults();
        array<dict> resultDicts;
        for (uint i = 0; i < results.size(); i++) {
            resultDicts.push(results[i].toDict());
        }
        return RpcResponse(request.getRequestId(), true, "", {"pattern", pattern, "results", resultDicts, "count", results.size()});
    }

    RpcResponse@ handleValue(RpcRequest@ request) {
        dict data = request.getData();
        int value = data.exists("value") ? data["value"].toInteger() : 0;
        string scanType = data.exists("type") ? data["type"].toString() : "dword";
        uint64 start = data.exists("start") ? data["start"].toInteger() : 0;
        uint64 end = data.exists("end") ? data["end"].toInteger() : 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;
        bool result = memScanner.scanExactValue(value, scanType, start, end);
        array<MemoryScanResult@> results = memScanner.getResults();
        array<dict> resultDicts;
        for (uint i = 0; i < results.size(); i++) {
            resultDicts.push(results[i].toDict());
        }
        return RpcResponse(request.getRequestId(), true, "", {"value", value, "type", scanType, "results", resultDicts, "count", results.size()});
    }

    EchoScanningClient@ getScanningClient() { return scanClient; }
    AdvancedMemoryScanner@ getMemoryScanner() { return memScanner; }
}

// RPC Dispatcher
class RpcDispatcher {
    private dict<string, RpcHandler@> handlers;
    private EchoBackendWebSocketClient@ wsClient;
    private func@ onRequestCallback;
    private func@ onResponseCallback;
    private func@ onErrorCallback;

    RpcDispatcher() {
        handlers = {};
        wsClient = createEchoWebSocketClient();
    }

    void registerHandler(RpcHandler@ handler) {
        handlers[handler.getCategory()] = handler;
        print("[RPC] Registered handler: " + handler.getCategory() + "\n");
    }

    RpcResponse@ dispatch(RpcRequest@ request) {
        string category = request.getCategory();
        if (!handlers.exists(category)) {
            return RpcResponse(request.getRequestId(), false, "No handler for category: " + category, {});
        }
        RpcHandler@ handler = handlers[category];
        if (!handler.hasHandler(request.getType())) {
            return RpcResponse(request.getRequestId(), false, "No handler for type: " + request.getType(), {});
        }
        if (onRequestCallback) onRequestCallback.call(this, request);
        RpcResponse@ response = handler.handle(request);
        if (onResponseCallback) onResponseCallback.call(this, response);
        return response;
    }

    bool connect() {
        if (!wsClient.isConnected()) {
            wsClient.setOnMessage(this.handleWsMessage);
            wsClient.setOnError(this.handleWsError);
            wsClient.setOnConnect(this.handleWsConnect);
            wsClient.setOnDisconnect(this.handleWsDisconnect);
            return wsClient.connect();
        }
        return true;
    }

    void disconnect() { wsClient.disconnect(); }

    bool sendRequest(RpcRequest@ request, func@ callback = null) {
        if (!wsClient.isConnected()) {
            if (callback) callback.call(this, RpcResponse(request.getRequestId(), false, "Not connected", {}));
            return false;
        }
        return wsClient.send(request.toJSON());
    }

    void handleWsMessage(auto message) {
        if (message is string) {
            string strMessage = message;
            RpcResponse@ resp = RpcResponse.fromJSON(strMessage);
            if (resp != null) {
                if (onResponseCallback) onResponseCallback.call(this, resp);
                return;
            }
            RpcRequest@ req = RpcRequest.fromJSON(strMessage);
            if (req != null) {
                RpcResponse@ resp = dispatch(req);
                if (wsClient.isConnected()) wsClient.send(resp.toJSON());
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void handleWsError(string error) {
        print("[RPC] WS Error: " + error + "\n");
        if (onErrorCallback) onErrorCallback.call(this, error);
    }

    void handleWsConnect() { print("[RPC] WS Connected\n"); }
    void handleWsDisconnect() { print("[RPC] WS Disconnected\n"); }

    void setOnRequest(func@ cb) { onRequestCallback = cb; }
    void setOnResponse(func@ cb) { onResponseCallback = cb; }
    void setOnError(func@ cb) { onErrorCallback = cb; }

    bool send(string category, string type, dict data = {}, func@ cb = null) {
        return sendRequest(RpcRequest(category, type, data), cb);
    }

    uint getHandlerCount() { return handlers.size(); }
}

// Global dispatcher
RpcDispatcher@ g_rpcDispatcher = null;

void initRpcDispatcher() {
    if (g_rpcDispatcher == null) {
        g_rpcDispatcher = RpcDispatcher();
        g_rpcDispatcher.registerHandler(RenderingRpcHandler());
        g_rpcDispatcher.registerHandler(MemoryRpcHandler());
        g_rpcDispatcher.registerHandler(MathRpcHandler());
        g_rpcDispatcher.registerHandler(PerformanceRpcHandler());
        g_rpcDispatcher.registerHandler(ScanningRpcHandler());
        g_rpcDispatcher.registerHandler(BoneEspRpcHandler());
        g_rpcDispatcher.registerHandler(GameRpcHandler());
        g_rpcDispatcher.registerHandler(SystemRpcHandler());
    }
}

RpcDispatcher@ getRpcDispatcher() { initRpcDispatcher(); return g_rpcDispatcher; }
bool connectRpcDispatcher() { return getRpcDispatcher().connect(); }
void disconnectRpcDispatcher() { getRpcDispatcher().disconnect(); }
bool sendRpcRequest(string category, string type, dict data = {}, func@ cb = null) {
    return getRpcDispatcher().send(category, type, data, cb);
}
```
