`app/echo/echo-websocket-client.as`:

```as
// echo-websocket-client.as
// WebSocket client for Echo Backend integration
// Part of Echo Reverse - Game Cheat Framework

// ============================================================================
// IMPORTS
// ============================================================================

import "echo-backend-extensions.as";

// ============================================================================
// WEBSOCKET CLIENT CLASS
// ============================================================================

/// WebSocket client for connecting to Echo Backend
class EchoWebSocketClient {
    private bool connected = false;
    private bool connecting = false;
    private int reconnectAttempts = 0;
    private uint64 lastPingTime = 0;
    private uint64 lastActivityTime = 0;
    private int maxReconnectAttempts = 10;
    private int reconnectDelay = 5000; // milliseconds
    
    private string url = "ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext";
    private uint64 lastMessageId = 0;
    
    // Callback handlers
    private func@ onConnectCallback;
    private func@ onDisconnectCallback;
    private func@ onMessageCallback;
    private func@ onErrorCallback;
    
    // Pending requests
    private dict pendingRequests;
    
    // Message queue
    private array<dict@> messageQueue;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    /// Initialize the WebSocket client
    EchoWebSocketClient(string url = "ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext") {
        this.url = url;
        this.connected = false;
        this.connecting = false;
        this.reconnectAttempts = 0;
        this.pendingRequests = {};
        this.messageQueue = {};
        this.lastActivityTime = platform::time();
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CONNECTION MANAGEMENT
    // ============================================================================

    /// Connect to the WebSocket server
    bool connect() {
        if (connected) {
            print("[EchoWebSocket] Already connected\n");
            return true;
        }
        
        if (connecting) {
            print("[EchoWebSocket] Already connecting...\n");
            return false;
        }

        connecting = true;
        connected = false;
        reconnectAttempts = 0;
        lastActivityTime = platform::time();

        print("[EchoWebSocket] Connecting to " + url + "...\n");

        // Platform-specific WebSocket connection
        // This is a placeholder - actual implementation depends on the platform
        bool result = platform::websocket_connect(url);
        
        if (result) {
            connected = true;
            connecting = false;
            reconnectAttempts = 0;
            lastActivityTime = platform::time();
            
            print("[EchoWebSocket] Connected to Echo Backend\n");
            
            // Process queued messages
            processQueue();
            
            // Call onConnect callback
            if (onConnectCallback) {
                onConnectCallback.call(this);
            }
            
            return true;
        } else {
            connecting = false;
            connected = false;
            reconnectAttempts++;
            
            print("[EchoWebSocket] Connection failed, attempt " + reconnectAttempts + "/" + maxReconnectAttempts + "\n");
            
            // Attempt reconnection
            if (reconnectAttempts < maxReconnectAttempts) {
                platform::sleep(reconnectDelay);
                return connect();
            }
            
            // Call onError callback
            if (onErrorCallback) {
                onErrorCallback.call(this, "Connection failed");
            }
            
            return false;
        }
    }

    /// Disconnect from the WebSocket server
    void disconnect() {
        if (!connected && !connecting) {
            return;
        }

        print("[EchoWebSocket] Disconnecting...\n");
        
        // Platform-specific disconnect
        platform::websocket_disconnect();
        
        connected = false;
        connecting = false;
        lastActivityTime = platform::time();
        
        print("[EchoWebSocket] Disconnected\n");
        
        // Call onDisconnect callback
        if (onDisconnectCallback) {
            onDisconnectCallback.call(this);
        }
    }

    /// Reconnect to the WebSocket server
    bool reconnect() {
        disconnect();
        reconnectAttempts = 0;
        return connect();
    }

    /// Check if connected
    bool isConnected() {
        return connected;
    }

    /// Check if connecting
    bool isConnecting() {
        return connecting;
    }

    /// Get connection status
    dict getConnectionStatus() {
        return {
            {"connected", connected},
            {"connecting", connecting},
            {"reconnectAttempts", reconnectAttempts},
            {"maxReconnectAttempts", maxReconnectAttempts},
            {"url", url},
            {"lastActivityTime", lastActivityTime},
            {"pendingRequests", pendingRequests.size()},
            {"queuedMessages", messageQueue.size()}
        };
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // MESSAGE HANDLING
    // ============================================================================

    /// Send a message to the server
    bool send(dict@ message) {
        if (!connected) {
            // Queue the message if not connected
            print("[EchoWebSocket] Not connected, queuing message: " + json::encode(message) + "\n");
            messageQueue.push(message);
            
            // Attempt to connect
            connect();
            return false;
        }

        // Generate message ID
        lastMessageId++;
        message["message_id"] = lastMessageId;
        message["timestamp"] = platform::time();

        // Convert to JSON string
        string jsonStr = json::encode(message);
        
        // Platform-specific send
        bool result = platform::websocket_send(jsonStr);
        
        if (result) {
            lastActivityTime = platform::time();
            
            // Store pending request if it has a request_id
            if (message.exists("request_id")) {
                uint64 requestId = message["request_id"].toInteger();
                pendingRequests[requestId] = message;
            }
            
            return true;
        } else {
            // Connection lost, try to reconnect
            connected = false;
            print("[EchoWebSocket] Send failed, reconnecting...\n");
            reconnect();
            return false;
        }
    }

    /// Send a request with response handling
    uint64 sendRequest(string type, dict@ data, func@ callback) {
        lastMessageId++;
        uint64 requestId = lastMessageId;
        
        dict@ message = {
            {"type", type},
            {"request_id", requestId},
            {"data", data},
            {"timestamp", platform::time()}
        };

        // Store callback
        if (callback) {
            dict@ request = {
                {"request_id", requestId},
                {"timestamp", platform::time()},
                {"callback", callback}
            };
            pendingRequests[requestId] = request;
        }

        // Send the message
        send(message);
        
        return requestId;
    }

    /// Send a response to a request
    bool sendResponse(uint64 requestId, string type, dict@ data, bool success = true, string error = "") {
        dict@ response = {
            {"type", type},
            {"request_id", requestId},
            {"success", success},
            {"error", error},
            {"data", data},
            {"timestamp", platform::time()}
        };

        return send(response);
    }

    /// Process queued messages
    void processQueue() {
        if (!connected) {
            return;
        }

        while (messageQueue.size() > 0) {
            dict@ message = messageQueue[0];
            messageQueue.removeAt(0);
            
            bool result = send(message);
            if (!result) {
                // Put it back in the queue
                messageQueue.insertAt(0, message);
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    /// Handle incoming message
    void handleMessage(string message) {
        lastActivityTime = platform::time();
        
        // Parse JSON
        dict@ jsonData;
        try {
            jsonData = json::decode(message);
        } catch (exception e) {
            print("[EchoWebSocket] Failed to parse message: " + message + "\n");
            if (onErrorCallback) {
                onErrorCallback.call(this, "Invalid JSON: " + e.message);
            }
            return;
        }

        // Call onMessage callback
        if (onMessageCallback) {
            onMessageCallback.call(this, jsonData);
        }

        // Handle response
        if (jsonData.exists("request_id")) {
            uint64 requestId = jsonData["request_id"].toInteger();
            
            if (pendingRequests.exists(requestId)) {
                dict@ request = pendingRequests[requestId];
                
                // Call the callback if it exists
                if (request.exists("callback") && request["callback"]) {
                    func@ callback = request["callback"];
                    callback.call(this, jsonData);
                }
                
                // Remove from pending
                pendingRequests.remove(requestId);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Handle error
    void handleError(string error) {
        print("[EchoWebSocket] Error: " + error + "\n");
        
        if (onErrorCallback) {
            onErrorCallback.call(this, error);
        }
        
        // Check if we need to reconnect
        if (connected) {
            connected = false;
            reconnect();
        }
    }

    /// Handle connection close
    void handleClose(int code, string reason) {
        print("[EchoWebSocket] Connection closed: " + code + " - " + reason + "\n");
        
        connected = false;
        connecting = false;
        
        if (onDisconnectCallback) {
            onDisconnectCallback.call(this, code, reason);
        }
        
        // Attempt to reconnect
        reconnect();
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // PING/PONG
    // ============================================================================

    /// Send ping
    bool sendPing() {
        if (!connected) {
            return false;
        }

        dict@ ping = {
            {"type", "ping"},
            {"timestamp", platform::time()}
        };

        bool result = send(ping);
        if (result) {
            lastPingTime = platform::time();
        }
        
        return result;
    }

    /// Send pong
    bool sendPong() {
        if (!connected) {
            return false;
        }

        dict@ pong = {
            {"type", "pong"},
            {"timestamp", platform::time()}
        };

        return send(pong);
    }

    /// Check if connection is alive
    bool isAlive() {
        if (!connected) {
            return false;
        }

        // Check if we've received activity in the last 30 seconds
        uint64 currentTime = platform::time();
        return (currentTime - lastActivityTime) < 30000;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CALLBACK REGISTRATION
    // ============================================================================

    /// Set connection callback
    void setOnConnect(func@ callback) {
        onConnectCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set disconnection callback
    void setOnDisconnect(func@ callback) {
        onDisconnectCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set message callback
    void setOnMessage(func@ callback) {
        onMessageCallback = callback;
    }

    /// Set error callback
    void setOnError(func@ callback) {
        onErrorCallback = callback;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CLEANUP
    // ============================================================================

    /// Clear pending requests
    void clearPendingRequests() {
        pendingRequests.clear();
    }

    /// Clear message queue
    void clearMessageQueue() {
        messageQueue.clear();
    }

    /// Reset all callbacks
    void resetCallbacks() {
        onConnectCallback = null;
        onDisconnectCallback = null;
        onMessageCallback = null;
        onErrorCallback = null;
    }
}

/// WebSocket connection manager
class EchoWebSocketManager {
    private dict<string, EchoWebSocketClient@> connections;
    private EchoWebSocketClient@ defaultConnection;

    // ============================================================================
    // CONSTRUCTOR
    // ============================================================================

    EchoWebSocketManager() {
        connections = {};
        defaultConnection = null;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CONNECTION MANAGEMENT
    // ============================================================================

    /// Create a new connection
    EchoWebSocketClient@ createConnection(string url = "ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext") {
        EchoWebSocketClient@ conn = EchoWebSocketClient(url);
        string id = "conn_" + connections.size();
        connections[id] = conn;
        
        // Set as default if it's the first connection
        if (defaultConnection == null) {
            defaultConnection = conn;
        }
        
        return conn;
    }

    /// Get connection by ID
    EchoWebSocketClient@ getConnection(string id) {
        if (connections.exists(id)) {
            return connections[id];
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// Get default connection
    EchoWebSocketClient@ getDefaultConnection() {
        return defaultConnection;
    }

    /// Set default connection
    void setDefaultConnection(string id) {
        if (connections.exists(id)) {
            defaultConnection = connections[id];
        }
    }

    /// Remove a connection
    void removeConnection(string id) {
        if (connections.exists(id)) {
            EchoWebSocketClient@ conn = connections[id];
            conn.disconnect();
            connections.remove(id);
            
            // Update default if needed
            if (defaultConnection == conn) {
                if (connections.size() > 0) {
                    defaultConnection = connections.values()[0];
                } else {
                    defaultConnection = null;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Remove all connections
    void removeAllConnections() {
        for (uint i = 0; i < connections.size(); i++) {
            string id = connections.keys()[i];
            EchoWebSocketClient@ conn = connections[id];
            conn.disconnect();
        }
        connections.clear();
        defaultConnection = null;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // UTILITY FUNCTIONS
    // ============================================================================

    /// Get all connections
    array<EchoWebSocketClient@> getAllConnections() {
        return connections.values();
    }

    /// Get connection count
    uint getConnectionCount() {
        return connections.size();
    }

    /// Check if any connection is active
    bool isAnyConnected() {
        for (uint i = 0; i < connections.size(); i++) {
            EchoWebSocketClient@ conn = connections.values()[i];
            if (conn.isConnected()) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /// Connect all connections
    void connectAll() {
        for (uint i = 0; i < connections.size(); i++) {
            EchoWebSocketClient@ conn = connections.values()[i];
            if (!conn.isConnected()) {
                conn.connect();
            }
        }
    }

    /// Disconnect all connections
    void disconnectAll() {
        for (uint i = 0; i < connections.size(); i++) {
            EchoWebSocketClient@ conn = connections.values()[i];
            conn.disconnect();
        }
    }
}
```

`app/echo/integrations/angel-menu-control.as`:

```as
// ============================================================================
// AI MENU CONTROL — portable drop-in lane (paste into any Angel script)
// ============================================================================
// Exposes a WebSocket lane (ui_list / ui_get / ui_set) that an external AI / MCP client
// (the angel-menu-mcp server) uses to enumerate and toggle THIS script's menu — for automated
// testing. Control set/read goes through the STORED handle (live-verified: ui::get/ui::set on a
// stored copy track the real control), so this file is fully control-agnostic — the per-script
// registry is generated by generate-registry.mjs (names each control by its m_<var> global).
//
// INTEGRATION (see INTEGRATION.md):
//   1. Paste this file's contents into your script (once).
//   2. Run:  node generate-registry.mjs your_script.as   -> paste the amc_build_registry() it prints.
//   3. In build_menu(), after your controls: amc_add_buttons();
//   4. In main(), after build_menu():          amc_build_registry();
//   5. In your render callback, first line:     amc_render();
//   6. In on_unload():                          amc_on_unload();
//
// SINGLE ws:: SOCKET: the host allows one ws:: connection per script. If this script also uses
// ws:: (e.g. WebRadar), only one may be connected at a time — disconnect the other before
// clicking "AI Menu Control: Connect".
//
// SAFETY: controls whose registration passed danger=true (anything that writes game memory)
// refuse ui_set unless the operator clicks "AI Menu Control: ARM" in the overlay. Arming is a
// live human click, never a wire verb.

const string AMC_URL = "ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ui"; // must match angel-menu-mcp's port/path

const int AMC_CHECK = 0, AMC_SLIDER = 1, AMC_COMBO = 2, AMC_MULTI = 3, AMC_COLOR = 4;

class AmcCtl
{
    string name;
    string label;             // human menu label (the ui::add_* first arg); falls back to name
    int    kind;
    bool   danger;
    bool   writable;          // check/slider/combo -> true; multi/color -> read-only in v1
    string tab;               // overlay tab this control lives under (from amc_tab)
    string subtab;            // overlay sub-tab (from amc_subtab)
    string category;          // overlay category (from amc_category)
    checkbox     cb;
    slider       sl;
    combobox     co;
    multi_select ms;
    color_picker cp;
    int mn, mx, st;           // slider
    array<string> options;    // combo/multi labels
}
array<AmcCtl> g_amc;          // built once in amc_build_registry(); read-only after

// Running tab/category context, mirroring the overlay's own ui::add_tab / ui::add_category calls.
// The generated amc_build_registry() calls amc_tab()/amc_category() so the registry keeps the
// menu's structure; each amc_* registration stamps the current tab/category onto the control.
string g_amc_cur_tab = "";
string g_amc_cur_sub = "";
string g_amc_cur_cat = "";
void amc_tab(const string &in t)      { g_amc_cur_tab = t; g_amc_cur_sub = ""; g_amc_cur_cat = ""; }
void amc_subtab(const string &in s)   { g_amc_cur_sub = s; g_amc_cur_cat = ""; }
void amc_category(const string &in c) { g_amc_cur_cat = c; }

// queued ui_set requests, applied on the render thread by amc_render()
class AmcSetReq { string id; int idx; bool bval; int ival; }
mutex@ g_amc_qmtx = create_mutex();
array<AmcSetReq> g_amc_q;

// lane state
bool g_amc_active = false;                  // true while connected
atomic_bool@ g_amc_armed     = atomic_bool(false); // danger-control arm
atomic_bool@ g_amc_unloading = atomic_bool(false); // set by amc_on_unload()
atomic_int32@ g_amc_busy     = atomic_int32(0);    // in-flight ws callbacks (drain on unload)

// buttons (added by amc_add_buttons())
button g_amc_btn_connect, g_amc_btn_disconnect, g_amc_btn_arm, g_amc_btn_disarm;

// ── registration helpers (the generated amc_build_registry() calls these) ────
void amc_check(const string &in name, checkbox &in c, const string &in label = "", bool danger = false)
{
    AmcCtl u; u.name = name; u.label = (label == "" ? name : label); u.kind = AMC_CHECK; u.danger = danger; u.writable = true; u.cb = c;
    u.tab = g_amc_cur_tab; u.subtab = g_amc_cur_sub; u.category = g_amc_cur_cat;
    g_amc.insertLast(u);
}
void amc_slider(const string &in name, slider &in s, int mn, int mx, int st, const string &in label = "", bool danger = false)
{
    AmcCtl u; u.name = name; u.label = (label == "" ? name : label); u.kind = AMC_SLIDER; u.danger = danger; u.writable = true; u.sl = s;
    u.mn = mn; u.mx = mx; u.st = st;
    u.tab = g_amc_cur_tab; u.subtab = g_amc_cur_sub; u.category = g_amc_cur_cat;
    g_amc.insertLast(u);
}
void amc_combo(const string &in name, combobox &in c, const string &in optsCsv, const string &in label = "", bool danger = false)
{
    AmcCtl u; u.name = name; u.label = (label == "" ? name : label); u.kind = AMC_COMBO; u.danger = danger; u.writable = true; u.co = c;
    amc_split_csv(optsCsv, u.options);
    u.tab = g_amc_cur_tab; u.subtab = g_amc_cur_sub; u.category = g_amc_cur_cat;
    g_amc.insertLast(u);
}
void amc_multi(const string &in name, multi_select &in m, const string &in optsCsv, const string &in label = "", bool danger = false)
{
    AmcCtl u; u.name = name; u.label = (label == "" ? name : label); u.kind = AMC_MULTI; u.danger = danger; u.writable = false; u.ms = m;
    amc_split_csv(optsCsv, u.options);
    u.tab = g_amc_cur_tab; u.subtab = g_amc_cur_sub; u.category = g_amc_cur_cat;
    g_amc.insertLast(u);
}
void amc_color(const string &in name, color_picker &in c, const string &in label = "", bool danger = false)
{
    AmcCtl u; u.name = name; u.label = (label == "" ? name : label); u.kind = AMC_COLOR; u.danger = danger; u.writable = false; u.cp = c;
    u.tab = g_amc_cur_tab; u.subtab = g_amc_cur_sub; u.category = g_amc_cur_cat;
    g_amc.insertLast(u);
}

void amc_split_csv(const string &in csv, array<string> &inout dst)
{
    string cur = "";
    for (uint i = 0; i < csv.length(); i++)
    {
        if (csv[i] == 44) { dst.insertLast(cur); cur = ""; }   // 44 = ','
        else cur += csv.substr(i, 1);
    }
    if (cur != "") dst.insertLast(cur);
}
int amc_find(const string &in name)
{
    for (uint i = 0; i < g_amc.length(); i++) if (g_amc[i].name == name) return int(i);
    return -1;
}
string amc_kind_name(int k)
{
    if (k == AMC_CHECK)  return "check";
    if (k == AMC_SLIDER) return "slider";
    if (k == AMC_COMBO)  return "combo";
    if (k == AMC_MULTI)  return "multi";
    return "color";
}

// ── value read via STORED handle (live) ─────────────────────────────────────
string amc_value_json(AmcCtl@ u)
{
    if (u.kind == AMC_CHECK)  return ui::get(u.cb) ? "true" : "false";
    if (u.kind == AMC_SLIDER) return "" + ui::get(u.sl);
    if (u.kind == AMC_COMBO)  return "" + int(ui::get(u.co));
    if (u.kind == AMC_MULTI)
    {
        string a = "[";
        for (uint i = 0; i < u.options.length(); i++)
            a += (i > 0 ? "," : "") + (ui::get(u.ms, uint64(i)) ? "true" : "false");
        return a + "]";
    }
    color c = ui::get(u.cp);   // AMC_COLOR
    return "\"" + c.r + "," + c.g + "," + c.b + "," + c.a + "\"";
}

// ── minimal JSON scalar parsing (self-contained; no external helpers) ────────
string amc_json_str(const string &in f, const string &in key, const string &in def)
{
    string pat = "\"" + key + "\"";
    int k = f.findFirst(pat);
    if (k < 0) return def;
    int c = f.findFirst(":", uint(k) + pat.length());
    if (c < 0) return def;
    int q = f.findFirst("\"", uint(c) + 1);
    if (q < 0) return def;
    uint i = uint(q) + 1;
    string v = "";
    while (i < f.length() && f[i] != 34)   // 34 = '"'
    {
        if (f[i] == 92 && i + 1 < f.length()) { v += f.substr(i + 1, 1); i += 2; continue; }
        v += f.substr(i, 1); i++;
    }
    return v;
}
bool amc_json_has(const string &in f, const string &in key) { return f.findFirst("\"" + key + "\"") >= 0; }
bool amc_json_bool(const string &in f, const string &in key, bool def)
{
    int p = f.findFirst("\"" + key + "\"");
    if (p < 0) return def;
    int c = f.findFirst(":", uint(p));
    if (c < 0) return def;
    uint i = uint(c) + 1;
    while (i < f.length() && (f[i] == 0x20 || f[i] == 0x09)) i++;
    return i < f.length() && f[i] == 't'[0];
}
int amc_json_int(const string &in f, const string &in key, int def)
{
    int p = f.findFirst("\"" + key + "\"");
    if (p < 0) return def;
    int c = f.findFirst(":", uint(p));
    if (c < 0) return def;
    uint i = uint(c) + 1;
    while (i < f.length() && (f[i] == 0x20 || f[i] == 0x09)) i++;
    bool neg = false;
    if (i < f.length() && f[i] == '-'[0]) { neg = true; i++; }
    bool any = false; int v = 0;
    while (i < f.length()) { uint8 ch = f[i]; if (ch < 48 || ch > 57) break; v = v * 10 + int(ch - 48); any = true; i++; }
    if (!any) return def;
    return neg ? -v : v;
}
string amc_extract_id(const string &in s)
{
    int p = s.findFirst("\"id\"");
    if (p < 0) return "0";
    int c = s.findFirst(":", uint(p) + 4);
    if (c < 0) return "0";
    uint i = uint(c) + 1;
    while (i < s.length() && s[i] == 0x20) i++;
    uint j = i;
    while (j < s.length()) { uint8 ch = s[j]; if (ch < 48 || ch > 57) break; j++; }
    if (j == i) return "0";
    return s.substr(i, j - i);
}
string amc_json_escape(const string &in src)
{
    string r = "";
    for (uint i = 0; i < src.length(); i++)
    {
        uint8 ch = src[i];
        if (ch == 34 || ch == 92) { r += "\\"; r += src.substr(i, 1); }
        else if (ch >= 0x20) r += src.substr(i, 1);
    }
    return r;
}
void amc_err(const string &in id, int code, const string &in msg)
{
    ws::send("{\"type\":\"error\",\"id\":" + id + ",\"code\":" + code + ",\"message\":\"" + amc_json_escape(msg) + "\"}");
}

// ── verb handlers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void amc_handle_list(const string &in id)
{
    string rows = "";
    for (uint i = 0; i < g_amc.length(); i++)
    {
        AmcCtl@ u = g_amc[i];
        if (i > 0) rows += ",";
        rows += "{\"name\":\"" + amc_json_escape(u.name) + "\",\"label\":\"" + amc_json_escape(u.label) + "\",\"kind\":\"" + amc_kind_name(u.kind)
              + "\",\"value\":" + amc_value_json(u)
              + ",\"writable\":" + (u.writable ? "true" : "false")
              + ",\"danger\":" + (u.danger ? "true" : "false")
              + ",\"tab\":\"" + amc_json_escape(u.tab) + "\",\"subtab\":\"" + amc_json_escape(u.subtab) + "\",\"category\":\"" + amc_json_escape(u.category) + "\"";
        if (u.kind == AMC_SLIDER)
            rows += ",\"min\":" + u.mn + ",\"max\":" + u.mx + ",\"step\":" + u.st;
        if (u.kind == AMC_COMBO || u.kind == AMC_MULTI)
        {
            rows += ",\"options\":[";
            for (uint k = 0; k < u.options.length(); k++)
                rows += (k > 0 ? "," : "") + "\"" + amc_json_escape(u.options[k]) + "\"";
            rows += "]";
        }
        rows += "}";
    }
    ws::send("{\"type\":\"ui_list_result\",\"id\":" + id + ",\"count\":" + g_amc.length()
             + ",\"results\":[" + rows + "]}");
}
void amc_handle_get(const string &in frame, const string &in id)
{
    string name = amc_json_str(frame, "name", "");
    int i = amc_find(name);
    if (i < 0) { amc_err(id, 1030, "unknown control: " + name); return; }
    AmcCtl@ u = g_amc[uint(i)];
    ws::send("{\"type\":\"ui_get_result\",\"id\":" + id + ",\"name\":\"" + amc_json_escape(name)
             + "\",\"kind\":\"" + amc_kind_name(u.kind) + "\",\"value\":" + amc_value_json(u) + "}");
}
void amc_handle_set(const string &in frame, const string &in id)
{
    string name = amc_json_str(frame, "name", "");
    int i = amc_find(name);
    if (i < 0) { amc_err(id, 1030, "unknown control: " + name); return; }
    AmcCtl@ u = g_amc[uint(i)];
    if (!u.writable) { amc_err(id, 1032, "read-only control (" + amc_kind_name(u.kind) + "): " + name); return; }
    if (u.danger && !g_amc_armed.load())
    { amc_err(id, 1005, "danger control disarmed: " + name + " (click 'AI Menu Control: ARM' in the overlay)"); return; }
    if (!amc_json_has(frame, "value")) { amc_err(id, 1031, "missing value"); return; }

    AmcSetReq r; r.id = id; r.idx = i;
    if (u.kind == AMC_CHECK)
        r.bval = amc_json_bool(frame, "value", false) || amc_json_int(frame, "value", 0) != 0;
    else
    {
        int v = amc_json_int(frame, "value", 0);
        if (u.kind == AMC_SLIDER) { if (v < u.mn) v = u.mn; if (v > u.mx) v = u.mx; }
        else { int oc = int(u.options.length()); if (v < 0) v = 0; if (oc > 0 && v >= oc) v = oc - 1; }
        r.ival = v;
    }
    g_amc_qmtx.lock();
    g_amc_q.insertLast(r);
    g_amc_qmtx.unlock();
}

// ── RENDER-THREAD: drain + apply queued sets, reply per applied control ──────
// Call amc_render() as the first line of your render callback.
void amc_render()
{
    if (!g_amc_active)
    {
        g_amc_qmtx.lock();
        if (g_amc_q.length() != 0) g_amc_q.resize(0);
        g_amc_qmtx.unlock();
        return;
    }
    g_amc_qmtx.lock();
    if (g_amc_q.length() == 0) { g_amc_qmtx.unlock(); return; }
    array<AmcSetReq> batch = g_amc_q;
    g_amc_q.resize(0);
    g_amc_qmtx.unlock();

    for (uint i = 0; i < batch.length(); i++)
    {
        AmcSetReq@ r = batch[i];
        if (r.idx < 0 || r.idx >= int(g_amc.length())) continue;
        AmcCtl@ u = g_amc[uint(r.idx)];
        if      (u.kind == AMC_CHECK)  ui::set(u.cb, r.bval);   // set through the STORED handle (live)
        else if (u.kind == AMC_SLIDER) ui::set(u.sl, r.ival);
        else if (u.kind == AMC_COMBO)  ui::set(u.co, r.ival);
        // echo the APPLIED value (reads can lag a frame; we just wrote this, so it's the truth)
        string applied = (u.kind == AMC_CHECK) ? (r.bval ? "true" : "false") : ("" + r.ival);
        ws::send("{\"type\":\"ui_set_result\",\"id\":" + r.id + ",\"success\":true,\"name\":\""
                 + amc_json_escape(u.name) + "\",\"kind\":\"" + amc_kind_name(u.kind)
                 + "\",\"value\":" + applied + "}");
    }
}

// ── ws:: lane plumbing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void amc_on_open()  { alert::show_tag("AI Menu Control: connected (/agent-ui)", "amc", 80, 255, 120); }
void amc_on_msg(string msg)
{
    // busy-count around dispatch so amc_on_unload()'s drain waits for an in-flight handler
    { int c = g_amc_busy.load(); while (true) { int e = c; int s = g_amc_busy.compare_exchange(e, c + 1); if (s == c) break; c = s; } }
    if (!g_amc_unloading.load())
    {
        string type = amc_json_str(msg, "type", "");
        string id   = amc_extract_id(msg);
        if      (type == "ui_list") amc_handle_list(id);
        else if (type == "ui_get")  amc_handle_get(msg, id);
        else if (type == "ui_set")  amc_handle_set(msg, id);
        else amc_err(id, 1000, "unknown ui verb: " + type);
    }
    { int c = g_amc_busy.load(); while (true) { int e = c; int s = g_amc_busy.compare_exchange(e, c - 1); if (s == c) break; c = s; } }
}
void amc_on_close() { g_amc_active = false; g_amc_armed.store(false); alert::show_tag("AI Menu Control: disconnected", "amc", 255, 160, 40); }
void amc_on_err(string err) { g_amc_active = false; g_amc_armed.store(false); alert::show_tag("AI Menu Control: ws error — " + err, "amc", 255, 80, 80); }

void amc_connect()
{
    if (g_amc_unloading.load()) return;
    if (g_amc_active) { alert::show_tag("AI Menu Control: already connected", "amc", 255, 200, 40); return; }
    g_amc_active = true;   // optimistic; on_err/on_close clears it if the socket won't open
    ws::connect(AMC_URL, @amc_on_open, @amc_on_msg, @amc_on_close, @amc_on_err);
}
void amc_disconnect()
{
    if (!g_amc_active) return;
    g_amc_active = false;
    g_amc_armed.store(false);
    ws::disconnect();
    alert::show_tag("AI Menu Control: disconnected", "amc", 200, 200, 200);
}
void amc_arm()
{
    if (!g_amc_active) { alert::show_tag("AI Menu Control: connect first", "amc", 255, 160, 40); return; }
    g_amc_armed.store(true);
    alert::show_tag("AI Menu Control: danger controls ARMED", "amc", 255, 110, 40);
}
void amc_disarm() { g_amc_armed.store(false); alert::show_tag("AI Menu Control: danger controls disarmed", "amc", 200, 200, 200); }

void amc_on_connect_click()    { amc_connect(); }
void amc_on_disconnect_click() { amc_disconnect(); }
void amc_on_arm_click()        { amc_arm(); }
void amc_on_disarm_click()     { amc_disarm(); }

// Call inside build_menu() (e.g. in a "Debug" or "Misc" category).
void amc_add_buttons()
{
    g_amc_btn_connect    = ui::add_button("AI Menu Control: Connect", @amc_on_connect_click);
    g_amc_btn_disconnect = ui::add_button("AI Menu Control: Disconnect", @amc_on_disconnect_click);
    g_amc_btn_arm        = ui::add_button("AI Menu Control: ARM danger controls (DANGEROUS)", @amc_on_arm_click);
    g_amc_btn_disarm     = ui::add_button("AI Menu Control: Disarm danger controls", @amc_on_disarm_click);
}

// Call from on_unload(): stop new work, drain in-flight handlers, drop the socket + arm.
void amc_on_unload()
{
    g_amc_unloading.store(true);
    g_amc_armed.store(false);
    uint64 dl = util::tickcount() + 2000;
    while (g_amc_busy.load() != 0 && util::tickcount() < dl) {}
    if (g_amc_active) { g_amc_active = false; ws::disconnect(); }
}
```

`app/echo/templates/aimbot.as`:

```as
// Full CS2 aimbot: target selection, smoothing, velocity prediction, triggerbot
//
// OFFSETS AND SIGNATURES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS. They are illustrative values
// from one community dump and are NOT verified. Re-derive them from a current
// cs2-dumper run after every game update before using this template.
//
// The mouse is driven through input::mouse_move(), which takes ABSOLUTE
// screen coordinates. To apply a relative delta we read the current cursor
// position with input::mouse_pos() and add the delta to it.

// ─── Offsets (placeholders — re-verify per patch) ────────────────────────────
const uint64 OFF_HP         = 0x344;
const uint64 OFF_LIFE       = 0x338;
const uint64 OFF_TEAM       = 0x3CB;
const uint64 OFF_ORIGIN     = 0x1294;
const uint64 OFF_VELOCITY   = 0x1254;
const uint64 OFF_PUNCH_P    = 0x1450; // m_aimPunchAngle pitch
const uint64 OFF_PUNCH_Y    = 0x1454; // m_aimPunchAngle yaw
const uint64 OFF_VIEW_P     = 0x1658; // view pitch
const uint64 OFF_VIEW_Y     = 0x165C; // view yaw
const uint64 OFF_SKELETON   = 0x168;
const uint64 OFF_BONE_ARR   = 0x80;

// Bone indices
const int BONE_HEAD  = 9;
const int BONE_NECK  = 8;
const int BONE_CHEST = 7;

// Source units per second travelled by a bullet (approximate, placeholder)
const float BULLET_SPEED = 1500.0f;

// ─── State ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
uint64 g_entity_list  = 0;
uint64 g_local_player = 0; // ptr to local pawn ptr

checkbox g_aim_on;
slider   g_aim_fov;      // degrees
slider   g_aim_smooth;   // 1..30
combobox g_aim_bone;
combobox g_aim_mode;     // 0 = hold RMB, 1 = toggle RMB
checkbox g_aim_recoil;
checkbox g_trig_on;
slider   g_trig_fov;     // hundredths of a degree

bool g_aim_active  = false;
bool g_last_rmb    = false;
bool g_aim_toggled = false;

// ─── Entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
bool main() {
    ui::config_path("echo_aimbot");

    ui::add_tab("Aimbot");
    ui::add_category("Settings");
    g_aim_on     = ui::add_checkbox("Enable", false, "aim.on");
    g_aim_fov    = ui::add_slider("FOV (deg)", 8, 1, 45, 1, "deg", "aim.fov");
    g_aim_smooth = ui::add_slider("Smoothing", 5, 1, 30, 1, "", "aim.smooth");
    g_aim_bone   = ui::add_combobox("Bone", {"Head", "Neck", "Chest"}, 0, "aim.bone");
    g_aim_mode   = ui::add_combobox("Mode", {"Hold RMB", "Toggle RMB"}, 0, "aim.mode");
    g_aim_recoil = ui::add_checkbox("Recoil comp", true, "aim.recoil");
    g_trig_on    = ui::add_checkbox("Triggerbot", false, "aim.trig");
    g_trig_fov   = ui::add_slider("Trigger FOV", 30, 5, 100, 5, "cdeg", "aim.trigfov");

    attach_data ad = process::attach("cs2.exe");
    if (ad.pid == 0) {
        alert::show("cs2.exe not found");
        return false;
    }

    create_thread(0,   @do_scan);
    create_thread(128, @aim_tick);
    return true;
}

void do_scan() {
    uint64 client = process::get_module_base("client.dll");
    if (client == 0) {
        alert::show("client.dll not found");
        return;
    }

    uint64 sig = process::find_signature(client, "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? 48 89 5C 24");
    if (sig == 0) {
        alert::show("entity list sig failed");
        return;
    }
    uint64 ent_sys = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);
    g_entity_list  = process::read_uint64(process::read_uint64(ent_sys) + 0x10);

    sig = process::find_signature(client, "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? 48 85 C9 74 ? 8B 01");
    if (sig != 0) g_local_player = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);

    alert::show("Aimbot ready");
}

// ─── User helpers (not Echo API) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
float clampf(float v, float lo, float hi) {
    if (v < lo) return lo;
    if (v > hi) return hi;
    return v;
}

// ─── Entity helpers (user code — chunk layout is game specific) ──────────────
uint64 get_entity(int idx) {
    uint64 chunk = process::read_uint64(g_entity_list + uint64(idx >> 9) * 8);
    if (chunk == 0) return 0;
    return process::read_uint64(chunk + uint64(idx & 0x1FF) * 120);
}

vec3 get_bone(uint64 ent, int bone) {
    uint64 skel = process::read_uint64(ent + OFF_SKELETON);
    uint64 arr  = process::read_uint64(skel + OFF_BONE_ARR);
    uint64 a    = arr + uint64(bone) * 0x20 + 0x10;
    return vec3(process::read_float(a),
                process::read_float(a + 4),
                process::read_float(a + 8));
}

// ─── Aimbot tick ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void aim_tick() {
    if (!ui::get(g_aim_on) || g_entity_list == 0 || g_local_player == 0) return;

    // Keybind handling — input::key_active() is true while the key is held
    bool rmb = input::key_active(0x02); // VK_RBUTTON
    uint64 mode = ui::get(g_aim_mode);
    if (mode == 0) {
        g_aim_active = rmb;
    } else {
        if (rmb && !g_last_rmb) g_aim_toggled = !g_aim_toggled;
        g_aim_active = g_aim_toggled;
    }
    g_last_rmb = rmb;
    if (!g_aim_active) return;

    // Local player
    uint64 lp = process::read_uint64(g_local_player);
    if (lp == 0) return;
    int   lp_team = process::read_int32(lp + OFF_TEAM);
    vec3  lp_pos  = vec3(process::read_float(lp + OFF_ORIGIN),
                         process::read_float(lp + OFF_ORIGIN + 4),
                         process::read_float(lp + OFF_ORIGIN + 8));
    vec2  view    = vec2(process::read_float(lp + OFF_VIEW_P),
                         process::read_float(lp + OFF_VIEW_Y));

    // Select bone
    array<int> bones = {BONE_HEAD, BONE_NECK, BONE_CHEST};
    int target_bone = bones[int(ui::get(g_aim_bone))];

    // Find best target
    double fov_limit = double(ui::get(g_aim_fov));
    double best_fov  = fov_limit;
    int    best_idx  = -1;

    for (int i = 1; i < 64; i++) {
        uint64 ent = get_entity(i);
        if (ent == 0) continue;
        if (process::read_uint8(ent + OFF_LIFE) != 0) continue;
        if (process::read_int32(ent + OFF_HP) <= 0) continue;
        if (process::read_int32(ent + OFF_TEAM) == lp_team) continue;

        vec3  origin = vec3(process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN),
                            process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN + 4),
                            process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN + 8));
        float dist = origin.distance(lp_pos);
        if (dist > 15000.0f) continue; // ~380m hard cap

        vec2 target = math::calculate_angle(lp_pos, get_bone(ent, target_bone));
        double fov  = math::calculate_fov(view, target);
        if (fov < best_fov) {
            best_fov = fov;
            best_idx = i;
        }
    }

    if (best_idx < 0) return;

    // Get target bone with velocity prediction
    uint64 best_ent = get_entity(best_idx);
    vec3  bp        = get_bone(best_ent, target_bone);
    vec3  vel       = vec3(process::read_float(best_ent + OFF_VELOCITY),
                           process::read_float(best_ent + OFF_VELOCITY + 4),
                           process::read_float(best_ent + OFF_VELOCITY + 8));

    float dist   = bp.distance(lp_pos);
    float travel = dist / BULLET_SPEED; // approximate bullet speed in Source units/s
    vec3  pred   = bp.add(vel.multiply(travel));

    // Target angle
    vec2 tgt = math::calculate_angle(lp_pos, pred);

    // Recoil compensation
    vec2 delta = vec2(float(math::angle_diff(tgt.x, view.x)),
                       float(math::angle_diff(tgt.y, view.y)));
    if (ui::get(g_aim_recoil)) {
        delta.x -= process::read_float(lp + OFF_PUNCH_P) * 2.0f;
        delta.y -= process::read_float(lp + OFF_PUNCH_Y) * 2.0f;
    }

    // Smooth — math::smooth_angles() returns the smoothed angle pair
    double smoothing = double(ui::get(g_aim_smooth)) / 30.0;
    vec2 smoothed = math::smooth_angles(view, vec2(view.x + delta.x, view.y + delta.y),
                                        angle_range::R_180, smoothing, 1.0, 45.0);
    vec2 step = vec2(smoothed.x - view.x, smoothed.y - view.y);

    // Angle step → mouse pixels (CS2 default: sensitivity 1.0, yaw 0.022)
    float sens = 0.022f; // adjust if user sens differs
    float mx = step.y / sens + util::random_float(-0.25f, 0.25f);
    float my = step.x / sens + util::random_float(-0.25f, 0.25f);
    mx = clampf(mx, -20.0f, 20.0f);
    my = clampf(my, -20.0f, 20.0f);

    // input::mouse_move() is absolute: read the cursor, add the delta, move back
    int cx, cy;
    input::mouse_pos(cx, cy);
    input::mouse_move(cx + int(mx), cy + int(my));

    // Triggerbot
    if (ui::get(g_trig_on) && best_fov * 100.0 < double(ui::get(g_trig_fov))) {
        // shortcut: 80% fire chance per tick; add a delay for realism
        if (util::random_int(0, 4) != 0)
            input::mouse_click();
    }
}

void on_unload() {
    process::detach();
}
```

`app/echo/templates/esp-bones.as`:

```as
// Full CS2/Source 2 ESP: boxes, skeleton, health bar, distance labels
//
// OFFSETS BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS. They are illustrative values copied from a
// community dump of one specific build. They are NOT verified and will be
// wrong after any game update. Re-derive every offset with a current
// cs2-dumper run before using this template.

// ─── Offsets (placeholders — re-verify per patch) ────────────────────────────
const uint64 OFF_HP         = 0x344;
const uint64 OFF_LIFE       = 0x338;  // 0 = alive
const uint64 OFF_TEAM       = 0x3CB;
const uint64 OFF_ORIGIN     = 0x1294;
const uint64 OFF_NAME       = 0x640;
const uint64 OFF_SKELETON   = 0x168;
const uint64 OFF_BONE_ARR   = 0x80;   // from skeleton base
const uint64 OFF_SPOTTED    = 0xF9B;

const int HEAD  = 9;
const int NECK  = 8;
const int CHEST = 7;
const int SPINE = 6;
const int PELVIS= 5;
const int SHL   = 10; const int ELB_L = 12; const int HAND_L = 13;
const int SHR   = 14; const int ELB_R = 16; const int HAND_R = 17;
const int HIP_L = 18; const int KNEE_L= 23; const int FOOT_L = 28;
const int HIP_R = 33; const int KNEE_R= 38; const int FOOT_R = 43;

// Pairs for skeleton draw: flat [from, to, from, to, ...]
array<int> BONE_PAIRS = {
    HEAD,NECK,  NECK,CHEST,  CHEST,SPINE,  SPINE,PELVIS,   // spine
    CHEST,SHL,  SHL,ELB_L,   ELB_L,HAND_L,                 // L arm
    CHEST,SHR,  SHR,ELB_R,   ELB_R,HAND_R,                 // R arm
    PELVIS,HIP_L, HIP_L,KNEE_L, KNEE_L,FOOT_L,              // L leg
    PELVIS,HIP_R, HIP_R,KNEE_R, KNEE_R,FOOT_R              // R leg
};
const int BONE_PAIR_COUNT = 16;

// ─── Shared entity data (written by tick, read by render) ────────────────────
class EspEntity {
    bool   alive;
    bool   visible;
    bool   is_team;
    int    hp;
    float  dist;
    string name;
    array<float> sx; array<float> sy; array<bool> sv; // bone screen positions
    float  box_x, box_y, box_w, box_h;

    EspEntity() {
        sx.resize(44);
        sy.resize(44);
        sv.resize(44);
    }
}

array<EspEntity@> g_entities;
mutex@ g_mx = create_mutex();

// ─── Menu ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
checkbox     g_esp_on;
checkbox     g_show_box;
checkbox     g_show_skel;
checkbox     g_show_hp;
checkbox     g_show_name;
slider       g_max_dist;      // metres
color_picker g_col_enemy;
color_picker g_col_team;
color_picker g_col_visible;

// ─── Process state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
uint64 g_entity_list   = 0;
uint64 g_view_mat_addr = 0;
uint64 g_local_player  = 0;

// ─── Entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
bool main() {
    ui::config_path("echo_esp_bones");

    ui::add_tab("ESP");
    ui::add_category("Visuals");
    g_esp_on      = ui::add_checkbox("Enable", true, "esp.on");
    g_show_box    = ui::add_checkbox("Boxes", true, "esp.box");
    g_show_skel   = ui::add_checkbox("Skeleton", true, "esp.skel");
    g_show_hp     = ui::add_checkbox("Health bar", true, "esp.hp");
    g_show_name   = ui::add_checkbox("Names", true, "esp.name");
    g_max_dist    = ui::add_slider("Max dist (m)", 200, 10, 500, 10, "m", "esp.dist");
    g_col_enemy   = ui::add_color_picker("Enemy", 220, 60, 60, 255, true, "esp.col_e");
    g_col_team    = ui::add_color_picker("Team", 80, 120, 255, 255, true, "esp.col_t");
    g_col_visible = ui::add_color_picker("Vis", 0, 220, 60, 255, true, "esp.col_v");

    attach_data ad = process::attach("cs2.exe");
    if (ad.pid == 0) {
        alert::show("cs2.exe not found");
        return false;
    }

    create_thread(0,  @do_scan);   // one-shot: find addresses
    create_thread(32, @tick);      // 32 tps entity update
    on_render(@draw);
    return true;
}

// ─── Address scan (runs once after attach) ───────────────────────────────────
void do_scan() {
    uint64 client = process::get_module_base("client.dll");
    if (client == 0) {
        alert::show("client.dll not found");
        return;
    }

    // Entity system
    uint64 sig = process::find_signature(client, "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? 48 89 5C 24");
    if (sig == 0) {
        alert::show("entity list sig failed");
        return;
    }
    uint64 ent_sys = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);
    g_entity_list  = process::read_uint64(process::read_uint64(ent_sys) + 0x10);

    // View matrix
    sig = process::find_signature(client, "48 8D 05 ? ? ? ? 48 89 05 ? ? ? ?");
    if (sig != 0) g_view_mat_addr = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);

    // Local player
    sig = process::find_signature(client, "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? 48 85 C9 74 ? 8B 01");
    if (sig != 0) g_local_player = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);

    alert::show("ESP ready");
}

// ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Entity list chunk walk (user code — the chunk layout is game specific)
uint64 get_entity(int idx) {
    uint64 chunk = process::read_uint64(g_entity_list + uint64(idx >> 9) * 8);
    if (chunk == 0) return 0;
    return process::read_uint64(chunk + uint64(idx & 0x1FF) * 120);
}

// Read a 4x4 float matrix (16 floats) from the target process (user code)
matrix4x4 read_matrix16(uint64 addr) {
    matrix4x4 m;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++)
        for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
            m[c][r] = process::read_float(addr + uint64(c * 4 + r) * 4);
    return m;
}

// Read one bone's world position (user code — bone stride is game specific)
vec3 get_bone_pos(uint64 ent, int bone) {
    uint64 skel = process::read_uint64(ent + OFF_SKELETON);
    uint64 arr  = process::read_uint64(skel + OFF_BONE_ARR);
    uint64 a    = arr + uint64(bone) * 0x20 + 0x10;
    return vec3(process::read_float(a),
                 process::read_float(a + 4),
                 process::read_float(a + 8));
}

// ─── Tick: read entity data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
void tick() {
    if (!ui::get(g_esp_on) || g_entity_list == 0 || g_view_mat_addr == 0) return;

    // Read the 4x4 view-projection matrix (float[16])
    matrix4x4 vm = read_matrix16(g_view_mat_addr);

    uint64 lp_ptr  = process::read_uint64(g_local_player);
    int    lp_team = (lp_ptr != 0) ? process::read_int32(lp_ptr + OFF_TEAM) : 0;
    vec3   lp_pos  = (lp_ptr != 0)
                   ? vec3(process::read_float(lp_ptr + OFF_ORIGIN),
                          process::read_float(lp_ptr + OFF_ORIGIN + 4),
                          process::read_float(lp_ptr + OFF_ORIGIN + 8))
                   : vec3(0, 0, 0);
    float  dist_max = float(ui::get(g_max_dist)) * 39.37f; // metres → Source units

    array<EspEntity@> local_buf;

    for (int i = 1; i < 64; i++) {
        uint64 ent = get_entity(i);
        if (ent == 0) continue;
        if (process::read_uint8(ent + OFF_LIFE) != 0) continue;  // dead
        int hp = process::read_int32(ent + OFF_HP);
        if (hp <= 0) continue;

        vec3 origin = vec3(process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN),
                           process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN + 4),
                           process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN + 8));
        float dist_units = origin.distance(lp_pos);
        if (dist_units > dist_max) continue;

        int  team    = process::read_int32(ent + OFF_TEAM);
        bool spotted = process::read_uint8(ent + OFF_SPOTTED) != 0;

        EspEntity@ ed = EspEntity();
        ed.alive   = true;
        ed.hp      = hp;
        ed.is_team = (team == lp_team);
        ed.visible = spotted;
        ed.dist    = dist_units / 39.37f;
        ed.name    = process::read_string(ent + OFF_NAME);

        // Project all skeleton bones
        bool head_ok = false, feet_ok = false;
        for (int b = 0; b < 44; b++) {
            vec2 screen;
            bool ok = source2::w2s(get_bone_pos(ent, b), vm, screen);
            ed.sv[b] = ok;
            // w2s leaves the out-param untouched when it fails — only store
            // the position when the conversion actually succeeded.
            if (ok) {
                ed.sx[b] = screen.x;
                ed.sy[b] = screen.y;
            }
        }
        head_ok = ed.sv[HEAD];
        feet_ok = ed.sv[FOOT_L] || ed.sv[FOOT_R];

        float head_sx = ed.sx[HEAD];
        float head_sy = ed.sy[HEAD];
        float feet_sx = ed.sv[FOOT_L] ? ed.sx[FOOT_L] : ed.sx[FOOT_R];
        float feet_sy = ed.sv[FOOT_L] ? ed.sy[FOOT_L] : ed.sy[FOOT_R];

        if (head_ok && feet_ok) {
            float bh = feet_sy > head_sy ? feet_sy - head_sy : head_sy - feet_sy;
            float bw = bh * 0.45f;
            ed.box_x = head_sx - bw * 0.5f;
            ed.box_y = head_sy;
            ed.box_w = bw;
            ed.box_h = bh;
        }

        local_buf.insertLast(ed);
    }

    g_mx.lock();
    g_entities = local_buf;
    g_mx.unlock();
}

// ─── Render ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void draw() {
    if (!ui::get(g_esp_on)) return;

    g_mx.lock_shared();
    array<EspEntity@> snap = g_entities;
    g_mx.unlock_shared();

    render::update_font(fonts::TAHOMA, 11);

    for (uint i = 0; i < snap.length(); i++) {
        EspEntity@ e = snap[i];
        if (!e.alive) continue;

        color c = e.is_team   ? ui::get(g_col_team)
                : e.visible   ? ui::get(g_col_visible)
                :               ui::get(g_col_enemy);

        // Fade alpha with distance
        float alpha_f = 1.0f - (e.dist / float(ui::get(g_max_dist))) * 0.5f;
        int a = int(c.a * alpha_f);
        if (a < 0) a = 0;

        // Box
        if (ui::get(g_show_box) && e.box_w > 0) {
            int x = int(e.box_x), y = int(e.box_y);
            int w = int(e.box_w), h = int(e.box_h);
            int cx = int(w * 0.25f), cy = int(h * 0.25f);
            // corners
            render::draw_line(x,     y,     x + cx, y,     c.r, c.g, c.b, a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(x,     y,     x,     y + cy, c.r, c.g, c.b, a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(x + w, y,     x + w - cx, y, c.r, c.g, c.b, a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(x + w, y,     x + w, y + cy, c.r, c.g, c.b, a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(x,     y + h, x + cx, y + h, c.r, c.g, c.b, a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(x,     y + h, x,     y + h - cy, c.r, c.g, c.b, a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(x + w, y + h, x + w - cx, y + h, c.r, c.g, c.b, a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(x + w, y + h, x + w, y + h - cy, c.r, c.g, c.b, a, 1.5f);
        }

        // Health bar (left of box, vertical)
        if (ui::get(g_show_hp) && e.box_h > 0) {
            int x = int(e.box_x) - 7;
            int y = int(e.box_y);
            int h = int(e.box_h);
            int filled = int(h * (float(e.hp) / 100.0f));
            render::draw_box(x, y, 4, h, 0, 0, 0, 180, box_style::OUTLINED, 0.0f);
            int r = int(255.0f * (1.0f - float(e.hp) / 100.0f));
            int g = int(255.0f * (float(e.hp) / 100.0f));
            render::draw_box(x + 1, y + (h - filled), 2, filled, r, g, 0, 220,
                             box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
        }

        // Skeleton
        if (ui::get(g_show_skel)) {
            for (int p = 0; p < BONE_PAIR_COUNT; p++) {
                int b0 = BONE_PAIRS[p * 2], b1 = BONE_PAIRS[p * 2 + 1];
                if (!e.sv[b0] || !e.sv[b1]) continue;
                render::draw_line(e.sx[b0], e.sy[b0], e.sx[b1], e.sy[b1],
                                  c.r, c.g, c.b, a, 1.0f);
            }
        }

        // Name + distance
        if (ui::get(g_show_name) && e.box_y > 14.0f) {
            string label = e.name + " [" + util::format_string("{}m", int(e.dist)) + "]";
            render::draw_text_outlined(int(e.box_x + e.box_w * 0.5f),
                                       int(e.box_y) - 14, label,
                                       c.r, c.g, c.b, a);
        }
    }
}

void on_unload() {
    process::detach();
}
```

```as
// esp-preview.as — complete Echo ESP preview template
//
// Bundles the echo-esp-preview layout helper (upstream commit

// ---- upstream esp_preview.as ----------------------------------------------------

class esp_preview {
    int width;

    int box_w_logical;

    int label_gap;

    esp_preview() {

        box_h_logical = 240;

        toggle_drawn = false;
        label_gap = 4;
        label_spacing = 2;
        drag_active = false;
        drag_index = -1;
        drag_target_side = -1;
        drag_target_slot = -1;
        drag_kind = 0;
        lmb_last = false;
        rmb_last = false;

        popup_label_index = -1;

        popup_combo_expanded = false;

        popup_font_choices.insertLast(fonts::TAHOMA);
        popup_font_choices.insertLast(fonts::TAHOMA_PX);

        popup_font_choices.insertLast(fonts::TAHOMA_BOLD_PX);
        popup_font_choices.insertLast(fonts::SMALLEST_PIXEL_7);
        popup_font_choices.insertLast(fonts::TAHOMISH);

        popup_font_names.insertLast("Tahoma");
        popup_font_names.insertLast("Tahoma PX");
        popup_font_names.insertLast("Tahoma Bold");
        popup_font_names.insertLast("Tahoma Bold PX");

        popup_font_names.insertLast("Tahomish");
```
