// Fortnite ESP — UE5 GWorld traversal, cornered box, 7-bone skeleton, health bar
//
// Engine:    Unreal Engine 5
// AC:        EasyAntiCheat (external read — no injection needed)
//
// IMPORTANT: THE OFFSETS AND SIGNATURES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS. They are
// illustrative values copied from one Dumper-7 output and are NOT verified.
// They break with every patch. Re-run Dumper-7 and update them before use.
//
// Post-patch workflow:  skills/offset-update-workflow.md
// Dumper-7 SDK guide:   skills/dumper7-sdk.md
// UE5 traversal ref:    templates/ue5-sdk.as
// mcp-gamehacking:      get_agent_briefing("fortnite-specialist")

// ── struct offsets (placeholders — update from Dumper-7 each patch) ──────────
const uint32 OFF_PERSISTENT_LEVEL  = 0x38;    // UWorld::PersistentLevel
const uint32 OFF_ACTOR_ARRAY       = 0xA0;    // ULevel::AActors.Data
const uint32 OFF_ACTOR_COUNT       = 0xA8;    // ULevel::AActors.Num
const uint32 OFF_ROOT_COMPONENT    = 0x1A8;   // AActor::RootComponent
const uint32 OFF_COMP_TRANS        = 0x264;   // USceneComponent::ComponentToWorld.Translation
const uint32 OFF_MESH              = 0x3B8;   // APawn::Mesh (USkeletalMeshComponent*)
const uint32 OFF_BONE_ARRAY        = 0x5C0;   // USkeletalMeshComponent::CachedBoneSpaceTransforms
const uint32 OFF_BONE_COUNT        = 0x5C8;
const uint32 OFF_HEALTH_SET        = 0x5E8;   // AFortPawn::HealthSet (UFortHealthSet*)
const uint32 OFF_HP_CUR            = 0x1D0;   // UFortHealthSet::CurrentValue
const uint32 OFF_HP_MAX            = 0x1D8;
const uint32 OFF_SHIELD_CUR        = 0x1F0;   // UFortHealthSet::ShieldCurrentValue
const uint32 OFF_SHIELD_MAX        = 0x1F8;

// Camera chain offsets (placeholders — update from Dumper-7 each patch)
const uint32 OFF_CAM_MANAGER       = 0x1F0;   // UWorld -> PlayerCameraManager
const uint32 OFF_CAM_LOC           = 0x300;   // CameraLocation
const uint32 OFF_CAM_ROT           = 0x30C;   // CameraRotation (pitch, yaw, roll)
const uint32 OFF_CAM_FOV           = 0x318;   // FOVAngle

// bone indices — standard Fortnite humanoid rig (placeholder, verify with Dumper-7)
const uint32 BONE_HEAD     = 66;
const uint32 BONE_NECK     = 65;
const uint32 BONE_CHEST    = 6;
const uint32 BONE_PELVIS   = 0;
const uint32 BONE_L_UPPER  = 9;
const uint32 BONE_R_UPPER  = 38;
const uint32 BONE_L_HAND   = 15;
const uint32 BONE_R_HAND   = 44;
const uint32 BONE_L_KNEE   = 70;
const uint32 BONE_R_KNEE   = 74;
const uint32 BONE_L_FOOT   = 72;
const uint32 BONE_R_FOOT   = 76;

// Colours are 4 separate ints: r, g, b, a
const int COL_BOX_R = 220, COL_BOX_G = 50,  COL_BOX_B = 50,  COL_BOX_A = 200;
const int COL_BONE_R = 220, COL_BONE_G = 50, COL_BONE_B = 50, COL_BONE_A = 160;
const int COL_FILL_R = 0,   COL_FILL_G = 0,   COL_FILL_B = 0,   COL_FILL_A = 60;
const int COL_HP_R   = 60,  COL_HP_G   = 220, COL_HP_B   = 80,  COL_HP_A   = 255;
const int COL_SHI_R  = 80,  COL_SHI_G  = 140, COL_SHI_B  = 255, COL_SHI_A  = 255;

uint64 g_world = 0;
f_view_cache g_view;

// ── shared state (written by tick, read by render) ──────────────────────────
class ActorInfo {
    uint64 mesh;
    vec3   root_pos;
    float  hp, hp_max;
    float  shield, shield_max;
}
array<ActorInfo@> g_actors;
mutex@ g_mx = create_mutex();

// ── entry ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

bool main() {
    attach_data ad = process::attach("FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe");
    if (ad.pid == 0) {
        alert::show("FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe not found");
        return false;
    }

    g_world = find_gworld();
    if (g_world == 0) {
        alert::show("GWorld scan failed — update the pattern in find_gworld()");
        process::detach();
        return false;
    }

    create_thread(64, @tick);
    on_render(@draw);
    return true;
}

void on_unload() {
    process::detach();
}

// ── per-tick actor walk ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void tick() {
    if (!process::is_alive()) return;

    read_view();

    array<ActorInfo@> next;

    uint64 level = process::read_uint64(g_world + OFF_PERSISTENT_LEVEL);
    if (level != 0) {
        uint64 actor_base  = process::read_uint64(level + OFF_ACTOR_ARRAY);
        uint32 actor_count = process::read_uint32(level + OFF_ACTOR_COUNT);
        if (actor_base != 0 && actor_count > 0 && actor_count <= 4096) {
            for (uint32 i = 0; i < actor_count && next.length() < 128; i++) {
                uint64 actor = process::read_uint64(actor_base + uint64(i) * 8);
                if (actor == 0) continue;
                ActorInfo@ info = read_actor(actor);
                if (info !is null) next.insertLast(info);
            }
        }
    }

    g_mx.lock();
    g_actors = next;
    g_mx.unlock();
}

// Read the fields we need for one actor (user code — offsets are game specific)
ActorInfo@ read_actor(uint64 actor) {
    // Quick-filter: must have mesh (APawn) and health set (AFortPawn)
    uint64 mesh       = process::read_uint64(actor + OFF_MESH);
    uint64 health_set = process::read_uint64(actor + OFF_HEALTH_SET);
    if (mesh == 0 || health_set == 0) return null;

    float hp         = process::read_float(health_set + OFF_HP_CUR);
    float hp_max     = process::read_float(health_set + OFF_HP_MAX);
    float shield     = process::read_float(health_set + OFF_SHIELD_CUR);
    float shield_max = process::read_float(health_set + OFF_SHIELD_MAX);
    if (hp <= 0.0f || hp_max <= 0.0f) return null;

    uint64 root = process::read_uint64(actor + OFF_ROOT_COMPONENT);
    if (root == 0) return null;

    ActorInfo@ info = ActorInfo();
    info.mesh   = mesh;
    info.root_pos = vec3(process::read_float(root + OFF_COMP_TRANS),
                         process::read_float(root + OFF_COMP_TRANS + 4),
                         process::read_float(root + OFF_COMP_TRANS + 8));
    info.hp         = hp;
    info.hp_max     = hp_max;
    info.shield     = shield;
    info.shield_max = shield_max;
    return info;
}

// ── render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void draw() {
    g_mx.lock_shared();
    array<ActorInfo@> snap = g_actors;
    f_view_cache view = g_view;
    g_mx.unlock_shared();

    for (uint i = 0; i < snap.length(); i++) {
        ActorInfo@ e = snap[i];

        vec2 foot;
        if (!unreal::w2s(e.root_pos, view, foot)) continue;

        // Head position for box height — if the head bone cannot be projected
        // the entity is skipped rather than drawn with a zero-height box.
        vec3 bone_pos;
        if (!get_bone(e.mesh, BONE_HEAD, bone_pos)) continue;
        vec2 head;
        if (!unreal::w2s(bone_pos, view, head)) continue;

        float box_h = foot.y - head.y;
        if (box_h < 8.0f) continue;
        float box_w = box_h * 0.55f;
        float box_x = head.x - box_w * 0.5f;
        float box_y = head.y;
        float corner = box_w * 0.22f;

        draw_cornered_box(box_x, box_y, box_w, box_h,
                          COL_BOX_R, COL_BOX_G, COL_BOX_B, COL_BOX_A, corner);
        draw_skeleton(e.mesh, view);

        int bx = int(box_x) - 5;
        int by = int(box_y);
        int bh = int(box_h);

        // HP bar — left side
        render::draw_box(bx - 1, by - 1, 4, bh + 2,
                         COL_FILL_R, COL_FILL_G, COL_FILL_B, COL_FILL_A,
                         box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
        int hp_fill = int(box_h * (e.hp / e.hp_max));
        render::draw_box(bx, by + (bh - hp_fill), 2, hp_fill,
                         COL_HP_R, COL_HP_G, COL_HP_B, COL_HP_A,
                         box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);

        // Shield bar — right side
        if (e.shield_max > 0.0f) {
            int sx = int(box_x + box_w) + 3;
            render::draw_box(sx - 1, by - 1, 4, bh + 2,
                             COL_FILL_R, COL_FILL_G, COL_FILL_B, COL_FILL_A,
                             box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
            int sh_fill = int(box_h * (e.shield / e.shield_max));
            render::draw_box(sx, by + (bh - sh_fill), 2, sh_fill,
                             COL_SHI_R, COL_SHI_G, COL_SHI_B, COL_SHI_A,
                             box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
        }
    }
}

// ── skeleton ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void draw_skeleton(uint64 mesh, f_view_cache view) {
    // 12 segments — full humanoid rig. pa[i] is the from-bone and pb[i] the
    // matching to-bone of segment i.
    const uint pairs_n = 12;
    array<uint32> pa = {BONE_HEAD,    BONE_NECK,   BONE_CHEST,   BONE_L_UPPER,
                        BONE_L_UPPER, BONE_L_HAND, BONE_CHEST,   BONE_R_UPPER,
                        BONE_R_UPPER, BONE_R_HAND, BONE_PELVIS,  BONE_PELVIS};
    array<uint32> pb = {BONE_NECK,    BONE_CHEST,  BONE_PELVIS,  BONE_L_HAND,
                        BONE_L_KNEE,  BONE_L_FOOT, BONE_R_UPPER, BONE_R_HAND,
                        BONE_R_KNEE,  BONE_R_FOOT, BONE_L_KNEE,  BONE_R_KNEE};

    for (uint i = 0; i < pairs_n; i++) {
        vec3 a, b;
        if (!get_bone(mesh, pa[i], a)) continue;
        if (!get_bone(mesh, pb[i], b)) continue;
        vec2 sa, sb;
        if (!unreal::w2s(a, view, sa)) continue;
        if (!unreal::w2s(b, view, sb)) continue;
        render::draw_line(sa.x, sa.y, sb.x, sb.y,
                          COL_BONE_R, COL_BONE_G, COL_BONE_B, COL_BONE_A, 1.0f);
    }
}

bool get_bone(uint64 mesh, uint32 idx, vec3 &out pos) {
    uint64 bone_base  = process::read_uint64(mesh + OFF_BONE_ARRAY);
    uint32 bone_count = process::read_uint32(mesh + OFF_BONE_COUNT);
    if (bone_base == 0 || idx >= bone_count) return false;
    // FTransform: [rotation quat 16 bytes][translation vec3 12 bytes][scale 12 bytes] = 48 bytes
    uint64 entry = bone_base + uint64(idx) * 48;
    pos = vec3(process::read_float(entry + 16),
               process::read_float(entry + 20),
               process::read_float(entry + 24));
    return true;
}

// ── rendering helpers (user code) ───────────────────────────────────────────

void draw_cornered_box(float x, float y, float w, float h,
                       int r, int g, int b, int a, float c) {
    float t = 1.5f;
    render::draw_line(x,     y,     x + c, y,     r, g, b, a, t);
    render::draw_line(x,     y,     x,     y + c, r, g, b, a, t);
    render::draw_line(x + w, y,     x+w-c, y,     r, g, b, a, t);
    render::draw_line(x + w, y,     x + w, y + c, r, g, b, a, t);
    render::draw_line(x,     y + h, x + c, y + h, r, g, b, a, t);
    render::draw_line(x,     y + h, x,     y+h-c, r, g, b, a, t);
    render::draw_line(x + w, y + h, x+w-c, y + h, r, g, b, a, t);
    render::draw_line(x + w, y + h, x + w, y+h-c, r, g, b, a, t);
}

// ── camera ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void read_view() {
    // shortcut: reads the camera manager from the GWorld chain;
    // update the camera offsets from Dumper-7 if W2S is wrong
    uint64 cam_mgr = process::read_uint64(g_world + OFF_CAM_MANAGER);
    if (cam_mgr == 0) return;

    f_view_info info;
    info.location = vec3(process::read_float(cam_mgr + OFF_CAM_LOC),
                         process::read_float(cam_mgr + OFF_CAM_LOC + 4),
                         process::read_float(cam_mgr + OFF_CAM_LOC + 8));
    info.rotation = vec3(process::read_float(cam_mgr + OFF_CAM_ROT),
                         process::read_float(cam_mgr + OFF_CAM_ROT + 4),
                         process::read_float(cam_mgr + OFF_CAM_ROT + 8));
    info.fov = process::read_float(cam_mgr + OFF_CAM_FOV);

    f_view_cache new_view = build_view_cache(info);

    g_mx.lock();
    g_view = new_view;
    g_mx.unlock();
}

// ── GWorld ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

uint64 find_gworld() {
    // LEA rcx,[rip+GWorld] in UEngine::Tick — stable across most patches
    // If this breaks after a patch run: mcp-gamehacking get_agent_briefing("fortnite-specialist")
    uint64 base = process::get_module_base("FortniteClient-Win64-Shipping.exe");
    if (base == 0) return 0;

    uint64 addr = process::find_signature(
        base,
        "48 8B 05 ? ? ? ? 48 85 C0 74 ? 48 8B 40 ? 48 85 C0 74"
    );
    if (addr == 0) return 0;
    return process::get_relative_address(addr, 3, 7);
}

`app/echo/templates/loot.as`:

```as
// CS2 loot/dropped-weapon ESP
// Scans entity list for dropped weapons; renders tiered labels + sorted panel.
//
// IMPORTANT: THE OFFSETS AND SIGNATURES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS. They are
// illustrative values from one community dump and are NOT verified. Re-derive
// them with a current cs2-dumper run after every game update.

// ─── Offsets (placeholders — re-verify per patch) ───────────────────────────
const uint64 OFF_ORIGIN       = 0x1294;
const uint64 OFF_ITEM_DEF_IDX = 0x2FAA; // C_EconItemView::m_iItemDefinitionIndex (uint16)
const uint64 OFF_OWNER_HANDLE = 0x568;  // C_WeaponBase::m_hOwnerEntity

// ─── Loot config ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const float DIST_DOT   = 300.0f;  // metres — show dot only beyond this
const float DIST_LABEL = 150.0f;  // metres — show full label+tier prefix
const float DIST_HIDE  = 400.0f;  // metres — don't render at all

const int PANEL_MAX = 12;         // rows in sorted loot panel

// ─── Item tiers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
enum ItemTier { JUNK, COMMON, RARE, EPIC, LEGEND }

ItemTier cs2_weapon_tier(uint16 def_idx) {
    // shortcut: hard-coded per item definition index; update for new ops
    if (def_idx == 9 || def_idx == 19 || def_idx == 1 || def_idx == 2)
        return JUNK;    // glock, p2000, deagle, dualies
    if (def_idx == 7 || def_idx == 11)
        return RARE;    // AK, M4A4
    if (def_idx == 60 || def_idx == 8)
        return EPIC;    // M4A1-S, AWP
    if (def_idx == 9001)
        return LEGEND;  // placeholder — add new knives/special weapons here
    return COMMON;
}

color tier_color(ItemTier t) {
    if (t == LEGEND) return color(255, 215,  0, 255);  // gold
    if (t == EPIC)   return color(200,  80, 255, 255);  // purple
    if (t == RARE)   return color( 80, 150, 255, 255);  // blue
    if (t == COMMON) return color(180, 180, 180, 255);  // grey
    return                   color(100, 100, 100, 160);  // dim — JUNK
}

string tier_prefix(ItemTier t) {
    if (t == LEGEND) return "[*] ";
    if (t == EPIC)   return "[E] ";
    if (t == RARE)   return "[R] ";
    if (t == COMMON) return "[C] ";
    return                   "";
}

// ─── Shared state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class LootEntry {
    float  sx, sy;     // screen position of origin
    bool   on_screen;
    float  dist;       // metres from local player
    string name;
    ItemTier tier;
    uint64 ent_addr;
}
array<LootEntry@> g_loot;
mutex@ g_mx = create_mutex();

// ─── Menu ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
checkbox g_l_on;
checkbox g_l_panel;     // sorted panel in corner
slider   g_l_max_dist;  // metres
checkbox g_l_hide_junk;

// ─── Process state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
uint64 g_entity_list   = 0;
uint64 g_local_player  = 0;
uint64 g_view_mat_addr = 0;

bool main() {
    ui::config_path("echo_loot");

    ui::add_tab("Loot");
    ui::add_category("Settings");
    g_l_on       = ui::add_checkbox("Enable", true, "loot.on");
    g_l_panel    = ui::add_checkbox("Sorted panel", true, "loot.panel");
    g_l_max_dist = ui::add_slider("Max dist (m)", 200, 50, 400, 10, "m", "loot.dist");
    g_l_hide_junk = ui::add_checkbox("Hide junk", true, "loot.nojunk");

    attach_data ad = process::attach("cs2.exe");
    if (ad.pid == 0) {
        alert::show("cs2.exe not found");
        return false;
    }

    create_thread(0, @do_scan);
    create_thread(8, @tick);    // 8 tps sufficient for static loot
    on_render(@draw);
    return true;
}

void do_scan() {
    uint64 client = process::get_module_base("client.dll");
    if (client == 0) {
        alert::show("client.dll not found");
        return;
    }

    uint64 sig = process::find_signature(client, "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? 48 89 5C 24");
    if (sig == 0) {
        alert::show("entity list sig failed");
        return;
    }
    uint64 ent_sys = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);
    g_entity_list  = process::read_uint64(process::read_uint64(ent_sys) + 0x10);

    sig = process::find_signature(client, "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? 48 85 C9 74 ? 8B 01");
    if (sig != 0) g_local_player = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);

    sig = process::find_signature(client, "48 8D 05 ? ? ? ? 48 89 05 ? ? ? ?");
    if (sig != 0) g_view_mat_addr = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);

    alert::show("Loot ESP ready");
}

// Entity list chunk walk (user code — chunk layout is game specific)
uint64 get_entity(int idx) {
    uint64 chunk = process::read_uint64(g_entity_list + uint64(idx >> 9) * 8);
    if (chunk == 0) return 0;
    return process::read_uint64(chunk + uint64(idx & 0x1FF) * 120);
}

// Read a 4x4 float matrix (16 floats) from the target process (user code)
matrix4x4 read_matrix16(uint64 addr) {
    matrix4x4 m;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++)
        for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
            m[c][r] = process::read_float(addr + uint64(c * 4 + r) * 4);
    return m;
}

bool is_dropped_weapon(uint64 ent) {
    // Dropped weapon: valid entity with no owner handle (0 or invalid)
    uint32 owner = process::read_uint32(ent + OFF_OWNER_HANDLE);
    return (owner == 0 || (owner & 0xFFFF) == 0xFFFF);
}

string weapon_name_for(uint16 def_idx) {
    // shortcut: minimal lookup — extend this table as needed
    if (def_idx == 9)   return "Glock-18";
    if (def_idx == 11)  return "AK-47";
    if (def_idx == 7)   return "M4A4";
    if (def_idx == 60)  return "M4A1-S";
    if (def_idx == 8)   return "AWP";
    if (def_idx == 19)  return "P2000";
    if (def_idx == 2)   return "Dual Berrettas";
    return "wpn_" + util::format_string("{}", def_idx);
}

// ─── Tick ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void tick() {
    if (!ui::get(g_l_on) || g_entity_list == 0) return;

    uint64 lp_ptr = process::read_uint64(g_local_player);
    if (lp_ptr == 0) return;

    vec3  lp_pos = vec3(process::read_float(lp_ptr + OFF_ORIGIN),
                        process::read_float(lp_ptr + OFF_ORIGIN + 4),
                        process::read_float(lp_ptr + OFF_ORIGIN + 8));
    float range     = float(ui::get(g_l_max_dist));
    bool  hide_junk = ui::get(g_l_hide_junk);

    // Read the view matrix for W2S
    bool have_vm = (g_view_mat_addr != 0);
    matrix4x4 vm;
    if (have_vm) vm = read_matrix16(g_view_mat_addr);

    array<LootEntry@> buf;

    // Scan all entity slots for dropped weapons
    for (int i = 1; i < 512; i++) {
        uint64 ent = get_entity(i);
        if (ent == 0) continue;
        if (!is_dropped_weapon(ent)) continue;

        uint16 def_idx = process::read_uint16(ent + OFF_ITEM_DEF_IDX);
        if (def_idx == 0) continue;

        vec3  epos = vec3(process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN),
                          process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN + 4),
                          process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN + 8));
        float dist_m = epos.distance(lp_pos) / 39.37f;
        if (dist_m > range || dist_m > DIST_HIDE) continue;

        ItemTier t = cs2_weapon_tier(def_idx);
        if (hide_junk && t == JUNK) continue;

        LootEntry@ le = LootEntry();
        le.ent_addr = ent;
        le.dist     = dist_m;
        le.tier     = t;
        le.name     = weapon_name_for(def_idx);
        le.on_screen = false;

        // W2S — source2::w2s writes the screen position and returns false
        // when the point is off-screen or behind the camera
        if (have_vm) {
            vec2 screen;
            le.on_screen = source2::w2s(epos, vm, screen);
            le.sx = screen.x;
            le.sy = screen.y;
        }

        buf.insertLast(le);
    }

    // Sort: tier desc, then dist asc
    // Bubble sort (small array, ponytail-approved).
    // buf holds handles: the handle VALUES are swapped, so the two slots end
    // up pointing at the original two entries.
    for (uint a = 0; a < buf.length(); a++) {
        for (uint b = a + 1; b < buf.length(); b++) {
            if (int(buf[a].tier) < int(buf[b].tier) ||
               (buf[a].tier == buf[b].tier && buf[a].dist > buf[b].dist)) {
                LootEntry@ tmp = buf[a];
                buf[a] = buf[b];
                buf[b] = tmp;
            }
        }
    }

    g_mx.lock();
    g_loot = buf;
    g_mx.unlock();
}

// ─── Render ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void draw() {
    if (!ui::get(g_l_on)) return;

    g_mx.lock_shared();
    array<LootEntry@> snap = g_loot;
    g_mx.unlock_shared();

    render::update_font(fonts::TAHOMA, 10);

    // World-space labels
    for (uint i = 0; i < snap.length(); i++) {
        LootEntry@ e = snap[i];
        if (!e.on_screen) continue;

        color col = tier_color(e.tier);

        if (e.dist <= DIST_LABEL) {
            // Full label: prefix + name + distance
            string label = tier_prefix(e.tier) + e.name + " " +
                           util::format_string("{:.0}m", e.dist);
            render::draw_text_outlined(int(e.sx), int(e.sy), label,
                                       col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a);
        } else if (e.dist <= DIST_DOT) {
            // Dot only
            render::draw_circle(e.sx, e.sy, 3.5f, 0, 0, 0, 180, true, 12);
            render::draw_circle(e.sx, e.sy, 2.5f, col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a, true, 12);
        }
    }

    // Sorted panel (top-right corner)
    if (!ui::get(g_l_panel) || snap.length() == 0) return;

    vec2  vp    = render::get_viewport_size();
    int   pw    = 160;
    int   row_h = 16;
    uint  rows  = (snap.length() < uint(PANEL_MAX)) ? snap.length() : uint(PANEL_MAX);
    int   ph    = row_h * int(rows) + 8;
    int   px    = int(vp.x) - pw - 10;
    int   py    = 10;

    render::draw_box(px, py, pw, ph, 10, 10, 10, 200, box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
    render::draw_box(px, py, pw, ph, 80, 80, 80, 180, box_style::OUTLINED, 0.0f);

    for (uint i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
        LootEntry@ e = snap[i];
        string label = tier_prefix(e.tier) + e.name + " " +
                       util::format_string("{:.0}m", e.dist);
        color c = tier_color(e.tier);
        render::draw_text_outlined(px + 6, py + 4 + int(i) * row_h, label,
                                   c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a);
    }
}

void on_unload() {
    process::detach();
}

`app/echo/templates/memory.as`:

```as
// Memory reading template – attach, scan, tick loop
//
// Notes:
//  - process::attach() returns an attach_data struct, not a handle.
//  - process::find_signature() needs a BASE address: get it with
//    process::get_module_base("module.dll") first.
//  - process::virtual_query() returns ONE region; advance with base + size to
//    walk the whole address space.

uint64 g_hp_addr   = 0;
float  g_hp_cached = 0.0f;
mutex@ g_mx = create_mutex();

bool main() {
    attach_data ad = process::attach("target.exe");
    if (ad.pid == 0) {
        alert::show("Attach failed");
        return false;
    }

    create_thread(0,  @on_attach);
    create_thread(16, @tick);       // 16 tps – memory reads don't need high rate
    on_render(@draw);
    return true;
}

void on_attach() {
    uint64 base = process::get_module_base("target.exe");
    if (base == 0) {
        alert::show("target.exe not found");
        return;
    }

    // Scan for a signature once; cache the resolved address
    uint64 sig = process::find_signature(base, "F3 0F 10 05 ? ? ? ? F3 0F 58 C8");
    if (sig == 0) {
        alert::show("Signature not found");
        return;
    }

    g_hp_addr = process::get_relative_address(sig, 4, 8);
    alert::show("hp_addr = " + util::to_hex(g_hp_addr));
}

void tick() {
    if (g_hp_addr == 0) return;

    float v = process::read_float(g_hp_addr);

    g_mx.lock();
    g_hp_cached = v;
    g_mx.unlock();
}

void draw() {
    g_mx.lock_shared();
    float hp = g_hp_cached;
    g_mx.unlock_shared();

    render::draw_text(10, 30, "HP: " + util::format_string("{:.1}", hp),
                      255, 255, 255, 255);
}

// ── Region walk ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// process::virtual_query() describes the contiguous region containing the
// address. base + size lands on the next region (possibly an unmapped hole).
void dump_regions(uint64 start_addr) {
    uint64 addr = start_addr;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        memory_region r = process::virtual_query(addr);
        if (r.size == 0) break;

        console::log(util::to_hex(r.base) +
                     " size=" + util::format_string("{}", r.size) +
                     " present=" + (r.present ? "yes" : "no") +
                     " rw=" + (r.writable ? "yes" : "no") +
                     " x=" + (r.executable ? "yes" : "no"));

        addr = r.base + r.size;
    }
}

// ── Bulk read ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// read_buffer() fetches a block once; the memory_buffer accessors then read
// fields out of it without another memory read.
void dump_fields(uint64 addr) {
    memory_buffer@ buf = process::read_buffer(addr, 32);
    if (buf is null) return;

    console::log("u32@0  = " + util::format_string("{}", buf.read_uint32(0)));
    console::log("u32@4  = " + util::format_string("{}", buf.read_uint32(4)));
    console::log("f32@8  = " + util::format_string("{}", buf.read_float(8)));
    console::log("u64@16 = " + util::format_string("{}", buf.read_uint64(16)));
}

void on_unload() {
    process::detach();
}

// Menu UI template – demonstrates all common element types
//
// UI order matters: ui::add_tab -> ui::add_subtab -> ui::add_category ->
// elements. Elements attach to the most recently created category.
// Values are read/written through handles: ui::get(handle) / ui::set(handle, v).
// Sliders are integer-only in this API.

slider       g_sl_fov;
color_picker g_cp_color;

    ui::add_tab("MyScript");
    ui::add_subtab("Main");
    ui::add_category("Settings");

    g_cb_enable = ui::add_checkbox("Enable", false, "myscript.enable");
    g_sl_fov    = ui::add_slider("FOV radius", 90, 0, 360, 5, "deg", "myscript.fov");
    g_cp_color  = ui::add_color_picker("Color", 255, 255, 0, 255, true, "myscript.color");

    g_ms_filters = ui::add_multi_select("Filters", {"Visible", "Dormant", "Dead"}, "myscript.filters");
    g_btn_reset = ui::add_button("Reset defaults", @do_reset);

    ui::add_tooltip(g_cb_enable, "Toggle the whole script on/off");

    on_render(@draw);
    return true;
}

void do_reset() {
    ui::set(g_sl_fov, 90);
    ui::set(g_cp_color, color(255, 255, 0, 255));
    ui::set(g_cmb_mode, uint64(0));
    ui::set(g_ms_filters, uint64(0), false);
    ui::set(g_ms_filters, uint64(1), false);
    ui::set(g_ms_filters, uint64(2), false);
}

    bool show_visible = ui::get(g_ms_filters, uint64(0));
    bool show_dormant = ui::get(g_ms_filters, uint64(1));
    bool show_dead    = ui::get(g_ms_filters, uint64(2));

    render::draw_circle(960, 540, fov, c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a, false, 64);
    render::draw_text(10, 10, "mode: " + util::format_string("{}", mode), 255, 255, 255, 255);

    if (show_visible) render::draw_text(10, 30, "visible", 255, 255, 255, 255);
    if (show_dormant) render::draw_text(10, 50, "dormant", 255, 255, 255, 255);
    if (show_dead)    render::draw_text(10, 70, "dead", 255, 255, 255, 255);
}

void on_unload() {
    // nothing to release
}

`app/echo/templates/misc.as`:

```as
// Misc features: bunny hop, radar, spectator list, flash reduction
// CS2/Source 2 offsets.
//
// IMPORTANT: THE OFFSETS AND SIGNATURES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS. They are
// illustrative values from one community dump and are NOT verified. Re-derive
// them with a current cs2-dumper run after every game update.

// ─── Offsets (placeholders — re-verify per update) ───────────────────────────
const uint64 OFF_FLAGS      = 0x3F4;  // m_fFlags; bit 0 = FL_ONGROUND
const uint64 OFF_ORIGIN     = 0x1294;
const uint64 OFF_VELOCITY   = 0x1254;
const uint64 OFF_TEAM       = 0x3CB;
const uint64 OFF_LIFE       = 0x338;
const uint64 OFF_HP         = 0x344;
const uint64 OFF_FLASH_DUR  = 0x1514; // m_flFlashDuration
const uint64 OFF_FLASH_MAX  = 0x1518; // m_flFlashMaxAlpha
const uint64 OFF_NAME       = 0x640;
const uint64 OFF_OBSERVER   = 0x12C8; // observed target ptr (for spectators)

const int VK_SPACE  = 0x20;
const int VK_LSHIFT = 0xA0;

// ─── Process state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
uint64 g_entity_list  = 0;
uint64 g_local_player = 0;

// ─── Menu ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
checkbox g_bhop_on;
checkbox g_flash_on;
slider   g_flash_max;   // 0..255
checkbox g_radar_on;
slider   g_radar_scale; // tenths
checkbox g_spec_on;

bool main() {
    ui::config_path("echo_misc");

    ui::add_tab("Misc");
    ui::add_category("Features");
    g_bhop_on     = ui::add_checkbox("Bunny Hop", false, "misc.bhop");
    g_flash_on    = ui::add_checkbox("Flash Reduce", false, "misc.flash");
    g_flash_max   = ui::add_slider("Flash alpha cap", 20, 0, 255, 5, "", "misc.flash_max");
    g_radar_on    = ui::add_checkbox("Radar", false, "misc.radar");
    g_radar_scale = ui::add_slider("Radar scale", 10, 1, 50, 1, "x0.1", "misc.radar_scale");
    g_spec_on     = ui::add_checkbox("Spectator list", false, "misc.spec");

    attach_data ad = process::attach("cs2.exe");
    if (ad.pid == 0) {
        alert::show("cs2.exe not found");
        return false;
    }

    create_thread(0,  @do_scan);
    create_thread(64, @tick);
    on_render(@draw);
    return true;
}

void do_scan() {
    uint64 client = process::get_module_base("client.dll");
    if (client == 0) {
        alert::show("client.dll not found");
        return;
    }

    uint64 sig = process::find_signature(client, "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? 48 89 5C 24");
    if (sig == 0) {
        alert::show("sig failed");
        return;
    }
    uint64 ent_sys = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);
    g_entity_list  = process::read_uint64(process::read_uint64(ent_sys) + 0x10);

    sig = process::find_signature(client, "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? 48 85 C9 74 ? 8B 01");
    if (sig != 0) g_local_player = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);

    alert::show("Misc ready");
}

// Entity list chunk walk (user code — chunk layout is game specific)
uint64 get_entity(int idx) {
    uint64 chunk = process::read_uint64(g_entity_list + uint64(idx >> 9) * 8);
    if (chunk == 0) return 0;
    return process::read_uint64(chunk + uint64(idx & 0x1FF) * 120);
}

// ─── Bunny hop ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Fires jump at the exact frame the player lands (FL_ONGROUND set)
bool g_was_on_ground = false;

void bhop_tick(uint64 lp) {
    if (!ui::get(g_bhop_on) || lp == 0) return;

    // input::key_active() is true while the key is held
    if (!input::key_active(VK_SPACE)) {
        g_was_on_ground = false;
        return;
    }

    int  flags      = process::read_int32(lp + OFF_FLAGS);
    bool on_ground = (flags & 1) != 0;

    if (on_ground && !g_was_on_ground) {
        // Player just landed while holding space — jump immediately
        input::key_tap(VK_SPACE);
    }
    g_was_on_ground = on_ground;
}

// ─── Flash reduction ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void flash_tick(uint64 lp) {
    if (!ui::get(g_flash_on) || lp == 0) return;
    float dur = process::read_float(lp + OFF_FLASH_DUR);
    if (dur <= 0.0f) return;
    float cap = float(ui::get(g_flash_max));
    float cur = process::read_float(lp + OFF_FLASH_MAX);
    if (cur > cap) process::write_float(lp + OFF_FLASH_MAX, cap);
}

// ─── Spectator list (stored for render) ──────────────────────────────────────
array<string> g_spectators;
mutex@ g_spec_mx = create_mutex();

void spec_tick(uint64 lp) {
    if (!ui::get(g_spec_on) || lp == 0 || g_entity_list == 0) return;
    array<string> spectators;
    for (int i = 1; i < 64; i++) {
        uint64 ent = get_entity(i);
        if (ent == 0) continue;
        // Spectator: lifeState != 0 (dead/spec) and observing local player
        if (process::read_uint8(ent + OFF_LIFE) == 0) continue; // alive, skip
        uint64 obs_target = process::read_uint64(ent + OFF_OBSERVER);
        if (obs_target != lp) continue;
        // Read name
        string name = process::read_string(ent + OFF_NAME);
        if (name.length() > 0) spectators.insertLast(name);
    }
    g_spec_mx.lock();
    g_spectators = spectators;
    g_spec_mx.unlock();
}

// ─── Radar data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class RadarDot { float rx, ry; bool team; }
array<RadarDot@> g_radar;
mutex@ g_radar_mx = create_mutex();

void radar_tick(uint64 lp) {
    if (!ui::get(g_radar_on) || lp == 0 || g_entity_list == 0) return;
    vec3 lpos = vec3(process::read_float(lp + OFF_ORIGIN),
                     process::read_float(lp + OFF_ORIGIN + 4),
                     process::read_float(lp + OFF_ORIGIN + 8));
    int lt = process::read_int32(lp + OFF_TEAM);

    array<RadarDot@> dots;
    for (int i = 1; i < 64; i++) {
        uint64 ent = get_entity(i);
        if (ent == 0) continue;
        if (process::read_uint8(ent + OFF_LIFE) != 0) continue;
        if (process::read_int32(ent + OFF_HP) <= 0) continue;

        vec3 epos = vec3(process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN),
                         process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN + 4),
                         process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN + 8));
        int et = process::read_int32(ent + OFF_TEAM);

        RadarDot@ dot = RadarDot();
        float scale = float(ui::get(g_radar_scale)) / 10.0f;
        dot.rx   = (epos.x - lpos.x) / (500.0f / scale); // 500 units = 1 radar unit
        dot.ry   = (epos.y - lpos.y) / (500.0f / scale);
        dot.team = (et == lt);
        dots.insertLast(dot);
    }
    g_radar_mx.lock();
    g_radar = dots;
    g_radar_mx.unlock();
}

// ─── Tick ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void tick() {
    uint64 lp_ptr = (g_local_player != 0) ? process::read_uint64(g_local_player) : 0;
    bhop_tick(lp_ptr);
    flash_tick(lp_ptr);
    spec_tick(lp_ptr);
    radar_tick(lp_ptr);
}

// ─── Render ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const float RADAR_CX = 200.0f; // radar center X on screen
const float RADAR_CY = 880.0f; // radar center Y on screen
const float RADAR_R  = 80.0f;  // radar radius in pixels

void draw() {
    render::update_font(fonts::TAHOMA, 11);

    // Spectator list
    if (ui::get(g_spec_on)) {
        g_spec_mx.lock_shared();
        array<string> snap_spec = g_spectators;
        g_spec_mx.unlock_shared();
        if (snap_spec.length() > 0) {
            render::draw_text_outlined(10, 200, "Spectators:", 255, 200, 60, 255);
            for (uint i = 0; i < snap_spec.length(); i++)
                render::draw_text_outlined(10, 214 + int(i) * 14, snap_spec[i],
                                           255, 100, 100, 255);
        }
    }

    // Radar
    if (ui::get(g_radar_on)) {
        render::draw_circle(RADAR_CX, RADAR_CY, RADAR_R, 0, 0, 0, 120, true, 64);
        render::draw_circle(RADAR_CX, RADAR_CY, RADAR_R, 255, 255, 255, 60, false, 64);
        render::draw_line(RADAR_CX - RADAR_R, RADAR_CY, RADAR_CX + RADAR_R, RADAR_CY,
                          255, 255, 255, 30, 1.0f);
        render::draw_line(RADAR_CX, RADAR_CY - RADAR_R, RADAR_CX, RADAR_CY + RADAR_R,
                          255, 255, 255, 30, 1.0f);

        g_radar_mx.lock_shared();
        array<RadarDot@> snap = g_radar;
        g_radar_mx.unlock_shared();

        for (uint i = 0; i < snap.length(); i++) {
            RadarDot@ d = snap[i];
            float rx = RADAR_CX + d.rx * RADAR_R;
            float ry = RADAR_CY - d.ry * RADAR_R; // y-axis flipped
            // Clamp to radar circle
            float dx = rx - RADAR_CX, dy = ry - RADAR_CY;
            float dist = vec2(dx, dy).length();
            if (dist > RADAR_R - 3.0f) {
                float scale = (RADAR_R - 3.0f) / dist;
                rx = RADAR_CX + dx * scale;
                ry = RADAR_CY + dy * scale;
            }
            if (d.team)
                render::draw_box(int(rx) - 2, int(ry) - 2, 4, 4,
                                 80, 120, 255, 220, box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
            else
                render::draw_box(int(rx) - 2, int(ry) - 2, 4, 4,
                                 220, 60, 60, 220, box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
        }
        // Local player dot (center)
        render::draw_box(int(RADAR_CX) - 3, int(RADAR_CY) - 3, 6, 6,
                         0, 220, 60, 255, box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
    }
}

void on_unload() {
    process::detach();
}

`app/echo/templates/radar.as`:

// 2D radar/minimap overlay — CS2 Source 2 variant
// Draws a circular radar panel on the overlay with entity dots + edge indicators.
//
// IMPORTANT: THE OFFSETS AND SIGNATURES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS. They are
// illustrative values from one community dump and are NOT verified. Re-derive
// them with a current cs2-dumper run after every game update.

// ─── Offsets (placeholders — re-verify per patch) ────────────────────────────
const uint64 OFF_ORIGIN      = 0x1294;
const uint64 OFF_TEAM        = 0x3CB;
const uint64 OFF_HP          = 0x344;
const uint64 OFF_LIFE        = 0x338;
const uint64 OFF_VIEW_ANGLES = 0x1510;  // QAngle pitch/yaw/roll

// ─── Radar config ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const float RADAR_X    = 20.0f;   // top-left corner on screen
const float RADAR_Y    = 20.0f;
const float RADAR_SIZE = 180.0f;  // diameter in pixels
const float RADAR_R    = RADAR_SIZE * 0.5f;
const float RADAR_CX   = RADAR_X + RADAR_R;
const float RADAR_CY   = RADAR_Y + RADAR_R;

// ─── Shared state (tick → render) ────────────────────────────────────────────
class RadarEntry {
    float rx, ry;   // pixel offset from panel center
    bool  is_team;
    bool  on_edge;  // clamped to rim
    int   hp;

array<RadarEntry@> g_ents;
mutex@ g_mx = create_mutex();

float g_local_yaw = 0.0f;

// ─── Menu ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
checkbox g_r_on;
checkbox g_r_rotate;  // rotating (yaw-locked) vs north-up
slider   g_r_range;   // source units
slider   g_r_alpha;   // percent

// ─── Process state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
uint64 g_entity_list  = 0;
uint64 g_local_player = 0;

bool main() {
    ui::config_path("echo_radar");

    ui::add_tab("Radar");
    ui::add_category("Settings");
    g_r_on     = ui::add_checkbox("Enable", true, "radar.on");

    g_r_alpha  = ui::add_slider("Alpha", 70, 10, 100, 5, "%", "radar.alpha");

    attach_data ad = process::attach("cs2.exe");
    if (ad.pid == 0) {
        alert::show("cs2.exe not found");
        return false;
    }

    create_thread(0,  @do_scan);
    create_thread(32, @tick);
    on_render(@draw);
    return true;
}

void do_scan() {
    uint64 client = process::get_module_base("client.dll");
    if (client == 0) {
        alert::show("client.dll not found");
        return;
    }

    uint64 sig = process::find_signature(client, "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? 48 89 5C 24");
    if (sig == 0) {
        alert::show("entity list sig failed");
        return;
    }
    uint64 ent_sys = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);
    g_entity_list  = process::read_uint64(process::read_uint64(ent_sys) + 0x10);

    sig = process::find_signature(client, "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? 48 85 C9 74 ? 8B 01");
    if (sig != 0) g_local_player = process::get_relative_address(sig, 3, 7);

    alert::show("Radar ready");
}

// Entity list chunk walk (user code — chunk layout is game specific)
uint64 get_entity(int idx) {
    uint64 chunk = process::read_uint64(g_entity_list + uint64(idx >> 9) * 8);
    if (chunk == 0) return 0;
    return process::read_uint64(chunk + uint64(idx & 0x1FF) * 120);
}

// ─── world_to_radar (user code) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// on_edge=true when clamped to the rim; caller draws arrow instead of dot.
// Rotation uses math::forward_vector()/math::right_vector() for the local yaw
// instead of raw trigonometry.
void world_to_radar(float dx, float dz, float yaw_deg, float range,
                    float &out px, float &out py, bool &out on_edge) {
    vec2 angles = vec2(0.0f, -yaw_deg);
    vec3 fwd = math::forward_vector(angles);
    vec3 right = math::right_vector(angles);

    float rx = dx * right.x + dz * right.z;
    float ry = dx * fwd.x   + dz * fwd.z;

    float scale = RADAR_R / range;
    px = rx * scale;
    py = ry * scale;

    float dist = vec2(px, py).length();
    if (dist > RADAR_R - 3.0f) {
        float norm = (RADAR_R - 3.0f) / dist;
        px *= norm;
        py *= norm;
        on_edge = true;
    } else {
        on_edge = false;
    }
}

// ─── Tick ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void tick() {
    if (!ui::get(g_r_on) || g_entity_list == 0) return;

    uint64 lp_ptr = process::read_uint64(g_local_player);
    if (lp_ptr == 0) return;

    float lp_x    = process::read_float(lp_ptr + OFF_ORIGIN);
    float lp_z    = process::read_float(lp_ptr + OFF_ORIGIN + 8);
    float yaw     = process::read_float(lp_ptr + OFF_VIEW_ANGLES + 4);
    int   lp_team = process::read_int32(lp_ptr + OFF_TEAM);
    float range   = float(ui::get(g_r_range));

    g_local_yaw = ui::get(g_r_rotate) ? yaw : 0.0f;

    array<RadarEntry@> buf;

    for (int i = 1; i < 64; i++) {
        uint64 ent = get_entity(i);
        if (ent == 0) continue;
        if (process::read_uint8(ent + OFF_LIFE) != 0) continue;
        int hp = process::read_int32(ent + OFF_HP);
        if (hp <= 0) continue;

        float ex = process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN);
        float ez = process::read_float(ent + OFF_ORIGIN + 8);

        float dx = ex - lp_x;
        float dz = -(ez - lp_z);
        if (vec2(dx, dz).length() > range * 2.0f) continue;

        RadarEntry@ re = RadarEntry();
        world_to_radar(dx, dz, g_local_yaw, range, re.rx, re.ry, re.on_edge);
        re.is_team = (process::read_int32(ent + OFF_TEAM) == lp_team);
        re.hp      = hp;
        buf.insertLast(re);
    }

    g_mx.lock();
    g_ents = buf;
    g_mx.unlock();
}

// ─── Draw helpers (user code) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
void draw_background(int alpha) {
    render::draw_circle(RADAR_CX, RADAR_CY, RADAR_R, 15, 15, 15, alpha, true, 64);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++)
        render::draw_circle(RADAR_CX, RADAR_CY, RADAR_R * float(i) * 0.25f,
                            80, 80, 80, alpha / 2, false, 32);
    render::draw_line(RADAR_CX - RADAR_R, RADAR_CY,
                      RADAR_CX + RADAR_R, RADAR_CY, 80, 80, 80, alpha, 1.0f);
    render::draw_line(RADAR_CX, RADAR_CY - RADAR_R,
                      RADAR_CX, RADAR_CY + RADAR_R, 80, 80, 80, alpha, 1.0f);
    render::draw_circle(RADAR_CX, RADAR_CY, RADAR_R,
                        120, 120, 120, alpha, false, 64);
}

void draw_edge_indicator(float rx, float ry, int r, int g, int b, int a) {
    float len = vec2(rx, ry).length();
    if (len < 0.001f) return;
    float nx = rx / len, ny = ry / len;
    float tx = -ny,      ty = nx;
    float cx = RADAR_CX + rx, cy = RADAR_CY + ry;
    render::draw_triangle(cx + nx * 5.0f,         cy + ny * 5.0f,
                          cx - nx * 4.0f + tx * 4.0f, cy - ny * 4.0f + ty * 4.0f,
                          cx - nx * 4.0f - tx * 4.0f, cy - ny * 4.0f - ty * 4.0f,
                          r, g, b, a, true);
}

// ─── Render ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void draw() {
    if (!ui::get(g_r_on)) return;

    int alpha = int(float(ui::get(g_r_alpha)) / 100.0f * 255.0f);
    draw_background(alpha);

    // Local player center dot + forward indicator
    render::draw_circle(RADAR_CX, RADAR_CY, 3.5f, 100, 200, 255, alpha, true, 16);
    render::draw_line(RADAR_CX, RADAR_CY, RADAR_CX, RADAR_CY - 10.0f,
                      100, 200, 255, alpha, 1.5f);

    g_mx.lock_shared();
    array<RadarEntry@> snap = g_ents;
    g_mx.unlock_shared();

    for (uint i = 0; i < snap.length(); i++) {
        RadarEntry@ e = snap[i];
        int r = 220, g = 60, b = 60;
        if (e.is_team) { r = 60; g = 120; b = 255; }
        if (e.on_edge) {
            draw_edge_indicator(e.rx, e.ry, r, g, b, alpha);
        } else {
            float cx = RADAR_CX + e.rx, cy = RADAR_CY + e.ry;
            float dot_r = 2.0f + float(e.hp) / 100.0f * 2.0f;
            render::draw_circle(cx, cy, dot_r + 1.0f, 0, 0, 0, alpha, true, 12);
            render::draw_circle(cx, cy, dot_r, r, g, b, alpha, true, 12);
        }
    }
}

void on_unload() {
    process::detach();
}

// Render / ESP template
//
// Render calls only work inside the render thread, so every draw call must be
// registered with on_render(). Colours are 4 separate ints: r, g, b, a.
// Box styles come from box_style:: (NORMAL, OUTLINED, FILLED, FILLED_OUTLINED,
// CORNERED, CORNERED_FILLED).

checkbox    g_esp_on;
color_picker g_esp_color;

bool main() {
    ui::config_path("echo_render_template");

    // UI order matters: tab -> subtab -> category -> elements
    ui::add_tab("ESP");
    ui::add_category("Settings");
    g_esp_on    = ui::add_checkbox("Enable ESP", true, "esp.enable");
    g_esp_color = ui::add_color_picker("Color", 255, 0, 0, 200, true, "esp.color");

    on_render(@draw);
    return true;
}

void draw() {
    if (!ui::get(g_esp_on)) return;

    color c = ui::get(g_esp_color);

    // Example: draw a box around a fixed screen position.
    // Replace the fixed position with real world-to-screen projected coords.
    int sx = 640;
    int sy = 360;
    int w  = 40;
    int h  = 80;

    // Built-in font, size in pixels (render context only)
    render::update_font(fonts::TAHOMA, 12);

    render::draw_box(sx - w / 2, sy - h, w, h,
                     c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a, box_style::OUTLINED, 0.0f);

    render::draw_text(sx, sy - h - 14, "Player",
                      c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a);
}

void on_unload() {
    // nothing to release — the runtime drops handles automatically
}

`app/echo/templates/ue5-sdk.as`:

```as
// UE5 SDK-based ESP — Echo AngelScript template
// Requires: Dumper-7 SDK generated from your target game
// See: skills/dumper7-sdk.md, .claude/agents/echo-sdk.md
//
// How to use:
//   1. Run Dumper-7 on your target UE5 game
//   2. Open CppSDK/SDK_HEADERS/Engine_classes.hpp and Engine_structs.hpp
//   3. Update the offset constants below from those files
//   4. Place in %AppData%\Roaming\scripts\, reload in-game
//
// IMPORTANT: THE OFFSETS AND THE SIGNATURE BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS. They come
// from one Dumper-7 output and are NOT verified. They break on every patch.
// Re-derive them before using this template.

// ── Offset constants (placeholders — update from Dumper-7 after each patch) ──
// Source: Engine_classes.hpp / ShooterGame_classes.hpp
const uint32 OFF_PERSISTENTLEVEL  = 0x30;   // UWorld::PersistentLevel
const uint32 OFF_ACTORS_DATA      = 0xA0;   // ULevel::AActors.Data (TArray)
const uint32 OFF_ACTORS_COUNT     = 0xA8;   // ULevel::AActors.Num
const uint32 OFF_ROOTCOMPONENT    = 0x130;  // AActor::RootComponent
const uint32 OFF_COMPONENTWORLD   = 0x1C0;  // USceneComponent::ComponentToWorld
const uint32 OFF_FTRANSFORM_POS   = 0x10;   // FTransform::Translation (within ComponentToWorld)
const uint32 OFF_HEALTH           = 0x330;  // ACharacter / APawn health — game-specific
const uint32 OFF_MAXHEALTH        = 0x334;  // game-specific
const uint32 OFF_TEAM             = 0x3B8;  // APawn / APlayerState::TeamNum — game-specific
const uint32 OFF_GAMEINSTANCE     = 0x180;  // UWorld::GameInstance
const uint32 OFF_LOCALPLAYERS_DATA = 0x38;  // UGameInstance::LocalPlayers.Data
const uint32 OFF_PC               = 0x30;   // ULocalPlayer::PlayerController
const uint32 OFF_CAMMANAGER       = 0x440;  // APlayerController::PlayerCameraManager
const uint32 OFF_CAMLOC           = 0x1490; // APlayerCameraManager::CameraLocation
const uint32 OFF_CAMROT           = 0x149C; // APlayerCameraManager::CameraRotation
const uint32 OFF_CAMFOV           = 0x14A8; // APlayerCameraManager::FOVAngle

// ── GWorld scan pattern (placeholder — update if broken after patch) ─────────
const string GWORLD_SIG = "48 8B 1D ? ? ? ? 48 85 DB 74";

// ── Shared state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mutex@ g_ent_lock = create_mutex();
checkbox g_show_boxes;
checkbox g_show_health;
checkbox g_show_distance;
slider   g_fov_limit;      // degrees; 360 = no limit
color_picker g_col_visible;
color_picker g_col_occluded;

class Entity {
    vec3  pos;
    float health;
    float maxhealth;
    int   team;
}

array<Entity@> g_entities;
int  g_local_team = -1;
vec3 g_local_pos;
vec3 g_cam_rot;
f_view_cache g_view;

const string GAME_EXE = "YourGame-Win64-Shipping.exe"; // ← change me

// ── Setup ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
bool main() {
    ui::config_path("echo_ue5_sdk");

    attach_data ad = process::attach(GAME_EXE);
    if (ad.pid == 0) {
        alert::show("Game not found");
        return false;
    }

    ui::add_tab("UE5 ESP");
    ui::add_category("Settings");
    g_show_boxes    = ui::add_checkbox("Boxes", true, "ue5.boxes");
    g_show_health   = ui::add_checkbox("Health", true, "ue5.health");
    g_show_distance = ui::add_checkbox("Distance", true, "ue5.distance");
    g_fov_limit     = ui::add_slider("FOV limit", 360, 10, 360, 5, "deg", "ue5.fov");
    g_col_visible   = ui::add_color_picker("Visible", 0, 255, 0, 200, true, "ue5.col_v");
    g_col_occluded  = ui::add_color_picker("Occluded", 255, 80, 80, 200, true, "ue5.col_o");

    create_thread(64, @update_loop);    // 64 tps entity update
    on_render(@draw_loop);
    return true;
}

// ── Entity update ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void update_loop() {
    do_update();
}

void do_update() {
    // GWorld — find_signature needs a base address first
    uint64 base = process::get_module_base(GAME_EXE);
    if (base == 0) return;

    uint64 gw_sig = process::find_signature(base, GWORLD_SIG);
    if (gw_sig == 0) return;
    uint64 gworld_ptr = process::get_relative_address(gw_sig, 3, 7);
    uint64 world      = process::read_uint64(gworld_ptr);
    if (world == 0) return;

    // Camera — every link is checked so a null pointer is never dereferenced
    uint64 gi      = process::read_uint64(world + OFF_GAMEINSTANCE);
    if (gi == 0) return;
    uint64 lp_data = process::read_uint64(gi + OFF_LOCALPLAYERS_DATA);
    if (lp_data == 0) return;
    uint64 local_p = process::read_uint64(lp_data);
    if (local_p == 0) return;
    uint64 pc      = process::read_uint64(local_p + OFF_PC);
    if (pc == 0) return;
    uint64 cam     = process::read_uint64(pc + OFF_CAMMANAGER);
    if (cam == 0) return;

    vec3 cam_loc = vec3(process::read_float(cam + OFF_CAMLOC),
                        process::read_float(cam + OFF_CAMLOC + 4),
                        process::read_float(cam + OFF_CAMLOC + 8));
    vec3 cam_rot = vec3(process::read_float(cam + OFF_CAMROT),
                        process::read_float(cam + OFF_CAMROT + 4),
                        process::read_float(cam + OFF_CAMROT + 8));
    float cam_fov = process::read_float(cam + OFF_CAMFOV);
    if (cam_fov < 10.0f || cam_fov > 170.0f) cam_fov = 90.0f;

    f_view_info view_info;
    view_info.location = cam_loc;
    view_info.rotation = cam_rot;
    view_info.fov      = cam_fov;

    // Actor list
    uint64 level      = process::read_uint64(world + OFF_PERSISTENTLEVEL);
    uint64 actors_ptr = process::read_uint64(level + OFF_ACTORS_DATA);
    int32  actors_num = process::read_int32(level + OFF_ACTORS_COUNT);
    if (actors_num <= 0 || actors_num > 512) return;

    array<Entity@> tmp;
    int local_team = -1;

    for (int32 i = 0; i < actors_num; i++) {
        uint64 actor = process::read_uint64(actors_ptr + uint64(i) * 8);
        if (actor == 0) continue;

        int   team = process::read_int32(actor + OFF_TEAM);
        float hp   = process::read_float(actor + OFF_HEALTH);
        if (hp <= 0.0f) continue;

        uint64 root = process::read_uint64(actor + OFF_ROOTCOMPONENT);
        if (root == 0) continue;

        // ComponentToWorld.Translation — three consecutive floats
        vec3 pos = vec3(process::read_float(root + OFF_COMPONENTWORLD + OFF_FTRANSFORM_POS),
                        process::read_float(root + OFF_COMPONENTWORLD + OFF_FTRANSFORM_POS + 4),
                        process::read_float(root + OFF_COMPONENTWORLD + OFF_FTRANSFORM_POS + 8));

        // Assume local player has a team set and is closest to (0,0,0) initially
        // Better: compare to the PC actor address
        if (local_team == -1) local_team = team;

        Entity@ e = Entity();
        e.pos       = pos;
        e.health    = hp;
        e.maxhealth = process::read_float(actor + OFF_MAXHEALTH);
        if (e.maxhealth <= 0.0f) e.maxhealth = 100.0f;
        e.team      = team;
        tmp.insertLast(e);
    }

    g_ent_lock.lock();
    g_entities   = tmp;
    g_local_team = local_team;
    g_local_pos  = cam_loc;  // approximate local pos as camera loc
    g_cam_rot    = cam_rot;
    g_view       = build_view_cache(view_info);
    g_ent_lock.unlock();
}

// ── Draw ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void draw_loop() {
    g_ent_lock.lock_shared();
    array<Entity@> snap = g_entities;
    int local_team = g_local_team;
    vec3 local_pos = g_local_pos;
    vec3 cam_rot = g_cam_rot;
    f_view_cache view = g_view;
    g_ent_lock.unlock_shared();

    render::update_font(fonts::TAHOMA, 12);

    for (uint i = 0; i < snap.length(); i++) {
        Entity@ e = snap[i];
        if (e.team == local_team) continue;

        // FOV filter
        double dfov = math::unreal_calculate_fov(cam_rot, local_pos, e.pos);
        if (double(ui::get(g_fov_limit)) < 360.0 && dfov > double(ui::get(g_fov_limit))) continue;

        // W2S — unreal::w2s writes the screen position and returns false when
        // the point is off-screen or behind the camera
        vec2 feet_scr;
        if (!unreal::w2s(e.pos, view, feet_scr)) continue;

        vec2 head_scr;
        bool head_ok = unreal::w2s(e.pos.add(vec3(0, 0, 90)), view, head_scr);
        // Head not on screen: the body is occluded/out of view — fall back to
        // the feet so only the distance label is drawn, in the dim colour.
        if (!head_ok) head_scr = feet_scr;

        float h = feet_scr.y - head_scr.y;
        if (h < 0.0f) h = -h;
        float w = h * 0.5f;
        float cx = feet_scr.x;
        float cy = head_scr.y;

        color col = head_ok ? ui::get(g_col_visible)
                            : ui::get(g_col_occluded);

        // Cornered box
        if (ui::get(g_show_boxes)) {
            float clen = w * 0.25f;
            render::draw_line(cx - w / 2,       cy,          cx - w / 2 + clen, cy,
                              col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(cx + w / 2 - clen, cy,          cx + w / 2,        cy,
                              col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(cx - w / 2,       cy + h,      cx - w / 2 + clen, cy + h,
                              col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(cx + w / 2 - clen, cy + h,      cx + w / 2,        cy + h,
                              col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(cx - w / 2,       cy,          cx - w / 2,        cy + clen,
                              col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(cx - w / 2,       cy + h - clen, cx - w / 2,      cy + h,
                              col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(cx + w / 2,       cy,          cx + w / 2,        cy + clen,
                              col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a, 1.5f);
            render::draw_line(cx + w / 2,       cy + h - clen, cx + w / 2,      cy + h,
                              col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a, 1.5f);
        }

        // Health bar
        if (ui::get(g_show_health)) {
            float pct = e.health / e.maxhealth;
            if (pct > 1.0f) pct = 1.0f;
            float bh = h * pct;
            float bx = cx - w / 2 - 6;
            render::draw_box(int(bx) - 2, int(cy), 4, int(h),
                             0, 0, 0, 150, box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
            render::draw_box(int(bx) - 2, int(cy + h - bh), 4, int(bh),
                             int((1 - pct) * 255), int(pct * 255), 0, 220,
                             box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);
        }

        // Distance label
        if (ui::get(g_show_distance)) {
            float dist_m = e.pos.distance(local_pos) / 100.0f;
            string lbl = util::format_string("{:.0}m", dist_m);
            render::draw_text(int(cx), int(cy + h) + 2, lbl, 220, 220, 220, 200);
        }
    }
}

`app/echo/templates/unity-il2cpp.as`:

```as
// Unity IL2CPP ESP — REA-discovered offsets
// Run REA inspect_unity_il2cpp on global-metadata.dat first to get class/method
// offsets.
//
// IMPORTANT: THE OFFSETS AND SIGNATURES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS. They are
// illustrative values, NOT verified against any specific game build. Re-derive
// them per game and per patch before using this template.

const uint32 OFFSET_TRANSFORM      = 0x10;   // Component._transform
const uint32 OFFSET_POSITION       = 0x90;   // Transform.m_LocalPosition (world)
const uint32 OFFSET_HEALTH_CUR     = 0x58;   // HealthComponent.current
const uint32 OFFSET_HEALTH_MAX     = 0x5C;   // HealthComponent.maximum
const uint32 OFFSET_NAME_PTR       = 0x60;   // Il2CppObject.name (pointer to string)
const uint32 IL2CPP_STRING_CHARS   = 0x14;   // Il2CppString.chars offset

const string GAME_EXE = "Game.exe";   // ← change me to your game's executable

uint64 g_camera_obj = 0;
uint64 g_obj_manager = 0;
uint64 g_last_scan = 0;

bool main() {
    // process::attach() takes a PROCESS name — GameAssembly.dll is a module
    // inside that process and is resolved with get_module_base() below.
    attach_data ad = process::attach(GAME_EXE);
    if (ad.pid == 0) {
        alert::show(GAME_EXE + " not found");
        return false;
    }

    uint64 il2cpp_base = process::get_module_base("GameAssembly.dll");
    if (il2cpp_base == 0) {
        alert::show("GameAssembly.dll base not found");
        process::detach();
        return false;
    }

    // Camera class pointer — placeholder pattern; replace with REA output
    uint64 camera_class = process::find_signature(
        il2cpp_base,
        "48 8B 05 ? ? ? ? 48 85 C0 74 ? 48 8B 40 ? 48 85 C0"
    );
    if (camera_class == 0) {
        alert::show("Camera class pattern failed — update the signature");
        process::detach();
        return false;
    }
    g_camera_obj = process::get_relative_address(camera_class, 3, 7);

    // Object manager — placeholder pattern; replace with REA output
    uint64 mgr_sig = process::find_signature(
        il2cpp_base,
        "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? 48 85 C0 74 ? 48 8B 10"
    );
    if (mgr_sig != 0) {
        g_obj_manager = process::get_relative_address(mgr_sig, 3, 7);
    }

    create_thread(16, @tick);
    on_render(@render);
    return true;
}

// Read a 4x4 float matrix (16 floats) from the target process (user code)
matrix4x4 read_matrix16(uint64 addr) {
    matrix4x4 m;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++)
        for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
            m[c][r] = process::read_float(addr + uint64(c * 4 + r) * 4);
    return m;
}

void tick() {
    // Refresh the object manager occasionally — the pointer can be rebuilt
    // by the game at any time, so re-resolve it every few seconds.
    uint64 now = util::tickcount();
    if (g_obj_manager != 0 && now - g_last_scan < 5000) return;
    g_last_scan = now;

    uint64 il2cpp_base = process::get_module_base("GameAssembly.dll");
    if (il2cpp_base == 0) return;

    uint64 mgr_sig = process::find_signature(
        il2cpp_base,
        "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? 48 85 C0 74 ? 48 8B 10"
    );
    if (mgr_sig != 0) g_obj_manager = process::get_relative_address(mgr_sig, 3, 7);
}

void render() {
    if (g_camera_obj == 0 || g_obj_manager == 0) return;

    // Read camera matrix — Camera.projectionMatrix (0x1B0 typical, placeholder)
    matrix4x4 vp = read_matrix16(g_camera_obj + 0x1B0);

    uint64 entity = process::read_uint64(g_obj_manager);
    uint32 drawn = 0;

    while (entity != 0 && drawn < 100) {
        uint64 transform = process::read_uint64(entity + OFFSET_TRANSFORM);
        if (transform == 0) {
            entity = process::read_uint64(entity + 0x8);
            continue;
        }

        // Read the transform position (three consecutive floats)
        vec3 world_pos = vec3(process::read_float(transform + OFFSET_POSITION),
                              process::read_float(transform + OFFSET_POSITION + 4),
                              process::read_float(transform + OFFSET_POSITION + 8));

        // unity::w2s writes the screen position and returns false when the
        // point is off-screen or behind the camera
        vec2 screen;
        if (!unity::w2s(world_pos, vp, screen)) {
            entity = process::read_uint64(entity + 0x8);
            continue;
        }

        float cur_hp = process::read_float(entity + OFFSET_HEALTH_CUR);
        float max_hp = process::read_float(entity + OFFSET_HEALTH_MAX);
        float hp_pct = max_hp > 0.0f ? cur_hp / max_hp : 0.0f;

        color box_col = color(255, int(hp_pct * 255.0f), 0, 220);
        float h = 60.0f, w = h * 0.4f;
        render::draw_box(int(screen.x - w * 0.5f), int(screen.y - h),
                         int(w), int(h),
                         box_col.r, box_col.g, box_col.b, box_col.a,
                         box_style::OUTLINED, 0.0f);

        color bar_col = color(int((1.0f - hp_pct) * 255.0f), int(hp_pct * 255.0f), 0, 220);
        render::draw_box(int(screen.x + w * 0.5f) + 2, int(screen.y - h),
                         4, int(h * hp_pct),
                         bar_col.r, bar_col.g, bar_col.b, bar_col.a,
                         box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);

        // Name label from Il2CppString — the chars are UTF-16LE
        uint64 name_ptr = process::read_uint64(entity + OFFSET_NAME_PTR);
        if (name_ptr != 0) {
            array<uint8>@ chars = process::read_bytes(name_ptr + IL2CPP_STRING_CHARS, 48);
            if (chars !is null) {
                array<uint8> buf(chars.length());
                for (uint i = 0; i < chars.length(); i++) buf[i] = chars[i];
                string name = util::wide_to_string(buf, true);
                if (name.length() > 0)
                    render::draw_text_outlined(int(screen.x), int(screen.y) + 2, name,
                                               255, 255, 255, 200);
            }
        }

        drawn++;
        entity = process::read_uint64(entity + 0x8);
    }
}

void on_unload() {
    process::detach();
}

`app/echo/templates/valorant.as`:

```as
// Valorant ESP — UE4 fork with Vanguard (VGK)
// Requires: Dumper-7-VGK SDK (https://github.com/sinistercodes/Dumper-7-VGK)
// VGK runs at kernel level — Echo is fully external, no injection required.
//
// IMPORTANT: THE OFFSETS AND SIGNATURES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS. They are
// illustrative values from one Dumper-7-VGK run and are NOT verified. They
// change every patch. Re-run Dumper-7-VGK and update them before use.

const uint32 UOBJECT_CLASS        = 0x10;
const uint32 UOBJECT_NAME_INDEX   = 0x18;
const uint32 ACTOR_ROOT_COMP      = 0x130;
const uint32 ACTOR_HEALTH         = 0x520;   // verify via Dumper-7-VGK
const uint32 PLAYERSTATE_TEAM_ID  = 0x3E8;
const uint32 PC_CAMERA_MANAGER    = 0x350;
const uint32 CAMMAN_VIEW_MATRIX   = 0x440;
const uint32 CAMMAN_LOCATION      = 0x11C;
const uint32 CAMMAN_ROTATION      = 0x128;
const uint32 CAMMAN_FOV           = 0x140;
const uint32 SCENE_COMP_LOCATION  = 0x11C;

const string GAME_EXE = "VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe";

f_view_cache g_view;
mutex@ g_mx = create_mutex();

bool main() {
    attach_data ad = process::attach(GAME_EXE);
    if (ad.pid == 0) {
        alert::show("VALORANT process not found");
        return false;
    }

    if (process::get_module_base(GAME_EXE) == 0) {
        alert::show("failed to read module base");
        process::detach();
        return false;
    }

    create_thread(15, @tick);
    on_render(@render);
    return true;
}

// GObjects is encrypted by VGK. This pattern targets the decryption stub.
// Replace with the sig from your Dumper-7-VGK run — it changes each patch.
uint64 get_gobjects() {
    uint64 base = process::get_module_base(GAME_EXE);
    if (base == 0) return 0;

    uint64 enc = process::find_signature(
        base,
        "48 8B 05 ? ? ? ? 48 85 C0 74 ? 48 8B 40 ? C3"
    );
    if (enc == 0) {
        alert::show("GObjects sig failed — run Dumper-7-VGK to get a new sig");
        return 0;
    }
    return process::read_uint64(process::get_relative_address(enc, 3, 7));
}

void tick() {
    // ~15 Hz — VGK is sensitive to read frequency
    uint64 base = process::get_module_base(GAME_EXE);
    if (base == 0) return;

    // Local player controller → camera manager → view cache
    uint64 local_pc = process::find_signature(
        base,
        "48 8B 0D ? ? ? ? E8 ? ? ? ? 48 89 43 ? 48 8B D8"
    );
    if (local_pc == 0) return;
    local_pc = process::read_uint64(process::get_relative_address(local_pc, 3, 7));
    if (local_pc == 0) return;

    uint64 cam_mgr = process::read_uint64(local_pc + PC_CAMERA_MANAGER);
    if (cam_mgr == 0) return;

    f_view_info info;
    info.location = vec3(process::read_float(cam_mgr + CAMMAN_LOCATION),
                         process::read_float(cam_mgr + CAMMAN_LOCATION + 4),
                         process::read_float(cam_mgr + CAMMAN_LOCATION + 8));
    info.rotation = vec3(process::read_float(cam_mgr + CAMMAN_ROTATION),
                         process::read_float(cam_mgr + CAMMAN_ROTATION + 4),
                         process::read_float(cam_mgr + CAMMAN_ROTATION + 8));
    info.fov = process::read_float(cam_mgr + CAMMAN_FOV);

    f_view_cache new_view = build_view_cache(info);

    g_mx.lock();
    g_view = new_view;
    g_mx.unlock();
}

void render() {
    g_mx.lock_shared();
    f_view_cache view = g_view;
    g_mx.unlock_shared();

    uint64 gobjects = get_gobjects();
    if (gobjects == 0) return;

    // TUObjectArray: data ptr at +0x0, count at +0x14
    uint32 obj_count = process::read_uint32(gobjects + 0x14);
    uint64 obj_data  = process::read_uint64(gobjects + 0x00);
    if (obj_data == 0 || obj_count == 0) return;

    render::update_font(fonts::TAHOMA, 10);

    uint32 drawn = 0;
    for (uint32 i = 0; i < obj_count && drawn < 64; i++) {
        // Each TUObjectArray entry: 24 bytes (ptr | serial | pad)
        uint64 obj = process::read_uint64(obj_data + uint64(i) * 24);
        if (obj == 0) continue;

        uint64 root_comp = process::read_uint64(obj + ACTOR_ROOT_COMP);
        if (root_comp == 0) continue;

        vec3 world_pos = vec3(process::read_float(root_comp + SCENE_COMP_LOCATION),
                              process::read_float(root_comp + SCENE_COMP_LOCATION + 4),
                              process::read_float(root_comp + SCENE_COMP_LOCATION + 8));
        if (world_pos.x == 0.0f && world_pos.y == 0.0f) continue;

        // unreal::w2s writes the screen position and returns false when the
        // point is off-screen or behind the camera
        vec2 screen;
        if (!unreal::w2s(world_pos, view, screen)) continue;

        float health = process::read_float(obj + ACTOR_HEALTH);
        if (health <= 0.0f || health > 150.0f) continue;

        float hp_pct = health / 150.0f;
        color col = color(255, int(hp_pct * 200.0f), 0, 210);

        float h = 65.0f, w = h * 0.35f;
        render::draw_box(int(screen.x - w * 0.5f), int(screen.y - h),
                         int(w), int(h),
                         col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a, box_style::OUTLINED, 0.0f);
        render::draw_box(int(screen.x - w * 0.5f) - 5, int(screen.y - h),
                         3, int(h * hp_pct),
                         col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a, box_style::FILLED, 0.0f);

        string hp_str = util::format_string("{:.0}", health);
        render::draw_text_outlined(int(screen.x), int(screen.y) + 2, hp_str,
                                   255, 255, 255, 180);

        drawn++;
    }
}

void on_unload() {
    process::detach();
}

`app/echo/templates/web-mv.as`:

```as
// web-mv compatibility template — exposes Echo's live memory socket to the
// echo-reverse relay (and any compatible web-mv browser client).
//
// Echo ships a built-in JSON-over-WebSocket memory server. You attach to the
// game and open the socket; the runtime then answers the viewer's requests.
//
//   bool process::open_socket(const string url);
//
// Requirements: a process must be attached first, and only one socket may be
// open at a time (open_socket() returns false otherwise).
//
// Wire protocol — every frame is a JSON object with a "type" and an optional
// integer "id" (defaults to 0) that is echoed back in the response.
//
//   request  {"type":"ping","id":1}
//   response {"type":"ping_result","id":1,"attached":true,"pid":1234,"base":"0x7ff6..."}
//
//   request  {"type":"read","id":2,"address":"0x7ff600001000","size":16}
//   response {"type":"read_result","id":2,"success":true,
//             "address":"0x7ff600001000","size":16,"data":"48895c2408574883ec20..."}
//
//   request  {"type":"read_batch","id":3,
//             "reads":[{"address":"0x7ff600001000","size":8},
//                      {"address":"0x7ff600002000","size":4}]}
//   response {"type":"read_batch_result","id":3,"success":true,
//             "results":[{"success":true,"address":"0x7ff600001000","data":"4883ec28..."},
//                        {"success":false,"address":"0x7ff600002000","data":""}]}
//
//   request  {"type":"modules","id":4}
//   response {"type":"modules_result","id":4,"success":true,
//             "modules":[{"name":"game.exe","base":"0x7ff600000000","size":10485760}]}
//
//   request  {"type":"sig_scan","id":5,"sig":"4883ec28ff15","mask":"xxxxxx",
//             "module":"game.exe","find_all":false}
//   response {"type":"sig_scan_result","id":5,"success":true,
//             "results":["0x7ff600012340"]}
//
//   request  {"type":"sig_scan_ida","id":6,"pattern":"48 83 EC 28 FF 15 ? ? ? ? 85 C0"}
//   response {"type":"sig_scan_ida_result","id":6,"success":true,
//             "results":["0x7ff600012340"]}
//
//   request  {"type":"string_scan","id":7,"text":"PlayerController","find_all":true}
//   response {"type":"string_scan_result","id":7,"success":true,
//             "results":["0x7ff601a04bc0"]}
//
//   request  {"type":"resolve_relative","id":8,"address":"0x7ff600012340","offset":3,"inst_size":7}
//   response {"type":"resolve_relative_result","id":8,"success":true,"address":"0x7ff60001f000"}
//
//   request  {"type":"rtti_resolve","id":9,"address":"0x1f3a0000b40"}
//   response {"type":"rtti_resolve_result","id":9,"success":true,"name":"class PlayerController"}
//
//   request  {"type":"enumerate_functions","id":11,"module":"game.exe"}
//   response {"type":"enumerate_functions_result","id":11,"success":true,"count":2,
//             "results":[{"address":"0x7ff600001000","size":128,"method":0}]}
//
//   request  {"type":"disassemble","id":12,"address":"0x7ff600001000","size":64}
//   response {"type":"disassemble_result","id":12,"success":true,"complete":true,"count":2,
//             "results":[{"address":"0x7ff600001000","length":4,"bytes":"4883ec28",
//                         "text":"sub rsp, 0x28"}]}
//
//   error    {"type":"error","id":1,"code":1002,"message":"invalid or missing arguments",
//             "detail":"read requires 'address' and 'size'"}
//
// Error codes: 1000 unknown type, 1001 not attached, 1002 invalid arguments,
// 1003 module not found, 1004 size out of range, 1005 memory read failed,
// 1006 function enumeration failed, 1007 disassembly failed.

const string GAME_EXE = "game.exe";
const string SOCKET_URL = "ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent";

bool main() {
    attach_data ad = process::attach(GAME_EXE);
    if (ad.pid == 0) {
        alert::show(GAME_EXE + " not found");
        return false;
    }

    // The socket answers the viewer's JSON requests out of the attached
    // process — memory reads, module list, sig scans, disassembly.
    if (!process::open_socket(SOCKET_URL)) {
        alert::show("Failed to open " + SOCKET_URL +
                    " (no process attached, or a socket is already open)");
        process::detach();
        return false;
    }

    console::log("web-mv socket open on " + SOCKET_URL);
    return true;
}

void on_unload() {
    process::detach();
}

// ─── User code: region list for the viewer ───────────────────────────────────
// The built-in "modules" route already reports every module, so this is only
// needed if you want to hand the viewer a custom set of named regions.
void build_regions_json() {
    json_obj@ arr = json::array();
    array<module_entry>@ mods = process::get_module_list();
    if (mods is null) return;

    for (uint i = 0; i < mods.length(); i++) {
        json_obj@ entry = json_obj();
        entry.set("name", mods[i].name);
        entry.set("base", util::to_hex(mods[i].base));
        entry.set("size", mods[i].size);
        arr.push(entry);
    }

    console::log(json::stringify(arr, true));
}

```md
# Echo Relay - Rust WebSocket Relay Server

A Rust-based WebSocket relay server that connects Echo Backend to the Echo Reverse application.

## Overview

The Echo Relay server acts as a bridge between:
- **Echo Backend** (WebSocket at `ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext`)
- **Echo Reverse** application (connects to relay at `ws://127.0.0.1:9001`)

## Features

- **Bidirectional WebSocket Relay**: Forwards messages between Echo Backend and Echo Reverse
- **RPC Request/Response Handling**: Manages RPC requests and routes responses back to the correct clients
- **Multiple Client Support**: Can handle multiple Echo Reverse instances simultaneously
- **Automatic Reconnection**: Automatically reconnects to Echo Backend if connection is lost
- **High Performance**: Built with Rust and Tokio for maximum performance

## RPC Support

The relay supports the following RPC categories:
- `rendering` - Bone ESP, Glow ESP, Box ESP, etc.
- `memory` - Read, Write, Scan operations
- `math` - Vector, Matrix, Quaternion operations
- `performance` - Performance monitoring
- `scanning` - Pattern, Value, Signature scanning
- `bone_esp` - Bone ESP operations
- `game` - Player, Entity, Matrix data
- `system` - System info, ping, config

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Rust 2021 edition or later
- Cargo (Rust package manager)

### Build

```bash
cd rust-relay
cargo build --release
```

The compiled binary will be at `target/release/echo-relay`.

## Usage

### Start the Relay Server

```bash
# With default ports
cargo run --release

# With custom ports
cargo run --release -- 9001 ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext
```

### Command Line Arguments

1. **Relay Port** (optional): The port the relay server listens on (default: 9001)
2. **Echo Backend URL** (optional): The WebSocket URL of Echo Backend (default: ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext)

### Using npm scripts

From the project root:

```bash
npm run relay          # Build the relay
npm run relay:run      # Build and run the relay
npm run relay:debug    # Run in debug mode
```

## Configuration

### Environment Variables

- `ECHO_BACKEND_URL`: Echo Backend WebSocket URL (default: ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext)
- `RELAY_PORT`: Port to listen on (default: 9001)
- `RUST_LOG`: Logging level (e.g., `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`)

## API

### WebSocket Protocol

The relay server speaks WebSocket protocol with JSON messages.

#### RPC Request Format

```json
{
  "category": "memory",
  "type": "read",
  "data": {
    "address": 12345678,
    "size": 4
  },
  "request_id": 123456789,
  "timestamp": 1234567890
}
```

#### RPC Response Format

```json
{
  "request_id": 123456789,
  "category": "memory",
  "type": "read",
  "success": true,
  "error": "",
  "data": {
    "address": 12345678,
    "size": 4,
    "value": [1, 2, 3, 4]
  },
  "timestamp": 1234567891
}
```

### Supported Endpoints

- `ws://127.0.0.1:9001` - WebSocket endpoint for Echo Reverse to connect to
- `ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext` - Echo Backend WebSocket endpoint (relay connects here)

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────┐
│   Echo Reverse   │────▶│   Echo Relay     │────▶│   Echo Backend   │
│    (React/TS)    │◀────│   (Rust/WS)      │◀────│    (AngelScript) │
└─────────────────┘     └─────────────────┘     └─────────────────┘
                           │
                           ▼
                     ┌─────────────────┐
                     │   Multiple      │
                     │   Clients       │
                     └─────────────────┘
```

## Integration with Echo Reverse

The Echo Reverse application uses the `EchoBackendWebSocketClient` AngelScript class to connect to the relay server. The client sends RPC requests which are forwarded to Echo Backend, and responses are routed back to the appropriate client.

### Example AngelScript Usage

```angelscript
// Connect to the relay
EchoBackendWebSocketClient@ client = createEchoWebSocketClient();
client.connect();

// Send an RPC request
dict data = {
    {"address", 0x12345678},
    {"size", 4}
};

bool result = client.send("memory", "read", data);

// Handle response in callback
client.setOnMessage(func(auto message) {
    RpcResponse@ response = RpcResponse.fromJSON(message);
    if (response != null) {
        print("Received response: " + json::encode(response.getData()) + "\n");
    }
});
```

## Troubleshooting

### Connection Issues

- **Echo Backend not running**: Ensure Echo Backend is running and listening at the configured URL
- **Port conflicts**: Make sure the relay port (default 9001) is not already in use
- **Firewall**: Check that your firewall allows connections on the specified ports

### Build Issues

- **Rust not installed**: Install Rust from [rust-lang.org](https://www.rust-lang.org/)
- **Missing dependencies**: Run `cargo build` to automatically download and compile dependencies

## Performance

The relay server is designed for high performance:
- **Concurrent connections**: Can handle up to 100 simultaneous connections
- **Low latency**: Minimal overhead in message forwarding
- **Efficient memory usage**: Small memory footprint
- **Non-blocking I/O**: Uses Tokio for asynchronous operations
