```rs
// echo-relay.rs
// Rust WebSocket relay server for Echo Backend
// Connects to Echo Backend WebSocket and relays messages to AngelScript

use std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};
use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::thread;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use tokio::net::{TcpListener as TokioTcpListener, TcpStream as TokioTcpStream};
use tokio::sync::broadcast;
use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
use futures_util::{SinkExt, StreamExt};
use tokio_tungstenite::{connect_async, tungstenite::protocol::Message, tungstenite::connect};
use url::Url;

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

const ECHO_BACKEND_WS_URL: &str = "ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext";
const RELAY_PORT: u16 = 9001;
const MAX_CONNECTIONS: usize = 100;
const HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL: u64 = 30;
const TIMEOUT_SECONDS: u64 = 60;

// ============================================================================
// DATA STRUCTURES
// ============================================================================

/// RPC Request structure
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)]
struct RpcRequest {
    pub category: String,
    pub r#type: String,
    pub data: Value,
    #[serde(default = "default_request_id")]
    pub request_id: u64,
    #[serde(default = "default_timestamp")]
    pub timestamp: u64,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub source: String,
    #[serde(flatten)]
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, Value>,
}

fn default_request_id() -> u64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .unwrap()
        .as_secs()
}

fn default_timestamp() -> u64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .unwrap()
        .as_secs()
}

impl RpcRequest {
    pub fn new(category: &str, r#type: &str, data: Value) -> Self {
        Self {
            category: category.to_string(),
            r#type: r#type.to_string(),
            data,
            request_id: default_request_id(),
            timestamp: default_timestamp(),
            source: "echo-relay".to_string(),
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn to_message(&self) -> Message {
        Message::Text(serde_json::to_string(self).unwrap())
    }
}

/// RPC Response structure
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)]
struct RpcResponse {
    pub request_id: u64,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub category: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub r#type: String,
    pub success: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub error: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub data: Value,
    #[serde(default = "default_timestamp")]
    pub timestamp: u64,
    #[serde(flatten)]
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, Value>,
}

impl RpcResponse {
    pub fn new(request_id: u64, success: bool, error: &str, data: Value) -> Self {
        Self {
            request_id,
            category: String::new(),
            r#type: String::new(),
            success,
            error: error.to_string(),
            data,
            timestamp: default_timestamp(),
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn to_message(&self) -> Message {
        Message::Text(serde_json::to_string(self).unwrap())
    }
}

/// Client connection state
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct ClientState {
    pub id: usize,
    pub stream: Arc<Mutex<TcpStream>>,
    pub last_activity: std::time::Instant,
    pub pending_requests: HashMap<u64, String>, // request_id -> category.type
}

impl ClientState {
    pub fn new(id: usize, stream: TcpStream) -> Self {
        Self {
            id,
            stream: Arc::new(Mutex::new(stream)),
            last_activity: std::time::Instant::now(),
            pending_requests: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// ECHO BACKEND CLIENT
// ============================================================================

/// Echo Backend WebSocket client
struct EchoBackendClient {
    url: String,
    connection: Option<tokio_tungstenite::WebSocketStream<tokio::net::TcpStream>>,
    sender: Option<tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<Message>>,
    receiver: Option<tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<Message>>,
    request_counter: u64,
}

impl EchoBackendClient {
    pub fn new(url: &str) -> Self {
        Self {
            url: url.to_string(),
            connection: None,
            sender: None,
            receiver: None,
            request_counter: 0,
        }
    }

    /// Connect to Echo Backend
    pub async fn connect(&mut self) -> Result<(), String> {
        let url = Url::parse(&self.url).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        
        let (ws_stream, _) = connect_async(url)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to connect to Echo Backend: {}", e))?;
        
        let (mut write, mut read) = ws_stream.split();
        
        let (sender, mut receiver) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(100);
        
        // Spawn write task
        let write_sender = sender.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            while let Some(msg) = receiver.recv().await {
                if let Err(e) = write.send(msg).await {
                    eprintln!("Failed to send message to Echo Backend: {}", e);
                    break;
                }
            }
        });
        
        // Spawn read task
        let read_sender = sender.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            while let Some(msg) = read.next().await {
                match msg {
                    Ok(message) => {
                        if read_sender.send(message).await.is_err() {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        eprintln!("Echo Backend connection error: {}", e);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        
        self.connection = Some(ws_stream);
        self.sender = Some(sender);
        self.receiver = Some(receiver);
        
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Disconnect from Echo Backend
    pub async fn disconnect(&mut self) {
        self.sender = None;
        self.receiver = None;
        self.connection = None;
    }

    /// Check if connected
    pub fn is_connected(&self) -> bool {
        self.sender.is_some() && self.receiver.is_some()
    }

    /// Send a message to Echo Backend
    pub async fn send(&self, message: Message) -> Result<(), String> {
        if let Some(sender) = &self.sender {
            sender
                .send(message)
                .await
                .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to send message: {}", e))
        } else {
            Err("Not connected to Echo Backend".to_string())
        }
    }

    /// Receive a message from Echo Backend
    pub async fn receive(&mut self) -> Option<Message> {
        if let Some(receiver) = &mut self.receiver {
            receiver.recv().await
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    /// Send an RPC request to Echo Backend
    pub async fn send_rpc(&mut self, category: &str, r#type: &str, data: Value) -> Result<u64, String> {
        self.request_counter += 1;
        let request = RpcRequest::new(category, r#type, data);
        
        // Convert to Echo Backend format
        let echo_request = json!({
            "method": format!("{}.{}", category, r#type),
            "params": request.data,
            "id": request.request_id,
            "timestamp": request.timestamp,
        });
        
        self.send(Message::Text(echo_request.to_string())).await?;
        
        Ok(request.request_id)
    }

    /// Get next request ID
    pub fn next_request_id(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.request_counter += 1;
        self.request_counter
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// RELAY SERVER
// ============================================================================

/// WebSocket relay server for Echo Backend
pub struct EchoRelayServer {
    port: u16,
    echo_client: Arc<Mutex<EchoBackendClient>>,
    clients: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<usize, ClientState>>>,
    client_counter: Arc<Mutex<usize>>,
    running: Arc<Mutex<bool>>,
}

impl EchoRelayServer {
    pub fn new(port: u16) -> Self {
        Self {
            port,
            echo_client: Arc::new(Mutex::new(EchoBackendClient::new(ECHO_BACKEND_WS_URL))),
            clients: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),
            client_counter: Arc::new(Mutex::new(0)),
            running: Arc::new(Mutex::new(false)),
        }
    }

    /// Start the relay server
    pub async fn start(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
        let listener = TokioTcpListener::bind(format!("127.0.0.1:{}", self.port))
            .await
            .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to bind to port {}: {}", self.port, e))?;
        
        *self.running.lock().unwrap() = true;
        
        println!("[EchoRelay] Started on port {}", self.port);
        
        // Connect to Echo Backend
        {
            let mut echo_client = self.echo_client.lock().unwrap();
            if let Err(e) = echo_client.connect().await {
                eprintln!("[EchoRelay] Failed to connect to Echo Backend: {}", e);
                // Continue anyway - we'll try to reconnect
            } else {
                println!("[EchoRelay] Connected to Echo Backend at {}", ECHO_BACKEND_WS_URL);
            }
        }

        while *self.running.lock().unwrap() {
            let (stream, addr) = listener
                .accept()
                .await
                .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to accept connection: {}", e))?;
            
            let client_id = {
                let mut counter = self.client_counter.lock().unwrap();
                *counter += 1;
                *counter
            };
            
            let clients = self.clients.clone();
            let echo_client = self.echo_client.clone();
            let running = self.running.clone();
            
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                Self::handle_client(client_id, stream, addr, clients, echo_client, running).await;
            });
        }
        
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Stop the relay server
    pub async fn stop(&self) {
        *self.running.lock().unwrap() = false;
        
        // Disconnect all clients
        let mut clients = self.clients.lock().unwrap();
        for (_, client) in clients.drain() {
            let _ = client.stream.lock().unwrap().shutdown(std::net::Shutdown::Both);
        }
        
        // Disconnect from Echo Backend
        let mut echo_client = self.echo_client.lock().unwrap();
        echo_client.disconnect().await;
        
        println!("[EchoRelay] Stopped");
    }

    /// Handle a client connection
    async fn handle_client(
        client_id: usize,
        stream: TokioTcpStream,
        addr: std::net::SocketAddr,
        clients: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<usize, ClientState>>>,
        echo_client: Arc<Mutex<EchoBackendClient>>,
        running: Arc<Mutex<bool>>,
    ) {
        println!("[EchoRelay] New client connection from {} (ID: {})", addr, client_id);
        
        let stream = stream.into_std().unwrap();
        let client_state = ClientState::new(client_id, stream);
        
        // Add client to the map
        {
            let mut clients = clients.lock().unwrap();
            clients.insert(client_id, client_state.clone());
        }
        
        // Split into reader and writer
        let mut stream = client_state.stream.lock().unwrap();
        
        // Read loop
        let mut buffer = [0u8; 8192];
        while *running.lock().unwrap() {
            match stream.read(&mut buffer) {
                Ok(0) => {
                    // Connection closed
                    println!("[EchoRelay] Client {} disconnected", client_id);
                    break;
                }
                Ok(n) => {
                    // Parse message
                    let message = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buffer[..n]);
                    
                    // Try to parse as JSON
                    let json: Result<Value, _> = serde_json::from_str(&message);
                    
                    if let Ok(json) = json {
                        // Handle RPC request
                        if let Some(request) = Self::parse_rpc_request(&json) {
                            Self::handle_rpc_request(request, &echo_client, &clients, client_id).await;
                        } else if let Some(response) = Self::parse_rpc_response(&json) {
                            // Forward response to Echo Backend or other clients
                            Self::forward_response(response, &echo_client, &clients).await;
                        }
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    eprintln!("[EchoRelay] Error reading from client {}: {}", client_id, e);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Remove client
        {
            let mut clients = clients.lock().unwrap();
            clients.remove(&client_id);
        }
    }

    /// Parse RPC request from JSON
    fn parse_rpc_request(json: &Value) -> Option<RpcRequest> {
        serde_json::from_value::<RpcRequest>(json.clone()).ok()
    }

    /// Parse RPC response from JSON
    fn parse_rpc_response(json: &Value) -> Option<RpcResponse> {
        serde_json::from_value::<RpcResponse>(json.clone()).ok()
    }

    /// Handle an RPC request
    async fn handle_rpc_request(
        request: RpcRequest,
        echo_client: &Arc<Mutex<EchoBackendClient>>,
        clients: &Arc<Mutex<HashMap<usize, ClientState>>>,
        client_id: usize,
    ) {
        println!(
            "[EchoRelay] Received RPC request: {}::{}",
            request.category, request.r#type
        );

        // Forward to Echo Backend
        let mut echo_client = echo_client.lock().unwrap();
        
        if !echo_client.is_connected() {
            // Try to reconnect
            if let Err(e) = echo_client.connect().await {
                eprintln!("[EchoRelay] Failed to reconnect to Echo Backend: {}", e);
                let error_response = RpcResponse::new(
                    request.request_id,
                    false,
                    "Echo Backend not connected",
                    Value::Null,
                );
                Self::send_to_client(clients, client_id, error_response.to_message()).await;
                return;
            }
        }

        // Convert to Echo Backend format and send
        let echo_request = json!({
            "method": format!("{}.{}", request.category, request.r#type),
            "params": request.data,
            "id": request.request_id,
            "timestamp": request.timestamp,
        });

        if let Err(e) = echo_client
            .send(Message::Text(echo_request.to_string()))
            .await
        {
            eprintln!("[EchoRelay] Failed to send to Echo Backend: {}", e);
            let error_response = RpcResponse::new(
                request.request_id,
                false,
                &format!("Failed to forward to Echo Backend: {}", e),
                Value::Null,
            );
            Self::send_to_client(clients, client_id, error_response.to_message()).await;
            return;
        }

        // Store pending request
        {
            let mut clients = clients.lock().unwrap();
            if let Some(client) = clients.get_mut(&client_id) {
                let mut state = client.clone();
                state.pending_requests.insert(request.request_id, format!("{}.{}", request.category, request.r#type));
                clients.insert(client_id, state);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Forward a response
    async fn forward_response(
        response: RpcResponse,
        echo_client: &Arc<Mutex<EchoBackendClient>>,
        clients: &Arc<Mutex<HashMap<usize, ClientState>>>,
    ) {
        // Check if this is a response from Echo Backend
        // Forward to all connected clients that have pending requests
        let clients = clients.lock().unwrap();
        for (client_id, client) in clients.iter() {
            if client.pending_requests.contains_key(&response.request_id) {
                Self::send_to_client(clients, *client_id, response.clone().to_message()).await;
            }
        }
    }

    /// Send message to client
    async fn send_to_client(
        clients: &Arc<Mutex<HashMap<usize, ClientState>>>,
        client_id: usize,
        message: Message,
    ) {
        let clients = clients.lock().unwrap();
        if let Some(client) = clients.get(&client_id) {
            let mut stream = client.stream.lock().unwrap();
            if let Message::Text(text) = message {
                if let Err(e) = stream.write_all(text.as_bytes()) {
                    eprintln!(
                        "[EchoRelay] Failed to send to client {}: {}",
                        client_id, e
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Synchronous version for compatibility
// ============================================================================

/// Synchronous relay server for compatibility with non-Tokio environments
pub struct SyncEchoRelayServer {
    port: u16,
    echo_url: String,
}

impl SyncEchoRelayServer {
    pub fn new(port: u16, echo_url: &str) -> Self {
        Self {
            port,
            echo_url: echo_url.to_string(),
        }
    }

    pub fn start(&self) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind(format!("127.0.0.1:{}", self.port))?;
        println!("[SyncEchoRelay] Started on port {}", self.port);

        for stream in listener.incoming() {
            match stream {
                Ok(stream) => {
                    let echo_url = self.echo_url.clone();
                    thread::spawn(move || {
                        Self::handle_client(stream, echo_url);
                    });
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    eprintln!("[SyncEchoRelay] Error accepting connection: {}", e);
                }
            }
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    fn handle_client(stream: TcpStream, echo_url: String) {
        let addr = stream
            .peer_addr()
            .expect("Failed to get peer address");
        println!("[SyncEchoRelay] New connection from {}", addr);

        // For simplicity, just forward all messages
        let mut reader = stream.try_clone().expect("Failed to clone stream");
        let mut writer = stream;

        let mut buffer = [0u8; 8192];
        loop {
            match reader.read(&mut buffer) {
                Ok(0) => {
                    println!("[SyncEchoRelay] Client {} disconnected", addr);
                    break;
                }
                Ok(n) => {
                    let message = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buffer[..n]);
                    println!("[SyncEchoRelay] Received: {}", message);

                    // Echo back for now
                    if let Err(e) = writer.write_all(&buffer[..n]) {
                        eprintln!("[SyncEchoRelay] Failed to write: {}", e);
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    eprintln!("[SyncEchoRelay] Error reading: {}", e);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN
// ============================================================================

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), String> {
    // Parse command line arguments
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    
    let port = if args.len() > 1 {
        args[1].parse::<u16>().unwrap_or(RELAY_PORT)
    } else {
        RELAY_PORT
    };

    let echo_url = if args.len() > 2 {
        args[2].clone()
    } else {
        ECHO_BACKEND_WS_URL.to_string()
    };

    println!("Echo Backend Relay Server");
    println!("========================");
    println!("Relay port: {}", port);
    println!("Echo Backend URL: {}", echo_url);
    println!();

    // Create and start the relay server
    let mut server = EchoRelayServer::new(port);
    
    // Update Echo Backend URL
    {
        let mut echo_client = server.echo_client.lock().unwrap();
        *echo_client = EchoBackendClient::new(&echo_url);
    }
    
    server.start().await?;

    Ok(())
}

// ============================================================================
// TESTING
// ============================================================================

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_rpc_request_serialization() {
        let request = RpcRequest::new("memory", "read", json!({"address": 0x1234, "size": 4}));
        let json = serde_json::to_string(&request).unwrap();
        let parsed: RpcRequest = serde_json::from_str(&json).unwrap();
        
        assert_eq!(parsed.category, "memory");
        assert_eq!(parsed.r#type, "read");
        assert_eq!(parsed.data["address"], 0x1234);
        assert_eq!(parsed.data["size"], 4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_rpc_response_serialization() {
        let response = RpcResponse::new(1, true, "", json!({"data": [1, 2, 3]}));
        let json = serde_json::to_string(&response).unwrap();
        let parsed: RpcResponse = serde_json::from_str(&json).unwrap();
        
        assert_eq!(parsed.request_id, 1);
        assert_eq!(parsed.success, true);
        assert_eq!(parsed.data["data"], [1, 2, 3]);
    }
}
```

`app/scripts/check-api.mjs`:

```mjs
// Keep the bundled AngelScript declarations aligned with Echo's live API docs.
//
//   node scripts/check-api.mjs           compare against the committed snapshot
//   node scripts/check-api.mjs --refresh fetch llms-full.txt and update it
import { build } from "esbuild";
import { readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const app = fileURLToPath(new URL("..", import.meta.url));
const indexPath = fileURLToPath(new URL("./echo-api-index.json", import.meta.url));
const docsUrl = "https://echo-23.gitbook.io/angel/llms-full.txt";

function namesFromDocs(text) {
  const names = new Set();
  const blocks = text.matchAll(/```(?:cpp|c\+\+)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g);
  for (const match of blocks) {
    for (const line of match[1].split("\n")) {
      for (const call of line.matchAll(/\b([a-z][a-z0-9_]*)::([a-z][a-z0-9_]*)\s*\(/g)) {
        // memory_buffer is a class; its methods are not namespace calls.
        if (call[1] !== "memory_buffer") names.add(`${call[1]}::${call[2]}`);
      }
    }
  }
  return [...names].sort();
}

if (process.argv.includes("--refresh")) {
  const response = await fetch(docsUrl);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`could not fetch ${docsUrl}: HTTP ${response.status}`);
  const text = await response.text();
  const current = JSON.parse(await readFile(indexPath, "utf8"));
  const next = { ...current, source: docsUrl, namespaced: namesFromDocs(text) };
  await writeFile(indexPath, `${JSON.stringify(next, null, 2)}\n`);
  console.log(`check-api: refreshed ${next.namespaced.length} namespace calls`);
}

const out = fileURLToPath(new URL("../node_modules/.cache/check-api.mjs", import.meta.url));
await build({
  entryPoints: [`${app}src/lib/angelscript/index.ts`],
  bundle: true,
  format: "esm",
  platform: "node",
  outfile: out,
  logLevel: "warning",
});
const { apiNamespaceNames, apiGlobalNames, apiConstructorNames } = await import(out);
const snapshot = JSON.parse(await readFile(indexPath, "utf8"));
const documented = new Set(snapshot.namespaced ?? []);
const declared = new Set(apiNamespaceNames());
const missing = [...documented].filter((name) => !declared.has(name));
const extra = [...declared].filter((name) => !documented.has(name));
if (missing.length || extra.length) {
  for (const name of missing) console.error(`missing API declaration: ${name}()`);
  for (const name of extra) console.error(`API declaration not in docs: ${name}()`);
  process.exit(1);
}

const documentedGlobals = new Set(snapshot.globals ?? []);
const declaredGlobals = new Set([...apiGlobalNames(), ...apiConstructorNames()]);
const missingGlobals = [...documentedGlobals].filter((name) => !declaredGlobals.has(name));
// Echo's docs show both the type-name constructors and a few create_* aliases.
const compatibilityAliases = new Set([
  "create_clip_paths",
  "create_hash_set_double", "create_hash_set_float", "create_hash_set_int32",
  "create_hash_set_int64", "create_hash_set_uint32", "create_hash_set_uint64",
]);
const extraGlobals = [...declaredGlobals].filter((name) => !documentedGlobals.has(name) && !compatibilityAliases.has(name));
if (missingGlobals.length || extraGlobals.length) {
  for (const name of missingGlobals) console.error(`missing global API declaration: ${name}()`);
  for (const name of extraGlobals) console.error(`global API declaration not in docs: ${name}()`);
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log(`check-api: ok (${declared.size} namespace calls, ${declaredGlobals.size} globals)`);
```

`app/scripts/check-as.mjs`:

```mjs
// app/scripts/check-as.mjs
// checks echo angelscript files against the echo api, default: app/echo/**/*.as
// usage: node scripts/check-as.mjs [file.as ...]
import { build } from "esbuild";
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const app = fileURLToPath(new URL("..", import.meta.url));
const out = `${app}node_modules/.cache/check-as.mjs`;
await build({ entryPoints: [`${app}src/lib/angelscript/index.ts`], bundle: true, format: "esm", platform: "node", outfile: out, logLevel: "warning" });
const { check } = await import(out);

const files = process.argv.length > 2
  ? process.argv.slice(2)
  : readdirSync(`${app}echo`, { recursive: true }).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".as")).map((f) => `${app}echo/${f}`);
let errors = 0;
for (const file of files) {
  for (const d of check(readFileSync(file, "utf8"))) {
    if (d.severity === "error") errors++;
    console.log(`${file}:${d.line + 1}:${d.column + 1}: ${d.severity}: ${d.message}`);
  }
}
console.log(`check-as: ${files.length} file(s), ${errors} error(s)`);
process.exit(errors ? 1 : 0);
```

`app/scripts/echo-relay.js`:

```js
// echo-relay.js
// Node.js WebSocket relay server for Echo Backend
// This is a pure JavaScript alternative to the Rust relay

const WebSocket = require('ws');
const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

const ECHO_BACKEND_WS_URL = 'ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ext';
const RELAY_PORT = 9001;
const HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL = 30000;
const TIMEOUT_MS = 60000;

// ============================================================================
// WEBSOCKET RELAY SERVER
// ============================================================================

class EchoRelayServer {
    constructor(port = RELAY_PORT, echoUrl = ECHO_BACKEND_WS_URL) {
        this.port = port;
        this.echoUrl = echoUrl;
        this.server = null;
        this.wss = null;
        this.echoClient = null;
        this.clients = new Map();
        this.pendingRequests = new Map();
        this.running = false;
        this.heartbeatInterval = null;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // START SERVER
    // ============================================================================

    start() {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            if (this.running) {
                return reject(new Error('Server is already running'));
            }

            // Create HTTP server
            this.server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                res.end('Echo Relay Server');
            });

            // Create WebSocket server
            this.wss = new WebSocket.Server({ server: this.server });

            this.wss.on('connection', (ws, req) => {
                this.handleClientConnection(ws, req);
            });

            this.wss.on('error', (error) => {
                console.error('[EchoRelay] WebSocket server error:', error.message);
            });

            this.server.on('error', (error) => {
                console.error('[EchoRelay] HTTP server error:', error.message);
            });

            // Start listening
            this.server.listen(this.port, '127.0.0.1', () => {
                this.running = true;
                console.log(`[EchoRelay] Server started on ws://127.0.0.1:${this.port}`);
                
                // Connect to Echo Backend
                this.connectToEchoBackend().then(() => {
                    console.log(`[EchoRelay] Connected to Echo Backend at ${this.echoUrl}`);
                    resolve();
                }).catch((error) => {
                    console.error(`[EchoRelay] Failed to connect to Echo Backend: ${error.message}`);
                    console.log('[EchoRelay] Will retry connection when first request is received');
                    resolve();
                });

                // Start heartbeat
                this.startHeartbeat();
            });
        });
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // STOP SERVER
    // ============================================================================

    stop() {
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            if (!this.running) {
                return resolve();
            }

            // Close all client connections
            for (const [id, client] of this.clients) {
                client.ws.close(1001, 'Server shutting down');
            }
            this.clients.clear();
            this.pendingRequests.clear();

            // Stop heartbeat
            if (this.heartbeatInterval) {
                clearInterval(this.heartbeatInterval);
                this.heartbeatInterval = null;
            }

            // Disconnect from Echo Backend
            this.disconnectFromEchoBackend();

            // Close WebSocket server
            if (this.wss) {
                this.wss.close(() => {
                    this.wss = null;
                });
            }

            // Close HTTP server
            if (this.server) {
                this.server.close(() => {
                    this.server = null;
                    this.running = false;
                    console.log('[EchoRelay] Server stopped');
                    resolve();
                });
            } else {
                this.running = false;
                resolve();
            }
        });
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // CONNECT TO ECHO BACKEND
    // ============================================================================

    async connectToEchoBackend() {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            try {
                console.log(`[EchoRelay] Connecting to Echo Backend at ${this.echoUrl}...`);
                
                this.echoClient = new WebSocket(this.echoUrl, {
                    handshakeTimeout: TIMEOUT_MS,
                    timeout: TIMEOUT_MS
                });

                this.echoClient.on('open', () => {
                    console.log('[EchoRelay] Echo Backend connection opened');
                    this.echoConnected = true;
                    resolve();
                });

                this.echoClient.on('message', (data) => {
                    this.handleEchoBackendMessage(data);
                });

                this.echoClient.on('close', (code, reason) => {
                    console.log(`[EchoRelay] Echo Backend connection closed: ${code} ${reason}`);
                    this.echoConnected = false;
                });

                this.echoClient.on('error', (error) => {
                    console.error('[EchoRelay] Echo Backend connection error:', error.message);
                    this.echoConnected = false;
                    reject(error);
                });

            } catch (error) {
                console.error('[EchoRelay] Failed to create Echo Backend connection:', error.message);
                reject(error);
            }
        });
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // DISCONNECT FROM ECHO BACKEND
    // ============================================================================

    disconnectFromEchoBackend() {
        if (this.echoClient) {
            try {
                this.echoClient.close(1000, 'Normal closure');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('[EchoRelay] Error closing Echo Backend connection:', error.message);
            }
            this.echoClient = null;
            this.echoConnected = false;
        }
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // HANDLE CLIENT CONNECTION
    // ============================================================================

    handleClientConnection(ws, req) {
        const clientId = this.generateClientId();
        const client = {
            id: clientId,
            ws,
            lastActivity: Date.now(),
            connectedAt: Date.now(),
            pendingRequests: new Map()
        };

        console.log(`[EchoRelay] New client connected (ID: ${clientId}, IP: ${req.socket.remoteAddress})`);
        this.clients.set(clientId, client);

        ws.on('message', (data) => {
            this.handleClientMessage(clientId, data);
        });

        ws.on('close', (code, reason) => {
            console.log(`[EchoRelay] Client disconnected (ID: ${clientId}, Code: ${code})`);
            this.clients.delete(clientId);
        });

        ws.on('error', (error) => {
            console.error(`[EchoRelay] Client error (ID: ${clientId}):`, error.message);
            this.clients.delete(clientId);
        });
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // HANDLE CLIENT MESSAGE
    // ============================================================================

    handleClientMessage(clientId, data) {
        try {
            // Update last activity
            const client = this.clients.get(clientId);
            if (client) {
                client.lastActivity = Date.now();
            }

            // Try to parse as JSON
            let message;
            if (typeof data === 'string') {
                message = JSON.parse(data);
            } else if (Buffer.isBuffer(data)) {
                message = JSON.parse(data.toString());
            } else {
                message = data;
            }

            // Handle RPC request
            if (message && message.category && message.type) {
                this.handleRpcRequest(clientId, message);
            } else {
                console.log(`[EchoRelay] Received non-RPC message from client ${clientId}:`, data);
            }

        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`[EchoRelay] Error handling message from client ${clientId}:`, error.message);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // HANDLE RPC REQUEST
    // ============================================================================

    handleRpcRequest(clientId, request) {
        console.log(`[EchoRelay] RPC Request from ${clientId}: ${request.category}.${request.type}`);

        const client = this.clients.get(clientId);
        if (!client) {
            return;
        }

        // Store pending request
        const requestId = request.request_id || Date.now();
        client.pendingRequests.set(requestId, request);

        // If not connected to Echo Backend, try to connect
        if (!this.echoConnected) {
            this.connectToEchoBackend().then(() => {
                // Retry sending
                this.sendToEchoBackend(requestId, request);
            }).catch((error) => {
                console.error(`[EchoRelay] Failed to reconnect to Echo Backend:`, error.message);
                // Send error response back to client
                this.sendToClient(clientId, {
                    request_id: requestId,
                    category: request.category,
                    type: request.type,
                    success: false,
                    error: 'Echo Backend not connected',
                    timestamp: Date.now()
                });
                client.pendingRequests.delete(requestId);
            });
            return;
        }

        // Send to Echo Backend
        this.sendToEchoBackend(requestId, request);
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // SEND TO ECHO BACKEND
    // ============================================================================

    sendToEchoBackend(requestId, request) {
        if (!this.echoClient || this.echoClient.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
            console.error('[EchoRelay] Echo Backend not connected');
            return;
        }

        try {
            // Convert to Echo Backend format
            const echoRequest = {
                method: `${request.category}.${request.type}`,
                params: request.data || {},
                id: requestId,
                timestamp: Date.now()
            };

            this.pendingRequests.set(requestId, { clientId: null, request });
            this.echoClient.send(JSON.stringify(echoRequest));
            console.log(`[EchoRelay] Sent to Echo Backend: ${echoRequest.method}`);

        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[EchoRelay] Failed to send to Echo Backend:', error.message);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // HANDLE ECHO BACKEND MESSAGE
    // ============================================================================

    handleEchoBackendMessage(data) {
        try {
            let message;
            if (typeof data === 'string') {
                message = JSON.parse(data);
            } else if (Buffer.isBuffer(data)) {
                message = JSON.parse(data.toString());
            } else {
                message = data;
            }

            console.log('[EchoRelay] Received from Echo Backend:', JSON.stringify(message).substring(0, 200));

            // Handle as RPC response
            if (message && message.id) {
                const requestId = message.id;
                const pending = this.pendingRequests.get(requestId);
                
                if (pending) {
                    this.pendingRequests.delete(requestId);
                    
                    // Convert to RPC response format
                    const response = {
                        request_id: requestId,
                        category: pending.request.category,
                        type: pending.request.type,
                        success: !message.error,
                        error: message.error || '',
                        data: message.result || message.data || {},
                        timestamp: Date.now()
                    };

                    // Forward to all clients that sent this request
                    for (const [clientId, client] of this.clients) {
                        if (client.pendingRequests.has(requestId)) {
                            this.sendToClient(clientId, response);
                            client.pendingRequests.delete(requestId);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[EchoRelay] Error handling Echo Backend message:', error.message);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // SEND TO CLIENT
    // ============================================================================

    sendToClient(clientId, message) {
        const client = this.clients.get(clientId);
        if (client && client.ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
            try {
                client.ws.send(JSON.stringify(message));
                console.log(`[EchoRelay] Sent to client ${clientId}: ${message.category || 'unknown'}.${message.type || 'unknown'}`);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[EchoRelay] Failed to send to client ${clientId}:`, error.message);
            }
        }
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // BROADCAST TO ALL CLIENTS
    // ============================================================================

    broadcast(message) {
        for (const [clientId, client] of this.clients) {
            this.sendToClient(clientId, message);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // HEARTBEAT
    // ============================================================================

    startHeartbeat() {
        this.heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => {
            // Check for stale connections
            const now = Date.now();
            for (const [clientId, client] of this.clients) {
                if (now - client.lastActivity > TIMEOUT_MS) {
                    console.log(`[EchoRelay] Client timeout (ID: ${clientId})`);
                    client.ws.close(1008, 'Connection timeout');
                    this.clients.delete(clientId);
                }
            }

            // Send ping to Echo Backend if connected
            if (this.echoConnected && this.echoClient.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                this.echoClient.send(JSON.stringify({
                    method: 'system.ping',
                    params: {},
                    id: Date.now(),
                    timestamp: Date.now()
                }));
            }

            // Reconnect to Echo Backend if disconnected
            if (!this.echoConnected) {
                this.connectToEchoBackend().catch(console.error);
            }

        }, HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL);
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // UTILITY FUNCTIONS
    // ============================================================================

    generateClientId() {
        return 'client_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
    }

    getClientCount() {
        return this.clients.size;
    }

    isRunning() {
        return this.running;
    }

    isEchoConnected() {
        return this.echoConnected || false;
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN
// ============================================================================

function main() {
    const args = process.argv.slice(2);
    
    let port = RELAY_PORT;
    let echoUrl = ECHO_BACKEND_WS_URL;

    if (args[0]) {
        port = parseInt(args[0]) || RELAY_PORT;
    }
    if (args[1]) {
        echoUrl = args[1];
    }

    console.log('Echo Backend Relay Server (Node.js)');
    console.log('==================================');
    console.log(`Relay port: ${port}`);
    console.log(`Echo Backend URL: ${echoUrl}`);
    console.log();

    const server = new EchoRelayServer(port, echoUrl);

    // Handle signals
    process.on('SIGINT', async () => {
        console.log('\n[EchoRelay] Received SIGINT, shutting down...');
        await server.stop();
        process.exit(0);
    });

    process.on('SIGTERM', async () => {
        console.log('\n[EchoRelay] Received SIGTERM, shutting down...');
        await server.stop();
        process.exit(0);
    });

    // Start server
    server.start().then(() => {
        console.log('[EchoRelay] Ready!');
    }).catch((error) => {
        console.error('[EchoRelay] Failed to start:', error.message);
        process.exit(1);
    });
}

// ============================================================================
// EXPORTS
// ============================================================================

if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = { EchoRelayServer };
}

// Run if this is the main module
if (require.main === module) {
    main();
}
```

`app/scripts/gen-icons.mjs`:

```mjs
// app/scripts/gen-icons.mjs
//
// Generates the bundle icons from the brand source image at
// src/assets/reverse-slop-icon.png. Tauri needs a set of PNGs plus an ICO at
// build time; `tauri icon` requires the tauri CLI to fetch its own tooling, so
// the resampling happens here: the source is decoded, area-averaged down to
// each target size, and re-encoded, all with node:zlib, no image library
//
// Run with: npm run icons

import { deflateSync, inflateSync } from "node:zlib";
import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const scriptDir = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const sourcePath = join(scriptDir, "..", "src", "assets", "reverse-slop-icon.png");
const outDir = join(scriptDir, "..", "src-tauri", "icons");
mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });

const kSig = Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]);

const crcTable = (() => {
  const t = new Int32Array(256);
  for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
    let c = n;
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1;
    t[n] = c;
  }
  return t;
})();

function crc32(buf) {
  let c = 0xffffffff;
  for (const b of buf) c = crcTable[(c ^ b) & 0xff] ^ (c >>> 8);
  return (c ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
}

function chunk(type, data) {
  const len = Buffer.alloc(4);
  len.writeUInt32BE(data.length);
  const body = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(type, "ascii"), data]);
  const crc = Buffer.alloc(4);
  crc.writeUInt32BE(crc32(body));
  return Buffer.concat([len, body, crc]);
}

// decoding

/** Decode an 8-bit non-interlaced PNG (colour types 2 RGB and 6 RGBA) to RGBA. */
function decodePng(buf) {
  if (!buf.subarray(0, 8).equals(kSig)) throw new Error("source is not a PNG");

  let width = 0;
  let height = 0;
  let bitDepth = 0;
  let colorType = 0;
  let interlace = 0;
  const idat = [];

  let off = 8;
  while (off < buf.length) {
    const len = buf.readUInt32BE(off);
    const type = buf.toString("ascii", off + 4, off + 8);
    const data = buf.subarray(off + 8, off + 8 + len);
    if (type === "IHDR") {
      width = data.readUInt32BE(0);
      height = data.readUInt32BE(4);
      bitDepth = data[8];
      colorType = data[9];
      interlace = data[12];
    } else if (type === "IDAT") {
      idat.push(data);
    } else if (type === "IEND") {
      break;
    }
    off += 12 + len;
  }

  if (bitDepth !== 8) throw new Error(`unsupported bit depth ${bitDepth} (need 8)`);
  if (interlace !== 0) throw new Error("interlaced PNGs are not supported");
  const channels = colorType === 2 ? 3 : colorType === 6 ? 4 : 0;
  if (!channels) throw new Error(`unsupported colour type ${colorType} (need RGB/RGBA)`);

  const raw = inflateSync(Buffer.concat(idat));
  const stride = width * channels;
  const out = Buffer.alloc(width * height * 4);
  const row = Buffer.alloc(stride);
  const prev = Buffer.alloc(stride);

  const paeth = (a, b, c) => {
    const p = a + b - c;
    const pa = Math.abs(p - a);
    const pb = Math.abs(p - b);
    const pc = Math.abs(p - c);
    return pa <= pb && pa <= pc ? a : pb <= pc ? b : c;
  };

  for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
    const filter = raw[y * (stride + 1)];
    raw.copy(row, 0, y * (stride + 1) + 1, (y + 1) * (stride + 1));
    for (let i = 0; i < stride; i++) {
      const left = i >= channels ? row[i - channels] : 0;
      const up = prev[i];
      const upLeft = i >= channels ? prev[i - channels] : 0;
      if (filter === 1) row[i] = (row[i] + left) & 0xff;
      else if (filter === 2) row[i] = (row[i] + up) & 0xff;
      else if (filter === 3) row[i] = (row[i] + ((left + up) >> 1)) & 0xff;
      else if (filter === 4) row[i] = (row[i] + paeth(left, up, upLeft)) & 0xff;
    }
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const s = x * channels;
      const d = (y * width + x) * 4;
      out[d] = row[s];
      out[d + 1] = row[s + 1];
      out[d + 2] = row[s + 2];
      out[d + 3] = channels === 4 ? row[s + 3] : 255;
    }
    row.copy(prev);
  }
  return { width, height, rgba: out };
}

// resampling

/** Area-average downscale: each destination pixel averages the source pixels
 *  it covers, with fractional weights at the box edges. */
function resample(src, sw, sh, dw, dh) {
  const dst = Buffer.alloc(dw * dh * 4);
  const sx = sw / dw;
  const sy = sh / dh;
  for (let dy = 0; dy < dh; dy++) {
    const y0 = dy * sy;
    const y1 = y0 + sy;
    for (let dx = 0; dx < dw; dx++) {
      const x0 = dx * sx;
      const x1 = x0 + sx;
      let r = 0;
      let g = 0;
      let b = 0;
      let a = 0;
      let wsum = 0;
      for (let yy = Math.floor(y0); yy < Math.min(Math.ceil(y1), sh); yy++) {
        const wy = Math.min(y1, yy + 1) - Math.max(y0, yy);
        if (wy <= 0) continue;
        for (let xx = Math.floor(x0); xx < Math.min(Math.ceil(x1), sw); xx++) {
          const wx = Math.min(x1, xx + 1) - Math.max(x0, xx);
          if (wx <= 0) continue;
          const w = wx * wy;
          const i = (yy * sw + xx) * 4;
          r += src[i] * w;
          g += src[i + 1] * w;
          b += src[i + 2] * w;
          a += src[i + 3] * w;
          wsum += w;
        }
      }
      const d = (dy * dw + dx) * 4;
      dst[d] = Math.round(r / wsum);
      dst[d + 1] = Math.round(g / wsum);
      dst[d + 2] = Math.round(b / wsum);
      dst[d + 3] = Math.round(a / wsum);
    }
  }
  return dst;
}

// encoding

function png(size, px) {
  const stride = size * 4;
  const filtered = Buffer.alloc((stride + 1) * size);
  for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
    filtered[y * (stride + 1)] = 0; // filter type: none
    px.copy(filtered, y * (stride + 1) + 1, y * stride, (y + 1) * stride);
  }
  const ihdr = Buffer.alloc(13);
  ihdr.writeUInt32BE(size, 0);
  ihdr.writeUInt32BE(size, 4);
  ihdr[8] = 8; // bit depth
  ihdr[9] = 6; // colour type: RGBA
  return Buffer.concat([
    kSig,
    chunk("IHDR", ihdr),
    chunk("IDAT", deflateSync(filtered, { level: 9 })),
    chunk("IEND", Buffer.alloc(0)),
  ]);
}

function ico(frames) {
  const header = Buffer.alloc(6);
  header.writeUInt16LE(1, 2);
  header.writeUInt16LE(frames.length, 4);

  let offset = 6 + 16 * frames.length;
  const entries = frames.map(({ size, data }) => {
    const e = Buffer.alloc(16);
    e[0] = size >= 256 ? 0 : size; // 0 encodes 256
    e[1] = size >= 256 ? 0 : size;
    e.writeUInt16LE(1, 4); // planes
    e.writeUInt16LE(32, 6); // bit count
    e.writeUInt32LE(data.length, 8);
    e.writeUInt32LE(offset, 12);
    offset += data.length;
    return e;
  });
  return Buffer.concat([header, ...entries, ...frames.map((f) => f.data)]);
}

// generate

const source = decodePng(readFileSync(sourcePath));
console.log(`source: ${source.width}x${source.height} ${sourcePath}`);

const sizes = [32, 128, 256, 512];
const rendered = new Map(sizes.map((s) => [s, resample(source.rgba, source.width, source.height, s, s)]));
for (const s of [16, 48, 64]) rendered.set(s, resample(source.rgba, source.width, source.height, s, s));

const written = [];
for (const size of sizes) {
  const name = size === 512 ? "icon.png" : `${size}x${size}.png`;
  writeFileSync(join(outDir, name), png(size, rendered.get(size)));
  written.push(name);
}
writeFileSync(join(outDir, "128x128@2x.png"), png(256, rendered.get(256)));
written.push("128x128@2x.png");
writeFileSync(
  join(outDir, "icon.ico"),
  ico([16, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256].map((s) => ({ size: s, data: png(s, rendered.get(s)) }))),
);
written.push("icon.ico");

console.log(`wrote ${written.length} icons to src-tauri/icons: ${written.join(", ")}`);

```

`app/scripts/generate-menu-registry.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// generate-registry.mjs — auto-detect an Angel script's menu controls and emit the
// AI Menu Control registry for them. Names each control by its m_<var> variable (stable,
// meaningful), reads type / range / combo options / default straight from the ui::add_* call,
// and tracks the surrounding ui::add_tab / ui::add_category so the registry mirrors the overlay's
// own menu organization (tabs and categories).
//
// Usage:
//   node generate-registry.mjs <script.as>            # print the amc_build_registry() function
//   node generate-registry.mjs <script.as> --list     # just list detected controls (grouped)
//   node generate-registry.mjs <script.as> --json     # emit a JSON array of controls (for the mock / a web UI)
//   node generate-registry.mjs <script.as> --danger aim,chams,nosway   # extra danger names
//
// The default output is a paste-in AngelScript function. Pair it with the lane core
// (angel-menu-control.as). Re-run whenever the target's menu changes.

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const file = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
if (!file) {
  console.error("usage: node generate-registry.mjs <script.as> [--list] [--json] [--danger a,b,c]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const listOnly = args.includes("--list");
const jsonOnly = args.includes("--json");
// Emit only the writable kinds (check/slider/combo) — drop multi_select/color_picker. Use for a
// host whose lane has no multi/color set path (e.g. huntshowdown's uireg_* registry, which has no
// uireg_multi/uireg_color helpers and would fail to compile if they were emitted).
const writableOnly = args.includes("--writable-only");
const dIdx = args.indexOf("--danger");
const extraDanger = dIdx >= 0 && args[dIdx + 1] ? args[dIdx + 1].split(",").map((s) => s.trim()) : [];

const src = readFileSync(file, "utf8");

// Skip internal/plumbing variables and pure-position sliders — not "features".
const SKIP_PREFIX = ["m_pv_", "m_btn_", "m_pos_"];
// A control writes game memory if its name matches these — flags it danger (ui_set needs ARM).
const DANGER_RE = /(^|_)(aim|cham|chams|nosway|norecoil|nospread|force_bone|team_chams|team_cham)($|_)|^cv_/i;

const nameOf = (v) => v.replace(/^m_/, "");
const isSkipped = (v) => SKIP_PREFIX.some((p) => v.startsWith(p));
const isDanger = (v) => {
  const n = nameOf(v);
  return DANGER_RE.test(n) || extraDanger.includes(n);
};

// Split a top-level argument list (respects (), {}, "" nesting) into raw arg strings.
function splitArgs(s) {
  const out = [];
  let depth = 0, inStr = false, cur = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    const c = s[i];
    if (inStr) { cur += c; if (c === '"' && s[i - 1] !== "\\") inStr = false; continue; }
    if (c === '"') { inStr = true; cur += c; continue; }
    if (c === "(" || c === "{" || c === "[") depth++;
    if (c === ")" || c === "}" || c === "]") depth--;
    if (c === "," && depth === 0) { out.push(cur.trim()); cur = ""; continue; }
    cur += c;
  }
  if (cur.trim() !== "") out.push(cur.trim());
  return out;
}

// Grab the balanced (...) starting at index `open` ('('); returns {inner, end}.
function balanced(text, open) {
  let depth = 0, inStr = false;
  for (let i = open; i < text.length; i++) {
    const c = text[i];
    if (inStr) { if (c === '"' && text[i - 1] !== "\\") inStr = false; continue; }
    if (c === '"') { inStr = true; continue; }
    if (c === "(") depth++;
    else if (c === ")") { depth--; if (depth === 0) return { inner: text.slice(open + 1, i), end: i }; }
  }
  return null;
}

// Parse a brace list {"a","b",...} into label strings; null if it's not a literal list.
function parseOptionLabels(argRaw) {
  const m = argRaw.match(/\{([\s\S]*)\}/);
  if (!m) return null; // e.g. a variable like g_trait_filter_names — options unknown
  const labels = [];
  const re = /"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"/g;
  let mm;
  while ((mm = re.exec(m[1]))) labels.push(mm[1].replace(/\\"/g, '"'));
  return labels;
}

// First string literal inside a raw arg list (used for tab/category names).
function firstStringLiteral(inner) {
  const m = inner.match(/"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"/);
  return m ? m[1].replace(/\\"/g, '"') : "";
}
const parseBoolDefault = (raw) => (raw === undefined ? undefined : /^\s*true\s*$/i.test(raw) ? true : /^\s*false\s*$/i.test(raw) ? false : undefined);
const parseIntDefault = (raw) => {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined;
  const m = raw.match(/-?\d+/);
  return m ? parseInt(m[0], 10) : undefined;
};

// One combined scan in source order over: ui::add_tab, ui::add_category, and the five control
// kinds. Tracking the running tab/category as we go stamps each control with its menu location.
const controls = [];
let curTab = "", curSub = "", curCat = "";
const scanRe = /\bui::add_tab\s*\(|\bui::add_subtab\s*\(|\bui::add_category\s*\(|\bm_([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*=\s*ui::add_(checkbox|slider|combobox|multi_select|color_picker)\s*\(/g;
let m;
while ((m = scanRe.exec(src))) {
  const openParen = scanRe.lastIndex - 1;
  const bal = balanced(src, openParen);
  if (!bal) continue;
  const matched = m[0];

  if (matched.startsWith("ui::add_tab")) {
    curTab = firstStringLiteral(bal.inner);
    curSub = ""; curCat = ""; // a new tab resets subtab + category context
    scanRe.lastIndex = bal.end + 1;
    continue;
  }
  if (matched.startsWith("ui::add_subtab")) {
    curSub = firstStringLiteral(bal.inner);
    curCat = ""; // a new subtab resets the category context
    scanRe.lastIndex = bal.end + 1;
    continue;
  }
  if (matched.startsWith("ui::add_category")) {
    curCat = firstStringLiteral(bal.inner);
    scanRe.lastIndex = bal.end + 1;
    continue;
  }

  const vvar = "m_" + m[1];
  const type = m[2];
  scanRe.lastIndex = bal.end + 1;
  if (isSkipped(vvar)) continue;
  const a = splitArgs(bal.inner);
  const name = nameOf(vvar);
  const label = firstStringLiteral(bal.inner) || name; // human menu label (the ui::add_* first arg)
  const danger = isDanger(vvar);
  const tab = curTab, subtab = curSub, category = curCat;

  if (type === "checkbox") {
    controls.push({ kind: "check", name, label, vvar, danger, tab, subtab, category, def: parseBoolDefault(a[1]) });
  } else if (type === "slider") {
    // ui::add_slider(label, def, min, max, step[, "unit"[, "key"]])
    controls.push({ kind: "slider", name, label, vvar, danger, tab, subtab, category, mn: a[2], mx: a[3], st: a[4], def: parseIntDefault(a[1]) });
  } else if (type === "combobox") {
    // ui::add_combobox(label, {opts}, default[, "key"])
    controls.push({ kind: "combo", name, label, vvar, danger, tab, subtab, category, opts: parseOptionLabels(a[1]), def: parseIntDefault(a[2]) });
  } else if (type === "multi_select") {
    controls.push({ kind: "multi", name, label, vvar, danger, tab, subtab, category, opts: parseOptionLabels(a[1]) });
  } else if (type === "color_picker") {
    controls.push({ kind: "color", name, label, vvar, danger, tab, subtab, category });
  }
}

// de-dup by name (first wins) — a well-formed menu shouldn't collide, but guard anyway
const seen = new Set();
let uniq = controls.filter((c) => (seen.has(c.name) ? false : (seen.add(c.name), true)));
if (writableOnly) uniq = uniq.filter((c) => c.kind === "check" || c.kind === "slider" || c.kind === "combo");

if (jsonOnly) {
  // Static default value where known; the runtime overwrites with the live value on ui_list.
  const defVal = (c) => {
    if (c.kind === "check") return c.def ?? false;
    if (c.kind === "slider") return c.def ?? (parseIntDefault(c.mn) ?? 0);
    if (c.kind === "combo") return c.def ?? 0;
    return c.kind === "color" ? "255,255,255,255" : 0;
  };
  // The web Menu Control lane only handles the writable kinds; multi/color are standalone-only
  // (read-only) and would fail the frontend's uiControl schema. Emit just check/slider/combo.
  const out = uniq
    .filter((c) => c.kind === "check" || c.kind === "slider" || c.kind === "combo")
    .map((c) => {
      const o = { name: c.name, label: c.label, kind: c.kind, value: defVal(c), danger: c.danger, writable: true, tab: c.tab, subtab: c.subtab, category: c.category };
      if (c.kind === "slider") { o.min = parseIntDefault(c.mn) ?? 0; o.max = parseIntDefault(c.mx) ?? 100; o.step = parseIntDefault(c.st) ?? 1; }
      if (c.kind === "combo") o.options = c.opts ?? [];
      return o;
    });
  console.log(JSON.stringify(out, null, 2));
  console.error(`\n[generate-registry] ${out.length} controls emitted from ${file}`);
  process.exit(0);
}

if (listOnly) {
  let lastTab = null, lastSub = null, lastCat = null;
  for (const c of uniq) {
    if (c.tab !== lastTab) { console.log(`\n== ${c.tab || "(no tab)"} ==`); lastTab = c.tab; lastSub = null; lastCat = null; }
    if (c.subtab !== lastSub) { console.log(`  > ${c.subtab || "(no subtab)"}`); lastSub = c.subtab; lastCat = null; }
    if (c.category !== lastCat) { console.log(`    [${c.category || "(no category)"}]`); lastCat = c.category; }
    let extra = "";
    if (c.kind === "slider") extra = ` [${c.mn}..${c.mx} step ${c.st}]`;
    else if (c.kind === "combo" || c.kind === "multi") extra = c.opts ? ` {${c.opts.join("|")}}` : " {opts: dynamic}";
    console.log(`      ${c.kind.padEnd(7)} ${c.name}${c.danger ? "  (danger)" : ""}${extra}`);
  }
  const byKind = uniq.reduce((o, c) => ((o[c.kind] = (o[c.kind] || 0) + 1), o), {});
  console.error(`\n${uniq.length} controls: ${JSON.stringify(byKind)}  danger: ${uniq.filter((c) => c.danger).length}`);
  process.exit(0);
}

// emit amc_build_registry() — interleave amc_tab()/amc_category() so the registry reads like the menu
const L = [];
L.push("// AUTO-GENERATED by generate-registry.mjs from " + file);
L.push("// Names come from the m_<var> globals; grouped by the overlay's own tabs/categories.");
L.push("// Re-run when the menu changes. Pair with angel-menu-control.as.");
L.push("void amc_build_registry()");
L.push("{");
const dstr = (c) => (c.danger ? ", true" : "");
const q = (s) => JSON.stringify(s ?? "");                 // safely-quoted AngelScript string literal
let lastTab = null, lastSub = null, lastCat = null;
for (const c of uniq) {
  if (c.tab !== lastTab) { L.push(`    amc_tab(${q(c.tab)});`); lastTab = c.tab; lastSub = null; lastCat = null; }
  if (c.subtab !== lastSub) { L.push(`    amc_subtab(${q(c.subtab)});`); lastSub = c.subtab; lastCat = null; }
  if (c.category !== lastCat) { L.push(`    amc_category(${q(c.category)});`); lastCat = c.category; }
  if (c.kind === "check") L.push(`    amc_check("${c.name}", ${c.vvar}, ${q(c.label)}${dstr(c)});`);
  else if (c.kind === "slider") L.push(`    amc_slider("${c.name}", ${c.vvar}, ${c.mn}, ${c.mx}, ${c.st}, ${q(c.label)}${dstr(c)});`);
  else if (c.kind === "combo") L.push(`    amc_combo("${c.name}", ${c.vvar}, "${(c.opts || []).join(",")}", ${q(c.label)}${dstr(c)});`);
  else if (c.kind === "multi") L.push(`    amc_multi("${c.name}", ${c.vvar}, "${(c.opts || []).join(",")}", ${q(c.label)}${dstr(c)});   // read-only`);
  else if (c.kind === "color") L.push(`    amc_color("${c.name}", ${c.vvar}, ${q(c.label)}${dstr(c)});   // read-only`);
}
L.push("}");
console.log(L.join("\n"));
console.error(`\n[generate-registry] ${uniq.length} controls emitted from ${file}`);
```

`app/scripts/test-deobf.mjs`:

```mjs
// app/scripts/test-deobf.mjs
// drives the deobfuscation triage helpers and the overlay generator without a
// live target: entropy, the Valorant 7-state GObjects cipher (checked against a
// reference port of Dumper-7-VGK's Decryption.cpp), the offset export formats
// and the generated ESP script (which must also pass the AngelScript checker)
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { build } from "esbuild";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

globalThis.localStorage = { getItem: () => "http://127.0.0.1:19003/rpc", setItem() {} };

const app = fileURLToPath(new URL("..", import.meta.url));
const out = fileURLToPath(new URL("../node_modules/.cache/test-deobf.mjs", import.meta.url));
await build({
  stdin: {
    contents: 'export * from "./src/lib/deobf.ts"; export * from "./src/lib/overlay.ts"; export { decryptValorantGObjects } from "./src/lib/unreal.ts"; export { check } from "./src/lib/angelscript/index.ts";',
    resolveDir: app,
    loader: "ts",
  },
  bundle: true,
  plugins: [{ name: "raw", setup(b) {
    b.onResolve({ filter: /\?raw$/ }, (a) => ({ path: fileURLToPath(new URL(a.path.replace(/\?raw$/, ""), `file://${a.resolveDir}/`)), namespace: "raw" }));
    b.onLoad({ filter: /.*/, namespace: "raw" }, (a) => ({ contents: readFileSync(a.path, "utf8"), loader: "text" }));
  } }],
  format: "esm",
  platform: "node",
  outfile: out,
  logLevel: "warning",
});
const { entropy, buildOffsets, functionManifest, importFunctionNames, parseAddress, decryptValorantGObjects, buildOverlayScript, defaultOverlayConfig, parseRva, formatRva, check } = await import(out);

// ── entropy ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{
  const flat = new Uint8Array(4096);
  assert.equal(entropy(flat), 0, "all-zero bytes carry no entropy");
  const all = new Uint8Array(256).map((_, i) => i);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(entropy(all) - 8) < 1e-9, "one of each byte is 8 bits/byte");
  const nibbles = new Uint8Array(4096).map((_, i) => i & 0xf);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(entropy(nibbles) - 4) < 1e-9, "16 equally likely symbols is 4 bits/byte");
  assert.equal(entropy(new Uint8Array(0)), 0, "empty input is 0, not NaN");
}

// ── Valorant GObjects cipher ────────────────────────────────────────────────
// independent reference port of Dumper-7-VGK Dumper/Engine/Private/Valorant/Decryption.cpp

const MASK = 0xffffffffffffffffn;
const MAGIC = 0x2545f4914f6cdd1dn;
const rol = (v, n) => { n &= 63; v &= MASK; return n === 0 ? v : ((v << BigInt(n)) | (v >> BigInt(64 - n))) & MASK; };
const ror = (v, n) => { n &= 63; v &= MASK; return n === 0 ? v : ((v >> BigInt(n)) | (v << BigInt(64 - n))) & MASK; };
const stage1 = (v) => (v >> 1n) ^ (((v >> 1n) ^ (v << 1n)) & 0xaaaa_aaaa_aaaa_aaaAn);
const stage2 = (v) => (v >> 2n) ^ (((v >> 2n) ^ (v << 2n)) & 0xcccc_cccc_cccc_ccccn);
const stage3 = (v) => (v >> 4n) ^ (((v >> 4n) ^ (v << 4n)) & 0xf0f0_f0f0_f0f0_f0f0n);
const stage4 = (v) => (v >> 8n) ^ (((v >> 8n) ^ (v << 8n)) & 0xff00_ff00_ff00_ff00n);
const bitrev = (v) => ror(stage4(stage3(stage2(stage1(v)))), 32);

function selector(key) {
  const k = BigInt(key >>> 0);
  const mix = (k ^ ((k ^ (k >> 15n)) >> 12n) ^ (k << 25n)) & 0xffffffffn;
  const hash = (MAGIC * mix) & MASK;
  return { idx: Number(hash % 7n), hi: Number(hash >> 32n) >>> 0 };
}

function referenceDecrypt(key, state) {
  const { idx, hi } = selector(key);
  let v = state[idx] & MASK;
  switch (idx) {
    case 0: v = v ^ BigInt(hi); break;
    case 1: v = BigInt((hi + idx) >>> 0) + rol(v, ((hi + 2 * idx) % 63) + 1); break;
    case 2: v = (~v & MASK) - BigInt((hi + idx) >>> 0); break;
    case 3: v = ror(bitrev(v), ((hi + idx) % 63) + 1); break;
    case 4: v = v + BigInt((hi + 2 * idx) >>> 0) + BigInt((hi + idx) >>> 0); break;
    case 5: v = rol(stage1(v), ((hi + idx) % 63) + 1); break;
    case 6: v = ror((BigInt((hi + 2 * idx) >>> 0) + v) & MASK, ((hi + idx) % 63) + 1); break;
  }
  return (v ^ BigInt(key >>> 0)) & MASK;
}

/** Build a state that decrypts to `ptr`, so every case can be exercised. */
function stateFor(ptr, key) {
  const { idx, hi } = selector(key);
  const v = (BigInt(ptr) ^ BigInt(key >>> 0)) & MASK;
  const a1 = ((hi + idx) % 63) + 1;
  const a2 = ((hi + 2 * idx) % 63) + 1;
  const state = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => 0n);
  switch (idx) {
    case 0: state[idx] = v ^ BigInt(hi); break;
    case 1: state[idx] = ror((v - BigInt((hi + idx) >>> 0)) & MASK, a2); break;
    case 2: state[idx] = ~((v + BigInt((hi + idx) >>> 0)) & MASK) & MASK; break;
    case 3: state[idx] = bitrev(rol(v, a1)); break;
    case 4: state[idx] = (v - BigInt((hi + 2 * idx) >>> 0) - BigInt((hi + idx) >>> 0)) & MASK; break;
    case 5: state[idx] = stage1(ror(v, a1)); break;
    case 6: state[idx] = (rol(v, a1) - BigInt((hi + 2 * idx) >>> 0)) & MASK; break;
  }
  return state;
}

{
  // deterministic "random" states; cover every selector case at least once
  let seed = 0x12345678;
  const next = () => { seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return seed; };
  const seen = new Set();
  for (let i = 0; i < 512; i++) {
    const key = next() || 1;
    const state = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => {
      let v = 0n;
      for (let w = 0; w < 4; w++) v = (v << 16n) | BigInt(next() & 0xffff);
      return v;
    });
    seen.add(selector(key).idx);
    assert.equal(decryptValorantGObjects(key, state), referenceDecrypt(key, state), `key 0x${key.toString(16)}`);
  }
  assert.equal(seen.size, 7, `all 7 cipher cases were exercised (got ${[...seen].sort().join(",")})`);

  // every case is invertible: the encoded state decrypts back to the pointer
  for (let key = 1; key < 4096; key++) {
    const { idx } = selector(key);
    if (stateFor(0x140010000 + idx * 8, key)[idx] === 0n) continue;
    const state = stateFor(0x140010000 + idx * 8, key);
    assert.equal(decryptValorantGObjects(key, state), BigInt(0x140010000 + idx * 8), `case ${idx} key ${key}`);
  }
}

// ── offset exports ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const report = {
  module: "Game-Win64-Shipping.exe",
  base: 0x140000000,
  entry: 0x140001000,
  imageSize: 0x2000000,
  pe32plus: true,
  imports: 3,

};
const fns = [

  const importManifest = functionManifest(report, fns, "d.exe");

  const rebased = { ...report, base: report.base + 0x100000 };
  const movedFns = fns.map(f => ({ ...f, va: f.va + 0x100000 }));

  assert.throws(() => importFunctionNames(importManifest, { ...report, module: "other.exe" }, fns), /differs/);
  const bad = JSON.parse(importManifest); bad.functions[0].rva = -1;
  assert.throws(() => importFunctionNames(JSON.stringify(bad), report, fns), /invalid/);

{
  assert.equal(parseAddress("0x10"), 16);
  assert.equal(parseAddress(" 16 "), 16);
  assert.throws(() => parseAddress("nope"));

// ── overlay generator ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

{
  const template = readFileSync(`${app}echo/echo-reverse-overlay.as`, "utf8");
  assert.equal(buildOverlayScript(defaultOverlayConfig), template, "defaults round-trip through the template");

  assert.equal(parseRva("0x1f"), 31);
  assert.equal(parseRva("1F"), 31);
  assert.equal(parseRva(""), 0);
  assert.equal(parseRva("0xZZ"), 0);

  assert.equal(formatRva(0x1f), "0x1F");

  assert.match(script, /const bool UNITY_COORDS = true;/);
  assert.match(script, /const float BOX_WIDTH = 30\.0f;/);
  assert.match(script, /const float BOX_HEIGHT = 80\.0f;/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(script, /YourGame\.exe/, "the panel's module replaces the placeholder");

  const quoted = buildOverlayScript({ ...cfg, process: 'we"ird\\game.exe' });
  assert.match(quoted, /const string PROCESS_NAME = "we\\"ird\\\\game\.exe";/);

  assert.deepEqual(check(script).filter((d) => d.severity === "error"), [], "generated ESP script passes the Echo API check");
  assert.deepEqual(check(buildOverlayScript(defaultOverlayConfig)).filter((d) => d.severity === "error"), []);
```

```mjs
    const o = BigInt(a) - base;
    if (o >= 0n && o + BigInt(n) <= BigInt(buf.length)) return buf.subarray(Number(o), Number(o) + n).toString("hex");
  }

const reply = (m) => {
  switch (m.type) {
    case "ping": return { attached: true, pid: targetPid, base: "0x140000000" };
    case "modules": return { success: true, modules: [{ name: "kernel32.dll", base: "0x7ff800000000", size: 0x2000 }, { name: "game.exe", base: "0x140000000", size: 0x4000 }] };
    case "read_batch": return { success: true, results: m.reads.map((r) => { const d = read(r.address, r.size); return { success: !!d, address: r.address, data: d ?? "" }; }) };
    case "read": { const d = read(m.address, m.size); return { success: !!d, data: d ?? "" }; }
    case "enumerate_functions": assert.equal(m.module, "game.exe"); return { success: true, results: [{ address: "0x140001000", size: 16, method: 0 }] };
    case "disassemble": if (m.address === "0x140001310") return { success: true, results: [{ address: "0x140001310", length: 7, bytes: "488d05e9fdffff", text: "lea rax, [rip-0x217]" }] };
      if (m.address === "0x140001100") return { success: true, results: [

      { address: "0x14000110c", length: 1, bytes: "c3", text: "ret" }] };
      return { success: true, results: [{ address: "0x140001000", length: 5, bytes: "e800000000", text: "call 0x140001010" }, { address: "0x140001005", length: 2, text: "jne 0x140001000" }, { address: "0x140001007", length: 1, text: "ret" }] };
```

```mjs
// drives lib/il2cpp.ts and lib/source2.ts against a fake Echo relay serving a
// synthetic process: GameAssembly.dll pointing at a v29 global-metadata, and a
// Source 2 client.dll with a CreateInterface registry and static schema classes

import { build } from "esbuild";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

globalThis.localStorage = { getItem: () => "http://127.0.0.1:19002/rpc", setItem() {} };

const pages = new Map();
const page = (a) => { const p = Math.floor(a / 0x1000); if (!pages.has(p)) pages.set(p, Buffer.alloc(0x1000)); return pages.get(p); };
const put = (a, buf) => { for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) page(a + i)[(a + i) % 0x1000] = buf[i]; };
const u16 = (a, v) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(2); b.writeUInt16LE(v); put(a, b); };
const u32 = (a, v) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(4); b.writeInt32LE(v | 0); put(a, b); };
const u64 = (a, v) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(8); b.writeBigUInt64LE(BigInt(v)); put(a, b); };
const cstr = (a, s) => put(a, Buffer.from(s + "\0", "latin1"));

/** a PE64 with the given sections (rva, size, flags) and named exports */
function pe(base, size, sections, exports = []) {
  put(base, Buffer.from("MZ")); u32(base + 0x3c, 0x80); put(base + 0x80, Buffer.from("PE\0\0", "latin1"));
  u16(base + 0x86, sections.length); u16(base + 0x94, 0xf0);
  const opt = base + 0x98; u16(opt, 0x20b); u32(opt + 56, size);
  sections.forEach(([name, rva, vs, ch], i) => { const s = opt + 0xf0 + i * 40; put(s, Buffer.from(name)); u32(s + 8, vs); u32(s + 12, rva); u32(s + 16, vs); u32(s + 36, ch); });
  if (exports.length) {
    const ed = base + 0x800; u32(opt + 112, 0x800); u32(opt + 116, 0x400);
    u32(ed + 0x18, exports.length); u32(ed + 0x1c, 0x840); u32(ed + 0x20, 0x880); u32(ed + 0x24, 0x8c0);
    exports.forEach(([name, rva], i) => { u32(base + 0x840 + i * 4, rva); u32(base + 0x880 + i * 4, 0x900 + i * 0x40); u16(base + 0x8c0 + i * 2, i); cstr(base + 0x900 + i * 0x40, name); });
  }
}
const DATA = 0xc0000040, CODE = 0x60000020;

// ── IL2CPP: GameAssembly.dll .data -> global-metadata v29 ──
const GA = 0x180000000, META = 0x70000000;
pe(GA, 0x3000, [[".text", 0x1000, 0x1000, CODE], [".data", 0x2000, 0x1000, DATA]]);
u64(GA + 0x2010, 0x12345678); u64(GA + 0x2040, META); // some unrelated pointer, then s_GlobalMetadata
const strs = {};
let sp = 0;
for (const s of ["Assembly-CSharp.dll", "UnityEngine.CoreModule.dll", "Player", "Game", "Update", "Start", "health", "speed",
  "Vector3", "UnityEngine", "x", "y", "z", "Normalize", "Quaternion", "w", "Inverse"]) { strs[s] = sp; sp += s.length + 1; }
const sec = { strings: 0x200, methods: 0x400, fields: 0x500, types: 0x600, images: 0x800 };
u32(META, 0xfab11baf); u32(META + 4, 29);
for (let k = 0; k < 30; k++) { u32(META + 8 + k * 8, 0x900); u32(META + 12 + k * 8, 0); } // empty sections sit at the end
const setPair = (k, off, size) => { u32(META + 8 + k * 8, off); u32(META + 12 + k * 8, size); };
setPair(2, sec.strings, sp);
for (const [s, i] of Object.entries(strs)) cstr(META + sec.strings + i, s);
const methods = ["Update", "Start", "Normalize", "Inverse"];
methods.forEach((m, i) => u32(META + sec.methods + i * 0x24, strs[m]));
setPair(5, sec.methods, methods.length * 0x24);
const fields = ["health", "speed", "x", "y", "z", "x", "y", "z", "w"];
fields.forEach((f, i) => u32(META + sec.fields + i * 12, strs[f]));
setPair(11, sec.fields, fields.length * 12);
// Il2CppTypeDefinition v29: name, namespace, ..., fieldStart 0x24, methodStart 0x28, ..., method_count 0x48, field_count 0x4c
const types = [["Player", "Game", 0, 2, 0, 2], ["Vector3", "UnityEngine", 2, 1, 2, 3], ["Quaternion", "UnityEngine", 3, 1, 5, 4]];
types.forEach(([name, ns, ms, mc, fs, fc], i) => {
  const t = META + sec.types + i * 0x58;
  u32(t, strs[name]); u32(t + 4, strs[ns]); u32(t + 8, 1000 + i); u32(t + 0xc, -1);
  u32(t + 0x24, fs); u32(t + 0x28, ms); u16(t + 0x48, mc); u16(t + 0x4c, fc);
});
setPair(19, sec.types, types.length * 0x58);
[["Assembly-CSharp.dll", 0, 1], ["UnityEngine.CoreModule.dll", 1, 2]].forEach(([n, start, count], i) => {
  const im = META + sec.images + i * 40; u32(im, strs[n]); u32(im + 4, i); u32(im + 8, start); u32(im + 12, count);
});
setPair(20, sec.images, 80);

// ── Source 2: client.dll ──
const CL = 0x7ffa00000000, HEAP = 0x71000000;
pe(CL, 0x5000, [[".text", 0x1000, 0x1000, CODE], [".data", 0x2000, 0x2000, DATA]], [["CreateInterface", 0x1000]]);
// s_pInterfaceRegs at rva 0x3000 -> InterfaceReg { CreateFn, name, next }
u64(CL + 0x3000, HEAP); u64(HEAP, CL + 0x1100); u64(HEAP + 8, HEAP + 0x100); cstr(HEAP + 0x100, "Source2Client002");

const disasm = {
  [CL + 0x1000]: [{ length: 7, text: "mov r9, qword ptr [rip+0x1ff9]" }], // -> rva 0x3000
  [CL + 0x1100]: [{ length: 7, text: "lea rax, [rip+0x26f9]" }, { length: 1, text: "ret" }], // -> rva 0x3800
  [CL + 0x1200]: [{ length: 1, text: "ret" }],
};

for (const [a, s] of [[0x2800, "C_BaseEntity"], [0x2820, "client.dll"], [0x2840, "C_BasePlayerPawn"], [0x2860, "garbage\x01"]]) cstr(CL + a, s);
```
