```mjs
for (const [i, s] of ["int32", "uint8", "CPlayer_WeaponServices*"].entries()) { u64(T + i * 0x40 + 8, T + i * 0x40 + 0x20); cstr(T + i * 0x40 + 0x20, s); }
const F = HEAP + 0x20000; // SchemaClassFieldData { name, type, offset, ... } stride 0x20
const fieldNames = HEAP + 0x30000;
const fieldRows = [["m_iHealth", 0, 0x344], ["m_iTeamNum", 1, 0x3e3], ["m_pWeaponServices", 2, 0x1100]];
fieldRows.forEach(([n, t, off], i) => { cstr(fieldNames + i * 0x40, n); u64(F + i * 0x20, fieldNames + i * 0x40); u64(F + i * 0x20 + 8, T + t * 0x40); u32(F + i * 0x20 + 0x10, off); });
// SchemaClassInfoData { self, name, module, size, field count (int16 @0x1c), fields @0x28, base @0x38 }
const cls = (rva, name, size, nfields, fields, base) => {
  const a = CL + rva; u64(a, a); u64(a + 8, CL + name); u64(a + 0x10, CL + 0x2820); u32(a + 0x18, size); u16(a + 0x1c, nfields); u64(a + 0x28, fields);
  if (base) { u64(a + 0x38, HEAP + 0x40000); u32(HEAP + 0x40000, 0); u64(HEAP + 0x40008, CL + base); }
};
cls(0x2100, 0x2800, 0x400, 2, F);
cls(0x2200, 0x2840, 0x1200, 1, F + 0x40, 0x2100);
u64(CL + 0x2300, CL + 0x2300); u64(CL + 0x2308, CL + 0x2860); // a self-pointing list head, not a class

const read = (a, len) => {
  const out = Buffer.alloc(len);
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) { const p = pages.get(Math.floor((a + i) / 0x1000)); if (!p) return null; out[i] = p[(a + i) % 0x1000]; }
  return out.toString("hex");
};
const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  let body = ""; req.on("data", (c) => (body += c)); req.on("end", () => {
    const m = JSON.parse(body);
    const one = (r) => { const d = read(Number(BigInt(r.address)), r.size); return { success: d !== null, address: r.address, data: d ?? "" }; };
    const reply = {
      ping: () => ({ attached: true, pid: 7, base: "0x180000000" }),
      modules: () => ({ success: true, modules: [{ name: "GameAssembly.dll", base: "0x180000000", size: 0x3000 }, { name: "client.dll", base: "0x7ffa00000000", size: 0x5000 }] }),
      read: () => one(m),
      read_batch: () => ({ success: true, results: m.reads.map(one) }),
      disassemble: () => {
        const va = Number(BigInt(m.address));
        let at = va;
        return { success: true, results: (disasm[va] ?? []).map((i) => { const r = { address: `0x${at.toString(16)}`, ...i }; at += i.length; return r; }) };
      },
    }[m.type];
    res.end(JSON.stringify(reply ? { type: `${m.type}_result`, id: m.id, ...reply() } : { type: "error", code: 1000, message: m.type }));
  });
});
await new Promise((r) => server.listen(19002, "127.0.0.1", r));
```

`app/scripts/test-memory-tools.mjs`:

```mjs
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import http from "node:http";
import { build } from "esbuild";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
const app = fileURLToPath(new URL("..", import.meta.url));
const out = `${app}node_modules/.cache/test-memory-tools.mjs`;
globalThis.localStorage = { getItem: () => "http://127.0.0.1:19013/rpc", setItem() {} };
await build({ stdin: { contents: 'export * from "./src/lib/memoryTools.ts"; export * from "./src/lib/emulatorConfig.ts";', resolveDir: app, loader: "ts" }, bundle: true, platform: "node", format: "esm", outfile: out, logLevel: "silent" });
const { parseAddress, parseFields, resolvePointerChain, readStructure, parseEmulatedRegions, hex64 } = await import(out);
const memory = Buffer.alloc(4096); memory.writeBigUInt64LE(0x10100n, 0); memory.writeBigUInt64LE(0xffffffffffffffffn, 0x110); memory.writeFloatLE(3.5, 0x118);
const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { let body = ""; req.on("data", c => body += c); req.on("end", () => { const m = JSON.parse(body); const read = r => { const off = Number(BigInt(r.address)) - 0x10000; return off < 0 || off + r.size > memory.length ? { success: false, data: "" } : { success: true, data: memory.subarray(off, off + r.size).toString("hex") }; }; res.end(JSON.stringify(m.type === "read" ? read(m) : { results: m.reads.map(read) })); }); });
await new Promise(r => server.listen(19013, "127.0.0.1", r));
try {
  assert.equal(parseAddress("-0x10", true), -16); assert.throws(() => parseAddress("garbage"), /Invalid/);
  const chain = await resolvePointerChain(0x10000, [0, 0x10]); assert.equal(chain.address, 0x10110); assert.equal(chain.hops[0].value, 0x10100);
  const values = await readStructure(chain.address, parseFields("id:u64:0\nhealth:f32:8")); assert.equal(values[0].value, "18446744073709551615"); assert.equal(values[1].value, "3.5");
  assert.throws(() => parseFields("bad:toString:0"), /Invalid field/);
  await assert.rejects(resolvePointerChain(0x10010, [0, 0]), /Invalid pointer/);
  assert.equal(hex64("ffffffffffffffff"), "0xffffffffffffffff");
  assert.deepEqual(parseEmulatedRegions("scratch 70000000 1000 rw 1234"), [{ name: "scratch", address: "0x70000000", size: 4096, perms: 3, data: "1234" }]);
  assert.throws(() => parseEmulatedRegions("scratch 70000001 1000 rw"), /Invalid region/);
  assert.throws(() => parseEmulatedRegions("scratch 70000000 1000 rw 123"), /Invalid region/);
  console.log("test-memory-tools: ok");
} finally { server.closeAllConnections(); await new Promise(r => server.close(r)); }
```

```mjs
const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer);
view.setUint16(0, 0x5a4d, true); view.setUint32(0x3c, 0x80, true); view.setUint32(0x80, 0x4550, true);
view.setUint16(0x84, 0x8664, true); view.setUint16(0x86, 1, true); view.setUint16(0x94, 0xf0, true);
const opt = 0x98;
view.setUint16(opt, 0x20b, true); view.setUint32(opt + 16, 0x1000, true); view.setBigUint64(opt + 24, 0x140000000n, true);
view.setUint32(opt + 56, 0x2000, true); view.setUint32(opt + 60, 0x200, true);
const section = opt + 0xf0;
bytes.set(new TextEncoder().encode('.text'), section);
view.setUint32(section + 8, 0x200, true); view.setUint32(section + 12, 0x1000, true);
view.setUint32(section + 16, 0x200, true); view.setUint32(section + 20, 0x200, true);
bytes.set([0x41, 0x42, 0x43, 0x44], 0x200);
const pe = openOfflinePe(bytes, 'test.exe', 0x180000000);
assert.equal(pe.capture.address, 0x180000000);
assert.equal(pe.preferredBase, 0x140000000);
assert.equal(pe.sections[0].name, '.text');
assert.deepEqual(mapPeAddress(pe, 0x180001001), { rva: 0x1001, fileOffset: 0x201, section: '.text' });
assert.equal(mapPeAddress(pe, 0x180000900).fileOffset, null);
assert.equal(pe.capture.pages.find(p => p.address === 0x180001000).data.slice(0, 8), '41424344');
assert.equal(pe.capture.pages.find(p => p.address === 0x180000200).data, null);
assert.throws(() => openOfflinePe(bytes.subarray(0, 100), 'broken'), /Truncated/);
view.setUint32(section + 20, 0x10000, true);
assert.throws(() => openOfflinePe(bytes, 'broken'), /bounds/);
```

```mjs
import http from "node:http";

globalThis.localStorage = { getItem: () => "http://127.0.0.1:19012/rpc", setItem() {} };

const { runScanSession, cancelScanSession, scanSessionResult, scanSessionStatus, compareScanSessions } = await import(out);
const base = 0x10000, memory = Buffer.alloc(8192);
memory.writeBigUInt64LE(9007199254740993n, 0); memory.writeBigUInt64LE(0xffffffffffffffffn, 8);
let pid = 5, delay = false, failPage = false;
const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  let body = ""; req.on("data", c => body += c); req.on("end", () => {
    const m = JSON.parse(body);
    let reply;
    if (m.type === "ping") reply = { attached: true, pid, base: "0x10000" };
    else if (m.type === "regions") reply = { regions: [{ base: "0x10000", size: 4096, protect: 4 }, { base: "0x11000", size: 4096, protect: 0x20 }] };
    else if (m.type === "read_batch") reply = { results: m.reads.map(r => { const offset = Number(BigInt(r.address)) - base; return offset < 0 || offset + r.size > memory.length || failPage && r.size === 4096 ? { success: false, data: "" } : { success: true, data: memory.subarray(offset, offset + r.size).toString("hex") }; }) };
    else reply = { type: "error", message: "unknown" };
    if (delay && m.type === "read_batch") setTimeout(() => res.end(JSON.stringify(reply)), 100);
    else res.end(JSON.stringify(reply));
  });
});
await new Promise(r => server.listen(19012, "127.0.0.1", r));
try {
  const options = { width: "u64", kind: "exact", value: "9007199254740993", protection: "writable" };
  let progress = [];
  const first = await runScanSession("a", false, options, p => progress.push(p));
  assert.equal(first.total, 1); assert.equal(first.hits[0].formatted, "9007199254740993"); assert.equal(first.hits[0].addr, base); assert.equal(progress.at(-1).completed, 4096);
  assert.equal((await runScanSession("b", false, { ...options, value: "18446744073709551615" })).hits[0].addr, base + 8);
  assert.deepEqual(compareScanSessions("a", "b"), { common: 0, onlyFirst: 1, onlySecond: 1, truncated: false });
  memory.writeBigUInt64LE(9007199254740994n, 0);
  failPage = true;
  const narrowed = await runScanSession("a", true, { ...options, kind: "increased" });
  assert.equal(narrowed.hits[0].formatted, "9007199254740994"); assert.equal(narrowed.unreadable, 0);
  failPage = false;
  assert.equal(scanSessionResult("b").total, 1);
  const capped = await runScanSession("cap", false, { ...options, kind: "unknown", maxResults: 2 });
  assert.equal(capped.total, 2); assert.equal(capped.truncated, true);
  assert.equal(compareScanSessions("a", "cap").truncated, true);
  const restricted = await runScanSession("range", false, { ...options, start: "10008", end: "10010", value: "18446744073709551615" });
  assert.equal(restricted.total, 1);
  await assert.rejects(runScanSession("bad", false, { ...options, value: "18446744073709551616" }), /out of range/);
  delay = true;
  const pending = runScanSession("a", true, { ...options, kind: "unchanged" });
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 20)); assert.equal(scanSessionStatus("a").busy, true); cancelScanSession("a");
  await assert.rejects(pending, e => e.name === "AbortError");
  assert.equal(scanSessionResult("a").hits[0].formatted, "9007199254740994");
  delay = false; pid = 6;
  await assert.rejects(runScanSession("a", true, { ...options, kind: "unchanged" }), /target changed/i);
  assert.equal(scanSessionResult("a"), null);
  console.log("test-scan-sessions: ok");
} finally { server.closeAllConnections(); await new Promise(r => server.close(r)); }
```

`app/scripts/test-unreal.mjs`:

```mjs
// app/scripts/test-unreal.mjs
// drives lib/unreal.ts against fake Echo relays serving two synthetic processes:
// a UE5 one (FNamePool, chunked GObjects, FField properties) and a UE4.20 one
// (TNameEntryArray, flat GObjects, UProperty objects), each with an enum, a
// function with parameters and a struct used by value before it's declared
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import http from "node:http";
import { build } from "esbuild";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

globalThis.localStorage = { getItem: () => "http://127.0.0.1:19001/rpc", setItem() {} };

const BASE = 0x140000000, DATA = BASE + 0x10000;
const NAMES = 0x20000000, NAMES1 = 0x20100000, OBJS = 0x30000000, FIELDS = 0x40000000, CHUNK = 0x50000000, CHUNKS = 0x50100000;
const EXEC = BASE + 0x1234;
const kNames = ["None", "ByteProperty", "/Script/CoreUObject", "Object", "Class", "Package", "ScriptStruct", "Vector", "X", "Y", "Z",
  "DoubleProperty", "StructProperty", "ObjectProperty", "IntProperty", "BoolProperty", "/Script/Engine", "Actor", "Transform", "Translation",
  "Owner", "Health", "Function", "Enum", "ENetRole", "ENetRole::ROLE_None", "ENetRole::ROLE_Authority", "HitResult", "LastHit", "Time",
  "K2_DestroyActor", "Seconds", "ReturnValue"];

/** Which of the 7 cipher cases a key selects, matching lib/unreal.ts. */
function valorantCase(key) {
  const k = BigInt(key >>> 0);
  const mix = (k ^ ((k ^ (k >> 15n)) >> 12n) ^ (k << 25n)) & 0xffffffffn;
  const hash = (0x2545f4914f6cdd1dn * mix) & 0xffffffffffffffffn;
  return { idx: Number(hash % 7n), hi: Number(hash >> 32n) >>> 0 };
}

function makeProcess(legacy, encrypted = false) {
  const pages = new Map();
  const page = (a) => { const p = Math.floor(a / 0x1000); if (!pages.has(p)) pages.set(p, Buffer.alloc(0x1000)); return pages.get(p); };
  const put = (a, buf) => { for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) page(a + i)[(a + i) % 0x1000] = buf[i]; };
  const u32 = (a, v) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(4); b.writeUInt32LE(v >>> 0); put(a, b); };
  const u64 = (a, v) => { const b = Buffer.alloc(8); b.writeBigUInt64LE(BigInt(v)); put(a, b); };
  const n = Object.fromEntries(kNames.map((s, i) => [s, i]));

  if (legacy) {
    // TNameEntryArray: a .data global -> Chunks[128], NumElements, NumChunks; entries {Index, HashNext, AnsiName}
    const ARR = 0x21000000, SLOTS = 0x21100000, ENTRIES = 0x21200000;
    u64(DATA + 0x200, ARR); u64(ARR, SLOTS); u32(ARR + 0x400, 0x200); u32(ARR + 0x404, 1); // a real game has thousands of names
    kNames.forEach((s, i) => { const e = ENTRIES + i * 0x40; u32(e, i << 1); put(e + 0x10, Buffer.from(s + "\0", "latin1")); u64(SLOTS + i * 8, e); });
  } else {
    // FNamePool block 0: 2 byte headers (len << 6), stride 2; indices are byte offsets / 2
    let cursor = 0;
    for (const s of kNames) {
      const b = Buffer.alloc(2 + s.length); b.writeUInt16LE(s.length << 6); b.write(s, 2, "latin1");
      put(NAMES + cursor, b); n[s] = cursor / 2; cursor += b.length + (b.length % 2);
    }
    put(NAMES1, Buffer.from([0x40, 0x00, 0x51]));
    u32(DATA + 0x100 + 0x08, 1); u32(DATA + 0x100 + 0x0c, 4); u64(DATA + 0x100 + 0x10, NAMES); u64(DATA + 0x100 + 0x18, NAMES1);
  }

  const objects = [];
  const add = (name, cls, outer) => { objects.push({ name, cls, outer }); return objects.length - 1; };
  const obj = (i) => OBJS + i * 0x200;
  const pkgCore = add("/Script/CoreUObject", 3, -1);
  const clsObject = add("Object", 2, pkgCore);
  add("Class", 2, pkgCore);
  add("Package", 2, pkgCore);
  const clsStruct = add("ScriptStruct", 2, pkgCore);
  const vector = add("Vector", clsStruct, pkgCore);
  const transform = add("Transform", clsStruct, pkgCore);
  const pkgEngine = add("/Script/Engine", 3, -1);
  const actor = add("Actor", 2, pkgEngine);
  const clsFunction = add("Function", 2, pkgCore);
  const clsEnum = add("Enum", 2, pkgCore);
  const netRole = add("ENetRole", clsEnum, pkgEngine);
  const destroy = add("K2_DestroyActor", clsFunction, actor);
  const hit = add("HitResult", clsStruct, pkgEngine); // declared after Actor, which holds one by value
  const propClass = {};
  for (const c of ["DoubleProperty", "StructProperty", "ObjectProperty", "IntProperty", "BoolProperty"]) propClass[c] = add(c, 2, pkgCore);

  // layouts: UE5 FField vs UE4.20 UProperty objects
  const L = legacy
    ? { super: 0x30, children: 0x38, size: 0x40, next: 0x28, name: 0x18, cls: 0x10, dim: 0x30, elem: 0x34, flags: 0x38, offset: 0x44, base: 0x70, func: 0xc0, enumNames: 0x40 }
    : { super: 0x40, children: 0x50, size: 0x58, next: 0x20, name: 0x28, cls: 0x08, dim: 0x34, elem: 0x38, flags: 0x40, offset: 0x4c, base: 0x78, func: 0xd8, enumNames: 0x40 };
  let nextField = FIELDS, fc = FIELDS + 0x100000;
  const fieldClass = {};
  if (!legacy) for (const c of Object.keys(propClass)) { u32(fc, n[c]); fieldClass[c] = fc; fc += 0x40; }
  const chain = (owner, list) => {
    let prev = 0;
    for (const [name, cls, off, size, flags = 0, ref] of list) {
      let f;
      if (cls === "Function") f = obj(ref);
      else if (legacy) { f = obj(add(name, propClass[cls], owner)); }
      else { f = nextField; nextField += 0x100; }
      if (cls !== "Function") {
        if (!legacy) { u64(f + L.cls, fieldClass[cls]); u32(f + L.name, n[name]); }
        u32(f + L.dim, 1); u32(f + L.elem, size); u32(f + L.offset, off); u64(f + L.flags, flags);
        if (ref !== undefined) u64(f + L.base, obj(ref));
      }
      if (prev) u64(prev + L.next, f); else u64(obj(owner) + L.children, f);
      prev = f;
    }
  };
  chain(vector, [["X", "DoubleProperty", 0, 8], ["Y", "DoubleProperty", 8, 8], ["Z", "DoubleProperty", 16, 8]]);
  u32(obj(vector) + L.size, 24);
  chain(transform, [["Translation", "StructProperty", 0x20, 24, 0, vector]]);
  u32(obj(transform) + L.size, 0x60);
  u32(obj(clsObject) + L.size, 0x28);
  chain(hit, [["Time", "IntProperty", 0, 4]]);
  u32(obj(hit) + L.size, 4);
  chain(destroy, [["Seconds", "IntProperty", 0, 4, 0x80], ["ReturnValue", "BoolProperty", 4, 1, 0x480]]);
  u64(obj(destroy) + L.func, EXEC);
  const actorProps = [["Owner", "ObjectProperty", 0x28, 8, 0, actor], ["Health", "IntProperty", 0x30, 4], ["LastHit", "StructProperty", 0x34, 4, 0, hit]];
  // pre-4.25 Children also chains the class's functions, which the property walk must skip
  chain(actor, legacy ? [...actorProps, ["K2_DestroyActor", "Function", 0, 0, 0, destroy]] : actorProps);
  u32(obj(actor) + L.size, 0x40); u64(obj(actor) + L.super, obj(clsObject));
  // UEnum::Names: TArray<TPair<FName, int64>>
  const NAMESARR = 0x60000000;
  u64(obj(netRole) + L.enumNames, NAMESARR); u32(obj(netRole) + L.enumNames + 8, 2); u32(obj(netRole) + L.enumNames + 12, 2);
  u32(NAMESARR, n["ENetRole::ROLE_None"]); u64(NAMESARR + 8, 0); u32(NAMESARR + 16, n["ENetRole::ROLE_Authority"]); u64(NAMESARR + 24, 3);

  while (objects.length < 0x110) add("None", clsObject, pkgCore);
  objects.forEach((o, i) => {
    u32(obj(i) + 0xc, i); u64(obj(i) + 0x10, obj(o.cls)); u32(obj(i) + 0x18, n[o.name]); if (o.outer >= 0) u64(obj(i) + 0x20, obj(o.outer));
    u64(CHUNK + i * 0x18, obj(i));
  });
  if (legacy) {
    u64(DATA + 0x400 + 0x10, CHUNK); u32(DATA + 0x400 + 0x18, 0x20000); u32(DATA + 0x400 + 0x1c, objects.length);
  } else {
    u64(CHUNKS, CHUNK);
    if (!encrypted) {
      u64(DATA + 0x400 + 0x10, CHUNKS); u32(DATA + 0x400 + 0x20, 0x20000); u32(DATA + 0x400 + 0x24, objects.length);
      u32(DATA + 0x400 + 0x28, 2); u32(DATA + 0x400 + 0x2c, 1);
    }
  }
  const read = (a, len) => {
    const out = Buffer.alloc(len);
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) { const p = pages.get(Math.floor((a + i) / 0x1000)); if (!p) return null; out[i] = p[(a + i) % 0x1000]; }
    return out.toString("hex");
  };
  if (encrypted) {
    // Valorant-style: the FUObjectArray header is on the heap, so the plain
    // .data scanner cannot find it; only the 7-state cipher points at it.
    const HEAP = 0x70000000, fuoa = HEAP + 0x10;
    u64(HEAP + 0x10, CHUNKS);
    u32(HEAP + 0x20, 0x20000); u32(HEAP + 0x24, objects.length);
    u32(HEAP + 0x28, 2); u32(HEAP + 0x2c, 1);

    let key = 1;
    let sel = valorantCase(key);
    while (sel.idx !== 0) { key++; sel = valorantCase(key); }
    // case 0 inverts as state = pointer ^ key ^ hi
    const state = (BigInt(fuoa) ^ BigInt(key) ^ BigInt(sel.hi)) & 0xffffffffffffffffn;
    const STATE = DATA + 0x800;
    u64(STATE + 0x40, state); u32(STATE + 0x78, key);

    // LEA rcx, [rip+disp] at 0x10c0, magic at 0x1100 (inside the 100-byte walk-back)
    const lea = BASE + 0x10c0;
    const disp = STATE - (lea + 7);
    put(lea, Buffer.from([0x48, 0x8d, 0x0d, disp & 0xff, (disp >> 8) & 0xff, (disp >> 16) & 0xff, (disp >>> 24) & 0xff]));
    u64(BASE + 0x1100, 0x2545f4914f6cdd1dn);
    return { read, L, HEAP };
  }
  return { read, L };
}

const out = fileURLToPath(new URL("../node_modules/.cache/test-unreal.mjs", import.meta.url));
await build({ entryPoints: [fileURLToPath(new URL("../src/lib/unreal.ts", import.meta.url))], bundle: true, format: "esm", platform: "node", outfile: out, logLevel: "warning" });
const { Unreal } = await import(out);
const sections = [{ name: ".text", rva: 0x1000, vsize: 0x1000, exec: true, writable: false }, { name: ".data", rva: 0x10000, vsize: 0x1000, exec: false, writable: true }];

// one relay, the process behind it swapped per scenario (echo.ts reads the url once)
let read = () => null;
const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
    let body = ""; req.on("data", (c) => (body += c)); req.on("end", () => {
      const m = JSON.parse(body);
      const one = (r) => { const d = read(Number(BigInt(r.address)), r.size); return { success: d !== null, address: r.address, data: d ?? "" }; };
      res.end(JSON.stringify(m.type === "read_batch" ? { type: "read_batch_result", success: true, results: m.reads.map(one) }
        : m.type === "read" ? { type: "read_result", ...one(m) } : { type: "error", code: 1000, message: "unknown" }));
    });
  });
await new Promise((r) => server.listen(19001, "127.0.0.1", r));

for (const legacy of [false, true]) {
  const proc = makeProcess(legacy);
  read = proc.read;
  const L = proc.L;

  const ue = await Unreal.open(BASE, sections, () => {});
  const want = legacy ? "UE4.20" : "UE5";
  const knownObjects = await Unreal.open(BASE, sections, () => {}, { gobjects: DATA + 0x400 });
  assert.equal(knownObjects.layout.gnames, legacy ? DATA + 0x200 : DATA + 0x100, `${want}: discover names with object override`);
  const knownNames = await Unreal.open(BASE, sections, () => {}, { gnames: legacy ? DATA + 0x200 : DATA + 0x100 });
  assert.equal(knownNames.layout.gobjects, DATA + 0x400, `${want}: discover objects with name override`);
  assert.equal(ue.layout.gobjects, DATA + 0x400, want);
  assert.equal(ue.layout.gnames, legacy ? DATA + 0x200 : DATA + 0x100, want);
  assert.deepEqual(
    [ue.layout.objectsFlat, ue.layout.namesLegacy, ue.layout.propsLegacy, ue.layout.childProps, ue.layout.ffName, ue.layout.ffNext, ue.layout.offset,
      ue.layout.elemSize, ue.layout.structSize, ue.layout.super, ue.layout.propBase, ue.layout.propFlags, ue.layout.funcExec, ue.layout.enumNames],
    [legacy, legacy, legacy, L.children, L.name, L.next, L.offset, L.elem, L.size, L.super, L.base, L.flags, L.func, L.enumNames], want);

  assert.equal(await ue.dump(ue.find("/Script/Engine.Actor", "Class")), [
    "// Class /Script/Engine.Actor",
    "// 0x18 (0x40 - 0x28)",
    "class AActor : public UObject",
    "{",
    "public:",
    "\tclass AActor* Owner; // 0x0028(0x0008)",
    "\tint32 Health; // 0x0030(0x0004)",
    "\tstruct FHitResult LastHit; // 0x0034(0x0004)",
    "\tuint8 Pad_38[0x0008];",
    "",
    "public:",
    "\t// Function /Script/Engine.Actor.K2_DestroyActor  exec 0x140001234 (rva 0x1234)",
    "\tbool K2_DestroyActor(int32 Seconds);",
    "};",
    "",
  ].join("\n"), want);
  assert.equal(await ue.dumpEnum(ue.find("/Script/Engine.ENetRole", "Enum")),
    "// Enum /Script/Engine.ENetRole\nenum class ENetRole : uint8\n{\n\tROLE_None = 0,\n\tROLE_Authority = 3,\n};\n", want);
  assert.match(await ue.dump(ue.find("/Script/CoreUObject.Transform", "ScriptStruct")), /\tstruct FVector Translation; \/\/ 0x0020\(0x0018\)/, want);
  const sdk = await ue.sdk(() => {});
  // enums first, and HitResult (declared later in GObjects) ahead of the Actor that embeds it
  assert.ok(sdk.indexOf("enum class ENetRole") < sdk.indexOf("struct FVector"), want);
  assert.ok(sdk.indexOf("struct FHitResult") < sdk.indexOf("class AActor"), want);
}
{
  // Valorant-style encrypted GObjects: the plain scanner must fail and the
  // cipher must find the heap FUObjectArray through the magic + LEA.
  const proc = makeProcess(false, true);
  read = proc.read;
  const ue = await Unreal.open(BASE, sections, () => {});
  assert.equal(ue.valorant, true, "encrypted GObjects were decrypted");
  assert.equal(ue.layout.gobjects, proc.HEAP, "header is the decrypted FChunkedFixedUObjectArray pointer minus 0x10");
  assert.equal(ue.objs.length, 0x110, "objects load through the decrypted header");
  assert.ok(ue.find("/Script/Engine.Actor", "Class"), "the indexed SDK still resolves classes");
}
server.close();
console.log("test-unreal: ok");
```

```mjs
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { build } from "esbuild";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const app = fileURLToPath(new URL("..", import.meta.url));
const outfile = fileURLToPath(new URL("../node_modules/.cache/test-updater.mjs", import.meta.url));
await build({
  entryPoints: [fileURLToPath(new URL("../src/store/updater.ts", import.meta.url))],
  bundle: true, format: "esm", platform: "node", outfile,
  plugins: [{ name: "updater-mocks", setup(build) {
    build.onResolve({ filter: /^(?:@tauri-apps\/plugin-updater|@tauri-apps\/plugin-process|@\/lib\/endpoint)$/ }, args => ({ path: args.path, namespace: "mock" }));
    build.onLoad({ filter: /.*/, namespace: "mock" }, args => ({ contents: args.path.endsWith("plugin-updater")
      ? "export const check = (...args) => globalThis.updaterMock.check(...args)"
      : args.path.endsWith("plugin-process")
        ? "export const relaunch = () => globalThis.updaterMock.relaunch()"
        : "export const isTauri = () => true", loader: "js" }));
  } }],
});
const { useUpdater } = await import(pathToFileURL(outfile).href);
const state = () => useUpdater.getState();
let closed = 0, installs = 0, restarts = 0;
let update = {
  version: "1.2.3",
  async download(onEvent) {
    onEvent({ event: "Started", data: { contentLength: 100 } });
    onEvent({ event: "Progress", data: { chunkLength: 50 } });
    assert.match(state().status, /50%/);
    onEvent({ event: "Finished" });
  },
  async close() { closed++; },
  async install(options) { assert.equal(options.restartAfterInstall, true); installs++; },
};
let checks = 0;
globalThis.updaterMock = { check: async options => {
  checks++;
  assert.equal(options.timeout, 30_000);
  assert.equal(options.headers["Cache-Control"], "no-cache");
  return update;
}, relaunch: async () => { restarts++; } };

await state().check();
assert.equal(state().ready, update);
assert.equal(state().busy, false);
await state().check();
assert.equal(checks, 1);
let failRestart = true;
globalThis.updaterMock.relaunch = async () => { restarts++; if (failRestart) throw Error("restart denied"); };
await state().install();
assert.equal(state().ready, null);
assert.equal(state().installedVersion, "1.2.3");
assert.match(state().status, /Restart failed/);
assert.equal(closed, 1);
failRestart = false;
await state().install();
assert.equal(installs, 1);
assert.equal(restarts, 2);

useUpdater.setState({ ready: null, installedVersion: null, busy: false });
update = { version: "2.0", async download() { throw Error("offline"); }, async close() { closed++; } };
await state().check();
assert.equal(closed, 2);
assert.equal(state().ready, null);
assert.match(state().status, /Update download failed: offline/);

globalThis.updaterMock.check = async () => null;
await state().check();
assert.equal(state().status, "Up to date");

globalThis.updaterMock.check = async () => { throw Error("network"); };
await state().check();
assert.match(state().status, /Update check failed: network/);

update = { version: "3.0", async download() {}, async close() {}, async install() { throw Error("permission denied"); } };
globalThis.updaterMock.check = async () => update;
await state().check();
await state().install();
assert.equal(state().ready, update);
assert.equal(state().busy, false);
assert.match(state().status, /Install failed: permission denied/);

useUpdater.setState({ ready: null, installedVersion: null, busy: false });
update = { version: "4.0", async download() {}, async close() {}, async install() { installs++; } };
await state().check(true);
assert.equal(installs, 2);
assert.equal(restarts, 3);
assert.equal(state().installedVersion, "4.0");
console.log("test-updater: ok");
```

`app/scripts/test-version-bump.mjs`:

```mjs
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { cpSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../..', import.meta.url));
const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'echo-version-'));
const files = ['app/package.json', 'app/package-lock.json', 'app/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json', 'app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml', 'app/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'];
try {
  for (const file of files) {
    mkdirSync(dirname(join(dir, file)), { recursive: true });
    cpSync(join(root, file), join(dir, file));
  }
  const script = join(root, 'tools/bump-version.mjs');
  const old = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dir, files[0]), 'utf8')).version;
  const next = execFileSync(process.execPath, [script, dir], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
  const [major, minor, patch] = old.split('.').map(Number);
  assert.equal(next, `${major}.${minor}.${patch + 1}`);
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dir, files[1]), 'utf8')).packages[''].version, next);
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dir, files[2]), 'utf8')).version, next);
  assert.match(readFileSync(join(dir, files[3]), 'utf8'), new RegExp(`version = "${next.replaceAll('.', '\\.')}"`));
  assert.ok(readFileSync(join(dir, files[4]), 'utf8').includes(`name = "reverse-slop-ui"\nversion = "${next}"`));
  const config = join(dir, files[2]);
  writeFileSync(config, JSON.stringify({ version: old }));
  assert.throws(() => execFileSync(process.execPath, [script, dir], { stdio: 'pipe' }));
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dir, files[0]), 'utf8')).version, next);
  console.log('test-version-bump: ok');
} finally { rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
```

`app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml`:

```toml
[package]
name = "reverse-slop-ui"
version = "0.2.12"
description = "reverse-slop workbench front end"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.77"
publish = false

# the release exe is echo-reverse.exe, one self-contained file (web assets are
# embedded, the vc runtime is linked statically by the tauri cli)
[[bin]]
name = "echo-reverse"
path = "src/main.rs"

[lib]
name = "reverse_slop_ui_lib"
# desktop only: the mobile staticlib/cdylib outputs cost a second full link every build
crate-type = ["rlib"]

[build-dependencies]
tauri-build = { version = "2", features = [] }

[dependencies]
tauri = { version = "2", features = ["devtools"] }
tauri-plugin-dialog = "2"
tauri-plugin-process = "2"
tauri-plugin-updater = "2"
serde_json = "1"
tungstenite = "0.28"


[features]
# Keeps `tauri build --features custom-protocol` working with the default setup.
custom-protocol = ["tauri/custom-protocol"]

[profile.release]
codegen-units = 1
lto = true
panic = "abort"
strip = true

```

`app/src-tauri/app.manifest`:

```manifest
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<assembly xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:asm.v1"
          xmlns:asmv3="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:asm.v3"
          manifestVersion="1.0">
  <assemblyIdentity type="win32"
                    name="reverse-slop-ui"
                    version="0.1.1.0"
                    processorArchitecture="*"/>
  <!-- comctl32 v6. Replacing Tauri's default manifest means re-declaring this:
       rfd/muda import TaskDialogIndirect, which only v6 exports, so without the
       dependency the loader binds v5 and the process dies at start with
       STATUS_ENTRYPOINT_NOT_FOUND before any code runs. -->
  <dependency>
    <dependentAssembly>
      <assemblyIdentity type="win32"
                        name="Microsoft.Windows.Common-Controls"
                        version="6.0.0.0"
                        processorArchitecture="*"
                        publicKeyToken="6595b64144ccf1df"
                        language="*"/>
    </dependentAssembly>
  </dependency>
  <trustInfo xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:asm.v3">
    <security>
      <requestedPrivileges>
        <requestedExecutionLevel level="asInvoker" uiAccess="false"/>
      </requestedPrivileges>
    </security>
  </trustInfo>
  <compatibility xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:compatibility.v1">
    <application>
      <supportedOS Id="{8e0f7a12-bfb3-4fe8-b9a5-48fd50a15a9a}"/>
    </application>
  </compatibility>
  <asmv3:application>
    <asmv3:windowsSettings xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/SMI/2005/WindowsSettings">
      <dpiAwareness xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/SMI/2016/WindowsSettings">PerMonitorV2</dpiAwareness>
    </asmv3:windowsSettings>
  </asmv3:application>
</assembly>

```

`app/src-tauri/build.rs`:

```rs
fn main() {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        let attrs = tauri_build::WindowsAttributes::new().app_manifest(include_str!("app.manifest"));
        tauri_build::try_build(tauri_build::Attributes::new().windows_attributes(attrs))
            .expect("failed to run tauri-build");
    }
    #[cfg(not(windows))]
    tauri_build::build();
}

```

```json
    "core:window:allow-set-title",
    "core:webview:allow-internal-toggle-devtools",
    "dialog:allow-open",
    "dialog:allow-save",
    "dialog:allow-message",
    "updater:default",
    "process:allow-restart"
  ]
}
```

`app/src-tauri/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
// app/src-tauri/src/lib.rs
//
// hosts the echo relay the hypervisor connects to (see relay.rs), the web ui
// reaches it over loopback http like it would web-mv's relay

mod relay;
mod script_io;

#[tauri::command]
fn update_requested() -> bool {
    std::env::args_os().skip(1).any(|arg| arg == "--update")
}

/// a bare file name with the given extension, so the ui can't write anywhere else
fn plain_name(name: &str, ext: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), String> {
    let valid = ext.map_or(true, |e| name.ends_with(e))
        && !name.is_empty()
        && name.len() <= 128
        && name.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || "_-.".contains(c))
        && !name.starts_with('.');
    valid.then_some(()).ok_or_else(|| format!("'{name}' is not a plain file name"))
}

/// %APPDATA% on windows; linux builds (ui preview) fall back to ~/.config
fn appdata() -> Result<std::path::PathBuf, String> {
    std::env::var_os("APPDATA")
        .or_else(|| std::env::var_os("XDG_CONFIG_HOME"))
        .map(std::path::PathBuf::from)
        .or_else(|| std::env::var_os("HOME").map(|h| std::path::Path::new(&h).join(".config")))
        .ok_or_else(|| "APPDATA is not set".into())
}

fn write_under(sub: &[&str], name: &str, data: &[u8]) -> Result<String, String> {
    let mut dir = appdata()?;
    dir.extend(sub);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let path = dir.join(name);
    std::fs::write(&path, data).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    Ok(path.display().to_string())
}

/// Install stock scripts only when absent; existing scripts may contain user edits.
fn install_stock_scripts() {
    let Ok(appdata) = appdata() else { return };
    for (name, text) in [
        ("echo-reverse.as", include_str!("../../echo/echo-reverse.as")),
        ("echo-reverse-agent.as", include_str!("../../echo/echo-reverse-agent.as")),
    ] {
        let path = appdata.join("scripts").join(name);
        if path.exists() {
            continue;
        }
        if let Err(e) = write_under(&["scripts"], name, text.as_bytes()) {
            eprintln!("could not install {name}: {e}");
        }
    }
}

/// lists .as scripts in %APPDATA%\scripts so agents can see what's installed
#[tauri::command]
fn list_scripts() -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
    let mut dir = appdata()?;
    dir.push("scripts");
    if !dir.exists() { return Ok(vec![]); }
    let mut names: Vec<String> = std::fs::read_dir(&dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .flatten()
        .map(|e| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .filter(|n| n.ends_with(".as"))
        .collect();
    names.sort();
    Ok(names)
}

/// writes a script where echo loads them from, %APPDATA%\scripts
#[tauri::command]
fn install_script(name: String, text: String) -> Result<String, String> {
    plain_name(&name, Some(".as"))?;
    let dir = appdata()?.join("scripts");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let path = dir.join(&name);
    script_io::install(&path, text.as_bytes())?;
    Ok(path.display().to_string())
}

/// read an arbitrary text file from disk (used to load models.yml from any path)
#[tauri::command]
fn read_text_file(path: String) -> Result<String, String> {
    std::fs::read_to_string(&path).map_err(|e| format!("{path}: {e}"))
}

/// dumps and sdks for the static tools, %APPDATA%\echo-reverse\out; raw body so
/// a 100 MB module doesn't go through json, the name rides in the x-name header
#[tauri::command]
fn save_output(request: tauri::ipc::Request<'_>) -> Result<String, String> {
    let tauri::ipc::InvokeBody::Raw(data) = request.body() else {
        return Err("expected raw bytes".into());
    };
    let name = request.headers().get("x-name").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()).ok_or("missing x-name")?;
    plain_name(name, None)?;
    write_under(&["echo-reverse", "out"], name, data)
}

#[cfg_attr(mobile, tauri::mobile_entry_point)]
pub fn run() {
    let port = std::env::var("ECHO_RELAY_PORT")
        .ok()
        .and_then(|p| p.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(relay::DEFAULT_PORT);
    // a busy port usually means web-mv's or signature-doctor's relay is already
    // running there, the ui talks to that one just the same
    if let Err(e) = relay::serve(port) {
        eprintln!("echo relay not started on 127.0.0.1:{port}: {e}");
    }

    install_stock_scripts();

    tauri::Builder::default()
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_dialog::init())
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_process::init())
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_updater::Builder::new().build())
        .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![list_scripts, install_script, save_output, update_requested, read_text_file])
        .run(tauri::generate_context!())
        .expect("error while running echo-reverse UI");
}
```

`app/src-tauri/src/relay.rs`:

```rs
// app/src-tauri/src/relay.rs
//
// the echo backend relay. echo's hypervisor connects out as a websocket client
// (process::open_socket / ws::connect), so something has to listen for it, and
// the web ui can't. one loopback port serves:
//   ws  /agent      echo's native socket routes (read, modules, sig_scan_ida, ...)
//   ws  /agent-ext  optional angelscript ext agent (write, regions, exports, scan_*, emulate)
//   ws  /agent-ui   optional menu control lane (angel-menu-mcp's angel-menu-control.as)
//   ws  /agent-app  the echo-reverse ui itself: registers its tools (pe, strings, scanner,
//                   unreal, dumps, scripts, navigation) and runs them for mcp callers
//   POST /rpc       one json frame in, the agent's reply out (web-mv / signature-doctor shape)
//   POST /mcp       the same verbs as mcp tools, streamable http with json responses
//   GET  /status    which agents are connected
// the paths and port match web-mv's relay, so its agent scripts work unchanged

use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::io::{ErrorKind, Read, Write};
use std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::mpsc::{channel, sync_channel, Sender, SyncSender, TrySendError};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use tungstenite::{handshake::derive_accept_key, protocol::Role, Message, WebSocket};

pub const DEFAULT_PORT: u16 = 9000;
const MAX_HEAD: usize = 16 * 1024;
const MAX_BODY: usize = 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_PENDING_PER_AGENT: usize = 128;
const REPLY_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(60);
/// app tools walk whole modules or export an sdk
const APP_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(900);

/// verbs only the ext agent implements, everything else goes to echo's native socket
const EXT_VERBS: &[&str] = &[
    // attachment control and the write/analysis family served by echo-reverse.as
    "attach", "detach", "process_alive", "query_region", "resolve_export", "disassemble_detail",
    "write", "dump", "exports", "imports", "iat_rebuild", "sections", "regions", "pe_header",
    "pe_dirs", "resource_tree", "scan_new", "scan_filter", "scan_clear", "scan_grouped",
    "raw_scan", "emulate", "capabilities",
];

/// verbs of the menu control lane
const UI_VERBS: &[&str] = &["ui_list", "ui_get", "ui_set"];

const ALLOWED_ORIGINS: &[&str] = &[
    "tauri://localhost",
    "http://tauri.localhost",
    "https://tauri.localhost",
    "http://localhost:1420",
    "http://127.0.0.1:1420",
];

#[derive(Default)]
struct Agent {
    /// (generation, outgoing frames) of the live connection
    out: Mutex<Option<(u64, SyncSender<(u64, String)>)>>,
    pending: Mutex<HashMap<u64, Sender<Value>>>,
    completed: AtomicU64,
    timeouts: AtomicU64,
    rejected: AtomicU64,
    last_latency_ms: AtomicU64,
}

impl Agent {
    fn health(&self) -> Value {
        let generation = self.out.lock().unwrap().as_ref().map(|(g, _)| *g);
        json!({ "connected": generation.is_some(), "generation": generation,
            "pending": self.pending.lock().unwrap().len(), "limit": MAX_PENDING_PER_AGENT,
            "completed": self.completed.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
            "timeouts": self.timeouts.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
            "rejected": self.rejected.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
            "last_latency_ms": self.last_latency_ms.load(Ordering::Relaxed) })
    }
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Relay {
    core: Agent,
    ext: Agent,
    ui: Agent,
    app: Agent,
    /// tool definitions the app registered with its hello frame
    app_tools: Mutex<Vec<Value>>,
    seq: AtomicU64,
}

fn error(code: &str, message: impl Into<String>) -> Value {
    json!({ "type": "error", "code": code, "message": message.into() })
}

impl Relay {
    pub fn status(&self) -> Value {
        let core = self.core.health();
        let ext = self.ext.health();
        let ui = self.ui.health();
        let app = self.app.health();
        json!({
            "core": core["connected"], "ext": ext["connected"],
            "ui": ui["connected"], "app": app["connected"],
            "lanes": { "core": core, "ext": ext, "ui": ui, "app": app },
        })
    }

    /// forward one frame to the agent that owns its verb and wait for the reply
    pub fn request(&self, mut frame: Value) -> Value {
        let Some(kind) = frame.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str).map(str::to_owned) else {
            return error("InvalidRequest", "frame needs a string 'type'");
        };
        let (agent, path) = if EXT_VERBS.contains(&kind.as_str()) {
            (&self.ext, "/agent-ext")
        } else if UI_VERBS.contains(&kind.as_str()) {
            (&self.ui, "/agent-ui")
        } else if kind == "app" {
            (&self.app, "/agent-app")
        } else {
            (&self.core, "/agent")
        };
        let out = agent.out.lock().unwrap();
        let Some(tx) = out.as_ref().map(|(_, tx)| tx) else {
            return error("NoAgent", format!("no echo agent connected on {path} for '{kind}'"));
        };

        // echo echoes an int id back, keep it in i32 range and restore the caller's after
        let client_id = frame.get("id").cloned();
        let id = self.seq.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) % 0x7fff_ffff + 1;
        frame["id"] = json!(id);
        let (reply_tx, reply_rx) = channel();
        {
            let mut pending = agent.pending.lock().unwrap();
            if pending.len() >= MAX_PENDING_PER_AGENT {
                agent.rejected.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                return error("Busy", format!("too many pending requests for {path}"));
            }
            pending.insert(id, reply_tx);
        }
        let started = Instant::now();

        if let Err(err) = tx.try_send((id, frame.to_string())) {
            agent.pending.lock().unwrap().remove(&id);
            return match err {
                TrySendError::Full(_) => {
                    agent.rejected.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    error("Busy", format!("request queue for {path} is full"))
                }
                TrySendError::Disconnected(_) => error("NoAgent", format!("echo agent on {path} disconnected")),
            };
        }
        drop(out);
        let wait = if kind == "app" { APP_TIMEOUT } else { REPLY_TIMEOUT };
        let mut reply = match reply_rx.recv_timeout(wait) {
            Ok(reply) => {
                agent.completed.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                agent.last_latency_ms.store(started.elapsed().as_millis().min(u64::MAX as u128) as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
                reply
            }
            Err(std::sync::mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Disconnected) => return error("NoAgent", format!("echo agent on {path} disconnected")),
            Err(std::sync::mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Timeout) => {
                agent.pending.lock().unwrap().remove(&id);
                agent.timeouts.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                return error("Timeout", format!("'{kind}' got no reply from {path}"));
            }
        };
        match client_id {
            Some(cid) => reply["id"] = cid,
            None => {
                if let Some(o) = reply.as_object_mut() {
                    o.remove("id");
                }
            }
        }
        reply
    }

    fn run_agent(&self, path: &str, mut ws: WebSocket<TcpStream>) {
        let agent = match path {
            "/agent-ext" => &self.ext,
            "/agent-ui" => &self.ui,
            "/agent-app" => &self.app,
            _ => &self.core,
        };
        let generation = self.seq.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let (tx, rx) = sync_channel::<(u64, String)>(MAX_PENDING_PER_AGENT);
        // a reconnect replaces the old socket; its thread notices its sender is gone
        {
            let mut out = agent.out.lock().unwrap();
            agent.pending.lock().unwrap().clear();
            *out = Some((generation, tx));
        }
        eprintln!("relay: echo agent connected on {path}");

        // short read timeout so one thread can both drain outgoing frames and read replies
        let _ = ws.get_ref().set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_millis(15)));
        'conn: loop {
            loop {
                match rx.try_recv() {
                    Ok((id, text)) => {
                        if !agent.pending.lock().unwrap().contains_key(&id) { continue; }
                        if ws.send(Message::text(text)).is_err() {
                            break 'conn;
                        }
                    }
                    Err(std::sync::mpsc::TryRecvError::Empty) => break,
                    Err(std::sync::mpsc::TryRecvError::Disconnected) => break 'conn,
                }
            }
            match ws.read() {
                Ok(Message::Text(text)) => {
                    let Ok(reply) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(text.as_str()) else { continue };
                    if path == "/agent-app" && reply["type"] == "hello" {
                        *self.app_tools.lock().unwrap() = reply["tools"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
                        continue;
                    }
                    let Some(id) = reply.get("id").and_then(Value::as_u64) else { continue };
                    if let Some(waiter) = agent.pending.lock().unwrap().remove(&id) {
                        let _ = waiter.send(reply);
                    }
                }
                Ok(Message::Close(_)) => break,
                Ok(_) => {}
                Err(tungstenite::Error::Io(e))
                    if matches!(e.kind(), ErrorKind::WouldBlock | ErrorKind::TimedOut) => {}
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }

        let mut out = agent.out.lock().unwrap();
        if out.as_ref().is_some_and(|(g, _)| *g == generation) {
            *out = None;
            if path == "/agent-app" {
                self.app_tools.lock().unwrap().clear();
            }
            // dropping the waiters wakes every caller with "disconnected" instead of a 60s hang
            agent.pending.lock().unwrap().clear();
        }
        eprintln!("relay: echo agent on {path} disconnected");
    }
}

struct Head {
    method: String,
    path: String,
    headers: HashMap<String, String>,
}

fn read_head(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> Option<Head> {
    // byte at a time so nothing past the head is swallowed before a websocket takes over
    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(512);
    let mut byte = [0u8; 1];
    while !buf.ends_with(b"\r\n\r\n") {
        if buf.len() >= MAX_HEAD || stream.read(&mut byte).ok()? == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        buf.push(byte[0]);
    }
    let text = String::from_utf8(buf).ok()?;
    let mut lines = text.split("\r\n");
    let mut first = lines.next()?.split(' ');
    let method = first.next()?.to_string();
    let path = first.next()?.split('?').next()?.to_string();
    let headers = lines
        .filter_map(|l| l.split_once(':'))
        .map(|(k, v)| (k.trim().to_ascii_lowercase(), v.trim().to_string()))
        .collect();
    Some(Head { method, path, headers })
}

fn respond(stream: &mut TcpStream, status: &str, origin: Option<&str>, body: &str) {
    let cors = origin
        .map(|o| {
            format!(
                "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: {o}\r\nAccess-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, OPTIONS\r\n\
                 Access-Control-Allow-Headers: content-type, x-mv-client\r\nVary: Origin\r\n"
            )
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let _ = write!(
        stream,
        "HTTP/1.1 {status}\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n{cors}Connection: close\r\n\r\n{body}",
        body.len()
    );
    // drain what the client still sends (an unread body) so close isn't a reset
    let _ = stream.shutdown(std::net::Shutdown::Write);
    let _ = std::io::copy(&mut stream.take(MAX_BODY as u64), &mut std::io::sink());
}

fn handle(relay: &Relay, port: u16, mut stream: TcpStream) {
    let _ = stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10)));
    let Some(head) = read_head(&mut stream) else { return };

    // loopback only plus host/origin checks: a web page must not drive memory writes
    // through this port (dns rebinding, or a no-preflight text/plain post)
    let host_ok = head.headers.get("host").is_some_and(|h| {
        h == &format!("127.0.0.1:{port}") || h == &format!("localhost:{port}") || h == &format!("[::1]:{port}")
    });
    let origin = head.headers.get("origin").map(String::as_str);
    if !host_ok || origin.is_some_and(|o| !ALLOWED_ORIGINS.contains(&o)) {
        return respond(&mut stream, "403 Forbidden", None, &error("Forbidden", "origin not allowed").to_string());
    }

    let upgrade = head.headers.get("upgrade").is_some_and(|u| u.eq_ignore_ascii_case("websocket"));
    match (head.method.as_str(), head.path.as_str()) {
        ("GET", path @ ("/agent" | "/agent-ext" | "/agent-ui" | "/agent-app")) if upgrade => {
            let Some(key) = head.headers.get("sec-websocket-key") else { return };
            let accept = derive_accept_key(key.as_bytes());
            if write!(
                stream,
                "HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\nSec-WebSocket-Accept: {accept}\r\n\r\n"
            )
            .is_err()
            {
                return;
            }
            relay.run_agent(path, WebSocket::from_raw_socket(stream, Role::Server, None));
        }
        ("OPTIONS", _) => respond(&mut stream, "204 No Content", origin, ""),
        ("GET", "/status") => respond(&mut stream, "200 OK", origin, &relay.status().to_string()),
        ("GET", "/mcp") => respond(&mut stream, "405 Method Not Allowed", origin, ""),
        // OAuth callback: browser redirect lands here (no Origin header → host check only).
        // Extracts ?code= and posts it back to the opener, then closes the popup.
        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/oauth-callback") => {
            let html = r#"<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Connecting…</title>
<style>body{font-family:system-ui;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh;margin:0;background:#111;color:#eee}</style>
</head><body><p>Connecting — you can close this window.</p><script>
const p=new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const code=p.get('code');
const prov=p.get('provider')||'openrouter';
if(code&&window.opener)window.opener.postMessage({type:'echo-reverse-oauth',provider:prov,code},'*');
setTimeout(()=>window.close(),500);
</script></body></html>"#;
            let _ = stream.write_all(format!(
                "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n{}",
                html.len(), html
            ).as_bytes());
        }
        ("POST", path @ ("/rpc" | "/mcp")) => {
            // json content type forces a cors preflight for any browser caller
            let json_ct = head.headers.get("content-type").is_some_and(|c| c.starts_with("application/json"));
            let len = head.headers.get("content-length").and_then(|l| l.parse::<usize>().ok());
            let Some(len) = len.filter(|&l| json_ct && l <= MAX_BODY) else {
                return respond(&mut stream, "400 Bad Request", origin, &error("InvalidRequest", "json body up to 1 MiB required").to_string());
            };
            let mut body = vec![0u8; len];
            if stream.read_exact(&mut body).is_err() {
                return;
            }
            let reply = match serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&body) {
                Ok(msg) if path == "/mcp" => match mcp::handle(relay, &msg) {
                    Some(reply) => reply,
                    // notifications get no body
                    None => return respond(&mut stream, "202 Accepted", origin, ""),
                },
                Ok(frame) if frame.is_object() => relay.request(frame),
                _ => error("InvalidRequest", "expected a json object"),
            };
            respond(&mut stream, "200 OK", origin, &reply.to_string());
        }
        _ => respond(&mut stream, "404 Not Found", origin, &error("NotFound", "unknown route").to_string()),
    }
}

/// bind on loopback and serve forever on background threads
pub fn serve(port: u16) -> std::io::Result<Arc<Relay>> {
    let listener = TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port))?;
    let relay = Arc::new(Relay::default());
    let shared = relay.clone();
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        for stream in listener.incoming().flatten() {
            let relay = shared.clone();
            std::thread::spawn(move || handle(&relay, port, stream));
        }
    });
    Ok(relay)
}

/// echo's verbs as mcp tools; arguments are the frame fields, the reply is the agent's json
mod mcp {
    use super::Relay;
    use serde_json::{json, Value};

    fn addr(desc: &str) -> Value {
        json!({ "type": "string", "description": format!("{desc}, hex like 0x7ff600001000") })
    }

    fn tools() -> Vec<(&'static str, &'static str, &'static str, Value)> {
        let module = json!({ "type": "string", "description": "module file name, defaults to the main executable" });
        let address = json!({ "type": "string", "description": "hex address, e.g. 0x7ff600001000" });
        let text = json!({ "type": "string" });
        let none = json!({ "type": "object", "properties": {} });
        vec![
            ("ping", "ping", "Whether Echo is attached, with the target pid and base.", none.clone()),
            ("attach", "attach", "Attach Echo to a process by PID or executable name.", json!({
                "type": "object", "properties": { "pid": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 4294967295u64 }, "name": { "type": "string" } },
                "oneOf": [{ "required": ["pid"] }, { "required": ["name"] }] })),
            ("detach", "detach", "Detach Echo from the current process.", none.clone()),
            ("capabilities", "capabilities", "Report the connected Echo extension's supported operations.", none.clone()),
            ("modules", "modules", "Loaded modules of the attached process: name, base, size.", none.clone()),
            ("read", "read", "Read up to 1 MiB of target memory, returned as hex.", json!({
                "type": "object", "required": ["address", "size"],
                "properties": { "address": addr("start"), "size": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 1048576 } } })),
            ("read_batch", "read_batch", "Several reads of up to 64 KiB each in one call.", json!({
                "type": "object", "required": ["reads"],
                "properties": { "reads": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "required": ["address", "size"],
                    "properties": { "address": addr("start"), "size": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 65536 } } } } } })),
            ("sig_scan", "sig_scan_ida", "IDA-style signature scan in a module, e.g. '48 8B 05 ? ? ? ?'.", json!({
                "type": "object", "required": ["pattern"],

                "type": "object", "required": ["name", "value"],
                "properties": { "name": { "type": "string" }, "value": { "type": ["boolean", "integer"] } } })),
        ]
    }

    /// one json-rpc message in, its response out, None for notifications
    pub fn handle(relay: &Relay, msg: &Value) -> Option<Value> {
        let id = msg.get("id")?.clone();
        let method = msg.get("method").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("");
        let params = msg.get("params").cloned().unwrap_or(json!({}));
        let result = match method {
            "initialize" => json!({
                "protocolVersion": params.get("protocolVersion").cloned().unwrap_or(json!("2025-06-18")),
                "capabilities": { "tools": {} },
                "serverInfo": { "name": "echo-reverse", "version": env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION") },
                "instructions": "Live memory of the process Echo is attached to, through Echo's hypervisor. Addresses are hex strings. Start with status. Raw Echo verbs (read, sig_scan, disassemble, ...) need echo-reverse-agent.as, write/scan/emulate need echo-reverse.as, the app_* style tools (pe, strings, unreal, dumps, signatures, scripts, navigation) need the echo-reverse window open.",
            }),
            "ping" => json!({}),
            "tools/list" => {
                let mut list: Vec<Value> = tools().into_iter()
                    .map(|(name, _, description, schema)| json!({ "name": name, "description": description, "inputSchema": schema }))
                    .collect();
                list.extend(relay.app_tools.lock().unwrap().iter().cloned());
                json!({ "tools": list })
            }
            "tools/call" => {
                let name = params.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("");
                let args = params.get("arguments").filter(|a| a.is_object()).cloned().unwrap_or(json!({}));
                let frame = if let Some((_, verb, _, _)) = tools().into_iter().find(|t| t.0 == name) {
                    let mut frame = args;
                    frame["type"] = json!(verb);
                    frame.as_object_mut()?.remove("id");
                    frame
                } else if relay.app_tools.lock().unwrap().iter().any(|t| t["name"] == name) {
                    json!({ "type": "app", "tool": name, "arguments": args })
                } else {
                    return Some(json!({ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id, "error": { "code": -32602, "message": format!("unknown tool {name}") } }));
                };
                let reply = relay.request(frame);
                // app tools answer with a ready result, echo verbs with their raw frame
                let text = match reply.get("result") {
                    Some(Value::String(text)) if reply["type"] == "app_result" => text.clone(),
                    Some(r) if reply["type"] == "app_result" => serde_json::to_string_pretty(r).unwrap_or_default(),
                    _ => reply.to_string(),
                };
                json!({
                    "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": text }],
                    "isError": reply.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("error"),
                })
            }
            _ => return Some(json!({ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id, "error": { "code": -32601, "message": format!("unknown method {method}") } })),
        };
        Some(json!({ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id, "result": result }))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn http(port: u16, req: &str) -> String {
        let mut s = TcpStream::connect(("127.0.0.1", port)).unwrap();
        s.write_all(req.as_bytes()).unwrap();
        let mut out = String::new();
        s.read_to_string(&mut out).unwrap();
        out
    }

    fn post(port: u16, origin: &str, body: &str) -> String {
        http(port, &format!(
            "POST /rpc HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1:{port}\r\n{origin}Content-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{body}",
            body.len()
        ))
    }

    #[test]
    fn limits_pending_requests_and_reports_health() {
        let relay = Relay::default();
        let (tx, _rx) = sync_channel(MAX_PENDING_PER_AGENT);
        *relay.core.out.lock().unwrap() = Some((42, tx));
        let mut receivers = Vec::new();
        for id in 1000..1000 + MAX_PENDING_PER_AGENT as u64 {
            let (tx, rx) = channel();
            relay.core.pending.lock().unwrap().insert(id, tx);
            receivers.push(rx);
        }
        let reply = relay.request(json!({"type": "ping"}));
        assert_eq!(reply["code"], "Busy");
        let status = relay.status();
        assert_eq!(status["core"], true);
        assert_eq!(status["lanes"]["core"]["generation"], 42);
        assert_eq!(status["lanes"]["core"]["pending"], MAX_PENDING_PER_AGENT);
        assert_eq!(status["lanes"]["core"]["rejected"], 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn routes_frames_to_agents_and_restores_ids() {
        let port = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap().local_addr().unwrap().port();
        serve(port).unwrap();

        // no agent yet: a clear error, not a hang
        assert!(post(port, "", r#"{"type":"ping","id":5}"#).contains("NoAgent"));

        // fake echo native socket: answers ping with the relay-assigned id
        let (mut ws, _) = tungstenite::connect(format!("ws://127.0.0.1:{port}/agent")).unwrap();
        std::thread::spawn(move || loop {
            let Ok(Message::Text(t)) = ws.read() else { return };
            let req: Value = serde_json::from_str(t.as_str()).unwrap();
            let reply = json!({ "type": format!("{}_result", req["type"].as_str().unwrap()), "id": req["id"], "attached": true });
            ws.send(Message::text(reply.to_string())).unwrap();
        });
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));

        let out = post(port, "", r#"{"type":"ping","id":5}"#);
        let body: Value = serde_json::from_str(out.split("\r\n\r\n").nth(1).unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(body["type"], "ping_result");
        assert_eq!(body["id"], 5);

        // write/attach-family verbs go to the ext agent, which isn't connected
        assert!(post(port, "", r#"{"type":"write","address":"0x1","data":"90"}"#).contains("/agent-ext"));
        assert!(post(port, "", r#"{"type":"attach","pid":42}"#).contains("/agent-ext"));
        assert!(http(port, &format!("GET /status HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1:{port}\r\n\r\n")).contains(r#""core":true"#));

        // foreign origins and rebinding hosts are refused before reaching the agent
        assert!(post(port, "Origin: https://evil.example\r\n", r#"{"type":"ping"}"#).starts_with("HTTP/1.1 403"));
        assert!(http(port, &format!("GET /status HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: evil.example:{port}\r\n\r\n")).starts_with("HTTP/1.1 403"));
        assert!(post(port, "Origin: http://localhost:1420\r\n", r#"{"type":"ping"}"#).contains("Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://localhost:1420"));

        // mcp: tools forward to the agents, notifications are accepted without a body
        let mcp = |body: &str| http(port, &format!(
            "POST /mcp HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1:{port}\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nAccept: application/json, text/event-stream\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{body}",
            body.len()
        ));
        let json_of = |out: String| serde_json::from_str::<Value>(out.split("\r\n\r\n").nth(1).unwrap()).unwrap();
        let init = json_of(mcp(r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18"}}"#));
        assert_eq!(init["result"]["protocolVersion"], "2025-06-18");
        assert!(mcp(r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"}"#).starts_with("HTTP/1.1 202"));
        let list = json_of(mcp(r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}"#));
        assert!(list["result"]["tools"].as_array().unwrap().iter().any(|t| t["name"] == "sig_scan"));
        assert!(list["result"]["tools"].as_array().unwrap().iter().any(|t| t["name"] == "raw_scan"));
        assert!(list["result"]["tools"].as_array().unwrap().iter().any(|t| t["name"] == "module_resource_tree"));
        for name in ["process_alive", "query_region", "resolve_export", "disassemble_detail"] {
            assert!(list["result"]["tools"].as_array().unwrap().iter().any(|t| t["name"] == name));
            assert!(EXT_VERBS.contains(&name));
        }
        let call = json_of(mcp(r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"ping","arguments":{}}}"#));
        assert_eq!(call["result"]["isError"], false);
        assert!(call["result"]["content"][0]["text"].as_str().unwrap().contains("ping_result"));
        // the app registers a tool on /agent-app and answers it
        let (mut app, _) = tungstenite::connect(format!("ws://127.0.0.1:{port}/agent-app")).unwrap();
        app.send(Message::text(r#"{"type":"hello","tools":[{"name":"image_info","description":"d","inputSchema":{"type":"object"}}]}"#)).unwrap();
        std::thread::spawn(move || loop {
            let Ok(Message::Text(t)) = app.read() else { return };
            let req: Value = serde_json::from_str(t.as_str()).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(req["tool"], "image_info");
            app.send(Message::text(json!({ "type": "app_result", "id": req["id"], "result": { "name": "game.exe" } }).to_string())).unwrap();
        });
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
        let list = json_of(mcp(r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":5,"method":"tools/list"}"#));
        assert!(list["result"]["tools"].as_array().unwrap().iter().any(|t| t["name"] == "image_info"));
        let info = json_of(mcp(r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":6,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"image_info","arguments":{}}}"#));
        assert_eq!(info["result"]["isError"], false);
        assert!(info["result"]["content"][0]["text"].as_str().unwrap().contains("game.exe"));
        let menu = json_of(mcp(r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":4,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"list_features","arguments":{}}}"#));
        assert_eq!(menu["result"]["isError"], true);
        assert!(menu["result"]["content"][0]["text"].as_str().unwrap().contains("/agent-ui"));
    }
}
```

`app/src-tauri/src/script_io.rs`:

```rs
use std::io::Write;
use std::path::Path;

/// Keep the previous script before replacing it, using unique backup names.
pub fn install(path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
    if path.exists() {
        let existing =
            std::fs::read(path).map_err(|e| format!("could not read existing script: {e}"))?;
        if existing == data {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let name = path
            .file_name()
            .ok_or("invalid script path")?
            .to_string_lossy();
        let dir = path.parent().ok_or("invalid script directory")?;
        let mut saved = false;
        for n in 1..=10000 {
            let backup = dir.join(format!("{name}.bak.{n}"));
            match std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
                .write(true)
                .create_new(true)
                .open(backup)
            {
                Ok(mut file) => {
                    file.write_all(&existing)
                        .map_err(|e| format!("could not back up script: {e}"))?;
                    saved = true;
                    break;
                }
                Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
                Err(e) => return Err(format!("could not back up script: {e}")),
            }
        }
        if !saved {
            return Err("could not create script backup: too many backups".into());
        }
    }
    std::fs::write(path, data).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn preserves_existing_versions_without_duplicate_backups() {
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("echo-script-test-{}", std::process::id()));
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
        let path = dir.join("test.as");
        install(&path, b"first").unwrap();
        install(&path, b"first").unwrap();
        assert!(!dir.join("test.as.bak.1").exists());
        install(&path, b"second").unwrap();
        install(&path, b"third").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read(dir.join("test.as.bak.1")).unwrap(), b"first");
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read(dir.join("test.as.bak.2")).unwrap(), b"second");
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&path).unwrap(), b"third");
        std::fs::remove_dir_all(dir).unwrap();
    }
}
```

```tsx
    void import("@/lib/mcpTools").then((module) => { mcp = module; module.startAppBridge(); });

    // Event handlers must be registered before connect() so the first frames
    // after the stream opens are not dropped
    const detachOutput = attachOutput();
    const detachWatch = attachWatch();
    const offTarget = on("target.changed", () => {
      mcp?.clearMcpCaches(); clearXrefCache(); useScanner.getState().invalidate();
      useMemory.getState().reset(); usePe.getState().reset();
      useDisasm.setState({ image: { ready: false }, functions: [], insns: [], selected: null, total: 0, strings: [], stringsTruncated: false, hypeReady: false, error: "Target or agent connection changed; reload the image." });
      useUnreal.setState({ ue: null, base: 0, module: "", busy: false, progress: "", error: "Target or agent connection changed; re-index." });
      useEngines.setState({ unity: null, source2: null, unityState: { busy: false, progress: "", error: "Target or agent connection changed; reload." }, source2State: { busy: false, progress: "", error: "Target or agent connection changed; rescan." } });
    });
    const offRelay = onRelayUrlChange(() => {
      invalidateTargetCaches();
      const target = { attached: false };
      useEngine.setState({ connected: false, target, lanes: { core: false, ext: false, ui: false, app: false } });
      emit("target.changed", target);
    });
    void start();
    const timer = setInterval(() => void useEngine.getState().refresh(), 3000);
    const checkUpdates = () => void useUpdater.getState().check();
    if ("__TAURI_INTERNALS__" in window) {
      void import("@tauri-apps/api/core").then(({ invoke }) => invoke<boolean>("update_requested"))
        .then((requested) => {
          if (requested) useUi.getState().openSettings();
          return useUpdater.getState().check(requested);
        })
        .catch(checkUpdates);
    }
    const updateTimer = setInterval(checkUpdates, 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    window.addEventListener("online", checkUpdates);
    return () => { clearInterval(timer); clearInterval(updateTimer); window.removeEventListener("online", checkUpdates); offRelay(); offTarget(); detachOutput(); detachWatch(); };
  }, [start, attachOutput, attachWatch]);

  const leftPanel = () => {
    // Keyed so switching rails remounts the panel and replays its enter
    // animation (see `.panel` in the motion section of app.css)
    switch (rail) {
      case "targets":
        return <TargetsPanel key="targets" />;
      case "modules":
        return <ModulesPanel key="modules" />;
      case "captures":
        return <CapturePanel key="captures" />;
      case "scripts":
        return <ScriptsPanel key="scripts" />;
      case "frida":
        return <FridaPanel key="frida" />;
      case "ai":
        return <AiChatPanel key="ai" />;
      case "unreal":
        return <UnrealPanel key="unreal" />;
      case "unity":
        return <UnityPanel key="unity" />;
      case "source2":
        return <Source2Panel key="source2" />;
      case "sigdoc":
        return <SigDocPanel key="sigdoc" />;
      case "rtti":
        return <RttiPanel key="rtti" />;
      case "types":
        return <DataTypesPanel key="types" />;
      case "overlay":
        return <OverlayPanel key="overlay" />;
      case "menu":
        return <MenuPanel key="menu" />;
      case "deobf":
        return <DeobfPanel key="deobf" />;
      case "bone_esp":
        return <BoneEspPanel key="bone_esp" />;
      case "memory_scanner":
        return <AdvancedMemoryScannerPanel key="memory_scanner" />;
      case "performance":
        return <PerformanceMonitorPanel key="performance" />;
      case "value_tracker":
        return <ValueTrackerPanel key="value_tracker" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="app" ref={appRef}>
      <TitleBar />

      {!boot.done && !offline ? (
        <Splash onOffline={() => { setRail("captures"); setOffline(true); }} />
      ) : (
        <div className="app-body">
          <ActivityRail active={rail} onSelect={setRail} onSettings={openSettings} />

          <Suspense fallback={<div className="panel"><div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>Loading view…</div></div>}>
            {leftPanel()}
          </Suspense>
          <Splitter axis="x" variable="--left-w" target={appRef} min={200} max={620} />

          <div className="center-col">
            <div className="center-top">
              <ScannerPanel />
              <Splitter axis="x" variable="--scan-w" target={appRef} min={220} max={620} />
              <WorkspacePanel />
            </div>
            <Splitter
              axis="y"
              variable="--bottom-h"
              target={appRef}
              min={100}
              max={640}
              invert
            />
            <OutputPanel />
          </div>

          <Splitter axis="x" variable="--right-w" target={appRef} min={220} max={620} invert />
          <InspectorPanel />
        </div>
      )}

      <StatusBar />
      {settingsOpen && <SettingsModal onClose={closeSettings} />}
      <TooltipLayer />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/components/ProcessIcon.tsx
// The per-row app icon from the mockup. Falls back to a generic glyph for system
// processes and anything the shell has no icon for

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AppWindow } from "lucide-react";
import { iconFor, onIconsResolved } from "@/lib/icons";

type Props = { path?: string; size?: number };

export default function ProcessIcon({ path, size = 14 }: Props) {
  const [, bump] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => onIconsResolved(() => bump((n) => n + 1)), []);

  const url = iconFor(path);

  if (typeof url === "string") {
    return (
      <img
        src={url}
        width={size}
        height={size}
        alt=""
        draggable={false}
        style={{ display: "block", flex: "none" }}
      />
    );
  }

  // undefined = still resolving, null = no icon. Both render the placeholder so
  // the row height never shifts
  return (
    <span
      className="faint"
      style={{
        display: "grid",
        placeItems: "center",
        width: size,
        height: size,
        flex: "none",
        opacity: url === undefined ? 0.25 : 0.5,
      }}
    >
      <AppWindow size={size - 2} strokeWidth={1.75} />
    </span>
  );
}
```
