```tsx
// ── OAuth popup flow ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function openOauthPopup(url: string): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const popup = window.open(url, 'echo-reverse-oauth', 'width=640,height=740,menubar=no,toolbar=no');
    if (!popup) { reject(new Error('Popup was blocked — allow popups for this site')); return; }
    const timer = setInterval(() => { if (popup.closed) { clearInterval(timer); reject(new Error('Window closed before auth completed')); } }, 1000);
    const handler = (e: MessageEvent) => {
      if (e.data?.type !== 'echo-reverse-oauth') return;
      clearInterval(timer);
      window.removeEventListener('message', handler);
      popup.close();
      if (e.data.code) resolve(e.data.code as string);
      else reject(new Error('No code in OAuth response'));
    };
    window.addEventListener('message', handler);
    setTimeout(() => { clearInterval(timer); window.removeEventListener('message', handler); reject(new Error('OAuth timed out')); }, 5 * 60_000);
  });
}

// ── provider card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ProviderCard({ def, defaultModel, onDefaultModelChange }: {
  def: ProviderDef;
  defaultModel: string;
  onDefaultModelChange: (m: string) => void;
}) {
  const isOllama = def.id === 'ollama';
  const [key, setKey] = useState(() => isOllama ? '' : getApiKey(def.id));
  const [ollamaUrl, setOllamaUrlState] = useState(getOllamaUrl);
  const [customModel, setCustomModelState] = useState(getCustomOllamaModel);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [testing, setTesting] = useState(false);
  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState('');
  const [oauthBusy, setOauthBusy] = useState(false);

  const connected = isOllama ? true : !!getApiKey(def.id);

  const save = useCallback((k: string) => {
    setApiKey(def.id, k.trim());
    setKey(k);
    setTestResult('');
  }, [def.id]);

  const disconnect = () => {
    setApiKey(def.id, '');
    setKey('');
    setTestResult('');
  };

  const runTest = async () => {
    setTesting(true);
    setTestResult('');
    if (!isOllama) setApiKey(def.id, key.trim());
    else { setOllamaUrl(ollamaUrl); setCustomOllamaModel(customModel); }
    const r = await testProvider(def.id);
    setTestResult(r);
    setTesting(false);
  };

  const doOauth = async () => {
    setOauthBusy(true);
    setTestResult('');
    try {
      const relay = getRelayUrl();
      const base = relay.replace(/\/rpc\/?$/, '');
      const callbackUrl = `${base}/oauth-callback?provider=${def.id}`;
      const oauthUrl = `https://openrouter.ai/auth?callback_url=${encodeURIComponent(callbackUrl)}&site_name=echo-reverse`;
      const code = await openOauthPopup(oauthUrl);
      save(code);
      setTestResult('Connected via OAuth');
    } catch (e) {
      setTestResult(`Error: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
    }
    setOauthBusy(false);
  };

  const modelCount = MODEL_CATALOG.filter(m => m.provider === def.id).length;

  return (
    <div style={{
      border: '1px solid var(--border)',
      borderRadius: 6,
      overflow: 'hidden',
      marginBottom: 8,
    }}>
      {/* header row */}
      <div
        style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 12px', cursor: 'pointer', background: 'var(--bg-2)' }}
        onClick={() => setOpen(o => !o)}
      >
        {/* provider initials badge */}
        <div style={{
          width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 6, flexShrink: 0,
          background: def.color, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
          fontWeight: 700, fontSize: def.initials.length > 1 ? 9 : 12, color: '#fff', letterSpacing: '-0.5px',
        }}>
          {def.initials}
        </div>

        <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 12 }}>{def.name}</span>
            <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>· {modelCount} model{modelCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10, marginTop: 1, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
            {def.description}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* status badge */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flexShrink: 0 }}>
          {connected ? (
            <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--accent)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 3 }}>
              <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', background: 'var(--accent)', display: 'inline-block' }} />
              Connected
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 3 }}>
              <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', background: 'var(--border)', display: 'inline-block' }} />
              Not connected
            </span>
          )}
          {open ? <ChevronDown size={12} /> : <ChevronRight size={12} />}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* expanded body */}
      {open && (
        <div style={{ padding: '10px 12px', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--bg-1)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
          {isOllama ? (
            <>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <input
                  className="select" style={{ flex: 1, fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: 11 }}
                  value={ollamaUrl} placeholder="http://localhost:11434"
                  onChange={e => setOllamaUrlState(e.target.value)}
                  onBlur={() => setOllamaUrl(ollamaUrl)}
                />
                <button className="row-action" disabled={testing} onClick={() => void runTest()}>
                  {testing ? <Loader size={11} className="spin" /> : 'Test'}
                </button>
              </div>
              <input
                className="select" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}
                placeholder="Custom model (e.g. llama3.3)" value={customModel}
                onChange={e => { setCustomModelState(e.target.value); setCustomOllamaModel(e.target.value); }}
              />
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* OAuth button for supported providers */}
              {def.oauthLabel && (
                <button
                  className="row-action" data-active
                  style={{ fontSize: 11, width: '100%', justifyContent: 'center' }}
                  disabled={oauthBusy}
                  onClick={() => void doOauth()}
                >
                  {oauthBusy ? <><Loader size={11} className="spin" /> Connecting…</> : def.oauthLabel}
                </button>
              )}

              {/* API key input */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
                <input
                  className="select"
                  style={{ flex: 1, fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: 11 }}
                  type="password"
                  value={key}
                  placeholder={def.keyPlaceholder ?? 'API key'}
                  onChange={e => save(e.target.value)}
                />
                <button className="row-action" disabled={testing || !key.trim()} onClick={() => void runTest()}>
                  {testing ? <Loader size={11} className="spin" /> : 'Test'}
                </button>
                {connected && (
                  <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Disconnect" onClick={disconnect}>
                    <X size={12} />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* get key link */}
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, fontSize: 10 }}>
                <a href={def.keysUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 3, textDecoration: 'none' }}>
                  <ExternalLink size={9} /> Get API key
                </a>
                <a href={def.docsUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 3, textDecoration: 'none' }}>
                  <ExternalLink size={9} /> Docs
                </a>
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* test result */}
          {testResult && (
            <div style={{
              fontSize: 10, padding: '3px 8px', borderRadius: 4,
              color: testResult.startsWith('Error') ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent)',
              background: testResult.startsWith('Error')
                ? 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 10%, transparent)'
                : 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent)',
              display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4,
            }}>
              {testResult.startsWith('Error') ? <X size={9} /> : <Check size={9} />}
              {testResult}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* default model selector for this provider */}
          {MODEL_CATALOG.filter(m => m.provider === def.id).length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 4 }}>
              <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10, flexShrink: 0 }}>Default model</span>
              <select
                value={defaultModel.startsWith(def.id) ? defaultModel : ''}
                onChange={e => e.target.value && onDefaultModelChange(e.target.value)}
                style={{ fontSize: 10, background: 'var(--bg-2)', color: 'var(--text)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 3, padding: '1px 4px', flex: 1 }}
              >
                {!defaultModel.startsWith(def.id) && <option value="">— pick a model —</option>}
                {MODEL_CATALOG.filter(m => m.provider === def.id).map(m => (
                  <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{m.label}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── OMP models.yml import card ────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ModelsYmlCard({ onReload }: { onReload: () => void }) {
  const [path, setPathState] = useState(getModelsYmlPath);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const loaded = getLoadedModels();

  const load = async (p = path) => {
    setBusy(true); setStatus('');
    try {
      const result = await applyModelsYml(p || undefined);
      const provCount = Object.keys(result.providers).length;
      const modelCount = Object.values(result.providers).reduce((s, p2) => s + (p2.models?.length ?? 0), 0);
      setStatus(`Loaded ${provCount} providers, ${modelCount} models`);
      onReload();
    } catch (e) {
      setStatus(`Error: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
    }
    setBusy(false);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ border: '1px solid var(--accent)', borderRadius: 6, overflow: 'hidden', marginBottom: 12 }}>
      <div
        style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '8px 12px', cursor: 'pointer', background: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, var(--bg-2))' }}
        onClick={() => setOpen(o => !o)}
      >
        <FileJson size={16} style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', flexShrink: 0 }} />
        <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 12 }}>OMP Models YAML</div>
          <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>
            {loaded
              ? `${Object.keys(loaded.providers).length} providers, ${Object.values(loaded.providers).reduce((s, p2) => s + (p2.models?.length ?? 0), 0)} models loaded`
              : 'Import providers and API keys from ~/.omp/agent/models.yml'}
          </div>
        </div>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: loaded ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 3 }}>
          {loaded && <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', background: 'var(--accent)', display: 'inline-block' }} />}
          {loaded ? 'Active' : 'Not loaded'}
        </span>
        {open ? <ChevronDown size={12} /> : <ChevronRight size={12} />}
      </div>

      {open && (
        <div style={{ padding: '10px 12px', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--bg-1)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
          <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>
            Path to your OMP <code>models.yml</code> (gitignored — keys stay local).
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
            <input
              className="select"
              style={{ flex: 1, fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: 11 }}
              value={path}
              placeholder="C:/Users/you/.omp/agent/models.yml"
              onChange={e => { setPathState(e.target.value); setModelsYmlPath(e.target.value); }}
            />
            <button className="row-action" data-active disabled={busy} onClick={() => void load()}>
              {busy ? <Loader size={11} className="spin" /> : loaded ? <RefreshCw size={11} /> : 'Load'}
            </button>
          </div>

          {status && (
            <div style={{
              fontSize: 10, padding: '3px 8px', borderRadius: 4,
              color: status.startsWith('Error') ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--accent)',
              background: status.startsWith('Error')
                ? 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 10%, transparent)'
                : 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent)',
              display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4,
            }}>
              {status.startsWith('Error') ? <X size={9} /> : <Check size={9} />}
              {status}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* loaded provider list */}
          {loaded && Object.entries(loaded.providers).map(([name, prov]: [string, OmpProvider]) => (
            prov.baseUrl ? (
              <div key={name} style={{ fontSize: 10, display: 'flex', gap: 8, padding: '3px 6px', background: 'var(--bg-2)', borderRadius: 3 }}>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, minWidth: 120 }}>{name}</span>
                <span className="faint">{prov.models?.length ?? 0} models</span>
                <span className="faint" style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', flex: 1 }}>{prov.baseUrl}</span>
              </div>
            ) : null
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── public component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function ProviderHub() {
  const [defaultModel, setDefaultModelState] = useState(getDefaultModel);
  const [, forceUpdate] = useState(0);

  const handleDefaultModel = (m: string) => {
    setDefaultModel(m);
    setDefaultModelState(m);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <ModelsYmlCard onReload={() => forceUpdate(n => n + 1)} />
      <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10, marginBottom: 8 }}>
        Keys stored locally in your browser — never sent anywhere except the provider's own API.
      </div>
      {DEFS.map(def => (
        <ProviderCard
          key={def.id}
          def={def}
          defaultModel={defaultModel}
          onDefaultModelChange={handleDefaultModel}
        />
      ))}
      <div style={{ marginTop: 6, display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>Global default model</span>
        <select
          value={defaultModel}
          onChange={e => handleDefaultModel(e.target.value)}
          style={{ fontSize: 10, background: 'var(--bg-2)', color: 'var(--text)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 3, padding: '2px 6px', flex: 1 }}
        >
          {MODEL_CATALOG.map(m => <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{m.label} ({m.provider})</option>)}
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/components/SettingsModal.tsx
// App settings — theme, motion, and relay URL.

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { getVersion } from "@tauri-apps/api/app";
import { Check, Copy, X } from "lucide-react";
import logoUrl from "@/assets/reverse-slop-icon.png";
import { echoRequest, getRelayUrl, setRelayUrl } from "@/lib/echo";
import { copyText } from "@/lib/clipboard";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";
import { useUpdater } from "@/store/updater";
import { kMotionOptions, osPrefersReduced, useMotion } from "@/store/motion";
import { kThemes, useTheme, type ThemeName } from "@/store/theme";
import ProviderHub from "@/components/ProviderHub";

type Props = { onClose: () => void };

export default function SettingsModal({ onClose }: Props) {
  const theme = useTheme((s) => s.theme);
  const setTheme = useTheme((s) => s.setTheme);
  const motion = useMotion((s) => s.motion);
  const setMotion = useMotion((s) => s.setMotion);
  const { backend, target, reconnect } = useEngine();
  const [relayUrl, setRelayUrlState] = useState(getRelayUrl);
  const [relayDirty, setRelayDirty] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [diagnostic, setDiagnostic] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const copiedReset = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const updater = useUpdater();
  const [version, setVersion] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => { if (isTauri()) void getVersion().then(setVersion); }, []);

  const mcpCommand = `claude mcp add --transport http echo-reverse ${relayUrl.replace(/\/rpc$/, "/mcp")}`;

  const saveRelay = () => {
    setRelayUrl(relayUrl.trim());
    setRelayDirty(false);
    setStatus("Relay URL saved. Reconnecting…");
    void reconnect().then(() => setStatus(null));
  };

  const diagnose = async () => {
    setDiagnostic("Checking relay…");
    const lines: string[] = [];
    try {
      const url = new URL(relayUrl.trim());
      url.pathname = url.pathname.replace(/\/rpc\/?$/, "/status");
      const response = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
      const lanes = await response.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
      const details = lanes.lanes as Record<string, { pending?: number; limit?: number; completed?: number; timeouts?: number; rejected?: number; last_latency_ms?: number; generation?: number }> | undefined;
      lines.push(...["core", "ext", "ui", "app"].map(k => {
        const d = details?.[k];
        return `${k}: ${lanes[k] === true ? "connected" : lanes[k] === false ? "not connected" : "unknown"}${d ? ` · generation ${d.generation ?? "–"} · pending ${d.pending}/${d.limit} · completed ${d.completed} · timeouts ${d.timeouts} · rejected ${d.rejected} · last ${d.last_latency_ms} ms` : ""}`;
      }));
    } catch (e) { lines.push(`Relay status unavailable: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`); }
    if (relayUrl.trim() !== getRelayUrl()) lines.push("Save the URL to test Echo requests.");
    else try {
      const ping = await echoRequest<{ attached?: boolean; pid?: number }>({ type: "ping" }, AbortSignal.timeout(5000));
      lines.push(ping.attached ? `Echo attached${ping.pid ? ` (PID ${ping.pid})` : ""}` : "Echo connected; no target attached");
    } catch (e) { lines.push(`Echo ping: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`); }
    if (relayUrl.trim() === getRelayUrl()) {
      try {
        const caps = await echoRequest<{ protocol?: string; verbs?: string[] }>({ type: "capabilities" }, AbortSignal.timeout(5000));
        lines.push(`Extension protocol: ${caps.protocol ?? "unknown"}`);
        const required = ["write", "regions", "scan_new", "scan_filter", "scan_clear", "emulate"];
        if (Array.isArray(caps.verbs)) {
          const missing = required.filter(verb => !caps.verbs!.includes(verb));
          lines.push(missing.length ? `Missing extension features: ${missing.join(", ")}` : "Extension features: available");
        } else lines.push("Extension did not report its supported features.");
        if (caps.protocol && caps.protocol !== "echo-reverse-ext/2" && caps.protocol !== "echo-reverse-ext/3") lines.push("Extension protocol differs from the version expected by this app.");
      } catch (e) { lines.push(`Extension capabilities unavailable: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}. Load the current echo-reverse.as in Echo.`); }
    }
    setDiagnostic(lines.join("\n"));
  };

  const copyUrl = async () => {
    try {
      await copyText(relayUrl);
      setCopied(true);
      if (copiedReset.current !== null) clearTimeout(copiedReset.current);
      copiedReset.current = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1600);
    } catch (e) {
      setStatus(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="modal-scrim" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="panel-head">
          <span className="panel-title">Settings</span>
          <div className="spacer" />
          <button className="icon-button" onClick={onClose}>
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="modal-body">
          <div className="settings-brand">
            <img src={logoUrl} alt="echo-reverse" draggable={false} />
            <div className="settings-brand-name">echo-reverse</div>
            <div className="settings-brand-sub">
              {backend.badge} backend · {target.attached ? `attached: ${target.name ?? "?"}` : "no target"}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="settings-group">
            <div className="settings-label">Theme</div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
              {kThemes.map((t) => (
                <button
                  key={t.id}
                  className="row-action"
                  data-active={theme === t.id}
                  onClick={() => setTheme(t.id as ThemeName)}
                >
                  {t.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="settings-group">
            <div className="settings-label">Motion</div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--pad-sm)", alignItems: "center" }}>
              {kMotionOptions.map((o) => (
                <button
                  key={o.id}
                  className="row-action"
                  data-active={motion === o.id}
                  data-tip={o.hint}
                  onClick={() => setMotion(o.id)}
                >
                  {o.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            {osPrefersReduced() && (
              <div className="settings-rows">
                Windows animation effects are disabled. "Auto" follows that; "On" overrides.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="settings-group">
            <div className="settings-label">Echo Relay</div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--pad-sm)", alignItems: "center" }}>
              <input
                className="select"
                style={{ flex: 1, fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)" }}
                value={relayUrl}
                placeholder="http://127.0.0.1:9000/rpc"
                onChange={(e) => { setRelayUrlState(e.target.value); setRelayDirty(true); }}
                onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") saveRelay(); }}
              />
              {relayDirty && (
                <button className="row-action" data-active onClick={saveRelay}>
                  Save
                </button>
              )}
              <button className="icon-button" data-tip={copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"} onClick={() => void copyUrl()}>
                {copied ? <Check size={14} /> : <Copy size={14} />}
              </button>
            </div>
            <button className="row-action" onClick={() => void diagnose()}>Diagnose connection</button>
            {diagnostic && <pre className="settings-rows faint" style={{ fontSize: 11, whiteSpace: "pre-wrap" }}>{diagnostic}</pre>}
            <div className="settings-rows faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
              The desktop app hosts this relay and copies echo-reverse.as into %APPDATA%\scripts on
              start. Attach your game in Echo and load echo-reverse.as from Echo's script menu to connect.
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="settings-group">
            <div className="settings-label">Updates</div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--pad-sm)", alignItems: "center" }}>
              <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{version ? `Version ${version}` : "Updates need the desktop app"}</span>
              <div className="spacer" />
              {updater.ready || updater.installedVersion ? (
                <button className="row-action" data-active disabled={updater.busy} onClick={() => void updater.install()}>
                  {updater.installedVersion ? "Restart app" : `Restart to update ${updater.ready!.version}`}
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button className="row-action" disabled={updater.busy || !version} onClick={() => void updater.check()}>
                  Check for updates
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            {updater.status && <div className="settings-rows faint" role="status" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{updater.status}</div>}
          </div>

          <div className="settings-group">
            <div className="settings-label">AI / LLM Providers</div>
            <ProviderHub />
          </div>

          <div className="settings-group">
            <div className="settings-label">MCP for agents</div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--pad-sm)", alignItems: "center" }}>
              <input className="select" style={{ flex: 1, fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)" }} readOnly value={mcpCommand} />
              <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Copy" onClick={() => void copyText(mcpCommand)}>
                <Copy size={14} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="settings-rows faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
              Every Echo verb as an MCP tool (read, sig_scan, disassemble, rtti, write, scan, emulate) plus the
              angel-menu-control lane (list_features, set_feature) on ws /agent-ui.
            </div>
          </div>

          {status !== null && <div className="settings-status">{status}</div>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/Splitter.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/Splitter.tsx
// drag handle that writes a css custom property, keeps the layout in css grid

import { useCallback, useRef } from "react";

type Props = {
  axis: "x" | "y";
  /** CSS variable to drive, e.g. "--left-w". */
  variable: string;
  /** Element the variable is set on. Defaults to the app root. */
  target?: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  /** Drag right/down shrinks instead of grows (handles on a panel's left edge). */
  invert?: boolean;
};

export default function Splitter({ axis, variable, target, min, max, invert }: Props) {
  const dragging = useRef(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const onPointerDown = useCallback(
    (down: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      const host = target?.current ?? document.documentElement;
      // start from the panel's rendered size: css may cap the track below the variable on narrow windows
      const panel = (invert === true ? down.currentTarget.nextElementSibling : down.currentTarget.previousElementSibling)?.getBoundingClientRect();
      const start = panel ? (axis === "x" ? panel.width : panel.height) : parseFloat(getComputedStyle(host).getPropertyValue(variable)) || min;
      const origin = axis === "x" ? down.clientX : down.clientY;

      dragging.current = true;
      ref.current?.setAttribute("data-dragging", "true");
      down.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(down.pointerId);

      const onMove = (move: PointerEvent) => {
        if (!dragging.current) return;
        const now = axis === "x" ? move.clientX : move.clientY;
        const delta = (now - origin) * (invert === true ? -1 : 1);
        const next = Math.min(max, Math.max(min, start + delta));
        host.style.setProperty(variable, `${Math.round(next)}px`);
      };

      const onUp = () => {
        dragging.current = false;
        ref.current?.removeAttribute("data-dragging");
        window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
        window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
      };

      window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
      window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
    },
    [axis, variable, target, min, max, invert],
  );

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="splitter" data-axis={axis} onPointerDown={onPointerDown} />
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/components/StatusBar.tsx
// indicator row, everything here is pushed by the engine so nothing polls

import { Download, MonitorCog, Settings2, SunMoon } from "lucide-react";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { kThemes, useTheme } from "@/store/theme";
import { useUi } from "@/store/ui";
import { useUpdater } from "@/store/updater";

type DotState = "ok" | "busy" | "bad" | "idle";

function Pill({ label, state }: { label: string; state: DotState }) {
  return (
    <span className="status-pill">
      <span className="dot" data-state={state} />
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

export default function StatusBar() {
  const { connected, backend, target, lanes } = useEngine();
  const image = useDisasm((s) => s.image);
  const theme = useTheme((s) => s.theme);
  const setTheme = useTheme((s) => s.setTheme);
  const openSettings = useUi((s) => s.openSettings);
  const setRail = useUi((s) => s.setRail);
  const update = useUpdater((s) => s.ready);
  const installedVersion = useUpdater((s) => s.installedVersion);
  const updateBusy = useUpdater((s) => s.busy);
  const install = useUpdater((s) => s.install);

  const cycleTheme = () => {
    const i = kThemes.findIndex((t) => t.id === theme);
    setTheme(kThemes[(i + 1) % kThemes.length].id);
  };

  return (
    <div className="statusbar">
      <span>
        {target.attached
          ? `${target.name ?? "target"} (${target.pid ?? 0})`
          : connected
            ? "Ready"
            : "Disconnected"}
      </span>

      <div className="spacer" />

      <Pill label={`Backend: ${backend.badge}`} state={connected ? "ok" : "bad"} />
      <Pill label={lanes.core ? "Echo Core: Up" : "Echo Core: Down"} state={lanes.core ? "ok" : connected ? "idle" : "bad"} />
      <Pill label={lanes.ext ? "Extension: Up" : "Extension: Off"} state={lanes.ext ? "ok" : "idle"} />
      <Pill label={lanes.ui ? "Menu: Up" : "Menu: Off"} state={lanes.ui ? "ok" : "idle"} />
      <Pill label={target.attached ? "Memory: Ready" : "Memory: Idle"} state={target.attached ? "ok" : "idle"} />
      <Pill label={image.ready ? `Image: ${image.name ?? "loaded"}` : "Image: none"} state={image.ready ? "ok" : "idle"} />

      <div className="status-actions">
        {(update || installedVersion) && (
          <button className="row-action" data-active disabled={updateBusy} onClick={() => void install()}>
            <Download size={12} /> {installedVersion ? "Restart app" : `Restart to update ${update!.version}`}
          </button>
        )}
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip={`Theme: ${theme}`} onClick={cycleTheme}>
          <SunMoon size={14} />
        </button>
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Scripts" onClick={() => setRail("scripts")}>
          <MonitorCog size={14} />
        </button>
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Settings" onClick={openSettings}>
          <Settings2 size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/TitleBar.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/TitleBar.tsx
// custom titlebar, drag region and window controls

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Minus, Square, X } from "lucide-react";
import { openBinary } from "@/lib/openBinary";
import { useTheme, type ThemeName, kThemes } from "@/store/theme";
import { useUi } from "@/store/ui";
import logoUrl from "@/assets/reverse-slop-icon.png";

type MenuName = "File" | "View" | "Window" | "Theme" | "Help";

async function windowAction(action: "minimize" | "toggleMaximize" | "close") {
  try {
    const mod = await import("@tauri-apps/api/window");
    const win = mod.getCurrentWindow();
    if (action === "minimize") await win.minimize();
    else if (action === "toggleMaximize") await win.toggleMaximize();
    else await win.close();
  } catch {
    // Running in a plain browser: nothing to drive
  }
}

export default function TitleBar() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<MenuName | null>(null);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const theme = useTheme((s) => s.theme);
  const setTheme = useTheme((s) => s.setTheme);
  const rail = useUi((s) => s.rail);
  const setRail = useUi((s) => s.setRail);
  const openSettings = useUi((s) => s.openSettings);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open === null) return;
    const onDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(null);
    };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") setOpen(null);
    };
    window.addEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    };
  }, [open]);

  const menu = (name: MenuName, body: React.ReactNode) => (
    <div className="menu-root" key={name}>
      <button
        className="menu-button"
        data-open={open === name}
        onClick={() => setOpen(open === name ? null : name)}
        onMouseEnter={() => open !== null && setOpen(name)}
      >
        {name}
      </button>
      {open === name && (
        <div className="menu-pop" onClick={() => setOpen(null)}>
          {body}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="titlebar" ref={rootRef}>
      <div className="brand">
        <img src={logoUrl} width={16} height={16} alt="" draggable={false} />
      </div>

      {menu(
        "File",
        <>
          <button className="menu-item" onClick={() => void openBinary()}>
            <span>Open binary…</span>
            <span className="faint">Ctrl+O</span>
          </button>
          <div className="menu-sep" />
          <button className="menu-item" onClick={() => void windowAction("close")}>
            <span>Exit</span>
            <span className="faint">Alt+F4</span>
          </button>
        </>,
      )}

      {menu(
        "View",
        <>
          {(
            [
              ["targets", "Targets"],
              ["modules", "Modules"],
              ["scripts", "Scripts"],
              ["unreal", "Unreal"],
              ["unity", "Unity (IL2CPP)"],
              ["source2", "Source 2"],
              ["sigdoc", "Signature Doctor"],
              ["rtti", "RTTI"],
            ] as const
          ).map(([id, label]) => (
            <button key={id} className="menu-item" onClick={() => setRail(id)}>
              <span>{label}</span>
              {rail === id && <span className="faint">●</span>}
            </button>
          ))}
        </>,
      )}

      {menu(
        "Window",
        <>
          <button className="menu-item" onClick={openSettings}>
            Settings…
          </button>
          <div className="menu-sep" />
          <button className="menu-item" onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>
            Reload interface
          </button>
        </>,
      )}

      {menu(
        "Theme",
        <>
          {kThemes.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              className="menu-item"
              onClick={() => setTheme(t.id as ThemeName)}
            >
              <span>{t.label}</span>
              {theme === t.id && <span className="faint">●</span>}
            </button>
          ))}
        </>,
      )}

      {menu(
        "Help",
        <button className="menu-item" disabled>
          echo-reverse · Echo relay backend
        </button>,
      )}

      <div className="titlebar-drag" data-tauri-drag-region />

      <div className="win-buttons">
        <button className="win-button" onClick={() => void windowAction("minimize")}>
          <Minus size={14} />
        </button>
        <button className="win-button" onClick={() => void windowAction("toggleMaximize")}>
          <Square size={12} />
        </button>
        <button className="win-button close" onClick={() => void windowAction("close")}>
          <X size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/TooltipLayer.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/TooltipLayer.tsx
// one global tooltip instead of the native title attribute, any element can
// opt in with data-tip

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

type Placed = {
  text: string;
  left: number;
  top: number;
  below: boolean;
};

/** Long enough not to flicker while the cursor crosses a toolbar. */
const kDelayMs = 380;
const kGap = 7;
const kMargin = 6;

export default function TooltipLayer() {
  const [tip, setTip] = useState<Placed | null>(null);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const bubbleRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const cancel = () => {
      if (timer.current !== null) {
        clearTimeout(timer.current);
        timer.current = null;
      }
      setTip(null);
    };

    const onOver = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const host = (e.target as Element | null)?.closest?.("[data-tip]");
      if (!(host instanceof HTMLElement)) {
        cancel();
        return;
      }
      const text = host.dataset.tip ?? "";
      if (text === "") {
        cancel();
        return;
      }
      if (timer.current !== null) clearTimeout(timer.current);
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        const r = host.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Prefer below; flip above when the element sits near the bottom edge
        // (the status bar and Output pane are full of tooltip targets)
        const below = r.bottom + 34 < window.innerHeight;
        setTip({
          text,
          left: r.left + r.width / 2,
          top: below ? r.bottom + kGap : r.top - kGap,
          below,
        });
      }, kDelayMs);
    };

    // Any interaction dismisses: a tooltip lingering over a menu that just
    // opened is worse than no tooltip
    document.addEventListener("pointerover", onOver, true);
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", cancel, true);
    document.addEventListener("wheel", cancel, true);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", cancel, true);
    window.addEventListener("blur", cancel);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerover", onOver, true);
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", cancel, true);
      document.removeEventListener("wheel", cancel, true);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", cancel, true);
      window.removeEventListener("blur", cancel);
      if (timer.current !== null) clearTimeout(timer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Clamp horizontally once the bubble has a measured width
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = bubbleRef.current;
    if (el === null || tip === null) return;
    const half = el.offsetWidth / 2;
    const clamped = Math.min(
      Math.max(tip.left, half + kMargin),
      window.innerWidth - half - kMargin,
    );
    if (Math.abs(clamped - tip.left) > 0.5) setTip({ ...tip, left: clamped });
  }, [tip]);

  if (tip === null) return null;

  return (
    <div
      ref={bubbleRef}
      className="tooltip"
      role="tooltip"
      style={{
        left: tip.left,
        top: tip.top,
        transform: `translate(-50%, ${tip.below ? "0" : "-100%"})`,
      }}
    >
      {tip.text}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/AdvancedMemoryScannerPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/AdvancedMemoryScannerPanel.tsx
// Advanced Memory Scanner Panel for Echo Backend

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useOverlay } from '@/hooks/useOverlay';
import { memory, util } from '@/lib/echo-extensions';
import { PanelProps } from './panelTypes';

interface ScanResult {
  address: string;
  pattern: string;
  mask: string;
  module: string;
}

interface ValueScanResult {
  address: string;
  value: string;
  module: string;
  type: string;
}

interface SignatureEntry {
  name: string;
  pattern: string;
  mask: string;
  module: string;
  description: string;
}

const AdvancedMemoryScannerPanel: React.FC<PanelProps> = ({ }) => {
  const overlay = useOverlay();
  
  // States
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'pattern' | 'value' | 'signature'>('pattern');
  const [isScanning, setIsScanning] = useState(false);
  const [scanResults, setScanResults] = useState<ScanResult[]>([]);
  const [valueScanResults, setValueScanResults] = useState<ValueScanResult[]>([]);
  const [signatureResults, setSignatureResults] = useState<ScanResult[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [modules, setModules] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [loadingModules, setLoadingModules] = useState(false);
  
  // Pattern scan form
  const [patternScanModule, setPatternScanModule] = useState('');
  const [pattern, setPattern] = useState('');
  const [mask, setMask] = useState('');
  
  // Value scan form
  const [valueScanModule, setValueScanModule] = useState('');
  const [valueType, setValueType] = useState('int32');
  const [searchValue, setSearchValue] = useState('');
  
  // Signature database form
  const [signatureName, setSignatureName] = useState('');
  const [signaturePattern, setSignaturePattern] = useState('');
  const [signatureMask, setSignatureMask] = useState('');
  const [signatureModule, setSignatureModule] = useState('');
  const [signatureDescription, setSignatureDescription] = useState('');
  const [signatures, setSignatures] = useState<SignatureEntry[]>([]);
  
  // Load modules
  const loadModules = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingModules(true);
    try {
      const result = await util.getModuleList();
      if (result.success && result.modules) {
        setModules(result.modules.map(m => m.name));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load modules:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingModules(false);
    }
  }, []);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    loadModules();
  }, [loadModules]);
  
  // Pattern scan
  const handlePatternScan = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!pattern) {
      setError('Please enter a pattern');
      return;
    }
    
    setIsScanning(true);
    setError(null);
    setScanResults([]);
    
    try {
      let results: ScanResult[] = [];
      
      if (patternScanModule) {
        // Scan specific module
        const result = await memory.patternScanModule(patternScanModule, pattern, mask);
        if (result.success && result.results) {
          results = result.results.map(r => ({
            address: r.address,
            pattern: r.pattern,
            mask: r.mask,
            module: r.module
          }));
        }
      } else {
        // Scan all modules
        const result = await memory.patternScanAll(pattern, mask);
        if (result.success && result.results) {
          results = result.results.map(r => ({
            address: r.address,
            pattern: r.pattern,
            mask: r.mask,
            module: r.module
          }));
        }
      }
      
      setScanResults(results);
      
      if (results.length === 0) {
        setError('No matches found');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(`Scan failed: ${err}`);
      console.error('Pattern scan error:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsScanning(false);
    }
  }, [patternScanModule, pattern, mask]);
  
  // Value scan
  const handleValueScan = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!searchValue) {
      setError('Please enter a value to search for');
      return;
    }
    
    setIsScanning(true);
    setError(null);
    setValueScanResults([]);
    
    try {
      const result = await memory.valueScan(valueScanModule, searchValue, valueType);
      if (result.success && result.results) {
        setValueScanResults(result.results);
      }
      
      if (!result.success || !result.results || result.results.length === 0) {
        setError('No matches found');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(`Scan failed: ${err}`);
      console.error('Value scan error:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsScanning(false);
    }
  }, [valueScanModule, searchValue, valueType]);
  
  // Add signature to database
  const handleAddSignature = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!signatureName || !signaturePattern) {
      setError('Please enter at least a name and pattern');
      return;
    }
    
    const newSignature: SignatureEntry = {
      name: signatureName,
      pattern: signaturePattern,
      mask: signatureMask,
      module: signatureModule,
      description: signatureDescription
    };
    
    setSignatures([...signatures, newSignature]);
    
    // Reset form
    setSignatureName('');
    setSignaturePattern('');
    setSignatureMask('');
    setSignatureModule('');
    setSignatureDescription('');
    
    setError(null);
  }, [signatureName, signaturePattern, signatureMask, signatureModule, signatureDescription, signatures]);
  
  // Scan all signatures
  const handleScanAllSignatures = useCallback(async () => {
    if (signatures.length === 0) {
      setError('No signatures in database');
      return;
    }
    
    setIsScanning(true);
    setError(null);
    setSignatureResults([]);
    
    try {
      const patterns = signatures.map(s => ({
        name: s.name,
        pattern: s.pattern,
        mask: s.mask,
        module: s.module
      }));
      
      const result = await memory.multiPatternScan(patterns);
      if (result.success && result.results) {
        setSignatureResults(result.results.map(r => ({
          address: r.address,
          pattern: r.pattern,
          mask: r.mask,
          module: r.module
        }));
      }
      
      if (!result.success || !result.results || result.results.length === 0) {
        setError('No signature matches found');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(`Scan failed: ${err}`);
      console.error('Signature scan error:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsScanning(false);
    }
  }, [signatures]);
  
  // Remove signature
  const handleRemoveSignature = useCallback((index: number) => {
    const newSignatures = [...signatures];
    newSignatures.splice(index, 1);
    setSignatures(newSignatures);
  }, [signatures]);
  
  // Clear results
  const clearResults = useCallback(() => {
    setScanResults([]);
    setValueScanResults([]);
    setSignatureResults([]);
    setError(null);
  }, []);
  
  // Format address for display
  const formatAddress = (addr: string) => {
    if (addr.startsWith('0x')) {
      return addr;
    }
    return `0x${parseInt(addr).toString(16)}`;
  };
  
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-[#1a1a2e] text-white p-4 overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4 border-b border-gray-700 pb-2">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">Advanced Memory Scanner</h2>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={clearResults}
            className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-700 rounded text-sm hover:bg-gray-600 transition-colors"
            disabled={isScanning}
          >
            Clear
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex border-b border-gray-700 mb-4">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('pattern')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm ${activeTab === 'pattern' ? 'bg-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
        >
          Pattern Scan
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('value')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm ${activeTab === 'value' ? 'bg-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
        >
          Value Scan
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('signature')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm ${activeTab === 'signature' ? 'bg-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
        >
          Signatures
        </button>
      </div>
      
      {/* Error display */}
      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 bg-red-900/50 border border-red-700 rounded text-red-300 text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
      
      {/* Tab content */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        {activeTab === 'pattern' && (
          <>
            {/* Pattern Scan Form */}
            <div className="mb-4 p-4 bg-gray-800 rounded">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Module (optional)</label>
                  <select
                    value={patternScanModule}
                    onChange={(e) => setPatternScanModule(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"
                    disabled={loadingModules}
                  >
                    <option value="">All Modules</option>
                    {modules.map((mod) => (
                      <option key={mod} value={mod}>{mod}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Mask (optional)</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={mask}
                    onChange={(e) => setMask(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="?? ?? ?? ??"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="md:col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Pattern *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={pattern}
                    onChange={(e) => setPattern(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="48 8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 85 C0 74"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={handlePatternScan}
                disabled={isScanning || !pattern}
                className="mt-4 px-6 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-600 disabled:cursor-not-allowed rounded transition-colors"
              >
                {isScanning ? 'Scanning...' : 'Scan'}
              </button>
            </div>
            
            {/* Pattern Scan Results */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto">
              <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded overflow-hidden">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead className="bg-gray-700">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Module</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Address</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Pattern</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {scanResults.length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={3} className="px-4 py-4 text-center text-gray-500">
                          No results. Enter a pattern and click Scan.
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      scanResults.slice(0, 1000).map((result, index) => (
                        <tr key={`${result.address}-${index}`} className="border-t border-gray-700">
                          <td className="px-4 py-2">{result.module}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono">{formatAddress(result.address)}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono text-xs max-w-xs truncate">
                            {result.pattern}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
                {scanResults.length > 1000 && (
                  <div className="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
                    Showing first 1000 of {scanResults.length} results
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        
        {activeTab === 'value' && (
          <>
            {/* Value Scan Form */}
            <div className="mb-4 p-4 bg-gray-800 rounded">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Module (optional)</label>
                  <select
                    value={valueScanModule}
                    onChange={(e) => setValueScanModule(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"
                    disabled={loadingModules}
                  >
                    <option value="">All Modules</option>
                    {modules.map((mod) => (
                      <option key={mod} value={mod}>{mod}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Type</label>
                  <select
                    value={valueType}
                    onChange={(e) => setValueType(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"
                  >
                    <option value="int8">Int 8</option>
                    <option value="int16">Int 16</option>
                    <option value="int32">Int 32</option>
                    <option value="int64">Int 64</option>
                    <option value="uint8">UInt 8</option>
                    <option value="uint16">UInt 16</option>
                    <option value="uint32">UInt 32</option>
                    <option value="uint64">UInt 64</option>
                    <option value="float">Float</option>
                    <option value="double">Double</option>
                    <option value="string">String</option>
                    <option value="pointer">Pointer</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="md:col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Value *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={searchValue}
                    onChange={(e) => setSearchValue(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="100 or 0x64 or 3.14"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"

                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Address</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Value</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Type</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={4} className="px-4 py-4 text-center text-gray-500">
                          No results. Enter a value and click Scan.
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      valueScanResults.slice(0, 1000).map((result, index) => (
                        <tr key={`${result.address}-${index}`} className="border-t border-gray-700">
                          <td className="px-4 py-2">{result.module}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono">{formatAddress(result.address)}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-2">{result.value}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-2">{result.type}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
                {valueScanResults.length > 1000 && (
                  <div className="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
                    Showing first 1000 of {valueScanResults.length} results
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        
        {activeTab === 'signature' && (
          <>
            {/* Signature Database Form */}
            <div className="mb-4 p-4 bg-gray-800 rounded">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>

                  />

                    value={signatureModule}
                    onChange={(e) => setSignatureModule(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"

                    ))}
                  </select>

                  <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Pattern *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={signaturePattern}
                    onChange={(e) => setSignaturePattern(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="48 8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ??"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Mask (optional)</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={signatureMask}
                    onChange={(e) => setSignatureMask(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="?? ?? ?? ?? ??"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="md:col-span-2">
                  <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Description (optional)</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={signatureDescription}
                    onChange={(e) => setSignatureDescription(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Unreal Engine GObjects pointer"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2 mt-4">
                <button
                  onClick={handleAddSignature}
                  disabled={!signatureName || !signaturePattern}
                  className="px-6 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-600 disabled:cursor-not-allowed rounded transition-colors"
                >
                  Add Signature
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={handleScanAllSignatures}
                  disabled={isScanning || signatures.length === 0}
                  className="px-6 py-2 bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 disabled:bg-gray-600 disabled:cursor-not-allowed rounded transition-colors"
                >
                  {isScanning ? 'Scanning...' : 'Scan All'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Signatures List */}
            <div className="mb-4">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-2">Signature Database ({signatures.length})</h3>
              <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded overflow-hidden max-h-[200px] overflow-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-xs">
                  <thead className="bg-gray-700 sticky top-0">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="px-3 py-1 text-left">Name</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-1 text-left">Pattern</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-1 text-left">Module</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-1 text-left w-16">Actions</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {signatures.length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={4} className="px-3 py-2 text-center text-gray-500">
                          No signatures. Add one above.
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      signatures.map((sig, index) => (
                        <tr key={`${sig.name}-${index}`} className="border-t border-gray-700">
                          <td className="px-3 py-1">{sig.name}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-1 font-mono truncate max-w-xs">{sig.pattern}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-1">{sig.module || 'Any'}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-1">
                            <button
                              onClick={() => handleRemoveSignature(index)}
                              className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 text-xs"
                            >
                              Remove
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Signature Scan Results */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto">
              <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded overflow-hidden">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead className="bg-gray-700">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Module</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Address</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Pattern</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {signatureResults.length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={3} className="px-4 py-4 text-center text-gray-500">
                          No results. Add signatures and click "Scan All".
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      signatureResults.slice(0, 1000).map((result, index) => (
                        <tr key={`${result.address}-${index}`} className="border-t border-gray-700">
                          <td className="px-4 py-2">{result.module}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono">{formatAddress(result.address)}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono text-xs max-w-xs truncate">
                            {result.pattern}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
                {signatureResults.length > 1000 && (
                  <div className="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
                    Showing first 1000 of {signatureResults.length} results
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AdvancedMemoryScannerPanel;
```

```tsx
const QUICK_ACTIONS = [
  { label: 'Analyze',     prompt: 'Analyze this function thoroughly: identify the algorithm, purpose, inputs/outputs, and any notable patterns or anomalies in the disassembly.' },
  { label: 'Find vulns',  prompt: 'Audit this disassembly for security vulnerabilities: buffer overflows, integer overflows, use-after-free, race conditions, type confusion, and any other exploitable conditions.' },

// ── helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function formatInsns(insns: Insn[]): string {
  return insns.map(i => `0x${i.va.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(16, '0')}  ${i.text}`).join('\n');
}

function buildContext(
  imageBase: number | undefined,
  imageName: string | undefined,
  fnLabel: string,
  fnVa: number,
  insns: Insn[],
): string {
  const baseStr = imageBase ? `Base: 0x${imageBase.toString(16).toUpperCase()}` : '';
  const moduleStr = imageName ? `Module: ${imageName}` : '';
  const header = [moduleStr, baseStr].filter(Boolean).join(' | ');
  return `${header ? header + '\n' : ''}Function: ${fnLabel} @ 0x${fnVa.toString(16).toUpperCase()}\n\n\`\`\`asm\n${formatInsns(insns)}\n\`\`\``;
}

export default function AiChatPanel() {

  const disasm = useDisasm();

  const [showSidebar, setShowSidebar] = useState(true);
  const [showSystemEdit, setShowSystemEdit] = useState(false);
  const [systemDraft, setSystemDraft] = useState(store.systemPrompt);
  const [model, setModel] = useState(() => conv?.model ?? getDefaultModel());

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const bottomRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  // keep model in sync with active conversation
  useEffect(() => {
    if (conv) setModel(conv.model);
  }, [conv?.id]);

  // scroll to bottom on new messages
  useEffect(() => {
    bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [conv?.messages.length, streaming]);

  // ensure there's an active conversation
  const ensureConv = useCallback((): string => {
    if (conv) return conv.id;
    return store.newConversation(model);
  }, [conv, store, model]);

  const send = useCallback(async (userText: string) => {
    const text = userText.trim();
    if (!text || streaming) return;

    setError(null);
    const id = ensureConv();
    store.addMessage(id, { role: 'user', content: text });
    setInput('');

    // build full messages array including system prompt
    const convNow = store.conversations.find(c => c.id === id)!;
    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [
      { role: 'system', content: store.systemPrompt },
      ...convNow.messages.filter(m => m.role !== 'tool_call'), // strip tool_call display messages
    ];
    // seed the assistant bubble immediately
    store.addMessage(id, { role: 'assistant', content: '' });

    const ac = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = ac;

      if (agentMode) {

              role: 'tool_call',

            });
            // re-seed the assistant bubble for the final response
            store.addMessage(id, { role: 'assistant', content: '' });
          },

        );

      }
    } catch (e) {

        setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));

// ── tool call bubble ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ToolCallBubble({ content }: { content: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  let name = 'echo_tool';
  let inputStr = '';
  let result = '';
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(content) as { name: string; input: Record<string, unknown>; result: string };
    name = parsed.name;
    inputStr = Object.entries(parsed.input).map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${JSON.stringify(v)}`).join(', ');
    result = parsed.result;
  } catch { result = content; }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
      <div style={{
        width: 22, height: 22, borderRadius: '50%', flexShrink: 0,
        background: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--bg-3))',
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
      }}>
        <Wrench size={11} style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }} />
      </div>
      <div
        style={{
          flex: 1, background: 'var(--bg-2)', border: '1px solid var(--border)',
          borderRadius: '4px 12px 12px 12px', padding: '4px 10px',
          fontSize: 11, cursor: 'pointer', userSelect: 'none',
        }}
        onClick={() => setOpen(o => !o)}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, color: 'var(--accent)' }}>
          <code style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{name}({inputStr})</code>
          <span style={{ opacity: 0.4, marginLeft: 'auto' }}>{open ? '▲' : '▼'}</span>
        </div>
        {open && (
          <pre style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: 10, whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', opacity: 0.75, maxHeight: 200, overflow: 'auto' }}>
            {result}
          </pre>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── message bubble ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function MessageBubble({ msg, streaming }: { msg: ChatMessage; streaming: boolean }) {
  const isUser = msg.role === 'user';
  return (
    <div style={{
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: isUser ? 'row-reverse' : 'row',
      gap: 6,
      alignItems: 'flex-start',
    }}>
      <div style={{
        width: 22, height: 22, borderRadius: '50%', flexShrink: 0,
        background: isUser ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--bg-3)',
        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
        fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: isUser ? '#000' : 'var(--text)',
      }}>
        {isUser ? 'U' : <Bot size={12} />}
      </div>
      <div style={{
        maxWidth: '85%',
        background: isUser ? 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, var(--bg-2))' : 'var(--bg-2)',
        border: '1px solid var(--border)',
        borderRadius: isUser ? '12px 4px 12px 12px' : '4px 12px 12px 12px',
        padding: '6px 10px',
        fontSize: 12,
        lineHeight: 1.5,
        wordBreak: 'break-word',
      }}>
        {isUser ? (
          <pre style={{ margin: 0, fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)', whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', fontSize: 12 }}>{msg.content}</pre>
        ) : (
          <>
            {msg.content ? <Markdown>{msg.content}</Markdown> : null}
            {streaming && <span className="cursor-blink">▋</span>}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
