```tsx
// Static analysis view for the selected function: a compact control-flow
// diagram, call targets and function-size statistics. This ports the useful
// analysis surfaces from web-mv into echo-reverse's existing workspace tabs.

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import { functionLabel, hex, useDisasm, type Insn } from "@/store/disasm";
import { xrayInsns, type XrayResult } from "@/lib/staticAnalysis";
import { applyPatch, clearJournal, exportIda, exportX64dbg, listPatches, nopRange, redoPatch, removeEntry, undoPatch } from "@/lib/patchJournal";
import { saveOrDownload } from "@/lib/files";
import { echoRequest } from "@/lib/echo";
import { complete, getDefaultModel, MODEL_CATALOG } from "@/lib/llm";

type Block = {
  id: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  insns: Insn[];
  edges: number[];
  external: boolean;
};

function buildBlocks(insns: Insn[]): Block[] {
  const blocks: Block[] = [];
  let current: Block | null = null;
  const start = (va: number): Block => {
    const block: Block = { id: blocks.length, start: va, end: va, insns: [], edges: [], external: false };
    blocks.push(block);
    return block;
  };
  for (let index = 0; index < insns.length; index++) {
    const insn = insns[index];
    if (!current) current = start(insn.va);
    current.insns.push(insn);
    current.end = insn.va + insn.len;
    if (insn.flow === "ret") {
      current = null;
    } else if (insn.flow === "jump" && insn.target !== undefined) {
      current.edges.push(-1); // resolved to the target block after all blocks exist
      current = null;
    } else if (insn.flow === "cond_jump") {
      const next = insns[index + 1];
      if (next) current.edges.push(-2); // fall-through
      current = null;
    }
  }
  const byStart = new Map(blocks.map((block) => [block.start, block.id]));
  for (const block of blocks) {
    block.edges = block.edges.map((edge) => {
      if (edge === -1) {
        const target = block.insns.at(-1)?.target;
        return target !== undefined && byStart.has(target) ? byStart.get(target)! : -1;
      }
      const next = block.insns.at(-1);
      const following = next ? byStart.get(next.va + next.len) : undefined;
      return following ?? -1;
    });
  }
  return blocks;
}

export default function AnalysisView() {
  const { functions, insns, selected, linear } = useDisasm();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"flow" | "calls" | "stats" | "operands" | "xray" | "patch" | "decompile">("flow");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");

  // decompile state
  const [decomp, setDecomp] = useState("");
  const [decompBusy, setDecompBusy] = useState(false);
  const [decompNote, setDecompNote] = useState("");
  const [decompModel, setDecompModel] = useState(() => getDefaultModel());

  // xray state
  const [xray, setXray] = useState<XrayResult | null>(null);
  const [xrayBusy, setXrayBusy] = useState(false);
  const [xrayNote, setXrayNote] = useState("");

  // patch state
  const [patchAddr, setPatchAddr] = useState("");
  const [patchHex, setPatchHex] = useState("");
  const [patchLabel, setPatchLabel] = useState("");
  const [patchNote, setPatchNote] = useState("");
  const [patchTick, setPatchTick] = useState(0); // force re-render on journal change
  const patches = listPatches();

  const selectedFunction = functions.find((fn) => fn.va === selected);

  const runDecompile = async () => {
    if (!insns.length) return;
    setDecompBusy(true); setDecompNote(`Sending to ${decompModel}…`); setDecomp("");
    try {
      const listing = insns.slice(0, 2000).map(i => `${hex(i.va)}  ${i.text}`).join("\n");
      const header = selectedFunction ? `; ${selectedFunction.symbol ?? hex(selectedFunction.va)}  size=0x${selectedFunction.size.toString(16)}` : "; unknown function";
      const text = await complete(
        "You are an expert reverse engineer. Decompile the provided x86-64 assembly listing to clean, readable pseudo-C. Use meaningful variable names inferred from context. Produce only the code with minimal inline comments on non-obvious logic.",
        `${header}\n\n${listing}`,
        decompModel,
      );
      setDecomp(text);
      setDecompNote("");
    } catch (e) {
      setDecompNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally { setDecompBusy(false); }
  };

  const runXray = async () => {
    if (!insns.length) return;
    setXrayBusy(true);
    setXray(null);
    setXrayNote("Running passes…");
    try {
      let rawBytes: Uint8Array | undefined;
      if (selectedFunction?.size) {
        try {
          const r = await echoRequest<{ success?: boolean; data?: string }>({ type: "read", address: hex(selectedFunction.va), size: selectedFunction.size });
          if (r.success && typeof r.data === "string") rawBytes = Uint8Array.from(r.data.match(/../g) ?? [], b => parseInt(b, 16));
        } catch { /* byte-level passes skip gracefully */ }
      }
      const result = xrayInsns(insns, rawBytes);
      setXray(result);
      setXrayNote(`Score ${result.score}/100 · ${result.ropGadgets.length} ROP · ${result.antiDebug.length} anti-debug · ${result.indirectBranches.length} indirect · ${result.cryptoHits.length} crypto`);
    } catch (e) {
      setXrayNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally { setXrayBusy(false); }
  };

  const doPatch = async () => {
    try {
      await applyPatch(parseInt(patchAddr, 16), patchHex, patchLabel);
      setPatchNote(`Applied at 0x${parseInt(patchAddr, 16).toString(16)}`);
      setPatchTick(t => t + 1);
    } catch (e) { setPatchNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); }
  };
  const doNop = async () => {
    const addr = parseInt(patchAddr, 16);
    const count = patchHex.replace(/\s+/g, '').length / 2 || 1;
    if (!addr) return;
    try { await nopRange(addr, count); setPatchNote(`NOPed ${count}B at 0x${addr.toString(16)}`); setPatchTick(t => t + 1); }
    catch (e) { setPatchNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); }
  };

  const blocks = useMemo(() => buildBlocks(insns), [insns]);
  const calls = useMemo(() => insns.filter((insn) => insn.flow === "call" && insn.target !== undefined), [insns]);
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const sizes = functions.map((fn) => fn.size).filter((size) => size > 0).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const total = sizes.reduce((sum, size) => sum + size, 0);
    return {
      count: sizes.length,
      total,
      median: sizes.length ? sizes[Math.floor(sizes.length / 2)] : 0,
      largest: sizes.at(-1) ?? 0,
      smallest: sizes[0] ?? 0,
    };
  }, [functions]);

  const operandRows = useMemo(() => {
    if (!query.trim()) return insns;
    let expression: RegExp;
    try { expression = new RegExp(query, "i"); }
    catch { return []; }
    return insns.filter((insn) => expression.test(insn.text));
  }, [insns, query]);

  if (!selectedFunction && insns.length === 0) {
    return <div className="empty"><div className="empty-title">No function selected.</div><div className="empty-hint">Choose a function in the disassembly list.</div></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      <div className="view-bar">
        {(["flow", "calls", "stats", "operands", "xray", "patch", "decompile"] as const).map((item) => (
          <button key={item} className="tab" data-active={mode === item} onClick={() => setMode(item)}>{item}</button>
        ))}
        <div className="spacer" />
        <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
          {selectedFunction ? `${functionLabel(selectedFunction)} @ ${hex(selectedFunction.va)}` : `${insns.length} instructions`}
          {linear ? " · linear listing" : ""}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="panel-body" style={{ overflow: "auto" }}>
        {mode === "flow" && (
          <>
            <div style={{ minWidth: 760, minHeight: 280, border: "1px solid var(--border-soft)", borderRadius: 5, background: "var(--bg-1)", padding: 12, overflow: "auto" }}>
              <svg width="100%" height={Math.max(260, blocks.length * 54 + 40)} viewBox={`0 0 900 ${Math.max(260, blocks.length * 54 + 40)}`} role="img" aria-label="Control flow graph">
                <defs><marker id="cfg-arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="var(--faint)" /></marker></defs>
                {blocks.flatMap((block) => block.edges.map((target, index) => {
                  if (target < 0) return null;
                  const from = { x: 120 + (block.id % 3) * 260, y: 24 + block.id * 54 };
                  const to = { x: 120 + (target % 3) * 260, y: 24 + target * 54 };
                  return <path key={`${block.id}-${index}`} d={`M ${from.x + 90} ${from.y} C ${from.x + 130} ${from.y}, ${to.x - 130} ${to.y}, ${to.x + 90} ${to.y}`} fill="none" stroke="var(--faint)" strokeWidth="1" markerEnd="url(#cfg-arrow)" opacity="0.7" />;
                }))}
                {blocks.map((block) => {
                  const x = 120 + (block.id % 3) * 260;
                  const y = 24 + block.id * 54;
                  const branch = block.insns.at(-1)?.flow === "cond_jump";
                  return (
                    <g key={block.id}>
                      <rect x={x - 90} y={y - 18} width="180" height="36" rx="5" fill="var(--bg-3)" stroke={branch ? "var(--accent)" : "var(--border)"} />
                      <text x={x} y={y - 2} textAnchor="middle" fill="var(--text)" fontSize="10" fontFamily="var(--font-mono)">{hex(block.start)}</text>
                      <text x={x} y={y + 11} textAnchor="middle" fill="var(--text-dim)" fontSize="9">{block.insns.length} instruction{block.insns.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}</text>
                    </g>
                  );
                })}
              </svg>
            </div>
            <div className="dbg-head">Basic blocks</div>
            {blocks.map((block) => (
              <details className="tree" key={block.id}>
                <summary><span className="mono">{hex(block.start)}</span><span className="faint">{block.insns.length} instructions · {block.edges.length} edge{block.edges.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}</span></summary>
                {block.insns.map((insn) => <div className="tree-leaf mono" key={insn.va}>{hex(insn.va)} {insn.text}</div>)}
              </details>
            ))}
          </>
        )}

        {mode === "calls" && (
          <table className="table">
            <thead><tr><th style={{ width: 140 }}>Call site</th><th>Target</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {calls.map((insn) => {
                const target = functions.find((fn) => insn.target !== undefined && fn.va === insn.target);
                return <tr key={insn.va}><td className="mono">{hex(insn.va)}</td><td className="mono">{target ? `${functionLabel(target)} @ ${hex(target.va)}` : hex(insn.target ?? 0)}</td></tr>;
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}

        {mode === "stats" && (
          <>
            <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(130px, 1fr))", gap: 8, padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
              {[['functions', stats.count], ['total bytes', stats.total], ['median', stats.median], ['largest', stats.largest], ['smallest', stats.smallest]].map(([label, value]) => (
                <div key={String(label)} className="deobf-summary" style={{ padding: 10 }}><div><div className="deobf-score" style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>{value}</div><div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{label}</div></div></div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <table className="table">
              <thead><tr><th>Function</th><th style={{ width: 130 }}>VA</th><th style={{ width: 90 }}>Size</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{[...functions].sort((a, b) => b.size - a.size).slice(0, 500).map((fn) => <tr key={fn.va}><td>{functionLabel(fn)}</td><td className="mono">{hex(fn.va)}</td><td className="mono">0x{fn.size.toString(16)}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
            </table>
          </>
        )}

        {mode === "operands" && (
          <>
            <div className="search" style={{ margin: 0 }}><Search size={13} /><input value={query} placeholder="Regex over instruction text…" onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} /></div>
            <table className="table">
              <thead><tr><th style={{ width: 140 }}>VA</th><th>Instruction</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{operandRows.map((insn) => <tr key={insn.va}><td className="mono">{hex(insn.va)}</td><td className="mono">{insn.text}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
            </table>
          </>
        )}

        {mode === "xray" && (
          <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", display: "grid", gap: 8 }}>
            <button className="row-action" disabled={xrayBusy || !insns.length} onClick={() => void runXray()}>{xrayBusy ? "Analyzing…" : "Run xray analysis"}</button>
            {xrayNote && <div className="faint">{xrayNote}</div>}
            {xray && <>
              <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(110px, 1fr))", gap: 8 }}>
                {[["score", xray.score + "/100"], ["ROP gadgets", xray.ropGadgets.length], ["anti-debug", xray.antiDebug.length], ["indirect", xray.indirectBranches.length], ["XOR ops", xray.xorDecryptors.length], ["crypto", xray.cryptoHits.length], ["entropy", xray.entropy !== null ? xray.entropy.toFixed(2) : "—"]].map(([k, v]) => (
                  <div key={String(k)} className="deobf-summary" style={{ padding: 8 }}><div className="deobf-score" style={{ fontSize: 18 }}>{v}</div><div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{k}</div></div>
                ))}
              </div>
              {xray.antiDebug.length > 0 && <details open><summary className="dbg-head" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>Anti-debug ({xray.antiDebug.length})</summary>
                <table className="table"><thead><tr><th style={{ width: 140 }}>VA</th><th>Pattern</th><th>Instruction</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>{xray.antiDebug.map(h => <tr key={h.address}><td className="mono">{hex(h.address)}</td><td>{h.pattern}</td><td className="mono">{h.text}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></details>}
              {xray.ropGadgets.length > 0 && <details><summary className="dbg-head" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>ROP gadgets ({xray.ropGadgets.length})</summary>
                <table className="table"><thead><tr><th style={{ width: 140 }}>VA</th><th>Kind</th><th>Instructions</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>{xray.ropGadgets.slice(0, 200).map(g => <tr key={g.address}><td className="mono">{hex(g.address)}</td><td>{g.kind}</td><td className="mono" style={{ overflowWrap: "anywhere" }}>{g.insns.join(" ; ")}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></details>}
              {xray.indirectBranches.length > 0 && <details><summary className="dbg-head" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>Indirect calls/jumps ({xray.indirectBranches.length})</summary>
                <table className="table"><thead><tr><th style={{ width: 140 }}>VA</th><th>Kind</th><th>Instruction</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>{xray.indirectBranches.map(b => <tr key={b.address}><td className="mono">{hex(b.address)}</td><td>{b.kind}</td><td className="mono">{b.text}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></details>}
              {xray.cryptoHits.length > 0 && <details open><summary className="dbg-head" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>Crypto constants ({xray.cryptoHits.length})</summary>
                <table className="table"><thead><tr><th style={{ width: 140 }}>VA</th><th>Algorithm</th><th>Bytes</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>{xray.cryptoHits.map(c => <tr key={c.address}><td className="mono">{hex(c.address)}</td><td>{c.name}</td><td className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{c.matchBytes}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></details>}
              {xray.xorDecryptors.length > 0 && <details><summary className="dbg-head" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>XOR operations ({xray.xorDecryptors.length})</summary>
                <table className="table"><thead><tr><th style={{ width: 140 }}>VA</th><th>Instruction</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>{xray.xorDecryptors.slice(0, 100).map(x => <tr key={x.address}><td className="mono">{hex(x.address)}</td><td className="mono">{x.text}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></details>}
            </>}
          </div>
        )}

        {mode === "patch" && (
          <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", display: "grid", gap: 8 }}>
            <label>Address <input className="addr-input" value={patchAddr} onChange={e => setPatchAddr(e.target.value)} placeholder="0x1400012345" /></label>
            <label>Bytes (hex) <input className="addr-input" value={patchHex} onChange={e => setPatchHex(e.target.value)} placeholder="90 90 90 or 909090" /></label>
            <label>Label (optional) <input className="addr-input" value={patchLabel} onChange={e => setPatchLabel(e.target.value)} /></label>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
              <button className="row-action" disabled={!patchAddr || !patchHex} onClick={() => void doPatch()}>Apply patch</button>
              <button className="row-action" disabled={!patchAddr} onClick={() => void doNop()}>NOP range</button>
            </div>
            {patchNote && <div className="faint" role="status">{patchNote}</div>}
            {patches.length > 0 && <>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                <button className="row-action" onClick={() => { void saveOrDownload("patches.py", exportIda()); }}>Export IDA Python</button>
                <button className="row-action" onClick={() => { void saveOrDownload("patches.txt", exportX64dbg()); }}>Export x64dbg</button>
                <button className="row-action" onClick={() => { clearJournal(); setPatchTick(t => t + 1); }}>Clear journal</button>
              </div>
              <table className="table" key={patchTick}>
                <thead><tr><th style={{ width: 160 }}>Address</th><th>Label</th><th>Bytes</th><th style={{ width: 120 }}>Actions</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>{patches.map(p => (
                  <tr key={p.address}>
                    <td className="mono">{hex(p.address)}</td>
                    <td>{p.label || <span className="faint">—</span>}</td>
                    <td className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, overflowWrap: "anywhere" }}>{p.applied ? p.patchHex : <span className="faint">{p.originalHex} (undone)</span>}</td>
                    <td style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4 }}>
                      {p.applied
                        ? <button className="row-action" onClick={() => { void undoPatch(p.address).then(() => setPatchTick(t => t + 1)).catch(e => setPatchNote(e.message)); }}>Undo</button>
                        : <button className="row-action" onClick={() => { void redoPatch(p.address).then(() => setPatchTick(t => t + 1)).catch(e => setPatchNote(e.message)); }}>Redo</button>}
                      <button className="row-action" onClick={() => { removeEntry(p.address); setPatchTick(t => t + 1); }}>×</button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}</tbody>
              </table>
            </>}
            {patches.length === 0 && <div className="faint">No patches yet. Enter an address + bytes and click Apply.</div>}
          </div>
        )}

        {mode === "decompile" && (
          <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", display: "grid", gap: 8 }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, alignItems: "center" }}>
              <select
                value={decompModel}
                onChange={e => setDecompModel(e.target.value)}
                style={{ flex: 1, background: "var(--bg-2)", color: "var(--text)", border: "1px solid var(--border)", borderRadius: 4, padding: "4px 6px", fontSize: 12 }}
              >
                {MODEL_CATALOG.map(m => <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{m.label}</option>)}
              </select>
              <button className="row-action" disabled={decompBusy || !insns.length} onClick={() => void runDecompile()}>
                {decompBusy ? "Decompiling…" : "Decompile"}
              </button>
            </div>
            {decompNote && <div className="faint" style={{ color: decompNote.toLowerCase().includes("key") || decompNote.startsWith("Error") ? "var(--danger)" : undefined }}>{decompNote}</div>}
            {!decomp && !decompBusy && (
              <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>Add API keys in Settings → AI. Sends the selected function's disassembly (up to 2000 instructions) to the chosen model.</div>
            )}
            {decomp && (
              <pre style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)", fontSize: 12, background: "var(--bg-1)", border: "1px solid var(--border-soft)", borderRadius: 4, padding: 10, overflowX: "auto", whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", wordBreak: "break-word" }}>
                {decomp}
              </pre>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

`app/src/components/panels/BoneEspPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/BoneEspPanel.tsx
// Bone ESP panel for Unreal Engine and other game engines
// Provides bone visualization and configuration for ESP overlays

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useUi } from "@/store/ui";
import { useEngineSupportActions, useUnreal, useSettings } from "@/store/echoExtensions";
import * as echoExt from "@/lib/echo-extensions";

// ============================================================================
// TYPES
// ============================================================================

interface BoneInfo {
  address: number;
  position: echoExt.Vec3;
  parentIndex: number;
  name: string;
}

interface EntityBoneInfo {
  entityAddress: number;
  skeletalMesh: number;
  boneArrayOffset: number;
  boneArrayCachedOffset: number;
  componentOffset: number;
  bones: BoneInfo[];
}

// ============================================================================
// COMPONENT
// ============================================================================

export default function BoneEspPanel() {
  const engine = useEngine();
  const unreal = useUnreal();
  const settings = useSettings();
  const {
    setUnrealGObjects,
    setUnrealGNames,
    setUnrealWorld,
    scanForUnreal,
    readUnrealBones,
    unrealW2S,
  } = useEngineSupportActions();

  // State for bone ESP
  const [boneEntities, setBoneEntities] = useState<EntityBoneInfo[]>([]);
  const [selectedEntity, setSelectedEntity] = useState<EntityBoneInfo | null>(null);
  const [scanInProgress, setScanInProgress] = useState(false);
  const [scanProgress, setScanProgress] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [addressInput, setAddressInput] = useState("");
  const [boneAddresses, setBoneAddresses] = useState<string>("");
  
  // Engine-specific addresses
  const [gObjects, setGObjects] = useState<string>("");
  const [gNames, setGNames] = useState<string>("");
  const [world, setWorld] = useState<string>("");
  const [perspective, setPerspective] = useState<string>("");
  
  // Bone configuration
  const [showBoneNames, setShowBoneNames] = useState(false);
  const [boneSize, setBoneSize] = useState(2);
  const [boneColor, setBoneColor] = useState("#FFFF00");
  const [lineThickness, setLineThickness] = useState(1);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // ENGINE ADDRESS MANAGEMENT
  // ========================================================================
  
  // Load saved addresses
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedGObjects = localStorage.getItem("echo-reverse-unreal-gobjects");
    const savedGNames = localStorage.getItem("echo-reverse-unreal-gnames");
    const savedWorld = localStorage.getItem("echo-reverse-unreal-world");
    const savedPerspective = localStorage.getItem("echo-reverse-unreal-perspective");
    
    if (savedGObjects) setGObjects(savedGObjects);
    if (savedGNames) setGNames(savedGNames);
    if (savedWorld) setWorld(savedWorld);
    if (savedPerspective) setPerspective(savedPerspective);
  }, []);
  
  const saveAddresses = useCallback(() => {
    localStorage.setItem("echo-reverse-unreal-gobjects", gObjects);
    localStorage.setItem("echo-reverse-unreal-gnames", gNames);
    localStorage.setItem("echo-reverse-unreal-world", world);
    localStorage.setItem("echo-reverse-unreal-perspective", perspective);
    
    // Update store
    setUnrealGObjects(echoExt.parseAddress(gObjects));
    setUnrealGNames(echoExt.parseAddress(gNames));
    setUnrealWorld(echoExt.parseAddress(world));
  }, [gObjects, gNames, world, perspective, setUnrealGObjects, setUnrealGNames, setUnrealWorld]);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // BONE SCANNING
  // ========================================================================
  
  const scanForBones = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!engine.connected) {
      setError("Not connected to Echo. Please attach a process first.");
      return;
    }
    
    setScanInProgress(true);
    setScanProgress("Starting bone scan...");
    setError(null);
    
    try {
      // For now, we'll just test the bone reading with a sample address
      // In a real implementation, we would:
      // 1. Find all entities
      // 2. For each entity, find skeletal mesh
      // 3. Read bones
      
      setScanProgress("Reading bones...");
      
      // Test with a placeholder address (would be replaced with actual entity address)
      const testSkeletalMesh = 0x12345678;
      const testBoneArrayOffset = 0x100;
      const testBoneArrayCachedOffset = 0x200;
      const testComponentOffset = 0x300;
      
      const result = await readUnrealBones({
        skeletalMesh: testSkeletalMesh,
        boneArrayOffset: testBoneArrayOffset,
        boneArrayCachedOffset: testBoneArrayCachedOffset,
        componentOffset: testComponentOffset,
        maxBones: 100,
      });
      
      if (result.success) {
        setScanProgress(`Found ${result.count} bones`);
        
        // Create sample bone data (in real implementation, we'd have real positions)
        const sampleBones: BoneInfo[] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(result.count, result.bones.length); i++) {
          sampleBones.push({
            address: echoExt.parseAddress(result.bones[i].address),
            position: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }, // Placeholder
            parentIndex: i > 0 ? i - 1 : -1,
            name: `Bone_${i}`,
          });
        }
        
        const entityInfo: EntityBoneInfo = {
          entityAddress: testSkeletalMesh,
          skeletalMesh: testSkeletalMesh,
          boneArrayOffset: testBoneArrayOffset,
          boneArrayCachedOffset: testBoneArrayCachedOffset,
          componentOffset: testComponentOffset,
          bones: sampleBones,
        };
        
        setBoneEntities([entityInfo]);
        setSelectedEntity(entityInfo);
      } else {
        setError("Failed to read bones. Check addresses and try again.");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(`Error scanning bones: ${err}`);
      console.error("Bone scan error:", err);
    } finally {
      setScanInProgress(false);
    }
  }, [engine.connected, readUnrealBones, setUnrealGObjects, setUnrealGNames, setUnrealWorld]);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // ADDRESS INPUT
  // ========================================================================
  
  const handleAddressSubmit = useCallback(async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!addressInput.trim()) return;
    
    const addr = echoExt.parseAddress(addressInput);
    
    try {
      // Try to read memory at this address
      const result = await echoExt.memory.readBuffer(addr, 64);
      
      if (result.success) {
        setBoneAddresses(`Address ${echoExt.toHex(addr)} is readable. Size: ${result.size} bytes`);
        
        // Try to interpret as various types
        if (result.data) {
          // Check if it looks like a pointer
          const asPointer = echoExt.parseAddress(result.data.substring(0, 16));
          setBoneAddresses((prev) => `${prev}\nPointer value: ${echoExt.toHex(asPointer)}`);
        }
      } else {
        setBoneAddresses("Failed to read address");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setBoneAddresses(`Error: ${err}`);
    }
  }, [addressInput]);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // W2S TEST
  // ========================================================================
  
  const testW2S = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!engine.connected) {
      setError("Not connected to Echo");
      return;
    }
    
    try {
      // Test W2S with a sample position
      const result = await unrealW2S({ x: 100, y: 200, z: 50 });
      
      if (result.success) {
        setBoneAddresses((prev) => `${prev}\nW2S Test: Success! Screen position: (${result.x?.toFixed(2)}, ${result.y?.toFixed(2)})`);
      } else {
        setBoneAddresses((prev) => `${prev}\nW2S Test: Failed - position may be off-screen`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setBoneAddresses((prev) => `${prev}\nW2S Test: Error - ${err}`);
    }
  }, [engine.connected, unrealW2S]);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // BONE SELECTION
  // ========================================================================
  
  const handleBoneSelect = useCallback((bone: BoneInfo) => {
    console.log("Selected bone:", bone);
    // Could update UI to highlight this bone, etc.
  }, []);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // RENDER
  // ========================================================================
  
  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Bone ESP (Unreal Engine)</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button
          className="row-action"
          onClick={scanForBones}
          disabled={scanInProgress || !engine.connected}
        >
          {scanInProgress ? "Scanning..." : "Scan Bones"}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="panel-body">
        <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
          {/* Engine Addresses */}
          <div style={{ marginBottom: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
            <details open>
              <summary style={{ cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 500, marginBottom: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
                Engine Addresses
              </summary>
              <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "var(--type-small)", marginBottom: "2px" }}>
                    GObjects
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={gObjects}
                    onChange={(e) => setGObjects(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="0x..."
                    style={{ width: "100%", padding: "4px 6px", fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "var(--type-small)", marginBottom: "2px" }}>
                    GNames
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={gNames}
                    onChange={(e) => setGNames(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="0x..."
                    style={{ width: "100%", padding: "4px 6px", fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "var(--type-small)", marginBottom: "2px" }}>
                    World
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={world}
                    onChange={(e) => setWorld(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="0x..."
                    style={{ width: "100%", padding: "4px 6px", fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "var(--type-small)", marginBottom: "2px" }}>
                    Perspective
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={perspective}
                    onChange={(e) => setPerspective(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="0x..."
                    style={{ width: "100%", padding: "4px 6px", fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                className="row-action"
                onClick={saveAddresses}
                style={{ marginTop: "var(--pad-sm)" }}
              >
                Save Addresses
              </button>
            </details>
          </div>

          {/* Address Tester */}
          <div style={{ marginBottom: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
            <details>
              <summary style={{ cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 500, marginBottom: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
                Address Tester
              </summary>
              <form onSubmit={handleAddressSubmit} style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--pad-sm)", alignItems: "center" }}>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={addressInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setAddressInput(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Enter address (hex or decimal)"
                  style={{ flex: 1, padding: "4px 6px", fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}
                />
                <button type="submit" className="row-action">
                  Test Address
                </button>
              </form>
              {boneAddresses && (
                <pre style={{ 
                  fontSize: "var(--type-mono)", 
                  marginTop: "var(--pad-sm)",
                  padding: "var(--pad-xs)",
                  background: "var(--bg-1)",
                  borderRadius: "var(--radius-sm)",
                  whiteSpace: "pre-wrap",
                  wordBreak: "break-word",
                  maxHeight: "100px",
                  overflow: "auto"
                }}>
                  {boneAddresses}
                </pre>
              )}
              <button
                className="row-action"
                onClick={testW2S}
                style={{ marginTop: "var(--pad-sm)" }}
                disabled={!engine.connected}
              >
                Test W2S
              </button>
            </details>
          </div>

          {/* Bone Visualization */}
          <div style={{ marginBottom: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
            <details open={boneEntities.length > 0}>
              <summary style={{ cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 500, marginBottom: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
                Bone Visualization ({boneEntities.length} entities)
              </summary>
              
              {error && (
                <div style={{ 
                  color: "var(--danger)", 
                  padding: "var(--pad-sm)",
                  marginBottom: "var(--pad-sm)",
                  background: "var(--bg-1)",
                  borderRadius: "var(--radius-sm)"
                }}>
                  {error}
                </div>
              )}
              
              {scanInProgress && (
                <div style={{ 
                  padding: "var(--pad-sm)", 
                  marginBottom: "var(--pad-sm)",
                  background: "var(--bg-1)",
                  borderRadius: "var(--radius-sm)"
                }}>
                  {scanProgress}
                </div>
              )}
              
              {selectedEntity && (
                <div>
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--pad-sm)", marginBottom: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
                    <button
                      className="row-action"
                      onClick={() => setSelectedEntity(null)}
                    >
                      Deselect
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="row-action"
                      onClick={() => console.log("Export bones", selectedEntity)}
                    >
                      Export Bones
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div style={{ 
                    padding: "var(--pad-sm)", 
                    background: "var(--bg-1)", 
                    borderRadius: "var(--radius-sm)",
                    marginBottom: "var(--pad-sm)"
                  }}>
                    <div><strong>Entity:</strong> {echoExt.toHex(selectedEntity.entityAddress)}</div>
                    <div><strong>Skeletal Mesh:</strong> {echoExt.toHex(selectedEntity.skeletalMesh)}</div>
                    <div><strong>Bone Count:</strong> {selectedEntity.bones.length}</div>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div style={{ maxHeight: "200px", overflow: "auto" }}>
                    <table className="table" style={{ fontSize: "var(--type-mono)" }}>
                      <thead>
                        <tr>
                          <th>Index</th>
                          <th>Address</th>
                          <th>Name</th>
                          <th>Parent</th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>
                      <tbody>
                        {selectedEntity.bones.map((bone, index) => (
                          <tr
                            key={index}
                            onClick={() => handleBoneSelect(bone)}
                            style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}
                          >
                            <td>{index}</td>
                            <td>{echoExt.toHex(bone.address)}</td>
                            <td>{bone.name}</td>
                            <td>{bone.parentIndex >= 0 ? bone.parentIndex : "root"}</td>
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              
              {!selectedEntity && boneEntities.length > 0 && (
                <div style={{ color: "var(--text-faint)" }}>
                  Select an entity to view bone details
                </div>
              )}
              
              {!selectedEntity && boneEntities.length === 0 && !scanInProgress && !error && (
                <div className="empty">
                  <div className="empty-hint">No bones scanned yet</div>
                  <div className="empty-hint">Click "Scan Bones" to start</div>
                </div>
              )}
            </details>
          </div>

          {/* Settings */}
          <details>
            <summary style={{ cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 500, marginBottom: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
              Visualization Settings
            </summary>
            <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
              <div>
                <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "var(--type-small)", marginBottom: "2px" }}>
                  Bone Color
                </label>
                <input
                  type="color"
                  value={boneColor}
                  onChange={(e) => setBoneColor(e.target.value)}
                  style={{ width: "100%", height: "28px" }}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "var(--type-small)", marginBottom: "2px" }}>
                  Line Color
                </label>
                <input
                  type="color"
                  value={lineColor}
                  onChange={(e) => setLineThickness(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  style={{ width: "100%", height: "28px" }}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "var(--type-small)", marginBottom: "2px" }}>
                  Bone Size
                </label>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min="1"
                  max="10"
                  value={boneSize}
                  onChange={(e) => setBoneSize(parseInt(e.target.value))}
                  style={{ width: "100%" }}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "var(--type-small)", marginBottom: "2px" }}>
                  Line Thickness
                </label>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min="1"
                  max="5"
                  step="0.1"
                  value={lineThickness}
                  onChange={(e) => setLineThickness(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  style={{ width: "100%" }}
                />
              </div>
              <div style={{ gridColumn: "1 / -1" }}>
                <label style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "var(--pad-sm)", cursor: "pointer" }}>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={showBoneNames}
                    onChange={(e) => setShowBoneNames(e.target.checked)}
                  />
                  <span style={{ fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}>Show Bone Names</span>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>
          </details>

          {/* Quick Actions */}
          <div style={{ marginTop: "var(--pad-md)", paddingTop: "var(--pad-md)", borderTop: "1px solid var(--border-soft)" }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: "var(--type-small)", color: "var(--text-dim)", marginBottom: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
              Quick Actions
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--pad-sm)", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
              <button
                className="row-action"
                onClick={scanForBones}
                disabled={scanInProgress || !engine.connected}
              >
                Scan All Bones
              </button>
              <button
                className="row-action"
                onClick={() => setBoneEntities([])}
                disabled={boneEntities.length === 0}
              >
                Clear Bones
              </button>
              <button
                className="row-action"
                onClick={testW2S}
                disabled={!engine.connected}
              >
                Test W2S
              </button>
              <button
                className="row-action"
                onClick={() => {
                  // Placeholder for bone ESP overlay toggle
                  console.log("Toggle Bone ESP overlay");
                }}
              >
                Toggle Overlay
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Help */}
          <div style={{ 
            marginTop: "var(--pad-md)", 
            padding: "var(--pad-sm)", 
            background: "var(--bg-1)", 
            borderRadius: "var(--radius-sm)",
            fontSize: "var(--type-mono)",
            color: "var(--text-faint)"
          }}>
            <strong>Note:</strong> This panel provides Bone ESP functionality for Unreal Engine games.
            Enter the correct engine addresses (GObjects, GNames, World, Perspective) for your game.
            Use the "Scan Bones" button to automatically find entities and read their bones.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

`app/src/components/panels/CapturePanel.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { captureRuntimeRange, captureStrings, captureWideStrings, compareRuntimeCaptures, parseRuntimeCapture, readCapture, searchCapture, type RuntimeCapture } from '@/lib/runtimeCapture';
import { saveOrDownload } from '@/lib/files';
import { useEngine } from '@/store/engine';
import { mapPeAddress, openOfflinePe, parsePeExports, parsePeImports, type OfflinePe, type PeExport, type PeImport } from '@/lib/offlinePe';
import { minidumpRegions, openMinidumpRegion, stitchMinidumpRegions, type DumpRegion } from '@/lib/minidump';
import { disassembleCapture, extractCallTargets, type CallTarget, type OfflineInstruction } from '@/lib/offlineDisasm';
import { setActiveCapture } from '@/lib/mcpTools';

export default function CapturePanel() {
  const target = useEngine(s => s.target);
  const [name, setName] = useState('capture');
  const [address, setAddress] = useState('0x1000');
  const [size, setSize] = useState('4096');
  const [before, setBefore] = useState<RuntimeCapture | null>(null);
  const [after, setAfter] = useState<RuntimeCapture | null>(null);
  const [note, setNote] = useState('Live reads are not atomic. Missing pages remain gaps.');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const controller = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const [view, setView] = useState('');
  const [diff, setDiff] = useState<ReturnType<typeof compareRuntimeCaptures> | null>(null);
  const [strings, setStrings] = useState<ReturnType<typeof captureStrings> | null>(null);
  const [wideStrings, setWideStrings] = useState<ReturnType<typeof captureWideStrings> | null>(null);
  const [pe, setPe] = useState<OfflinePe | null>(null);
  const [peImports, setPeImports] = useState<PeImport[] | null>(null);
  const [peExports, setPeExports] = useState<PeExport[] | null>(null);
  const [loadBase, setLoadBase] = useState('');
  const [dump, setDump] = useState<{ bytes: Uint8Array; name: string; regions: DumpRegion[] } | null>(null);
  const [stitched, setStitched] = useState<RuntimeCapture[]>([]);
  const [bitness, setBitness] = useState<32 | 64>(64);
  const [instructions, setInstructions] = useState<OfflineInstruction[]>([]);
  const [callTargets, setCallTargets] = useState<CallTarget[]>([]);
  const [searchPat, setSearchPat] = useState('');
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<Array<{ address: number; match: string }>>([]);
  const mapping = pe ? mapPeAddress(pe, Number(address)) : null;

  const activate = (capture: RuntimeCapture) => {
    setBefore(capture);
    setActiveCapture(capture);
  };

  const open = async (file: File | undefined, slot: 'before' | 'after') => {
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      if (file.size > 40 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error('Capture file is too large');
      const capture = parseRuntimeCapture(await file.text());
      if (slot === 'before') { activate(capture); setPe(null); }
      else setAfter(capture);
      setDiff(null); setStrings(null); setWideStrings(null); setInstructions([]); setCallTargets([]); setSearchResults([]);
      setNote(`Loaded ${capture.name}: ${capture.pages.filter(p => p.data === null).length} unreadable pages`);
    } catch (error) { setNote(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
  };
  const openPe = async (file: File | undefined) => {
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      if (file.size > 32 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error('PE file is too large');
      const image = openOfflinePe(new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()), file.name, loadBase.trim() ? Number(loadBase) : undefined);
      setPe(image); setPeImports(null); setPeExports(null);
      if (image.architecture === 'x86') setBitness(32);
      if (image.architecture === 'x64') setBitness(64);
      activate(image.capture);
      setAddress(`0x${image.capture.address.toString(16)}`);
      setSize('256');
      setView(''); setStrings(null); setWideStrings(null); setDiff(null); setInstructions([]); setCallTargets([]); setSearchResults([]);
      setNote('File-backed bytes only. Relocations and loader changes have not been applied; gaps are unknown.');
    } catch (error) { setNote(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
  };
  const openDump = async (file: File | undefined) => {
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      if (file.size > 128 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error('Minidump file exceeds 128 MiB');
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
      const regions = minidumpRegions(bytes);
      setDump({ bytes, name: file.name, regions });
      setStitched([]);
      setNote(`Found ${regions.length} memory regions. Select one or stitch all.`);
    } catch (error) { setDump(null); setNote(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
  };
  const selectRegion = (index: number) => {
    if (!dump || !dump.regions[index]) return;
    try {
      const capture = openMinidumpRegion(dump.bytes, dump.regions[index], dump.name);
      activate(capture); setPe(null); setAddress(`0x${capture.address.toString(16)}`); setSize('256');
      setView(''); setStrings(null); setWideStrings(null); setDiff(null); setInstructions([]); setCallTargets([]); setSearchResults([]);
      setNote(`Loaded ${capture.size} bytes from minidump region. Other regions are not included.`);
    } catch (error) { setNote(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
  };
  const stitchAll = () => {
    if (!dump) return;
    try {
      const groups = stitchMinidumpRegions(dump.bytes, dump.regions, dump.name);
      setStitched(groups);
      setNote(`Stitched into ${groups.length} group${groups.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}. Select a group to use it.`);
    } catch (error) { setNote(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
  };
  const capture = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    const pending = new AbortController();
    controller.current = pending;
    try {
      const result = await captureRuntimeRange(name, Number(address), Number(size), target.name ?? '', {
        signal: pending.signal,
        progress: (done, total) => setNote(`Capturing: ${Math.floor(done / total * 100)}%`),
      });
      activate(result);
      setPe(null); setView(''); setStrings(null); setWideStrings(null); setDiff(null); setInstructions([]); setCallTargets([]); setSearchResults([]);
      const path = await saveOrDownload(`capture-${result.name.replace(/[^\w.-]/g, '_')}.json`, JSON.stringify(result));
      setNote(`${path}; ${result.pages.filter(p => p.data === null).length} unreadable pages`);
    } catch (error) { setNote(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
    finally { controller.current = null; setBusy(false); }
  };
  const inspect = () => {
    if (!before) return;
    const bytes = readCapture(before, Number(address), Math.min(Number(size), 256));
    setView(bytes === null ? 'Outside capture or unreadable.' : bytes.match(/.{1,32}/g)?.join('\n') ?? '');
  };
  const compare = () => {
    if (!before || !after) return;
    try { setDiff(compareRuntimeCaptures(before, after, 100)); }
    catch (error) { setNote(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
  };
  const disassemble = async () => {
    if (!before) return;
    try {
      const insns = await disassembleCapture(before, Number(address), Math.min(Number(size), 4096), bitness);
      setInstructions(insns);
      setCallTargets([]);
    } catch (error) { setInstructions([]); setCallTargets([]); setNote(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
  };
  const search = () => {
    if (!before || !searchPat.trim()) return;
    try { setSearchResults(searchCapture(before, searchPat, 200)); }
    catch (error) { setNote(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)); }
  };
  const exportDisasmScript = () => {
    if (!instructions.length) return;
    const lines = instructions.map(i => `idc.set_cmt(0x${i.address.toString(16)}, "${i.text.replace(/"/g, "'")}", 0)`);
    const script = `# IDA Python — generated disassembly comments\nimport idc\n${lines.join('\n')}\n`;
    void saveOrDownload('disasm-comments.py', script);
  };

  return <div className="panel" style={{ overflow: 'auto' }}>
    <div className="panel-head"><span className="panel-title">Runtime captures</span></div>
    <div style={{ padding: 'var(--pad-sm)', display: 'grid', gap: 8 }}>

      {/* ── live capture ── */}
      <label>Capture name <input className="addr-input" value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} /></label>
      <label>Address <input className="addr-input" value={address} onChange={e => setAddress(e.target.value)} /></label>
      <label>Size in bytes <input className="addr-input" value={size} onChange={e => setSize(e.target.value)} /></label>
      <button className="row-action" disabled={busy || !target.attached} onClick={() => void capture()}>{busy ? 'Capturing…' : 'Capture and save'}</button>
      {busy && <button className="row-action" onClick={() => controller.current?.abort()}>Cancel capture</button>}

      {/* ── open saved capture ── */}
      <label>Open capture <input type="file" accept=".json,application/json" onChange={e => void open(e.target.files?.[0], 'before')} /></label>

      {/* ── PE ── */}
      <label>PE load base (optional) <input className="addr-input" value={loadBase} onChange={e => setLoadBase(e.target.value)} placeholder="preferred base" /></label>
      <label>Open PE file <input type="file" accept=".exe,.dll,.sys,.efi" onChange={e => void openPe(e.target.files?.[0])} /></label>

      {/* ── minidump ── */}
      <label>Open minidump <input type="file" accept=".dmp,.mdmp" onChange={e => void openDump(e.target.files?.[0])} /></label>
      {dump && <>
        <label>Memory region <select defaultValue="" onChange={e => selectRegion(Number(e.target.value))}>
          <option value="" disabled>Select a region…</option>
          {dump.regions.map((region, i) => <option key={i} value={i}>0x{region.address.toString(16)} · {region.size.toLocaleString()} bytes</option>)}
        </select></label>
        <button className="row-action" onClick={stitchAll}>Stitch nearby regions into groups</button>
        {stitched.length > 0 && <label>Stitched group <select defaultValue="" onChange={e => { const c = stitched[Number(e.target.value)]; if (c) { activate(c); setPe(null); setAddress(`0x${c.address.toString(16)}`); setSize('256'); } }}>
          <option value="" disabled>Select a group…</option>
          {stitched.map((c, i) => <option key={i} value={i}>0x{c.address.toString(16)} · {c.size.toLocaleString()} bytes · {c.pages.filter(p => p.data !== null).length}/{c.pages.length} pages present</option>)}
        </select></label>}
      </>}

      {/* ── comparison ── */}
      <label>Open comparison <input type="file" accept=".json,application/json" onChange={e => void open(e.target.files?.[0], 'after')} /></label>

      <div className="faint" role="status">{note}</div>
      {before && <div><strong>{before.name}</strong>: 0x{before.address.toString(16)} · {before.size.toLocaleString()} bytes · {before.pages.filter(p => p.data === null).length} unreadable pages</div>}

      {/* ── PE header info ── */}
      {pe && <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85em' }}>
        {pe.architecture} · entry RVA 0x{pe.entryRva.toString(16)} · preferred base 0x{pe.preferredBase.toString(16)}
        {mapping && <div>cursor RVA 0x{mapping.rva.toString(16)} · {mapping.section ?? 'unmapped'} · {mapping.fileOffset === null ? 'no file bytes' : `file 0x${mapping.fileOffset.toString(16)}`}</div>}
        <details><summary>{pe.sections.length} sections</summary>
          {pe.sections.map(s => <div key={s.rva}>{s.name} RVA 0x{s.rva.toString(16)} file 0x{s.rawOffset.toString(16)} {s.rawSize.toLocaleString()}B flags 0x{s.flags.toString(16)}</div>)}
        </details>
        <button className="row-action" onClick={() => setPeExports(pe ? parsePeExports(pe) : null)}>Parse exports</button>
        <button className="row-action" onClick={() => setPeImports(pe ? parsePeImports(pe) : null)}>Parse imports</button>
        {peExports !== null && <details open><summary>{peExports.length} exports</summary>
          {peExports.map(e => <div key={e.ordinal} style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>#{e.ordinal} {e.name ?? '<unnamed>'} RVA 0x{e.rva.toString(16)}{e.forwarded ? ` → ${e.forwarded}` : ''}</div>)}
        </details>}
        {peImports !== null && <details open><summary>{peImports.length} import modules</summary>
          {peImports.map(m => <details key={m.module}><summary>{m.module} ({m.functions.length} functions)</summary>
            {m.functions.map((f, i) => <div key={i} style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>{f.name ?? `#${f.ordinal}`}{f.hint !== null ? ` hint ${f.hint}` : ''} IAT 0x{f.iatRva.toString(16)}</div>)}
          </details>)}
        </details>}
      </div>}

      {/* ── hex inspect ── */}
      <button className="row-action" disabled={!before} onClick={inspect}>Read up to 256 bytes as hex</button>
      {view && <pre style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', overflowWrap: 'anywhere', fontSize: '0.82em' }}>{view}</pre>}

      {/* ── disassembly ── */}
      <label>Disassembly mode <select value={bitness} onChange={e => setBitness(e.target.value === '32' ? 32 : 64)}><option value="32">x86</option><option value="64">x64</option></select></label>
      <button className="row-action" disabled={!before} onClick={() => void disassemble()}>Disassemble range</button>
      {instructions.length > 0 && <>
        <button className="row-action" onClick={() => setCallTargets(extractCallTargets(instructions))}>Extract call/jmp targets</button>
        <button className="row-action" onClick={exportDisasmScript}>Export as IDA Python comments script</button>
        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82em' }}>
          {instructions.map(item => <div key={item.address} style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>0x{item.address.toString(16)}: {item.text}{item.invalid ? ' (invalid)' : ''}</div>)}
        </div>
      </>}
      {callTargets.length > 0 && <details open><summary>{callTargets.length} call/jmp targets</summary>
        {callTargets.map((t, i) => <div key={i}>0x{t.from.toString(16)} {t.mnemonic} → 0x{t.to.toString(16)}</div>)}
      </details>}

      {/* ── compare ── */}
      <button className="row-action" disabled={!before || !after} onClick={compare}>Compare captures (diff)</button>
      {diff && <div><div>{diff.changed} changed bytes · {diff.unavailable} unavailable{diff.truncated ? ' · first 100 shown' : ''}</div>
        {diff.changes.map(change => <div key={change.address}>0x{change.address.toString(16)}: {change.before} → {change.after}</div>)}
      </div>}

      {/* ── pattern search ── */}
      <label>Pattern search (IDA style: 48 89 ?? 24) <input className="addr-input" value={searchPat} onChange={e => setSearchPat(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 48 89 5C 24 ??" /></label>
      <button className="row-action" disabled={!before || !searchPat.trim()} onClick={search}>Search in capture</button>
      {searchResults.length > 0 && <div>
        <div>{searchResults.length} match{searchResults.length !== 1 ? 'es' : ''}</div>
        {searchResults.map(r => <div key={r.address} style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere', fontSize: '0.82em' }}>0x{r.address.toString(16)}: {r.match}</div>)}
      </div>}

      {/* ── strings ── */}
      <button className="row-action" disabled={!before} onClick={() => before && setStrings(captureStrings(before, 4, 200))}>Extract ASCII strings</button>
      {strings && <div><div>{strings.matches} strings{strings.truncated ? ' · first 200 shown' : ''}</div>
        {strings.strings.map(item => <div key={item.address} style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere', fontSize: '0.82em' }}>0x{item.address.toString(16)}: {item.text}{item.truncated ? '…' : ''}</div>)}
      </div>}
      <button className="row-action" disabled={!before} onClick={() => before && setWideStrings(captureWideStrings(before, 4, 200))}>Extract UTF-16 (wide) strings</button>
      {wideStrings && <div><div>{wideStrings.matches} wide strings{wideStrings.truncated ? ' · first 200 shown' : ''}</div>
        {wideStrings.strings.map(item => <div key={item.address} style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere', fontSize: '0.82em' }}>0x{item.address.toString(16)}: {item.text}{item.truncated ? '…' : ''}</div>)}
      </div>}
    </div>
  </div>;
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/DataTypesPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// Reusable struct and enum registry. This is the data-type workflow ported
// from web-mv, kept inside the existing reverse-slop activity rail.

import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Braces, Download, Plus, Trash2, Upload } from "lucide-react";
import {
  exportCppHeader,
  fieldSize,
  kPrimitiveTypes,
  structSize,
  validateRegistry,
  type PrimitiveTypeId,
} from "@/lib/dataTypes";
import { download } from "@/lib/files";
import { useDataTypes } from "@/store/dataTypes";
import { useUi } from "@/store/ui";

export default function DataTypesPanel() {
  const {
    registry,
    addStruct,
    renameStruct,
    removeStruct,
    addField,
    updateField,
    removeField,
    addEnum,
    renameEnum,
    removeEnum,
    setEnumUnderlying,
    addEnumMember,
    updateEnumMember,
    removeEnumMember,
    importJson,
    setActiveStruct,
  } = useDataTypes();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"structs" | "enums">("structs");
  const [structId, setStructId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [enumId, setEnumId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const setTab = useUi((s) => s.setTab);

  const selectedStruct = registry.structs.find((s) => s.id === structId) ?? registry.structs[0];
  const selectedEnum = registry.enums.find((e) => e.id === enumId) ?? registry.enums[0];
  const errors = useMemo(() => validateRegistry(registry), [registry]);

  const useInMemory = () => {
    if (!selectedStruct) return;
    setActiveStruct(selectedStruct.name);
    setTab("memory");
  };

  const exportJson = () => download("echo-reverse-data-types.json", JSON.stringify(registry, null, 2));
  const exportCpp = () => {
    try {
      download("echo-reverse-data-types.hpp", exportCppHeader(registry));
      setNote("C++ header exported");
    } catch (e) {
      setNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    }
  };

  const importFile = async (file: File | undefined) => {
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      const problems = importJson(await file.text());
      setNote(problems.length ? problems.join("; ") : "Registry imported");
    } catch (e) {
      setNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateRows: "auto auto 1fr", minHeight: 0 }}>
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Data Types</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Export registry JSON" onClick={exportJson}><Download size={13} /></button>
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Export C++ header" onClick={exportCpp}><Braces size={13} /></button>
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Import registry JSON" onClick={() => fileInput.current?.click()}><Upload size={13} /></button>
        <input ref={fileInput} type="file" accept=".json,application/json" hidden onChange={(e) => { void importFile(e.currentTarget.files?.[0]); e.currentTarget.value = ""; }} />
      </div>

      <div className="view-bar" style={{ gap: "var(--pad-xs)", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
        <button className="row-action" data-active={mode === "structs"} onClick={() => setMode("structs")}>Structs ({registry.structs.length})</button>
        <button className="row-action" data-active={mode === "enums"} onClick={() => setMode("enums")}>Enums ({registry.enums.length})</button>
        {mode === "structs" ? (
          <button className="row-action" onClick={() => { const id = addStruct(); setStructId(id); }}><Plus size={11} /> Struct</button>
        ) : (
          <button className="row-action" onClick={() => { const id = addEnum(); setEnumId(id); }}><Plus size={11} /> Enum</button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="panel-body" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
        {errors.length > 0 && <div style={{ color: "var(--danger)", fontSize: 11, marginBottom: 8 }}>{errors.join("; ")}</div>}
        {note !== null && <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11, marginBottom: 8 }}>{note}</div>}

        {mode === "structs" && (
          selectedStruct ? (
            <>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 5, alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 8 }}>
                <input
                  className="addr-input mono"
                  style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}
                  value={selectedStruct.name}
                  onChange={(e) => renameStruct(selectedStruct.id, e.target.value)}
                  aria-label="Struct name"
                />
                <span className="pill">{structSize(registry, selectedStruct)} B</span>
                <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Delete struct" onClick={() => { removeStruct(selectedStruct.id); setStructId(null); }}><Trash2 size={12} /></button>
              </div>
              <select className="select" value={selectedStruct.id} onChange={(e) => setStructId(e.target.value)} style={{ width: "100%", marginBottom: 8 }} aria-label="Struct">
                {registry.structs.map((s) => <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name}</option>)}
              </select>
              <div className="dbg-head">Fields</div>
              {selectedStruct.fields.map((field, index) => {
                let offset = 0;
                for (const prior of selectedStruct.fields.slice(0, index)) offset += fieldSize(registry, prior);
                const current = field.kind === "primitive" ? `p:${field.typeId}` : field.kind === "struct" ? `s:${field.refName}` : `e:${field.refName}`;
                return (
                  <div key={field.id} className="dt-field">
                    <div className="dt-field-grid">
                      <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 9 }}>+0x{offset.toString(16)}</span>
                      <input className="addr-input mono" value={field.name} onChange={(e) => updateField(selectedStruct.id, field.id, { name: e.target.value })} aria-label="Field name" />
                      <select
                        className="select"
                        value={current}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const raw = e.target.value;
                          if (raw.startsWith("p:")) updateField(selectedStruct.id, field.id, { kind: "primitive", typeId: raw.slice(2) as PrimitiveTypeId, refName: undefined });
                          else updateField(selectedStruct.id, field.id, { kind: raw.startsWith("s:") ? "struct" : "enum", refName: raw.slice(2) });
                        }}
                        aria-label="Field type"
                      >
                        <optgroup label="Primitives">{kPrimitiveTypes.map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={`p:${p.id}`}>{p.label}</option>)}</optgroup>
                        {registry.structs.length > 0 && <optgroup label="Structs">{registry.structs.map((s) => <option key={s.id} value={`s:${s.name}`}>{s.name}</option>)}</optgroup>}
                        {registry.enums.length > 0 && <optgroup label="Enums">{registry.enums.map((e) => <option key={e.id} value={`e:${e.name}`}>{e.name}</option>)}</optgroup>}
                      </select>
                      <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Remove field" onClick={() => removeField(selectedStruct.id, field.id)}><Trash2 size={11} /></button>
                    </div>
                    <div className="dt-field-options">
                      {field.kind === "primitive" && (field.typeId === "string" || field.typeId === "wstring") && (
                        <label>chars <input className="addr-input mono" type="number" min={0} max={65536} value={field.length ?? 0} onChange={(e) => updateField(selectedStruct.id, field.id, { length: Number(e.target.value) || 0 })} aria-label="String length" /></label>
                      )}
                      <label>count <input className="addr-input mono" type="number" min={1} max={4096} value={field.count ?? 1} onChange={(e) => updateField(selectedStruct.id, field.id, { count: Number(e.target.value) || 1 })} aria-label="Element count" /></label>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 5, marginTop: 8 }}>
                <button className="row-action" onClick={() => addField(selectedStruct.id)}><Plus size={11} /> Field</button>
                <button className="row-action" data-active="true" onClick={useInMemory}>Use in Memory</button>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : <div className="empty-hint">No structs yet. Add one to define a reusable memory layout.</div>
        )}

        {mode === "enums" && (
          selectedEnum ? (
            <>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 5, alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 8 }}>
                <input className="addr-input mono" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }} value={selectedEnum.name} onChange={(e) => renameEnum(selectedEnum.id, e.target.value)} aria-label="Enum name" />
                <select className="select" value={selectedEnum.underlying} onChange={(e) => setEnumUnderlying(selectedEnum.id, e.target.value as PrimitiveTypeId)} aria-label="Underlying type">
                  {kPrimitiveTypes.filter((p) => !["float", "double", "string", "wstring"].includes(p.id)).map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.label}</option>)}
                </select>
                <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Delete enum" onClick={() => { removeEnum(selectedEnum.id); setEnumId(null); }}><Trash2 size={12} /></button>
              </div>
              <select className="select" value={selectedEnum.id} onChange={(e) => setEnumId(e.target.value)} style={{ width: "100%", marginBottom: 8 }} aria-label="Enum">
                {registry.enums.map((e) => <option key={e.id} value={e.id}>{e.name}</option>)}
              </select>
              <div className="dbg-head">Members</div>
              {selectedEnum.members.map((member, index) => (
                <div key={index} className="dt-member">
                  <input className="addr-input mono" value={member.name} onChange={(e) => updateEnumMember(selectedEnum.id, index, { name: e.target.value })} aria-label="Enum member" />
                  <input className="addr-input mono" type="number" value={member.value} onChange={(e) => updateEnumMember(selectedEnum.id, index, { value: Number(e.target.value) || 0 })} aria-label="Enum value" />
                  <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Remove member" onClick={() => removeEnumMember(selectedEnum.id, index)}><Trash2 size={11} /></button>
                </div>
              ))}
              <button className="row-action" style={{ marginTop: 8 }} onClick={() => addEnumMember(selectedEnum.id)}><Plus size={11} /> Member</button>
            </>
          ) : <div className="empty-hint">No enums yet. Add one to name integer values.</div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
