`app/src/components/panels/DeobfPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/DeobfPanel.tsx
// Obfuscation triage and static-tool handoff. Echo reads the image; the heavy
// devirtualizers (NoVmp, VTIL, Triton, vmp-lazy-unpack) stay external and get a
// dump plus ready-to-run import/lift scripts for that dump.

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ClipboardCopy, Download, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { copyText } from "@/lib/clipboard";
import {
  analyzeDeobf,
  buildHandoff,
  buildOffsets,
  importFunctionNames,
  saveArtifacts,
  type DeobfReport,
  type FnRow,
  type OffsetFormat,
} from "@/lib/deobf";
import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";
import { download } from "@/lib/files";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";

const kTone: Record<string, string> = {
  high: "var(--danger)",
  medium: "var(--warning)",
  low: "var(--accent)",
  info: "var(--text-dim)",
};

async function functionsFor(report: DeobfReport): Promise<FnRow[]> {
  const [{ functions }, pe] = await Promise.all([
    call<{ functions: FnRow[] }>("disasm", "functions"),
    call<{ exports: Array<{ name: string; rva: number }> }>("disasm", "pe"),
  ]);
  const exportAt = new Map(pe.exports.map((e) => [report.base + e.rva, e.name]));
  return functions.map((f) => ({ ...f, name: exportAt.get(f.va) }));
}

export default function DeobfPanel() {
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const [report, setReport] = useState<DeobfReport | null>(null);
  const [fns, setFns] = useState<FnRow[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState("");
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [format, setFormat] = useState<OffsetFormat>("hpp");

  const scan = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setNote(null);
    setProgress("reading PE headers…");
    try {
      const r = await analyzeDeobf(setProgress);
      setReport(r);
      setFns(await functionsFor(r));
      setProgress("");
    } catch (e) {
      setNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
      setProgress("");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handoff = async () => {
    if (!report) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setNote(null);
    try {
      const { artifacts } = await buildHandoff(report, fns, setProgress);
      if (isTauri()) {
        const paths = await saveArtifacts(artifacts, setProgress);
        setNote(`${artifacts.length} files written, e.g. ${paths[paths.length - 1]}`);
      } else {
        for (const a of artifacts) download(a.name, a.data);
        setNote(`${artifacts.length} files downloaded. Keep them in one folder: the scripts reference each other by name.`);
      }
      setProgress("");
    } catch (e) {
      setNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
      setProgress("");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const importNames = async (file: File | undefined) => {
    if (!file || !report) return;
    try {
      if (file.size > 16 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error("manifest exceeds 16 MiB");
      const pe = await call<{ image: string; image_base: number; size_of_image: number }>("disasm", "pe");
      if (pe.image.toLowerCase() !== report.module.toLowerCase() || pe.image_base !== report.base || pe.size_of_image !== report.imageSize) throw new Error("attached image changed; scan again before importing");
      const names = importFunctionNames(await file.text(), report, fns);
      if (!names.size) { setNote("No matching named functions found."); return; }
      if (!useDisasm.getState().functions.length) await useDisasm.getState().refreshFunctions();
      setFns(prev => prev.map(f => names.has(f.va) ? { ...f, name: names.get(f.va) } : f));
      useDisasm.setState(state => ({ functions: state.functions.map(f => names.has(f.va) ? { ...f, symbol: names.get(f.va) } : f) }));
      setNote(`Imported ${names.size} names by RVA into the current session. Verify they correspond to this build.`);
    } catch (e) { setNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); }
  };

  const exportOffsets = async () => {
    if (!report) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setNote(null);
    try {
      const file = buildOffsets(report, fns, format);
      if (isTauri()) {
        const [path] = await saveArtifacts([{ ...file, tool: "offsets" }]);
        setNote(`saved to ${path}`);
      } else { download(file.name, file.data); setNote(`downloaded ${file.name}`); }
    } catch (e) {
      setNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (!target.attached) {
    return (
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><span className="panel-title">Deobfuscation</span></div>
        <div className="empty">
          <div className="empty-title">No process attached.</div>
          <div className="empty-hint">Attach in Echo, then scan the module for packer and VM indicators.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Deobfuscation</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Copy triage report" disabled={!report}
          onClick={() => report && void copyText(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2))}>
          <ClipboardCopy size={14} />
        </button>
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Scan the attached module" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void scan()}>
          <RefreshCw size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="panel-body" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", display: "grid", gap: "var(--pad-md)", alignContent: "start" }}>
        {!report && (
          <section>
            <div className="empty-hint" style={{ marginBottom: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
              Samples the attached module, measures section entropy, and checks the usual packer/VMProtect
              signatures. Nothing is written until a handoff is built.
            </div>
            <button className="row-action" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void scan()}>
              {busy ? "Scanning…" : "Scan module"}
            </button>
          </section>
        )}

        {report && (
          <>
            <section className="deobf-summary">
              <div>
                <div className="deobf-score" style={{ color: report.score >= 55 ? "var(--danger)" : report.score >= 25 ? "var(--warning)" : "var(--success, #4caf50)" }}>
                  {report.score}
                </div>
                <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>/ 100</div>
              </div>
              <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                <div className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{report.module}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: kTone[report.score >= 55 ? "high" : report.score >= 25 ? "medium" : "info"] }}>
                  {report.verdict}
                </div>
                <div className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 10.5 }}>
                  base 0x{report.base.toString(16)} · entry 0x{report.entry.toString(16)} ·{" "}
                  {(report.imageSize / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MiB · {report.imports} imports · {fns.length} functions
                </div>
              </div>
            </section>

            <section>
              <div className="view-label">Sections</div>
              <table className="deobf-table">
                <thead><tr><th>name</th><th>rva</th><th>size</th><th>entropy</th><th>flags</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>
                  {report.sections.map((s) => (
                    <tr key={`${s.name}:${s.rva}`}>
                      <td className="mono">{s.name || "(unnamed)"}</td>
                      <td className="mono">0x{s.rva.toString(16)}</td>
                      <td className="mono">{s.vsize.toString(16)}</td>
                      <td className="mono" style={{ color: s.entropy >= 7.2 ? "var(--danger)" : s.entropy >= 6.8 ? "var(--warning)" : undefined }}>
                        {s.entropy.toFixed(2)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="faint">{s.exec ? "X" : ""}{s.writable ? "W" : ""}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </section>

            <section>
              <div className="view-label">Findings ({report.findings.length})</div>
              {report.findings.length === 0 && <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>No packer or VM indicators found.</div>}
              {report.findings.map((f) => (
                <div key={f.id} className="deobf-finding">
                  <span className="deobf-tag" style={{ color: kTone[f.severity], borderColor: kTone[f.severity] }}>{f.severity}</span>
                  <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5 }}>{f.title}</div>
                    <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10.5 }}>{f.detail}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </section>

            <section>
              <div className="view-label">Handoff</div>
              <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10.5, marginBottom: "var(--pad-xs)" }}>
                Dumps the module with the live base and imports rebuilt, then writes NoVmp/VTIL notes,
                Triton lifter, IDA, Ghidra, radare2 and SuperGhidra import files.
              </div>
              <button className="row-action" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void handoff()}>
                <Download size={12} style={{ marginRight: 6, verticalAlign: -2 }} />
                {busy ? "Working…" : "Build handoff bundle"}
              </button>
            </section>

            <section>
              <div className="view-label">Import function names</div>
              <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10.5 }}>Import a handoff JSON whose module and image size match. Names are rebased by RVA and remain in this session.</div>
              <button className="row-action" disabled={busy} onClick={() => input.current?.click()}>Import manifest</button>
              <input ref={input} type="file" accept=".json,application/json" hidden onChange={e => { void importNames(e.currentTarget.files?.[0]); e.currentTarget.value = ""; }} />
            </section>

            <section>
              <div className="view-label">Offsets only</div>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--pad-xs)" }}>
                <select className="select" value={format} onChange={(e) => setFormat(e.target.value as OffsetFormat)}>
                  <option value="hpp">C++ header</option>
                  <option value="json">JSON manifest</option>
                  <option value="ida">IDA script</option>
                  <option value="ghidra">Ghidra script</option>
                  <option value="r2">radare2 script</option>
                </select>
                <button className="row-action" style={{ flex: 1 }} disabled={busy} onClick={() => void exportOffsets()}>
                  Export
                </button>
              </div>
            </section>
          </>
        )}

        {progress !== "" && <div className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 10.5 }}>{progress}</div>}
        {note !== null && <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10.5 }}>{note}</div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/DisassemblyView.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/DisassemblyView.tsx
// port of the disasm view, function list and instruction listing, both
// virtualized since a real binary has tens of thousands of each

import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { Pencil, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { xrefsTo, type Xref } from "@/lib/xrefs";
import { functionLabel, hex, useDisasm, type FunctionRow } from "@/store/disasm";
import { echoRequest } from "@/lib/echo";

const kRow = 20;

function flowColor(flow: string): string | undefined {
  switch (flow) {
    case "call":
      return "var(--accent)";
    case "jump":
    case "cond_jump":
      return "var(--warning)";
    case "ret":
      return "var(--danger)";
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

function FunctionList() {
  const { functions, total, selected, filter, setFilter, select, rename } = useDisasm();
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    if (filter === "") return functions;
    const needle = filter.toLowerCase();
    return functions.filter(
      (f) =>
        functionLabel(f).toLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
        hex(f.va).toLowerCase().includes(needle.replace(/^0x/, "")),
    );
  }, [functions, filter]);

  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: rows.length,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 15,
  });

  const commit = async (fn: FunctionRow, value: string) => {
    setEditing(null);
    if (value !== functionLabel(fn)) await rename(fn.va, value);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fn-list">
      <div className="search">
        <Search size={13} />
        <input
          value={filter}
          placeholder={`Filter ${total} functions…`}
          onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="panel-body" ref={scrollRef}>
        <div style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
          {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => {
            const fn = rows[v.index];
            return (
              <div
                key={fn.va}
                className="fn-row"
                data-selected={fn.va === selected}
                style={{ top: v.start, height: kRow }}
                onClick={() => void select(fn.va)}
                onDoubleClick={() => setEditing(fn.va)}
                data-tip={`${hex(fn.va)} · ${fn.size} bytes${fn.callconv ? ` · ${fn.callconv}` : ""}`}
              >
                {editing === fn.va ? (
                  <input
                    className="fn-rename mono"
                    autoFocus
                    defaultValue={functionLabel(fn)}
                    onBlur={(e) => void commit(fn, e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === "Enter") void commit(fn, e.currentTarget.value);
                      if (e.key === "Escape") setEditing(null);
                    }}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <span className="fn-name">{functionLabel(fn)}</span>
                    {fn.noreturn === true && <span className="pill">noret</span>}
                    {fn.blocks !== undefined && <span className="faint">{fn.blocks}bb</span>}
                    <Pencil className="fn-edit" size={11} />
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Listing() {
  const { insns, selected, functions, gotoAddress, linear } = useDisasm();
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [xrefs, setXrefs] = useState<{ of: number; list: Xref[] | null; note: string } | null>(null);
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const inspect = async (va: number, size: number) => {
    try { const result = await echoRequest<{ results?: unknown[] }>({ type: "disassemble_detail", address: hex(va), size }); setDetail(JSON.stringify(result.results?.[0] ?? result, null, 2)); }
    catch (e) { setDetail(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); }
  };

  const findXrefs = async (va: number) => {
    setXrefs({ of: va, list: null, note: "searching…" });
    try {
      const list = await xrefsTo(va, { functions, progress: (note) => setXrefs({ of: va, list: null, note }) });
      setXrefs({ of: va, list, note: `${list.length} references` });
    } catch (e) {
      setXrefs({ of: va, list: [], note: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    }
  };

  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: insns.length,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 25,
  });

  const fn = functions.find((f) => f.va === selected);

  return (
    <div className="listing" style={(xrefs !== null && xrefs.of === selected) || detail ? { gridTemplateRows: `auto ${xrefs !== null && xrefs.of === selected ? "auto " : ""}${detail ? "auto " : ""}minmax(0, 1fr)` } : undefined}>
      <div className="listing-head mono">
        {fn ? (
          <>
            <span style={{ color: "var(--accent)" }}>{functionLabel(fn)}</span>
            <span className="faint">
              {hex(fn.va)} · {fn.size} bytes · {insns.length} insns
              {fn.callconv ? ` · ${fn.callconv}` : ""}
            </span>
            <button className="row-action" style={{ marginLeft: "auto" }} onClick={() => void findXrefs(fn.va)}
              data-tip="calls, jumps, rip-relative and data references to this function">
              xrefs
            </button>
            {linear && (
              <span
                className="pill"
                data-tip="the function index under-reported this range, so the listing is a linear sweep past its end"
              >
                linear
              </span>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <span className="faint">no function selected</span>
        )}
      </div>
      {xrefs !== null && xrefs.of === selected && (
        <div style={{ maxHeight: 160, overflow: "auto", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--border-soft)" }}>
          <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: "2px var(--pad-sm)" }}>{xrefs.note}</div>
          {(xrefs.list ?? []).map((x) => {
            const caller = functions.find((f) => f.va === x.function);
            return (
              <button key={x.from} className="fn-row mono" style={{ position: "static", height: 20 }}
                onClick={() => void gotoAddress(x.from)}>
                <span className="faint" style={{ width: 70 }}>{x.kind}</span>
                <span className="fn-name">{caller ? `${functionLabel(caller)}+0x${(x.from - caller.va).toString(16)}` : hex(x.from)}</span>
                <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{x.text}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
      {detail && <div style={{ maxHeight: 160, overflow: "auto", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--border-soft)" }}><button className="row-action" onClick={() => setDetail(null)}>Close operands</button><pre className="mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap" }}>{detail}</pre></div>}
      {/* Keyed on the selection so picking a new function fades its listing in
          rather than swapping rows underneath the cursor. Remounting also puts
          the scroll back at the top, which the effect below used to do. */}
      <div className="panel-body swap-fade" key={selected ?? "none"} ref={scrollRef}>
        <div style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
          {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => {
            const insn = insns[v.index];
            const target = insn.target;
            return (
              <div key={insn.va} className="insn-row mono" style={{ top: v.start, height: kRow }}>
                <span className="insn-va">{hex(insn.va)}</span>
                <button className="insn-text" style={{ color: flowColor(insn.flow), textAlign: "left" }} onClick={() => void inspect(insn.va, insn.len)} data-tip="Inspect structured operands" aria-label={`Inspect operands for ${insn.text}`}>
                  {insn.text}
                </button>
                {target !== undefined && (
                  <button
                    className="insn-target"
                    onClick={() => void gotoAddress(target)}
                    data-tip={`follow ${hex(target)}`}
                  >
                    → {hex(target, 8)}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function DisassemblyView() {
  return (
    <div className="disasm">
      <FunctionList />
      <Listing />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/DotNetView.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/DotNetView.tsx
// The managed (.NET/CLI) assembly explorer, dnSpy-style: a namespace -> type ->
// member tree on the left, and a code pane on the right that shows a type as C#
// or a method as C# / IL. Backed by the `dotnet` MCP tool, so the UI and an
// agent see the exact same model.

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import {
  useDotnet,
  type MethodInfo,
  type TreeType,
  type TypeDetail,
} from "@/store/dotnet";

// One-letter badge + color role per type/member kind, echoing dnSpy's icons.
const kindBadge: Record<string, { c: string; cls: string }> = {
  class: { c: "C", cls: "dn-class" },
  struct: { c: "S", cls: "dn-struct" },
  interface: { c: "I", cls: "dn-iface" },
  enum: { c: "E", cls: "dn-enum" },
  delegate: { c: "D", cls: "dn-delegate" },
  method: { c: "M", cls: "dn-method" },
  field: { c: "F", cls: "dn-field" },
  property: { c: "P", cls: "dn-prop" },
  event: { c: "e", cls: "dn-event" },
};

function Badge({ kind }: { kind: string }) {
  const b = kindBadge[kind] ?? { c: "?", cls: "" };
  return <span className={`dn-badge ${b.cls}`}>{b.c}</span>;
}

function MethodRow({ m }: { m: MethodInfo }) {
  const { selection, selectMethod } = useDotnet();
  const active = selection?.kind === "method" && selection.token === m.token;
  return (
    <div
      className="dn-leaf"
      data-selected={active}
      onClick={() => void selectMethod(m.token, m.signature)}
      title={m.signature}
    >
      <Badge kind="method" />
      <span className="dn-leaf-name">
        {m.name}
        <span className="faint">
          (
          {m.pinvoke ? "extern " : ""}
          {m.static ? "static" : "instance"})
        </span>
      </span>
      {m.abstract && <span className="pill">abstract</span>}
      {m.virtual && !m.abstract && <span className="pill">virtual</span>}
      {!m.has_body && !m.abstract && <span className="pill">no body</span>}
    </div>
  );
}

function Members({ detail }: { detail: TypeDetail }) {
  return (
    <>
      {detail.fields.map((f) => (
        <div className="dn-leaf dn-info" key={`f${f.token}`} title={`${f.type} ${f.name}`}>
          <Badge kind="field" />
          <span className="dn-leaf-name">
            {f.name} <span className="faint">: {f.type}</span>
            {f.value !== undefined && <span className="faint"> = {f.value}</span>}
          </span>
          {f.const && <span className="pill">const</span>}
          {f.static && !f.const && <span className="pill">static</span>}
        </div>
      ))}
      {detail.properties.map((p) => (
        <div className="dn-leaf dn-info" key={`p${p.token}`} title={`${p.type} ${p.name}`}>
          <Badge kind="property" />
          <span className="dn-leaf-name">
            {p.name} <span className="faint">: {p.type}</span>
            <span className="faint"> {"{ "}{p.get ? "get; " : ""}{p.set ? "set; " : ""}{"}"}</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      ))}
      {detail.events.map((e) => (
        <div className="dn-leaf dn-info" key={`e${e.token}`} title={`${e.type} ${e.name}`}>
          <Badge kind="event" />
          <span className="dn-leaf-name">
            {e.name} <span className="faint">: {e.type}</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      ))}
      {detail.methods.map((m) => (
        <MethodRow m={m} key={`m${m.token}`} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

function TypeNode({ t, depth }: { t: TreeType; depth: number }) {
  const { expandedType, toggleType, selectType, selection, details } = useDotnet();
  const open = expandedType.has(t.token);
  const active = selection?.kind === "type" && selection.token === t.token;
  const detail = details[t.token];
  const memberCount =
    t.counts.fields + t.counts.properties + t.counts.events + t.counts.methods;
  const hasChildren = memberCount > 0 || t.counts.nested > 0;

  return (
    <div className="dn-type">
      <div
        className="dn-row"
        data-selected={active}
        style={{ paddingLeft: 8 + depth * 14 }}
        onClick={() => {
          void selectType(t.token, t.full_name);
          void toggleType(t.token);
        }}
      >
        <span className="dn-caret">
          {hasChildren ? (
            open ? <ChevronDown size={12} /> : <ChevronRight size={12} />
          ) : (
            <span style={{ width: 12, display: "inline-block" }} />
          )}
        </span>
        <Badge kind={t.kind} />
        <span className="dn-leaf-name">{t.name}</span>
        <span className="faint">{memberCount || ""}</span>
      </div>

      {open && (
        <div className="dn-children">
          {t.nested?.map((n) => (
            <TypeNode t={n} depth={depth + 1} key={n.token} />
          ))}
          {!detail && hasChildren && (
            <div className="dn-leaf dn-info" style={{ paddingLeft: 8 + (depth + 1) * 14 }}>
              <span className="faint">loading…</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {detail && (
            <div style={{ paddingLeft: (depth + 1) * 14 }}>
              <Members detail={detail} />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Tree() {
  const { namespaces, expandedNs, toggleNs, filter, setFilter, status } = useDotnet();

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (filter.trim() === "") return namespaces;
    const needle = filter.toLowerCase();
    return namespaces
      .map((ns) => ({
        ...ns,
        types: ns.types.filter((t) => t.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(needle)),
      }))
      .filter((ns) => ns.types.length > 0);
  }, [namespaces, filter]);

  const filtering = filter.trim() !== "";

  return (
    <div className="dn-tree">
      <div className="search">
        <Search size={13} />
        <input
          value={filter}
          placeholder={`Filter ${status?.types ?? 0} types…`}
          onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="panel-body">
        {filtered.map((ns) => {
          const open = filtering || expandedNs.has(ns.name);
          return (
            <div className="dn-ns" key={ns.name}>
              <div className="dn-row dn-ns-row" onClick={() => toggleNs(ns.name)}>
                <span className="dn-caret">
                  {open ? <ChevronDown size={12} /> : <ChevronRight size={12} />}
                </span>
                <span className="dn-ns-name">{ns.name}</span>
                <span className="faint">{ns.types.length}</span>
              </div>
              {open && (
                <div>
                  {ns.types.map((t) => (
                    <TypeNode t={t} depth={1} key={t.token} />
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {filtered.length === 0 && (
          <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
            no types match “{filter}”.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function CodePane() {
  const { selection, csharp, ilText, view, setView, loadingCode, method } = useDotnet();
  const { gotoAddress } = useDisasm();

  const body = view === "csharp" ? csharp : ilText;
  const canIl = ilText.trim() !== "";

  return (
    <div className="dn-code">
      <div className="listing-head mono">
        {selection ? (
          <>
            <span style={{ color: "var(--accent)" }}>{selection.title}</span>
            <div className="spacer" />
            <div className="dn-toggle">
              <button data-active={view === "csharp"} onClick={() => setView("csharp")}>
                C#
              </button>
              <button
                data-active={view === "il"}
                disabled={!canIl}
                onClick={() => setView("il")}
              >
                IL
              </button>
            </div>
            {method?.entry !== undefined && method.entry !== 0 && (
              <button
                className="link mono"
                style={{ fontSize: 11 }}
                onClick={() => void gotoAddress(method.entry as number)}
                title="show this method in the Disassembly view"
              >
                → disasm
              </button>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <span className="faint">select a type or method</span>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="panel-body">
        {loadingCode ? (
          <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
            decompiling…
          </div>
        ) : (
          <pre className="dn-code-pre mono">{body}</pre>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function DotNetView() {
  // WorkspacePanel drives the metadata probe (so the tree survives tab switches);
  // this view just renders from the shared store.
  const { status, busy } = useDotnet();
  const image = useDisasm((s) => s.image);

  if (busy && status === null) {
    return (
      <div className="empty">
        <div className="empty-title">Reading metadata…</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!status?.managed) {
    return (
      <div className="empty">
        <div className="empty-title">Not a .NET assembly.</div>
        <div className="empty-hint">
          This view lists managed types, members and IL. The loaded image carries no
          CLI metadata (COM descriptor directory).
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      <div className="view-bar">
        <span className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--accent)" }}>
          {status.assembly || image.name}
        </span>
        <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
          {status.runtime} · {status.types} types · {status.methods} methods ·{" "}
          {status.fields} fields · {status.properties} props
          {status.il_only ? " · IL-only" : ""}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="dn-explorer">
        <Tree />
        <CodePane />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/EmulatorView.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/EmulatorView.tsx
// Unicorn emulation over the attached process (uc::create_process in the ext
// agent): pages fault in from the target read-only, the game is never touched.
// Takes the Debugger tab's place, Echo has no live debugging primitive. Calls out
// of the module are stubbed and logged with their arguments, stores are logged.

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Play } from "lucide-react";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { hex, useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { hex64, parseEmulatedRegions } from "@/lib/emulatorConfig";
import { parseAddress } from "@/lib/memoryTools";
import { on } from "@/lib/events";

const kInputRegs = ["rcx", "rdx", "r8", "r9", "rax", "rbx", "rsi", "rdi"];
const kRegOrder = [
  "rip", "rsp", "rbp", "rax", "rbx", "rcx", "rdx",
  "rsi", "rdi", "r8", "r9", "r10", "r11", "r12", "r13", "r14", "r15", "eflags",
];

type Run = {
  ok: boolean; error: number; fault: number; regs: Record<string, number>; regs_hex: Record<string, string>; trace: number[];
  mapped_regions: Array<{ name: string; address: string; size: number; perms: number }>;
  vector_regs?: Record<string, string>; memory_map?: Array<{ address: string; end: string; perms: number }>; memory_map_truncated?: boolean;
  error_name?: string;
  calls: Array<{ target: number; symbol: string; ret: number; args: number[] }>;
  writes: Array<{ at: number; addr: number; size: number; value: string }>;
};

type Preset = { start: string; count: string; apiReturn: string; inputs: Record<string, string>; regions: string; timeout: string; traceLimit: string; stub: boolean; track: boolean };
const presetKey = "echo-emulator-presets-v1";
function loadPresets(): Record<string, Preset> { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(presetKey) ?? "{}"); } catch { return {}; } }

export default function EmulatorView() {
  const { selected, gotoAddress } = useDisasm();
  const [start, setStart] = useState("");
  const [count, setCount] = useState("100000");
  const [apiReturn, setApiReturn] = useState("0");
  const [regions, setRegions] = useState("");
  const [timeout, setTimeoutValue] = useState("1000000");
  const [traceLimit, setTraceLimit] = useState("2000");
  const [stub, setStub] = useState(true);
  const [track, setTrack] = useState(true);
  const [configOpen, setConfigOpen] = useState(false);
  const [presets, setPresets] = useState(loadPresets);
  const [presetName, setPresetName] = useState("");
  const [view, setView] = useState<"trace" | "calls" | "writes">("calls");
  const [inputs, setInputs] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [run, setRun] = useState<Run | null>(null);
  const [previous, setPrevious] = useState<Run | null>(null);
  const [traceFilter, setTraceFilter] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => on("target.changed", () => { setRun(null); setPrevious(null); setError("Target or agent connection changed; run again."); }), []);

  const go = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const addr = start.trim() === "" && selected !== null ? selected : parseAddress(start);
      const regs = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(inputs).filter(([, v]) => v.trim() !== "").map(([k, v]) => [k, hex64(v)]));
      const maxInsns = Number(count), timeoutUs = Number(timeout), traceMax = Number(traceLimit);
      if (!Number.isInteger(maxInsns) || maxInsns < 1 || maxInsns > 5000000 || !Number.isInteger(timeoutUs) || timeoutUs < 1 || timeoutUs > 5000000 || !Number.isInteger(traceMax) || traceMax < 0 || traceMax > 100000) throw new Error("Invalid instruction, timeout or trace limit");
      const result = await call<Run>("emu", "run", { addr, count: maxInsns, timeout_us: timeoutUs, trace_limit: traceMax, regs, api_return: hex64(apiReturn), stub_external: stub, track_writes: track, regions: parseEmulatedRegions(regions) });
      setPrevious(run); setRun(result);
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const savePreset = () => {
    const name = presetName.trim(); if (!name) { setError("Enter a preset name"); return; }
    const next = { ...presets, [name]: { start, count, apiReturn, inputs, regions, timeout, traceLimit, stub, track } };
    try { localStorage.setItem(presetKey, JSON.stringify(next)); setPresets(next); setError(null); }
    catch { setError("Could not save preset"); }
  };
  const applyPreset = (name: string) => {
    const p = presets[name]; if (!p) return;
    setPresetName(name); setStart(p.start); setCount(p.count); setApiReturn(p.apiReturn); setInputs(p.inputs); setRegions(p.regions); setTimeoutValue(p.timeout); setTraceLimit(p.traceLimit); setStub(p.stub); setTrack(p.track);
  };
  const deletePreset = () => {
    const next = { ...presets }; delete next[presetName];
    try { localStorage.setItem(presetKey, JSON.stringify(next)); setPresets(next); setPresetName(""); } catch { setError("Could not delete preset"); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      <div className="view-bar">
        <span className="pill">emulator</span>
        <input
          className="addr-input mono"
          style={{ width: 150 }}
          value={start}
          placeholder={selected !== null ? hex(selected) : "start address"}
          onChange={(e) => setStart(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && void go()}
        />
        <label className="view-label">
          max insns
          <input className="addr-input mono" style={{ width: 80 }} value={count} onChange={(e) => setCount(e.target.value)} />
        </label>
        <label className="view-label" data-tip="rax returned by stubbed calls out of the module">
          api rax
          <input className="addr-input mono" style={{ width: 60 }} value={apiReturn} onChange={(e) => setApiReturn(e.target.value)} />
        </label>
        <button className="row-action" data-active={configOpen} onClick={() => setConfigOpen(!configOpen)}>Options</button>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button className="row-action" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void go()}>
          <Play size={11} /> Run
        </button>
      </div>

      {configOpen && <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--border-soft)" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 4 }}>
          <input className="addr-input" value={presetName} placeholder="preset name" aria-label="Preset name" onChange={e => setPresetName(e.target.value)} />
          <button className="row-action" onClick={savePreset}>Save preset</button>
          <select className="select" aria-label="Load preset" value="" onChange={e => applyPreset(e.target.value)}><option value="">Load preset…</option>{Object.keys(presets).sort().map(n => <option key={n}>{n}</option>)}</select>
          <button className="row-action" disabled={!presets[presetName]} onClick={deletePreset}>Delete preset</button>
          <label>timeout µs <input className="addr-input mono" value={timeout} onChange={e => setTimeoutValue(e.target.value)} /></label>
          <label>trace limit <input className="addr-input mono" value={traceLimit} onChange={e => setTraceLimit(e.target.value)} /></label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" checked={stub} onChange={e => setStub(e.target.checked)} /> stub external calls</label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" checked={track} onChange={e => setTrack(e.target.checked)} /> track writes</label>
        </div>
        <textarea className="code-area mono" style={{ width: "100%", height: 52 }} aria-label="Named emulator regions" placeholder="name address size permissions [hex bytes] — one per line" value={regions} onChange={e => setRegions(e.target.value)} />
        <div className="faint">Region address and size are hexadecimal and page aligned; permissions use r, w, x. Regions exist only in the emulator.</div>
        {run?.mapped_regions?.map(r => <div key={r.name} className="mono faint">{r.name}: {r.address} · {r.size} bytes · permissions {r.perms}</div>)}
      </div>}
      {error !== null && (
        <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm) var(--pad-md)", color: "var(--danger)" }}>
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="dbg">
        <div className="dbg-col">
          <div className="dbg-head">Inputs</div>
          <div className="panel-body">
            <table className="table">
              <tbody>
                {kInputRegs.map((name) => (
                  <tr key={name}>
                    <td className="mono faint" style={{ width: 52 }}>{name}</td>
                    <td>
                      <input
                        className="addr-input mono"
                        style={{ width: "100%" }}
                        value={inputs[name] ?? ""}
                        placeholder="0"
                        onChange={(e) => setInputs({ ...inputs, [name]: e.target.value })}
                      />
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="dbg-col">
          <div className="dbg-head">
            Result {run?.mapped_regions?.length ? `· ${run.mapped_regions.length} mapped regions` : ""}
            {run !== null && (
              <span className="pill" style={{ color: run.ok ? undefined : "var(--danger)", marginLeft: 6 }}>
                {run.ok ? "completed" : `stopped (${run.error_name ?? `uc error ${run.error}`}${run.fault ? ` at ${hex(run.fault)}` : ""})`}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="panel-body">
            {run === null ? (
              <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
                Runs until the function returns, the instruction cap, or a fault. Needs echo-reverse.as.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <table className="table">
                <tbody>
                  {kRegOrder.map((name) => (
                    <tr key={name}>
                      <td className="mono faint" style={{ width: 52 }}>{name}</td>
                      <td className="mono" style={previous && previous.regs_hex?.[name] !== run.regs_hex?.[name] ? { color: "var(--accent)" } : undefined} data-tip={previous ? `previous: ${previous.regs_hex?.[name] ?? hex(previous.regs[name] ?? 0)}` : undefined}>{run.regs_hex?.[name] ?? hex(run.regs[name] ?? 0)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                  {Object.entries(run.vector_regs ?? {}).map(([name, value]) => <tr key={name}><td className="mono faint">{name}</td><td className="mono">{value}</td></tr>)}
                  {(run.memory_map ?? []).map((region, i) => <tr key={`map-${i}`}><td className="mono faint">map</td><td className="mono">{region.address}–{region.end} · {region.perms}</td></tr>)}
                  {run.memory_map_truncated && <tr><td colSpan={2}>Memory map truncated at 1,000 regions.</td></tr>}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="dbg-col">
          <div className="dbg-head">
            {(["calls", "writes", "trace"] as const).map((v) => (
              <button key={v} className="row-action" data-active={view === v} onClick={() => setView(v)}>
                {v} {run !== null && <span className="faint">({run[v].length})</span>}
              </button>
            ))}
            {view === "trace" && <input className="addr-input mono" value={traceFilter} placeholder="filter address" aria-label="Filter trace addresses" onChange={(e) => setTraceFilter(e.target.value)} />}
          </div>
          <div className="panel-body">
            {view === "trace" && (run?.trace ?? []).map((va, i) => ({ va, i })).filter(({ va }) => hex(va).toLowerCase().includes(traceFilter.trim().toLowerCase())).map(({ va, i }) => (
              <button key={i} className="fn-row" style={{ position: "static", height: 20 }} onClick={() => void gotoAddress(va)}>
                <span className="faint" style={{ width: 40 }}>{i}</span>
                <span className="fn-name mono">{hex(va)}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
            {view === "calls" && (run?.calls ?? []).map((c, i) => (
              <button key={i} className="fn-row" style={{ position: "static", height: "auto", minHeight: 20 }} onClick={() => void gotoAddress(c.ret)}
                data-tip={`returns to ${hex(c.ret)}`}>
                <span className="fn-name mono">{c.symbol}</span>
                <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>({c.args.map((a) => `0x${a.toString(16)}`).join(", ")})</span>
              </button>
            ))}
            {view === "writes" && (run?.writes ?? []).map((w, i) => (
              <button key={i} className="fn-row" style={{ position: "static", height: 20 }} onClick={() => void gotoAddress(w.at)}
                data-tip={`by ${hex(w.at)}`}>
                <span className="fn-name mono">{hex(w.addr)}</span>
                <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{w.size}B = {w.value}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// Frida instrumentation panel — connects to a local frida-relay WebSocket.
// The relay bridges frida-server to this UI over a simple JSON protocol.
// Run: node frida-relay.js <process> [port=27043]
// (copy relay script from the panel)

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ClipboardCopy, Download, Unplug, Zap } from "lucide-react";
import { copyText } from "@/lib/clipboard";
import { download } from "@/lib/files";
import {
  fridaClearMessages, fridaConnect, fridaDisconnect, fridaEval,
  fridaOnMessage, fridaStatus, fridaUnload, RELAY_TEMPLATE,
  type FridaMessage, type FridaScript,
} from "@/lib/frida";

const kUrlKey = "echo-reverse-frida-url";

const kSample = `// Frida JS — runs inside the target process
Interceptor.attach(ptr("0x0"), {
  onEnter: function(args) {
    console.log("called! arg0 =", args[0]);
    send({ type: "hit", arg0: args[0].toString() });
  }
});
`;

export default function FridaPanel() {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem(kUrlKey) ?? "ws://localhost:27043");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(fridaStatus());
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [note, setNote] = useState<{ text: string; error: boolean } | null>(null);
  const [script, setScript] = useState(kSample);
  const [label, setLabel] = useState("script");
  const [showRelay, setShowRelay] = useState(false);
  const tick = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const off = fridaOnMessage(() => {
      tick.current++;
      setStatus({ ...fridaStatus() });
    });
    return off;
  }, []);

  const connect = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setNote(null);
    localStorage.setItem(kUrlKey, url);
    try {
      const r = await fridaConnect(url);
      setStatus(fridaStatus());
      setNote({ text: `Connected to ${r.target} (pid ${r.pid})`, error: false });
    } catch (e) {
      setNote({ text: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e), error: true });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const disconnect = () => {
    fridaDisconnect();
    setStatus(fridaStatus());
    setNote({ text: "Disconnected", error: false });
  };

  const evalScript = async () => {
    if (!script.trim()) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setNote(null);
    try {
      const id = await fridaEval(script, label || "script");
      setStatus(fridaStatus());
      setNote({ text: `Loaded script ${id}`, error: false });
    } catch (e) {
      setNote({ text: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e), error: true });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const unload = async (id: string) => {
    fridaUnload(id);
    setStatus(fridaStatus());
  };

  const msg = (m: FridaMessage) => {
    try { return JSON.stringify(m.payload, null, 2); }
    catch { return String(m.payload); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="panel stack">
      <div className="panel-section-label">Frida relay</div>
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 4, padding: "0 var(--pad-md)" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4 }}>
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            style={{ flex: 1 }}
            value={url}
            placeholder="ws://localhost:27043"
            onChange={e => setUrl(e.target.value)}
            disabled={status.connected}
          />
          {!status.connected
            ? <button className="row-action" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void connect()}>Connect</button>
            : <button className="row-action" onClick={disconnect}><Unplug size={13} /> Disconnect</button>}
        </div>
        {note && <div className="faint" style={{ color: note.error ? "var(--danger)" : undefined }}>{note.text}</div>}
        {status.connected && (
          <div className="faint" style={{ color: "var(--accent)" }}>
            ● {status.connectedTo || url}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {!status.connected && (
        <div style={{ padding: "0 var(--pad-md)" }}>
          <button className="row-action" style={{ fontSize: 11 }} onClick={() => setShowRelay(v => !v)}>
            {showRelay ? "Hide" : "Show"} relay script
          </button>
          {showRelay && (
            <div style={{ position: "relative", marginTop: 4 }}>
              <pre style={{ fontSize: 10, overflowX: "auto", background: "var(--bg-1)", padding: 8, borderRadius: 4, border: "1px solid var(--border-soft)", maxHeight: 200 }}>
                {RELAY_TEMPLATE}
              </pre>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4, marginTop: 4 }}>
                <button className="row-action" onClick={() => void copyText(RELAY_TEMPLATE)}><ClipboardCopy size={12} /> Copy</button>
                <button className="row-action" onClick={() => void download("frida-relay.js", RELAY_TEMPLATE)}><Download size={12} /> Save</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {status.connected && (
        <>
          <div className="panel-section-label">Script editor</div>
          <div style={{ padding: "0 var(--pad-md)", display: "grid", gap: 4 }}>
            <input
              className="addr-input"
              value={label}
              placeholder="Label"
              onChange={e => setLabel(e.target.value)}
            />
            <textarea
              value={script}
              onChange={e => setScript(e.target.value)}
              rows={10}
              style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)", fontSize: 12, padding: 8, background: "var(--bg-1)", border: "1px solid var(--border-soft)", borderRadius: 4, resize: "vertical", width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", color: "var(--text)" }}
            />
            <button className="row-action" disabled={busy || !script.trim()} onClick={() => void evalScript()}>
              <Zap size={13} /> {busy ? "Loading…" : "Eval / load script"}
            </button>
          </div>

          {status.scripts.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <div className="panel-section-label">Active scripts ({status.scripts.length})</div>
              <table className="table">
                <thead><tr><th>ID</th><th>Label</th><th style={{ width: 70 }}></th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>
                  {(status.scripts as FridaScript[]).map(s => (
                    <tr key={s.id}>
                      <td className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{s.id}</td>
                      <td>{s.label}</td>
                      <td><button className="row-action" onClick={() => void unload(s.id)}>Unload</button></td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </>
          )}

          <div className="panel-section-label" style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
            <span>Messages ({status.messages.length})</span>
            {status.messages.length > 0 && (
              <button className="row-action" style={{ fontSize: 10 }} onClick={() => { fridaClearMessages(); setStatus(fridaStatus()); }}>Clear</button>
            )}
          </div>
          {status.messages.length === 0 && (
            <div className="faint" style={{ padding: "0 var(--pad-md)" }}>No messages yet. Use <code>send({"{"} ... {"}"})</code> in your script.</div>
          )}
          <div style={{ overflowY: "auto", maxHeight: 400 }}>
            {(status.messages as FridaMessage[]).slice().reverse().map((m, i) => (
              <div key={i} style={{ padding: "4px var(--pad-md)", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--border-soft)", fontSize: 11 }}>
                <div className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{m.ts.slice(11, 19)} · {m.scriptId}</div>
                <pre style={{ margin: 0, fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)", fontSize: 11, overflowX: "auto", whiteSpace: "pre-wrap" }}>{msg(m)}</pre>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/InspectorPanel.tsx
// right hand pane, whatever the engine knows about the target and image

import { SlidersHorizontal, X } from "lucide-react";
import { hex as hexAddr, useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useTargets } from "@/store/targets";

function Row({ k, v }: { k: string; v: string }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--pad-md)", padding: "2px var(--pad-md)" }}>
      <span className="faint" style={{ width: 92, flex: "none", fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}>
        {k}
      </span>
      {/* Ellipsis rather than break-all: a wrapped path or process name split
          mid-word ("reverse-slo p-engine.ex e") is harder to read than a
          truncated one with the full value on hover. */}
      <span
        className="mono"
        data-tip={v}
        style={{ minWidth: 0, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}
      >
        {v}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function InspectorPanel() {
  const { target, backend, lanes } = useEngine();
  const modules = useTargets((s) => s.modules);
  // Image facts come from the disasm store, not from `hype.image`: the workspace
  // reads the polled `disasm.loaded` and the event mirror can lag it, which had
  // the Inspector naming one image while the listing showed another
  const image = useDisasm((s) => s.image);

  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Inspector</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Options">
          <SlidersHorizontal size={14} />
        </button>
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Close">
          <X size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="panel-body">
        {!target.attached && !image.ready ? (
          <div className="empty">
            <div className="empty-title">No target selected</div>
            <div className="empty-hint">Select a target to inspect.</div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm) 0" }}>
            {target.attached && (
              <>
                <Row k="process" v={target.name ?? "?"} />
                <Row k="pid" v={String(target.pid ?? 0)} />
                <Row k="backend" v={backend.badge} />
                <Row k="echo core" v={lanes.core ? "connected" : "not connected"} />
                <Row k="extension" v={lanes.ext ? "connected" : "not connected"} />
                <Row k="menu lane" v={lanes.ui ? "connected" : "not connected"} />
                <Row k="modules" v={String(modules.length)} />
              </>
            )}
            {image.ready && (
              <>
                {target.attached && <div className="menu-sep" />}
                <Row k="image" v={image.name ?? "?"} />
                {image.format !== undefined && (
                  <Row k="format" v={image.format === "macho" ? "Mach-O" : "PE"} />
                )}
                {image.arch !== undefined && <Row k="arch" v={image.arch} />}
                {image.encrypted !== undefined && (
                  <Row k="encrypted" v={image.encrypted ? "yes" : "no"} />
                )}
                <Row k="base" v={image.base !== undefined ? hexAddr(image.base) : "n/a"} />
                <Row k="functions" v={String(image.functions ?? 0)} />
                {image.bundle !== undefined && (
                  <>
                    <div className="menu-sep" />
                    <Row k="app directory" v={image.bundle.app_dir} />
                    <Row k="executable" v={image.bundle.executable} />
                    <Row k="archive path" v={image.bundle.executable_path} />
                    {image.bundle.bundle_id !== "" && <Row k="bundle id" v={image.bundle.bundle_id} />}
                    {image.bundle.version !== "" && <Row k="version" v={image.bundle.version} />}
                    {image.bundle.build !== "" && <Row k="build" v={image.bundle.build} />}
                    {image.bundle.min_os !== "" && <Row k="min iOS" v={image.bundle.min_os} />}
                  </>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/MemoryView.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/MemoryView.tsx
// Hex editor over live target memory, port of src/ui/view_memory.cpp
// Region list on the left, 16-bytes-per-row grid on the right, edit in place

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { ArrowRight, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { hex } from "@/store/disasm";
import { kPageBytes, protectName, useMemory } from "@/store/memory";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { parseAddress, parseFields, readStructure, resolvePointerChain, type Field } from "@/lib/memoryTools";
import { readDataStructure, type DataValueRow } from "@/lib/dataTypes";
import { useDataTypes } from "@/store/dataTypes";
import { on } from "@/lib/events";
import { captureSnapshot, compareSnapshots, listSnapshots, removeSnapshot } from "@/lib/snapshots";
import { download } from "@/lib/files";
import { discoverPointers, revalidatePointer, type PointerCandidate } from "@/lib/pointerDiscovery";

const kRow = 19;
const kCols = 16;

function ascii(b: number): string {
  return b >= 0x20 && b < 0x7f ? String.fromCharCode(b) : ".";
}

export default function MemoryView() {
  const { regions, bytes, cursor, loading, error, loadRegions, readAt, writeBytes } = useMemory();
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<{ addr: number; bytes: Uint8Array; pid?: number; name?: string; time: string } | null>(null);
  const comparable = snapshot !== null && target.attached && snapshot.pid === target.pid && snapshot.name === target.name && snapshot.addr === cursor && snapshot.bytes.length === bytes.length && !loading && error === null;
  const changed = comparable ? bytes.reduce((n, b, i) => n + Number(b !== snapshot.bytes[i]), 0) : 0;
  const [toolsOpen, setToolsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [recipeBase, setRecipeBase] = useState("");
  const [offsets, setOffsets] = useState("0, 0");
  const [definition, setDefinition] = useState("health:f32:0\nflags:u32:4");
  const [resolved, setResolved] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [hops, setHops] = useState<Array<{ address: number; value: number }>>([]);
  const [fields, setFields] = useState<Array<Field & { address: number; value: string | null }>>([]);
  const [typedRows, setTypedRows] = useState<DataValueRow[]>([]);
  const [layoutName, setLayoutName] = useState("");
  const registry = useDataTypes((s) => s.registry);
  const activeStruct = useDataTypes((s) => s.activeStruct);
  const [toolError, setToolError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [toolBusy, setToolBusy] = useState(false);
  const [goto, setGoto] = useState("");
  const [savedSnapshots, setSavedSnapshots] = useState(listSnapshots);
  const [snapshotName, setSnapshotName] = useState("");
  const [snapshotSize, setSnapshotSize] = useState("4096");
  const [snapshotA, setSnapshotA] = useState("");
  const [snapshotB, setSnapshotB] = useState("");
  const [snapshotFilter, setSnapshotFilter] = useState("");
  const [snapshotDiff, setSnapshotDiff] = useState<ReturnType<typeof compareSnapshots> | null>(null);
  const [pointerTarget, setPointerTarget] = useState("");
  const [pointerSize, setPointerSize] = useState("65536");
  const [candidates, setCandidates] = useState<PointerCandidate[]>([]);
  const findPointers = async () => {
    setToolBusy(true); setToolError(null);
    try { const r = await discoverPointers(parseAddress(pointerTarget), cursor, Number(pointerSize), 2, 4096); setCandidates(r.candidates); if (r.truncated) setToolError("Pointer results capped; narrow the search range."); }
    catch (e) { setCandidates([]); setToolError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); }
    finally { setToolBusy(false); }
  };
  const checkPointer = async (c: PointerCandidate) => {
    try { const r = await revalidatePointer(c, parseAddress(pointerTarget)); setToolError(r.matches ? `Pointer resolves to ${hex(r.address)}` : `Pointer now resolves to ${hex(r.address)}`); }
    catch (e) { setToolError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); }
  };
  const saveSnapshot = async () => {
    setToolBusy(true); setToolError(null);
    try {
      await captureSnapshot(snapshotName, cursor, Number(snapshotSize), target.name ?? "");
      setSavedSnapshots(listSnapshots()); setSnapshotB(snapshotName.trim());
    } catch (e) { setToolError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); }
    finally { setToolBusy(false); }
  };
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const targetVersion = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => on("target.changed", () => { targetVersion.current++; setSnapshot(null); setResolved(null); setHops([]); setFields([]); setTypedRows([]); setToolError("Target or agent connection changed."); }), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeStruct) setLayoutName(activeStruct);
  }, [activeStruct]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadRegions();
  }, [loadRegions]);

  // Land on the first readable region so the pane is never blank
  useEffect(() => {
    if (cursor === 0 && regions.length > 0) void readAt(regions[0].base);
  }, [regions, cursor, readAt]);

  const rowCount = Math.ceil(bytes.length / kCols);
  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: rowCount,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 12,
  });

  const jump = () => {
    const parsed = Number.parseInt(goto.replace(/^0x/i, ""), 16);
    if (Number.isFinite(parsed)) void readAt(parsed);
  };

  const resolveRecipe = async () => {
    setToolBusy(true); setToolError(null);
    const generation = targetVersion.current;
    try {
      const base = recipeBase.trim() ? parseAddress(recipeBase) : cursor;
      const list = offsets.trim() ? offsets.split(",").map(x => parseAddress(x, true)) : [];
      const result = await resolvePointerChain(base, list);
      if (generation !== targetVersion.current) return;
      setResolved(result.address); setHops(result.hops); setFields([]);
    } catch (e) { setResolved(null); setFields([]); setToolError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); }
    finally { setToolBusy(false); }
  };
  const inspectStructure = async () => {
    setToolBusy(true); setToolError(null);
    const generation = targetVersion.current;
    try { const result = await readStructure(resolved ?? (recipeBase.trim() ? parseAddress(recipeBase) : cursor), parseFields(definition)); if (generation === targetVersion.current) setFields(result); }
    catch (e) { setToolError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); }
    finally { setToolBusy(false); }
  };

  const inspectLayout = async () => {
    if (!layoutName) return;
    setToolsOpen(true);
    setToolBusy(true); setToolError(null); setTypedRows([]);
    const generation = targetVersion.current;
    try {
      const base = resolved ?? (recipeBase.trim() ? parseAddress(recipeBase) : cursor);
      const rows = await readDataStructure(base, layoutName, registry);
      if (generation === targetVersion.current) setTypedRows(rows);
    } catch (e) {
      setToolError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setToolBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const commitByte = async (offset: number, text: string) => {
    setEdit(null);
    const value = Number.parseInt(text, 16);
    if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 0xff) return;
    await writeBytes(cursor + offset, new Uint8Array([value]));
    await readAt(cursor);
  };

  return (
    <div className="mem">
      <div className="mem-regions">
        <div className="view-bar" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
          <span className="panel-title">Regions</span>
          <div className="spacer" />
          <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
            {regions.length}
          </span>
          <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Refresh" onClick={() => void loadRegions()}>
            <RefreshCw size={13} />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="panel-body">
          {regions.map((r) => (
            <button
              key={r.base}
              className="fn-row"
              data-selected={cursor >= r.base && cursor < r.base + r.size}
              style={{ position: "static", height: kRow }}
              onClick={() => void readAt(r.base)}
              data-tip={`${r.size} bytes · ${protectName(r.protect)}`}
            >
              <span className="fn-name">{hex(r.base, 12)}</span>
              <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>
                {protectName(r.protect)}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="stack">
        <div className="view-bar">
          <label className="view-label">
            goto
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              value={goto}
              placeholder="7FF6..."
              onChange={(e) => setGoto(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && jump()}
            />
          </label>
          <button className="row-action" onClick={jump}>
            <ArrowRight size={11} />
          </button>
          <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
            {hex(cursor)} · {bytes.length}/{kPageBytes} bytes
          </span>
          <button className="row-action" data-active={toolsOpen} onClick={() => setToolsOpen(!toolsOpen)}>Pointers / struct</button>
          {registry.structs.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <select className="select" value={layoutName} onChange={(e) => setLayoutName(e.target.value)} aria-label="Data type layout">
                <option value="">layout…</option>
                {registry.structs.map((s) => <option key={s.id} value={s.name}>{s.name}</option>)}
              </select>
              <button className="row-action" disabled={toolBusy || !target.attached || !layoutName} onClick={() => void inspectLayout()}>Inspect layout</button>
            </>
          )}
          <button className="row-action" disabled={!target.attached || loading || error !== null || bytes.length === 0} onClick={() => setSnapshot({ addr: cursor, bytes: bytes.slice(), pid: target.pid, name: target.name, time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString() })}>Snapshot</button>
          {snapshot && <span className="faint" data-tip="Live reads can change while being captured">{comparable ? `${changed} changed · ${snapshot.time}` : `snapshot at ${hex(snapshot.addr)} · ${snapshot.time}`}</span>}
          <div className="spacer" />
          <button
            className="row-action"
            onClick={() => void readAt(Math.max(0, cursor - kPageBytes))}
          >
            ← prev
          </button>
          <button className="row-action" onClick={() => void readAt(cursor + kPageBytes)}>
            next →
          </button>
        </div>

        {toolsOpen && <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--border-soft)", maxHeight: 220, overflow: "auto" }}>
          <div className="toolbar-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            <input className="addr-input" value={snapshotName} onChange={e => setSnapshotName(e.target.value)} placeholder="snapshot name" aria-label="Snapshot name" />
            <input className="addr-input" value={snapshotSize} onChange={e => setSnapshotSize(e.target.value)} placeholder="size in bytes" aria-label="Snapshot size" />
            <button className="row-action" disabled={toolBusy || !target.attached} onClick={() => void saveSnapshot()}>Save snapshot</button>
            {[snapshotA, snapshotB].map((value, i) => <select key={i} className="select" aria-label={i ? "Snapshot after" : "Snapshot before"} value={value} onChange={e => i ? setSnapshotB(e.target.value) : setSnapshotA(e.target.value)}><option value="">{i ? "after…" : "before…"}</option>{savedSnapshots.map(s => <option key={s.name} value={s.name}>{s.name} · {hex(s.address)} · {s.size}</option>)}</select>)}
            <input className="addr-input mono" value={snapshotFilter} onChange={e => setSnapshotFilter(e.target.value)} placeholder="after byte (hex)" aria-label="Changed byte filter" />
            <button className="row-action" disabled={!snapshotA || !snapshotB} onClick={() => { try { const a = savedSnapshots.find(s => s.name === snapshotA), b = savedSnapshots.find(s => s.name === snapshotB); if (!a || !b) throw new Error('Snapshot not found'); setSnapshotDiff(compareSnapshots(a, b, 10000, snapshotFilter.trim())); setToolError(null); } catch (e) { setToolError(String(e)); } }}>Compare</button>
            <button className="row-action" disabled={!snapshotB} onClick={() => { removeSnapshot(snapshotB); setSavedSnapshots(listSnapshots()); setSnapshotB(""); setSnapshotDiff(null); }}>Delete</button>
            {snapshotDiff && <button className="row-action" onClick={() => download("snapshot-diff.json", JSON.stringify(snapshotDiff, null, 2))}>Export diff</button>}
          </div>
          {snapshotDiff && <div className="faint">{snapshotDiff.count} changed bytes · {snapshotDiff.matched} matched{snapshotDiff.truncated ? " (first 10,000 exported)" : ""} {snapshotDiff.changes.slice(0, 5).map(c => `${c.address}: ${c.before}→${c.after}`).join(" · ")}</div>}
          <div className="toolbar-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            <input className="addr-input mono" value={pointerTarget} onChange={e => setPointerTarget(e.target.value)} placeholder="pointer target (hex)" aria-label="Pointer search target" />
            <input className="addr-input" value={pointerSize} onChange={e => setPointerSize(e.target.value)} aria-label="Pointer search size" />
            <button className="row-action" disabled={toolBusy || !target.attached} onClick={() => void findPointers()}>Find pointers from current address</button>
            <span className="faint">{candidates.length} candidates · depth ≤ 2 · offsets ≤ 0x1000</span>
          </div>
          {candidates.slice(0, 20).map((c, i) => <button key={i} className="row-action mono" onClick={() => void checkPointer(c)}>{c.module ? `${c.module}+${hex(c.rva!)}` : hex(c.base)} → {c.offsets.map(x => hex(x)).join(" → ")}</button>)}
          <div style={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 4 }}>
            <input className="addr-input mono" value={recipeBase} placeholder={`base (default ${hex(cursor)})`} aria-label="Pointer base" onChange={e => { setRecipeBase(e.target.value); setResolved(null); }} />
            <input className="addr-input mono" value={offsets} placeholder="offsets, comma separated (hex)" aria-label="Pointer offsets" onChange={e => { setOffsets(e.target.value); setResolved(null); }} />
            <button className="row-action" disabled={toolBusy || !target.attached} onClick={() => void resolveRecipe()}>Resolve</button>
            {resolved !== null && <button className="row-action mono" onClick={() => void readAt(resolved)}>{hex(resolved)}</button>}
            <button className="row-action" disabled={toolBusy || !target.attached} onClick={() => void inspectStructure()}>Read fields</button>
          </div>
          <textarea className="code-area mono" style={{ width: "100%", height: 48 }} aria-label="Structure fields name:type:hex-offset" value={definition} onChange={e => setDefinition(e.target.value)} />
          <div className="faint">Offsets are hexadecimal; all but the last are dereferenced. Fields: name:type:hex-offset.</div>
          {hops.map((h, i) => <div className="mono faint" key={i}>{hex(h.address)} → {hex(h.value)}</div>)}
          {fields.map((f, i) => <div className="mono" key={i}>{f.name} ({f.type}) @ {hex(f.address)} = {f.value ?? "unreadable"}</div>)}
          {typedRows.map((row) => (
            <div className="mono" key={row.path} style={{ paddingLeft: row.depth * 12 }}>
              <span className="faint">+0x{row.offset.toString(16)}</span> {row.path} <span className="faint">({row.type})</span> @ {hex(row.address)} = {row.value}
            </div>
          ))}
          {toolError && <div style={{ color: "var(--danger)" }}>{toolError}</div>}
        </div>}
        <div className="panel-body" ref={scrollRef}>
          {error !== null && (
            <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)", color: "var(--danger)" }}>
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
          {loading && bytes.length === 0 && (
            <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>reading…</div>
          )}
          <div style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
            {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => {
              const off = v.index * kCols;
              const row = bytes.subarray(off, off + kCols);
              return (
                <div key={off} className="hex-row mono" style={{ top: v.start, height: kRow }}>
                  <span className="insn-va">{hex(cursor + off, 12)}</span>
                  <span className="hex-cells">
                    {Array.from(row).map((b, i) =>
                      edit === off + i ? (
                        <input
                          key={i}
                          className="hex-edit mono"
                          autoFocus
                          maxLength={2}
                          defaultValue={b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0").toUpperCase()}
                          onBlur={(e) => void commitByte(off + i, e.target.value)}
                          onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === "Enter") void commitByte(off + i, e.currentTarget.value);
                            if (e.key === "Escape") setEdit(null);
                          }}
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <button
                          key={i}
                          className="hex-cell"
                          data-zero={b === 0}
                          style={comparable && b !== snapshot.bytes[off + i] ? { color: "var(--accent)", fontWeight: 700 } : undefined}
                          onClick={() => setEdit(off + i)}
                          data-tip={`${hex(cursor + off + i, 12)} = ${b}`}
                        >
                          {b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0").toUpperCase()}
                        </button>
                      ),
                    )}
                  </span>
                  <span className="hex-ascii">
                    {Array.from(row)
                      .map((b) => ascii(b))
                      .join("")}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
