`app/src/components/panels/MenuPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// Live control surface for an Echo overlay connected to the relay's
// ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ui lane. This is the in-app equivalent of
// angel-menu-mcp, with the same ui_list / ui_get / ui_set contract and the
// overlay's human ARM gate for danger controls.

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { RefreshCw, ShieldAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { listMenuControls, setMenuControl, type MenuControl } from "@/lib/menu";

function groupName(control: MenuControl): string {
  return [control.tab, control.subtab, control.category].filter(Boolean).join(" › ") || "Controls";
}

function displayValue(control: MenuControl): string {
  if (Array.isArray(control.value)) return control.value.join(", ");
  if (typeof control.value === "object") return JSON.stringify(control.value);
  return String(control.value ?? "");
}

export default function MenuPanel() {
  const [controls, setControls] = useState<MenuControl[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");

  const refresh = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      setControls(await listMenuControls(AbortSignal.timeout(6000)));
    } catch (e) {
      setControls([]);
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, []);

  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!needle) return controls;
    return controls.filter((c) => `${c.name} ${c.label ?? ""} ${groupName(c)}`.toLowerCase().includes(needle));
  }, [controls, filter]);

  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const out = new Map<string, MenuControl[]>();
    for (const control of rows) {
      const key = groupName(control);
      const list = out.get(key) ?? [];
      list.push(control);
      out.set(key, list);
    }
    return out;
  }, [rows]);

  const update = async (control: MenuControl, value: boolean | number) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const applied = await setMenuControl(control.name, value);
      setControls((current) => current.map((c) => c.name === control.name ? applied : c));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateRows: "auto auto 1fr", minHeight: 0 }}>
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Menu Control</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{controls.length} controls</span>
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Refresh controls" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void refresh()}>
          <RefreshCw size={14} className={busy ? "spin" : undefined} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="search" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
        <input value={filter} placeholder="Filter menu controls…" onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)} />
      </div>

      <div className="panel-body">
        {error !== null && (
          <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", color: "var(--danger)", fontSize: 11 }}>
            {error}
            <div className="faint" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
              Load the overlay&apos;s AI Menu Control integration and connect it to ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ui.
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        {error === null && rows.length === 0 && !busy && (
          <div className="empty">
            <div className="empty-title">No menu controls connected.</div>
            <div className="empty-hint">The overlay must open the dedicated menu-control lane.</div>
          </div>
        )}
        {[...groups.entries()].map(([group, items]) => (
          <section key={group}>
            <div className="dbg-head">{group}</div>
            {items.map((control) => {
              const label = control.label || control.name;
              const disabled = busy || control.writable === false;
              return (
                <div key={control.name} className="fn-row" style={{ position: "static", height: "auto", minHeight: 26, padding: "4px var(--pad-sm)" }}>
                  <span style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6, minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
                    <span className="fn-name" style={{ overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{label}</span>
                    {control.danger && <ShieldAlert size={12} color="var(--danger)" data-tip="Writes target memory; the overlay requires a human ARM action" />}
                  </span>
                  {control.kind === "check" && (
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={control.value === true}
                      disabled={disabled}
                      aria-label={label}
                      onChange={(e) => void update(control, e.target.checked)}
                    />
                  )}
                  {control.kind === "slider" && (
                    <span style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 }}>
                      <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, width: 38, textAlign: "right" }}>{displayValue(control)}</span>
                      <input
                        type="range"
                        min={control.min ?? 0}
                        max={control.max ?? 100}
                        step={control.step ?? 1}
                        value={typeof control.value === "number" ? control.value : control.min ?? 0}
                        disabled={disabled}
                        aria-label={label}
                        onChange={(e) => void update(control, Number(e.target.value))}
                      />
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {control.kind === "combo" && (
                    <select
                      className="select"
                      value={typeof control.value === "number" ? control.value : 0}
                      disabled={disabled}
                      aria-label={label}
                      onChange={(e) => void update(control, Number(e.target.value))}
                    >
                      {(control.options ?? []).map((option, index) => <option key={option} value={index}>{option}</option>)}
                    </select>
                  )}
                  {control.kind !== "check" && control.kind !== "slider" && control.kind !== "combo" && (
                    <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{displayValue(control)}</span>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </section>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/ModulesPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/ModulesPanel.tsx
// Module list for the attached target, with a live-memory PE dump for the
// static tools (Ghidra, IDA, radare2, NoVmp, Triton) to load.

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { HardDriveDownload, RefreshCw, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { saveOrDownload } from "@/lib/files";
import { dumpModuleFile } from "@/lib/iat";
import { hex } from "@/store/disasm";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useTargets, type ModuleRow } from "@/store/targets";
import { captureModule, compareModules, listModuleCaptures, removeModuleCapture } from "@/lib/moduleCompare";
import { download } from "@/lib/files";

const kRow = 22;

export default function ModulesPanel() {
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const { modules, refreshModules } = useTargets();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [captures, setCaptures] = useState(listModuleCaptures);
  const [captureName, setCaptureName] = useState("");
  const [before, setBefore] = useState("");
  const [after, setAfter] = useState("");
  const [diff, setDiff] = useState<ReturnType<typeof compareModules> | null>(null);
  const capture = async (m: ModuleRow) => {
    try { setNote("Capturing module…"); const result = await captureModule(captureName, m.name, m.base); setCaptures(listModuleCaptures()); setAfter(result.name); setNote(`Captured ${result.name}${result.warnings.length ? `: ${result.warnings.join('; ')}` : ''}`); }
    catch (e) { setNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); }
  };
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (target.attached) void refreshModules();
  }, [target.attached, refreshModules]);

  const dump = async (m: ModuleRow) => {
    try {
      const { bytes, missing, imports } = await dumpModuleFile(m, setNote);
      const where = await saveOrDownload(m.name.replace(/(\.\w+)?$/, "_dump$1"), bytes);
      const named = typeof imports === "string" ? `imports not rebuilt: ${imports}` : `${imports.functions} imports from ${imports.modules} modules`;
      setNote(`${m.name}: ${bytes.length} bytes ${where}, ${named}${missing ? `, ${missing} unreadable pages zero filled` : ""}`);
    } catch (e) {
      setNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    }
  };

  const rows = modules.filter((m) => m.name.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase()));

  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: rows.length,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 12,
  });

  if (!target.attached) {
    return (
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head">
          <span className="panel-title">Modules</span>
        </div>
        <div className="empty">
          <div className="empty-hint">Attach to a process to list its modules.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Modules</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{modules.length}</span>
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Refresh" onClick={() => void refreshModules()}>
          <RefreshCw size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateRows: note !== null ? "auto auto auto 1fr" : "auto auto 1fr", minHeight: 0 }}>
        {note !== null && <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: "2px var(--pad-sm)" }}>{note}</div>}
        <div className="toolbar-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          <input className="addr-input" value={captureName} onChange={e => setCaptureName(e.target.value)} placeholder="capture name" aria-label="Module capture name" />
          {[before, after].map((value, i) => <select className="select" key={i} value={value} aria-label={i ? "Module capture after" : "Module capture before"} onChange={e => i ? setAfter(e.target.value) : setBefore(e.target.value)}><option value="">{i ? "after…" : "before…"}</option>{captures.map(c => <option key={c.name} value={c.name}>{c.name} · {c.module}</option>)}</select>)}
          <button className="row-action" disabled={!before || !after} onClick={() => { const a = captures.find(c => c.name === before), b = captures.find(c => c.name === after); if (a && b) { const d = compareModules(a, b); setDiff(d); setNote(Object.entries(d.changes).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: +${v.added.length} −${v.removed.length}`).join(' · ') + (d.warnings.length ? ` · ${d.warnings.join('; ')}` : '')); } }}>Compare</button>
          <button className="row-action" disabled={!after} onClick={() => { removeModuleCapture(after); setCaptures(listModuleCaptures()); setAfter(''); setDiff(null); }}>Delete</button>
          {diff && <button className="row-action" onClick={() => download('module-diff.json', JSON.stringify(diff, null, 2))}>Export</button>}
        </div>
        <div className="search">
          <Search size={13} />
          <input value={filter} placeholder="Filter modules…" onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)} />
        </div>

        <div className="panel-body" ref={scrollRef}>
          <div style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
            {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => {
              const m = rows[v.index];
              return (
                <div
                  key={m.base}
                  className="fn-row"
                  style={{ top: v.start, height: kRow }}
                  data-tip={m.path ?? m.name}
                >
                  <span className="fn-name">{m.name}</span>
                  <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{hex(m.base, 12)}</span>
                  <button className="row-action" disabled={!captureName.trim()} onClick={() => void capture(m)}>Capture</button>
                  <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Dump as PE (loads in Ghidra / IDA / r2)" onClick={() => void dump(m)}>
                    <HardDriveDownload size={12} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/OutputPanel.tsx
// output and log tabs, the app ring and the tagged diag ring side by side

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { ChevronDown, Eraser, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { useOutput } from "@/store/output";

type DiagEntry = { ms: number; level: string; tag: string; message: string };

const timeFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
  hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit", hour12: false,
});
const clock = (ms: number) => timeFormat.format(ms);

export default function OutputPanel() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"output" | "log">("output");
  const [diag, setDiag] = useState<DiagEntry[]>([]);
  const [follow, setFollow] = useState(true);
  const lines = useOutput((s) => s.lines);
  const clear = useOutput((s) => s.clear);
  const bodyRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const count = tab === "output" ? lines.length : diag.length;
  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count,
    getScrollElement: () => bodyRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => 20,
    overscan: 12,
    initialRect: { width: 800, height: 300 },
    getItemKey: (index) => tab === "output" ? `output-${lines[index].seq}` : `diag-${index}`,

  });
  virtualizer.shouldAdjustScrollPositionOnItemSizeChange = follow ? () => false : undefined;
  const totalSize = virtualizer.getTotalSize();


  // diag has no push channel: it is a high-volume ring that would swamp the
  // event stream, so the Log tab polls it while it is the visible tab
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab !== "log") return;
    let alive = true;
    let revision = 0;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    const pull = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await call<{ entries: DiagEntry[]; revision: number }>("app", "diag", {
          limit: 1000, since_revision: revision,
        });
        if (alive) {
          const reset = res.revision < revision;
          const replace = revision === 0 || reset;
          if (res.entries.length || reset) setDiag((previous) =>
            (replace ? res.entries : [...previous, ...res.entries]).slice(-1000));
          revision = reset ? 0 : res.revision;
        }
      } catch {
        /* engine down: keep the last snapshot */
      } finally {
        if (alive) timer = setTimeout(() => void pull(), 1000);
      }
    };
    void pull();
    return () => {
      alive = false;
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [tab]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = bodyRef.current;
    if (!follow || !el || !el.firstElementChild) return;
    const pin = () => { el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; };
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(pin);
    observer.observe(el.firstElementChild);
    pin();
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [follow, tab, lines, diag]);

  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ borderRight: "none", borderTop: "1px solid var(--border-soft)" }}>
      <div className="tabs">
        <button className="tab" data-active={tab === "output"} onClick={() => setTab("output")}>
          Output
        </button>
        <button className="tab" data-active={tab === "log"} onClick={() => setTab("log")}>
          Log
        </button>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <div style={{ display: "flex", alignSelf: "center", gap: 2, marginRight: 6 }}>
          <button
            className="icon-button"
            data-tip="Clear"
            onClick={() => void (tab === "output" ? clear() : setDiag([]))}
          >
            <Trash2 size={14} />
          </button>
          <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Clear engine ring" onClick={() => void clear()}>
            <Eraser size={14} />
          </button>
          <button
            className="icon-button"
            data-tip={follow ? "Following output" : "Scroll locked"}
            style={{ color: follow ? "var(--accent)" : undefined }}
            onClick={() => setFollow((v) => !v)}
          >
            <ChevronDown size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Keyed so switching Output <-> Log replays the enter animation and
          resets the scroll position to the new pane's tail. */}
      <div className="panel-body log swap-fade" key={tab} ref={bodyRef}>
        <div style={{ height: totalSize, position: "relative", width: "100%" }}>
        {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((row) => {
          const l = lines[row.index];
          const e = diag[row.index];
          return <div key={row.key} data-index={row.index} ref={virtualizer.measureElement}
            style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, width: "100%", transform: `translateY(${row.start}px)` }}>
            {tab === "output" ? <div className="log-row">
                <span className="log-time">{clock(l.ms)}</span>
                <span>{l.text}</span>
              </div> : <div className="log-row">
                <span className="log-time">{clock(e.ms)}</span>
                <span className="log-level" data-level={e.level}>
                  {e.level}
                </span>
                <span className="log-tag">{e.tag}</span>
                <span>{e.message}</span>
              </div>}
          </div>;
        })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/OverlayPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/OverlayPanel.tsx
// ESP overlay designer, the echo-esp-preview idea wired to Echo: configure the
// entity layout the same way the rest of the app reads memory, preview the
// box/label/bar arrangement, then install a self-contained .as that Echo's
// renderer runs. Every generated script uses documented Echo APIs only.

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Copy, Download, Crosshair } from "lucide-react";
import { check } from "@/lib/angelscript";
import { copyText } from "@/lib/clipboard";
import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";
import {
  buildOverlayScript,
  defaultOverlayConfig,
  formatRva,
  parseRva,
  type OverlayConfig,
} from "@/lib/overlay";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";

const kBoxColor = "#50dcff";

export default function OverlayPanel() {
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const [cfg, setCfg] = useState<OverlayConfig>(() => {
    try { return { ...defaultOverlayConfig, ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("overlay-config") ?? "{}") }; } catch { return defaultOverlayConfig; }
  });
  const [hexFields, setHexFields] = useState(() => ({
    entityListRva: formatRva(cfg.entityListRva),
    positionOffset: formatRva(cfg.positionOffset),
    healthOffset: formatRva(cfg.healthOffset),
    teamOffset: formatRva(cfg.teamOffset),
    viewMatrixRva: formatRva(cfg.viewMatrixRva),
  }));
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => { try { localStorage.setItem("overlay-config", JSON.stringify(cfg)); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ } }, [cfg]);

  // Adopt the attached process name until the user types their own.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (cfg.process === "YourGame.exe" && target.name) {
      setCfg((c) => ({ ...c, process: target.name! }));
    }
  }, [target.name, cfg.process]);

  const setHex = (key: keyof typeof hexFields, value: string) => {
    setHexFields((h) => ({ ...h, [key]: value }));
    setCfg((c) => ({ ...c, [key]: parseRva(value) }));
  };

  const script = useMemo(() => buildOverlayScript(cfg), [cfg]);
  const problems = useMemo(
    () => check(script).filter((d) => d.severity === "error"),
    [script],
  );

  const install = async () => {
    if (problems.length) {
      setNote(`not installed: ${problems[0].message} (line ${problems[0].line + 1})`);
      return;
    }
    try {
      if (isTauri()) {
        const { invoke } = await import("@tauri-apps/api/core");
        const path = await invoke<string>("install_script", { name: "echo-reverse-overlay.as", text: script });
        setNote(`installed to ${path}. Load it in Echo → Scripts.`);
      } else {
        const a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([script], { type: "text/plain" }));
        a.download = "echo-reverse-overlay.as";
        a.click();
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 10_000);
        setNote("downloaded. Put it in %APPDATA%\\scripts and load it in Echo.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    }
  };

  const field = (label: string, key: keyof typeof hexFields, hint: string) => (
    <label className="field">
      <span className="field-label">{label}</span>
      <input
        className="addr-input mono"
        placeholder="0x0"
        value={hexFields[key]}
        onChange={(e) => setHex(key, e.target.value)}
        data-tip={hint}
      />
    </label>
  );

  const num = (label: string, key: keyof OverlayConfig, hint: string, min = 0) => (
    <label className="field">
      <span className="field-label">{label}</span>
      <input
        className="addr-input mono"
        type="number"
        min={min}
        value={String(cfg[key])}
        onChange={(e) => setCfg((c) => ({ ...c, [key]: Number(e.target.value) }))}
        data-tip={hint}
      />
    </label>
  );

  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Overlay</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Copy the generated script" onClick={() => void copyText(script)}>
          <Copy size={14} />
        </button>
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Install to %APPDATA%\\scripts" onClick={() => void install()}>
          <Download size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="panel-body" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", display: "grid", gap: "var(--pad-md)", alignContent: "start" }}>
        <section>
          <div className="view-label">Target</div>
          <label className="field">
            <span className="field-label">Module</span>
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              value={cfg.process}
              onChange={(e) => setCfg((c) => ({ ...c, process: e.target.value }))}
              placeholder="Game-Win64-Shipping.exe"
            />
          </label>
          <div className="field-grid">
            {field("Entity list RVA", "entityListRva", "RVA of the entity pointer array")}
            {field("View matrix RVA", "viewMatrixRva", "RVA of the 16-float view/projection matrix")}
          </div>
          <label className="check-row">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={cfg.listDeref}
              onChange={(e) => setCfg((c) => ({ ...c, listDeref: e.target.checked }))}
            />
            <span>Entity list is a pointer to the array</span>
          </label>
        </section>

        <section>
          <div className="view-label">Entity layout</div>
          <div className="field-grid">
            {num("Count", "entityCount", "Maximum entity slots to walk", 1)}
            {num("Stride", "entityStride", "Bytes between entity pointers", 1)}
            {field("Position offset", "positionOffset", "Entity offset of float x/y/z")}
            {field("Health offset", "healthOffset", "Entity offset of int32 health, 0 disables")}
            {field("Team offset", "teamOffset", "Entity offset of int32 team, 0 disables")}
            {num("Local team", "localTeam", "Skip this team, -1 shows every entity", -1)}
          </div>
          <div className="field-grid">
            {num("Box width", "boxWidth", "Box width in world units", 1)}
            {num("Box height", "boxHeight", "Feet-to-head height in world units", 1)}
          </div>
          <label className="check-row">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={cfg.unityCoords}
              onChange={(e) => setCfg((c) => ({ ...c, unityCoords: e.target.checked }))}
            />
            <span>Unity coordinates (Y-up, left-handed)</span>
          </label>
        </section>

        <section>
          <div className="view-label">Preview</div>
          <div className="check-row" style={{ gap: "var(--pad-md)", marginBottom: "var(--pad-xs)" }}>
            <label className="check-row">Label <select className="select" value={cfg.labelSide ?? "top"} onChange={e => setCfg(c => ({ ...c, labelSide: e.target.value as "top" | "bottom" }))}><option>top</option><option>bottom</option></select></label>
            <label className="check-row">Bar <select className="select" value={cfg.barSide ?? "left"} onChange={e => setCfg(c => ({ ...c, barSide: e.target.value as "left" | "right" }))}><option>left</option><option>right</option></select></label>
          </div>
          <div className="esp-stage" onDragOver={e => e.preventDefault()} onDrop={e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const rect = box.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (!rect) return;
            const item = e.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain");
            if (item === "label") setCfg(c => ({ ...c, labelSide: e.clientY < rect.top + rect.height / 2 ? "top" : "bottom" }));
            if (item === "bar") setCfg(c => ({ ...c, barSide: e.clientX < rect.left + rect.width / 2 ? "left" : "right" }));
          }}>
            <div ref={box} className="esp-box" style={{ left: "46%", top: "22%", width: 64, height: 132, borderColor: kBoxColor }}>
              <span draggable onDragStart={e => e.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", "label")} className="esp-label" style={{ cursor: "grab", color: "#ebebeb", ...(cfg.labelSide === "bottom" ? { top: "100%", bottom: "auto" } : {}) }}>#3  87 hp</span>
              <div draggable onDragStart={e => e.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", "bar")} className="esp-bar" style={cfg.barSide === "right" ? { left: "auto", right: -5, cursor: "grab" } : { cursor: "grab" }}>
                <div style={{ height: "87%" }} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="esp-box" style={{ left: "22%", top: "34%", width: 44, height: 92, borderColor: kBoxColor }}>
              <span className="esp-label" style={{ color: "#ebebeb", ...(cfg.labelSide === "bottom" ? { top: "100%", bottom: "auto" } : {}) }}>#7  61 hp</span>
              <div className="esp-bar" style={cfg.barSide === "right" ? { left: "auto", right: -5 } : undefined}>
                <div style={{ height: "61%" }} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="esp-crosshair"><Crosshair size={18} /></div>
          </div>
          <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
            Drag the label or bar to reposition them. The installed script projects real boxes with
            <span className="mono"> render::calculate_2d_bbox</span> against Echo's live view matrix.
          </div>
        </section>

        <section>
          {problems.length > 0 ? (
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--danger)" }}>
              {problems.length} AngelScript error(s): {problems[0].message} (line {problems[0].line + 1})
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
              Generated script passes the vendored Echo API check. It installs as
              <span className="mono"> echo-reverse-overlay.as</span>; Echo's menu is still what loads it.
            </div>
          )}
          {note !== null && <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 4 }}>{note}</div>}
          <button className="row-action" style={{ marginTop: "var(--pad-xs)" }} onClick={() => void install()}>
            Install overlay script
          </button>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/PeView.tsx`:

```tsx
// PE browser for the attached image and every other loaded module. The main
// image is parsed directly from live memory; DLLs use echo-reverse.as's PE
// table extension so the same browser works across the whole process.

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { hex, useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { usePe, type ExportEntry, type ImportDll, type Section } from "@/store/pe";
import { useTargets } from "@/store/targets";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { moduleExports, moduleImports, moduleResourceTree, moduleSections, type ModuleResource } from "@/lib/echoTables";

type Sub = "sections" | "imports" | "exports" | "resources";
type ModuleView = { sections: Section[]; imports: ImportDll[]; exports: ExportEntry[]; base: number; entryRva: number };

export default function PeView() {
  const { pe, loading, error, load } = usePe();
  const { image, gotoAddress } = useDisasm();
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const { modules, refreshModules } = useTargets();
  const [sub, setSub] = useState<Sub>("sections");
  const [selectedModule, setSelectedModule] = useState("");
  const [moduleView, setModuleView] = useState<ModuleView | null>(null);
  const [resources, setResources] = useState<ModuleResource[]>([]);
  const [moduleLoading, setModuleLoading] = useState(false);
  const [moduleError, setModuleError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load, image.name]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (target.attached) void refreshModules();
  }, [target.attached, refreshModules]);

  const mainName = pe.image ?? image.name ?? "";
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedModule === "" && mainName) setSelectedModule(mainName);
  }, [mainName, selectedModule]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedModule) {
      setModuleView(null);
      setResources([]);
      setModuleError(null);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    setModuleLoading(true);
    setModuleError(null);
    const resourcePromise = moduleResourceTree(selectedModule).catch(() => [] as ModuleResource[]);
    if (selectedModule === mainName) {
      void resourcePromise.then((rows) => { if (!cancelled) setResources(rows); }).finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setModuleLoading(false); });
      setModuleView(null);
      return () => { cancelled = true; };
    }
    void Promise.all([
      moduleSections(selectedModule),
      moduleImports(selectedModule),
      moduleExports(selectedModule),
      resourcePromise,
    ]).then(([sections, imports, exports, resourceRows]) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      const grouped = new Map<string, string[]>();
      for (const row of imports) {
        const list = grouped.get(row.module) ?? [];
        list.push(row.name);
        grouped.set(row.module, list);
      }
      const module = modules.find((m) => m.name.toLowerCase() === selectedModule.toLowerCase());
      setResources(resourceRows);
      setModuleView({
        base: module?.base ?? 0,
        entryRva: 0,
        sections: sections.map((s) => ({
          name: s.name,
          rva: s.rva,
          vsize: s.size,
          raw_size: s.raw_size,
          exec: s.protect.includes("x"),
          writable: s.protect.includes("w"),
          characteristics: s.characteristics,
        })),
        imports: [...grouped.entries()].map(([dll, functions]) => ({ dll, functions })),
        exports: exports.map((e) => ({ name: e.name, rva: e.rva, ordinal: e.ordinal })),
      });
    }).catch((e) => {
      if (!cancelled) {
        setModuleView(null);
        setModuleError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
      }
    }).finally(() => {
      if (!cancelled) setModuleLoading(false);
    });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [selectedModule, mainName, modules]);

  const view = moduleView ?? {
    sections: pe.sections,
    imports: pe.imports,
    exports: pe.exports,
    base: pe.image_base ?? image.base ?? 0,
    entryRva: pe.entry_rva ?? 0,
  };
  const base = view.base;
  const format = image.format ?? pe.format;
  const arch = image.arch ?? pe.arch;
  const isPe = format !== "macho";
  const moduleOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const names = new Set<string>();
    if (mainName) names.add(mainName);
    for (const m of modules) names.add(m.name);
    return [...names].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  }, [mainName, modules]);

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      <div className="view-bar">
        {(["sections", "imports", "exports", "resources"] as Sub[]).map((s) => (
          <button key={s} className="tab" data-active={sub === s} onClick={() => setSub(s)}>
            {s}
            <span className="faint">
              {s === "sections" ? view.sections.length : s === "imports" ? view.imports.length : s === "exports" ? view.exports.length : resources.length}
            </span>
          </button>
        ))}
        <div className="spacer" />
        <select className="select" value={selectedModule || mainName} onChange={(e) => setSelectedModule(e.target.value)} aria-label="Loaded module">
          {moduleOptions.map((name) => <option key={name} value={name}>{name}</option>)}
        </select>
        <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
          {isPe ? (pe.pe32plus === true ? "PE32+" : "PE32") : "Mach-O"}
          {arch !== undefined ? ` · ${arch}` : ""} · base {hex(base)} · entry {hex(base + view.entryRva)}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="panel-body swap-fade" key={`${sub}:${selectedModule}`}>
        {error !== null && (
          <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)", color: "var(--danger)" }}>{error}</div>
        )}
        {moduleError !== null && (
          <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)", color: "var(--danger)" }}>
            {moduleError}. Load the current echo-reverse.as extension to browse loaded-module PE tables.
          </div>
        )}
        {(loading || moduleLoading) && <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>reading image metadata…</div>}

        {sub === "sections" && (
          <table className="table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style={{ width: 90 }}>Name</th>
                <th style={{ width: 130 }}>VA</th>
                <th style={{ width: 90 }}>RVA</th>
                <th style={{ width: 90 }}>Virtual</th>
                <th style={{ width: 90 }}>Raw</th>
                <th>Flags</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {view.sections.map((s) => (
                <tr key={`${s.name}-${s.rva}`}>
                  <td className="mono">{s.name}</td>
                  <td><button className="mono link" onClick={() => void gotoAddress(base + s.rva)}>{hex(base + s.rva)}</button></td>
                  <td className="mono faint">0x{s.rva.toString(16).toUpperCase()}</td>
                  <td className="mono faint">0x{s.vsize.toString(16).toUpperCase()}</td>
                  <td className="mono faint">0x{s.raw_size.toString(16).toUpperCase()}</td>
                  <td>
                    {s.exec && <span className="pill">exec</span>}{" "}
                    {s.writable && <span className="pill">write</span>}{" "}
                    {isPe && <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>0x{s.characteristics.toString(16).toUpperCase()}</span>}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}

        {sub === "imports" && (
          <div>
            {view.imports.map((d) => (
              <details key={d.dll} className="tree">
                <summary><span className="mono">{d.dll}</span><span className="faint">{d.functions.length}</span></summary>
                {d.functions.map((fn, i) => <div className="tree-leaf mono" key={`${d.dll}-${i}`}>{fn}</div>)}
              </details>
            ))}
            {view.imports.length === 0 && !loading && <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>no imports.</div>}
          </div>
        )}

        {sub === "exports" && (
          <table className="table">
            <thead><tr>{isPe && <th style={{ width: 70 }}>Ordinal</th>}<th style={{ width: 130 }}>VA</th><th>Name</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {view.exports.map((e, i) => (
                <tr key={`${e.name}-${i}`}>
                  {isPe && <td className="mono faint">{e.ordinal}</td>}
                  <td><button className="mono link" onClick={() => void gotoAddress(base + e.rva)}>{hex(base + e.rva)}</button></td>
                  <td className="mono">{e.name}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}

        {sub === "resources" && (
          <table className="table">
            <thead><tr><th style={{ width: 70 }}>Level</th><th style={{ width: 130 }}>ID / name</th><th style={{ width: 130 }}>VA</th><th>Size</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {resources.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={`${row.level}:${row.id}:${row.name}:${index}`}>
                  <td className="mono faint">{row.level}</td>
                  <td className="mono">{row.named ? row.name : row.id}</td>
                  <td className="mono">{row.address !== undefined ? <button className="link mono" onClick={() => void gotoAddress(row.address!)}>{hex(row.address)}</button> : "—"}</td>
                  <td className="mono faint">{row.size ?? "—"}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

`app/src/components/panels/PerformanceMonitorPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/PerformanceMonitorPanel.tsx
// Performance Monitor Panel for Echo Backend

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { performance, util } from '@/lib/echo-extensions';
import { PanelProps } from './panelTypes';

interface CounterData {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  value: number;
  lastValue: number;
  minValue: number;
  maxValue: number;
  total: number;
  count: number;
  average: number;
  lastUpdated: number;
}

interface MemoryData {
  totalPhysical: number;
  usedPhysical: number;
  availablePhysical: number;
  processMemory: number;
  processPrivate: number;
  physicalUsagePercent: number;
  totalVirtual: number;
  usedVirtual: number;
  availableVirtual: number;
  virtualUsagePercent: number;
}

interface CpuData {
  totalUsage: number;
  coreUsages: number[];
  timestamp: number;
}

interface ThreadData {
  threadId: number;
  name: string;
  startTime: number;
  cpuTime: number;
  priority: number;
  alive: boolean;
}

interface GraphData {
  label: string;
  data: { timestamp: number; value: number }[];
  color: string;
}

const PerformanceMonitorPanel: React.FC<PanelProps> = ({ }) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'overview' | 'counters' | 'memory' | 'cpu' | 'threads'>('overview');
  const [counters, setCounters] = useState<CounterData[]>([]);
  const [memory, setMemory] = useState<MemoryData | null>(null);
  const [cpu, setCpu] = useState<CpuData | null>(null);
  const [threads, setThreads] = useState<ThreadData[]>([]);
  const [isMonitoring, setIsMonitoring] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [autoRefresh, setAutoRefresh] = useState(true);
  const [refreshInterval, setRefreshInterval] = useState(1000); // 1 second
  
  // Graph data for FPS
  const [fpsGraph, setFpsGraph] = useState<GraphData>({
    label: 'FPS',
    data: [],
    color: '#3b82f6'
  });
  
  const [memoryGraph, setMemoryGraph] = useState<GraphData>({
    label: 'Memory (MB)',
    data: [],
    color: '#10b981'
  });
  
  const [cpuGraph, setCpuGraph] = useState<GraphData>({
    label: 'CPU %',
    data: [],
    color: '#ef4444'
  });
  
  const refreshTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  
  // Load initial data
  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      // Load counters
      const countersResult = await performance.getAllCounters();
      if (countersResult.success) {
        setCounters(countersResult.counters);
      }
      
      // Load memory
      const memoryResult = await performance.getMemoryUsage();
      if (memoryResult.success && memoryResult.memory) {
        setMemory(memoryResult.memory);
      }
      
      // Load CPU
      const cpuResult = await performance.getCpuUsage();
      if (cpuResult.success && cpuResult.cpu) {
        setCpu(cpuResult.cpu);
      }
      
      // Load threads
      const threadsResult = await performance.getThreads();
      if (threadsResult.success && threadsResult.threads) {
        setThreads(threadsResult.threads);
      }
      
      // Update graphs
      updateGraphs(countersResult.counters, memoryResult.memory, cpuResult.cpu);
      
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(`Failed to load data: ${err}`);
      console.error('Performance data load error:', err);
    }
  }, []);
  
  // Update graphs with new data
  const updateGraphs = useCallback((newCounters?: CounterData[], newMemory?: MemoryData, newCpu?: CpuData) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const maxPoints = 60;
    
    // Update FPS graph
    const fpsCounter = newCounters?.find(c => c.name === 'frames_per_second');
    if (fpsCounter) {
      setFpsGraph(prev => {
        const newData = [...prev.data, { timestamp: now, value: fpsCounter.value }];
        return {
          ...prev,
          data: newData.length > maxPoints ? newData.slice(-maxPoints) : newData
        };
      });
    }
    
    // Update memory graph
    if (newMemory) {
      setMemoryGraph(prev => {
        const newData = [...prev.data, { timestamp: now, value: newMemory.usedPhysical / (1024 * 1024) }];
        return {
          ...prev,
          data: newData.length > maxPoints ? newData.slice(-maxPoints) : newData
        };
      });
    }
    
    // Update CPU graph
    if (newCpu) {
      setCpuGraph(prev => {
        const newData = [...prev.data, { timestamp: now, value: newCpu.totalUsage }];
        return {
          ...prev,
          data: newData.length > maxPoints ? newData.slice(-maxPoints) : newData
        };
      });
    }
  }, []);
  
  // Toggle monitoring
  const toggleMonitoring = useCallback(async (enabled: boolean) => {
    try {
      await performance.setMonitoringEnabled(enabled);
      setIsMonitoring(enabled);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(`Failed to ${enabled ? 'enable' : 'disable'} monitoring: ${err}`);
    }
  }, []);
  
  // Reset counters
  const resetCounters = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await performance.resetCounters();
      await loadData();
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(`Failed to reset counters: ${err}`);
    }
  }, [loadData]);
  
  // Start/stop auto-refresh
  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoRefresh) {
      refreshTimerRef.current = setInterval(loadData, refreshInterval);
    } else if (refreshTimerRef.current) {
      clearInterval(refreshTimerRef.current);
      refreshTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    
    return () => {
      if (refreshTimerRef.current) {
        clearInterval(refreshTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [autoRefresh, refreshInterval, loadData]);
  
  // Load data on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
    
    // Check monitoring status
    performance.setMonitoringEnabled(true).then(() => {
      setIsMonitoring(true);
    }).catch(console.error);
    
    return () => {
      if (refreshTimerRef.current) {
        clearInterval(refreshTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [loadData]);
  
  // Format bytes to human readable
  const formatBytes = (bytes: number) => {
    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';
    const k = 1024;
    const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
    return `${parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2))} ${sizes[i]}`;
  };
  
  // Format number with comma separators
  const formatNumber = (num: number) => {
    return num.toLocaleString();
  };
  
  // Get FPS from counters
  const getFps = () => {
    const fpsCounter = counters.find(c => c.name === 'frames_per_second');
    return fpsCounter ? fpsCounter.value : 0;
  };
  
  // Get frame time from counters
  const getFrameTime = () => {
    const frameTimeCounter = counters.find(c => c.name === 'frame_time_ms');
    return frameTimeCounter ? frameTimeCounter.value : 0;
  };
  
  // Get average FPS from counters
  const getAverageFps = () => {
    const fpsCounter = counters.find(c => c.name === 'frames_per_second');
    return fpsCounter ? fpsCounter.average : 0;
  };
  
  // Render graph
  const renderGraph = (graph: GraphData, title: string) => {
    if (graph.data.length === 0) {
      return (
        <div className="h-[120px] flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 text-sm">
          No data
        </div>
      );
    }
    
    const maxValue = Math.max(...graph.data.map(d => d.value), 1);
    const minValue = Math.min(...graph.data.map(d => d.value));
    const valueRange = maxValue - minValue || 1;
    
    return (
      <div className="h-[120px] flex flex-col">
        <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">{title}</div>
        <div className="flex-1 relative">
          <svg className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full" preserveAspectRatio="none">
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="gradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
                <stop offset="0%" stopColor={graph.color} stopOpacity={0.5} />
                <stop offset="100%" stopColor={graph.color} stopOpacity={0} />
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
            
            {/* Grid lines */}
            {[25, 50, 75].map((percent) => (
              <line
                key={percent}
                x1="0%"
                y1={`${percent}%`}
                x2="100%"
                y2={`${percent}%`}
                stroke="#374151"
                strokeWidth="1"
                strokeDasharray="2,2"
              />
            ))}
            
            {/* Area fill */}
            <path
              d={`M 0 ${100 - ((graph.data[0].value - minValue) / valueRange) * 100}
                 ${graph.data.map((d, i) => {
                   const x = (i / (graph.data.length - 1)) * 100;
                   const y = 100 - ((d.value - minValue) / valueRange) * 100;
                   return `${x} ${y}`;
                 }).join(' L ')}
                 L 100 100 L 0 100 Z`}
              }
              fill="url(#gradient)"
            />
            
            {/* Line */}
            <polyline
              points={graph.data.map((d, i) => {
                const x = (i / (graph.data.length - 1)) * 100;
                const y = 100 - ((d.value - minValue) / valueRange) * 100;
                return `${x},${y}`;
              }).join(' ')}
              fill="none"
              stroke={graph.color}
              strokeWidth="2"
            />
            
            {/* Current value label */}
            <text
              x="100%"
              y={`${100 - ((graph.data[graph.data.length - 1].value - minValue) / valueRange) * 100}`}
              textAnchor="end"
              fill={graph.color}
              fontSize="10"
              dx="-4"
              dy="4"
            >
              {graph.data[graph.data.length - 1].value.toFixed(1)}
            </text>
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };
  
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-[#1a1a2e] text-white p-4 overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4 border-b border-gray-700 pb-2">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">Performance Monitor</h2>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              id="autoRefresh"
              checked={autoRefresh}
              onChange={(e) => setAutoRefresh(e.target.checked)}
              className="rounded"
            />
            <label htmlFor="autoRefresh">Auto-refresh</label>
            <select
              value={refreshInterval}
              onChange={(e) => setRefreshInterval(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="bg-gray-700 text-white px-2 py-1 rounded text-sm"
              disabled={!autoRefresh}
            >
              <option value={500}>0.5s</option>
              <option value={1000}>1s</option>
              <option value={2000}>2s</option>
              <option value={5000}>5s</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => loadData()}
            className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-700 rounded text-sm hover:bg-gray-600 transition-colors"
          >
            Refresh
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => toggleMonitoring(!isMonitoring)}
            className={`px-3 py-1 rounded text-sm transition-colors ${
              isMonitoring ? 'bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700' : 'bg-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-500'
            }`}
          >
            {isMonitoring ? 'Monitoring On' : 'Monitoring Off'}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={resetCounters}
            className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-700 rounded text-sm hover:bg-gray-600 transition-colors"
          >
            Reset
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Error display */}
      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 bg-red-900/50 border border-red-700 rounded text-red-300 text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
      
      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex border-b border-gray-700 mb-4">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('overview')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm ${activeTab === 'overview' ? 'bg-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
        >
          Overview
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('counters')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm ${activeTab === 'counters' ? 'bg-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
        >
          Counters
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('memory')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm ${activeTab === 'memory' ? 'bg-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
        >
          Memory
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('cpu')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm ${activeTab === 'cpu' ? 'bg-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
        >
          CPU
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('threads')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm ${activeTab === 'threads' ? 'bg-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
        >
          Threads
        </button>
      </div>
      
      {/* Tab content */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto">
        {activeTab === 'overview' && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {/* FPS Card */}
            <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded p-4">
              <div className="text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">FPS</div>
              <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">{getFps()}</div>
              <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                Avg: {getAverageFps().toFixed(1)} | Frame: {getFrameTime().toFixed(2)}ms
              </div>
              {renderGraph(fpsGraph, 'FPS')}
            </div>
            
            {/* Memory Card */}
            <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded p-4">
              <div className="text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Memory Usage</div>
              <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">
                {memory ? formatBytes(memory.usedPhysical) : 'N/A'}
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                {memory ? `${memory.physicalUsagePercent.toFixed(1)}% of ${formatBytes(memory.totalPhysical)}` : 'Loading...'}
              </div>
              {renderGraph(memoryGraph, 'Memory (MB)')}
            </div>
            
            {/* CPU Card */}
            <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded p-4">
              <div className="text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">CPU Usage</div>
              <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">
                {cpu ? cpu.totalUsage.toFixed(1) : 'N/A'}%
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                {cpu ? `${cpu.coreUsages.length} cores` : 'Loading...'}
              </div>
              {renderGraph(cpuGraph, 'CPU %')}
            </div>
            
            {/* Counters Summary */}
            <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded p-4 col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Key Counters</h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
                {counters
                  .filter(c => ['frames_total', 'draw_calls', 'triangles', 'memory_used_mb', 'memory_allocated_mb'].includes(c.name))
                  .map((counter) => (
                    <div key={counter.name} className="bg-gray-700 rounded p-3">
                      <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 truncate">{counter.name}</div>
                      <div className="text-lg font-bold">{formatNumber(counter.value)}</div>
                      {counter.count > 0 && (
                        <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                          Avg: {counter.average.toFixed(1)}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {activeTab === 'counters' && (
          <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded p-4 h-full overflow-auto">
            <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4">
              <button
                onClick={() => loadData()}
                className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-700 rounded text-sm hover:bg-gray-600 transition-colors"
              >
                Refresh
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={resetCounters}
                className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-700 rounded text-sm hover:bg-gray-600 transition-colors"
              >
                Reset All
              </button>
            </div>
            
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead className="bg-gray-700 sticky top-0">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Name</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Description</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">Value</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">Min</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">Max</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">Avg</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">Count</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {counters.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={7} className="px-4 py-4 text-center text-gray-500">
                      No counters available
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  counters.map((counter) => (
                    <tr key={counter.name} className="border-t border-gray-700">
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono">{counter.name}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 text-gray-400 text-xs">{counter.description || '-'}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{formatNumber(counter.value)}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{counter.minValue === 18446744073709551615 ? 'N/A' : formatNumber(counter.minValue)}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{formatNumber(counter.maxValue)}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{counter.average.toFixed(1)}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{formatNumber(counter.count)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {activeTab === 'memory' && (
          <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded p-4 h-full overflow-auto">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {/* Physical Memory */}
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Physical Memory</h3>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Total:</span>
                    <span>{memory ? formatBytes(memory.totalPhysical) : 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Used:</span>
                    <span>{memory ? formatBytes(memory.usedPhysical) : 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Available:</span>
                    <span>{memory ? formatBytes(memory.availablePhysical) : 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Usage:</span>
                    <span>{memory ? memory.physicalUsagePercent.toFixed(1) + '%' : 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              {/* Process Memory */}
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Process Memory</h3>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Process Memory:</span>
                    <span>{memory ? formatBytes(memory.processMemory) : 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Private Memory:</span>
                    <span>{memory ? formatBytes(memory.processPrivate) : 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              {/* Virtual Memory */}
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Virtual Memory</h3>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Total:</span>
                    <span>{memory ? formatBytes(memory.totalVirtual) : 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Used:</span>
                    <span>{memory ? formatBytes(memory.usedVirtual) : 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Available:</span>
                    <span>{memory ? formatBytes(memory.availableVirtual) : 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Usage:</span>
                    <span>{memory ? memory.virtualUsagePercent.toFixed(1) + '%' : 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              {/* Memory Graph */}
              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                {renderGraph(memoryGraph, 'Memory Usage')}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {activeTab === 'cpu' && (
          <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded p-4 h-full overflow-auto">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {/* Overall CPU */}
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Overall CPU Usage</h3>
                <div className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">
                  {cpu ? cpu.totalUsage.toFixed(1) : 'N/A'}%
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-400">
                  {cpu ? `Last updated: ${new Date(cpu.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()}` : 'Loading...'}
                </div>
                {renderGraph(cpuGraph, 'CPU Usage')}
              </div>
              
              {/* Core Usage */}
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Core Usage</h3>
                {cpu && cpu.coreUsages.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    {cpu.coreUsages.map((usage, index) => (
                      <div key={index} className="bg-gray-700 rounded p-2">
                        <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">Core {index}</div>
                        <div className="text-xl font-bold">{usage.toFixed(1)}%</div>
                        <div className="w-full bg-gray-600 rounded-full h-2 mt-1">
                          <div
                            className="bg-blue-600 h-2 rounded-full"
                            style={{ width: `${usage}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="text-gray-500 text-sm">No core data available</div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {activeTab === 'threads' && (
          <div className="bg-gray-800 rounded p-4 h-full overflow-auto">
            <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4">
              <button
                onClick={() => loadData()}
                className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-700 rounded text-sm hover:bg-gray-600 transition-colors"
              >
                Refresh
              </button>
              <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-700 rounded text-sm">
                Total: {threads.length}
              </span>
            </div>
            
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead className="bg-gray-700 sticky top-0">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">ID</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Name</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Status</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">Priority</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">CPU Time</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {threads.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={5} className="px-4 py-4 text-center text-gray-500">
                      No threads
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  threads.map((thread) => (
                    <tr key={thread.threadId} className="border-t border-gray-700">
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono">{thread.threadId}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2">{thread.name || '-'}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2">
                        <span className={thread.alive ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400'}>
                          {thread.alive ? 'Alive' : 'Dead'}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{thread.priority}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">{formatNumber(thread.cpuTime)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
```

`app/src/components/panels/RttiPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/RttiPanel.tsx
// RTTI resolver — paste addresses, resolve via Echo rtti_resolve_batch.
// Draws from web-mv's RTTITab. Called from App.tsx when rail === "rtti".

import { useState } from "react";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import { echoRequest } from "@/lib/echo";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";

interface RttiResult {
  address: string;
  name: string | null;
  error?: string;
}

interface BatchResponse extends Record<string, unknown> {
  results?: Array<{ success: boolean; name?: string }>;
  name?: string;
  error?: string;
}

async function resolveAddresses(addrs: string[]): Promise<RttiResult[]> {
  if (addrs.length === 0) return [];
  // Prefer batch; fall back to sequential single resolve
  try {
    const r = await echoRequest<BatchResponse>({ type: "rtti_resolve_batch", addresses: addrs });
    if (r.results) {
      // results come back in input order without addresses
      return r.results.map((item, i) => ({
        address: addrs[i],
        name: item.success ? item.name ?? null : null,
        error: item.success ? undefined : "no RTTI",
      }));
    }
  } catch {
    // fall through to single
  }
  const out: RttiResult[] = [];
  for (const addr of addrs) {
    try {
      const r = await echoRequest<BatchResponse>({ type: "rtti_resolve", address: addr });
      out.push({ address: addr, name: r.name ?? null, error: r.error });
    } catch (e) {
      out.push({ address: addr, name: null, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export default function RttiPanel() {
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  const [results, setResults] = useState<RttiResult[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");

  const resolve = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    const addrs = input
      .split(/[\s,\n]+/)
      .map((s) => s.trim())
      .filter((s) => s.length > 0);
    if (addrs.length === 0) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const r = await resolveAddresses(addrs);
      setResults(r);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (!target.attached) {
    return (
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><span className="panel-title">RTTI</span></div>
        <div className="empty"><div className="empty-hint">No process attached.</div></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const visible = results.filter((r) => {
    if (!filter) return true;
    const f = filter.toLowerCase();
    return r.address.includes(f) || (r.name ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(f);
  });

  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateRows: "auto auto auto 1fr", minHeight: 0 }}>
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">RTTI</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        {results.length > 0 && (
          <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{results.filter((r) => r.name).length}/{results.length}</span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
        <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11, marginBottom: "var(--pad-xs)" }}>
          Addresses (space/comma/newline separated)
        </div>
        <textarea
          style={{
            width: "100%", height: 60, resize: "vertical",
            fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)", fontSize: 11,
            background: "var(--bg-2)", border: "1px solid var(--border)",
            borderRadius: 4, color: "inherit", padding: "var(--pad-xs)",
          }}
          placeholder={"0x7ff812340000\n0x7ff812341000"}
          value={input}
          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter" && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) void resolve(); }}
          spellCheck={false}
        />
        <button
          className="row-action"
          style={{ marginTop: "var(--pad-xs)" }}
          data-active
          onClick={() => void resolve()}
          disabled={busy || !input.trim()}
        >
          {busy ? "Resolving…" : "Resolve"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {results.length > 0 && (
        <div className="search">
          <Search size={13} />
          <input value={filter} placeholder="Filter results…" onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="panel-body">
        {visible.map((r) => (
          <div
            key={r.address}
            className="fn-row"
            style={{ position: "static", height: "auto", minHeight: 22, padding: "3px var(--pad-sm)" }}
            data-tip={r.error ?? r.name ?? undefined}
          >
            <span
              className="fn-addr"
              style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)", fontSize: 11, minWidth: 130 }}
            >
              {r.address}
            </span>
            {r.name ? (
              <span className="fn-name" style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)" }}>{r.name}</span>
            ) : (
              <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11, fontStyle: "italic" }}>
                {r.error ?? "unresolved"}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
              const parsed = typed === null ? NaN : Number.parseInt(typed.replace(/^0x/i, ""), 16);
              if (Number.isFinite(parsed)) void add(parsed, scanner.width);
            }}
          >
            <Plus size={13} />

          {entries.length > 0 && (

            <table className="table">

                      <td className="mono" onDoubleClick={() => setEditing(e.id)}>
                        {editing === e.id ? (
                          <input
                            className="addr-input mono"
                            style={{ width: 70 }}
                            autoFocus
                            defaultValue={v?.text ?? ""}
                            onBlur={() => setEditing(null)}

                              if (e2.key === "Enter") {
                                void useWatch.getState().poke(e.id, e2.currentTarget.value);
                                setEditing(null);
                              }
                              if (e2.key === "Escape") setEditing(null);
                            }}
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            {v?.ok === true ? v.text : "-"}
                            {e.freeze && <span className="faint"> *</span>}
                          </>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ width: 26 }}>
                        <button
                          className="icon-button"
                          data-tip={e.freeze ? "Unfreeze" : "Freeze"}
                          style={{ color: e.freeze ? "var(--accent)" : undefined }}
                          onClick={() => void setFreeze(e.id, !e.freeze)}
                        >
                          <Snowflake size={11} />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ width: 24 }}>
                        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Remove" onClick={() => void remove(e.id)}>
                          <X size={11} />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
