`app/src/components/panels/ScriptsPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/ScriptsPanel.tsx
// Echo AngelScript editor: live diagnostics against the Echo API (vendored
// echo-angelscript-lsp), bundling a folder of .as files (as_bundler format),
// the relay agent templates prefilled for the attached process, and install
// into %APPDATA%\scripts where Echo loads scripts from.

import { useDeferredValue, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Download, FolderOpen, HardDriveDownload } from "lucide-react";
import { apiNames, completions, outline, check, type Diagnostic } from "@/lib/angelscript";
import { bundleWithMap, hasIncludes, type Files } from "@/lib/angelscript/bundle";
import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";
import { echoRequest } from "@/lib/echo";
import { download } from "@/lib/files";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { templateFile, templates, withProcess } from "@/lib/templates";

const kSample = `bool main()
{
    uint64 base = process::get_module_base("YourGame.exe");
    print("base " + util::to_hex(base));
    return true;
}
`;
const apiExamples: Record<string, string> = {
  'Process: read': 'uint64 value = process::read_uint64(address);',
  'Process: query region': 'memory_region region = process::virtual_query(address);',
  'Unicorn: create / close': 'uint64 emulator = uc::create_process();\nif (emulator != 0) uc::close(emulator);',
};


type ProjectProblem = Diagnostic & { file?: string };
const kRecoveryKey = "echo-script-recovery-v1";
type Recovery = { name: string; code: string; active: string | null; files: [string, string][] };
function recovery(): Recovery | null {
  try {
    const v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(kRecoveryKey) ?? "null");
    return v && typeof v.name === "string" && typeof v.code === "string" && Array.isArray(v.files) && v.files.every((x: unknown) => Array.isArray(x) && x.length === 2 && x.every(y => typeof y === "string")) ? v : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

export default function ScriptsPanel() {
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const saved = useMemo(recovery, []);
  const [name, setName] = useState(saved?.name ?? "script.as");
  const [code, setCode] = useState(saved?.code ?? kSample);
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<Files>(() => new Map(saved?.files ?? []));
  const [activeFile, setActiveFile] = useState<string | null>(saved?.active ?? null);
  const [entry, setEntry] = useState("");
  const [projectProblems, setProjectProblems] = useState<ProjectProblem[] | null>(null);
  const [completion, setCompletion] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [apiFilter, setApiFilter] = useState("");
  const [showApi, setShowApi] = useState(false);
  const apiMatches = useMemo(() => showApi ? apiNames().filter(n => n.toLowerCase().includes(apiFilter.toLowerCase())).slice(0, 100) : [], [showApi, apiFilter]);
  const [strip, setStrip] = useState(false);
  const [preprocess, setPreprocess] = useState(false);
  const [defines, setDefines] = useState("");
  const [note, setNote] = useState<{ text: string; error: boolean } | null>(null);
  const editor = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const picker = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const folderPicker = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => { folderPicker.current?.setAttribute("webkitdirectory", ""); }, []);
  useEffect(() => { try { localStorage.setItem(kRecoveryKey, JSON.stringify({ name, code, active: activeFile, files: [...files] })); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ } }, [name, code, activeFile, files]);

  const deferred = useDeferredValue(code);
  const diagnostics = useMemo(() => check(deferred), [deferred]);
  const symbols = useMemo(() => outline(deferred), [deferred]);

  const template = (kind: string) => {
    setFiles(new Map()); setActiveFile(null); setEntry(""); setProjectProblems(null);
    setName(templateFile(kind));
    setCode(withProcess(templates[kind], target.name || undefined));
    setNote(target.name ? null : { text: "attach first to prefill the process name", error: false });
  };

  const openFiles = async (list: FileList | null) => {
    if (!list || list.length === 0) return;
    const loaded: Files = new Map();
    for (const f of Array.from(list).filter((x) => x.name.endsWith(".as"))) {
      const path = f.webkitRelativePath ? f.webkitRelativePath.split("/").slice(1).join("/") : f.name;
      if (loaded.has(path)) { setNote({ text: `duplicate path: ${path}`, error: true }); return; }
      loaded.set(path, await f.text());
    }
    const first = loaded.keys().next().value as string | undefined;
    if (!first) return;
    setFiles(loaded); setActiveFile(first); setEntry(""); setProjectProblems(null);
    setName(first.split("/").pop()!);
    setCode(loaded.get(first)!);
    setNote({ text: `opened ${loaded.size} file(s)`, error: false });
  };

  const edit = (value: string) => {
    setCode(value);
    setFiles(prev => { if (!activeFile || !prev.has(activeFile)) return prev; const next = new Map(prev); next.set(activeFile, value); return next; });
    setProjectProblems(null); setCompletion([]);
  };
  const bundleOptions = () => {
    const macros: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const item of defines.split(",")) {
      const at = item.indexOf("=");
      if (at <= 0) continue;
      const name = item.slice(0, at).trim();
      if (!/^[A-Za-z_]\w*$/.test(name)) continue;
      macros[name] = item.slice(at + 1).trim();
    }
    return { preprocess, defines: macros };
  };
  const makeBundle = () => {
    try {
      const output = bundleWithMap(files, strip, entry || undefined, bundleOptions());
      setCode(output.code); setActiveFile(null); setName("bundle.as"); setProjectProblems(null);
      setNote({ text: `bundled ${files.size} files`, error: false });
    } catch (e) { setNote({ text: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e), error: true }); }
  };
  const checkProject = () => {
    try {
      const result = bundleWithMap(files, false, entry || undefined, bundleOptions());
      const problems = check(result.code).map(d => {
        const source = result.lines[d.line];
        return source ? { ...d, file: source.file, line: source.line } : d;
      });
      setProjectProblems(problems);
      setNote({ text: `checked project: ${problems.filter(d => d.severity === "error").length} errors, ${problems.filter(d => d.severity === "warning").length} warnings`, error: false });
    } catch (e) { setProjectProblems(null); setNote({ text: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e), error: true }); }
  };
  const complete = () => {
    const pos = editor.current?.selectionStart ?? code.length;
    const prefix = code.slice(0, pos).match(/[\w:]+$/)?.[0] ?? "";
    setCompletion(completions(code, pos).filter(n => n.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefix.toLowerCase()) && n !== prefix).slice(0, 40));
  };
  const insertCompletion = (value: string) => {
    const pos = editor.current?.selectionStart ?? code.length;
    const prefix = code.slice(0, pos).match(/[\w:]+$/)?.[0] ?? "";
    edit(code.slice(0, pos - prefix.length) + value + code.slice(pos));
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { editor.current?.focus(); editor.current?.setSelectionRange(pos - prefix.length + value.length, pos - prefix.length + value.length); });
  };

  const runtimeStatus = async () => {
    setNote({ text: "Checking Echo connection…", error: false });
    try {
      const [ping, caps] = await Promise.all([
        echoRequest<{ attached?: boolean; pid?: number }>({ type: "ping" }, AbortSignal.timeout(5000)),
        echoRequest<{ protocol?: string; features?: string[] }>({ type: "capabilities" }, AbortSignal.timeout(5000)),
      ]);
      setNote({ text: `Echo ${ping.attached ? `attached (PID ${ping.pid ?? "unknown"})` : "connected without a target"}; extension ${caps.protocol ?? "unknown"}; emulator regions ${caps.features?.includes("emulate_regions") ? "available" : "require updated script"}. Static diagnostics do not verify Echo compilation; check Echo's console for runtime messages.`, error: false });
    } catch (e) { setNote({ text: `Echo status unavailable: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}. Start the relay and load the full extension in Echo.`, error: true }); }
  };

  const install = async () => {
    try {
      const { invoke } = await import("@tauri-apps/api/core");
      const current = check(code);
      if (current.some(d => d.severity === "error")) throw new Error("Fix syntax errors before installing.");
      if (hasIncludes(code)) throw new Error("Bundle the project before installing a script with includes.");
      const path = await invoke<string>("install_script", { name, text: code });
      setNote({ text: `installed to ${path}; changed existing scripts are backed up. Reopen Echo's menu to see it`, error: false });
    } catch (e) {
      setNote({ text: String(e), error: true });
    }
  };

  const jump = (line: number, column: number) => {
    const ta = editor.current;
    if (!ta) return;
    const offset = code.split("\n").slice(0, line).reduce((n, l) => n + l.length + 1, 0) + column;
    ta.focus();
    ta.setSelectionRange(offset, offset);
  };

  const jumpProject = (d: ProjectProblem) => {
    if (!d.file || !files.has(d.file)) { jump(d.line, d.column); return; }
    const source = files.get(d.file)!;
    setActiveFile(d.file); setName(d.file.split("/").pop()!); setCode(source);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const offset = source.split("\n").slice(0, d.line).reduce((n, line) => n + line.length + 1, 0) + d.column;
      editor.current?.focus(); editor.current?.setSelectionRange(offset, offset);
    });
  };
  const shownProblems = projectProblems ?? diagnostics;
  const errors = diagnostics.filter((d) => d.severity === "error").length;

  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ gridTemplateRows: "auto auto 1fr" }}>
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Scripts</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Open .as files, several are bundled" onClick={() => picker.current?.click()}>
          <FolderOpen size={14} />
        </button>
        <button className="row-action" onClick={() => folderPicker.current?.click()} data-tip="Open project folder">Folder</button>
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Download" onClick={() => download(name, code)}>
          <Download size={14} />
        </button>
        {isTauri() && (
          <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Install to %APPDATA%\scripts" disabled={errors > 0} onClick={() => void install()}>
            <HardDriveDownload size={14} />
          </button>
        )}
        <input ref={folderPicker} type="file" multiple hidden onChange={e => { void openFiles(e.currentTarget.files); e.currentTarget.value = ""; }} />
        <input
          ref={picker}
          type="file"
          accept=".as"
          multiple
          hidden
          onChange={(e) => { void openFiles(e.currentTarget.files); e.currentTarget.value = ""; }}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="view-bar toolbar-row" style={{ gap: "var(--pad-xs)", flexWrap: "wrap", paddingBlock: "var(--pad-xs)" }}>
        <input className="addr-input mono" style={{ flex: "1 1 100%", minWidth: 0 }} aria-label="Script file name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
        <button className="row-action" onClick={() => template("ext")} data-tip="echo-reverse.as: Echo's socket plus write, scanner, emulator">full</button>
        <button className="row-action" onClick={() => template("agent")} data-tip="echo-reverse-agent.as: read-only, Echo's socket only">read-only</button>
        <select
          className="select"
          value=""
          aria-label="echo-ai-toolkit templates"
          data-tip="echo-ai-toolkit game templates"
          onChange={(e) => e.target.value && template(e.target.value)}
        >
          <option value="">templates…</option>
          {Object.keys(templates).filter((k) => k !== "agent" && k !== "ext").map((k) => <option key={k} value={k}>{k}</option>)}
        </select>
        {files.size > 0 && <select className="select" aria-label="Project file" value={activeFile ?? ""} onChange={e => { const file = e.target.value; setActiveFile(file || null); if (file) { setName(file.split("/").pop()!); setCode(files.get(file)!); } }}><option value="">project files…</option>{[...files.keys()].map(f => <option key={f}>{f}</option>)}</select>}
        {files.size > 0 && <select className="select" aria-label="Bundle entry" value={entry} onChange={e => { setEntry(e.target.value); setProjectProblems(null); }}><option value="">all files</option>{[...files.keys()].map(f => <option key={f} value={f}>{f}</option>)}</select>}
        <button className="row-action" disabled={!files.size} onClick={checkProject}>Check project</button>
        <button className="row-action" disabled={!files.size} onClick={makeBundle}>Bundle</button>
        {symbols.length > 0 && <select className="select" aria-label="Document outline" value="" onChange={e => { const symbol = symbols[Number(e.target.value)]; if (symbol) jump(symbol.line, symbol.column); }}><option value="">outline…</option>{symbols.map((symbol, i) => <option key={`${symbol.line}:${symbol.column}`} value={i}>{symbol.name}</option>)}</select>}
        <button className="row-action" onClick={complete} data-tip="Echo API completion (Ctrl+Space)">Complete</button>
        <button className="row-action" data-active={showApi} onClick={() => setShowApi(!showApi)}>API browser</button>
        <select className="select" aria-label="Echo API examples" value="" onChange={e => { const example = apiExamples[e.target.value]; if (example) { const pos = editor.current?.selectionStart ?? code.length; edit(code.slice(0, pos) + example + code.slice(pos)); } }}><option value="">API examples…</option>{Object.keys(apiExamples).map(name => <option key={name}>{name}</option>)}</select>
        <button className="row-action" onClick={() => setNote({ text: "Checklist: 1. Fix static errors. 2. Bundle includes. 3. Install the script. 4. Reload it in Echo. 5. Check Echo's console for compilation and runtime errors. Static diagnostics do not run Echo.", error: false })}>Test checklist</button>
        <button className="row-action" onClick={() => void runtimeStatus()} data-tip="Check Echo and extension compatibility">Runtime status</button>
        <label className="view-label" style={{ fontSize: 11 }} data-tip="Strip comment-only lines when bundling">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={strip} onChange={(e) => setStrip(e.target.checked)} />
          strip
        </label>
        <label className="view-label" style={{ fontSize: 11 }} data-tip="Expand defines, build timestamps and STRHASH before bundling">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={preprocess} onChange={(e) => setPreprocess(e.target.checked)} />
          preprocess
        </label>
        {preprocess && <input className="addr-input mono" style={{ flex: "1 1 150px" }} value={defines} placeholder="DEBUG=1, MODE=2" onChange={(e) => setDefines(e.target.value)} aria-label="Preprocessor defines" />}
        {showApi && <div style={{ flex: "1 1 100%", maxHeight: 110, overflow: "auto" }}><input className="addr-input" value={apiFilter} onChange={e => setApiFilter(e.target.value)} placeholder="Filter Echo API…" aria-label="Filter Echo API" /><span className="faint"> Select a name to insert it; templates provide working examples.</span><div>{apiMatches.map(n => <button key={n} className="row-action mono" onMouseDown={e => e.preventDefault()} onClick={() => insertCompletion(n)}>{n}</button>)}</div></div>}
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateRows: completion.length ? "1fr auto auto 1fr" : "1fr auto 1fr", minHeight: 0 }}>
        <textarea
          ref={editor}
          className="code-area mono"
          value={code}
          spellCheck={false}
          onChange={(e) => edit(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={e => { if (e.ctrlKey && e.code === "Space") { e.preventDefault(); complete(); } }}
        />
        {completion.length > 0 && <div style={{ overflow: "auto", maxHeight: 100 }}>{completion.map(n => <button key={n} className="row-action mono" onMouseDown={e => e.preventDefault()} onClick={() => insertCompletion(n)}>{n}</button>)}</div>}
        <div className="dbg-head" style={{ borderTop: "1px solid var(--border-soft)" }}>
          Problems
          <div className="spacer" />
          <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
            {shownProblems.filter(d => d.severity === "error").length} errors · {shownProblems.filter(d => d.severity === "warning").length} warnings
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="panel-body log">
          {note !== null && (
            <div className="log-row" style={{ color: note.error ? "var(--danger)" : undefined }}>{note.text}</div>
          )}
          {shownProblems.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="empty-hint">No problems against the Echo API.</div>
          ) : (
            shownProblems.map((d, i) => (
              <button key={i} className="log-row" style={{ textAlign: "left", width: "100%" }} onClick={() => jumpProject(d)}>
                <span className="faint">{"file" in d && d.file ? `${d.file}:` : ""}{d.line + 1}:{d.column + 1}</span>
                <span style={{ color: d.severity === "error" ? "var(--danger)" : "var(--warning)" }}>{d.message}</span>
              </button>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/SigDocPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/SigDocPanel.tsx
// Signature Doctor catalog panel — paste catalog JSON, validate each sig against
// the live process via Echo relay. Ported from github.com/b4rzY/Signature-Doctor.
// Called from App.tsx leftPanel() when rail === "sigdoc".

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { CheckCircle, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, PlayCircle, Square, XCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { resolveSignature, type SignatureItem, type SignatureResult } from "@/lib/signatures";
import { download } from "@/lib/files";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";

// ── Catalog model (subset of Signature-Doctor shared/model.mjs) ──────────────

interface Catalog { schemaVersion?: number; id?: string; name?: string; processName?: string; items: SignatureItem[]; }
type Status = SignatureResult["status"];

// ── Visual helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const TONE: Record<Status, string> = {
  valid:    "var(--success, #4caf50)",
  moved:    "var(--warning, #ff9800)",
  ambiguous:"var(--accent, #9c27b0)",
  missing:  "var(--danger, #f44336)",
  error:    "var(--danger, #f44336)",
  disabled: "var(--muted, #888)",
  pending:  "var(--accent)",
};

const ICON: Record<Status, React.ReactNode> = {
  valid:    <CheckCircle size={12} />,
  moved:    <CheckCircle size={12} />,
  ambiguous:<XCircle size={12} />,
  missing:  <XCircle size={12} />,
  error:    <XCircle size={12} />,
  disabled: <Square size={12} />,
  pending:  <ChevronRight size={12} />,
};

const kDemo: Catalog = {
  name: "Demo catalog",
  items: [
    { id: "d1", name: "Example signature", module: "GameModule.dll", kind: "signature", pattern: "48 8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 85 C0", enabled: true },
    { id: "d2", name: "Example RVA",       module: "GameModule.dll", kind: "rva",       rva: "0x1234",                              enabled: true },
  ],
};

function normalizeCatalog(catalog: Catalog): Catalog {
  return catalog.schemaVersion === 1
    ? { ...catalog, items: catalog.items.map((item) => item.kind === "pointer" ? { ...item, pointerSize: item.pointerSize ?? 8 } : item) }
    : catalog;
}

// ── Component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function SigDocPanel() {
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const [json, setJson] = useState(() => { try { return localStorage.getItem("signature-catalog") ?? JSON.stringify(kDemo, null, 2); } catch { return JSON.stringify(kDemo, null, 2); } });
  const [catalog, setCatalog] = useState<Catalog | null>(() => { try { const v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("signature-catalog") ?? "null"); return Array.isArray(v?.items) ? normalizeCatalog(v) : kDemo; } catch { return kDemo; } });
  const [parseErr, setParseErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [results, setResults] = useState<Map<string, SignatureResult>>(new Map());
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [approved, setApproved] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [baseline, setBaseline] = useState<{ catalog: string; values: Record<string, string> } | null>(() => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("signature-baseline") ?? "null"); } catch { return null; }
  });
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const parse = (text: string) => {
    setJson(text);
    setResults(new Map());
    setApproved(new Set());
    try {
      const c = JSON.parse(text) as Catalog;
      if (!Array.isArray(c.items)) throw new Error("missing items array");
      const ids = new Set<string>();
      for (const item of c.items) {
        if (!item || typeof item.id !== "string" || !item.id || ids.has(item.id) || typeof item.name !== "string" || typeof item.module !== "string") throw new Error("items require unique IDs, names and modules");
        ids.add(item.id);
      }
      // Versioned catalogs default pointer recipes to 64-bit pointers; the
      // resolver uses the same semantics for compact local recipes.
      const normalized = normalizeCatalog(c);
      setCatalog(normalized);
      try { localStorage.setItem("signature-catalog", JSON.stringify(normalized)); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
      setParseErr(null);
    } catch (e) {
      setCatalog(null);
      setParseErr(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    }
  };

  const catalogKey = (text: string) => { try { return JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(text)); } catch { return text; } };
  const matchesBaseline = baseline !== null && catalogKey(baseline.catalog) === catalogKey(json);
  const run = async () => {
    if (!catalog || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setApproved(new Set());
    const seed = new Map(catalog.items.map((i) => [i.id, { id: i.id, status: "pending" as Status, message: "…" }]));
    setResults(seed);
    const ac = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = ac;
    for (const item of catalog.items) {
      if (ac.signal.aborted) break;
      const r = await resolveSignature(item, matchesBaseline ? baseline!.values[item.id] : undefined, ac.signal);
      if (ac.signal.aborted) break;
      setResults((prev) => new Map([...prev, [r.id, r]]));
    }
    setBusy(false);
  };

  const stop = () => { abortRef.current?.abort(); };
  const saveBaseline = () => {
    const values = Object.fromEntries([...results].filter(([, r]) => (r.status === "valid" || r.status === "moved") && r.rva !== undefined).map(([id, r]) => [id, r.rva!]));
    const next = { catalog: json, values };
    try { localStorage.setItem("signature-baseline", JSON.stringify(next)); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
    setBaseline(next);
  };
  const exportReviewed = () => {
    if (!catalog) return;
    const entries = catalog.items.filter(i => approved.has(i.id)).map(i => ({ ...i, result: results.get(i.id) })).filter(i => i.result?.status === "valid" || i.result?.status === "moved");
    download("signatures-reviewed.json", JSON.stringify({ catalog: catalog.name, entries }, null, 2));
  };
  const toggle = (id: string) => setExpanded((prev) => {
    const s = new Set(prev);
    s.has(id) ? s.delete(id) : s.add(id);
    return s;
  });

  if (!target.attached) {
    return (
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><span className="panel-title">Signature Doctor</span></div>
        <div className="empty"><div className="empty-hint">No process attached.</div></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const items = catalog?.items ?? [];
  let ok = 0, fail = 0;
  for (const r of results.values()) {
    if (r.status === "valid" || r.status === "moved") ok++;
    else if (r.status !== "disabled" && r.status !== "pending") fail++;
  }

  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateRows: "auto auto 1fr", minHeight: 0 }}>
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Signature Doctor</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        {results.size > 0 && (
          <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{ok}✓ {fail}✗</span>
        )}
        <button
          className="icon-button"
          data-tip={busy ? "Stop" : "Run all"}
          onClick={busy ? stop : () => void run()}
          disabled={!catalog || parseErr !== null}
        >
          <PlayCircle size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
        <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11, marginBottom: "var(--pad-xs)" }}>Catalog JSON</div>
        <textarea
          style={{
            width: "100%", height: 80, resize: "vertical",
            fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)", fontSize: 11,
            background: "var(--bg-2)", border: `1px solid ${parseErr ? "var(--danger)" : "var(--border)"}`,
            borderRadius: 4, color: "inherit", padding: "var(--pad-xs)",
          }}
          value={json}
          disabled={busy}
          onChange={(e) => parse(e.target.value)}
          spellCheck={false}
        />
        {parseErr && <div style={{ color: "var(--danger)", fontSize: 11 }}>{parseErr}</div>}
      </div>

      <div className="panel-body">
        <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", display: "flex", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          <button className="row-action" disabled={busy || !results.size} onClick={saveBaseline}>Set baseline</button>
          <button className="row-action" disabled={busy || !approved.size} onClick={exportReviewed}>Export reviewed ({approved.size})</button>
          <span className="faint">{baseline ? matchesBaseline ? "baseline matches catalog" : "baseline belongs to another catalog" : "no baseline"}</span>
        </div>
        {items.map((item) => {
          const r = results.get(item.id);
          const status: Status = r?.status ?? "pending";
          const open = expanded.has(item.id);
          return (
            <div key={item.id} style={{ borderBottom: "1px solid var(--border-subtle, var(--border))" }}>
              <div
                className="fn-row"
                style={{ position: "static", height: "auto", minHeight: 22, padding: "2px var(--pad-sm)", cursor: "pointer" }}
                onClick={() => toggle(item.id)}
              >
                <span style={{ color: TONE[status], marginRight: 4, display: "flex", alignItems: "center" }}>
                  {ICON[status]}
                </span>
                <span className="fn-name">{item.name}</span>
                <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10, marginLeft: "auto", marginRight: 4 }}>{item.module}</span>
                {open ? <ChevronDown size={11} /> : <ChevronRight size={11} />}
              </div>
              {open && r && (
                <div style={{ padding: "2px var(--pad-md) var(--pad-sm)", fontSize: 11, fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)" }}>
                  <div><span className="faint">kind: </span>{item.kind}</div>
                  {item.pattern && <div><span className="faint">pattern: </span>{item.pattern}</div>}
                  <div><span className="faint">status: </span><span style={{ color: TONE[status] }}>{r.status}</span></div>
                  {r.address && <div><span className="faint">address: </span>{r.address}</div>}
                  {r.candidates && <div><span className="faint">hits: </span>{r.candidates.join(", ")}</div>}
                  <div><span className="faint">msg: </span>{r.message}</div>
                  {r.rva && <div><span className="faint">module-relative: </span>{r.rva}</div>}
                  {r.evidence?.map((step, i) => <div key={i} className="faint">{step}</div>)}
                  {(r.status === "valid" || r.status === "moved") && <label><input type="checkbox" checked={approved.has(item.id)} onChange={(e) => setApproved(prev => { const next = new Set(prev); if (e.target.checked) next.add(item.id); else next.delete(item.id); return next; })} /> Approve for export</label>}
                  {r.durationMs !== undefined && <div className="faint">{r.durationMs.toFixed(1)} ms</div>}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/Source2Panel.tsx
// Source 2 schema classes and CreateInterface registries from live memory
// (lib/source2.ts), exported as a cs2-dumper-style offsets header.

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Copy, Download, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { copyText } from "@/lib/clipboard";
import { saveOrDownload } from "@/lib/files";
import { schemaHeader, type SchemaClass } from "@/lib/source2";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useEngines } from "@/store/engines";

const kShown = 500;
const hx = (n: number) => `0x${n.toString(16).toUpperCase()}`;

export default function Source2Panel() {
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const { source2, source2State, scanSource2 } = useEngines();
  const [module, setModule] = useState("client.dll");
  const [view, setView] = useState<"classes" | "interfaces">("classes");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<SchemaClass | null>(null);
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const f = filter.toLowerCase();
  const classes = useMemo(() => (source2?.classes ?? []).filter((c) => !f || c.name.toLowerCase().includes(f)).slice(0, kShown), [source2, f]);
  const ifaces = useMemo(() => (source2?.interfaces ?? []).filter((i) => !f || i.name.toLowerCase().includes(f)), [source2, f]);

  if (!target.attached) {
    return (
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><span className="panel-title">Source 2</span></div>
        <div className="empty"><div className="empty-hint">No process attached.</div></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const header = source2 ? schemaHeader(source2.classes) : "";

  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateRows: "auto auto auto 1fr auto", minHeight: 0 }}>
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Source 2</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        {source2 && (
          <>
            <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Copy offsets header" onClick={() => void copyText(header)}><Copy size={13} /></button>
            <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Export offsets header"
              onClick={() => void saveOrDownload(`${module.replace(/\.\w+$/, "") || "schema"}_offsets.hpp`, header).then(setNote)}>
              <Download size={13} />
            </button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", display: "grid", gap: "var(--pad-xs)" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--pad-xs)" }}>
          <input className="addr-input mono" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }} value={module} placeholder="module (empty = all)"
            onChange={(e) => setModule(e.target.value)} />
          <button className="row-action" data-active disabled={source2State.busy} onClick={() => void scanSource2(module.trim())}>
            {source2State.busy ? "Working…" : "Scan"}
          </button>
        </div>
        {source2State.progress !== "" && <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{source2State.progress}</div>}
        {source2State.error !== null && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--danger)" }}>{source2State.error}</div>}
        {note !== null && <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{note}</div>}
      </div>
      {source2 ? (
        <div className="search">
          <Search size={13} />
          <input value={filter} placeholder="Filter…" onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)} />
          <select value={view} onChange={(e) => setView(e.target.value as "classes" | "interfaces")}>
            <option value="classes">classes</option>
            <option value="interfaces">interfaces</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      ) : <div />}
      <div className="panel-body">
        {view === "classes" && classes.map((c) => (
          <button key={c.address} className="fn-row" style={{ position: "static", height: 20 }} data-tip={c.module} onClick={() => setPicked(c)}>
            <span className="fn-name mono">{c.name}</span>
            <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{c.fields.length}f · {hx(c.size)}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
        {view === "interfaces" && ifaces.map((i) => (
          <div key={`${i.module}:${i.name}`} className="fn-row" style={{ position: "static", height: 20 }} data-tip={`CreateFn ${hx(i.create)}`}>
            <span className="fn-name mono">{i.name}</span>
            <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{i.module} {i.instance !== null ? hx(i.instance) : "?"}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {picked && (
        <pre className="mono" style={{ margin: 0, padding: "var(--pad-sm)", overflow: "auto", fontSize: 11, maxHeight: "40%", borderTop: "1px solid var(--border)" }}>
          {`// ${picked.module} size ${hx(picked.size)}\nclass ${picked.name}${picked.base ? ` : public ${picked.base}` : ""}\n{\n${picked.fields.map((x) => `\t${x.type} ${x.name}; // ${hx(x.offset)}`).join("\n")}\n};`}
        </pre>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/StringsView.tsx
// Port of src/ui/view_strings.cpp. Virtualized because a real image yields
// thousands of hits, and the engine caps at 10k

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { Download, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { hex, useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { classifyString, exportStrings, type StringCategory } from "@/lib/strings";
import { download } from "@/lib/files";
import { useMemory } from "@/store/memory";
import { useUi } from "@/store/ui";

const kRow = 20;

export default function StringsView() {
  const { strings, stringsTruncated, loadStrings, gotoAddress, busy } = useDisasm();
  const [minChars, setMinChars] = useState(4);
  const [includeExec, setIncludeExec] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<"all" | StringCategory>("all");
  const [regex, setRegex] = useState(false);
  const [exportFormat, setExportFormat] = useState<"csv" | "json" | "txt">("csv");
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const readAt = useMemory((s) => s.readAt);
  const setTab = useUi((s) => s.setTab);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadStrings(minChars, includeExec);
  }, [loadStrings, minChars, includeExec]);

  const regexError = useMemo(() => {
    if (!regex || filter === "") return null;
    try { new RegExp(filter, "i"); return null; }
    catch (e) { return e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e); }
  }, [regex, filter]);

  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    let expression: RegExp | null = null;
    if (regex && filter !== "" && regexError === null) expression = new RegExp(filter, "i");
    return strings.filter((s) => {
      if (category !== "all" && classifyString(s.text) !== category) return false;
      if (expression) return expression.test(s.text);
      if (filter === "") return true;
      return s.text.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase());
    });
  }, [strings, filter, category, regex, regexError]);

  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: rows.length,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 20,
  });

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      <div className="view-bar">
        <div className="search" style={{ margin: 0, flex: 1 }}>
          <Search size={13} />
          <input
            value={filter}
            placeholder={regex ? `Regex filter ${strings.length} strings…` : `Filter ${strings.length} strings…`}
            onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
        <label className="view-label" data-tip="Treat the filter as a regular expression">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={regex} onChange={(e) => setRegex(e.target.checked)} />
          regex
        </label>
        <select className="select" value={category} onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value as "all" | StringCategory)} aria-label="String category">
          <option value="all">all categories</option>
          <option value="url">URLs</option>
          <option value="path">paths</option>
          <option value="cmd">commands</option>
          <option value="rtti">RTTI / class names</option>
          <option value="other">other</option>
        </select>
        <label className="view-label">
          min
          <select
            className="select"
            value={minChars}
            onChange={(e) => setMinChars(Number(e.target.value))}
          >
            {[3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16].map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>
                {n}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label className="view-label">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={includeExec}
            onChange={(e) => setIncludeExec(e.target.checked)}
          />
          exec sections
        </label>
        {stringsTruncated && <span className="pill">truncated</span>}
        {regexError !== null && <span style={{ color: "var(--danger)", fontSize: 10 }}>{regexError}</span>}
        <div className="spacer" />
        <select className="select" value={exportFormat} onChange={(e) => setExportFormat(e.target.value as "csv" | "json" | "txt")} aria-label="String export format">
          <option value="csv">CSV</option><option value="json">JSON</option><option value="txt">TXT</option>
        </select>
        <button
          className="icon-button"
          data-tip="Export filtered strings"
          disabled={rows.length === 0}
          onClick={() => download(`strings.${exportFormat}`, exportStrings(rows.map((s) => ({ address: `0x${s.va.toString(16)}`, text: s.text, utf16: s.utf16, category: classifyString(s.text) })), exportFormat))}
        >
          <Download size={13} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="panel-body" ref={scrollRef}>
        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
            {busy ? "scanning…" : "no strings matched."}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
            {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => {
              const s = rows[v.index];
              return (
                <div
                  key={`${s.va}-${v.index}`}
                  className="insn-row mono"
                  style={{ top: v.start, height: kRow }}
                >
                  <button
                    className="insn-va link"
                    onClick={() => void gotoAddress(s.va)}
                    data-tip="follow in disassembly"
                  >
                    {hex(s.va)}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="row-action"
                    style={{ height: 16, padding: "0 4px", fontSize: 9 }}
                    onClick={() => { setTab("memory"); void readAt(s.va); }}
                    data-tip="open at this address in Memory"
                  >
                    mem
                  </button>
                  {s.utf16 && <span className="pill">w</span>}
                  <span className="insn-text" style={{ userSelect: "text" }}>
                    {s.text}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/TargetsPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/TargetsPanel.tsx
// process list and attach flow, stays on the list after attaching so targets
// can be switched without detaching

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { RefreshCw, Search, Unplug } from "lucide-react";
import ProcessIcon from "@/components/ProcessIcon";
import { matchesFilter, useTargets } from "@/store/targets";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";

const kRowHeight = 22;

export default function TargetsPanel() {
  const { processes, filter, loading, error, setFilter, refresh, attach, detach } = useTargets();
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const backend = useEngine((s) => s.backend);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [attachTo, setAttachTo] = useState("");
  const [attaching, setAttaching] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, [refresh]);

  const submitAttach = async () => {
    const value = attachTo.trim();
    if (!value || attaching) return;
    setAttaching(true);
    const ok = await attach(value);
    setAttaching(false);
    if (ok) {
      setAttachTo("");
      await refresh();
    }
  };

  const rows = useMemo(
    () => processes.filter((p) => matchesFilter(p, filter)),
    [processes, filter],
  );

  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: rows.length,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRowHeight,
    overscan: 12,
  });

  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Backend: {backend.badge}</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}>
          {processes.length} live target{processes.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
        </span>
        {target.attached && (
          <button className="icon-button" data-tip={`Detach ${target.name}`} onClick={() => void detach()}>
            <Unplug size={14} />
          </button>
        )}
        <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Refresh" onClick={() => void refresh()}>
          <RefreshCw size={14} className={loading ? "spin" : undefined} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateRows: "auto auto 1fr", minHeight: 0 }}>
        <div className="search">
          <Search size={13} />
          <input
            value={filter}
            placeholder="Filter target…"
            onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="view-bar" style={{ gap: "var(--pad-xs)", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          <label className="view-label" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 150 }}>
            attach
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              value={attachTo}
              placeholder="process.exe or PID"
              onChange={(e) => setAttachTo(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") void submitAttach(); }}
            />
          </label>
          <button className="row-action" disabled={attaching || !attachTo.trim()} onClick={() => void submitAttach()}>
            {attaching ? "Attaching…" : "Attach"}
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="panel-body" ref={scrollRef}>
          {rows.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="empty">
              <div className="empty-title">No target attached.</div>
              <div className="empty-hint">
                Attach in Echo, or load the full echo-reverse.as extension and use the attach field above.
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <table className="table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th style={{ width: 58 }}>PID</th>
                  <th>Name</th>
                  <th style={{ width: 44 }}>Arch</th>
                  <th style={{ width: 60 }}>Action</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
                {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => {
                  const p = rows[v.index];
                  const isTarget = target.attached && target.pid === p.pid;
                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={p.pid}
                      data-selected={isTarget}
                      style={{
                        position: "absolute",
                        top: v.start,
                        left: 0,
                        width: "100%",
                        height: kRowHeight,
                        display: "table",
                        tableLayout: "fixed",
                      }}
                      data-tip={p.path ?? p.name}
                    >
                      <td style={{ width: 58 }} className="mono faint">
                        {p.pid}
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <span style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "var(--pad-sm)", minWidth: 0 }}>
                          <ProcessIcon path={p.path} />
                          <span style={{ overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
                            {p.name}
                          </span>
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ width: 44 }}>
                        <span className="faint">—</span>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ width: 60 }}>
                        {isTarget ? (
                          <button className="row-action" data-active="true" onClick={() => void detach()}>
                            Detach
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <button className="row-action" onClick={() => void attach(p.pid)}>
                            Attach
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          )}
          {error !== null && <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", color: "var(--danger)", fontSize: 11 }}>{error}</div>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/UnityPanel.tsx
// IL2CPP from live memory (lib/il2cpp.ts): browse types, export the in-memory
// global-metadata.dat and a GameAssembly dump for Il2CppDumper / Cpp2IL.

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Download, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { saveOrDownload } from "@/lib/files";
import { dumpModuleFile } from "@/lib/iat";
import type { Il2CppType } from "@/lib/il2cpp";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useEngines } from "@/store/engines";

const kShown = 500;

export default function UnityPanel() {
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const { unity, unityState, openUnity } = useEngines();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<Il2CppType | null>(null);
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const visible = useMemo(() => {
    const f = filter.toLowerCase();
    return (unity?.types ?? []).filter((t) => !f || `${t.namespace}.${t.name}`.toLowerCase().includes(f)).slice(0, kShown);
  }, [unity, filter]);

  if (!target.attached) {
    return (
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><span className="panel-title">Unity</span></div>
        <div className="empty"><div className="empty-hint">No process attached.</div></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const exportAll = async () => {
    if (!unity) return;
    try {
      setNote("writing global-metadata.dat…");
      const meta = await saveOrDownload("global-metadata.dat", unity.bytes);
      const { modules } = await call<{ modules: Array<{ name: string; base: number; size: number }> }>("target", "modules");
      const ga = modules.find((m) => m.name.toLowerCase() === "gameassembly.dll");
      const dump = ga ? await dumpModuleFile(ga, setNote) : null;
      const dll = dump ? await saveOrDownload("GameAssembly_dump.dll", dump.bytes) : "GameAssembly.dll not loaded";
      setNote(`metadata ${meta}; GameAssembly ${dll}. Feed both to Il2CppDumper or Cpp2IL.`);
    } catch (e) {
      setNote(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateRows: "auto auto auto 1fr auto", minHeight: 0 }}>
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Unity</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        {unity && (
          <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Export global-metadata.dat + GameAssembly dump for Il2CppDumper" onClick={() => void exportAll()}>
            <Download size={13} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", display: "grid", gap: "var(--pad-xs)" }}>
        <button className="row-action" data-active disabled={unityState.busy} onClick={() => void openUnity()}>
          {unityState.busy ? "Working…" : unity ? "Re-read metadata" : "Find IL2CPP metadata"}
        </button>
        {unityState.progress !== "" && <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{unityState.progress}</div>}
        {unityState.error !== null && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--danger)" }}>{unityState.error}</div>}
        {note !== null && <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{note}</div>}
      </div>
      {unity ? (
        <div className="search">
          <Search size={13} />
          <input value={filter} placeholder="Filter types…" onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
      ) : <div />}
      <div className="panel-body">
        {visible.map((t, i) => (
          <button key={i} className="fn-row" style={{ position: "static", height: 20 }} data-tip={t.image} onClick={() => setPicked(t)}>
            <span className="fn-name mono">{t.namespace ? `${t.namespace}.` : ""}{t.name}</span>
            <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{t.fields.length}f {t.methods.length}m</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {picked && (
        <pre className="mono" style={{ margin: 0, padding: "var(--pad-sm)", overflow: "auto", fontSize: 11, maxHeight: "40%", borderTop: "1px solid var(--border)" }}>
          {`// ${picked.image}\nclass ${picked.namespace ? `${picked.namespace}.` : ""}${picked.name}\n{\n${picked.fields.map((f) => `\t${f};`).join("\n")}\n\n${picked.methods.map((m) => `\t${m}();`).join("\n")}\n}`}
        </pre>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
