`app/src/components/panels/UnrealPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/UnrealPanel.tsx
// Dumper-7-style Unreal SDK dump over Echo reads (lib/unreal.ts): finds GObjects
// and GNames, browses objects, dumps a class/struct or the whole SDK.

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Copy, Download, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { copyText } from "@/lib/clipboard";
import { download } from "@/lib/files";
import type { UObj } from "@/lib/unreal";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useUnreal } from "@/store/unreal";

const kKinds = ["Class", "ScriptStruct", "Enum", "Function", "Package", "all"] as const;
const kShown = 500;

const rvaText = (n: number) => `0x${n.toString(16).toUpperCase()}`;


export default function UnrealPanel() {
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const { ue, base, module, progress, busy, error, open, exportSdk } = useUnreal();
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<(typeof kKinds)[number]>("Class");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");
  const [manualError, setManualError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [manual, setManual] = useState({ gobjects: "", gnames: "" });
  const [dump, setDump] = useState<{ title: string; text: string } | null>(null);

  const visible = useMemo(() => {
    if (!ue) return [];
    const f = filter.toLowerCase();
    const out: UObj[] = [];
    for (const o of ue.objs) {
      if (kind !== "all" && o.cls !== kind) continue;
      if (f && !o.name.toLowerCase().includes(f)) continue;
      out.push(o);
      if (out.length >= kShown) break;
    }
    return out;
  }, [ue, kind, filter]);

  if (!target.attached) {
    return (
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head"><span className="panel-title">Unreal</span></div>
        <div className="empty"><div className="empty-hint">No process attached.</div></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const start = () => {
    const parse = (value: string) => value.trim() === "" ? undefined : /^(?:0x)?[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(value.trim()) ? Number.parseInt(value.replace(/^0x/i, ""), 16) : NaN;
    const g = parse(manual.gobjects), n = parse(manual.gnames);
    if ((g !== undefined && !Number.isSafeInteger(g)) || (n !== undefined && !Number.isSafeInteger(n))) {
      setManualError("Enter valid hexadecimal RVAs or leave the fields empty."); return;
    }
    setManualError(null);
    void open(g, n);
  };

  const show = async (o: UObj) => {
    if (!ue) return;
    const dumpable = o.cls === "Class" || o.cls === "ScriptStruct" || o.cls === "Enum";
    setDump({ title: ue.path(o), text: dumpable ? "dumping…" : `// ${o.cls} ${ue.path(o)} @ 0x${o.addr.toString(16)}` });
    if (dumpable) setDump({ title: ue.path(o), text: o.cls === "Enum" ? await ue.dumpEnum(o) : await ue.dump(o) });
  };

  const offsets = ue
    ? `// ${module}${ue.valorant ? "\n// GObjects was recovered with the Valorant 7-state encrypted-globals cipher" : ""}\nconstexpr uint64 GObjects = ${rvaText(ue.layout.gobjects - base)};\nconstexpr uint64 GNames = ${rvaText(ue.layout.gnames - base)};\n`
      + Object.entries(ue.layout).filter(([k]) => k !== "gobjects" && k !== "gnames").map(([k, v]) => `// ${k} = ${typeof v === "number" ? rvaText(v) : v}`).join("\n")
    : "";

  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateRows: "auto auto auto 1fr auto", minHeight: 0 }}>
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Unreal</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        {ue && (
          <>
            <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Copy offsets" onClick={() => void copyText(offsets)}>
              <Copy size={13} />
            </button>
            <button
              className="icon-button"
              data-tip="Export SDK (.hpp)"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => void exportSdk().then((sdk) => sdk && download(`${module.replace(/\.\w+$/, "")}_SDK.hpp`, sdk))}
            >
              <Download size={13} />
            </button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      <div style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", display: "grid", gap: "var(--pad-xs)" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--pad-xs)" }}>
          <input
            className="addr-input mono"
            style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}
            placeholder="GObjects rva (auto)"
            value={manual.gobjects}
            onChange={(e) => setManual({ ...manual, gobjects: e.target.value })}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input mono"
            style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}
            placeholder="GNames rva (auto)"
            value={manual.gnames}
            onChange={(e) => setManual({ ...manual, gnames: e.target.value })}
          />
        </div>
        <button className="row-action" data-active disabled={busy} onClick={start}>
          {busy ? "Working…" : ue ? "Re-index" : "Find GObjects + index"}
        </button>
        {progress !== "" && <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{progress}</div>}
        {manualError && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--danger)" }}>{manualError}</div>}
        {error !== null && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--danger)" }}>{error}</div>}
        {ue && (
          <div className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
            GObjects {rvaText(ue.layout.gobjects - base)} · GNames {rvaText(ue.layout.gnames - base)}
            {ue.valorant && <span style={{ color: "var(--accent)" }}> · Valorant cipher</span>}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {ue ? (
        <div className="search">
          <Search size={13} />
          <input value={filter} placeholder="Filter by name…" onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)} />
          <select value={kind} onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value as (typeof kKinds)[number])}>
            {kKinds.map((k) => <option key={k} value={k}>{k}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
      ) : <div />}

      <div className="panel-body">
        {visible.map((o) => (
          <button
            key={o.addr}
            className="fn-row"
            style={{ position: "static", height: 20 }}
            data-tip={ue?.path(o)}
            onClick={() => void show(o)}
          >
            <span className="fn-name mono">{o.name}</span>
            <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{o.cls}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
        {visible.length === kShown && <div className="faint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)", fontSize: 11 }}>first {kShown} shown, filter to narrow.</div>}
      </div>

      {dump && (
        <div style={{ borderTop: "1px solid var(--border)", maxHeight: "45%", display: "grid", gridTemplateRows: "auto 1fr", minHeight: 0 }}>
          <div className="panel-head">
            <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" }}>{dump.title}</span>
            <div className="spacer" />
            <button className="icon-button" data-tip="Copy" onClick={() => void copyText(dump.text)}><Copy size={12} /></button>
          </div>
          <pre className="mono" style={{ margin: 0, padding: "var(--pad-sm)", overflow: "auto", fontSize: 11 }}>{dump.text}</pre>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```

`app/src/components/panels/ValueTrackerPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/ValueTrackerPanel.tsx
// Value Tracker Panel for Echo Backend

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { valueTracking, util, parseAddress } from '@/lib/echo-extensions';
import { PanelProps } from './panelTypes';

interface TrackedValueData {
  address: string;
  name: string;
  currentValue: string;
  previousValue: string;
  lastUpdated: number;
  changed: boolean;
}

const ValueTrackerPanel: React.FC<PanelProps> = ({ }) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'tracker' | 'history'>('tracker');
  const [trackedValues, setTrackedValues] = useState<TrackedValueData[]>([]);
  const [changedValues, setChangedValues] = useState<TrackedValueData[]>([]);
  const [isTracking, setIsTracking] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [autoRefresh, setAutoRefresh] = useState(true);
  const [refreshInterval, setRefreshInterval] = useState(1000);
  
  // Form states
  const [addressInput, setAddressInput] = useState('');
  const [nameInput, setNameInput] = useState('');
  const [modules, setModules] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [loadingModules, setLoadingModules] = useState(false);
  
  // Address selection from module scan
  const [selectedModule, setSelectedModule] = useState('');
  const [moduleAddresses, setModuleAddresses] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [loadingAddresses, setLoadingAddresses] = useState(false);
  
  // History states
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<{
    address: string;
    name: string;
    timestamp: number;
    oldValue: string;
    newValue: string;
  }[]>([]);
  
  // Load modules
  const loadModules = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingModules(true);
    try {
      const result = await util.getModuleList();
      if (result.success && result.modules) {
        setModules(result.modules.map(m => m.name));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load modules:', err);
      setError('Failed to load modules');
    } finally {
      setLoadingModules(false);
    }
  }, []);
  
  // Load addresses from module
  const loadModuleAddresses = useCallback(async (moduleName: string) => {
    if (!moduleName) {
      setModuleAddresses([]);
      return;
    }
    
    setLoadingAddresses(true);
    setError(null);
    
    try {
      // In a real implementation, we would scan the module for readable addresses
      // For now, we'll just show some placeholder addresses
      setModuleAddresses([
        `0x${(Math.random() * 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF).toString(16).padStart(12, '0')}`,
        `0x${(Math.random() * 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF).toString(16).padStart(12, '0')}`,
        `0x${(Math.random() * 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF).toString(16).padStart(12, '0')}`,
      ]);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(`Failed to load addresses: ${err}`);
    } finally {
      setLoadingAddresses(false);
    }
  }, []);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    loadModules();
  }, [loadModules]);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedModule) {
      loadModuleAddresses(selectedModule);
    } else {
      setModuleAddresses([]);
    }
  }, [selectedModule, loadModuleAddresses]);
  
  // Load tracked values
  const loadTrackedValues = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const result = await valueTracking.getAllValues();
      if (result.success && result.values) {
        setTrackedValues(result.values);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load tracked values:', err);
    }
  }, []);
  
  // Load changed values
  const loadChangedValues = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const result = await valueTracking.getChangedValues();
      if (result.success && result.values) {
        setChangedValues(result.values);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load changed values:', err);
    }
  }, []);
  
  // Update tracked values
  const updateValues = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await valueTracking.updateValues();
      await loadTrackedValues();
      await loadChangedValues();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to update values:', err);
    }
  }, [loadTrackedValues, loadChangedValues]);
  
  // Auto-refresh
  useEffect(() => {
    let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
    
    if (autoRefresh && isTracking) {
      timer = setInterval(updateValues, refreshInterval);
    }
    
    return () => {
      if (timer) {
        clearInterval(timer);
      }
    };
  }, [autoRefresh, isTracking, refreshInterval, updateValues]);
  
  // Load initial data
  useEffect(() => {
    loadTrackedValues();
    loadChangedValues();
    
    return () => {
      // Clean up on unmount
      valueTracking.clearValues().catch(console.error);
    };
  }, [loadTrackedValues, loadChangedValues]);
  
  // Add value to track
  const handleAddValue = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!addressInput) {
      setError('Please enter an address');
      return;
    }
    
    setError(null);
    
    try {
      // Parse the address
      let address: number | string = addressInput;
      
      // If it's a hex string, parse it
      if (typeof address === 'string' && address.startsWith('0x')) {
        address = parseAddress(address);
      }
      
      const result = await valueTracking.addValue(address, nameInput || `Value_${Date.now()}`);
      if (result.success) {
        setAddressInput('');
        setNameInput('');
        await loadTrackedValues();
        setIsTracking(true);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to add value');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(`Failed to add value: ${err}`);
      console.error('Add value error:', err);
    }
  }, [addressInput, nameInput, loadTrackedValues]);
  
  // Remove tracked value
  const handleRemoveValue = useCallback(async (address: string) => {
    try {
      await valueTracking.removeValue(address);
      await loadTrackedValues();
      await loadChangedValues();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to remove value:', err);
      setError('Failed to remove value');
    }
  }, [loadTrackedValues, loadChangedValues]);
  
  // Clear all tracked values
  const handleClearAll = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await valueTracking.clearValues();
      setTrackedValues([]);
      setChangedValues([]);
      setHistory([]);
      setIsTracking(false);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to clear values:', err);
      setError('Failed to clear values');
    }
  }, []);
  
  // Select address from list
  const handleSelectAddress = useCallback((addr: string) => {
    setAddressInput(addr);
    setModuleAddresses([]);
  }, []);
  
  // Format value for display
  const formatValue = (value: string, type: 'int8' | 'int16' | 'int32' | 'int64' | 'uint8' | 'uint16' | 'uint32' | 'uint64' | 'float' | 'double' | 'string' | 'pointer' = 'int32') => {
    // Try to parse the value based on type
    try {
      const num = parseFloat(value);
      if (!isNaN(num)) {
        switch (type) {
          case 'float':
          case 'double':
            return num.toFixed(4);
          case 'int8':
          case 'uint8':
          case 'int16':
          case 'uint16':
          case 'int32':
          case 'uint32':
            return Math.round(num).toString();
          case 'int64':
          case 'uint64':
            return BigInt(num).toString();
          case 'pointer':
            return `0x${BigInt(num).toString(16).padStart(12, '0')}`;
          default:
            return value;
        }
      }
      return value;
    } catch {
      return value;
    }
  };
  
  // Track value change in history
  const handleTrackChange = useCallback((value: TrackedValueData) => {
    if (value.changed) {
      setHistory(prev => [
        ...prev,
        {
          address: value.address,
          name: value.name,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          oldValue: value.previousValue,
          newValue: value.currentValue
        }
      ].slice(-100)); // Keep only last 100 history entries
    }
  }, []);
  
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-[#1a1a2e] text-white p-4 overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4 border-b border-gray-700 pb-2">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">Value Tracker</h2>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              id="autoRefresh"
              checked={autoRefresh}
              onChange={(e) => setAutoRefresh(e.target.checked)}
              className="rounded"
            />
            <label htmlFor="autoRefresh">Auto-refresh</label>
            <select
              value={refreshInterval}
              onChange={(e) => setRefreshInterval(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="bg-gray-700 text-white px-2 py-1 rounded text-sm"
              disabled={!autoRefresh}
            >
              <option value={100}>100ms</option>
              <option value={500}>500ms</option>
              <option value={1000}>1s</option>
              <option value={2000}>2s</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={updateValues}
            className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-700 rounded text-sm hover:bg-gray-600 transition-colors"
            disabled={!isTracking}
          >
            Update
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={handleClearAll}
            className="px-3 py-1 bg-red-600 rounded text-sm hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors"
          >
            Clear All
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Error display */}
      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 bg-red-900/50 border border-red-700 rounded text-red-300 text-sm">
          {error}
          <button
            onClick={() => setError(null)}
            className="ml-4 text-red-300 hover:text-red-200"
          >
            Dismiss
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      
      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex border-b border-gray-700 mb-4">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('tracker')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm ${activeTab === 'tracker' ? 'bg-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
        >
          Tracker
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('history')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm ${activeTab === 'history' ? 'bg-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
        >
          History ({history.length})
        </button>
      </div>
      
      {/* Tracker Tab */}
      {activeTab === 'tracker' && (
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
          {/* Add Value Form */}
          <div className="mb-4 p-4 bg-gray-800 rounded">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Address *</label>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={addressInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setAddressInput(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="0x7FF... or module+offset"
                    className="flex-1 p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"
                  />
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setAddressInput(`0x${(Math.random() * 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF).toString(16).padStart(12, '0')}`)}
                    className="px-3 py-2 bg-gray-600 rounded hover:bg-gray-500 transition-colors text-xs"
                  >
                    Random
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Name (optional)</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={nameInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setNameInput(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Health, Ammo, etc."
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Module address selection */}
            <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Select from Module</label>
                <select
                  value={selectedModule}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedModule(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"
                  disabled={loadingModules}
                >
                  <option value="">Select a module...</option>
                  {modules.map((mod) => (
                    <option key={mod} value={mod}>{mod}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm text-gray-400 mb-1">Module Addresses</label>
                <select
                  value=""
                  onChange={(e) => handleSelectAddress(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2 bg-gray-700 border border-gray-600 rounded text-white"
                  disabled={loadingAddresses || moduleAddresses.length === 0}
                >
                  <option value="">Select an address...</option>
                  {moduleAddresses.map((addr) => (
                    <option key={addr} value={addr}>{addr}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <button
              onClick={handleAddValue}
              disabled={!addressInput}
              className="mt-4 px-6 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-600 disabled:cursor-not-allowed rounded transition-colors"
            >
              Add Value
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {/* Tracked Values */}
          <div className="flex-1 flex gap-4 overflow-hidden">
            {/* All Tracked Values */}
            <div className="flex-1 bg-gray-800 rounded overflow-hidden">
              <div className="p-2 bg-gray-700 border-b border-gray-600">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Tracked Values ({trackedValues.length})</h3>
              </div>
              <div className="overflow-auto h-[calc(100%-40px)]">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead className="bg-gray-700 sticky top-0">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Name</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Address</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Current</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Previous</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-center">Changed</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-2 text-center w-16">Actions</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {trackedValues.length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={6} className="px-4 py-4 text-center text-gray-500">
                          No values being tracked. Add one above.
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      trackedValues.map((value) => (
                        <tr
                          key={value.address}
                          className={`border-t border-gray-700 ${value.changed ? 'bg-yellow-900/20' : ''}`}
                          onClick={() => handleTrackChange(value)}
                        >
                          <td className="px-4 py-2">{value.name}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono">{value.address}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-2">{formatValue(value.currentValue)}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-2">{formatValue(value.previousValue)}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-2 text-center">
                            {value.changed ? (
                              <span className="text-green-400">Yes</span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-gray-500">No</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-2 text-center">
                            <button
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                handleRemoveValue(value.address);
                              }}
                              className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 text-xs"
                            >
                              Remove
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Changed Values */}
            <div className="w-80 bg-gray-800 rounded overflow-hidden">
              <div className="p-2 bg-gray-700 border-b border-gray-600 flex justify-between items-center">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Changed Values ({changedValues.length})</h3>
                <button
                  onClick={loadChangedValues}
                  className="px-2 py-1 bg-gray-600 rounded text-xs hover:bg-gray-500 transition-colors"
                >
                  Refresh
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="overflow-auto h-[calc(100%-40px)]">
                {changedValues.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="p-4 text-center text-gray-500 text-sm">
                    No changes detected
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <table className="w-full text-sm">
                    <thead className="bg-gray-700 sticky top-0">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="px-3 py-1 text-left">Name</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-1 text-left">From</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-1 text-left">To</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {changedValues.map((value) => (
                        <tr key={value.address} className="border-t border-gray-700">
                          <td className="px-3 py-1">{value.name}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-1">{formatValue(value.previousValue)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-1 text-green-400">{formatValue(value.currentValue)}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      
      {/* History Tab */}
      {activeTab === 'history' && (
        <div className="flex-1 bg-gray-800 rounded p-4 overflow-auto">
          <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4">
            <button
              onClick={() => setHistory([])}
              className="px-3 py-1 bg-gray-700 rounded text-sm hover:bg-gray-600 transition-colors"
            >
              Clear History
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {history.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center text-gray-500 py-8">
              No history. Changes will appear here when values are updated.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead className="bg-gray-700 sticky top-0">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Time</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Name</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Address</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Old Value</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">New Value</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left">Delta</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {history.map((entry, index) => {
                  const oldNum = parseFloat(entry.oldValue);
                  const newNum = parseFloat(entry.newValue);
                  const delta = !isNaN(oldNum) && !isNaN(newNum) ? newNum - oldNum : null;
                  
                  return (
                    <tr key={`${entry.address}-${index}`} className="border-t border-gray-700">
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 text-xs">
                        {new Date(entry.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2">{entry.name}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono">{entry.address}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2">{formatValue(entry.oldValue)}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2 text-green-400">{formatValue(entry.newValue)}</td>
                      <td className={`px-4 py-2 ${delta && delta > 0 ? 'text-green-400' : delta && delta < 0 ? 'text-red-400' : ''}`}>
                        {delta !== null ? (delta > 0 ? '+' : '') + delta.toFixed(2) : '-'}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ValueTrackerPanel;
```

`app/src/components/panels/WorkspacePanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/WorkspacePanel.tsx
// The tabbed centre area, shared across PE, Mach-O and live-target views.

import { lazy, Suspense, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { FolderOpen, Plus, X } from "lucide-react";
import DisassemblyView from "@/components/panels/DisassemblyView";
import EmulatorView from "@/components/panels/EmulatorView";
import DotNetView from "@/components/panels/DotNetView";
import MemoryView from "@/components/panels/MemoryView";
import PeView from "@/components/panels/PeView";
import StringsView from "@/components/panels/StringsView";
import { openBinary } from "@/lib/openBinary";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { useDotnet } from "@/store/dotnet";
import { useUi, type TabId } from "@/store/ui";

const AnalysisView = lazy(() => import("@/components/panels/AnalysisView"));

// Which tabs read the static analysis session and which need a live process
// Getting this wrong is what made Memory and Debugger look broken behind a
// "no binary loaded" wall they never needed
const kTabs: readonly { id: TabId; label: string; needs: "image" | "target" }[] = [
  { id: "disassembly", label: "Disassembly", needs: "image" },
  { id: "dotnet", label: ".NET", needs: "image" },
  { id: "strings", label: "Strings", needs: "image" },
  { id: "memory", label: "Memory", needs: "target" },
  { id: "emulator", label: "Emulator", needs: "target" },
  { id: "analysis", label: "Analysis", needs: "image" },
  { id: "pe", label: "PE Browser", needs: "image" },
];

export default function WorkspacePanel() {
  const { tab: active, setTab: setActive } = useUi();
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const hype = useEngine((s) => s.hype);
  const { image, busy, error, refreshLoaded, unload } = useDisasm();
  const dotnetManaged = useDotnet((s) => s.status?.managed ?? false);
  const dotnetRefresh = useDotnet((s) => s.refresh);
  const dotnetReset = useDotnet((s) => s.reset);

  // The session is shared with the ImGui shell and with agents, so the image can
  // change without this window doing anything, re-read when the engine reports
  // analysis movement
  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshLoaded();
  }, [refreshLoaded, hype.has_image, hype.ready]);

  // Probe the managed model once analysis lands: for a .NET image this reveals
  // the tree and turns the ".NET" tab on; for a native image the probe is cheap
  // (status only) and the tab stays hidden. Runs here, not in DotNetView, so the
  // tree + expansion state survive tab switches (the view remounts on switch).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (image.ready && hype.ready) void dotnetRefresh();
    else if (!image.ready) dotnetReset();
  }, [image.ready, image.name, hype.ready, dotnetRefresh, dotnetReset]);

  // The ".NET" tab only exists for managed images; if it vanishes while active,
  // fall back to Disassembly rather than showing a blank pane.
  const tabs = useMemo(
    () => kTabs.filter((t) => t.id !== "dotnet" || dotnetManaged),
    [dotnetManaged],
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tabs.some((t) => t.id === active)) setActive("disassembly");
  }, [tabs, active]);

  const body = () => {
    const tab = tabs.find((t) => t.id === active);

    if (tab?.needs === "target" && !target.attached) {
      return (
        <div className="empty">
          <div className="empty-title">No target attached.</div>
          <div className="empty-hint">
            Attach to a process from the Targets panel to use {tab.label}.
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (tab?.needs === "image") {
      if (busy && !image.ready) {
        return (
          <div className="empty">
            <div className="empty-title">Loading…</div>
          </div>
        );
      }
      if (!image.ready) {
        return (
          <div className="empty">
            <div className="empty-title">No binary loaded.</div>
            <div className="empty-hint">
              {target.attached
                ? "Open a file, or dump a module from the attached target."
                : "Open a binary, or attach to a process."}
            </div>
            <button className="row-action" onClick={() => void openBinary()}>
              <FolderOpen size={12} style={{ marginRight: 6, verticalAlign: -2 }} />
              Open binary…
            </button>
            {error !== null && (
              <div className="empty-hint" style={{ color: "var(--danger)" }}>
                {error}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      }
    }

    switch (active) {
      case "disassembly":
        return <DisassemblyView />;
      case "dotnet":
        return <DotNetView />;
      case "strings":
        return <StringsView />;
      case "pe":
        return <PeView />;
      case "memory":
        return <MemoryView />;
      case "emulator":
        return <EmulatorView />;
      case "analysis":
        return <Suspense fallback={<div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>Loading analysis…</div>}><AnalysisView /></Suspense>;
    }
  };

  const warning = image.warning || (image.encrypted === true
    ? "Encrypted image: on-disk code is protected; disassembly may be invalid."
    : undefined);

  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <div className="tabs">
        {tabs.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t.id}
            className="tab"
            data-active={active === t.id}
            onClick={() => setActive(t.id)}
          >
            {t.id === "pe" && image.format === "macho" ? "Mach-O Browser" : t.label}
          </button>
        ))}
        <button className="tab" data-tip="Add view">
          <Plus size={13} />
        </button>
        <div className="spacer" />
        {image.ready && (
          <span
            className="faint"
            style={{ alignSelf: "center", fontSize: "var(--type-small)", marginRight: 8 }}
          >
            {image.name}
            {image.format !== undefined ? ` · ${image.format === "macho" ? "Mach-O" : "PE"}` : ""}
            {image.arch !== undefined ? ` · ${image.arch}` : ""}
            {hype.running ? ` · analyzing ${Math.round(hype.progress * 100)}%` : ""}
          </span>
        )}
        <button
          className="icon-button"
          style={{ alignSelf: "center", marginRight: 6 }}
          data-tip={image.ready ? "Close binary" : "Open binary…"}
          onClick={() => void (image.ready ? unload() : openBinary())}
        >
          {image.ready ? <X size={14} /> : <FolderOpen size={14} />}
        </button>
      </div>
      {image.ready && warning !== undefined && (
        <div
          className="empty-hint"
          role="alert"
          style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm) var(--pad-md)", color: "var(--warning)" }}
        >
          {warning}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="panel-body" style={{ overflow: "hidden" }}>
        {/* Keyed on the active tab so the enter animation replays on every
            switch rather than only on first mount. */}
        <div className="view-swap" key={active}>
          {body()}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
// TypeScript interfaces for panel components

export interface PanelProps {
```

`app/src/hooks/useOverlay.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/hooks/useOverlay.ts
// Hook for managing overlay rendering with Echo Backend

import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useUi } from "@/store/ui";
import { useSettings } from "@/store/echoExtensions";
import * as echoExt from "@/lib/echo-extensions";

// ============================================================================
// TYPES
// ============================================================================

interface Entity {
  address: number | string;
  name: string;
  position: echoExt.Vec3;
  health: number;
  maxHealth: number;
  team: number;
  dormant: boolean;
  visible: boolean;
  bonePositions?: echoExt.Vec3[];
}

interface OverlaySettings {
  showBox: boolean;
  showHealth: boolean;
  showName: boolean;
  showBones: boolean;
  showLines: boolean;
  boxColor: string;
  teamColor: string;
  enemyColor: string;
  lineColor: string;
  boxStyle: "normal" | "outlined" | "filled" | "filled_outlined" | "cornered" | "cornered_filled";
  lineThickness: number;
  healthBarWidth: number;
  healthBarHeight: number;
  nameFontSize: number;
  maxEntities: number;
  showDistance: boolean;
  maxDistance: number;
  showFPS: boolean;
  fpsPosition: "top_left" | "top_right" | "bottom_left" | "bottom_right";
}

interface OverlayState {
  entities: Entity[];
  localPlayer: Entity | null;
  viewport: echoExt.ViewportSize | null;
  fps: number;
  isActive: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

// ============================================================================
// DEFAULT VALUES
// ============================================================================

const defaultOverlaySettings: OverlaySettings = {
  showBox: true,
  showHealth: true,
  showName: true,
  showBones: false,
  showLines: false,
  boxColor: "#00FF00",
  teamColor: "#0000FF",
  enemyColor: "#FF0000",
  lineColor: "#FFFF00",
  boxStyle: "cornered",
  lineThickness: 1.0,
  healthBarWidth: 3,
  healthBarHeight: 50,
  nameFontSize: 12,
  maxEntities: 64,
  showDistance: true,
  maxDistance: 200,
  showFPS: true,
  fpsPosition: "top_right",
};

// ============================================================================
// HOOK
// ============================================================================

export const useOverlay = (initialSettings?: Partial<OverlaySettings>) => {
  const engine = useEngine();
  const [state, setState] = useState<OverlayState>({
    entities: [],
    localPlayer: null,
    viewport: null,
    fps: 0,
    isActive: false,
    error: null,
  });
  
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<OverlaySettings>({
    ...defaultOverlaySettings,
    ...initialSettings,
  });
  
  const overlayRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const animationFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const entityCacheRef = useRef<Map<number, Entity>>(new Map());
  
  // ========================================================================
  // ENTITY MANAGEMENT
  // ========================================================================
  
  const addEntity = useCallback((entity: Entity) => {
    setState((prev) => {
      const existingIndex = prev.entities.findIndex(
        (e) => e.address === entity.address
      );
      
      let newEntities;
      if (existingIndex >= 0) {
        newEntities = [...prev.entities];
        newEntities[existingIndex] = entity;
      } else {
        newEntities = [...prev.entities, entity];
      }
      
      return {
        ...prev,
        entities: newEntities.slice(0, settings.maxEntities),
      };
    });
    
    entityCacheRef.current.set(
      typeof entity.address === "number" ? entity.address : echoExt.parseAddress(entity.address),
      entity
    );
  }, [settings.maxEntities]);
  
  const removeEntity = useCallback((address: number | string) => {
    const addr = typeof address === "number" ? address : echoExt.parseAddress(address);
    entityCacheRef.current.delete(addr);
    
    setState((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      entities: prev.entities.filter(
        (e) => e.address !== address
      ),
    }));
  }, []);
  
  const clearEntities = useCallback(() => {
    entityCacheRef.current.clear();
    setState((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      entities: [],
    }));
  }, []);
  
  const setLocalPlayer = useCallback((player: Entity | null) => {
    setState((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      localPlayer: player,
    }));
  }, []);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // W2S CONVERSION
  // ========================================================================
  
  const worldToScreen = useCallback(async (
    worldPos: echoExt.Vec3,
    engineType: echoExt.GameEngine = "unknown"
  ): Promise<echoExt.W2SResult> => {
    if (!engine.connected) {
      return { success: false };
    }
    
    try {
      switch (engineType) {
        case "unreal":
          return await echoExt.unreal.w2s(worldPos);
        case "unity":
          return await echoExt.unity.w2s(worldPos);
        case "source":
          return await echoExt.source.w2s(worldPos);
        case "source2":
          return await echoExt.source2.w2s(worldPos);
        default:
          // Try to auto-detect
          const detectedEngine = await echoExt.detectGameEngine();
          if (detectedEngine === "unreal") return await echoExt.unreal.w2s(worldPos);
          if (detectedEngine === "unity") return await echoExt.unity.w2s(worldPos);
          if (detectedEngine === "source") return await echoExt.source.w2s(worldPos);
          if (detectedEngine === "source2") return await echoExt.source2.w2s(worldPos);
          return { success: false };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("W2S conversion failed:", error);
      return { success: false };
    }
  }, [engine.connected]);
  
  const worldToScreenBatch = useCallback(async (
    positions: echoExt.Vec3[],
    engineType: echoExt.GameEngine = "unknown"
  ): Promise<echoExt.W2SResult[]> => {
    const results: echoExt.W2SResult[] = [];
    for (const pos of positions) {
      results.push(await worldToScreen(pos, engineType));
    }
    return results;
  }, [worldToScreen]);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // BONE ESP
  // ========================================================================
  
  const readBones = useCallback(async (
    skeletalMesh: number | string,
    boneArrayOffset: number | string,
    boneArrayCachedOffset: number | string,
    componentOffset: number | string,
    maxBones: number = settings.maxEntities
  ): Promise<echoExt.BoneInfo[] | null> => {
    try {
      const result = await echoExt.unreal.readBones({
        skeletalMesh,
        boneArrayOffset,
        boneArrayCachedOffset,
        componentOffset,
        maxBones,
      });
      
      if (result.success) {
        return result.bones;
      }
      return null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to read bones:", error);
      return null;
    }
  }, [settings.maxEntities]);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // RENDERING
  // ========================================================================
  
  const renderEntity = useCallback<(
    ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
    entity: Entity,
    screenPos: { x: number; y: number } | null,
    viewport: echoExt.ViewportSize
  ) => void>((ctx, entity, screenPos, viewport) => {
    if (!screenPos || !settings.showBox) return;
    
    const { x: sx, y: sy } = screenPos;
    const { boxColor, teamColor, enemyColor, boxStyle } = settings;
    const isLocal = entity.address === state.localPlayer?.address;
    const entityColor = isLocal ? "#FFFFFF" : entity.team === 0 ? enemyColor : teamColor;
    
    // Draw box
    const boxWidth = 30;
    const boxHeight = 60;
    const halfWidth = boxWidth / 2;
    const halfHeight = boxHeight / 2;
    
    ctx.strokeStyle = entityColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    
    switch (boxStyle) {
      case "normal":
        ctx.strokeRect(sx - halfWidth, sy - halfHeight, boxWidth, boxHeight);
        break;
      case "filled":
        ctx.fillStyle = entityColor + "33";
        ctx.fillRect(sx - halfWidth, sy - halfHeight, boxWidth, boxHeight);
        ctx.strokeRect(sx - halfWidth, sy - halfHeight, boxWidth, boxHeight);
        break;
      case "cornered":
        // Draw corner lines
        const cornerSize = 10;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(sx - halfWidth, sy - halfHeight);
        ctx.lineTo(sx - halfWidth + cornerSize, sy - halfHeight);
        ctx.moveTo(sx + halfWidth, sy - halfHeight);
        ctx.lineTo(sx + halfWidth - cornerSize, sy - halfHeight);
        ctx.moveTo(sx - halfWidth, sy + halfHeight);
        ctx.lineTo(sx - halfWidth + cornerSize, sy + halfHeight);
        ctx.moveTo(sx + halfWidth, sy + halfHeight);
        ctx.lineTo(sx + halfWidth - cornerSize, sy + halfHeight);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      default:
        ctx.strokeRect(sx - halfWidth, sy - halfHeight, boxWidth, boxHeight);
    }
    
    // Draw health bar
    if (settings.showHealth && entity.maxHealth > 0) {
      const healthPercent = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, entity.health / entity.maxHealth));
      const barHeight = 5;
      const barWidth = boxWidth;
      const barY = sy - halfHeight - barHeight - 2;
      
      // Background
      ctx.fillStyle = "#00000080";
      ctx.fillRect(sx - halfWidth, barY, barWidth, barHeight);
      
      // Health
      const healthColor = healthPercent > 0.5 ? "#00FF00" : healthPercent > 0.25 ? "#FFFF00" : "#FF0000";
      ctx.fillStyle = healthColor;
      ctx.fillRect(sx - halfWidth, barY, barWidth * healthPercent, barHeight);
    }
    
    // Draw name
    if (settings.showName && entity.name) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF";
      ctx.font = `${settings.nameFontSize}px sans-serif`;
      const textWidth = ctx.measureText(entity.name).width;
      ctx.fillText(entity.name, sx - textWidth / 2, sy - halfHeight - (settings.showHealth ? 10 : 0));
    }
  }, [settings, state.localPlayer?.address]);
  
  const renderBone = useCallback<(
    ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
    bonePos: echoExt.Vec3,
    screenPos: { x: number; y: number } | null,
    parentScreenPos: { x: number; y: number } | null,
    color: string
  ) => void>((ctx, bonePos, screenPos, parentScreenPos, color) => {
    if (!screenPos || !settings.showBones) return;
    
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = settings.lineThickness;
    
    if (parentScreenPos) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(parentScreenPos.x, parentScreenPos.y);
      ctx.lineTo(screenPos.x, screenPos.y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    
    // Draw bone point
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(screenPos.x, screenPos.y, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fill();
  }, [settings]);
  
  const renderLine = useCallback<(
    ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
    from: { x: number; y: number },
    to: { x: number; y: number }
  ) => void>((ctx, from, to) => {
    if (!settings.showLines) return;
    
    ctx.strokeStyle = settings.lineColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = settings.lineThickness;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(from.x, from.y);
    ctx.lineTo(to.x, to.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }, [settings]);
  
  const renderFPS = useCallback<(
    ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
    viewport: echoExt.ViewportSize
  ) => void>((ctx, viewport) => {
    if (!settings.showFPS || !state.fps) return;
    
    const padding = 10;
    let x: number, y: number;
    
    switch (settings.fpsPosition) {
      case "top_left":
        x = padding;
        y = padding + 20;
        break;
      case "top_right":
        x = viewport.width - padding - 100;
        y = padding + 20;
        break;
      case "bottom_left":
        x = padding;
        y = viewport.height - padding - 5;
        break;
      case "bottom_right":
      default:
        x = viewport.width - padding - 100;
        y = viewport.height - padding - 5;
        break;
    }
    
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF";
    ctx.font = "12px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`FPS: ${Math.round(state.fps)}`, x, y);
  }, [settings, state.fps]);
  
  const renderOverlay = useCallback(() => {
    if (!overlayRef.current || !state.isActive || !state.viewport) return;
    
    const canvas = overlayRef.current;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    
    // Clear canvas
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    
    // Render entities
    for (const entity of state.entities) {
      if (entity.dormant && !settings.showDormant) continue;
      
      // Convert world position to screen
      worldToScreen(entity.position, "unreal").then((screenPos) => {
        if (screenPos.success) {
          renderEntity(ctx, entity, screenPos, state.viewport!);
          
          // Render bones if available
          if (entity.bonePositions && settings.showBones) {
            let parentScreenPos: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;
            for (const bonePos of entity.bonePositions) {
              worldToScreen(bonePos, "unreal").then((boneScreenPos) => {
                if (boneScreenPos.success) {
                  renderBone(ctx, bonePos, boneScreenPos, parentScreenPos, "#FFFF00");
                  parentScreenPos = boneScreenPos;
                }
              });
            }
          }
          
          // Render line to local player
          if (settings.showLines && state.localPlayer) {
            worldToScreen(state.localPlayer.position, "unreal").then((localScreenPos) => {
              if (localScreenPos.success) {
                renderLine(ctx, screenPos, localScreenPos);
              }
            });
          }
        }
      });
    }
    
    // Render FPS
    renderFPS(ctx, state.viewport);
  }, [state, settings, worldToScreen, renderEntity, renderBone, renderLine, renderFPS]);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // CANVAS MANAGEMENT
  // ========================================================================
  
  const initCanvas = useCallback((canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | null) => {
    if (canvas) {
      overlayRef.current = canvas;
      resizeCanvas();
    }
  }, []);
  
  const resizeCanvas = useCallback(() => {
    if (!overlayRef.current) return;
    
    const canvas = overlayRef.current;
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }, []);
  
  const startRendering = useCallback(() => {
    if (animationFrameRef.current !== null) return;
    
    const renderLoop = () => {
      renderOverlay();
      animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);
    };
    
    animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);
    setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, isActive: true }));
  }, [renderOverlay]);
  
  const stopRendering = useCallback(() => {
    if (animationFrameRef.current !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameRef.current);
      animationFrameRef.current = null;
    }
    setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, isActive: false }));
  }, []);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // PERFORMANCE MONITORING
  // ========================================================================
  
  const startPerformanceMonitor = useCallback(() => {
    const monitor = async () => {
      try {
        const fpsInfo = await echoExt.rendering.getFPS();
        setState((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          fps: fpsInfo.fps,
        }));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Failed to get FPS:", error);
      }
    };
    
    // Update every second
    const intervalId = setInterval(monitor, 1000);
    
    // Initial fetch
    monitor();
    
    return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
  }, []);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // ENGINE DETECTION
  // ========================================================================
  
  const detectEngine = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const engineType = await echoExt.detectGameEngine();
      console.log("Detected engine:", engineType);
      return engineType;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to detect engine:", error);
      return "unknown";
    }
  }, []);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // EFFECTS
  // ========================================================================
  
  // Handle window resize
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      resizeCanvas();
    };
    
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
  }, [resizeCanvas]);
  
  // Auto-start performance monitoring
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!engine.connected) return;
    
    const stopMonitor = startPerformanceMonitor();
    return () => stopMonitor();
  }, [engine.connected, startPerformanceMonitor]);
  
  // ========================================================================
  // PUBLIC API
  // ========================================================================
  
  return {
    // State
    ...state,
    settings,
    overlayRef,
    
    // Actions
    setSettings,
    startRendering,
    stopRendering,
    addEntity,
    removeEntity,
    clearEntities,
    setLocalPlayer,
    initCanvas,
    
    // Utilities
    worldToScreen,
    worldToScreenBatch,
    readBones,
    detectEngine,
    
    // Cleanup
    cleanup: () => {
      stopRendering();
      clearEntities();
    },
  };
};

// ============================================================================
// EXPORTS
// ============================================================================

export type { Entity, OverlaySettings, OverlayState };
export { defaultOverlaySettings };
```

`app/src/lib/angelscript/analyzer/analyzer.ts`:

```ts
import {
  ClassDecl,
  Declaration,
  EnumDecl,
  Expression,
  FuncDefDecl,
  FunctionDecl,
  InterfaceDecl,
  Module,
  NamespaceDecl,
  Parameter,
  Position,
  Statement,
  TypeDefDecl,
  TypeRef,
  VariableDecl,
} from '../parser';
import { Scope } from './scope';
import { Reference, Sym, SymDecl, SymKind } from './symbol';

/**
 * Symbol kinds that participate as qualifiers in `Foo::bar` (i.e. have an
 * inner scope worth descending into). Used to disambiguate against
 * same-named user functions / variables when looking up a qualifier.
 */
const TYPE_LIKE_KINDS: ReadonlySet<SymKind> = new Set<SymKind>([
  'class', 'interface', 'enum', 'namespace', 'funcdef', 'typedef',
]);

function hasInnerScopeOrTypeLike(sym: Sym): boolean {
  return !!sym.innerScope || TYPE_LIKE_KINDS.has(sym.kind);
}

const PRIMITIVE_TYPES = new Set([
  'void', 'bool', 'auto',
  'int', 'int8', 'int16', 'int32', 'int64',
  'uint', 'uint8', 'uint16', 'uint32', 'uint64',
  'float', 'double',
  // AS variant type -- not really a primitive, but treated as one for
  // reference-emission purposes (don't try to resolve `?` as a symbol).
  '?',
]);

export interface AnalyzerResult {
  global: Scope;
  references: Reference[];
}

/**
 * Two-pass static analyzer.
 *
 * Pass 1 (declare) walks the AST and registers every type-like and
 * module-level / class-member / enum-member symbol into scopes. Forward
 * references between top-level decls work because the entire pass completes
 * before resolution begins.
 *
 * Pass 2 (resolve) walks bodies, declaring locals/parameters as it goes,
 * and records every identifier reference together with the symbol it
 * resolves to (or null if unresolved).
 */
/**
 * Callback the analyzer uses when local scope lookup fails. Returns a
 * symbol from another file (workspace-wide), or null if nothing matches.
 * Used to make qualified names like `relay::on_load` from main.as resolve
 * to declarations in relay.as.
 */
export type ExternalLookup = (name: string) => Sym | null;

export class Analyzer {
  private global!: Scope;
  private readonly references: Reference[] = [];
  /**
   * Optional source-file URI stamped onto every symbol this analyzer
   * creates. Used by the API loader (and the workspace layer) so goto-def
   * can jump to the on-disk copy of a bundled declaration file or to a
   * sibling user file.
   */
  private sourceUri?: string;
  /** Cross-file lookup fallback -- see ExternalLookup. */
  private externalLookup?: ExternalLookup;

  constructor(sourceUri?: string, externalLookup?: ExternalLookup) {
    this.sourceUri = sourceUri;
    this.externalLookup = externalLookup;
  }

  /** scope.lookup with a workspace-wide fallback for the first lookup. */
  private lookupWithFallback(name: string, scope: Scope): Sym[] | null {
    const local = scope.lookup(name);
    if (local && local.length > 0) return local;
    if (this.externalLookup) {
      const external = this.externalLookup(name);
      if (external) return [external];
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Like {@link lookupWithFallback}, but for the qualifier position of
   * `Foo::bar`: prefers a symbol that has an inner scope (namespace,
   * class, interface, enum, funcdef, typedef). Fixes the case where a
   * user function called `render` shadows the API's `render` namespace.
   */
  private lookupQualifierWithFallback(name: string, scope: Scope): Sym[] | null {
    const local = scope.lookupPreferring(name, hasInnerScopeOrTypeLike);
    if (local && local.length > 0 && hasInnerScopeOrTypeLike(local[0])) return local;
    if (this.externalLookup) {
      const external = this.externalLookup(name);
      if (external && hasInnerScopeOrTypeLike(external)) return [external];
    }
    return local && local.length > 0 ? local : null;
  }

  analyze(module: Module, parent: Scope | null = null): AnalyzerResult {
    this.global = new Scope('global', parent, { start: module.start, end: module.end });
    for (const d of module.declarations) this.declareDecl(d, this.global);
    for (const d of module.declarations) this.resolveDecl(d, this.global);
    return { global: this.global, references: this.references };
  }

  /** Analyze a module's declarations directly into an existing scope. */
  analyzeInto(module: Module, scope: Scope): AnalyzerResult {
    this.global = scope;
    for (const d of module.declarations) this.declareDecl(d, scope);
    for (const d of module.declarations) this.resolveDecl(d, scope);
    return { global: scope, references: this.references };
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Pass 1 -- declare
  // =========================================================================

  private declareDecl(decl: Declaration, scope: Scope): void {
    switch (decl.kind) {
      case 'ClassDecl':
      case 'InterfaceDecl':     return this.declareTypeWithMembers(decl, scope);
      case 'EnumDecl':          return this.declareEnum(decl, scope);
      case 'NamespaceDecl':     return this.declareNamespace(decl, scope);
      case 'FunctionDecl':      return this.declareFunction(decl, scope);
      case 'VariableDecl':      return this.declareVariable(decl, scope);
      case 'FuncDefDecl':       return this.declareFuncDef(decl, scope);
      case 'TypeDefDecl':       return this.declareTypeDef(decl, scope);
      case 'ImportDecl':        return this.declareDecl(decl.signature, scope);
    }
  }

  private declareTypeWithMembers(decl: ClassDecl | InterfaceDecl, scope: Scope): void {
    const sym = this.makeSymbol(decl.name, decl.kind === 'ClassDecl' ? 'class' : 'interface', decl, scope);
    scope.declare(sym);
    const inner = scope.pushChild(decl.kind === 'ClassDecl' ? 'class' : 'interface',
      { start: decl.start, end: decl.end }, sym);
    sym.innerScope = inner;
    for (const m of decl.members) this.declareDecl(m, inner);
  }

  private declareEnum(decl: EnumDecl, scope: Scope): void {
    const sym = this.makeSymbol(decl.name, 'enum', decl, scope);
    scope.declare(sym);
    const inner = scope.pushChild('enum', { start: decl.start, end: decl.end }, sym);
    sym.innerScope = inner;
    for (const m of decl.members) {
      inner.declare(this.makeSymbol(m.name, 'enum-member', m, inner));
    }
  }

  private declareNamespace(decl: NamespaceDecl, scope: Scope): void {
    // `namespace A::B { ... }` -- walk parts, reusing existing namespace
    // symbols if they already exist (namespaces can be reopened).
    let cur = scope;
    for (const part of decl.name) {
      const existing = cur.lookupLocal(part);
      let nsSym: Sym;
      if (existing && existing[0].kind === 'namespace' && existing[0].innerScope) {
        nsSym = existing[0];
      } else {
        nsSym = this.makeSymbol(part, 'namespace', decl, cur);
        cur.declare(nsSym);
        const inner = cur.pushChild('namespace', { start: decl.start, end: decl.end }, nsSym);
        nsSym.innerScope = inner;
      }
      cur = nsSym.innerScope!;
    }
    for (const d of decl.declarations) this.declareDecl(d, cur);
  }

  private declareFunction(decl: FunctionDecl, scope: Scope): void {
    let kind: SymKind = 'function';
    if (scope.kind === 'class' || scope.kind === 'interface') {
      if (decl.name.startsWith('~')) kind = 'destructor';
      else if (scope.owner && decl.name === scope.owner.name) kind = 'constructor';
      else kind = 'method';
    }
    scope.declare(this.makeSymbol(decl.name, kind, decl, scope));
  }

  private declareVariable(decl: VariableDecl, scope: Scope): void {
    const kind: SymKind =
      scope.kind === 'class' || scope.kind === 'interface' ? 'field' : 'global-variable';
    scope.declare(this.makeSymbol(decl.name, kind, decl, scope));
  }

  private declareFuncDef(decl: FuncDefDecl, scope: Scope): void {
    scope.declare(this.makeSymbol(decl.name, 'funcdef', decl, scope));
  }

  private declareTypeDef(decl: TypeDefDecl, scope: Scope): void {
    scope.declare(this.makeSymbol(decl.name, 'typedef', decl, scope));
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Pass 2 -- resolve
  // =========================================================================

  private resolveDecl(decl: Declaration, scope: Scope): void {
    switch (decl.kind) {
      case 'ClassDecl':
      case 'InterfaceDecl': {
        const sym = scope.lookupLocal(decl.name)?.[0];
        if (!sym?.innerScope) return;
        for (const m of decl.members) this.resolveDecl(m, sym.innerScope);
        return;
      }
      case 'EnumDecl': {
        const sym = scope.lookupLocal(decl.name)?.[0];
        if (!sym?.innerScope) return;
        for (const m of decl.members) {
          if (m.value) this.resolveExpr(m.value, sym.innerScope);
        }
        return;
      }
      case 'NamespaceDecl': {
        let cur: Scope | undefined = scope;
        for (const part of decl.name) {
          cur = cur?.lookupLocal(part)?.[0]?.innerScope;
          if (!cur) return;
        }
        for (const d of decl.declarations) this.resolveDecl(d, cur);
        return;
      }
      case 'FunctionDecl': return this.resolveFunction(decl, scope);
      case 'VariableDecl': return this.resolveVariableAtDecl(decl, scope);
      case 'FuncDefDecl':  return this.resolveFuncDef(decl, scope);
      case 'TypeDefDecl':  return this.resolveType(decl.aliased, scope);
      case 'ImportDecl':   return this.resolveDecl(decl.signature, scope);
    }
  }

  private resolveFunction(decl: FunctionDecl, scope: Scope): void {
    if (decl.returnType) this.resolveType(decl.returnType, scope);
    const funcScope = scope.pushChild('function', { start: decl.start, end: decl.end });
    for (const p of decl.params) this.resolveParameter(p, scope, funcScope);
    if (decl.body) {
      // The body is a BlockStmt -- but we want params and body-locals in the
      // same scope. Inline the block's statements into funcScope.
      for (const s of decl.body.statements) this.resolveStmt(s, funcScope);
    }
  }

  private resolveParameter(p: Parameter, typeScope: Scope, funcScope: Scope): void {
    this.resolveType(p.type, typeScope);
    if (p.defaultValue) this.resolveExpr(p.defaultValue, funcScope);
    if (p.name) {
      funcScope.declare(this.makeSymbol(p.name, 'parameter', p, funcScope));
    }
  }

  private resolveVariableAtDecl(decl: VariableDecl, scope: Scope): void {
    this.resolveType(decl.type, scope);
    if (decl.initializer) this.resolveExpr(decl.initializer, scope);
  }

  private resolveFuncDef(decl: FuncDefDecl, scope: Scope): void {
    this.resolveType(decl.returnType, scope);
    for (const p of decl.params) this.resolveType(p.type, scope);
  }

  // ----- statements -------------------------------------------------------

  private resolveStmt(stmt: Statement, scope: Scope): void {
    switch (stmt.kind) {
      case 'BlockStmt': {
        const block = scope.pushChild('block', { start: stmt.start, end: stmt.end });
        for (const s of stmt.statements) this.resolveStmt(s, block);
        return;
      }
      case 'IfStmt':
        this.resolveExpr(stmt.condition, scope);
        this.resolveStmt(stmt.then, scope);
        if (stmt.else) this.resolveStmt(stmt.else, scope);
        return;
      case 'WhileStmt':
        this.resolveExpr(stmt.condition, scope);
        this.resolveStmt(stmt.body, scope);
        return;
      case 'DoWhileStmt':
        this.resolveStmt(stmt.body, scope);
        this.resolveExpr(stmt.condition, scope);
        return;
      case 'ForStmt': {
        const forScope = scope.pushChild('block', { start: stmt.start, end: stmt.end });
        if (stmt.init) this.resolveStmt(stmt.init, forScope);
        if (stmt.condition) this.resolveExpr(stmt.condition, forScope);
        for (const u of stmt.update) this.resolveExpr(u, forScope);
        this.resolveStmt(stmt.body, forScope);
        return;
      }
      case 'SwitchStmt':
        this.resolveExpr(stmt.discriminant, scope);
        for (const c of stmt.cases) {
          if (c.match) this.resolveExpr(c.match, scope);
          const caseScope = scope.pushChild('block', { start: c.start, end: c.end });
          for (const s of c.statements) this.resolveStmt(s, caseScope);
        }
        return;
      case 'BreakStmt':
      case 'ContinueStmt':
        return;
      case 'ReturnStmt':
        if (stmt.value) this.resolveExpr(stmt.value, scope);
        return;
      case 'TryStmt':
        this.resolveStmt(stmt.block, scope);
        this.resolveStmt(stmt.catchBlock, scope);
        return;
      case 'ExprStmt':
        this.resolveExpr(stmt.expression, scope);
        return;
      case 'VarDeclStmt':
        for (const d of stmt.declarations) {
          this.resolveType(d.type, scope);
          if (d.initializer) this.resolveExpr(d.initializer, scope);
          scope.declare(this.makeSymbol(d.name, 'local-variable', d, scope));
        }
        return;
    }
  }

  // ----- expressions ------------------------------------------------------

  private resolveExpr(expr: Expression, scope: Scope): void {
    switch (expr.kind) {
      case 'AssignmentExpr':
        this.resolveExpr(expr.target, scope);
        this.resolveExpr(expr.value, scope);
        return;
      case 'TernaryExpr':
        this.resolveExpr(expr.condition, scope);
        this.resolveExpr(expr.whenTrue, scope);
        this.resolveExpr(expr.whenFalse, scope);
        return;
      case 'BinaryExpr':
        this.resolveExpr(expr.left, scope);
        this.resolveExpr(expr.right, scope);
        return;
      case 'UnaryExpr':
      case 'PostfixExpr':
        this.resolveExpr(expr.operand, scope);
        return;
      case 'CallExpr':
        this.resolveExpr(expr.callee, scope);
        for (const a of expr.args) this.resolveExpr(a, scope);
        return;
      case 'MemberExpr':
        return this.resolveMember(expr, scope);
      case 'IndexExpr':
        this.resolveExpr(expr.object, scope);
        this.resolveExpr(expr.index, scope);
        return;
      case 'CastExpr':
        this.resolveType(expr.targetType, scope);
        this.resolveExpr(expr.value, scope);
        return;
      case 'NewExpr':
        this.resolveType(expr.type, scope);
        for (const a of expr.args) this.resolveExpr(a, scope);
        return;
      case 'HandleExpr':
        this.resolveExpr(expr.operand, scope);
        return;
      case 'ParenExpr':
        this.resolveExpr(expr.expression, scope);
        return;
      case 'Identifier': {
        // Skip primitive-type names -- they appear here only as cast-style
        // calls like `int(x)` and aren't symbols.
        if (PRIMITIVE_TYPES.has(expr.name)) return;
        const found = this.lookupWithFallback(expr.name, scope);
        this.references.push({
          range: { start: expr.startPos, end: expr.endPos },
          name: expr.name,
          symbol: found ? found[0] : null,
        });
        return;
      }
      case 'QualifiedName':
        return this.resolveQualifiedPerPart(expr.parts, expr.partRanges, scope);
      case 'LiteralExpr':
      case 'ThisExpr':
        return;

      case 'InitListExpr': {
        for (const el of expr.elements) this.resolveExpr(el, scope);
        return;
      }

      case 'AnonymousFunctionExpr': {
        if (expr.returnType) this.resolveType(expr.returnType, scope);
        const fnScope = scope.pushChild('function', { start: expr.start, end: expr.end });
        for (const p of expr.params) this.resolveParameter(p, scope, fnScope);
        for (const s of expr.body.statements) this.resolveStmt(s, fnScope);
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Resolve a member access. We handle the cases where the receiver carries
   * enough info to do a name lookup without full type inference:
   *   - `this.X`                  -> look up X in enclosing class scope
   *   - `Identifier.X` where the identifier resolves to a class / enum /
   *      namespace / typedef-of-a-type -> look up X in that inner scope
   * Everything else (arbitrary expression .X) is left unresolved for now;
   * the type checker (step 5) will fill that in.
   */
  private resolveMember(expr: { kind: 'MemberExpr'; object: Expression; property: string; propertyStartPos: Position; propertyEndPos: Position }, scope: Scope): void {
    this.resolveExpr(expr.object, scope);

    let sym: Sym | null = null;

    if (expr.object.kind === 'ThisExpr') {
      const found = scope.lookupInEnclosingClass(expr.property);
      sym = found ? found[0] : null;
    } else if (expr.object.kind === 'Identifier') {
      const recv = scope.lookup(expr.object.name);
      if (recv && recv[0].innerScope) {
        const found = recv[0].innerScope.lookupLocal(expr.property);
        sym = found ? found[0] : null;
      }
    } else if (expr.object.kind === 'QualifiedName') {
      const recv = this.lookupQualified(expr.object.parts, scope);
      if (recv && recv.innerScope) {
        const found = recv.innerScope.lookupLocal(expr.property);
        sym = found ? found[0] : null;
      }
    }

    this.references.push({
      range: { start: expr.propertyStartPos, end: expr.propertyEndPos },
      name: expr.property,
      symbol: sym,
    });
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Types
  // =========================================================================

  private resolveType(t: TypeRef, scope: Scope): void {
    // Primitive type -- no symbol to emit.
    if (t.name.length > 0 && !PRIMITIVE_TYPES.has(t.name[0])) {
      this.resolveQualifiedPerPart(t.name, t.nameRanges, scope);
    }
    for (const arg of t.templateArgs) this.resolveType(arg, scope);
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Lookup helpers
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * Emit one reference per part of a qualified name, each resolved against
   * the appropriate scope (first part against the lexical scope, subsequent
   * parts against the previous symbol's inner scope). This lets semantic
   * tokens / goto-def / hover work on the precise part the cursor sits on.
   */
  private resolveQualifiedPerPart(parts: string[], ranges: { startPos: Position; endPos: Position }[], scope: Scope): void {
    if (parts.length === 0) return;

    // First part: scope-chain lookup, with cross-file fallback so qualified
    // names like `relay::on_load` resolve to another file's namespace.
    // For multi-part names, prefer a type-like (namespace/class/enum/etc.)
    // symbol over a plain function/variable that shadows it -- otherwise
    // a user function called `render` would steal the lookup of
    // `render::draw_line`.
    const firstHit = parts.length > 1
      ? this.lookupQualifierWithFallback(parts[0], scope)
      : this.lookupWithFallback(parts[0], scope);
    let sym: Sym | null = firstHit ? firstHit[0] : null;
    this.references.push({
      range: { start: ranges[0].startPos, end: ranges[0].endPos },
      name: parts[0],
      symbol: sym,
    });

    // Subsequent parts: walk the symbol chain via innerScope.
    for (let i = 1; i < parts.length; i++) {
      let nextSym: Sym | null = null;
      if (sym && sym.innerScope) {
        const found = sym.innerScope.lookupLocal(parts[i]);
        if (found && found.length > 0) nextSym = found[0];
      }
      this.references.push({
        range: { start: ranges[i].startPos, end: ranges[i].endPos },
        name: parts[i],
        symbol: nextSym,
      });
      sym = nextSym;
    }
  }

  private lookupQualified(parts: string[], scope: Scope): Sym | null {
    const first = scope.lookup(parts[0]);
    if (!first || first.length === 0) return null;
    let sym: Sym = first[0];
    for (let i = 1; i < parts.length; i++) {
      const inner = sym.innerScope;
      if (!inner) return null;
      const next = inner.lookupLocal(parts[i]);
      if (!next || next.length === 0) return null;
      sym = next[0];
    }
    return sym;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // Symbol construction
  // =========================================================================

  private makeSymbol(name: string, kind: SymKind, decl: SymDecl, scope: Scope): Sym {
    // For most decls the "selection range" is the name token position.
    // We don't have that token range cached on every decl node -- for first
    // cut, use the decl's full range. The outline already shows the same.
    return {
      name,
      kind,
      decl,
      scope,
      range: { start: decl.startPos, end: decl.endPos },
      selectionRange: { start: decl.startPos, end: decl.endPos },
      sourceUri: this.sourceUri,
    };
  }
}
```
