`app/src/lib/deobf.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/deobf.ts
// Obfuscation triage and static-tool handoff, entirely over Echo reads.
//
// This is not a devirtualizer: NoVmp, VTIL, Triton and vmp-lazy-unpack are
// separate engines and stay separate. What echo-reverse can do is the part they
// need from a live process: measure the image, flag the packer/VM signatures,
// dump it with the live base and imports, and emit import scripts and function
// metadata in the shape each tool expects.

import { dumpModuleFile } from "./iat";
import { call, mainModule } from "./rpc";
import { Mem } from "./mem";
import { saveOutput } from "./files";

export type DeobfSection = {
  name: string;
  rva: number;
  vsize: number;
  exec: boolean;
  writable: boolean;
  entropy: number;
  /** bytes actually sampled (sections can be larger than the sample) */
  sampled: number;
};

export type Finding = {
  id: string;
  severity: "high" | "medium" | "low" | "info";
  title: string;
  detail: string;
  address?: number;
};

export type DeobfReport = {
  module: string;
  base: number;
  entry: number;
  imageSize: number;
  pe32plus: boolean;
  imports: number;
  exports: number;
  sections: DeobfSection[];
  findings: Finding[];
  score: number;
  verdict: string;
};

export type FnRow = { va: number; size: number; name?: string };

const kMagic = [0x1d, 0xdd, 0x6c, 0x4f, 0x91, 0xf4, 0x45, 0x25]; // 0x2545F4914F6CDD1D
const kSuspiciousName = /(vmp|themida|winlice|enigma|aspack|mpress|upx|packed|protect|\.tmd|\.boot)/i;
const kSampleChunk = 0x10000;
const kSampleChunks = 3;

type PeInfo = {
  image: string;
  image_base: number;
  entry_rva: number;
  size_of_image: number;
  pe32plus: boolean;
  sections: Array<{ name: string; rva: number; vsize: number; exec: boolean; writable: boolean }>;
  imports: Array<{ dll: string; functions: string[] }>;
  exports: Array<{ name: string; rva: number }>;
};

/** Shannon entropy in bits per byte. */
export function entropy(b: Uint8Array): number {
  if (b.length === 0) return 0;
  const counts = new Uint32Array(256);
  for (const x of b) counts[x]++;
  let h = 0;
  for (const c of counts) {
    if (c === 0) continue;
    const p = c / b.length;
    h -= p * Math.log2(p);
  }
  return h;
}

/** Read up to three 64 KiB windows (start, middle, end) of a section. */
async function sampleSection(mem: Mem, base: number, s: { rva: number; vsize: number }): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
  const size = Math.max(0, s.vsize);
  if (size === 0) return null;
  const windows: Array<{ off: number; len: number }> = [];
  const chunk = Math.min(kSampleChunk, size);
  if (size <= kSampleChunk * kSampleChunks) {
    for (let off = 0; off < size; off += kSampleChunk) windows.push({ off, len: Math.min(kSampleChunk, size - off) });
  } else {
    windows.push({ off: 0, len: chunk });
    windows.push({ off: Math.floor((size - chunk) / 2), len: chunk });
    windows.push({ off: size - chunk, len: chunk });
  }
  const parts: Uint8Array[] = [];
  for (const w of windows) {
    const b = await mem.bytes(base + s.rva + w.off, w.len);
    if (b) parts.push(b);
  }
  if (parts.length === 0) return null;
  const out = new Uint8Array(parts.reduce((n, p) => n + p.length, 0));
  let at = 0;
  for (const p of parts) { out.set(p, at); at += p.length; }
  return out;
}

const adr = (n: number) => `0x${n.toString(16)}`;

/** Triage the attached main module: sections, entropy, packer/VM signatures. */
export async function analyzeDeobf(progress?: (msg: string) => void): Promise<DeobfReport> {
  const m = await mainModule();
  if (!m) throw new Error("Echo is not attached");
  progress?.("reading PE headers…");
  const pe = await call<PeInfo>("disasm", "pe");
  if (pe.image_base !== m.base) throw new Error("PE base and Echo base disagree");
  const mem = new Mem();

  const sections: DeobfSection[] = [];
  const findings: Finding[] = [];
  const samples = new Map<string, Uint8Array>();

  for (const s of pe.sections) {
    progress?.(`sampling ${s.name || "(unnamed)"}…`);
    const b = await sampleSection(mem, m.base, s);
    if (b) samples.set(s.name, b);
    sections.push({
      name: s.name,
      rva: s.rva,
      vsize: s.vsize,
      exec: s.exec,
      writable: s.writable,
      entropy: b ? entropy(b) : 0,
      sampled: b?.length ?? 0,
    });
  }

  // section heuristics
  for (const s of sections) {
    if (kSuspiciousName.test(s.name)) {
      findings.push({
        id: `section:${s.name}`, severity: "high",
        title: `packer section name ${s.name || "(unnamed)"}`,
        detail: `section at ${adr(s.rva)} looks like a packer/VM section (${s.vsize} bytes)`,
        address: m.base + s.rva,
      });
    }
    if (s.exec && s.writable) {
      findings.push({
        id: `wx:${s.name}`, severity: "high",
        title: `writable + executable section ${s.name || "(unnamed)"}`,
        detail: `section at ${adr(s.rva)} is W+X, which is normal only for JITs and unpackers`,
        address: m.base + s.rva,
      });
    }
    if (s.entropy >= 7.2 && s.sampled >= 0x1000) {
      findings.push({
        id: `entropy:${s.name}`, severity: "high",
        title: `high entropy in ${s.name || "(unnamed)"} (${s.entropy.toFixed(2)})`,
        detail: "packed, encrypted or compressed content; compare against the on-disk file",
        address: m.base + s.rva,
      });
    } else if (s.entropy >= 6.8 && s.sampled >= 0x1000 && !s.exec) {
      findings.push({
        id: `entropy-low:${s.name}`, severity: "low",
        title: `elevated entropy in ${s.name || "(unnamed)"} (${s.entropy.toFixed(2)})`,
        detail: "could be compressed data, a large resource, or a packed section",
        address: m.base + s.rva,
      });
    }
  }

  // entry point shape and location
  const entry = m.base + pe.entry_rva;
  const entrySec = sections.find((s) => pe.entry_rva >= s.rva && pe.entry_rva < s.rva + s.vsize);
  if (entrySec && !entrySec.exec) {
    findings.push({
      id: "entry:not-exec", severity: "medium",
      title: "entry point is outside an executable section",
      detail: `RVA ${adr(pe.entry_rva)} falls in ${entrySec.name || "(unnamed)"}, typical of packers`,
      address: entry,
    });
  }
  const eb = await mem.bytes(entry, 32);
  if (eb) {
    if (eb[0] === 0x68 && eb[5] === 0xc3) {
      findings.push({
        id: "entry:vmp-push-ret", severity: "high",
        title: "VMProtect-style entry (push imm32; ret)",
        detail: "the first six bytes match the classic VMProtect VMEnter thunk",
        address: entry,
      });
    }
    if (eb[0] === 0x9c && eb[1] === 0x50 && eb[2] === 0x53) {
      findings.push({
        id: "entry:pushfq", severity: "medium",
        title: "entry starts with pushfq / push rax / push rbx",
        detail: "matches several packers and VM entry stubs; confirm with the section layout",
        address: entry,
      });
    }
  }

  // imports and exports
  const imports = pe.imports.reduce((n, d) => n + d.functions.length, 0);
  if (imports === 0) {
    findings.push({
      id: "imports:none", severity: "high",
      title: "no imports in the import directory",
      detail: "a live dump may have a wiped IAT (the dump below rebuilds it from resolved pointers)",
    });
  } else if (imports < 10 && pe.size_of_image > 0x100000) {
    findings.push({
      id: "imports:few", severity: "medium",
      title: `only ${imports} imports in a ${Math.round(pe.size_of_image / 1024 / 1024)} MiB image`,
      detail: "few imports is common in packed or statically linked images",
    });
  }

  // Valorant / Dumper-7-VGK encrypted globals: the 0x2545F4914F6CDD1D magic
  for (const s of sections) {
    if (!s.exec) continue;
    const b = samples.get(s.name);
    if (!b) continue;
    for (let i = 0; i + kMagic.length <= b.length; i++) {
      if (!kMagic.every((x, j) => b[i + j] === x)) continue;
      findings.push({
        id: "valorant:magic", severity: "info",
        title: "encrypted-globals accessor magic found",
        detail: "0x2545F4914F6CDD1D is the 7-state cipher used by Valorant's GObjects/UEngine accessors (Dumper-7-VGK); the Unreal panel can decrypt GObjects",
        address: m.base + s.rva + i,
      });
      break;
    }
    if (findings.some((f) => f.id === "valorant:magic")) break;
  }

  const weights = { high: 30, medium: 15, low: 5, info: 0 } as const;
  const score = Math.min(100, findings.reduce((n, f) => n + weights[f.severity], 0));
  const verdict = score >= 55 ? "protected / likely virtualized"
    : score >= 25 ? "packed or obfuscated"
    : "no strong packer indicators";

  return {
    module: pe.image,
    base: m.base,
    entry,
    imageSize: pe.size_of_image,
    pe32plus: pe.pe32plus,
    imports,
    exports: pe.exports.length,
    sections,
    findings,
    score,
    verdict,
  };
}

// ── handoff artifacts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Artifact = { name: string; data: string | Uint8Array; tool: string };

const ident = (s: string, fallback: string): string => {
  const out = s.replace(/[^\w]/g, "_").replace(/^(\d)/, "_$1");
  return out !== "" ? out : fallback;
};
const stemOf = (name: string): { stem: string; ext: string } => {
  const i = name.lastIndexOf(".");
  return i > 0 ? { stem: name.slice(0, i), ext: name.slice(i) } : { stem: name, ext: "" };
};

function offsetsHeader(report: DeobfReport, fns: FnRow[], stem: string): string {
  const used = new Set<string>();
  const lines: string[] = [];
  for (const f of fns.slice(0, 50_000)) {
    const base = f.name ? ident(f.name, `sub_${f.va.toString(16)}`) : `sub_${f.va.toString(16)}`;
    let name = base;
    for (let n = 2; used.has(name); n++) name = `${base}_${n}`;
    used.add(name);
    lines.push(`inline constexpr std::uint64_t ${name} = ${adr(f.va)}; // ${adr(f.va - report.base)}`);
  }
  return `// generated by echo-reverse from live memory
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

namespace echo_reverse::${ident(stem, "module")} {

inline constexpr std::uint64_t kImageBase = ${adr(report.base)};
inline constexpr std::uint64_t kEntry = ${adr(report.entry)};
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kImageSize = ${adr(report.imageSize)};

${lines.join("\n")}

} // namespace
`;
}

function idaScript(report: DeobfReport, fns: FnRow[], stem: string): string {
  const rows = fns.slice(0, 50_000).map((f) =>
    `    (${adr(f.va)}, ${Math.max(1, f.size)}, ${JSON.stringify(f.name ?? "")}),`).join("\n");
  return `# generated by echo-reverse: import functions and names into IDA
# Load ${stem}_dump at ${adr(report.base)} first, then run this with File > Script file.
import ida_funcs
import ida_idaapi
import ida_kernwin
import ida_name

FUNCTIONS = [
${rows}
]

def main():
    made = named = 0
    ida_idaapi.require("ida_funcs")
    for ea, size, name in FUNCTIONS:
        if ida_funcs.add_func(ea, ea + size):
            made += 1
        if name:
            ida_name.set_name(ea, name, ida_name.SN_NOWARN | ida_name.SN_FORCE)
            named += 1
    print("echo-reverse: %d functions, %d names" % (made, named))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
`;
}

function ghidraScript(report: DeobfReport, fns: FnRow[], stem: string): string {
  const rows = fns.slice(0, 50_000).map((f) =>
    `    (${adr(f.va)}, ${Math.max(1, f.size)}, ${JSON.stringify(f.name ?? "")}),`).join("\n");
  return `# generated by echo-reverse: import functions and names into Ghidra
#@category echo-reverse
# Load ${stem}_dump at ${adr(report.base)}, then run this script.
from ghidra.program.model.symbol import SourceType

BASE = currentProgram.getImageBase()
FUNCTIONS = [
${rows}
]

made = 0
named = 0
for ea, size, name in FUNCTIONS:
    addr = BASE.add(ea - BASE.getOffset())
    try:
        createFunction(addr, None)
        made += 1
    except:
        pass
    if name:
        try:
            createLabel(addr, name, True)
            named += 1
        except:
            pass
print("echo-reverse: %d functions, %d names" % (made, named))
`;
}

function r2Script(report: DeobfReport, fns: FnRow[], stem: string): string {
  const lines = fns.slice(0, 20_000).map((f) => {
    const name = f.name ? f.name.replace(/[^\w.]/g, "_") : `sub_${f.va.toString(16)}`;
    return `af @ ${adr(f.va)}\nafn ${name} @ ${adr(f.va)}`;
  });
  return `# generated by echo-reverse: open ${stem}_dump with -b ${adr(report.base)}, then run this
e scr.color=0
${lines.join("\n")}
`;
}

function tritonScript(report: DeobfReport, fns: FnRow[], stem: string): string {
  return `#!/usr/bin/env python3
# generated by echo-reverse: lift every recovered function with Triton.
# ${report.module}: ${fns.length} functions, image base 0x${report.base.toString(16)}.
# pip install triton-library; run next to ${stem}_functions.json and the dump.
import json
import pathlib

from triton import ARCH, MODE, Instruction, TritonContext

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
meta = json.loads((HERE / "${stem}_functions.json").read_text())
dump = (HERE / meta["dump"]).read_bytes()

ctx = TritonContext(ARCH.X86_64)
ctx.setMode(MODE.ALIGNED_MEMORY, True)
for s in meta["sections"]:
    lo = s["rva"]
    hi = min(len(dump), lo + s["vsize"])
    if hi > lo:
        ctx.setConcreteMemoryAreaValue(meta["image_base"] + lo, dump[lo:hi])

lifted = {}
for f in meta["functions"][: meta.get("lift_limit", 2000)]:
    pc = f["address"]
    end = pc + max(1, f["size"])
    nodes = []
    for _ in range(512):
        if pc >= end:
            break
        insn = Instruction(pc)
        ctx.processing(insn)
        nodes.append({"address": hex(pc), "asm": insn.getDisassembly()})
        pc = insn.getAddress() + insn.getSize()
    lifted[hex(f["address"])] = nodes

(HERE / "${stem}_triton_lift.json").write_text(json.dumps(lifted, indent=2))
print("echo-reverse: lifted %d functions -> ${stem}_triton_lift.json" % len(lifted))
`;
}

function handoffDoc(report: DeobfReport, fns: FnRow[], stem: string, dumpName: string): string {
  const findings = report.findings.length
    ? report.findings.map((f) => `- **${f.severity}** ${f.title} — ${f.detail}${f.address !== undefined ? ` (${adr(f.address)})` : ""}`).join("\n")
    : "- no strong packer or VMProtect indicators";
  const sections = report.sections.map((s) =>
    `| \`${s.name || "(unnamed)"}\` | ${adr(s.rva)} | ${s.vsize.toString(16)} | ${s.entropy.toFixed(2)} | ${s.exec ? "X" : ""}${s.writable ? "W" : ""} |`).join("\n");
  return `# echo-reverse handoff: ${report.module}

Image base **${adr(report.base)}**, entry **${adr(report.entry)}**, ${(report.imageSize / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MiB, ${report.imports} imports, ${report.exports} exports, ${fns.length} functions.
Triage score **${report.score}/100**: ${report.verdict}.

## Findings

${findings}

## Sections

| name | rva | vsize | entropy | flags |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
${sections}

## Files

- \`${dumpName}\` — the live image, raw layout = virtual layout, ImageBase = ${adr(report.base)}. Imports were rebuilt from resolved IAT pointers where possible.
- \`${stem}_functions.json\` — every function from the exception directory, with RVAs and names.
- \`${stem}_offsets.hpp\` — the same addresses as C++ constants.
- \`${stem}_ida.py\`, \`${stem}_ghidra.py\`, \`${stem}_r2.r2\` — import functions/names after loading the dump.
- \`${stem}_triton.py\` — Triton lifter; writes \`${stem}_triton_lift.json\`.
- \`${stem}_superghidra.txt\` — SuperGhidra commands for RTTI/class recovery.

## Tools

**NoVmp** (VMProtect 3.x devirtualizer, VTIL): NoVmp wants an unpacked image and the original base.
\`\`\`text
NoVmp.exe ${dumpName} -base ${adr(report.base)}
\`\`\`
Add \`-vms <rva> ...\` for specific VMEnter addresses, or \`-sections .vmp0 .vmp1\` when section discovery fails. It writes VTIL that VTIL-Core / VTIL2 can optimize or recompile.

**vmp-lazy-unpack** (VMProtect 3.x static unpacker): use it on the original on-disk binary, not this dump, when the image is still packed.
\`\`\`text
py -m unpack "C:\\path\\to\\original.exe"
\`\`\`

**Triton** (symbolic/lifting):
\`\`\`text
pip install triton-library
python ${stem}_triton.py
\`\`\`

**SuperGhidra** (RTTI / MFC recovery and Ghidra daemon):
\`\`\`text
pip install superghidra
superghidra rtti-recover ${dumpName} -o ${stem}_rtti.json
\`\`\`
Then open the dump in Ghidra/IDA/radare2 and run the matching import script.

**IDA Nexus / ida-mcp / radare2-mcp**: load \`${dumpName}\` at ${adr(report.base)}, run the import script, and point the MCP at the resulting database. \`${stem}_functions.json\` is the tool-neutral source if a script needs regenerating.

## Notes

- The dump keeps the live base. Load it at **${adr(report.base)}**, not at the PE's preferred base.
- Imports may still be resolved pointers if the IAT was wiped; \`${stem}_functions.json\` and the offset header do not depend on the import table.
- A dump of an already-running protected game is usually unpacked in memory; static devirtualization still needs the VM entry points from the original binary.
`;
}

function superghidraDoc(report: DeobfReport, stem: string, dumpName: string): string {
  return `# SuperGhidra handoff: ${report.module}

SuperGhidra (https://github.com/yuatemycat/SuperGhidra) reads a PE directly, so it
does not need Echo. The dump already has the live base and virtual layout.

\`\`\`text
pip install superghidra
superghidra rtti-recover ${dumpName} -o ${stem}_rtti.json
python -m superghidra.formats.serialize_trace ${dumpName} <ClassName>
\`\`\`

For the Ghidra daemon/MCP path, start the daemon on 127.0.0.1:5073 and open the
dump at ${adr(report.base)}. Import \`${stem}_ghidra.py\` first so functions and
names match echo-reverse's listing.
`;
}

/** The tool-neutral metadata every other artifact and MCP client reads. */
export function functionManifest(report: DeobfReport, fns: FnRow[], dumpName: string): string {
  return JSON.stringify({
    generator: "echo-reverse",
    module: report.module,
    image_base: report.base,
    entry: report.entry,
    image_size: report.imageSize,
    dump: dumpName,
    sections: report.sections.map((s) => ({
      name: s.name, rva: s.rva, vsize: s.vsize, exec: s.exec, writable: s.writable, entropy: Number(s.entropy.toFixed(3)),
    })),
    findings: report.findings,
    score: report.score,
    verdict: report.verdict,
    functions: fns.map((f) => ({
      address: f.va, rva: f.va - report.base, size: f.size, name: f.name ?? null,
    })),
  }, null, 2);
}

/** Every file for the external-tool pipeline, including the module dump. */
export async function buildHandoff(
  report: DeobfReport,
  fns: FnRow[],
  progress?: (msg: string) => void,
): Promise<{ artifacts: Artifact[]; dump: Artifact }> {
  progress?.("dumping the module…");
  const m = await mainModule();
  if (!m) throw new Error("Echo is not attached");
  const dump = await dumpModuleFile(m, progress);
  const { stem, ext } = stemOf(report.module);
  const dumpName = `${stem}_dump${ext || ".bin"}`;

  const artifacts: Artifact[] = [
    { name: dumpName, data: dump.bytes, tool: "dump" },
    { name: `${stem}_functions.json`, data: functionManifest(report, fns, dumpName), tool: "metadata" },
    { name: `${stem}_offsets.hpp`, data: offsetsHeader(report, fns, stem), tool: "native" },
    { name: `${stem}_ida.py`, data: idaScript(report, fns, stem), tool: "ida" },
    { name: `${stem}_ghidra.py`, data: ghidraScript(report, fns, stem), tool: "ghidra" },
    { name: `${stem}_r2.r2`, data: r2Script(report, fns, stem), tool: "radare2" },
    { name: `${stem}_triton.py`, data: tritonScript(report, fns, stem), tool: "triton" },
    { name: `${stem}_superghidra.txt`, data: superghidraDoc(report, stem, dumpName), tool: "superghidra" },
    { name: `${stem}_handoff.md`, data: handoffDoc(report, fns, stem, dumpName), tool: "notes" },
  ];
  return { artifacts, dump: artifacts[0] };
}

/** Write artifacts into %APPDATA%\echo-reverse\out; returns their paths. */
export async function saveArtifacts(artifacts: Artifact[], progress?: (msg: string) => void): Promise<string[]> {
  const written: string[] = [];
  for (const a of artifacts) {
    progress?.(`writing ${a.name}…`);
    written.push(await saveOutput(a.name, a.data));
  }
  return written;
}

export type OffsetFormat = "json" | "hpp" | "ida" | "ghidra" | "r2";

/** One offsets file in the requested tool's format. */
export function buildOffsets(report: DeobfReport, fns: FnRow[], format: OffsetFormat): { name: string; data: string } {
  const { stem, ext } = stemOf(report.module);
  switch (format) {
    case "json":
      return { name: `${stem}_offsets.json`, data: functionManifest(report, fns, `${stem}_dump${ext || ".bin"}`) };
    case "hpp":
      return { name: `${stem}_offsets.hpp`, data: offsetsHeader(report, fns, stem) };
    case "ida":
      return { name: `${stem}_ida.py`, data: idaScript(report, fns, stem) };
    case "ghidra":
      return { name: `${stem}_ghidra.py`, data: ghidraScript(report, fns, stem) };
    case "r2":
      return { name: `${stem}_r2.r2`, data: r2Script(report, fns, stem) };
  }
}

/** Parse a "0x..." or decimal string from an agent, returning a number. */
export function parseAddress(v: unknown): number {
  const s = String(v).trim();
  const n = /^0x/i.test(s) ? Number.parseInt(s.slice(2), 16) : Number(s);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) throw new Error(`bad address ${s}`);
  return n;
}

/** Read names from a handoff manifest for the same image, rebasing RVAs. */
export function importFunctionNames(text: string, report: DeobfReport, functions: FnRow[]): Map<number, string> {
  const data: unknown = JSON.parse(text);
  if (!data || typeof data !== "object") throw new Error("invalid function manifest");
  const doc = data as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (typeof doc.module !== "string" || doc.module.toLowerCase() !== report.module.toLowerCase() || doc.image_size !== report.imageSize) {
    throw new Error("manifest module name or image size differs from the attached image");
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(doc.functions) || doc.functions.length > 100_000) throw new Error("invalid function list");
  const available = new Set(functions.map(f => f.va));
  const names = new Map<number, string>();
  for (const value of doc.functions) {
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object") throw new Error("invalid function entry");
    const row = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (row.name === null || row.name === undefined || row.name === "") continue;
    if (typeof row.name !== "string" || row.name.length > 512 || /[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(row.name) || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.rva) || (row.rva as number) < 0 || (row.rva as number) >= report.imageSize) throw new Error("invalid function name or RVA");
    const address = report.base + (row.rva as number);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(address)) throw new Error("function address is outside the supported range");
    if (available.has(address)) names.set(address, row.name);
  }
  return names;
}
```

```ts
export const unreal = {
  /**
   * World to Screen conversion for Unreal Engine
   */
  w2s: async (worldPos: Vec3): Promise<W2SResult> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<W2SResult>({
      type: "unreal_w2s",
      world_x: worldPos.x,
      world_y: worldPos.y,
      world_z: worldPos.z,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Read bones from skeletal mesh
   */
  readBones: async (
    skeletalMesh: number | string,
    boneArrayOffset: number | string,
    boneArrayCachedOffset: number | string,
    componentOffset: number | string,
    maxBones: number = 100
  ): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    count: number;
    bones: BoneInfo[];
  }> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{
      success: boolean;
      count: number;
      bones: Array<{ index: number; address: string }>;
    }>({
      type: "unreal_read_bones",
      skeletal_mesh: typeof skeletalMesh === "number" ? `0x${skeletalMesh.toString(16)}` : skeletalMesh,
      bone_array_offset: typeof boneArrayOffset === "number" ? `0x${boneArrayOffset.toString(16)}` : boneArrayOffset,
      bone_array_cached_offset: typeof boneArrayCachedOffset === "number" ? `0x${boneArrayCachedOffset.toString(16)}` : boneArrayCachedOffset,
      component_offset: typeof componentOffset === "number" ? `0x${componentOffset.toString(16)}` : componentOffset,
      max_bones: maxBones,
    });
    return {
      success: result.success,
      count: result.count,
      bones: result.bones || [],
    };
  },

  /**
   * Entity scan for Unreal Engine
   */
  entityScan: async (
    gobjectsAddress: number | string,
    maxCount: number = 1000
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; entities: EntityInfo[] }> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; entities: EntityInfo[] }>({
      type: "unreal_entity_scan",
      gobjects: typeof gobjectsAddress === "number" ? `0x${gobjectsAddress.toString(16)}` : gobjectsAddress,
      max_count: maxCount,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Get viewport size for Unreal Engine
   */
  viewportSize: async (): Promise<ViewportSize> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<ViewportSize>({
      type: "unreal_viewport_size",
    });
    return result;
  },
};

export const unity = {
  /**
   * World to Screen conversion for Unity (Y-up coordinate system)
   */
  w2s: async (worldPos: Vec3, viewMatrixAddress?: number | string): Promise<W2SResult> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<W2SResult>({
      type: "unity_w2s",
      world_x: worldPos.x,
      world_y: worldPos.y,
      world_z: worldPos.z,
      view_matrix: viewMatrixAddress ? (typeof viewMatrixAddress === "number" ? `0x${viewMatrixAddress.toString(16)}` : viewMatrixAddress) : "0x0",
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Get world position from Unity transform
   */
  transformPosition: async (transformAddress: number | string): Promise<Vec3> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; x: number; y: number; z: number }>({
      type: "unity_transform_position",
      transform_address: typeof transformAddress === "number" ? `0x${transformAddress.toString(16)}` : transformAddress,
    });
    if (!result.success) {
      throw new Error("Failed to read transform position");
    }
    return { x: result.x, y: result.y, z: result.z };
  },

  /**
   * Get prefab ID from name
   */
  prefabId: async (name: string): Promise<number> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; id: number }>({
      type: "unity_prefab_id",
      name: name,
    });
    if (!result.success) {
      throw new Error("Failed to get prefab ID");
    }
    return result.id;
  },

  /**
   * Entity scan for Unity Engine
   */
  entityScan: async (
    gameAssemblyAddress: number | string,
    maxCount: number = 1000
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; entities: EntityInfo[] }> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; entities: EntityInfo[] }>({
      type: "unity_entity_scan",
      game_assembly: typeof gameAssemblyAddress === "number" ? `0x${gameAssemblyAddress.toString(16)}` : gameAssemblyAddress,
      max_count: maxCount,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Find object by name in Unity
   */
  findObject: async (name: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; address: string }> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; address: string }>({
      type: "unity_find_object",
      name: name,
    });
    return result;
  },
};

// ============================================================================
// MEMORY OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

export const memory = {
  /**
   * Read memory into buffer for efficient multi-field access
   */
  readBuffer: async (address: number | string, size: number): Promise<ReadBufferResult> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<ReadBufferResult>({
      type: "read_buffer",
      address: typeof address === "number" ? `0x${address.toString(16)}` : address,
      size: size,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Batch read multiple memory regions
   */
  readBatch: async (
    reads: Array<{ address: number | string; size: number }>
  ): Promise<BatchReadResult> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<BatchReadResult>({
      type: "read_batch",
      reads: reads.map((r) => ({
        address: typeof r.address === "number" ? `0x${r.address.toString(16)}` : r.address,
        size: r.size,
      })),
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Find all occurrences of a signature
   */
  findSignatures: async (
    baseAddress: number | string,
    signature: string,
    mask?: string
  ): Promise<SignatureScanResult> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<SignatureScanResult>({
      type: "find_signatures",
      base: typeof baseAddress === "number" ? `0x${baseAddress.toString(16)}` : baseAddress,
      sig: signature,
      mask: mask || "",
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Pattern scan in a module
   */
  patternScanModule: async (
    moduleName: string,
    pattern: string,
    mask: string = ""
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; results: PatternScanResult[] }> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; results: PatternScanResult[] }>({
      type: "pattern_scan_module",
      module: moduleName,
      pattern: pattern,
      mask: mask,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Pattern scan in all modules
   */
  patternScanAll: async (
    pattern: string,
    mask: string = ""
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; results: PatternScanResult[] }> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; results: PatternScanResult[] }>({
      type: "pattern_scan_all",
      pattern: pattern,
      mask: mask,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Value scan in a module
   */
  valueScan: async (
    moduleName: string,
    value: string,
    type: string
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; results: ValueScanResult[] }> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; results: ValueScanResult[] }>({
      type: "value_scan",
      module: moduleName,
      value: value,
      type: type,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Multi-pattern scan
   */
  multiPatternScan: async (
    patterns: Array<{ name: string; pattern: string; mask: string; module: string }>
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; results: PatternScanResult[] }> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; results: PatternScanResult[] }>({
      type: "multi_pattern_scan",
      patterns: patterns,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Pointer chain scan
   */
  pointerChainScan: async (
    base: number | string,
    offsets: number[]
  ): Promise<PointerChainResult> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<PointerChainResult>({
      type: "pointer_chain_scan",
      base: typeof base === "number" ? `0x${base.toString(16)}` : base,
      offsets: offsets,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Dump memory region
   */
  dumpMemoryRegion: async (
    base: number | string,
    size: number,
    filename: string
  ): Promise<MemoryDump> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<MemoryDump>({
      type: "dump_memory_region",
      base: typeof base === "number" ? `0x${base.toString(16)}` : base,
      size: size,
      filename: filename,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Dump module to file
   */
  dumpModule: async (
    moduleName: string,
    filename: string
  ): Promise<MemoryDump> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<MemoryDump>({
      type: "dump_module",
      module: moduleName,
      filename: filename,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Get memory regions
   */
  getMemoryRegions: async (): Promise<{ success: boolean; regions: MemoryRegionInfo[] }> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; regions: MemoryRegionInfo[] }>({
      type: "get_memory_regions",
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Validate pattern at address
   */
  validatePattern: async (
    address: number | string,
    pattern: string,
    mask: string = ""
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; valid: boolean }> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; valid: boolean }>({
      type: "validate_pattern",
      address: typeof address === "number" ? `0x${address.toString(16)}` : address,
      pattern: pattern,
      mask: mask,
    });
    return result;
  },
};

    success: boolean;
    position?: Vec3;

// ============================================================================
// MATHEMATICS
// ============================================================================

export const math = {
  /**
   * Calculate angles from one position to another
   */
  calculateAngle: async (from: Vec3, to: Vec3): Promise<AngleResult> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<AngleResult>({
      type: "calculate_angle",
      from_x: from.x,
      from_y: from.y,
      from_z: from.z,
      to_x: to.x,
      to_y: to.y,
      to_z: to.z,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Calculate 2D bounding box from 3D bounding box
   */
  calculate2DBbox: async (
    origin: Vec3,
    mins: Vec3,
    maxs: Vec3,
    viewMatrixAddress?: number | string
  ): Promise<Bbox2D> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{
      success: boolean;
      x?: number;
      y?: number;
      width?: number;
      height?: number;
    }>({
      type: "calculate_2d_bbox",
      origin_x: origin.x,
      origin_y: origin.y,
      origin_z: origin.z,
      mins_x: mins.x,
      mins_y: mins.y,
      mins_z: mins.z,
      maxs_x: maxs.x,
      maxs_y: maxs.y,
      maxs_z: maxs.z,
      view_matrix: viewMatrixAddress ? (typeof viewMatrixAddress === "number" ? `0x${viewMatrixAddress.toString(16)}` : viewMatrixAddress) : "0x0",
    });
    return {
      x: result.x || 0,
      y: result.y || 0,
      width: result.width || 0,
      height: result.height || 0,
      valid: result.success || false,
    };
  },

  /**
   * Matrix multiplication
   */
  matrixMultiply: async (
    a: Matrix4x4,
    b: Matrix4x4
  ): Promise<Matrix4x4> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; data: number[] }>({
      type: "matrix_multiply",
      a: a.data,
      b: b.data,
    });
    if (!result.success) {
      throw new Error("Failed to multiply matrices");
    }
    return { data: result.data };
  },

  /**
   * Matrix vector multiplication
   */
  matrixVectorMultiply: async (
    matrix: Matrix4x4,
    vector: Vec3
  ): Promise<Vec3> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; x: number; y: number; z: number }>({
      type: "matrix_vector_multiply",
      matrix: matrix.data,
      x: vector.x,
      y: vector.y,
      z: vector.z,
    });
    if (!result.success) {
      throw new Error("Failed to multiply matrix and vector");
    }
    return { x: result.x, y: result.y, z: result.z };
  },

  /**
   * Quaternion multiplication
   */
  quaternionMultiply: async (
    a: Quaternion,
    b: Quaternion
  ): Promise<Quaternion> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; x: number; y: number; z: number; w: number }>({
      type: "quaternion_multiply",
      a_x: a.x,
      a_y: a.y,
      a_z: a.z,
      a_w: a.w,
      b_x: b.x,
      b_y: b.y,
      b_z: b.z,
      b_w: b.w,
    });
    if (!result.success) {
      throw new Error("Failed to multiply quaternions");
    }
    return { x: result.x, y: result.y, z: result.z, w: result.w };
  },

  /**
   * Ray-plane intersection
   */
  rayPlaneIntersection: async (
    ray: Ray,
    plane: Plane
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; distance?: number; point?: Vec3 }> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{
      success: boolean;
      distance?: number;
      point?: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
    }>({
      type: "ray_plane_intersection",
      ray_origin_x: ray.origin.x,
      ray_origin_y: ray.origin.y,
      ray_origin_z: ray.origin.z,
      ray_direction_x: ray.direction.x,
      ray_direction_y: ray.direction.y,
      ray_direction_z: ray.direction.z,
      plane_normal_x: plane.normal.x,
      plane_normal_y: plane.normal.y,
      plane_normal_z: plane.normal.z,
      plane_distance: plane.distance,
    });
    return {
      success: result.success,
      distance: result.distance,
      point: result.point ? { x: result.point.x, y: result.point.y, z: result.point.z } : undefined,
    };
  },

  /**
   * Perlin noise
   */
  perlinNoise: async (x: number, y: number, z: number = 0): Promise<number> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; value: number }>({
      type: "perlin_noise",
      x: x,
      y: y,
      z: z,
    });
    if (!result.success) {
      throw new Error("Failed to generate Perlin noise");
    }
    return result.value;
  },

  /**
   * Easing functions
   */
  easeInOutQuad: async (t: number): Promise<number> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; value: number }>({
      type: "ease_in_out_quad",
      t: t,
    });
    if (!result.success) {
      throw new Error("Failed to compute easing");
    }
    return result.value;
  },
};

// ============================================================================
// TRACING
// ============================================================================

export const tracing = {
  /**
   * Perform a ray cast (trace)
   */
  rayCast: async (
    start: Vec3,
    end: Vec3,
    mask: number = 0xFFFFFFFF
  ): Promise<ClipResult> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<ClipResult>({
      type: "ray_cast",
      start_x: start.x,
      start_y: start.y,
      start_z: start.z,
      end_x: end.x,
      end_y: end.y,
      end_z: end.z,
      mask: mask,
    });
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * Trace a line with multiple segments
   */
  traceLine: async (
    start: Vec3,
    end: Vec3,
    step: number = 1.0
  ): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    hit: boolean;
    fraction?: number;
    endPoint?: Vec3;
    normal?: Vec3;
  }> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{
      success: boolean;
      hit: boolean;
      fraction?: number;
      end_point?: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
      normal?: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
    }>({
      type: "trace_line",
      start_x: start.x,
      start_y: start.y,
      start_z: start.z,
      end_x: end.x,
      end_y: end.y,
      end_z: end.z,
      step: step,
    });
    return {
      success: result.success,
      hit: result.hit || false,
      fraction: result.fraction,
      endPoint: result.end_point ? { x: result.end_point.x, y: result.end_point.y, z: result.end_point.z } : undefined,
      normal: result.normal ? { x: result.normal.x, y: result.normal.y, z: result.normal.z } : undefined,
    };
  },

  /**
   * Clip ray to bounding box
   */
  clipToBbox: async (
    ray: Ray,
    mins: Vec3,
    maxs: Vec3
  ): Promise<ClipResult> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<ClipResult>({
      type: "clip_to_bbox",
      ray_origin_x: ray.origin.x,
      ray_origin_y: ray.origin.y,
      ray_origin_z: ray.origin.z,
      ray_direction_x: ray.direction.x,
      ray_direction_y: ray.direction.y,
      ray_direction_z: ray.direction.z,
      mins_x: mins.x,
      mins_y: mins.y,
      mins_z: mins.z,
      maxs_x: maxs.x,
      maxs_y: maxs.y,
      maxs_z: maxs.z,
    });
    return result;
  },
};

export const clipping = {
  /**
   * Clip point to screen bounds
   */

    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; x: number; y: number }>({
      type: "clip_point",
      x: x,
      y: y,
      width: width,
      height: height,
    });
    if (!result.success) {
      throw new Error("Failed to clip point");
    }
    return { x: result.x, y: result.y };
  },

  /**
   * Check if point is on screen
   */
  isOnScreen: async (x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number): Promise<boolean> => {
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; visible: boolean }>({
      type: "is_on_screen",
      x: x,
      y: y,
      width: width,
      height: height,
    });
    if (!result.success) {
      throw new Error("Failed to check on screen");
    }
    return result.visible;
  },
};

// ============================================================================

/**
 * Convert number to hex string
 */
export function toHex(value: number | bigint, prefix: boolean = true): string {
  const str = value.toString(16);
  return prefix ? `0x${str}` : str;
}

/**
 * Parse hex string to number
 */
export function parseHex(str: string): number {
  if (str.startsWith("0x") || str.startsWith("0X")) {
    return parseInt(str.slice(2), 16);
  }
  return parseInt(str, 16);
}

/**
 * Parse address that can be hex or decimal
 */
export function parseAddress(str: string | number): number {
  if (typeof str === "number") return str;
  if (str.startsWith("0x") || str.startsWith("0X")) {
    return parseInt(str.slice(2), 16);
  }
  return parseInt(str, 10);
}
```

`app/src/lib/echo.ts`:

```ts
// Echo relay HTTP client: POST /rpc to the relay Echo's hypervisor socket
// connects to (built into the desktop app, or web-mv's relay in a browser).
// The relay assigns wire ids; callers just send a frame and await the reply.

const kDefaultUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:9000/rpc";
const kStorageKey = "echo-relay-url";

let relayUrl: string = (() => {
  try { return localStorage.getItem(kStorageKey) ?? kDefaultUrl; } catch { return kDefaultUrl; }
})();

const relayListeners = new Set<() => void>();
export function getRelayUrl(): string { return relayUrl; }
export function onRelayUrlChange(listener: () => void): () => void { relayListeners.add(listener); return () => { relayListeners.delete(listener); }; }

export function setRelayUrl(url: string): void {
  const changed = relayUrl !== url;
  relayUrl = url;
  try { localStorage.setItem(kStorageKey, url); } catch { /* private window */ }
  if (changed) for (const listener of relayListeners) listener();
}

export class EchoError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly code: string, message: string) {
    super(message); this.name = "EchoError";
  }
}

export async function echoRequest<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  frame: Record<string, unknown>,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(relayUrl, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "x-mv-client": "echo-reverse" },
    body: JSON.stringify(frame),
    signal,
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new EchoError("HttpError", `relay returned HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const reply = (await res.json()) as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (reply.error) throw new EchoError("RelayError", String(reply.error));
  if (reply.type === "error") {
    throw new EchoError(String(reply.code ?? "EchoError"), String(reply.message ?? "unknown error"));
  }
  return reply as T;
}

/** True when the relay answers, whether or not an Echo agent is connected to it. */
export async function echoReachable(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await echoRequest({ type: "ping" }, AbortSignal.timeout(3000));
    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    return e instanceof EchoError && e.code !== "HttpError";
  }
}
```

`app/src/lib/echoTables.ts`:

```ts
// Generic loaded-module PE views served by echo-reverse.as. The main-module
// browser can also parse PE directly in TypeScript; these helpers are needed
// for DLLs and other loaded images and use only the Echo extension lane.

import { echoRequest } from "./echo";
import { num } from "./mem";

export type ModuleExport = { name: string; address: number; rva: number; ordinal: number };
export type ModuleImport = { module: string; name: string; iat: number };
export type ModuleSection = {
  name: string;
  address: number;
  rva: number;
  size: number;
  raw_size: number;
  characteristics: number;
  protect: string;
};
export type ModuleResource = {
  level: number;
  named: boolean;
  id: number;
  name: string;
  is_dir: boolean;
  address?: number;
  size?: number;
  code_page?: number;
};

export async function moduleExports(module: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<ModuleExport[]> {
  const reply = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ name: string; address: string; rva?: string; ordinal?: number }> }>({ type: "exports", module }, signal);
  return (reply.results ?? []).map((row) => ({
    name: row.name,
    address: num(row.address),
    rva: row.rva !== undefined ? num(row.rva) : 0,
    ordinal: row.ordinal ?? 0,
  }));
}

export async function moduleImports(module: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<ModuleImport[]> {
  const reply = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ module: string; name: string; iat: string }> }>({ type: "imports", module }, signal);
  return (reply.results ?? []).map((row) => ({ module: row.module, name: row.name, iat: num(row.iat) }));
}

export async function moduleSections(module: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<ModuleSection[]> {
  const reply = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ name: string; address: string; rva?: string; size: number; raw_size: number; characteristics: number; protect: string }> }>({ type: "sections", module }, signal);
  return (reply.results ?? []).map((row) => ({
    name: row.name,
    address: num(row.address),
    rva: row.rva !== undefined ? num(row.rva) : 0,
    size: row.size,
    raw_size: row.raw_size,
    characteristics: row.characteristics,
    protect: row.protect,
  }));
}

export async function moduleResourceTree(module: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<ModuleResource[]> {
  const reply = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ level: number; named: boolean; id: number; name: string; is_dir: boolean; address?: string; size?: number; code_page?: number }> }>({ type: "resource_tree", module }, signal);
  return (reply.results ?? []).map((row) => ({
    level: row.level,
    named: row.named,
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    is_dir: row.is_dir,
    address: row.address !== undefined ? num(row.address) : undefined,
    size: row.size,
    code_page: row.code_page,
  }));
}
```

`app/src/lib/emulatorConfig.ts`:

```ts
export type EmulatedRegion = { name: string; address: string; size: number; perms: number; data: string };
export function hex64(value: string): string {
  const text = value.trim().replace(/^0x/i, "");
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{1,16}$/i.test(text)) throw new Error("Expected a 64-bit hexadecimal value");
  return `0x${BigInt(`0x${text}`).toString(16)}`;
}
/** Each line: name address size perms [initial hex bytes]. Addresses and sizes are hex. */
export function parseEmulatedRegions(text: string): EmulatedRegion[] {
  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/).map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (lines.length > 16) throw new Error("Maximum 16 regions");
  let total = 0; const names = new Set<string>();
  return lines.map((line, i) => {
    const [name, rawAddress, rawSize, flags, ...extra] = line.split(/\s+/), data = extra.join("");
    if (!name || names.has(name) || !rawAddress || !rawSize || !flags || !/^[rwx]+$/i.test(flags) || !/^(?:[0-9a-f]{2})*$/i.test(data)) throw new Error(`Invalid region on line ${i + 1}`);
    names.add(name);
    const address = hex64(rawAddress), sizeBig = BigInt(hex64(rawSize)), addressBig = BigInt(address);
    const perms = (flags.toLowerCase().includes("r") ? 1 : 0) | (flags.toLowerCase().includes("w") ? 2 : 0) | (flags.toLowerCase().includes("x") ? 4 : 0);
    total += data.length / 2;
    if (!addressBig || addressBig % 4096n || !sizeBig || sizeBig % 4096n || sizeBig > 0x100000n || addressBig + sizeBig > 0x7fffffffffffn || BigInt(data.length / 2) > sizeBig || total > 65536) throw new Error(`Invalid region size, address or data on line ${i + 1}`);
    return { name, address, size: Number(sizeBig), perms, data };
  });
}
```

```ts
// app/src/lib/endpoint.ts
// Resolves the Echo relay URL from localStorage (set via Settings).
// The old Tauri IPC / C++ engine endpoint is gone; we talk to a relay server.

import { setRelayUrl, getRelayUrl, echoReachable } from "./echo";

export type Endpoint = { url: string };

export const isTauri = (): boolean => "__TAURI_INTERNALS__" in window;

export async function resolveEndpoint(): Promise<Endpoint> {
  // URL is already loaded from localStorage by echo.ts module init.
  return { url: getRelayUrl() };
}

export function updateEndpoint(url: string): void {
  setRelayUrl(url);
}

/** Poll /ping until the relay answers or the deadline passes. */
export async function waitForEngine(timeoutMs = 30_000): Promise<boolean> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (await echoReachable()) return true;
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
  }
  return false;
}
```

```ts
// app/src/lib/events.ts
// Echo relay has no server-push stream, so these are local events: lib/rpc.ts
// emits watch updates from its own poll, other engine events never fire.

export type WatchEntry = {
  id: number;
  addr: number;
  width: string;
  label: string;
  freeze: boolean;
  frozen_bits: number;
  frozen_text: string;
};

export type WatchValue = {
  id: number;
  addr: number;
  ok: boolean;
  held: boolean;
  bits: number;
  text: string;
};

export type EngineEvent =
  | { type: "hello"; data: { output_revision: number } }
  | { type: "output"; data: { seq: number; ms: number; text: string } }
  | { type: "output.cleared"; data: Record<string, never> }
  | { type: "boot.stage"; data: { stage: number; total: number; label: string; done: boolean } }
  | { type: "target.changed"; data: { attached: boolean; pid?: number; name?: string } }
  | { type: "backend.changed"; data: { badge: string; kernel: boolean } }
  | { type: "hype.progress"; data: { has_image: boolean; image: string; present: boolean; ready: boolean; running: boolean; progress: number; error: string } }
  | { type: "watch.list"; data: { entries: WatchEntry[] } }
  | { type: "watch.values"; data: { attached: boolean; values: WatchValue[] } }
  | { type: "app.quitting"; data: { reason: string } }
  | { type: "server.stopping"; data: Record<string, never> };

export type EventName = EngineEvent["type"];

type Handler = (data: never) => void;
const handlers = new Map<EventName, Set<Handler>>();

export function on<K extends EventName>(
  name: K,
  fn: (data: Extract<EngineEvent, { type: K }>["data"]) => void,
): () => void {
  const set = handlers.get(name) ?? new Set<Handler>();
  handlers.set(name, set);
  set.add(fn as Handler);
  return () => { set.delete(fn as Handler); };
}

export function emit<K extends EventName>(name: K, data: Extract<EngineEvent, { type: K }>["data"]): void {
  for (const fn of handlers.get(name) ?? []) (fn as (d: typeof data) => void)(data);
}

export function onConnectionChange(_fn: (open: boolean) => void): () => void {
  return () => {};
}

export function connect(): void {}
export function disconnect(): void {}
```

```ts
// app/src/lib/files.ts
// Getting dumps, SDKs and scripts out of the app: a browser download, or in the
// desktop app a write to %APPDATA%\echo-reverse\out (raw ipc body, no json).

import { isTauri } from "./endpoint";

export function download(name: string, data: string | Uint8Array): void {
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data as BlobPart]));
  a.download = name;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 10_000);
}

export async function saveOutput(name: string, data: string | Uint8Array): Promise<string> {
  if (!isTauri()) throw new Error("writing files needs the desktop app");
  const { invoke } = await import("@tauri-apps/api/core");
  const bytes = typeof data === "string" ? new TextEncoder().encode(data) : data;
  return invoke<string>("save_output", bytes, { headers: { "x-name": name.replace(/[^\w.-]/g, "_") } });
}

/** The desktop app saves and says where, a browser downloads. */
export async function saveOrDownload(name: string, data: string | Uint8Array): Promise<string> {
  if (isTauri()) return `saved to ${await saveOutput(name, data)}`;
  download(name, data);
  return "downloaded";
}
```

`app/src/lib/frida.ts`:

```ts
// Frida relay client — connects to a local WebSocket relay that bridges
// frida-server. Protocol is simple JSON; see the relay template in FridaPanel.
//
// Relay script: node frida-relay.js <process> [port=27043]
// Install: npm install frida ws (or use the built-in frida-tools)

export type FridaScript = { id: string; label: string };
export type FridaMessage = { ts: string; scriptId: string; payload: unknown };

type MsgListener = (msg: Record<string, unknown>) => void;

let _ws: WebSocket | null = null;
let _url = '';
let _connected = false;
let _connectedTo = '';
let _scripts: FridaScript[] = [];
let _messages: FridaMessage[] = [];
let _listeners: MsgListener[] = [];

function dispatch(msg: Record<string, unknown>) {
  if (msg.type === 'message') {
    _messages = [..._messages.slice(-199), { ts: new Date().toISOString(), scriptId: String(msg.scriptId ?? ''), payload: msg.payload }];
  }
  if (msg.type === 'scripts') {
    const ids = msg.scripts as string[];
    _scripts = ids.map(id => ({ id, label: _scripts.find(s => s.id === id)?.label ?? id }));
  }
  if (msg.type === 'eval_result' && msg.scriptId) {
    const id = String(msg.scriptId), label = String(msg.label ?? id);
    if (!_scripts.find(s => s.id === id)) _scripts = [..._scripts, { id, label }];
  }
  if (msg.type === 'unloaded') {
    _scripts = _scripts.filter(s => s.id !== String(msg.id));
  }
  _listeners.forEach(fn => fn(msg));
}

export function fridaStatus() {
  return { connected: _connected, url: _url, connectedTo: _connectedTo, scripts: [..._scripts], messages: [..._messages] };
}

export function fridaConnect(url: string): Promise<{ target: string; pid: number }> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (_ws) { _ws.close(); _ws = null; _connected = false; }
    _url = url;
    const ws = new WebSocket(url);
    let settled = false;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!settled) { settled = true; ws.close(); reject(new Error('Connection timed out')); }
    }, 8000);
    ws.onopen = () => {
      _ws = ws; _connected = true;
    };
    ws.onmessage = e => {
      try {
        const msg = JSON.parse(String(e.data)) as Record<string, unknown>;
        dispatch(msg);
        if (!settled && msg.type === 'connected') {
          settled = true; clearTimeout(timer);
          _connectedTo = String(msg.target ?? '');
          resolve({ target: _connectedTo, pid: Number(msg.pid ?? 0) });
        }
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
    };
    ws.onerror = () => { if (!settled) { settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); reject(new Error('WebSocket error')); } };
    ws.onclose = () => { _connected = false; _ws = null; if (!settled) { settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); reject(new Error('Connection closed')); } };
  });
}

export function fridaDisconnect(): void {
  _ws?.close(); _ws = null; _connected = false; _scripts = [];
}

export function fridaEval(script: string, label?: string): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!_ws || !_connected) { reject(new Error('Not connected to frida-relay')); return; }
    const id = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
    const off = fridaOnMessage(msg => {
      if (msg.type === 'eval_result' && msg.id === id) {
        off();
        if (msg.error) reject(new Error(String(msg.error)));
        else resolve(String(msg.scriptId ?? id));
      }
    });
    _ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'eval', id, script, label: label ?? 'script' }));
    setTimeout(() => { off(); reject(new Error('eval timed out (10 s)')); }, 10000);
  });
}

export function fridaUnload(scriptId: string): void {
  _ws?.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'unload', id: scriptId }));
  _scripts = _scripts.filter(s => s.id !== scriptId);
}

export function fridaCall(scriptId: string, method: string, args: unknown[]): Promise<unknown> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!_ws || !_connected) { reject(new Error('Not connected')); return; }
    const id = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
    const off = fridaOnMessage(msg => {
      if (msg.type === 'rpc_result' && msg.callId === id) {
        off();
        if (msg.error) reject(new Error(String(msg.error)));
        else resolve(msg.result);
      }
    });
    _ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'rpc', callId: id, scriptId, method, args }));
    setTimeout(() => { off(); reject(new Error('rpc timed out (15 s)')); }, 15000);
  });
}

export function fridaOnMessage(fn: MsgListener): () => void {
  _listeners = [..._listeners, fn];
  return () => { _listeners = _listeners.filter(l => l !== fn); };
}

export function fridaClearMessages(): void { _messages = []; }

export const RELAY_TEMPLATE = `// frida-relay.js — bridge frida-server to echo-reverse
// Usage: node frida-relay.js <process_name_or_pid> [port=27043]
// Requires: npm install frida ws
const frida = require('frida');
const { WebSocketServer } = require('ws');
const target = process.argv[2] ?? (() => { console.error('usage: node frida-relay.js <process>'); process.exit(1); })();
const port = parseInt(process.argv[3] ?? '27043');
(async () => {
  const session = await frida.attach(typeof target === 'string' && /^\\d+$/.test(target) ? parseInt(target) : target);
  const scripts = new Map();
  const wss = new WebSocketServer({ port });
  console.log(\`frida-relay listening on ws://localhost:\${port} (attached to \${target} pid=\${session.pid})\`);
  wss.on('connection', ws => {
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'connected', target, pid: session.pid }));
    ws.on('message', async data => {
      const msg = JSON.parse(data.toString());
      if (msg.type === 'eval') {
        try {
          const script = await session.createScript(msg.script);
          const id = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
          script.message.connect(p => ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'message', scriptId: id, payload: p })));
          await script.load();
          scripts.set(id, script);
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'eval_result', id: msg.id, scriptId: id, label: msg.label ?? id }));
        } catch (e) { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'eval_result', id: msg.id, error: e.message })); }
      } else if (msg.type === 'unload') {
        try { await scripts.get(msg.id)?.unload(); scripts.delete(msg.id); } catch { /* ignore */ }
        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'unloaded', id: msg.id }));
      } else if (msg.type === 'rpc') {
        try {
          const s = scripts.get(msg.scriptId);
          if (!s) throw new Error('script not found');
          const result = await s.exports[msg.method](...(msg.args ?? []));
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'rpc_result', callId: msg.callId, result }));
        } catch (e) { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'rpc_result', callId: msg.callId, error: e.message })); }
      } else if (msg.type === 'list_scripts') {
        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'scripts', scripts: [...scripts.keys()] }));
      }
    });
  });
})().catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });
`;
```

`app/src/lib/iat.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/iat.ts
// Scylla-style import rebuild for a memory dump (see dumpModule in rpc.ts). In
// memory the IAT holds resolved pointers and protected games wipe the import
// directory, so static tools see no import names. Here every IAT slot is
// resolved against the exports of the loaded modules, a new import section is
// appended, and the slots get their name thunks back like an unloaded PE.
// shortcut: forwarded exports are named after the module that implements them
// (kernelbase!Sleep rather than kernel32!Sleep), ordinal-only imports are skipped.

import { num } from "./mem";
import { call, exportsOf, modules } from "./rpc";

type Slot = { rva: number; dll: string; name: string };

const align = (n: number, a: number) => Math.ceil(n / a) * a;

export async function rebuildImports(
  dump: Uint8Array,
  self: string,
  progress?: (m: string) => void,
): Promise<{ bytes: Uint8Array; modules: number; functions: number }> {
  // every named export of every other module, va -> dll!name
  const exports = new Map<number, { dll: string; name: string }>();
  for (const m of await modules()) {
    if (m.name.toLowerCase() === self.toLowerCase()) continue;
    progress?.(`reading exports of ${m.name}…`);
    for (const [va, name] of await exportsOf(num(m.base))) exports.set(va, { dll: m.name, name });
  }

  const v = new DataView(dump.buffer, dump.byteOffset, dump.byteLength);
  const nt = v.getUint32(0x3c, true);
  const opt = nt + 24;
  if (v.getUint16(opt, true) !== 0x20b) throw new Error("import rebuild supports PE32+ (x64) dumps");
  const nsec = v.getUint16(nt + 6, true);
  const secOff = opt + v.getUint16(nt + 20, true);
  const sectionAlign = v.getUint32(opt + 32, true) || 0x1000;
  const dir = (i: number) => ({ rva: v.getUint32(opt + 112 + i * 8, true), size: v.getUint32(opt + 116 + i * 8, true) });

  // where to look: the IAT directory when it survived, else every non-code section
  const ranges: Array<[number, number]> = [];
  const iatDir = dir(12);
  if (iatDir.rva && iatDir.size && iatDir.rva + iatDir.size <= dump.length) ranges.push([iatDir.rva, iatDir.rva + iatDir.size]);
  else {
    for (let i = 0; i < nsec; i++) {
      const s = secOff + i * 40;
      if (v.getUint32(s + 36, true) & 0x20000000) continue;
      const rva = v.getUint32(s + 12, true);
      ranges.push([rva, Math.min(dump.length, rva + v.getUint32(s + 8, true))]);
    }
  }

  // runs of consecutive resolved slots; a lone pointer outside the IAT directory is likely just data
  const runs: Slot[][] = [];
  for (const [lo, hi] of ranges) {
    let run: Slot[] = [];
    const close = () => {
      if (run.length >= (iatDir.rva ? 1 : 2)) runs.push(run);
      run = [];
    };
    for (let rva = align(lo, 8); rva + 8 <= hi; rva += 8) {
      const e = exports.get(Number(v.getBigUint64(rva, true)));
      if (e) run.push({ rva, ...e });
      else close();
    }
    close();
  }
  // one descriptor per same-dll stretch of a run, the loader walks FirstThunk until the INT ends
  const descs: Slot[][] = [];
  for (const r of runs) {
    for (const slot of r) {
      const last = descs[descs.length - 1];
      if (last && last[last.length - 1].rva + 8 === slot.rva && last[0].dll === slot.dll) last.push(slot);
      else descs.push([slot]);
    }
  }
  if (descs.length === 0) return { bytes: dump, modules: 0, functions: 0 };

  // new section: descriptors, then each INT, then hint/name entries, then dll names
  const newRva = align(dump.length, sectionAlign);
  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  let size = (descs.length + 1) * 20;
  const intAt = descs.map((d) => { const at = size; size += (d.length + 1) * 8; return at; });
  const nameAt = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const d of descs) for (const s of d) if (!nameAt.has(s.name)) { nameAt.set(s.name, size); size = align(size + 2 + s.name.length + 1, 2); }
  const dllAt = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const d of descs) if (!dllAt.has(d[0].dll)) { dllAt.set(d[0].dll, size); size += d[0].dll.length + 1; }

  // the section header needs room before the first section's data
  const headerEnd = secOff + (nsec + 1) * 40;
  let firstData = dump.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < nsec; i++) firstData = Math.min(firstData, v.getUint32(secOff + i * 40 + 20, true) || firstData);
  if (headerEnd > firstData) throw new Error("no room for another section header");

  const out = new Uint8Array(newRva + align(size, sectionAlign));
  out.set(dump);
  const o = new DataView(out.buffer);
  const sec = out.subarray(newRva);
  descs.forEach((d, i) => {
    const desc = newRva + i * 20;
    o.setUint32(desc, newRva + intAt[i], true); // OriginalFirstThunk
    o.setUint32(desc + 12, newRva + dllAt.get(d[0].dll)!, true); // Name
    o.setUint32(desc + 16, d[0].rva, true); // FirstThunk, the original IAT slots
    d.forEach((s, j) => {
      const thunk = BigInt(newRva + nameAt.get(s.name)!);
      o.setBigUint64(newRva + intAt[i] + j * 8, thunk, true);
      o.setBigUint64(s.rva, thunk, true); // the IAT slot as it is on disk before loading
    });
  });
  for (const [name, at] of nameAt) sec.set(enc.encode(name), at + 2);
  for (const [dll, at] of dllAt) sec.set(enc.encode(dll), at);

  const h = secOff + nsec * 40;
  out.set(enc.encode(".eimp\0\0\0"), h);
  o.setUint32(h + 8, size, true);
  o.setUint32(h + 12, newRva, true);
  o.setUint32(h + 16, align(size, sectionAlign), true);
  o.setUint32(h + 20, newRva, true);
  o.setUint32(h + 36, 0xc0000040, true); // initialized data, read, write
  o.setUint16(nt + 6, nsec + 1, true);
  o.setUint32(opt + 56, out.length, true); // SizeOfImage
  if (o.getUint32(opt + 108, true) < 16) o.setUint32(opt + 108, 16, true); // NumberOfRvaAndSizes
  o.setUint32(opt + 112 + 8, newRva, true); // import directory
  o.setUint32(opt + 116 + 8, (descs.length + 1) * 20, true);
  o.setUint32(opt + 112 + 11 * 8, 0, true); // bound imports would point at stale data
  o.setUint32(opt + 116 + 11 * 8, 0, true);
  return { bytes: out, modules: new Set(descs.map((d) => d[0].dll)).size, functions: descs.reduce((n, d) => n + d.length, 0) };
}

/** A module from live memory as a loadable PE with its imports rebuilt. */
export async function dumpModuleFile(
  m: { name: string; base: number; size: number },
  progress?: (msg: string) => void,
): Promise<{ bytes: Uint8Array; missing: number; imports: { modules: number; functions: number } | string }> {
  progress?.(`dumping ${m.name}…`);
  const { bytes, missing } = await call<{ bytes: Uint8Array; missing: number }>("target", "dump", { base: m.base, size: m.size });
  try {
    const r = await rebuildImports(bytes, m.name, progress);
    return { bytes: r.bytes, missing, imports: { modules: r.modules, functions: r.functions } };
  } catch (e) {
    // the plain dump still loads, just without import names
    return { bytes, missing, imports: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) };
  }
}
```

`app/src/lib/icons.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/icons.ts
// process icon cache, the engine hands back raw bgra and the canvas turns it
// into a data url, requests deduped and batched

import { call } from "./rpc";

type IconBits = { width: number; height: number; bgra_b64?: string };

const cache = new Map<string, string | null>(); // path -> data URL, null = none
const pending = new Set<string>();
const waiters = new Set<() => void>();
let flushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

/** Notified when a batch resolves, so components can re-render. */
export function onIconsResolved(fn: () => void): () => void {
  waiters.add(fn);
  return () => {
    waiters.delete(fn);
  };
}

function toDataUrl(bits: IconBits): string | null {
  if (!bits.bgra_b64 || bits.width === 0 || bits.height === 0) return null;

  const binary = atob(bits.bgra_b64);
  const expected = bits.width * bits.height * 4;
  if (binary.length < expected) return null;

  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = bits.width;
  canvas.height = bits.height;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (ctx === null) return null;

  const image = ctx.createImageData(bits.width, bits.height);
  // BGRA (Win32 DIB order) -> RGBA (ImageData order)
  for (let i = 0; i < expected; i += 4) {
    image.data[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i + 2);
    image.data[i + 1] = binary.charCodeAt(i + 1);
    image.data[i + 2] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    image.data[i + 3] = binary.charCodeAt(i + 3);
  }
  ctx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);
  return canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
}

async function flush(): Promise<void> {
  flushTimer = null;
  // The engine caps a single request at 64 paths; drain in chunks so a full
  // process list still resolves
  const batch = [...pending].slice(0, 64);
  if (batch.length === 0) return;
  for (const p of batch) pending.delete(p);

  try {
    const res = await call<{ icons: Record<string, IconBits> }>("target", "icon", {
      paths: batch,
    });
    for (const path of batch) {
      const bits = res.icons[path];
      cache.set(path, bits ? toDataUrl(bits) : null);
    }
  } catch {
    // Mark them resolved-as-missing so a failing path is not retried forever
    for (const path of batch) cache.set(path, null);
  }

  for (const fn of waiters) fn();
  if (pending.size > 0) schedule();
}

function schedule(): void {
  if (flushTimer !== null) return;
  // One frame of coalescing: a virtualized table asks for every visible row in
  // the same tick
  flushTimer = setTimeout(() => void flush(), 16);
}

/**
 * Data URL for a process image, or null when there is no icon. Returns
 * undefined while the lookup is still in flight, render a placeholder and wait
 * for onIconsResolved.
 */
export function iconFor(path: string | undefined): string | null | undefined {
  if (!path) return null;
  const hit = cache.get(path);
  if (hit !== undefined) return hit;
  if (!pending.has(path)) {
    pending.add(path);
    schedule();
  }
  return undefined;
}
```

```ts
// app/src/lib/il2cpp.ts
// Unity IL2CPP over Echo reads. GameAssembly keeps a pointer to the loaded
// global-metadata.dat, so the metadata is taken from memory: already decrypted
// for games that ship it encrypted. Images, types, methods and fields come out
// of it by name, with the version-dependent Il2CppTypeDefinition offsets found
// by consistency (each type's methods/fields follow the previous type's), and
// the whole file plus a GameAssembly dump can be exported for Il2CppDumper or
// Cpp2IL, which recover addresses, field offsets and signatures.
// shortcut: no runtime Il2CppClass walk, so field offsets and method addresses
// come from those tools, not from here.

import { Mem, readMany, u32 } from "./mem";
import { modules, readPe } from "./rpc";

const kMagic = 0xfab11baf;
const i32 = (b: Uint8Array, o: number) => u32(b, o) | 0;
const u16 = (b: Uint8Array, o: number) => b[o] | (b[o + 1] << 8);

export type Il2CppType = { image: string; namespace: string; name: string; methods: string[]; fields: string[] };

export type Il2Cpp = {
  version: number;
  address: number;
  bytes: Uint8Array;
  images: Array<{ name: string; types: number }>;
  types: Il2CppType[];
  /** where the counts and starts were found in Il2CppTypeDefinition, for the curious */
  layout: { typeStride: number; fieldStart: number; methodStart: number; methodCount: number; fieldCount: number };
};

const pair = (b: Uint8Array, k: number) => ({ off: i32(b, 8 + k * 8), size: i32(b, 12 + k * 8) });

function cstr(b: Uint8Array, at: number): string {
  if (at < 0 || at >= b.length) return "";
  let end = at;
  while (end < b.length && b[end] !== 0) end++;
  return new TextDecoder().decode(b.subarray(at, end));
}

/** Find global-metadata.dat through GameAssembly's pointer to it and read the whole file. */
export async function findMetadata(progress?: (m: string) => void): Promise<{ address: number; bytes: Uint8Array }> {
  const mods = await modules();
  const ga = mods.find((m) => m.name.toLowerCase() === "gameassembly.dll");
  if (!ga) throw new Error("GameAssembly.dll isn't loaded, not an IL2CPP game");
  const base = Number(BigInt(ga.base));
  const mem = new Mem();
  const pe = await readPe(mem, base);
  const pointers = new Set<number>();
  for (const s of pe.sections.filter((x) => x.writable && !x.exec)) {
    progress?.(`scanning GameAssembly ${s.name}…`);
    const { bytes } = await mem.image(base + s.rva, s.vsize);
    const v = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
    for (let o = 0; o + 8 <= bytes.length; o += 8) {
      const p = Number(v.getBigUint64(o, true));
      if (p >= 0x10000 && p < 0x7fffffffffff && p % 8 === 0) pointers.add(p);
    }
  }
  progress?.(`checking ${pointers.size} pointers for the metadata header…`);
  const list = [...pointers];
  const heads = await readMany(list.map((addr) => ({ addr, len: 8 })));
  const at = list.find((_, i) => heads[i] && u32(heads[i]!, 0) === kMagic && i32(heads[i]!, 4) >= 16 && i32(heads[i]!, 4) <= 40);
  if (at === undefined) throw new Error("no global-metadata in memory (not loaded yet, or the header was stripped)");

  // the header is pairs of (offset, size); the file ends where the last section does
  const header = (await mem.bytes(at, 0x400))!;
  let end = 0;
  // the header ends where the first section starts, past that it's data, not pairs
  let headerEnd = 0x400;
  for (let k = 0; 8 + k * 8 + 8 <= headerEnd; k++) {
    const { off, size } = pair(header, k);
    if (off <= 0 || size < 0 || off > 0x10000000) break;
    headerEnd = Math.min(headerEnd, off);
    end = Math.max(end, off + size);
  }
  progress?.(`reading ${(end / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MiB of metadata…`);
  const { bytes } = await mem.image(at, end);
  return { address: at, bytes };
}

/** Parse images, types, method and field names out of a metadata file. */
export function parseMetadata(b: Uint8Array, address = 0): Il2Cpp {
  if (u32(b, 0) !== kMagic) throw new Error("not a global-metadata file");
  const version = i32(b, 4);
  const strings = pair(b, 2);
  const str = (index: number) => cstr(b.subarray(0, strings.off + strings.size), strings.off + index);

  // images sit at pair 20, or 21 when rgctxEntries precedes them (<= 24.1); entries are a
  // version-dependent 32..44 bytes starting nameIndex, assemblyIndex, typeStart, typeCount
  let images: Array<{ name: string; typeStart: number; typeCount: number }> = [];
  pick: for (const k of [20, 21]) {
    const { off, size } = pair(b, k);
    for (const stride of [40, 32, 36, 44]) {
      if (size <= 0 || size % stride) continue;
      const list = Array.from({ length: size / stride }, (_, i) => ({
        name: str(u32(b, off + i * stride)), typeStart: i32(b, off + i * stride + 8), typeCount: i32(b, off + i * stride + 12),
      }));
      const contiguous = list.every((im, i) => i === 0 || im.typeStart === list[i - 1].typeStart + list[i - 1].typeCount);
      if (list.length && contiguous && list.every((im) => im.name.endsWith(".dll"))) { images = list; break pick; }
    }
  }
  if (!images.length) throw new Error(`metadata v${version}: image table not recognized`);

  const typeDefs = pair(b, 19);
  const totalTypes = images.reduce((n, im) => n + im.typeCount, 0);
  const typeStride = totalTypes ? typeDefs.size / totalTypes : 0;
  if (!Number.isInteger(typeStride) || typeStride < 0x30) throw new Error(`metadata v${version}: type definitions don't divide by the type count`);
  const td = (i: number, o: number) => typeDefs.off + i * typeStride + o;

  // fieldStart and methodStart are adjacent int32s, method_count and field_count uint16s two apart;
  // the right offsets make every type's range start where the previous one's ended
  let best = { score: 0, seen: 0, fieldStart: 0, methodStart: 0, methodCount: 0, fieldCount: 0 };
  for (let s = 8; s + 8 <= typeStride; s += 4) {
    for (let c = s + 8; c + 6 <= typeStride; c += 2) {
      let ok = 0, seen = 0;
      for (let i = 1; i < totalTypes; i++) {
        const mPrev = i32(b, td(i - 1, s + 4)), mCount = u16(b, td(i - 1, c)), mNext = i32(b, td(i, s + 4));
        const fPrev = i32(b, td(i - 1, s)), fCount = u16(b, td(i - 1, c + 4)), fNext = i32(b, td(i, s));
        if (mPrev >= 0 && mNext >= 0 && mCount) { seen++; if (mNext === mPrev + mCount) ok++; }
        if (fPrev >= 0 && fNext >= 0 && fCount) { seen++; if (fNext === fPrev + fCount) ok++; }
      }
      const score = seen ? ok / seen : 0;
      // ties go to the offsets that explain more types
      if (seen >= 2 && (score > best.score || (score === best.score && seen > best.seen))) best = { score, seen, fieldStart: s, methodStart: s + 4, methodCount: c, fieldCount: c + 4 };
    }
  }

  const methods = pair(b, 5);
  const fields = pair(b, 11);
  let totalMethods = 0, totalFields = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < totalTypes && best.score; i++) {
    totalMethods = Math.max(totalMethods, i32(b, td(i, best.methodStart)) + u16(b, td(i, best.methodCount)));
    totalFields = Math.max(totalFields, i32(b, td(i, best.fieldStart)) + u16(b, td(i, best.fieldCount)));
  }
  const methodStride = totalMethods ? methods.size / totalMethods : 0;
  const fieldStride = totalFields ? fields.size / totalFields : 0;
  const names = (sec: { off: number }, stride: number, start: number, count: number) =>
    !best.score || !Number.isInteger(stride) || start < 0 ? [] : Array.from({ length: count }, (_, k) => str(u32(b, sec.off + (start + k) * stride)));

  const types: Il2CppType[] = [];
  for (const im of images) {
    for (let i = im.typeStart; i < im.typeStart + im.typeCount; i++) {
      types.push({
        image: im.name,
        name: str(u32(b, td(i, 0))),
        namespace: str(u32(b, td(i, 4))),
        methods: names(methods, methodStride, i32(b, td(i, best.methodStart)), u16(b, td(i, best.methodCount))),
        fields: names(fields, fieldStride, i32(b, td(i, best.fieldStart)), u16(b, td(i, best.fieldCount))),
      });
    }
  }
  return {
    version, address, bytes: b, types,
    images: images.map((im) => ({ name: im.name, types: im.typeCount })),
    layout: { typeStride, fieldStart: best.fieldStart, methodStart: best.methodStart, methodCount: best.methodCount, fieldCount: best.fieldCount },
  };
}

export async function openIl2Cpp(progress?: (m: string) => void): Promise<Il2Cpp> {
  const { address, bytes } = await findMetadata(progress);
  return parseMetadata(bytes, address);
}
```

```ts
// ── key storage ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const kKeyPrefix = 'echo-reverse-llm-key-';

function migrateKeys() {
  const old = localStorage.getItem('echo-reverse-anthropic-key');
  if (old && !localStorage.getItem(kKeyPrefix + 'anthropic')) {
    localStorage.setItem(kKeyPrefix + 'anthropic', old);
    localStorage.removeItem('echo-reverse-anthropic-key');
  }

export function getApiKey(provider: Provider): string {
  if (provider === 'ollama') return '';
  return localStorage.getItem(kKeyPrefix + provider) ?? '';

  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(kDisabledProviders) ?? '[]') as Provider[]; }
```
