export function availableModels(): ModelEntry[] {
  const disabled = getDisabledProviders();
  return MODEL_CATALOG.filter(m => {
    if (disabled.includes(m.provider)) return false;
    if (m.provider === 'ollama') return true;
    return !!getApiKey(m.provider);
  });
}

export function hasAnyKey(): boolean {
  return PROVIDERS.some(p => p === 'ollama' || !!getApiKey(p));
}

function resolveModel(model?: string): { provider: Provider; modelName: string } {
  const modelId = model ?? getDefaultModel();
  const slash = modelId.indexOf('/');
  if (slash === -1) throw new Error(`Model must be in "provider/model" format, got: ${modelId}`);
  return { provider: modelId.slice(0, slash) as Provider, modelName: modelId.slice(slash + 1) };
}

// ── single-turn completion (legacy, used by decompile / MCP) ──────────────────

export async function complete(
  systemPrompt: string,
  userPrompt: string,
  model?: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const msgs: ChatMessage[] = [
    { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
    { role: 'user', content: userPrompt },
  ];
  return chat(msgs, model);
}

// ── multi-turn completion ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function chat(
  messages: ChatMessage[],
  model?: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const { provider, modelName } = resolveModel(model);
  switch (provider) {
    case 'anthropic':  return _anthropicChat(modelName, messages);
    case 'openai':     return _openaiChat(modelName, messages);
    case 'gemini':     return _geminiChat(modelName, messages);
    case 'ollama':     return _ollamaChat(modelName, messages);
    case 'openrouter':
    case 'groq':
    case 'xai':
    case 'mistral':    return _openaiCompatChat(provider, _resolveCompatModel(provider, modelName), messages);
    default: {
      const dyn = getDynamicProvider(provider);
      if (dyn) return _dynChat(dyn.baseUrl, dyn.apiKey, modelName, messages);
      throw new Error(`Unknown provider: ${provider}`);
    }
  }
}

// ── streaming multi-turn ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Stream tokens as they arrive. onToken is called for each chunk. Throws on error. */
export async function chatStream(
  messages: ChatMessage[],
  model: string | undefined,
  onToken: (token: string) => void,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<void> {
  const { provider, modelName } = resolveModel(model);
  switch (provider) {
    case 'anthropic':  return _anthropicStream(modelName, messages, onToken, signal);
    case 'openai':     return _openaiStream(modelName, messages, onToken, signal);
    case 'gemini':     return _geminiStream(modelName, messages, onToken, signal);
    case 'ollama':     return _ollamaStream(modelName, messages, onToken, signal);
    case 'openrouter':
    case 'groq':
    case 'xai':
    case 'mistral':    return _openaiCompatStream(provider, _resolveCompatModel(provider, modelName), messages, onToken, signal);
    default: {
      const dyn = getDynamicProvider(provider);
      if (dyn) return _dynStream(dyn.baseUrl, dyn.apiKey, modelName, messages, onToken, signal);
      throw new Error(`Unknown provider: ${provider}`);
    }
  }
}

// ── SSE reader helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function readSseStream(
  resp: Response,
  onLine: (line: string) => void,
): Promise<void> {
  const reader = resp.body!.getReader();
  const dec = new TextDecoder();
  let buf = '';
  while (true) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    buf += dec.decode(value, { stream: true });
    const lines = buf.split('\n');
    buf = lines.pop()!;
    for (const line of lines) onLine(line);
  }
  if (buf) onLine(buf);
}

// ── Anthropic ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function _anthropicBody(model: string, messages: ChatMessage[], stream: boolean) {
  const system = messages.filter(m => m.role === 'system').map(m => m.content).join('\n');
  const msgs = messages.filter(m => m.role !== 'system').map(m => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content }));
  return { model, max_tokens: 8192, ...(system ? { system } : {}), messages: msgs, ...(stream ? { stream: true } : {}) };
}

async function _anthropicChat(model: string, messages: ChatMessage[]): Promise<string> {
  const key = getApiKey('anthropic');
  if (!key) throw new Error('No Anthropic API key — add it in Settings → AI');
  const resp = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'x-api-key': key, 'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01', 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(_anthropicBody(model, messages, false)),
  });
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Anthropic ${resp.status}: ${await resp.text()}`);
  const json = await resp.json() as { content: Array<{ type: string; text: string }> };
  return json.content.find(c => c.type === 'text')?.text ?? '';
}

async function _anthropicStream(model: string, messages: ChatMessage[], onToken: (t: string) => void, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
  const key = getApiKey('anthropic');
  if (!key) throw new Error('No Anthropic API key — add it in Settings → AI');
  const resp = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'x-api-key': key, 'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01', 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(_anthropicBody(model, messages, true)),
    signal,
  });
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Anthropic ${resp.status}: ${await resp.text()}`);
  await readSseStream(resp, line => {
    if (!line.startsWith('data: ')) return;
    const data = line.slice(6).trim();
    if (data === '[DONE]' || !data) return;
    try {
      const ev = JSON.parse(data) as { type?: string; delta?: { type?: string; text?: string } };
      if (ev.type === 'content_block_delta' && ev.delta?.type === 'text_delta' && ev.delta.text) {
        onToken(ev.delta.text);
      }
    } catch { /* skip malformed */ }
  });
}

// ── dynamic provider registry (loaded from models.yml at runtime) ─────────────

const _dynProviders = new Map<string, { baseUrl: string; apiKey: string }>();

export function registerDynamicProvider(id: string, baseUrl: string, apiKey: string): void {
  _dynProviders.set(id, { baseUrl, apiKey });
}
export function clearDynamicProviders(): void { _dynProviders.clear(); }
export function getDynamicProvider(id: string) { return _dynProviders.get(id); }

async function _dynChat(baseUrl: string, apiKey: string, model: string, messages: ChatMessage[]): Promise<string> {
  const resp = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/chat/completions`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { authorization: apiKey ? `Bearer ${apiKey}` : '', 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ model, messages: _openaiMessages(messages) }),
  });
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`${baseUrl} ${resp.status}: ${await resp.text()}`);
  const json = await resp.json() as { choices: Array<{ message: { content: string } }> };
  return json.choices[0]?.message.content ?? '';
}

async function _dynStream(baseUrl: string, apiKey: string, model: string, messages: ChatMessage[], onToken: (t: string) => void, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
  const resp = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/chat/completions`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { authorization: apiKey ? `Bearer ${apiKey}` : '', 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ model, messages: _openaiMessages(messages), stream: true }),
    signal,
  });
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`${baseUrl} ${resp.status}: ${await resp.text()}`);
  await readSseStream(resp, line => {
    if (!line.startsWith('data: ')) return;
    const data = line.slice(6).trim();
    if (data === '[DONE]' || !data) return;
    try {
      const ev = JSON.parse(data) as { choices?: Array<{ delta?: { content?: string } }> };
      const token = ev.choices?.[0]?.delta?.content;
      if (token) onToken(token);
    } catch { /* skip */ }
  });
}

function _resolveCompatModel(provider: Provider, model: string): string {
  if (model === 'custom') {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(`echo-reverse-llm-custom-${provider}`) ?? '';
    if (!stored) throw new Error(`Set a custom model name for ${provider} in Settings → AI`);
    return stored;
  }
  return model;
}

// ── OpenAI-compat providers (OpenRouter, Groq, xAI, Mistral) ─────────────────

const COMPAT_BASE: Partial<Record<Provider, string>> = {
  openai:      'https://api.openai.com/v1',
  openrouter:  'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1',
  groq:        'https://api.groq.com/openai/v1',
  xai:         'https://api.x.ai/v1',
  mistral:     'https://api.mistral.ai/v1',
};

// OpenRouter requires site attribution headers to avoid 429s.
function _compatHeaders(provider: Provider): Record<string, string> {
  const key = getApiKey(provider);
  const base: Record<string, string> = { authorization: `Bearer ${key}`, 'content-type': 'application/json' };
  if (provider === 'openrouter') {
    base['HTTP-Referer'] = 'https://github.com/NetVar1337/echo-reverse';
    base['X-Title'] = 'echo-reverse';
  }
  return base;
}

// ── OpenAI ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function _openaiMessages(messages: ChatMessage[]) {
  return messages.filter(m => m.role !== 'tool_call').map(m => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content }));
}

async function _openaiCompatChat(provider: Provider, model: string, messages: ChatMessage[]): Promise<string> {

// Aliases for OpenAI specifically (keep old name for backward compat in agentStream)

// ── Gemini ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function _geminiContents(messages: ChatMessage[]) {
  return messages
    .filter(m => m.role !== 'system')
    .map(m => ({ role: m.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user', parts: [{ text: m.content }] }));
}

function _geminiSystem(messages: ChatMessage[]): string {
  return messages.filter(m => m.role === 'system').map(m => m.content).join('\n');
}

async function _geminiChat(model: string, messages: ChatMessage[]): Promise<string> {
  const key = getApiKey('gemini');
  if (!key) throw new Error('No Gemini API key — add it in Settings → AI');
  const system = _geminiSystem(messages);
  const resp = await fetch(
    `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${model}:generateContent?key=${encodeURIComponent(key)}`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        ...(system ? { system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: system }] } } : {}),
        contents: _geminiContents(messages),
        generationConfig: { maxOutputTokens: 8192 },
      }),
    }
  );
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Gemini ${resp.status}: ${await resp.text()}`);
  const json = await resp.json() as { candidates: Array<{ content: { parts: Array<{ text: string }> } }> };
  return json.candidates[0]?.content.parts.map(p => p.text).join('') ?? '';
}

async function _geminiStream(model: string, messages: ChatMessage[], onToken: (t: string) => void, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
  const key = getApiKey('gemini');
  if (!key) throw new Error('No Gemini API key — add it in Settings → AI');
  const system = _geminiSystem(messages);
  const resp = await fetch(
    `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${model}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse&key=${encodeURIComponent(key)}`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        ...(system ? { system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: system }] } } : {}),
        contents: _geminiContents(messages),
        generationConfig: { maxOutputTokens: 8192 },
      }),
      signal,
    }
  );
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Gemini ${resp.status}: ${await resp.text()}`);
  await readSseStream(resp, line => {
    if (!line.startsWith('data: ')) return;
    const data = line.slice(6).trim();
    if (!data) return;
    try {
      const ev = JSON.parse(data) as { candidates?: Array<{ content?: { parts?: Array<{ text?: string }> } }> };
      const text = ev.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text;
      if (text) onToken(text);
    } catch { /* skip */ }
  });
}

// ── Ollama ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function _resolveOllama(model: string): string {
  const resolved = model === 'custom' ? getCustomOllamaModel() : model;
  if (!resolved) throw new Error('Set Ollama custom model name in Settings → AI');
  return resolved;
}

async function _ollamaChat(model: string, messages: ChatMessage[]): Promise<string> {
  const url = getOllamaUrl();
  const resp = await fetch(`${url}/api/chat`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ model: _resolveOllama(model), messages, stream: false }),
  });
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Ollama ${resp.status}: ${await resp.text()}`);
  const json = await resp.json() as { message?: { content: string }; response?: string };
  return json.message?.content ?? json.response ?? '';
}

async function _ollamaStream(model: string, messages: ChatMessage[], onToken: (t: string) => void, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
  const url = getOllamaUrl();
  const resp = await fetch(`${url}/api/chat`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ model: _resolveOllama(model), messages, stream: true }),
    signal,
  });
  if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Ollama ${resp.status}: ${await resp.text()}`);
  // Ollama streams newline-delimited JSON
  await readSseStream(resp, line => {
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;
    try {
      const ev = JSON.parse(trimmed) as { message?: { content?: string }; done?: boolean };
      if (ev.message?.content) onToken(ev.message.content);
    } catch { /* skip */ }
  });
}

// ── agentic tool use (Echo tool schemas + call dispatcher) ────────────────────

const ECHO_TOOLS_ANTHROPIC = [
  {
    name: 'echo_modules',
    description: 'List all modules (name, base address, size) loaded in the attached process.',
    input_schema: { type: 'object', properties: {}, required: [] as string[] },
  },
  {
    name: 'echo_read',
    description: 'Read raw bytes from process memory at a virtual address. Returns hex string.',
    input_schema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        address: { type: 'number', description: 'Virtual address (decimal integer)' },
        size:    { type: 'number', description: 'Byte count to read (1–256)' },
      },
      required: ['address', 'size'],
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'echo_disassemble',
    description: 'Disassemble instructions starting at a virtual address. Returns address + mnemonic per line.',
    input_schema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        address: { type: 'number', description: 'Virtual address (decimal integer)' },
        count:   { type: 'number', description: 'Instruction count (1–100)' },
      },
      required: ['address', 'count'],
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'echo_sig_scan',
    description: 'Scan for an IDA-style byte pattern (e.g. "48 8B 05 ? ? ? ?") in the target process.',
    input_schema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        pattern: { type: 'string', description: 'IDA-style hex pattern with ? wildcards' },
        module:  { type: 'string', description: 'Limit scan to this module name (optional)' },
      },
      required: ['pattern'],
    },
  },
] as const;

const ECHO_TOOLS_OPENAI = ECHO_TOOLS_ANTHROPIC.map(t => ({
  type: 'function' as const,
  function: { name: t.name, description: t.description, parameters: t.input_schema },
}));

async function callEchoTool(name: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
  try {
    switch (name) {
      case 'echo_modules': {
        const res = await echoRequest<{ modules?: Array<{ name: string; base: string; size: number }> }>({ type: 'modules' });
        return (res.modules ?? []).slice(0, 30)
          .map(m => `${m.name.padEnd(40)} base=0x${BigInt(m.base).toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(16, '0')} size=${m.size}`)
          .join('\n') || '(no modules)';
      }
      case 'echo_read': {
        const size = Math.min(Math.max(Number(input.size) || 16, 1), 256);
        const res = await echoRequest<{ data?: string }>({ type: 'read', addr: String(input.address), size });
        return res.data ?? '(no data)';
      }
      case 'echo_disassemble': {
        const count = Math.min(Math.max(Number(input.count) || 20, 1), 100);
        const res = await echoRequest<{ instructions?: Array<{ va: string | number; text: string }> }>(
          { type: 'disassemble', addr: String(input.address), count },
        );
        return (res.instructions ?? [])
          .map(i => `0x${BigInt(String(i.va)).toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(16, '0')}  ${i.text}`)
          .join('\n') || '(no instructions)';
      }
      case 'echo_sig_scan': {
        const req: Record<string, unknown> = { type: 'sig_scan_ida', pattern: String(input.pattern) };
        if (input.module) req.module = String(input.module);
        const res = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<string | number> }>(req);
        const hits = res.results ?? [];
        if (!hits.length) return 'No matches';
        const lines = hits.slice(0, 10).map(a => `0x${BigInt(String(a)).toString(16).toUpperCase()}`);
        if (hits.length > 10) lines.push(`… and ${hits.length - 10} more`);
        return lines.join('\n');
      }
      default:
        return `Unknown tool: ${name}`;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    return `Error: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
  }
}

// ── chatAgentStream — full agent loop with Echo tool use ──────────────────────

/**
 * Like chatStream but allows the LLM to call Echo tools mid-turn.
 * onToolCall fires for each tool execution so the UI can show progress.
 * Falls back to plain chatStream for Gemini/Ollama (no native tool use).
 */
export async function chatAgentStream(
  messages: ChatMessage[],
  model: string | undefined,
  onToken: (token: string) => void,
  onToolCall: (call: ToolCall) => void,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<void> {
  const { provider, modelName } = resolveModel(model);
  if (provider === 'anthropic') return _anthropicAgent(modelName, messages, onToken, onToolCall, signal);
  // OpenAI-compat providers (openai, openrouter, groq, xai, mistral) share the same agent loop
  if (provider in COMPAT_BASE) {
    const resolvedModel = (provider === 'ollama') ? modelName : _resolveCompatModel(provider, modelName);
    return _openaiAgent(provider, resolvedModel, messages, onToken, onToolCall, signal);
  }
  // dynamic providers from models.yml get the OpenAI-compat agent loop
  const dyn = getDynamicProvider(provider);
  if (dyn) return _openaiAgent(provider as Provider, modelName, messages, onToken, onToolCall, signal);
  return chatStream(messages, model, onToken, signal); // gemini/ollama fall back to plain streaming
}

type ABlock = { type: string; text?: string; id?: string; name?: string; input?: Record<string, unknown>; tool_use_id?: string; content?: string };

async function _anthropicAgent(
  model: string,
  messages: ChatMessage[],
  onToken: (t: string) => void,
  onToolCall: (call: ToolCall) => void,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<void> {
  const key = getApiKey('anthropic');
  if (!key) throw new Error('No Anthropic API key — add it in Settings → AI');
  const system = messages.filter(m => m.role === 'system').map(m => m.content).join('\n');
  let msgs: Array<{ role: 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string | ABlock[] }> = messages
    .filter(m => m.role !== 'system' && m.role !== 'tool_call')
    .map(m => ({ role: m.role as 'user' | 'assistant', content: m.content }));

  for (let loop = 0; loop < 12; loop++) {
    const resp = await fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'x-api-key': key, 'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01', 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ model, max_tokens: 8192, ...(system ? { system } : {}), messages: msgs, tools: ECHO_TOOLS_ANTHROPIC }),
      signal,
    });
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Anthropic ${resp.status}: ${await resp.text()}`);
    const json = await resp.json() as { stop_reason: string; content: ABlock[] };

    if (json.stop_reason !== 'tool_use') {
      onToken(json.content.find(c => c.type === 'text')?.text ?? '');
      return;
    }

    const toolBlocks = json.content.filter(c => c.type === 'tool_use');
    const results: ABlock[] = [];
    for (const b of toolBlocks) {
      const result = await callEchoTool(b.name!, b.input ?? {});
      onToolCall({ id: b.id!, name: b.name!, input: b.input ?? {}, result });
      results.push({ type: 'tool_result', tool_use_id: b.id!, content: result });
    }
    msgs = [...msgs, { role: 'assistant', content: json.content }, { role: 'user', content: results }];
  }
}

async function _openaiAgent(
  provider: Provider,
  model: string,
  messages: ChatMessage[],
  onToken: (t: string) => void,
  onToolCall: (call: ToolCall) => void,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<void> {
  const dynProv = getDynamicProvider(provider);
  const key = dynProv?.apiKey ?? getApiKey(provider);
  if (!key && provider !== 'ollama' && !dynProv) throw new Error(`No ${provider} API key — add it in Settings → AI`);
  const base = dynProv?.baseUrl ?? COMPAT_BASE[provider] ?? COMPAT_BASE.openai!;
  type OMsg = { role: string; content: string | null; tool_calls?: Array<{ id: string; function: { name: string; arguments: string } }>; tool_call_id?: string };
  let msgs: OMsg[] = messages
    .filter(m => m.role !== 'tool_call')
    .map(m => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content }));

  for (let loop = 0; loop < 12; loop++) {
    const resp = await fetch(`${base}/chat/completions`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: _compatHeaders(provider),
      body: JSON.stringify({ model, messages: msgs, tools: ECHO_TOOLS_OPENAI }),
      signal,
    });
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`OpenAI ${resp.status}: ${await resp.text()}`);
    const json = await resp.json() as { choices: Array<{ message: OMsg; finish_reason: string }> };
    const choice = json.choices[0];

    if (choice.finish_reason !== 'tool_calls' || !choice.message.tool_calls?.length) {
      onToken(choice.message.content ?? '');
      return;
    }

    msgs.push(choice.message);
    for (const tc of choice.message.tool_calls!) {
      let args: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      try { args = JSON.parse(tc.function.arguments) as Record<string, unknown>; } catch { /* bad JSON */ }
      const result = await callEchoTool(tc.function.name, args);
      onToolCall({ id: tc.id, name: tc.function.name, input: args, result });
      msgs.push({ role: 'tool', content: result, tool_call_id: tc.id });
    }
  }
}

// ── key test ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function testProvider(provider: Provider): Promise<string> {
  try {
    let m = MODEL_CATALOG.filter(x => x.provider === provider && x.id !== 'ollama/custom').at(-1);
    if (!m) m = MODEL_CATALOG.find(x => x.provider === provider)!;
    const reply = await complete('Reply only: OK', 'Say OK.', m.id);
    return `OK: ${reply.trim().slice(0, 60)}`;
  } catch (e) {
    return `Error: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`;
  }
}

`app/src/lib/markdownRenderer.tsx`:

```tsx
// Minimal markdown renderer — no external deps.
// Handles: code blocks, inline code, bold, italic, headers, hr, lists, paragraphs.

import type React from 'react';

type Block =
  | { kind: 'code'; lang: string; text: string }
  | { kind: 'heading'; level: number; text: string }
  | { kind: 'hr' }
  | { kind: 'paragraph'; text: string }
  | { kind: 'list'; items: string[]; ordered: boolean };

function parseBlocks(md: string): Block[] {
  const blocks: Block[] = [];
  const lines = md.split('\n');
  let i = 0;

  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i];

    // fenced code block
    if (line.startsWith('```')) {
      const lang = line.slice(3).trim();
      const codeLines: string[] = [];
      i++;
      while (i < lines.length && !lines[i].startsWith('```')) {
        codeLines.push(lines[i]);
        i++;
      }
      i++; // consume closing ```
      blocks.push({ kind: 'code', lang, text: codeLines.join('\n') });
      continue;
    }

    // heading
    const hm = line.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.*)/);
    if (hm) {
      blocks.push({ kind: 'heading', level: hm[1].length, text: hm[2] });
      i++; continue;
    }

    // hr
    if (/^[-*_]{3,}$/.test(line.trim())) {
      blocks.push({ kind: 'hr' });
      i++; continue;
    }

    // list
    if (/^(\s*[-*+]|\s*\d+\.)\s/.test(line)) {
      const ordered = /^\s*\d+\./.test(line);
      const items: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && /^(\s*[-*+]|\s*\d+\.)\s/.test(lines[i])) {
        items.push(lines[i].replace(/^\s*(?:[-*+]|\d+\.)\s+/, ''));
        i++;
      }
      blocks.push({ kind: 'list', items, ordered });
      continue;
    }

    // empty line — skip
    if (!line.trim()) { i++; continue; }

    // paragraph — collect until blank line or special line
    const paraLines: string[] = [];
    while (
      i < lines.length &&
      lines[i].trim() &&
      !lines[i].startsWith('```') &&
      !lines[i].match(/^#{1,6}\s/) &&
      !/^[-*_]{3,}$/.test(lines[i].trim())
    ) {
      paraLines.push(lines[i]);
      i++;
    }
    if (paraLines.length > 0) {
      blocks.push({ kind: 'paragraph', text: paraLines.join('\n') });
    }
  }
  return blocks;
}

// Inline formatting: bold, italic, inline code
function renderInline(text: string): React.ReactNode[] {
  const parts: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  // split on `code`, **bold**, *italic*
  const re = /(`[^`]+`|\*\*[^*]+\*\*|\*[^*]+\*)/g;
  let last = 0;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  let key = 0;
  while ((m = re.exec(text)) !== null) {
    if (m.index > last) parts.push(text.slice(last, m.index));
    const s = m[0];
    if (s.startsWith('`')) {
      parts.push(<code key={key++} style={{ background: 'var(--bg-3)', padding: '1px 4px', borderRadius: 3, fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontSize: '0.9em' }}>{s.slice(1, -1)}</code>);
    } else if (s.startsWith('**')) {
      parts.push(<strong key={key++}>{s.slice(2, -2)}</strong>);
    } else {
      parts.push(<em key={key++}>{s.slice(1, -1)}</em>);
    }
    last = m.index + s.length;
  }
  if (last < text.length) parts.push(text.slice(last));
  return parts;
}

export function Markdown({ children }: { children: string }) {
  const blocks = parseBlocks(children);
  return (
    <div className="md-body">
      {blocks.map((b, i) => {
        switch (b.kind) {
          case 'code':
            return (
              <pre key={i} className="md-code" data-lang={b.lang || undefined}>
                <code>{b.text}</code>
              </pre>
            );
          case 'heading': {
            const Tag = `h${Math.min(b.level + 1, 6)}` as 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' | 'h5' | 'h6';
            return <Tag key={i} className="md-heading">{renderInline(b.text)}</Tag>;
          }
          case 'hr':
            return <hr key={i} className="md-hr" />;
          case 'list':
            return b.ordered
              ? <ol key={i} className="md-list">{b.items.map((it, j) => <li key={j}>{renderInline(it)}</li>)}</ol>
              : <ul key={i} className="md-list">{b.items.map((it, j) => <li key={j}>{renderInline(it)}</li>)}</ul>;
          case 'paragraph':
            return (
              <p key={i} className="md-para">
                {b.text.split('\n').flatMap((line, j, arr) => {
                  const content = renderInline(line);
                  return j < arr.length - 1 ? [...content, <br key={`br-${j}`} />] : content;
                })}
              </p>
            );
        }
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// app/src/lib/mcpTools.ts
// Everything the app can do, as MCP tools. The ui connects to the relay's
// /agent-app lane, registers these with a hello frame and runs them when an

type Args = Record<string, unknown>;
type Tool = { name: string; description: string; inputSchema: object; run: (a: Args) => Promise<unknown> };

const addr = (v: unknown): number => {
  const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : Number(BigInt(String(v).trim()));
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) throw new Error(`bad address ${String(v)}`);
  return n;
};
const str = { type: "string" } as const;
const int = { type: "integer" } as const;
const address = { type: "string", description: "hex, e.g. 0x7ff600001000" } as const;
const kWidths = ["i8", "u8", "i16", "u16", "i32", "u32", "i64", "u64", "f32", "f64"];
const obj = (properties: object, required: string[] = []) => ({ type: "object", properties, required });
const page = <T,>(items: T[], a: Args, dflt = 200) => {
  const offset = Number(a.offset ?? 0);
  const limit = Number(a.limit ?? dflt);
  return { total: items.length, offset, items: items.slice(offset, offset + limit) };
};

// ── caches keyed by the attached image base ──────────────────────────────────

type Fn = { va: number; size: number; name?: string };
let fnCache: { key: string; fns: Fn[] } | null = null;
let strCache: { key: string; strings: Array<{ va: number; text: string; utf16: boolean }> } | null = null;
export function clearMcpCaches(): void { fnCache = null; strCache = null; }

async function functions(): Promise<Fn[]> {
  const generation = currentTargetGeneration();
  const m = await mainModule();
  if (!m) throw new Error("Echo is not attached");
  const key = `${m.pid}:${m.name}:${m.base}:${m.size}`;
  if (fnCache?.key === key) {
    const renamed = new Map(useDisasm.getState().functions.filter(f => f.symbol).map(f => [f.va, f.symbol!]));
    return fnCache.fns.map(f => renamed.has(f.va) ? { ...f, name: renamed.get(f.va) } : f);
  }
  const [{ functions: fns }, pe] = await Promise.all([
    call<{ functions: Fn[] }>("disasm", "functions"),
    call<{ exports: Array<{ name: string; rva: number }> }>("disasm", "pe").catch(() => ({ exports: [] })),
  ]);
  const exportAt = new Map(pe.exports.map((e) => [m.base + e.rva, e.name]));
  const renamed = new Map(useDisasm.getState().functions.filter((f) => f.symbol).map((f) => [f.va, f.symbol!]));
  if (generation !== currentTargetGeneration()) throw new Error("Target changed while indexing functions");
  fnCache = { key, fns: fns.map((f) => ({ ...f, name: exportAt.get(f.va) })) };
  return fnCache.fns.map(f => renamed.has(f.va) ? { ...f, name: renamed.get(f.va) } : f);
}

async function moduleOf(va: number): Promise<{ name: string; base: number; size: number }> {
  const { modules } = await call<{ modules: Array<{ name: string; base: number; size: number }> }>("target", "modules");
  const m = modules.find((x) => va >= x.base && va < x.base + x.size);
  if (!m) throw new Error(`${hexAddr(va)} is not inside a module`);
  return m;
}


// ── signatures ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Byte offsets in one instruction that change between builds: rel32 branch targets and rip displacements. */
export function volatileBytes(i: { address: string; length: number; bytes: string; text: string }): Set<number> {
  const out = new Set<number>();
  const va = num(i.address);
  const bytes = parseHex(i.bytes);
  const [mn, op] = i.text.trim().split(/\s+/, 2);
  if ((mn === "call" || mn === "jmp" || /^j[a-z]+$/.test(mn)) && op && /^0x[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(op)) {
    const width = i.length >= 5 ? 4 : 1;
    for (let k = i.length - width; k < i.length; k++) out.add(k);
    return out;
  }
  // [rip+0x10] / [rip-0x10] as Zydis prints relative, or the resolved absolute target
  const t = ripTarget(va, i.length, i.text);
  const disp = t === null ? null : t - (va + i.length);
  if (disp === null || disp < -0x80000000 || disp > 0x7fffffff) return out;
  const le = [disp & 0xff, (disp >>> 8) & 0xff, (disp >>> 16) & 0xff, (disp >>> 24) & 0xff];
  for (let k = 0; k + 4 <= bytes.length; k++) {
    if (le.every((b, j) => bytes[k + j] === b)) { for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) out.add(k + j); break; }
  }
  return out;
}

async function makeSignature(va: number, maxBytes: number) {
  const m = await moduleOf(va);
  const r = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ address: string; length: number; bytes: string; text: string }> }>({
    type: "disassemble", address: hexAddr(va), size: Math.min(maxBytes + 16, 0x1000),
  });
  const tokens: string[] = [];
  let hits: string[] = [];
  for (const insn of r.results ?? []) {
    const wild = volatileBytes(insn);
    parseHex(insn.bytes).forEach((b, k) => tokens.push(wild.has(k) ? "?" : b.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(2, "0")));
    if (tokens.length > maxBytes) break;
    if (tokens.filter((t) => t !== "?").length < 5) continue;
    const pattern = tokens.join(" ");
    hits = (await echoRequest<{ results?: string[] }>({ type: "sig_scan_ida", module: m.name, pattern, find_all: true })).results ?? [];
    if (hits.length === 1 && num(hits[0]) === va) return { module: m.name, signature: pattern, length: tokens.length, unique: true };
  }
  return { module: m.name, signature: tokens.join(" "), length: tokens.length, unique: false, matches: hits.length };
}

// ── typed reads ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function readValue(a: Args) {
  const at = addr(a.address);
  const type = String(a.type ?? "u64");
  const count = Math.min(Number(a.count ?? 1), 4096);
  if (type === "utf8" || type === "utf16") {
    const r = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; data: string }>({ type: "read", address: hexAddr(at), size: Number(a.length ?? 256) * (type === "utf16" ? 2 : 1) });
    if (!r.success) throw new Error("read failed");
    const text = new TextDecoder(type === "utf16" ? "utf-16le" : "utf-8").decode(parseHex(r.data));
    return { address: hexAddr(at), text: text.split("\0")[0] };
  }
  if (type === "bytes") {
    const r = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; data: string }>({ type: "read", address: hexAddr(at), size: Number(a.length ?? 64) });
    if (!r.success) throw new Error("read failed");
    return { address: hexAddr(at), hex: r.data };
  }
  const width = type === "ptr" ? "u64" : type;
  const size = widthBytes(width);
  const r = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; data: string }>({ type: "read", address: hexAddr(at), size: size * count });
  if (!r.success) throw new Error("read failed");
  const b = parseHex(r.data);
  const values = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    const part = b.subarray(i * size, i * size + size);
    return type === "ptr" ? `0x${new DataView(part.buffer, part.byteOffset, part.byteLength).getBigUint64(0, true).toString(16)}` : decodeText(part, width);
  });
  return { address: hexAddr(at), type, values };
}

async function pointerChain(a: Args) {
  let at = a.module ? (await call<{ modules: Array<{ name: string; base: number }> }>("target", "modules")).modules
    .find((m) => m.name.toLowerCase() === String(a.module).toLowerCase())?.base : addr(a.base);
  if (!at) throw new Error(`module ${String(a.module)} not loaded`);
  const offsets = ((a.offsets as unknown[]) ?? []).map((o) => Number(BigInt(String(o))));
  const hops: Array<{ at: string; value: string }> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < offsets.length; i++) {
    at += offsets[i];
    if (i === offsets.length - 1) break; // the last offset is a field, not a pointer
    const r = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; data: string }>({ type: "read", address: hexAddr(at), size: 8 });
    if (!r.success) return { resolved: null, hops, failed_at: hexAddr(at) };
    const p = u64(parseHex(r.data), 0);
    hops.push({ at: hexAddr(at), value: hexAddr(p) });
    at = p;
  }
  return { resolved: hexAddr(at), hops };
}

// ── unreal ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ue(): Unreal {
  const u = useUnreal.getState().ue;
  if (!u) throw new Error("run unreal_index first");
  return u;
}

function findObj(u: Unreal, a: Args): UObj {
  const q = String(a.path ?? a.name ?? "");
  const o = u.objs.find((x) => ["Class", "ScriptStruct", "Enum"].includes(x.cls) && (u.path(x) === q || x.name === q));
  if (!o) throw new Error(`no class, struct or enum named ${q}`);
  return o;
}

// ── overlay / deobfuscation argument mapping ────────────────────────────────

const rvaArg = (v: unknown): number => (v === undefined ? 0 : Number(BigInt(String(v))));

function overlayConfig(a: Args): OverlayConfig {
  const d = defaultOverlayConfig;
  return {
    process: String(a.process ?? useEngine.getState().target.name ?? d.process),
    entityListRva: rvaArg(a.entity_list_rva ?? d.entityListRva),
    listDeref: a.list_deref === undefined ? d.listDeref : a.list_deref !== false,
    entityCount: Number(a.entity_count ?? d.entityCount),
    entityStride: Number(a.entity_stride ?? d.entityStride),
    positionOffset: rvaArg(a.position_offset ?? d.positionOffset),
    healthOffset: rvaArg(a.health_offset ?? d.healthOffset),
    teamOffset: rvaArg(a.team_offset ?? d.teamOffset),
    localTeam: Number(a.local_team ?? d.localTeam),
    viewMatrixRva: rvaArg(a.view_matrix_rva ?? d.viewMatrixRva),
    unityCoords: a.unity_coords === true,
    boxWidth: Number(a.box_width ?? d.boxWidth),
    boxHeight: Number(a.box_height ?? d.boxHeight),
  };
}

const overlayProps = {
  process: str, entity_list_rva: address, list_deref: { type: "boolean" }, entity_count: int,
  entity_stride: int, position_offset: address, health_offset: address, team_offset: address,
  local_team: int, view_matrix_rva: address, unity_coords: { type: "boolean" },
  box_width: { type: "number" }, box_height: { type: "number" },
};

async function deobfFunctions(): Promise<FnRow[]> {
  const fns = await functions();
  return fns.map((f) => ({ va: f.va, size: f.size, name: f.name }));
}

  {
    name: "watch_wait",
    description: "Block until any watched value changes from its current reading, or the target detaches/reconnects. timeout_ms defaults to 30000, max 60000. Returns the changed entries (array), {event:'detached'|'reconnected'} on state change, or [] on timeout. Add watches first with the watch tool.",
    inputSchema: obj({ timeout_ms: int }),
    run: (a) => {
      const timeout = Math.min(Number(a.timeout_ms ?? 30_000), 60_000);
      const ws = useWatch.getState();
      const snap = new Map([...ws.values].map(([id, v]) => [id, v.text]));
      if (!snap.size) return Promise.resolve({ note: "no watches; add with watch action=add" });
      let wasAttached = ws.attached;
      return new Promise<unknown>((resolve) => {
        let done = false;
        const finish = (r: unknown) => { if (done) return; done = true; clearTimeout(t); off(); resolve(r); };
        const t = setTimeout(() => finish([]), timeout);
        const off = onEvent("watch.values", ({ attached, values: vals }) => {
          if (!attached && wasAttached) { wasAttached = false; return finish({ event: "detached" }); }
          if (attached && !wasAttached) { wasAttached = true; return finish({ event: "reconnected" }); }
          const changed = vals.filter((v) => snap.has(v.id) && snap.get(v.id) !== v.text);
          if (changed.length) finish(changed.map((v) => ({ id: v.id, address: hexAddr(v.addr), value: v.text })));
        });
      });
    },
  },

      if (!insns.length) throw new Error("No function selected in the disassembly view");
      const fn = functions.find(f => f.va === selected);
      let rawBytes: Uint8Array | undefined;
      if (fn?.size) {
        try {
          const r = await echoRequest<{ success?: boolean; data?: string }>({ type: "read", address: hexAddr(fn.va), size: fn.size });
          if (r.success && typeof r.data === "string") rawBytes = Uint8Array.from(r.data.match(/../g) ?? [], b => parseInt(b, 16));
        } catch { /* entropy skipped */ }
      }
      const result = xrayInsns(insns, rawBytes);
      return {
        score: result.score,
        entropy: result.entropy,
        ropGadgets: result.ropGadgets.length,
        antiDebug: result.antiDebug.map(h => ({ address: hexAddr(h.address), pattern: h.pattern })),
        indirectBranches: result.indirectBranches.map(b => ({ address: hexAddr(b.address), kind: b.kind, text: b.text })),
        xorDecryptors: result.xorDecryptors.slice(0, 20).map(x => ({ address: hexAddr(x.address), text: x.text })),
        cryptoHits: result.cryptoHits.map(c => ({ address: hexAddr(c.address), name: c.name })),
      };
    },
  },

// ── bridge ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

let started = false;

/** Keep a socket to the relay's /agent-app lane open for the app's lifetime. */
export function startAppBridge(): void {
  if (started) return;
  started = true;
  let generation = 0;
  let current: WebSocket | undefined;
  let retry: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  const connect = () => {
    const epoch = generation;
    let ws: WebSocket;
    try {
      ws = new WebSocket(getRelayUrl().replace(/^http/, "ws").replace(/\/rpc\/?$/, "/agent-app"));
    } catch {
      // a bad relay url (or a csp refusal, which webkitgtk throws) must not take the ui down with it
      retry = setTimeout(connect, 3000);
      return;
    }
    current = ws;
    ws.onopen = () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({
      type: "hello",
      tools: tools.map(({ name, description, inputSchema }) => ({ name, description, inputSchema })),
    }));
    ws.onmessage = async (e) => {
      const m = JSON.parse(String(e.data)) as { type: string; id: number; tool: string; arguments?: Args };
      if (m.type !== "app") return;
      const tool = tools.find((t) => t.name === m.tool);
      try {
        if (!tool) throw new Error(`unknown tool ${m.tool}`);
        const result = await tool.run(m.arguments ?? {});
        if (epoch === generation && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: "app_result", id: m.id, result }));
      } catch (err) {
        if (epoch === generation && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: "error", id: m.id, code: "ToolError", message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) }));
      }
    };
    ws.onclose = () => { if (epoch === generation) retry = setTimeout(connect, 3000); };
  };
  onRelayUrlChange(() => {
    generation++;
    if (retry) clearTimeout(retry);
    current?.close();
    connect();
  });
  connect();
}

`app/src/lib/mem.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/mem.ts
// Remote memory over Echo's read_batch: a page cache for walking structures
// and a batched small-read helper for scattered objects.

import { echoRequest } from "./echo";

export const hexAddr = (n: number): string => `0x${n.toString(16)}`;
export const num = (s: string): number => Number(BigInt(s));

export function parseHex(s: string): Uint8Array {
  const out = new Uint8Array(s.length >> 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] = parseInt(s.substr(i * 2, 2), 16);
  return out;
}

export const kPage = 0x1000;
export const kChunk = 0x10000; // read_batch per-entry limit
const kBatch = 16;

/** Pages fetched once per operation through read_batch; unreadable pages stay null. */
export class Mem {
  private pages = new Map<number, Uint8Array | null>();

  async prefetch(addr: number, len: number): Promise<void> {
    const want: number[] = [];
    for (let p = Math.floor(addr / kPage) * kPage; p < addr + len; p += kPage) {
      if (!this.pages.has(p)) want.push(p);
    }
    // coalesce adjacent pages into 64 KiB reads
    const reads: Array<{ address: number; size: number }> = [];
    for (const p of want) {
      const last = reads[reads.length - 1];
      if (last && last.address + last.size === p && last.size < kChunk) last.size += kPage;
      else reads.push({ address: p, size: kPage });
    }
    const retry: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < reads.length; i += kBatch) {
      const slice = reads.slice(i, i + kBatch);
      const r = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ success: boolean; data: string }> }>({
        type: "read_batch",
        reads: slice.map((x) => ({ address: hexAddr(x.address), size: x.size })),
      });
      slice.forEach((x, j) => {
        const res = r.results?.[j];
        const data = res?.success && res.data.length === x.size * 2 ? parseHex(res.data) : null;
        for (let off = 0; off < x.size; off += kPage) {
          // one unmapped page fails the whole read, so give its neighbours their own try
          if (!data && x.size > kPage) retry.push(x.address + off);
          else this.pages.set(x.address + off, data ? data.subarray(off, off + kPage) : null);
        }
      });
    }
    const pages = await readMany(retry.map((addr) => ({ addr, len: kPage })));
    retry.forEach((addr, i) => this.pages.set(addr, pages[i]));
  }

  /** Bytes at addr, or null when any covered page is unreadable. */
  async bytes(addr: number, len: number): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
    await this.prefetch(addr, len);
    const out = new Uint8Array(len);
    for (let done = 0; done < len; ) {
      const a = addr + done;
      const page = Math.floor(a / kPage) * kPage;
      const data = this.pages.get(page);
      if (!data) return null;
      const n = Math.min(len - done, page + kPage - a);
      out.set(data.subarray(a - page, a - page + n), done);
      done += n;
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** A whole range with unreadable pages zero filled, and how many there were. */
  async image(addr: number, len: number): Promise<{ bytes: Uint8Array; missing: number }> {
    await this.prefetch(addr, len);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(len);
    let missing = 0;
    for (let off = 0; off < len; ) {
      const current = addr + off;
      const pageAddr = Math.floor(current / kPage) * kPage;
      const within = current - pageAddr;
      const count = Math.min(kPage - within, len - off);
      const page = this.pages.get(pageAddr);
      if (page) bytes.set(page.subarray(within, within + count), off);
      else missing++;
      off += count;
    }
    return { bytes, missing };
  }

  async cstr(addr: number, max = 256): Promise<string> {
    const b = await this.bytes(addr, max) ?? (await this.bytes(addr, kPage - (addr % kPage)));
    if (!b) return "";
    const end = b.indexOf(0);
    return new TextDecoder("latin1").decode(end < 0 ? b : b.subarray(0, end));
  }
}

export const u16 = (b: Uint8Array, o: number) => b[o] | (b[o + 1] << 8);
export const u32 = (b: Uint8Array, o: number) => (b[o] | (b[o + 1] << 8) | (b[o + 2] << 16) | (b[o + 3] << 24)) >>> 0;

/** Many small scattered reads, 64 per read_batch; unreadable entries are null. */
export async function readMany(
  reads: Array<{ addr: number; len: number }>,
  progress?: (done: number) => void,
): Promise<Array<Uint8Array | null>> {
  const out: Array<Uint8Array | null> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < reads.length; i += 64) {
    if (i % 0x1000 === 0) progress?.(i);
    const slice = reads.slice(i, i + 64);
    const r = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ success: boolean; data: string }> }>({
      type: "read_batch",
      reads: slice.map((x) => ({ address: hexAddr(x.addr), size: x.len })),
    });
    slice.forEach((x, j) => {
      const res = r.results?.[j];
      out.push(res?.success && res.data.length === x.len * 2 ? parseHex(res.data) : null);
    });
  }
  return out;
}

export const u64 = (b: Uint8Array, o: number): number => u32(b, o) + u32(b, o + 4) * 2 ** 32;

/** Address a [rip±disp] / [0xabs] operand in Zydis text refers to, or null. */
export function ripTarget(va: number, length: number, text: string): number | null {
  const rel = /\[rip([+-])0x([0-9a-f]+)\]/i.exec(text);
  if (rel) return va + length + (rel[1] === "-" ? -1 : 1) * parseInt(rel[2], 16);
  const abs = /\[0x([0-9a-f]{6,})\]/i.exec(text);
  return abs ? parseInt(abs[1], 16) : null;
}

`app/src/lib/memoryTools.ts`:

```ts
import { echoRequest } from "./echo";
import { hexAddr, parseHex } from "./mem";

const userTop = 0x7fffffffffff;
export type FieldType = "i8" | "u8" | "i16" | "u16" | "i32" | "u32" | "i64" | "u64" | "f32" | "f64" | "ptr";
const sizes: Record<FieldType, number> = { i8: 1, u8: 1, i16: 2, u16: 2, i32: 4, u32: 4, i64: 8, u64: 8, f32: 4, f64: 8, ptr: 8 };
export type Field = { name: string; type: FieldType; offset: number };
export function parseAddress(text: string, signed = false): number {
  const s = text.trim();
  if (!(signed ? /^-?(?:0x)?[0-9a-f]+$/i : /^(?:0x)?[0-9a-f]+$/i).test(s)) throw new Error(`Invalid hexadecimal address or offset: ${text}`);
  const negative = s.startsWith("-");
  const value = BigInt(`0x${s.replace(/^-?(?:0x)?/i, "")}`) * (negative ? -1n : 1n);
  if (value > BigInt(userTop) || value < -BigInt(userTop)) throw new Error("Address or offset outside user memory");
  return Number(value);
}
function checkedAddress(addr: number): number {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(addr) || addr < 0 || addr > userTop) throw new Error("Resolved address outside user memory");
  return addr;
}
export function parseFields(text: string): Field[] {
  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/).map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (lines.length > 64) throw new Error("Maximum 64 fields");
  return lines.map((line, i) => {
    const parts = line.split(":").map(x => x.trim());
    if (parts.length !== 3 || !parts[0] || !Object.hasOwn(sizes, parts[1])) throw new Error(`Invalid field on line ${i + 1}; use name:type:hex-offset`);
    return { name: parts[0], type: parts[1] as FieldType, offset: parseAddress(parts[2], true) };
  });
}
export async function resolvePointerChain(base: number, offsets: number[]): Promise<{ address: number; hops: Array<{ address: number; value: number }> }> {
  if (offsets.length > 64) throw new Error("Maximum 64 pointer offsets");
  let at = checkedAddress(base); const hops: Array<{ address: number; value: number }> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < offsets.length; i++) {
    at = checkedAddress(at + offsets[i]);
    if (i === offsets.length - 1) break;
    const r = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; data: string }>({ type: "read", address: hexAddr(at), size: 8 });
    if (!r.success || r.data.length !== 16) throw new Error(`Cannot read pointer at ${hexAddr(at)}`);
    const bytes = parseHex(r.data), value = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength).getBigUint64(0, true);
    if (value > BigInt(userTop) || value === 0n) throw new Error(`Invalid pointer at ${hexAddr(at)}`);
    hops.push({ address: at, value: Number(value) }); at = Number(value);
  }
  return { address: at, hops };
}
function value(view: DataView, type: FieldType): string {
  switch (type) {
    case "i8": return String(view.getInt8(0)); case "u8": return String(view.getUint8(0));
    case "i16": return String(view.getInt16(0, true)); case "u16": return String(view.getUint16(0, true));
    case "i32": return String(view.getInt32(0, true)); case "u32": return String(view.getUint32(0, true));
    case "i64": return String(view.getBigInt64(0, true)); case "u64": return String(view.getBigUint64(0, true));
    case "ptr": return `0x${view.getBigUint64(0, true).toString(16)}`;
    case "f32": return String(view.getFloat32(0, true)); case "f64": return String(view.getFloat64(0, true));
  }
}
export async function readStructure(base: number, fields: Field[]): Promise<Array<Field & { address: number; value: string | null }>> {
  if (fields.length > 64) throw new Error("Maximum 64 fields");
  const items = fields.map(f => ({ ...f, address: checkedAddress(base + f.offset) }));
  const r = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ success: boolean; data: string }> }>({ type: "read_batch", reads: items.map(f => ({ address: hexAddr(f.address), size: sizes[f.type] })) });
  return items.map((f, i) => {
    const row = r.results?.[i];
    if (!row?.success || row.data.length !== sizes[f.type] * 2) return { ...f, value: null };
    const bytes = parseHex(row.data);
    return { ...f, value: value(new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength), f.type) };
  });
}

`app/src/lib/menu.ts`:

```ts
// Echo overlay menu-control lane.
//
// This is the same ui_list / ui_get / ui_set contract used by
// github.com/Jozkah/angel-menu-mcp. The desktop relay hosts the lane on
// ws://127.0.0.1:9000/agent-ui, so an overlay that includes angel-menu-control.as
// can expose its own controls without running a second MCP server.

import { echoRequest } from "./echo";

export type MenuKind = "check" | "slider" | "combo" | "multi" | "color" | string;

export type MenuControl = {
  name: string;
  label?: string;
  kind: MenuKind;
  value: unknown;
  writable?: boolean;
  danger?: boolean;
  tab?: string;
  subtab?: string;
  category?: string;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  options?: string[];
};

export type MenuListReply = {
  count?: number;
  results?: MenuControl[];
};

function requireControl(reply: Partial<MenuControl> & { name?: string }): MenuControl {
  if (!reply.name || typeof reply.name !== "string") throw new Error("Echo menu returned an invalid control");
  return {
    name: reply.name,
    label: typeof reply.label === "string" ? reply.label : reply.name,
    kind: typeof reply.kind === "string" ? reply.kind : "check",
    value: reply.value,
    writable: reply.writable !== false,
    danger: reply.danger === true,
    tab: typeof reply.tab === "string" ? reply.tab : "",
    subtab: typeof reply.subtab === "string" ? reply.subtab : "",
    category: typeof reply.category === "string" ? reply.category : "",
    min: typeof reply.min === "number" ? reply.min : undefined,
    max: typeof reply.max === "number" ? reply.max : undefined,
    step: typeof reply.step === "number" ? reply.step : undefined,
    options: Array.isArray(reply.options) ? reply.options.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === "string") : undefined,
  };
}

/** List the controls registered by the connected overlay script. */
export async function listMenuControls(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<MenuControl[]> {
  const reply = await echoRequest<MenuListReply>({ type: "ui_list" }, signal);
  return (reply.results ?? []).map(requireControl);
}

/** Read one control and its current value. */
export async function getMenuControl(name: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<MenuControl> {
  const reply = await echoRequest<Partial<MenuControl> & { name?: string }>({ type: "ui_get", name }, signal);
  return requireControl(reply);
}

/**
 * Set one control. Checkboxes use booleans; sliders and combo boxes use
 * integers. Danger controls remain protected by the overlay's human ARM gate.
 */
export async function setMenuControl(
  name: string,
  value: boolean | number,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<MenuControl> {
  if (typeof value !== "boolean" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
    throw new Error("Menu values must be a boolean or an integer");
  }
  const reply = await echoRequest<Partial<MenuControl> & { name?: string }>({ type: "ui_set", name, value }, signal);
  return requireControl(reply);
}

`app/src/lib/minidump.ts`:

```ts
import type { CapturePage, RuntimeCapture } from './runtimeCapture';

export type DumpRegion = { address: number; size: number; fileOffset: number };
export function minidumpRegions(bytes: Uint8Array): DumpRegion[] {
  const v = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
  const check = (offset: number, size: number) => {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(offset) || offset < 0 || !Number.isSafeInteger(size) || size < 0 || offset + size > bytes.length) throw new Error('Truncated minidump');
  };
  const number64 = (offset: number) => { check(offset, 8); const n = Number(v.getBigUint64(offset, true)); if (!Number.isSafeInteger(n)) throw new Error('Minidump address exceeds safe precision'); return n; };
  check(0, 32);
  if (v.getUint32(0, true) !== 0x504d444d) throw new Error('Not a minidump');
  const count = v.getUint32(8, true), directory = v.getUint32(12, true);
  if (count > 4096) throw new Error('Too many minidump streams');
  check(directory, count * 12);
  const regions: DumpRegion[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const entry = directory + i * 12, type = v.getUint32(entry, true), length = v.getUint32(entry + 4, true), offset = v.getUint32(entry + 8, true);
    if (type !== 5 && type !== 9) continue;
    check(offset, length);
    if (type === 5) {
      if (length < 4) throw new Error('Truncated memory list');
      const n = v.getUint32(offset, true);
      if (n > 100000 || n > Math.floor((length - 4) / 16)) throw new Error('Invalid memory list');
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        const item = offset + 4 + j * 16;
        regions.push({ address: number64(item), size: v.getUint32(item + 8, true), fileOffset: v.getUint32(item + 12, true) });
      }
    } else {
      if (length < 16) throw new Error('Truncated memory64 list');
      const n = number64(offset), base = number64(offset + 8);
      if (n > 100000 || n > Math.floor((length - 16) / 16)) throw new Error('Invalid memory64 list');
      let fileOffset = base;
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        const item = offset + 16 + j * 16, size = number64(item + 8);
        regions.push({ address: number64(item), size, fileOffset });
        fileOffset += size;
      }
    }
  }
  for (const region of regions) {
    check(region.fileOffset, region.size);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(region.address + region.size)) throw new Error('Invalid minidump memory range');
  }
  return regions.filter(region => region.size > 0);
}

/**
 * Stitch nearby regions into merged captures. Regions with gaps ≤ maxGap share
 * a capture (gap pages are null). Groups >128 MiB span are split individually.
 */
export function stitchMinidumpRegions(bytes: Uint8Array, regions: DumpRegion[], name: string, maxGap = 256 * 1024): RuntimeCapture[] {
  if (regions.length === 0) return [];
  const sorted = [...regions].filter(r => r.size > 0).sort((a, b) => a.address - b.address);
  const groups: DumpRegion[][] = [];
  let cur: DumpRegion[] = [sorted[0]];
  for (let i = 1; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    const prev = cur[cur.length - 1];
    const gap = sorted[i].address - (prev.address + prev.size);
    if (gap <= maxGap) cur.push(sorted[i]);
    else { groups.push(cur); cur = [sorted[i]]; }
  }
  groups.push(cur);
  const captures: RuntimeCapture[] = [];
  for (const group of groups) {
    const start = group[0].address;
    const end = group[group.length - 1].address + group[group.length - 1].size;
    const total = end - start;
    if (total > 128 * 1024 * 1024 || !Number.isSafeInteger(end)) {
      for (const r of group) { try { captures.push(openMinidumpRegion(bytes, r, name)); } catch { /* skip bad region */ } }
      continue;
    }
    const pages: CapturePage[] = [];
    for (let offset = 0; offset < total; offset += 4096) {
      const pageAddr = start + offset;
      const pageSize = Math.min(4096, total - offset);
      const region = group.find(r =>
        pageAddr >= r.address && pageAddr + pageSize <= r.address + r.size &&
        r.fileOffset + (pageAddr - r.address) + pageSize <= bytes.length
      );
      if (region) {
        const fileOff = region.fileOffset + (pageAddr - region.address);
        pages.push({ address: pageAddr, size: pageSize, data: Array.from(bytes.subarray(fileOff, fileOff + pageSize), x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('') });
      } else {
        pages.push({ address: pageAddr, size: pageSize, data: null });
      }
    }
    captures.push({ format: 'echo-runtime-capture-v1', name, target: name, captured: '', address: start, size: total, pages });
  }
  return captures;
}

export function openMinidumpRegion(bytes: Uint8Array, region: DumpRegion, name: string): RuntimeCapture {
  if (region.size < 1 || region.size > 16 * 1024 * 1024 || region.fileOffset < 0 || region.fileOffset + region.size > bytes.length || region.address <= 0 || !Number.isSafeInteger(region.address + region.size)) throw new Error('Unsupported memory region');
  const pages: CapturePage[] = [];
  for (let offset = 0; offset < region.size; offset += 4096) {
    const part = bytes.subarray(region.fileOffset + offset, region.fileOffset + Math.min(region.size, offset + 4096));
    pages.push({ address: region.address + offset, size: part.length, data: Array.from(part, x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('') });
  }
  return { format: 'echo-runtime-capture-v1', name, target: name, captured: '', address: region.address, size: region.size, pages };
}

`app/src/lib/modelsYml.ts`:

```ts
// Load OMP models.yml and register its providers dynamically in the LLM router.
// The file is gitignored; path comes from localStorage or VITE_MODELS_YML_PATH.

import { invoke } from '@tauri-apps/api/core';
import { isTauri } from './endpoint';
import { MODEL_CATALOG, registerDynamicProvider, clearDynamicProviders, type ModelEntry } from './llm';

const kPath = 'echo-reverse-models-yml-path';

// ── OMP schema types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type OmpModel = {
  id: string;
  name?: string;
  reasoning?: boolean;
  input?: string[];
  contextWindow?: number;
  maxTokens?: number;
  supportsTools?: boolean;
};

export type OmpProvider = {
  baseUrl?: string;
  api?: string;
  apiKey?: string;
  auth?: string;
  compat?: Record<string, boolean | string>;
  models?: OmpModel[];
};

export type OmpModels = { providers: Record<string, OmpProvider> };

// ── path config ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const _envDefault: string = (import.meta.env as Record<string, unknown>)['VITE_MODELS_YML_PATH'] as string ?? '';

export function getModelsYmlPath(): string {
  return localStorage.getItem(kPath) ?? _envDefault;
}
export function setModelsYmlPath(path: string): void {
  if (path.trim()) localStorage.setItem(kPath, path.trim());
  else localStorage.removeItem(kPath);
}

// ── file reading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function readFileText(path: string): Promise<string> {
  if (!isTauri()) throw new Error('File system access requires the desktop app');
  return invoke<string>('read_text_file', { path });
}

// ── YAML parser (OMP models.yml format) ───────────────────────────────────────
// Handles the specific structure of OMP models.yml without a generic YAML library.

function setModelField(m: OmpModel, key: string, val: string) {
  switch (key) {
    case 'id':            m.id = val; break;
    case 'name':          m.name = val; break;
    case 'reasoning':     m.reasoning = val === 'true'; break;
    case 'contextWindow': m.contextWindow = parseInt(val) || 0; break;
    case 'maxTokens':     m.maxTokens = parseInt(val) || 0; break;
    case 'supportsTools': m.supportsTools = val === 'true'; break;
    case 'input':         m.input = val.replace(/[\[\]\s]/g, '').split(',').filter(Boolean); break;
  }
}

export function parseOmpYaml(text: string): OmpModels {
  const result: OmpModels = { providers: {} };
  let provId = '';
  let inCompat = false;
  let inModels = false;
  let curModel: OmpModel | null = null;

  for (const raw of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const trim = raw.trim();
    if (!trim || trim.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const indent = raw.length - raw.trimStart().length;

    if (indent === 0) {
      // top-level key ("providers:") — reset context
      provId = ''; inCompat = false; inModels = false; curModel = null;
      continue;
    }

    // indent=2: provider name key
    if (indent === 2 && !trim.startsWith('-')) {
      provId = trim.replace(/:$/, '').replace(/^"|"$/g, '');
      result.providers[provId] = {};
      inCompat = false; inModels = false; curModel = null;
      continue;
    }

    if (!provId) continue;
    const prov = result.providers[provId]!;

    // indent=4: provider-level field
    if (indent === 4 && !trim.startsWith('-')) {
      const ci = trim.indexOf(':');
      const key = trim.slice(0, ci).trim();
      const val = trim.slice(ci + 1).trim();
      inCompat = false; inModels = false; curModel = null;

      if      (key === 'compat')  { inCompat = true; prov.compat = {}; }
      else if (key === 'models')  { inModels = true; prov.models = []; }
      else if (key === 'baseUrl') prov.baseUrl = val;
      else if (key === 'api')     prov.api = val;
      else if (key === 'apiKey')  prov.apiKey = val;
      else if (key === 'auth')    prov.auth = val;
      continue;
    }

    // indent=6 compat field
    if (indent === 6 && inCompat && !trim.startsWith('-')) {
      const ci = trim.indexOf(':');
      const key = trim.slice(0, ci).trim();
      const val = trim.slice(ci + 1).trim();
      prov.compat![key] = val === 'true' ? true : val === 'false' ? false : val;
      continue;
    }

    // indent=6 models list item: "- id: xyz"
    if (indent === 6 && inModels && trim.startsWith('- ')) {
      curModel = { id: '' };
      prov.models!.push(curModel);
      const content = trim.slice(2).trim();
      const ci = content.indexOf(':');
      if (ci !== -1) setModelField(curModel, content.slice(0, ci).trim(), content.slice(ci + 1).trim());
      continue;
    }

    // indent=8 model sub-field
    if (indent === 8 && inModels && curModel) {
      const ci = trim.indexOf(':');
      if (ci !== -1) setModelField(curModel, trim.slice(0, ci).trim(), trim.slice(ci + 1).trim());
      continue;
    }
  }

  return result;
}

// ── dynamic registration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

let _loaded: OmpModels | null = null;

/** Read, parse, and register all providers from models.yml into the LLM router. */
export async function applyModelsYml(path?: string): Promise<OmpModels> {
  const p = path ?? getModelsYmlPath();
  if (!p) throw new Error('No models.yml path — set it in Settings → AI → Models YAML');
  const text = await readFileText(p);
  const parsed = parseOmpYaml(text);
  _loaded = parsed;
  _registerAll(parsed);
  return parsed;
}

export function getLoadedModels(): OmpModels | null { return _loaded; }

function _registerAll(parsed: OmpModels) {
  clearDynamicProviders();
  // remove previously added dynamic entries from MODEL_CATALOG
  const idx = MODEL_CATALOG.findIndex(m => (m as ModelEntry & {dynamic?: boolean}).dynamic);
  if (idx !== -1) MODEL_CATALOG.splice(idx);

  for (const [name, prov] of Object.entries(parsed.providers)) {
    if (!prov.baseUrl || (!prov.apiKey && prov.auth !== 'none' && prov.auth !== 'oauth')) continue;

    registerDynamicProvider(name, prov.baseUrl, prov.apiKey ?? '');

    for (const m of prov.models ?? []) {
      if (!m.id) continue;
      const entry: ModelEntry & { dynamic: boolean } = {
        id: `${name}/${m.id}`,
        label: `${m.name ?? m.id} (${name})`,
        provider: name as never,   // dynamic, not in Provider union
        maxTokens: m.maxTokens ?? 8192,
        dynamic: true,
      };
      MODEL_CATALOG.push(entry);
    }
  }
}

`app/src/lib/moduleCompare.ts`:

```ts
import { moduleExports, moduleImports, moduleSections } from './echoTables';
import { echoRequest } from './echo';
import { num, readMany } from './mem';
import { currentTargetGeneration } from './rpc';

export type ModuleCapture = { name: string; module: string; captured: string; exports: string[]; imports: string[]; sections: string[]; functions: string[]; strings: string[]; warnings: string[] };
const key = 'echo-module-captures-v1';
export function listModuleCaptures(): ModuleCapture[] {
  try { const value: unknown = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) ?? '[]'); return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((v): v is ModuleCapture => v && typeof v.name === 'string' && typeof v.module === 'string' && ['exports', 'imports', 'sections', 'functions', 'strings', 'warnings'].every(k => Array.isArray(v[k]) && v[k].every((x: unknown) => typeof x === 'string'))) : []; } catch { return []; }
}
export async function captureModule(name: string, module: string, base: number): Promise<ModuleCapture> {
  if (!name.trim() || name.length > 100 || !module || !Number.isSafeInteger(base) || base <= 0) throw new Error('Invalid capture name or module');
  const generation = currentTargetGeneration();
  const [exportsResult, importsResult, sectionsResult, functionsResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
    moduleExports(module), moduleImports(module), moduleSections(module),
    echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ address: string; size: number }> }>({ type: 'enumerate_functions', module }),
  ]);
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  for (const [i, value] of [exportsResult, importsResult, sectionsResult, functionsResult].entries()) if (value.status === 'rejected') warnings.push(`${['exports', 'imports', 'sections', 'functions'][i]} unavailable: ${String(value.reason)}`);
  const fns = functionsResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? (functionsResult.value.results ?? []).slice(0, 256) : [];
  const addresses = fns.map(f => num(f.address));
  const reads = await readMany(addresses.map(addr => ({ addr, len: 16 })));
  const stringReads: Array<{ addr: number; len: number }> = [];
  let stringBudget = 1024 * 1024;
  if (sectionsResult.status === 'fulfilled') for (const section of sectionsResult.value) {
    if ((section.characteristics & 0x20000000) !== 0 || stringBudget <= 0) continue;
    const size = Math.min(section.size, stringBudget);
    for (let off = 0; off < size; off += 65536) stringReads.push({ addr: section.address + off, len: Math.min(65536, size - off) });
    stringBudget -= size;
  }
  const stringPages = await readMany(stringReads);
  const strings = new Set<string>();
  for (const page of stringPages) if (page) for (const match of new TextDecoder('latin1').decode(page).matchAll(/[\x20-\x7e]{4,256}/g)) if (strings.size < 2000) strings.add(match[0]);
  if (stringPages.some(p => p === null)) warnings.push('Some string sample reads failed');
  if (stringBudget === 0 || strings.size === 2000) warnings.push('String samples capped at 1 MiB or 2,000 strings');
  if (generation !== currentTargetGeneration()) throw new Error('Target changed during module capture');
  const snapshot: ModuleCapture = {
    name: name.trim(), module, captured: new Date().toISOString(), warnings,
    exports: exportsResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? exportsResult.value.map(e => `${e.name} @ 0x${e.rva.toString(16)}`) : [],
    imports: importsResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? importsResult.value.map(e => `${e.module}!${e.name}`) : [],
    sections: sectionsResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? sectionsResult.value.map(e => `${e.name} @ 0x${e.rva.toString(16)} size ${e.size} flags ${e.characteristics}`) : [],
    functions: fns.map((f, i) => `0x${(addresses[i] - base).toString(16)} size ${f.size} bytes ${reads[i] ? [...reads[i]!].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('') : 'unreadable'}`),
    strings: [...strings],
  };
  if (functionsResult.status === 'fulfilled' && (functionsResult.value.results?.length ?? 0) > 256) snapshot.warnings.push('Function byte samples limited to the first 256 entries');
  localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify([...listModuleCaptures().filter(v => v.name !== snapshot.name), snapshot]));
  return snapshot;
}
export function compareModules(before: ModuleCapture, after: ModuleCapture) {
  const result: Record<string, { added: string[]; removed: string[] }> = {};
  for (const field of ['exports', 'imports', 'sections', 'functions', 'strings'] as const) {
    const a = new Set(before[field]), b = new Set(after[field]);
    result[field] = { added: [...b].filter(x => !a.has(x)), removed: [...a].filter(x => !b.has(x)) };
  }
  return { before: before.name, after: after.name, changes: result, warnings: [...before.warnings, ...after.warnings] };
}
export function removeModuleCapture(name: string) { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(listModuleCaptures().filter(s => s.name !== name))); }

`app/src/lib/offlineDisasm.ts`:

```ts
import { readCapture, type RuntimeCapture } from './runtimeCapture';

export type OfflineInstruction = { address: number; length: number; text: string; invalid: boolean };
export type CallTarget = { from: number; to: number; mnemonic: string };

/** Extract direct CALL/JMP targets from already-decoded instructions. */
export function extractCallTargets(instructions: OfflineInstruction[]): CallTarget[] {
  const result: CallTarget[] = [];
  for (const insn of instructions) {
    if (insn.invalid) continue;
    const m = insn.text.match(/^(call|jmp|j[a-z]{1,4})\s+(0x[0-9a-f]+)\s*$/i);
    if (!m) continue;
    const to = parseInt(m[2], 16);
    if (Number.isSafeInteger(to) && to > 0) result.push({ from: insn.address, to, mnemonic: m[1].toLowerCase() });
  }
  return result;
}

export async function disassembleCapture(capture: RuntimeCapture, address: number, size: number, bitness: 32 | 64): Promise<OfflineInstruction[]> {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(size) || size < 1 || size > 4096) throw new Error('Disassembly size must be 1–4096 bytes');
  const hex = readCapture(capture, address, size);
  if (hex === null) throw new Error('Disassembly range includes missing or out-of-range bytes');
  const bytes = Uint8Array.from(hex.match(/../g) ?? [], byte => Number.parseInt(byte, 16));
  const iced = await import('iced-x86-disasm');
  const decoder = new iced.Decoder(bitness, bytes, iced.DecoderOptions.None);
  const instruction = new iced.Instruction();
  const formatter = new iced.Formatter(iced.FormatterSyntax.Nasm);
  const result: OfflineInstruction[] = [];
  try {
    decoder.ip = BigInt(address);
    while (decoder.canDecode && result.length < 1000) {
      decoder.decodeOut(instruction);
      result.push({ address: Number(instruction.ip), length: instruction.length, text: formatter.format(instruction), invalid: instruction.code === iced.Code.INVALID });
    }
  } finally { decoder.free(); instruction.free(); formatter.free(); }
  return result;
}
