`app/src/lib/offlinePe.ts`:

```ts
import { readCapture, type CapturePage, type RuntimeCapture } from './runtimeCapture';

export type OfflineSection = { name: string; rva: number; size: number; rawOffset: number; rawSize: number; flags: number };
export type OfflinePe = {
  capture: RuntimeCapture;
  preferredBase: number;
  entryRva: number;
  architecture: string;
  headerSize: number;
  sections: OfflineSection[];
  dataDirectories: Array<{ rva: number; size: number }>;
};
export type PeExport = { ordinal: number; name: string | null; rva: number; forwarded: string | null };
export type PeImport = { module: string; functions: Array<{ name: string | null; ordinal: number | null; hint: number | null; iatRva: number }> };

export function mapPeAddress(pe: OfflinePe, address: number) {
  const rva = address - pe.capture.address;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(rva) || rva < 0 || rva >= pe.capture.size) return null;
  if (rva < pe.headerSize) return { rva, fileOffset: rva, section: 'headers' };
  const section = pe.sections.find(item => rva >= item.rva && rva < item.rva + Math.max(item.size, item.rawSize));
  if (!section) return { rva, fileOffset: null, section: null };
  const delta = rva - section.rva;
  return { rva, fileOffset: delta < section.rawSize ? section.rawOffset + delta : null, section: section.name };
}

/** Map file-backed PE bytes at an explicit load base; unspecified memory stays unknown. */
export function openOfflinePe(bytes: Uint8Array, name: string, loadBase?: number): OfflinePe {
  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
  const requireBytes = (offset: number, size: number) => {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(offset) || offset < 0 || offset + size > bytes.length) throw new Error('Truncated PE file');
  };
  requireBytes(0, 64);
  if (view.getUint16(0, true) !== 0x5a4d) throw new Error('Not a PE file');
  const nt = view.getUint32(0x3c, true);
  requireBytes(nt, 24);
  if (view.getUint32(nt, true) !== 0x4550) throw new Error('Invalid PE signature');
  const machine = view.getUint16(nt + 4, true);
  const count = view.getUint16(nt + 6, true);
  const optionalSize = view.getUint16(nt + 20, true);
  const optional = nt + 24;
  requireBytes(optional, optionalSize);
  if (optionalSize < 64 || count > 96) throw new Error('Invalid PE headers');
  const magic = view.getUint16(optional, true);
  if (magic !== 0x10b && magic !== 0x20b) throw new Error('Unsupported PE optional header');
  const preferred = magic === 0x20b ? Number(view.getBigUint64(optional + 24, true)) : view.getUint32(optional + 28, true);
  const base = loadBase ?? preferred;
  const imageSize = view.getUint32(optional + 56, true);
  const headers = view.getUint32(optional + 60, true);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(base) || base <= 0 || !imageSize || imageSize > 16 * 1024 * 1024 || !Number.isSafeInteger(base + imageSize)) throw new Error('Unsupported image base or image size (maximum 16 MiB)');
  const sectionTable = optional + optionalSize;
  requireBytes(sectionTable, count * 40);
  const sections: OfflineSection[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const s = sectionTable + i * 40;
    const rva = view.getUint32(s + 12, true), size = view.getUint32(s + 8, true);
    const rawSize = view.getUint32(s + 16, true), rawOffset = view.getUint32(s + 20, true);
    if (rva + Math.max(size, rawSize) > imageSize || rawOffset + rawSize > bytes.length) throw new Error('Invalid PE section bounds');
    sections.push({ name: new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.subarray(s, s + 8)).replace(/\0.*$/, ''), rva, size, rawOffset, rawSize, flags: view.getUint32(s + 36, true) });
  }
  // Data directories: PE32 at opt+92 (count) / opt+96 (dirs); PE32+ at opt+108 / opt+112
  const numDirsOffset = magic === 0x20b ? 108 : 92;
  const dirTableOffset = magic === 0x20b ? 112 : 96;
  const numDirs = optional + numDirsOffset + 4 <= bytes.length ? Math.min(view.getUint32(optional + numDirsOffset, true), 16) : 0;
  const dataDirectories: Array<{ rva: number; size: number }> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < numDirs && optional + dirTableOffset + i * 8 + 8 <= bytes.length; i++) {
    dataDirectories.push({ rva: view.getUint32(optional + dirTableOffset + i * 8, true), size: view.getUint32(optional + dirTableOffset + i * 8 + 4, true) });
  }
  const mappings = [{ rva: 0, rawOffset: 0, rawSize: Math.min(headers, bytes.length, imageSize) }, ...sections.filter(s => s.rawSize > 0)].sort((a, b) => a.rva - b.rva);
  let cursor = 0;
  const pages: CapturePage[] = [];
  const append = (end: number, rawOffset: number | null) => {
    while (cursor < end) {
      const length = Math.min(4096, end - cursor);
      const data = rawOffset === null ? null : Array.from(bytes.subarray(rawOffset, rawOffset + length), x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
      pages.push({ address: base + cursor, size: length, data });
      cursor += length;
      if (rawOffset !== null) rawOffset += length;
    }
  };
  for (const mapping of mappings) {
    if (mapping.rva < cursor) throw new Error('Overlapping PE mappings');
    append(mapping.rva, null);
    append(mapping.rva + mapping.rawSize, mapping.rawOffset);
  }
  append(imageSize, null);
  return { capture: { format: 'echo-runtime-capture-v1', name, target: name, captured: '', address: base, size: imageSize, pages }, preferredBase: preferred, entryRva: view.getUint32(optional + 16, true), headerSize: mappings[0].rawSize, architecture: machine === 0x8664 ? 'x64' : machine === 0x14c ? 'x86' : `machine 0x${machine.toString(16)}`, sections, dataDirectories };
}

// ── helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function peReadRva(pe: OfflinePe, rva: number, size: number): Uint8Array | null {
  if (rva <= 0 || size <= 0 || rva + size > pe.capture.size) return null;
  const hex = readCapture(pe.capture, pe.capture.address + rva, size);
  if (!hex) return null;
  return Uint8Array.from(hex.match(/../g) ?? [], b => parseInt(b, 16));
}

function peReadStr(pe: OfflinePe, rva: number): string | null {
  const bytes = peReadRva(pe, rva, Math.min(256, pe.capture.size - rva));
  if (!bytes) return null;
  const end = bytes.indexOf(0);
  return new TextDecoder('ascii').decode(end === -1 ? bytes : bytes.subarray(0, end));
}

// ── exports ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function parsePeExports(pe: OfflinePe): PeExport[] | null {
  const dir = pe.dataDirectories[0];
  if (!dir || dir.rva === 0 || dir.size < 40) return null;
  const expBytes = peReadRva(pe, dir.rva, 40);
  if (!expBytes) return null;
  const ev = new DataView(expBytes.buffer, expBytes.byteOffset);
  const ordinalBase = ev.getUint32(16, true);
  const numFunctions = ev.getUint32(20, true);
  const numNames = ev.getUint32(24, true);
  const funcTableRva = ev.getUint32(28, true);
  const nameTableRva = ev.getUint32(32, true);
  const ordinalTableRva = ev.getUint32(36, true);
  if (numFunctions > 65535 || numNames > numFunctions) return null;
  const funcBytes = peReadRva(pe, funcTableRva, numFunctions * 4);
  if (!funcBytes) return null;
  const fv = new DataView(funcBytes.buffer, funcBytes.byteOffset);
  const nameMap = new Map<number, string>();
  const nameBytes = numNames > 0 ? peReadRva(pe, nameTableRva, numNames * 4) : null;
  const ordBytes = numNames > 0 ? peReadRva(pe, ordinalTableRva, numNames * 2) : null;
  if (nameBytes && ordBytes) {
    const nv = new DataView(nameBytes.buffer, nameBytes.byteOffset);
    const ov = new DataView(ordBytes.buffer, ordBytes.byteOffset);
    for (let i = 0; i < numNames; i++) {
      const name = peReadStr(pe, nv.getUint32(i * 4, true));
      if (name) nameMap.set(ov.getUint16(i * 2, true), name);
    }
  }
  const exports: PeExport[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < numFunctions && exports.length < 65535; i++) {
    const rva = fv.getUint32(i * 4, true);
    if (rva === 0) continue;
    const forwarded = (rva >= dir.rva && rva < dir.rva + dir.size) ? peReadStr(pe, rva) : null;
    exports.push({ ordinal: ordinalBase + i, name: nameMap.get(i) ?? null, rva: forwarded ? 0 : rva, forwarded });
  }
  return exports;
}

/** Build an OfflinePe from a RuntimeCapture whose base is the module load address. */
export function captureToOfflinePe(capture: RuntimeCapture): OfflinePe {
  const headerHex = readCapture(capture, capture.address, Math.min(4096, capture.size));
  if (!headerHex) throw new Error('Cannot read PE header from capture');
  const bytes = Uint8Array.from(headerHex.match(/../g) ?? [], b => parseInt(b, 16));
  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer);
  if (view.getUint16(0, true) !== 0x5a4d) throw new Error('Capture base does not have MZ signature');
  const nt = view.getUint32(0x3c, true);
  if (nt + 24 > bytes.length || view.getUint32(nt, true) !== 0x4550) throw new Error('Invalid PE signature');
  const optional = nt + 24, magic = view.getUint16(optional, true), is64 = magic === 0x20b;
  const machine = view.getUint16(nt + 4, true);
  const count = view.getUint16(nt + 6, true);
  const optionalSize = view.getUint16(nt + 20, true);
  const nDir = is64 ? 108 : 92, dDir = is64 ? 112 : 96;
  const numDirs = optional + nDir + 4 <= bytes.length ? Math.min(view.getUint32(optional + nDir, true), 16) : 0;
  const dataDirectories: Array<{ rva: number; size: number }> = Array.from({ length: numDirs }, (_, i) =>
    optional + dDir + i * 8 + 8 <= bytes.length
      ? { rva: view.getUint32(optional + dDir + i * 8, true), size: view.getUint32(optional + dDir + i * 8 + 4, true) }
      : { rva: 0, size: 0 }
  );
  const sectionTable = optional + optionalSize;
  const sections: OfflineSection[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count && sectionTable + i * 40 + 40 <= bytes.length; i++) {
    const s = sectionTable + i * 40;
    sections.push({
      name: new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.subarray(s, s + 8)).replace(/\0.*$/, ''),
      rva: view.getUint32(s + 12, true), size: view.getUint32(s + 8, true),
      rawOffset: view.getUint32(s + 20, true), rawSize: view.getUint32(s + 16, true),
      flags: view.getUint32(s + 36, true),
    });
  }
  return { capture, preferredBase: capture.address, entryRva: view.getUint32(optional + 16, true),
    architecture: machine === 0x8664 ? 'x64' : machine === 0x14c ? 'x86' : `machine 0x${machine.toString(16)}`,
    headerSize: 4096, sections, dataDirectories };
}

// ── imports ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function parsePeImports(pe: OfflinePe): PeImport[] | null {
  const dir = pe.dataDirectories[1];
  if (!dir || dir.rva === 0 || dir.size < 20) return null;
  const is64 = pe.architecture === 'x64';
  const thunkSize = is64 ? 8 : 4;
  const imports: PeImport[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 512; i++) {
    const descBytes = peReadRva(pe, dir.rva + i * 20, 20);
    if (!descBytes) break;
    const dv = new DataView(descBytes.buffer, descBytes.byteOffset);
    const iltRva = dv.getUint32(0, true), nameRva = dv.getUint32(12, true), iatRva = dv.getUint32(16, true);
    if (iltRva === 0 && nameRva === 0 && iatRva === 0) break;
    const modName = peReadStr(pe, nameRva) ?? `<unknown+${i}>`;
    const functions: PeImport['functions'] = [];
    const walkRva = iltRva || iatRva;
    if (walkRva) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) {
        const thunkBytes = peReadRva(pe, walkRva + j * thunkSize, thunkSize);
        if (!thunkBytes) break;
        const tv = new DataView(thunkBytes.buffer, thunkBytes.byteOffset);
        let thunk: number, isOrdinal: boolean;
        if (is64) {
          const hi = tv.getUint32(4, true), lo = tv.getUint32(0, true);
          if (hi === 0 && lo === 0) break;
          isOrdinal = !!(hi & 0x80000000);
          thunk = isOrdinal ? (lo & 0xffff) : lo;
        } else {
          thunk = tv.getUint32(0, true);
          if (thunk === 0) break;
          isOrdinal = !!(thunk & 0x80000000);
          thunk = thunk & 0x7fffffff;
        }
        if (isOrdinal) {
          functions.push({ name: null, ordinal: thunk & 0xffff, hint: null, iatRva: iatRva + j * thunkSize });
        } else {
          const hintBytes = peReadRva(pe, thunk, 258);
          if (hintBytes && hintBytes.length >= 3) {
            const hv = new DataView(hintBytes.buffer, hintBytes.byteOffset);
            const hint = hv.getUint16(0, true);
            const nameEnd = hintBytes.indexOf(0, 2);
            functions.push({ name: new TextDecoder('ascii').decode(nameEnd === -1 ? hintBytes.subarray(2) : hintBytes.subarray(2, nameEnd)), ordinal: null, hint, iatRva: iatRva + j * thunkSize });
          } else {
            functions.push({ name: null, ordinal: null, hint: null, iatRva: iatRva + j * thunkSize });
          }
        }
      }
    }
    imports.push({ module: modName, functions });
  }
  return imports;
}
```

```ts
// app/src/lib/openBinary.ts
// file picker, tauri dialog in the shell and a prompt in a plain browser

import { useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";

export async function openBinary(): Promise<void> {
  let path: string | null = null;

  try {
    const dialog = await import("@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog");
    const picked = await dialog.open({
      multiple: false,
      directory: false,
      title: "Open binary for analysis",
      filters: [
        { name: "Binaries and iOS apps", extensions: ["exe", "dll", "sys", "efi", "bin", "ipa"] },
        { name: "Executables", extensions: ["exe", "dll", "sys", "efi", "bin"] },
        { name: "iOS apps", extensions: ["ipa"] },
        { name: "All files", extensions: ["*"] },
      ],
    });
    path = typeof picked === "string" ? picked : null;
  } catch {
    const typed = window.prompt("Path to binary");
    path = typed !== null && typed.trim() !== "" ? typed.trim() : null;
  }

  if (path !== null) await useDisasm.getState().loadFile(path);
}
```

```ts
// app/src/lib/overlay.ts
// Builds an Echo ESP overlay from the Overlay panel's configuration. The
// template (app/echo/echo-reverse-overlay.as) is a complete, checkable script;
// here we only rewrite the constants the panel owns, so the generated file is
// still plain Echo AngelScript with no app-side runtime dependency.

import template from "../../echo/echo-reverse-overlay.as?raw";

export type OverlayConfig = {
  /** module name Echo knows, e.g. "VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe" */
  process: string;
  /** RVA of the entity pointer array, or of a pointer to it when listDeref */
  entityListRva: number;
  listDeref: boolean;
  entityCount: number;
  /** bytes between entity pointers (8 for a pointer array) */
  entityStride: number;
  /** entity field offsets, relative to the entity pointer */
  positionOffset: number;
  healthOffset: number;
  teamOffset: number;
  /** skip entities whose team equals this; -1 disables the filter */
  localTeam: number;
  viewMatrixRva: number;
  unityCoords: boolean;
  boxWidth: number;
  boxHeight: number;
  labelSide?: "top" | "bottom";
  barSide?: "left" | "right";
};

export const defaultOverlayConfig: OverlayConfig = {
  process: "YourGame.exe",
  entityListRva: 0,
  listDeref: true,
  entityCount: 128,
  entityStride: 8,
  positionOffset: 0x0,
  healthOffset: 0x0,
  teamOffset: 0x0,
  localTeam: -1,
  viewMatrixRva: 0,
  unityCoords: false,
  boxWidth: 28,
  boxHeight: 72,
  labelSide: "top",
  barSide: "left",
};

const hex = (n: number) => `0x${Math.max(0, Math.trunc(n)).toString(16).toUpperCase()}`;

/** Replace one `const <type> NAME = ...;` initializer. */
function setConst(source: string, name: string, literal: string): string {
  const re = new RegExp(`(const\\s+\\w+\\s+${name}\\s*=\\s*)[^;]+;`);
  if (!re.test(source)) throw new Error(`overlay template has no constant ${name}`);
  return source.replace(re, `$1${literal};`);
}

/**
 * The overlay script for a configuration. It is complete on its own: no
 * placeholders remain, so it can be installed into %APPDATA%\scripts and
 * loaded by Echo directly.
 */
export function buildOverlayScript(cfg: OverlayConfig): string {
  let s = template;
  s = setConst(s, "PROCESS_NAME", JSON.stringify(cfg.process || "YourGame.exe"));
  s = setConst(s, "ENTITY_LIST_RVA", hex(cfg.entityListRva));
  s = setConst(s, "ENTITY_LIST_DEREF", cfg.listDeref ? "true" : "false");
  s = setConst(s, "ENTITY_COUNT", String(Math.max(1, Math.trunc(cfg.entityCount))));
  s = setConst(s, "ENTITY_STRIDE", String(Math.max(1, Math.trunc(cfg.entityStride))));
  s = setConst(s, "POS_OFFSET", hex(cfg.positionOffset));
  s = setConst(s, "HEALTH_OFFSET", hex(cfg.healthOffset));
  s = setConst(s, "TEAM_OFFSET", hex(cfg.teamOffset));
  s = setConst(s, "LOCAL_TEAM", String(Math.trunc(cfg.localTeam)));
  s = setConst(s, "VIEW_MATRIX_RVA", hex(cfg.viewMatrixRva));
  s = setConst(s, "UNITY_COORDS", cfg.unityCoords ? "true" : "false");
  s = setConst(s, "BOX_WIDTH", `${Math.max(1, cfg.boxWidth).toFixed(1)}f`);
  s = setConst(s, "LABEL_BOTTOM", cfg.labelSide === "bottom" ? "true" : "false");
  s = setConst(s, "BAR_RIGHT", cfg.barSide === "right" ? "true" : "false");
  s = setConst(s, "BOX_HEIGHT", `${Math.max(1, cfg.boxHeight).toFixed(1)}f`);
  return s;
}

/** Parse "0x1234" / "1234" / "" as a non-negative integer. */
export function parseRva(text: string): number {
  const t = text.trim().replace(/^0x/i, "");
  if (t === "") return 0;
  const n = Number.parseInt(t, 16);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 ? n : 0;
}

export const formatRva = (n: number): string => (n === 0 ? "" : `0x${n.toString(16).toUpperCase()}`);
```

`app/src/lib/patchJournal.ts`:

```ts
// Patch journal: write bytes via Echo ext agent, remember originals, undo/redo.
// Requires echo-reverse.as loaded (write verb needs the AngelScript ext agent).

import { echoRequest } from './echo';
import { hexAddr } from './mem';

export type Patch = {
  address: number;
  size: number;
  originalHex: string; // hex before any patch
  patchHex: string;    // current patched bytes
  label: string;
  applied: boolean;
  timestamp: string;
};

const journal: Patch[] = [];

export function listPatches(): Readonly<Patch[]> { return journal; }

export function clearJournal(): void { journal.length = 0; }

function findEntry(address: number): Patch | undefined {
  return journal.find(e => e.address === address);
}

/** Read bytes from Echo (native read verb — no ext agent required). */
async function readOriginal(address: number, size: number): Promise<string> {
  const r = await echoRequest<{ success?: boolean; data?: string }>({ type: 'read', address: hexAddr(address), size });
  if (!r.success || typeof r.data !== 'string' || r.data.length !== size * 2) throw new Error(`Cannot read ${size} bytes at ${hexAddr(address)}`);
  return r.data.toLowerCase();
}

/** Write bytes via Echo ext agent (requires echo-reverse.as). */
async function writeBytes(address: number, hexData: string): Promise<void> {
  const r = await echoRequest<{ success?: boolean; error?: string }>({ type: 'write', address: hexAddr(address), data: hexData });
  if (!r.success) throw new Error(r.error ?? 'Write failed (ext agent may not be loaded)');
}

/**
 * Apply a patch. Reads and records original bytes before writing.
 * Hex format: space-separated or compact, e.g. "90 90 90" or "909090".
 */
export async function applyPatch(address: number, patchHex: string, label = ''): Promise<void> {
  const clean = patchHex.replace(/\s+/g, '').toLowerCase();
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]+$/.test(clean) || clean.length % 2 !== 0) throw new Error('Invalid hex bytes');
  const size = clean.length / 2;
  let entry = findEntry(address);
  if (!entry) {
    const originalHex = await readOriginal(address, size);
    entry = { address, size, originalHex, patchHex: clean, label, applied: false, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
    journal.push(entry);
  } else {
    entry.patchHex = clean;
    entry.size = size;
  }
  await writeBytes(address, clean);
  entry.applied = true;
  entry.label = label || entry.label;
}

/** Restore original bytes at an address. */
export async function undoPatch(address: number): Promise<void> {
  const entry = findEntry(address);
  if (!entry) throw new Error('No patch recorded for this address');
  if (!entry.applied) throw new Error('Patch is already undone');
  await writeBytes(address, entry.originalHex);
  entry.applied = false;
}

/** Re-apply a previously undone patch. */
export async function redoPatch(address: number): Promise<void> {
  const entry = findEntry(address);
  if (!entry) throw new Error('No patch recorded for this address');
  if (entry.applied) throw new Error('Patch is already applied');
  await writeBytes(address, entry.patchHex);
  entry.applied = true;
}

/** Remove a patch entry from the journal (does NOT undo it in memory). */
export function removeEntry(address: number): void {
  const idx = journal.findIndex(e => e.address === address);
  if (idx !== -1) journal.splice(idx, 1);
}

/** Export all applied patches as an IDA Python script (idc.patch_byte calls). */
export function exportIda(): string {
  const lines = ['# IDA Python — patch script generated by echo-reverse', 'import idc'];
  for (const p of journal) {
    if (!p.applied) continue;
    const bytes = p.patchHex.match(/../g) ?? [];
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++)
      lines.push(`idc.patch_byte(0x${(p.address + i).toString(16)}, 0x${bytes[i]})`);
  }
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

/** Export all applied patches as x64dbg patch format. */
export function exportX64dbg(): string {
  const lines = ['// x64dbg patch file'];
  for (const p of journal) {
    if (!p.applied) continue;
    const bytes = p.patchHex.match(/../g) ?? [];
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++)
      lines.push(`${(p.address + i).toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(16, '0')}:${p.originalHex.slice(i * 2, i * 2 + 2).toUpperCase()}:${bytes[i].toUpperCase()}`);
  }
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

/** NOP out a range (x64: 0x90). */
export async function nopRange(address: number, size: number): Promise<void> {
  await applyPatch(address, '90'.repeat(size), `nop ${size}B`);
}
```

`app/src/lib/pointerDiscovery.ts`:

```ts
import { echoRequest } from './echo';
import { hexAddr, parseHex, u64 } from './mem';
import { call, currentTargetGeneration } from './rpc';
import { resolvePointerChain } from './memoryTools';

export type PointerCandidate = { base: number; offsets: number[]; module?: string; rva?: number };
export async function revalidatePointer(candidate: PointerCandidate, target?: number) {
  let base = candidate.base;
  if (candidate.module && candidate.rva !== undefined) {
    const { modules } = await call<{ modules: Array<{ name: string; base: number; size: number }> }>('target', 'modules');
    const module = modules.find(m => m.name.toLowerCase() === candidate.module!.toLowerCase());
    if (!module || candidate.rva < 0 || candidate.rva >= module.size) throw new Error('Candidate module or RVA is unavailable');
    base = module.base + candidate.rva;
  }
  const result = await resolvePointerChain(base, [0, ...candidate.offsets]);
  return { ...result, matches: target === undefined ? undefined : result.address === target };
}
export async function discoverPointers(target: number, start: number, size: number, depth: number, maxOffset: number) {
  if (![target, start, size, depth, maxOffset].every(Number.isSafeInteger) || target <= 0 || start <= 0 || size < 8 || size > 4 * 1024 * 1024 || depth < 1 || depth > 3 || maxOffset < 0 || maxOffset > 65536 || !Number.isSafeInteger(start + size)) throw new Error('Invalid range: size 8 bytes–4 MiB, depth 1–3, offset 0–65536');
  const generation = currentTargetGeneration();
  const { modules } = await call<{ modules: Array<{ name: string; base: number; size: number }> }>('target', 'modules');
  const data = new Uint8Array(size);
  for (let off = 0; off < size; off += 65536) {
    const length = Math.min(65536, size - off);
    const r = await echoRequest<{ success?: boolean; data?: string }>({ type: 'read', address: hexAddr(start + off), size: length });
    if (generation !== currentTargetGeneration()) throw new Error('Target changed during pointer search');
    if (!r.success || !r.data || r.data.length !== length * 2 || !/^[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(r.data)) throw new Error(`Unreadable memory at ${hexAddr(start + off)}`);
    data.set(parseHex(r.data), off);
  }
  let frontier: PointerCandidate[] = [{ base: target, offsets: [] }];
  const results: PointerCandidate[] = [];
  let truncated = false;
  for (let level = 0; level < depth; level++) {
    const next: PointerCandidate[] = [];
    for (let off = (8 - start % 8) % 8; off + 8 <= size; off += 8) {
      const value = u64(data, off);
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value === 0) continue;
      for (const child of frontier) {
        const delta = child.base - value;
        if (delta < 0 || delta > maxOffset) continue;
        if (next.length >= 64) { truncated = true; break; }
        const base = start + off;
        if (base === child.base) continue;
        const module = modules.find(m => base >= m.base && base < m.base + m.size);
        next.push({ base, offsets: [delta, ...child.offsets], module: module?.name, rva: module ? base - module.base : undefined });
      }
      if (next.length >= 64) { truncated = true; break; }
    }
    results.push(...next);
    frontier = next;
    if (!frontier.length) break;
  }
  results.sort((a, b) => Number(Boolean(b.module)) - Number(Boolean(a.module)) || a.offsets.length - b.offsets.length || a.base - b.base);
  return { target: hexAddr(target), candidates: results, truncated, searchedBytes: size };
}
```

`app/src/lib/rpc.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/rpc.ts
// Adapts the legacy call(tool, action, params) API to Echo's socket routes
// (https://echo-23.gitbook.io/angel, "Socket routes"). The attached process is
// the "loaded image": its main module stands in for the file the C++ engine
// used to open, and PE metadata and strings are parsed from live memory.
// Write-family verbs (write, regions, scan_*, emulate) are served by the ext
// agent (app/echo/echo-reverse.as). Watches live here and are polled.

import { echoRequest, EchoError } from "./echo";
import { emit, type WatchEntry, type WatchValue } from "./events";
import { Mem, hexAddr, num, parseHex, u16, u32, kPage, kChunk } from "./mem";

/** Thrown when an operation reports failure. */
export class ToolError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly tool: string, readonly action: string, message: string, readonly code?: string) {
    super(`${tool}.${action}: ${message}`);
    this.name = "ToolError";
  }
}

// ── wire helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────



type EchoModule = { name: string; base: string; size: number };

export async function modules(): Promise<EchoModule[]> {
  return (await echoRequest<{ modules?: EchoModule[] }>({ type: "modules" })).modules ?? [];
}

/** The module at the process base Echo reports, i.e. the main executable. */
export async function mainModule(): Promise<{ name: string; base: number; size: number; pid: number } | null> {
  const ping = await echoRequest<{ attached?: boolean; pid?: number; base?: string }>({ type: "ping" }, AbortSignal.timeout(3000));
  if (!ping.attached || !ping.base) return null;
  const base = BigInt(ping.base);
  const mods = await modules();
  const m = mods.find((x) => BigInt(x.base) === base) ?? mods[0];
  return m ? { name: m.name, base: num(m.base), size: m.size, pid: ping.pid ?? 0 } : null;
}

// ── PE from memory ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Pe = {
  pe32plus: boolean;
  entry_rva: number;
  size_of_image: number;
  dirs: Array<{ rva: number; size: number }>;
  sections: Array<{ name: string; rva: number; vsize: number; raw_size: number; exec: boolean; writable: boolean; characteristics: number }>;
};

export async function readPe(mem: Mem, base: number): Promise<Pe> {
  const h = await mem.bytes(base, kPage);
  if (!h || u16(h, 0) !== 0x5a4d) throw new EchoError("BadImage", "no MZ header at module base");
  const nt = u32(h, 0x3c);
  if (nt + 0x108 > kPage || u32(h, nt) !== 0x4550) throw new EchoError("BadImage", "no PE header");
  const nsec = u16(h, nt + 6);
  const opt = nt + 24;
  const pe32plus = u16(h, opt) === 0x20b;
  const dirOff = opt + (pe32plus ? 112 : 96);
  const dirs = Array.from({ length: 16 }, (_, i) => ({ rva: u32(h, dirOff + i * 8), size: u32(h, dirOff + i * 8 + 4) }));
  const secOff = opt + u16(h, nt + 20);
  const sections = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nsec && secOff + (i + 1) * 40 <= kPage; i++) {
    const s = secOff + i * 40;
    const ch = u32(h, s + 36);
    sections.push({
      name: new TextDecoder("latin1").decode(h.subarray(s, s + 8)).replace(/\0+$/, ""),
      vsize: u32(h, s + 8),
      rva: u32(h, s + 12),
      raw_size: u32(h, s + 16),
      characteristics: ch,
      exec: (ch & 0x20000000) !== 0,
      writable: (ch & 0x80000000) !== 0,
    });
  }
  return { pe32plus, entry_rva: u32(h, opt + 16), size_of_image: u32(h, opt + 56), dirs, sections };
}

export async function peExports(mem: Mem, base: number, pe: Pe) {
  const { rva, size } = pe.dirs[0];
  const d = rva && size ? await mem.bytes(base + rva, 40) : null;
  if (!d) return [];
  const ordBase = u32(d, 16);
  const n = Math.min(u32(d, 24), 50_000);
  const [funcs, names, ords] = [u32(d, 28), u32(d, 32), u32(d, 36)];
  const nameRvas = await mem.bytes(base + names, n * 4);
  const ordinals = await mem.bytes(base + ords, n * 2);
  if (!nameRvas || !ordinals) return [];
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const ord = u16(ordinals, i * 2);
    const f = await mem.bytes(base + funcs + ord * 4, 4);
    out.push({ name: await mem.cstr(base + u32(nameRvas, i * 4)), rva: f ? u32(f, 0) : 0, ordinal: ordBase + ord });
  }
  return out;
}

export async function peImports(mem: Mem, base: number, pe: Pe) {
  const { rva } = pe.dirs[1];
  const out: Array<{ dll: string; functions: string[] }> = [];
  if (!rva) return out;
  const thunk = pe.pe32plus ? 8 : 4;
  for (let i = 0; i < 4096; i++) {
    const d = await mem.bytes(base + rva + i * 20, 20);
    if (!d || u32(d, 12) === 0) break;
    const functions: string[] = [];
    const first = u32(d, 0) || u32(d, 16); // OriginalFirstThunk, else the IAT itself
    for (let j = 0; j < 40_000; j++) {
      const t = await mem.bytes(base + first + j * thunk, thunk);
      if (!t) break;
      const lo = u32(t, 0);
      const hi = pe.pe32plus ? u32(t, 4) : 0;
      if (!lo && !hi) break;
      const byOrdinal = pe.pe32plus ? (hi & 0x80000000) !== 0 : (lo & 0x80000000) !== 0;
      // a bound IAT holds resolved pointers, not name rvas, so only trust in-image rvas
      if (byOrdinal) functions.push(`#${lo & 0xffff}`);
      else if (!hi && lo < pe.size_of_image) functions.push(await mem.cstr(base + lo + 2));
      else functions.push(`${hexAddr(hi * 2 ** 32 + lo)}`);
    }
    out.push({ dll: await mem.cstr(base + u32(d, 12)), functions });
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * A module as a PE file the static tools load (Ghidra, IDA, radare2, NoVmp,
 * Triton): raw layout = virtual layout and ImageBase = the live base, so
 * addresses match the process and nothing needs relocating.
 * shortcut: no IAT rebuild, imports stay resolved pointers, add Scylla-style
 * rebuilding if a tool needs named imports.
 */
async function dumpModule(base: number, size: number): Promise<{ bytes: Uint8Array; missing: number }> {
  const mem = new Mem();
  const pe = await readPe(mem, base);
  const { bytes, missing } = await mem.image(base, pe.size_of_image || size);
  const v = new DataView(bytes.buffer);
  const nt = v.getUint32(0x3c, true);
  const opt = nt + 24;
  if (pe.pe32plus) v.setBigUint64(opt + 24, BigInt(base), true);
  else v.setUint32(opt + 28, base, true);
  v.setUint32(opt + 36, v.getUint32(opt + 32, true), true); // FileAlignment = SectionAlignment
  const secOff = opt + v.getUint16(nt + 20, true);
  for (let i = 0; i < pe.sections.length; i++) {
    const s = secOff + i * 40;
    const va = v.getUint32(s + 12, true);
    const raw = Math.max(v.getUint32(s + 8, true), v.getUint32(s + 16, true));
    v.setUint32(s + 16, Math.min(raw, Math.max(0, bytes.length - va)), true); // SizeOfRawData
    v.setUint32(s + 20, va, true); // PointerToRawData = VirtualAddress
  }
  return { bytes, missing };
}

// ── symbols ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const exportCache = new Map<number, Map<number, string>>();

/** "kernel32.dll!Sleep" for exports, "game.exe+0x1234" otherwise. */
/** Named exports of a loaded module as va -> name, cached per base. */
export async function exportsOf(base: number): Promise<Map<number, string>> {
  let names = exportCache.get(base);
  const generation = targetGeneration;
  if (!names) {
    const mem = new Mem();
    const pe = await readPe(mem, base).catch(() => null);
    const exps = pe ? await peExports(mem, base, pe).catch(() => []) : [];
    names = new Map(exps.map((e) => [base + e.rva, e.name]));
    if (generation !== targetGeneration) throw new EchoError("TargetChanged", "Target changed while reading exports");
    exportCache.set(base, names);
  }
  return names;
}

export async function symbolize(vas: number[]): Promise<Map<number, string>> {
  const out = new Map<number, string>();
  if (vas.length === 0) return out;
  const mods = (await modules()).map((m) => ({ name: m.name, base: num(m.base), size: m.size }));
  for (const va of new Set(vas)) {
    const m = mods.find((x) => va >= x.base && va < x.base + x.size);
    if (!m) { out.set(va, hexAddr(va)); continue; }
    const names = await exportsOf(m.base);
    out.set(va, names.has(va) ? `${m.name}!${names.get(va)}` : `${m.name}+0x${(va - m.base).toString(16)}`);
  }
  return out;
}

// ── strings from memory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const kStringScanCap = 64 * 1024 * 1024;

function isText(c: number): boolean {
  return (c >= 0x20 && c < 0x7f) || c === 0x09;
}

function extractStrings(b: Uint8Array, va: number, min: number, limit: number, out: Array<{ va: number; text: string; utf16: boolean }>) {
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length && out.length < limit; ) {
    let j = i;
    while (j < b.length && isText(b[j])) j++;
    if (j - i >= min) {
      out.push({ va: va + i, text: new TextDecoder("latin1").decode(b.subarray(i, j)), utf16: false });
      i = j;
      continue;
    }
    j = i;
    while (j + 1 < b.length && isText(b[j]) && b[j + 1] === 0) j += 2;
    if ((j - i) >> 1 >= min) {
      let text = "";
      for (let k = i; k < j; k += 2) text += String.fromCharCode(b[k]);
      out.push({ va: va + i, text, utf16: true });
      i = j;
      continue;
    }
    i++;
  }
}

// ── typed values ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const kWidthBytes: Record<string, number> = { i8: 1, u8: 1, i16: 2, u16: 2, i32: 4, u32: 4, f32: 4, i64: 8, u64: 8, f64: 8 };

export function widthBytes(width: string): number {
  const n = kWidthBytes[width];
  if (!n) throw new EchoError("1002", `width '${width}' is not supported on the Echo backend`);
  return n;
}

export function decode(b: Uint8Array, width: string): number {
  const v = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.byteLength);
  switch (width) {
    case "i8": return v.getInt8(0);
    case "u8": return v.getUint8(0);
    case "i16": return v.getInt16(0, true);
    case "u16": return v.getUint16(0, true);
    case "i32": return v.getInt32(0, true);
    case "u32": return v.getUint32(0, true);
    case "f32": return v.getFloat32(0, true);
    case "f64": return v.getFloat64(0, true);
    case "i64": return Number(v.getBigInt64(0, true));
    default: return Number(v.getBigUint64(0, true));
  }
}

export function encode(text: string, width: string): string {
  const b = new Uint8Array(widthBytes(width));
  const v = new DataView(b.buffer);
  if (width === "i64" || width === "u64") {
    const raw = text.trim();
    if (!/^(?:-?[0-9]+|0x[0-9a-f]+)$/i.test(raw)) throw new EchoError("1002", `invalid ${width} value`);
    const n = BigInt(raw), min = width === "i64" ? -(1n << 63n) : 0n, max = width === "i64" ? (1n << 63n) - 1n : (1n << 64n) - 1n;
    if (n < min || n > max) throw new EchoError("1002", `${width} value out of range`);
    v.setBigUint64(0, BigInt.asUintN(64, n), true);
    return Array.from(b, (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  }
  const n = Number(text.trim());
  if (!text.trim() || !Number.isFinite(n)) throw new EchoError("1002", `'${text}' is not a number`);
  switch (width) {
    case "i8": case "u8": v.setUint8(0, n & 0xff); break;
    case "i16": case "u16": v.setUint16(0, n & 0xffff, true); break;
    case "i32": case "u32": v.setUint32(0, n >>> 0, true); break;
    case "f32": v.setFloat32(0, n, true); break;
    case "f64": v.setFloat64(0, n, true); break;
    default: v.setBigUint64(0, BigInt.asUintN(64, BigInt(Math.trunc(n))), true);
  }
  return Array.from(b, (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

export function decodeText(b: Uint8Array, width: string): string {
  if (width === "i64" || width === "u64") {
    const view = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.byteLength);
    return String(width === "i64" ? view.getBigInt64(0, true) : view.getBigUint64(0, true));
  }
  return fmt(decode(b, width), width);
}

// 9 significant digits round-trip any f32
export const fmt = (n: number, width: string): string => (width === "f32" ? String(Number(n.toPrecision(9))) : String(n));

async function write(addr: number, hex: string): Promise<void> {
  const r = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean }>({ type: "write", address: hexAddr(addr), data: hex });
  if (!r.success) throw new EchoError("WriteFailed", `write at ${hexAddr(addr)} failed`);
}

// ── watches ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Echo has no watch list, so it lives here: polled with read_batch, frozen
// entries rewritten through the ext agent whenever they drift

const watches: WatchEntry[] = [];
let watchValues: WatchValue[] = [];
let nextWatch = 1;
let poller: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
let polling = false;
let watchTarget = "";
let targetGeneration = 0;

function watchesChanged(): void {
  emit("watch.list", { entries: watches.map((w) => ({ ...w })) });
  if (watches.length > 0 && !poller) poller = setInterval(() => void pollWatches(), 250);
  if (watches.length === 0) {
    watchTarget = "";
    if (poller) { clearInterval(poller); poller = undefined; }
  }
}

async function pollWatches(): Promise<void> {
  if (polling || watches.length === 0) return;
  polling = true;
  const generation = targetGeneration;
  try {
    const list = watches.slice(0, 64);
    if (list.some(w => w.freeze)) {
      try {
        const live = await scanTargetIdentity();
        if (live.key !== watchTarget) { invalidateTargetCaches(); return; }
      } catch { invalidateTargetCaches(); return; }
      if (generation !== targetGeneration) return;
    }
    const r = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ success: boolean; data: string }> }>({
      type: "read_batch",
      reads: list.map((w) => ({ address: hexAddr(w.addr), size: widthBytes(w.width) })),
    });
    if (generation !== targetGeneration) return;
    const values = await Promise.all(list.map(async (w, i) => {
      const res = r.results?.[i];
      if (!res?.success) return { id: w.id, addr: w.addr, ok: false, held: w.freeze, bits: 0, text: "??" };
      const n = decode(parseHex(res.data), w.width);
      if (generation === targetGeneration && w.freeze && res.data !== encode(w.frozen_text, w.width)) {
        await write(w.addr, encode(w.frozen_text, w.width)).catch(() => undefined);
      }
      return { id: w.id, addr: w.addr, ok: true, held: w.freeze, bits: n, text: decodeText(parseHex(res.data), w.width) };
    }));
    if (generation === targetGeneration) { watchValues = values; emit("watch.values", { attached: true, values }); }
  } catch {
    if (generation === targetGeneration) emit("watch.values", { attached: false, values: [] });
  } finally {
    polling = false;
  }
}

/** Drop target-specific state when the target or an agent connection changes. */
export function currentTargetGeneration(): number { return targetGeneration; }
export function invalidateTargetCaches(): void {
  targetGeneration++;
  exportCache.clear();
  watches.length = 0;
  watchValues = [];
  watchesChanged();
  emit("watch.values", { attached: false, values: [] });
  scanState = { active: false, pid: 0, total: 0, width: "", kind: "" };
  scanTarget = "";
}

// ── value scanner (ext agent) ────────────────────────────────────────────────

let scanState = { active: false, pid: 0, total: 0, width: "", kind: "" };
let scanTarget = "";

async function scanTargetIdentity(): Promise<{ key: string; pid: number }> {
  const ping = await echoRequest<{ attached?: boolean; pid?: number; base?: string }>({ type: "ping" });
  if (!ping.attached || !ping.base) {
    scanState = { active: false, pid: 0, total: 0, width: "", kind: "" };
    scanTarget = "";
    throw new EchoError("TargetChanged", "Echo target disconnected; start a new scan");
  }
  return { key: `${ping.pid ?? 0}:${ping.base.toLowerCase()}`, pid: ping.pid ?? 0 };
}

function scanInteger64(value: unknown, width: string): string {
  const text = String(value ?? "").trim();
  if (!/^(?:-?[0-9]+|0x[0-9a-f]+)$/i.test(text)) throw new EchoError("InvalidValue", `invalid ${width} scan value`);
  const n = BigInt(text);
  const min = width === "i64" ? -(1n << 63n) : 0n;
  const max = width === "i64" ? (1n << 63n) - 1n : (1n << 64n) - 1n;
  if (n < min || n > max) throw new EchoError("InvalidValue", `${width} scan value out of range`);
  return `0x${BigInt.asUintN(64, n).toString(16)}`;
}

async function scan(type: "scan_new" | "scan_filter", p: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const target = await scanTargetIdentity();
  if (type === "scan_filter" && (!scanState.active || target.key !== scanTarget)) {
    scanState = { active: false, pid: 0, total: 0, width: "", kind: "" };
    scanTarget = "";
    throw new EchoError("TargetChanged", "Echo target changed; start a new scan");
  }
  const width = type === "scan_filter" ? scanState.width : String(p.width);
  const wide = width === "i64" || width === "u64";
  const kind = String(p.kind);
  const needsValue = ["exact", "between", "bigger", "smaller"].includes(kind);
  const range: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const key of ["start", "end"]) {
    if (p[key] === undefined || String(p[key]).trim() === "") continue;
    const text = String(p[key]).trim();
    if (!/^(?:0x)?[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(text)) throw new EchoError("InvalidValue", `invalid scan ${key} address`);
    const address = BigInt(`0x${text.replace(/^0x/i, "")}`);
    if (address > 0x7fffffffffffn) throw new EchoError("InvalidValue", `scan ${key} address is outside user memory`);
    range[key] = `0x${address.toString(16)}`;
  }
  if (range.start && range.end && BigInt(range.start) >= BigInt(range.end)) throw new EchoError("InvalidValue", "scan end must be greater than start");
  if (wide || Object.keys(range).length > 0) {
    const capabilities = await echoRequest<{ protocol?: string }>({ type: "capabilities" });
    if (capabilities.protocol !== "echo-reverse-ext/2" && capabilities.protocol !== "echo-reverse-ext/3") throw new EchoError("AgentUpgradeRequired", "Install and reload the current Echo extension script for 64-bit and ranged scans");
  }
  const frame: Record<string, unknown> = { type, width, kind, limit: p.limit ?? 1000, ...range };
  if (wide) {
    if (needsValue) frame.value_hex = scanInteger64(p.value, width);
    if (kind === "between") frame.value2_hex = scanInteger64(p.value2, width);
  } else if (needsValue) {
    const value = Number(p.value);
    if (String(p.value ?? "").trim() === "" || !Number.isFinite(value)) throw new EchoError("InvalidValue", "invalid scan value");
    frame.value = value;
    if (kind === "between") {
      const value2 = Number(p.value2);
      if (String(p.value2 ?? "").trim() === "" || !Number.isFinite(value2)) throw new EchoError("InvalidValue", "invalid scan upper value");
      frame.value2 = value2;
    }
  }
  const r = await echoRequest<{ total: number; width: string; truncated?: boolean; hits?: Array<{ address: string; value?: number; value_hex?: string }> }>(frame);
  const after = await scanTargetIdentity();
  if (after.key !== target.key) {
    scanState = { active: false, pid: 0, total: 0, width: "", kind: "" };
    scanTarget = "";
    throw new EchoError("TargetChanged", "Echo target changed during the scan; start a new scan");
  }
  scanTarget = target.key;
  scanState = { ...scanState, active: true, pid: target.pid, total: r.total, width: r.width, kind };
  return {
    total: r.total, truncated: r.truncated === true,
    hits: (r.hits ?? []).map((h) => {
      if (wide && h.value_hex === undefined) throw new EchoError("AgentUpgradeRequired", "Update the Echo extension script for exact 64-bit scanning");
      const integer = wide ? BigInt(h.value_hex!) : 0n;
      return { addr: num(h.address), bits: h.value ?? 0, formatted: wide ? (width === "i64" ? BigInt.asIntN(64, integer) : integer).toString() : fmt(h.value ?? 0, r.width), type: r.width };
    }),
  };
}

// ── disassembly ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function flowOf(text: string): { flow: string; target?: number } {
  const [mn, op] = text.trim().split(/\s+/, 2);
  const target = op && /^0x[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(op) ? num(op) : undefined;
  if (mn === "ret" || mn === "retn" || mn === "iret" || mn === "iretq") return { flow: "ret" };
  if (mn === "call") return { flow: "call", target };
  if (mn === "jmp") return { flow: "jump", target };
  if (/^j[a-z]+$/.test(mn) || mn === "loop" || mn === "jrcxz") return { flow: "cond_jump", target };
  return { flow: "none" };
}

function notAttached(): never {
  throw new EchoError("1001", "Echo is not attached to a process");
}

// ── dispatch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function dispatch(tool: string, action: string, p: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown> {
  const key = `${tool}.${action}`;
  switch (key) {
    case "app.status": {
      const m = await mainModule().catch(() => null);
      return { backend: "echo", target: m ? { attached: true, pid: m.pid, name: m.name, base: m.base } : { attached: false } };
    }

    case "memory.read": {
      const r = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; data: string }>({
        type: "read", address: hexAddr(p.addr as number), size: (p.len as number | undefined) ?? kPage,
      });
      if (!r.success) throw new EchoError("1005", "memory read failed");
      return { hex: r.data };
    }
    case "memory.write":
      await write(p.addr as number, p.hex as string);
      return {};
    case "memory.scan":
      return scan("scan_new", p);
    case "memory.rescan":
      return scan("scan_filter", p);
    case "memory.scan_state":
      return scanState;
    case "memory.scan_reset":
      scanState = { active: false, pid: 0, total: 0, width: "", kind: "" };
      scanTarget = "";
      await echoRequest({ type: "scan_clear" });
      return {};
    case "memory.watch_list":
      return { entries: watches, values: watchValues };
    case "memory.watch_add": {
      const width = String(p.width);
      widthBytes(width);
      const live = await scanTargetIdentity();
      if (watchTarget && watchTarget !== live.key) invalidateTargetCaches();
      watchTarget = live.key;
      watches.push({ id: nextWatch++, addr: p.addr as number, width, label: String(p.label ?? ""), freeze: false, frozen_bits: 0, frozen_text: "" });
      watchesChanged();
      return {};
    }
    case "memory.watch_remove": {
      const i = watches.findIndex((w) => w.id === p.id);
      if (i >= 0) watches.splice(i, 1);
      watchesChanged();
      return {};
    }
    case "memory.watch_clear":
      watches.length = 0;
      watchesChanged();
      return {};
    case "memory.watch_set": {
      const w = watches.find((x) => x.id === p.id);
      if (!w) throw new EchoError("1002", "no such watch");
      if (typeof p.value === "string") {
        await write(w.addr, encode(p.value, w.width));
        if (w.freeze) w.frozen_text = p.value;
      }
      if (p.freeze === true && !w.freeze) {
        // hold what's there now, the last poll may predate a poke
        const r = await echoRequest<{ success: boolean; data: string }>({ type: "read", address: hexAddr(w.addr), size: widthBytes(w.width) });
        if (!r.success) throw new EchoError("1005", "can't read the value to freeze");
        const bytes = parseHex(r.data);
        w.frozen_bits = decode(bytes, w.width);
        w.frozen_text = decodeText(bytes, w.width);
      }
      if (typeof p.freeze === "boolean") w.freeze = p.freeze;
      watchesChanged();
      return {};
    }

    case "emu.run": {
      if (Array.isArray(p.regions) && p.regions.length) {
        const caps = await echoRequest<{ features?: string[] }>({ type: "capabilities" });
        if (!caps.features?.includes("emulate_regions")) throw new EchoError("AgentUpgradeRequired", "Install and reload the current Echo extension for emulator regions");
      }
      const r = await echoRequest<{
        success: boolean; error: number; fault_address: string; regs: Record<string, string>; trace: string[];
        calls?: Array<{ target: string; return: string; rcx: string; rdx: string; r8: string; r9: string }>;
        writes?: Array<{ at: string; address: string; size: number; value: string }>;
        mapped_regions?: Array<{ name: string; address: string; size: number; perms: number }>;
        vector_regs?: Record<string, string>; memory_map?: Array<{ address: string; end: string; perms: number }>; memory_map_truncated?: boolean;
        error_name?: string;
      }>({
        type: "emulate", address: hexAddr(p.addr as number), count: p.count ?? 100_000, timeout_us: p.timeout_us ?? 1_000_000,
        trace_limit: p.trace_limit ?? 2000, regs: p.regs ?? {},
        stub_external: p.stub_external ?? true, api_return: p.api_return ?? "0x0", track_writes: p.track_writes ?? true, writes_limit: p.writes_limit ?? 1000, regions: p.regions ?? [],
      });
      const calls = r.calls ?? [];
      const names = await symbolize(calls.map((c) => num(c.target))).catch(() => new Map<number, string>());
      return {
        ok: r.success, error: r.error, fault: num(r.fault_address), trace: r.trace.map(num), mapped_regions: r.mapped_regions ?? [],
        regs: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r.regs).map(([k, v]) => [k, num(v)])), regs_hex: r.regs,
        vector_regs: r.vector_regs ?? {}, memory_map: r.memory_map ?? [], memory_map_truncated: r.memory_map_truncated ?? false,
        error_name: r.error_name,
        calls: calls.map((c) => ({ target: num(c.target), symbol: names.get(num(c.target)) ?? c.target, ret: num(c.return), args: [c.rcx, c.rdx, c.r8, c.r9].map(num) })),
        writes: (r.writes ?? []).map((w) => ({ at: num(w.at), addr: num(w.address), size: w.size, value: w.value })),
      };
    }

    case "target.list": {
      // Echo's public socket protocol exposes the target that is already
      // attached; it deliberately has no process-enumeration verb. Present that
      // one live target instead of pretending the desktop app owns a Windows
      // process list.
      const m = await mainModule().catch(() => null);
      return { processes: m ? [{ pid: m.pid, name: m.name, arch: "unknown" }] : [] };
    }
    case "target.attach": {
      const raw = String(p.name ?? p.pid ?? "").trim();
      if (!raw) throw new EchoError("InvalidTarget", "enter a process name or PID");
      const frame: Record<string, unknown> = { type: "attach" };
      if (/^\d+$/.test(raw)) frame.pid = Number(raw);
      else frame.name = raw;
      const result = await echoRequest<{ success?: boolean; pid?: number; base?: string }>(frame);
      if (result.success === false) throw new EchoError("AttachFailed", `Echo could not attach to ${raw}`);
      return { attached: true, pid: result.pid, base: result.base ? num(result.base) : undefined };
    }
    case "target.detach": {
      const result = await echoRequest<{ success?: boolean }>({ type: "detach" });
      if (result.success === false) throw new EchoError("DetachFailed", "Echo could not detach the target");
      return { attached: false };
    }
    case "target.modules":
      return { modules: (await modules()).map((m) => ({ name: m.name, base: num(m.base), size: m.size })) };
    case "target.dump":
      return dumpModule(p.base as number, p.size as number);
    case "target.regions": {
      const r = await echoRequest<{ regions?: Array<{ base: string; size: number; protect: number; type: number }> }>({ type: "regions" });
      // the ext agent only lists accessible regions and can't see MEM_* state, so they are committed
      return { regions: (r.regions ?? []).map((g) => ({ base: num(g.base), size: g.size, protect: g.protect, state: 0x1000, type: g.type })) };
    }

    case "disasm.loaded": {
      const m = await mainModule().catch(() => null);
      if (!m) return { ready: false };
      const pe = await readPe(new Mem(), m.base).catch(() => null);
      return {
        ready: true, format: "pe", arch: pe?.pe32plus === false ? "x86" : "x64",
        name: m.name, path: m.name, base: m.base, entry_va: pe ? m.base + pe.entry_rva : undefined,
      };
    }
    case "disasm.load":
    case "disasm.unload":
    case "disasm.symbol_set":
      // the image is whatever Echo is attached to, names live in the UI store
      return {};
    case "disasm.functions": {
      const m = (await mainModule()) ?? notAttached();
      const r = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ address: string; size: number }> }>({ type: "enumerate_functions", module: m.name });
      const functions = (r.results ?? []).map((f) => ({ va: num(f.address), size: f.size }));
      return { functions, total: functions.length };
    }
    case "disasm.disassemble": {
      const count = (p.count as number | undefined) ?? 256;
      const r = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ address: string; length: number; text: string }> }>({
        type: "disassemble", address: hexAddr(p.addr as number), size: Math.min(count * 16, 0x10000),
      });
      return {
        instructions: (r.results ?? []).slice(0, count).map((i) => ({ va: num(i.address), len: i.length, text: i.text, ...flowOf(i.text) })),
      };
    }
    case "disasm.pe": {
      const m = (await mainModule()) ?? notAttached();
      const mem = new Mem();
      const pe = await readPe(mem, m.base);
      return {
        image: m.name, format: "pe", arch: pe.pe32plus ? "x64" : "x86", pe32plus: pe.pe32plus,
        image_base: m.base, entry_rva: pe.entry_rva, size_of_image: pe.size_of_image, sections: pe.sections,
        imports: await peImports(mem, m.base, pe), exports: await peExports(mem, m.base, pe),
      };
    }
    case "disasm.strings": {
      const m = (await mainModule()) ?? notAttached();
      const min = (p.min_chars as number | undefined) ?? 4;
      const limit = (p.limit as number | undefined) ?? 10_000;
      const mem = new Mem();
      const pe = await readPe(mem, m.base);
      const out: Array<{ va: number; text: string; utf16: boolean }> = [];
      let budget = kStringScanCap;
      for (const s of pe.sections) {
        if (s.exec && !p.include_exec) continue;
        const len = Math.min(s.vsize, budget);
        budget -= len;
        // scan per 64 KiB so one unreadable page only drops its own chunk
        for (let off = 0; off < len && out.length < limit; off += kChunk) {
          const b = await mem.bytes(m.base + s.rva + off, Math.min(kChunk, len - off));
          if (b) extractStrings(b, m.base + s.rva + off, min, limit, out);
        }
      }
      return { strings: out, truncated: out.length >= limit || budget <= 0 };
    }
  }

  // debugger, frida and .NET have no Echo primitive
  throw new EchoError("Unsupported", `${key} is not available on the Echo backend`);
}

/** Invoke one action. Rejects with ToolError when the operation reports failure. */
export async function call<T>(tool: string, action: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<T> {
  const generation = targetGeneration;
  try {
    const value = await dispatch(tool, action, params ?? {});
    if (generation !== targetGeneration) throw new EchoError("TargetChanged", "Target or agent connection changed during the request");
    return value as T;
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof EchoError) throw new ToolError(tool, action, e.message, e.code);
    throw e;
  }
}
```

`app/src/lib/runtimeCapture.ts`:

```ts
import { echoRequest } from './echo';
import { hexAddr } from './mem';
import { currentTargetGeneration } from './rpc';

export type CapturePage = { address: number; size: number; data: string | null };
export type RuntimeCapture = {
  format: 'echo-runtime-capture-v1';
  name: string;
  target: string;
  captured: string;
  address: number;
  size: number;
  pages: CapturePage[];
};

const pageSize = 4096;
const maxSize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;

export function parseRuntimeCapture(text: string): RuntimeCapture {
  const value: unknown = JSON.parse(text);
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) throw new Error('Invalid capture');
  const data = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (data.format !== 'echo-runtime-capture-v1' || typeof data.name !== 'string' || typeof data.target !== 'string' ||
      typeof data.captured !== 'string' || !Number.isSafeInteger(data.address) || typeof data.address !== 'number' || data.address <= 0 ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(data.size) || typeof data.size !== 'number' || data.size <= 0 || data.size > maxSize ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(data.address + data.size) || !Array.isArray(data.pages)) throw new Error('Invalid capture metadata');
  let cursor = data.address;
  const pages: CapturePage[] = [];
  for (const item of data.pages) {
    if (typeof item !== 'object' || item === null) throw new Error('Invalid capture page');
    const page = item as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (page.address !== cursor || typeof page.size !== 'number' || !Number.isSafeInteger(page.size) || page.size <= 0 || page.size > pageSize ||
        cursor + page.size > data.address + data.size || (page.data !== null && (typeof page.data !== 'string' || page.data.length !== page.size * 2 || !/^[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(page.data)))) throw new Error('Invalid capture page');
    pages.push({ address: cursor, size: page.size, data: typeof page.data === 'string' ? page.data.toLowerCase() : null });
    cursor += page.size;
  }
  if (cursor !== data.address + data.size) throw new Error('Incomplete capture page map');
  return { format: 'echo-runtime-capture-v1', name: data.name, target: data.target, captured: data.captured, address: data.address, size: data.size, pages };
}

/** Capture is non-atomic; failed reads are recorded as gaps, never zero-filled. */
export async function captureRuntimeRange(name: string, address: number, size: number, target: string, options: { signal?: AbortSignal; progress?: (done: number, size: number) => void } = {}): Promise<RuntimeCapture> {
  if (!name.trim() || name.length > 100 || !Number.isSafeInteger(address) || address <= 0 ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(size) || size <= 0 || size > maxSize || !Number.isSafeInteger(address + size)) {
    throw new Error('Provide a name and a range of up to 16 MiB');
  }
  const generation = currentTargetGeneration();
  const pages: CapturePage[] = [];
  for (let offset = 0; offset < size;) {
    options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
    const start = address + offset;
    const length = Math.min(size - offset, pageSize - start % pageSize);
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success?: boolean; data?: string }>({ type: 'read', address: hexAddr(start), size: length }, options.signal);
    options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
    if (generation !== currentTargetGeneration()) throw new Error('Target changed during capture');
    const data = result.success && typeof result.data === 'string' && result.data.length === length * 2 && /^[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(result.data)
      ? result.data.toLowerCase() : null;
    pages.push({ address: start, size: length, data });
    offset += length;
    options.progress?.(offset, size);
  }
  return { format: 'echo-runtime-capture-v1', name: name.trim(), target, captured: new Date().toISOString(), address, size, pages };
}

/** A missing byte yields null; reads cannot accidentally cross a capture gap. */
export function readCapture(capture: RuntimeCapture, address: number, size: number): string | null {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(address) || !Number.isSafeInteger(size) || size <= 0 || address < capture.address || address + size > capture.address + capture.size) return null;
  let cursor = address;
  let result = '';
  for (const page of capture.pages) {
    if (page.address + page.size <= cursor) continue;
    if (page.address > cursor || page.data === null) return null;
    const count = Math.min(address + size - cursor, page.address + page.size - cursor);
    result += page.data.slice((cursor - page.address) * 2, (cursor - page.address + count) * 2);
    cursor += count;
    if (cursor === address + size) return result;
  }
  return null;
}

export function compareRuntimeCaptures(before: RuntimeCapture, after: RuntimeCapture, limit = 10000) {
  if (before.address !== after.address || before.size !== after.size) throw new Error('Captures must cover the same range');
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(limit) || limit < 0 || limit > 10000) throw new Error('Invalid change limit');
  const changes: Array<{ address: number; before: string; after: string }> = [];
  let changed = 0;
  let unavailable = 0;
  let i = 0, j = 0;
  let cursor = before.address;
  while (cursor < before.address + before.size) {
    const left = before.pages[i], right = after.pages[j];
    const end = Math.min(left.address + left.size, right.address + right.size);
    const length = end - cursor;
    if (left.data === null || right.data === null) unavailable += length;
    else for (let n = 0; n < length; n++) {
      const a = left.data.slice((cursor - left.address + n) * 2, (cursor - left.address + n + 1) * 2);
      const b = right.data.slice((cursor - right.address + n) * 2, (cursor - right.address + n + 1) * 2);
      if (a !== b) {
        changed++;
        if (changes.length < limit) changes.push({ address: cursor + n, before: a, after: b });
      }
    }
    cursor = end;
    if (cursor === left.address + left.size) i++;
    if (cursor === right.address + right.size) j++;
  }
  return { changed, unavailable, changes, truncated: changed > changes.length };
}

/** IDA-style pattern scan: space-separated hex bytes, '??' is wildcard. */
export function searchCapture(capture: RuntimeCapture, pattern: string, limit = 100): Array<{ address: number; match: string }> {
  const parts = pattern.trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (parts.length < 1 || parts.length > 256) throw new Error('Pattern must be 1–256 bytes');
  const mask: Array<number | null> = parts.map(p => {
    if (p === '??' || p === '?') return null;
    const v = parseInt(p, 16);
    if (isNaN(v) || v < 0 || v > 255) throw new Error(`Invalid pattern byte: ${p}`);
    return v;
  });
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 1000) throw new Error('limit must be 1–1000');
  const results: Array<{ address: number; match: string }> = [];
  let runAddr = 0;
  let run: number[] = [];
  const scanRun = () => {
    for (let i = 0; i <= run.length - mask.length && results.length < limit; i++) {
      if (mask.every((m, j) => m === null || run[i + j] === m))
        results.push({ address: runAddr + i, match: run.slice(i, i + mask.length).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(' ') });
    }
    run = [];
  };
  for (const page of capture.pages) {
    if (page.data === null) { scanRun(); runAddr = page.address + page.size; continue; }
    if (page.address !== runAddr + run.length) { scanRun(); runAddr = page.address; }
    const pageBytes = page.data.match(/../g)?.map(b => parseInt(b, 16)) ?? [];
    run.push(...pageBytes);
  }
  scanRun();
  return results;
}

/** UTF-16 LE string extraction. Scans for null-terminated wide-char ASCII runs. */
export function captureWideStrings(capture: RuntimeCapture, minimum = 4, limit = 1000): { strings: Array<{ address: number; text: string; truncated: boolean }>; matches: number; truncated: boolean } {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(minimum) || minimum < 4 || minimum > 256 || !Number.isSafeInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 10000) throw new Error('Invalid string search limits');
  const strings: Array<{ address: number; text: string; truncated: boolean }> = [];
  let start = 0;
  let chars: string[] = [];
  let matches = 0;
  const finish = () => {
    if (chars.length >= minimum) {
      matches++;
      if (strings.length < limit) strings.push({ address: start, text: chars.slice(0, 4096).join(''), truncated: chars.length > 4096 });
    }
    chars = [];
  };
  for (const page of capture.pages) {
    if (page.data === null) { finish(); continue; }
    // step by 2; page.size is always ≤ 4096 so offset+1 is safe to check
    for (let offset = 0; offset + 1 < page.size; offset += 2) {
      const lo = parseInt(page.data.slice(offset * 2, offset * 2 + 2), 16);
      const hi = parseInt(page.data.slice(offset * 2 + 2, offset * 2 + 4), 16);
      const code = lo | (hi << 8);
      if (hi === 0 && code >= 0x20 && code <= 0x7e) {
        if (!chars.length) start = page.address + offset;
        chars.push(String.fromCharCode(code));
      } else finish();
    }
  }
  finish();
  return { strings, matches, truncated: matches > strings.length };
}

export function captureStrings(capture: RuntimeCapture, minimum = 4, limit = 1000) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(minimum) || minimum < 4 || minimum > 256 || !Number.isSafeInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 10000) throw new Error('Invalid string search limits');
  const strings: Array<{ address: number; text: string; truncated: boolean }> = [];
  let start = 0;
  let text = '';
  let length = 0;
  let matches = 0;
  const finish = () => {
    if (length >= minimum) {
      matches++;
      if (strings.length < limit) strings.push({ address: start, text, truncated: length > text.length });
    }
    text = '';
    length = 0;
  };
  for (const page of capture.pages) {
    if (page.data === null) { finish(); continue; }
    for (let offset = 0; offset < page.size; offset++) {
      const byte = Number.parseInt(page.data.slice(offset * 2, offset * 2 + 2), 16);
      if (byte >= 32 && byte <= 126) {
        if (!length) start = page.address + offset;
        length++;
        if (text.length < 4096) text += String.fromCharCode(byte);
      } else finish();
    }
  }
  finish();
  return { strings, matches, truncated: matches > strings.length };
}
```
