`app/src/lib/scanSessions.ts`:

```ts
import { echoRequest, EchoError } from "./echo";
import { hexAddr, num, parseHex } from "./mem";

export type ScanWidth = "i8" | "u8" | "i16" | "u16" | "i32" | "u32" | "i64" | "u64" | "f32" | "f64";
type Value = number | bigint;
type Entry = { addr: number; value: Value };
type Region = { base: string; size: number; protect: number };
export type ScanResult = { hits: Array<{ addr: number; bits: number; formatted: string; type: string }>; total: number; truncated: boolean; unreadable: number };
export type ScanProgress = { completed: number; total: number; unit: "bytes" | "hits" };
export type ScanOptions = { width: ScanWidth; kind: string; value?: string; value2?: string; start?: string; end?: string; protection: "writable" | "readable" | "executable" | "all"; maxResults?: number; maxBytes?: number; limit?: number };
type Session = { target: string; width: ScanWidth; entries: Entry[]; truncated: boolean; unreadable: number; progress?: ScanProgress; controller?: AbortController };
const sessions = new Map<string, Session>();
const widths: Record<ScanWidth, number> = { i8: 1, u8: 1, i16: 2, u16: 2, i32: 4, u32: 4, i64: 8, u64: 8, f32: 4, f64: 8 };
const limitResults = 2_000_000;
const limitBytes = 4 * 1024 ** 3;
const chunkSize = 0x10000;
const batchSize = 16;
const userTop = 0x7fffffffffff;

async function target(signal: AbortSignal): Promise<string> {
  const p = await echoRequest<{ attached?: boolean; base?: string; pid?: number }>({ type: "ping" }, signal);
  if (!p.attached || !p.base) throw new EchoError("TargetChanged", "Echo target disconnected");
  return `${p.pid ?? 0}:${p.base.toLowerCase()}`;
}
function address(value: string | undefined, fallback: number): number {
  if (!value?.trim()) return fallback;
  const text = value.trim();
  if (!/^(?:0x)?[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(text)) throw new Error("Invalid scan address");
  const n = BigInt(`0x${text.replace(/^0x/i, "")}`);
  if (n > BigInt(userTop)) throw new Error("Scan address is outside user memory");
  return Number(n);
}
function input(value: string | undefined, width: ScanWidth): Value {
  const text = value?.trim() ?? "";
  if (width[0] === "f") {
    const n = Number(text);
    if (!text || !Number.isFinite(n)) throw new Error("Invalid floating point value");
    return width === "f32" ? Math.fround(n) : n;
  }
  if (!/^(?:-?[0-9]+|0x[0-9a-f]+)$/i.test(text)) throw new Error(`Invalid ${width} value`);
  const n = BigInt(text), bits = BigInt(widths[width] * 8);
  const min = width[0] === "i" ? -(1n << (bits - 1n)) : 0n;
  const max = width[0] === "i" ? (1n << (bits - 1n)) - 1n : (1n << bits) - 1n;
  if (n < min || n > max) throw new Error(`${width} value out of range`);
  return width.endsWith("64") ? n : Number(n);
}
function readValue(view: DataView, offset: number, width: ScanWidth): Value {
  switch (width) {
    case "i8": return view.getInt8(offset); case "u8": return view.getUint8(offset);
    case "i16": return view.getInt16(offset, true); case "u16": return view.getUint16(offset, true);
    case "i32": return view.getInt32(offset, true); case "u32": return view.getUint32(offset, true);
    case "i64": return view.getBigInt64(offset, true); case "u64": return view.getBigUint64(offset, true);
    case "f32": return view.getFloat32(offset, true); case "f64": return view.getFloat64(offset, true);
  }
}
function matches(kind: string, cur: Value, prev: Value, a: Value, b: Value): boolean {
  switch (kind) {
    case "unknown": return true; case "exact": return cur === a; case "between": return cur >= a && cur <= b;
    case "bigger": return cur > a; case "smaller": return cur < a; case "increased": return cur > prev;
    case "decreased": return cur < prev; case "changed": return cur !== prev; case "unchanged": return cur === prev;
    default: throw new Error("Invalid scan comparison");
  }
}
function result(s: Session, limit: number): ScanResult {
  return { total: s.entries.length, truncated: s.truncated, unreadable: s.unreadable, hits: s.entries.slice(0, limit).map(e => ({ addr: e.addr, bits: typeof e.value === "number" ? e.value : 0, formatted: String(e.value), type: s.width })) };
}
function checkCancelled(signal: AbortSignal) { if (signal.aborted) throw new DOMException("Scan cancelled", "AbortError"); }
async function reads(items: Array<{ addr: number; len: number }>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Array<Uint8Array | null>> {
  checkCancelled(signal);
  const r = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ success: boolean; data: string }> }>({ type: "read_batch", reads: items.map(x => ({ address: hexAddr(x.addr), size: x.len })) }, signal);
  return items.map((x, i) => { const v = r.results?.[i]; return v?.success && v.data.length === x.len * 2 ? parseHex(v.data) : null; });
}
export function cancelScanSession(id: string): void { sessions.get(id)?.controller?.abort(); }
export function deleteScanSession(id: string): void { cancelScanSession(id); sessions.delete(id); }
export function clearScanSessions(): void { for (const id of sessions.keys()) deleteScanSession(id); }
export function scanSessionResult(id: string, limit = 1000): ScanResult | null { const s = sessions.get(id); return s ? result(s, limit) : null; }
export function compareScanSessions(first: string, second: string) {
  const a = sessions.get(first), b = sessions.get(second);
  if (!a || !b || a.controller || b.controller) throw new Error('Both sessions must have completed scans');
  if (a.target !== b.target) throw new Error('Scan sessions belong to different targets');
  const addresses = new Set(a.entries.map(e => e.addr));
  let common = 0;
  for (const e of b.entries) if (addresses.has(e.addr)) common++;
  return { common, onlyFirst: a.entries.length - common, onlySecond: b.entries.length - common, truncated: a.truncated || b.truncated };
}
export function scanSessionStatus(id: string): { busy: boolean; progress: ScanProgress | null; total: number; truncated: boolean } | null {
  const s = sessions.get(id); return s ? { busy: !!s.controller, progress: s.progress ?? null, total: s.entries.length, truncated: s.truncated } : null;
}

export async function runScanSession(id: string, next: boolean, options: ScanOptions, progress: (p: ScanProgress) => void = () => {}): Promise<ScanResult> {
  let session = sessions.get(id);
  if (session?.controller) throw new Error("This scan session is already running");
  if (next && !session) throw new Error("Start a scan first");
  const width = next ? session!.width : options.width;
  if (!Object.hasOwn(widths, width)) throw new Error("Invalid scan width");
  const valid = next ? ["exact", "between", "bigger", "smaller", "increased", "decreased", "changed", "unchanged"] : ["exact", "unknown"];
  if (!valid.includes(options.kind)) throw new Error("Invalid scan comparison");
  if (!["writable", "readable", "executable", "all"].includes(options.protection)) throw new Error("Invalid protection filter");
  if (options.limit !== undefined && (!Number.isSafeInteger(options.limit) || options.limit < 0 || options.limit > 100000)) throw new Error("Invalid result page limit");
  const requires = ["exact", "between", "bigger", "smaller"].includes(options.kind);
  const zero = width.endsWith("64") && width[0] !== "f" ? 0n : 0;
  const a = requires ? input(options.value, width) : zero;
  const b = options.kind === "between" ? input(options.value2, width) : zero;
  if (options.kind === "between" && a > b) throw new Error("Upper value must be at least the lower value");
  const start = address(options.start, 0x10000), end = address(options.end, userTop);
  if (start >= end) throw new Error("Scan end must be greater than start");
  const maxResults = options.maxResults ?? 100000, maxBytes = options.maxBytes ?? limitBytes;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(maxResults) || maxResults < 1 || maxResults > limitResults) throw new Error(`Hit limit must be between 1 and ${limitResults}`);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(maxBytes) || maxBytes < 1 || maxBytes > limitBytes) throw new Error(`Byte limit must be between 1 and ${limitBytes}`);
  const controller = new AbortController(), signal = controller.signal;
  const oldSession = session;
  if (!session && sessions.size >= 32) throw new Error("Maximum 32 scan sessions; delete a session first");
  if (!session) { session = { target: "", width, entries: [], truncated: false, unreadable: 0 }; sessions.set(id, session); }
  session.controller = controller;
  session.progress = undefined;
  const notify = (p: ScanProgress) => { session!.progress = p; progress(p); };
  try {
    const identity = await target(signal);
    if (next && session.target !== identity) { sessions.delete(id); throw new EchoError("TargetChanged", "Echo target changed; start a new scan"); }
    const entries: Entry[] = [];
    let truncated = next && session.truncated;
    let unreadable = 0;
    if (!next) {
      const regionReply = await echoRequest<{ regions?: Region[]; truncated?: boolean }>({ type: "regions" }, signal);
      if (regionReply.truncated) truncated = true;
      const ranges = (regionReply.regions ?? []).flatMap(r => {
        const protect = r.protect & 0xff;
        const writable = [4, 8, 0x40, 0x80].includes(protect), executable = [0x10, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80].includes(protect);
        const readable = [2, 4, 8, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80].includes(protect);
        if (options.protection === "writable" && (!writable || executable) || options.protection === "readable" && !readable || options.protection === "executable" && !executable) return [];
        const lo = Math.max(start, num(r.base)), hi = Math.min(end, num(r.base) + r.size);
        return Number.isSafeInteger(lo) && Number.isSafeInteger(hi) && hi > lo ? [{ lo, hi }] : [];
      });
      const total = Math.min(maxBytes, ranges.reduce((n, r) => n + r.hi - r.lo, 0));
      let done = 0;
      notify({ completed: 0, total, unit: "bytes" });
      outer: for (const range of ranges) {
        let at = range.lo + (widths[width] - range.lo % widths[width]) % widths[width];
        while (at < range.hi) {
          const batch: Array<{ addr: number; len: number }> = [];
          while (batch.length < batchSize && at < range.hi && done + batch.reduce((n, v) => n + v.len, 0) < maxBytes) {
            const reserved = batch.reduce((n, v) => n + v.len, 0);
            const len = Math.min(chunkSize, range.hi - at, maxBytes - done - reserved);
            if (len <= 0) break;
            batch.push({ addr: at, len }); at += len;
          }
          if (!batch.length) { truncated = true; break outer; }
          const values = await reads(batch, signal);
          for (let i = 0; i < batch.length; i++) {
            const data = values[i], item = batch[i]; done += item.len;
            if (!data) { unreadable++; continue; }
            const view = new DataView(data.buffer, data.byteOffset, data.byteLength);
            for (let off = 0; off + widths[width] <= data.length; off += widths[width]) {
              const value = readValue(view, off, width);
              if (matches(options.kind, value, zero, a, b)) {
                if (entries.length >= maxResults) { truncated = true; break outer; }
                entries.push({ addr: item.addr + off, value });
              }
            }
          }
          notify({ completed: done, total, unit: "bytes" });
        }
      }
      if (done >= maxBytes && ranges.reduce((n, r) => n + r.hi - r.lo, 0) > done) truncated = true;
    } else {
      const grouped = new Map<number, Entry[]>();
      for (const e of session.entries) { const page = Math.floor(e.addr / 4096) * 4096; const list = grouped.get(page) ?? []; list.push(e); grouped.set(page, list); }
      const pages = [...grouped.entries()]; let done = 0;
      notify({ completed: 0, total: session.entries.length, unit: "hits" });
      for (let i = 0; i < pages.length; i += batchSize) {
        const batch = pages.slice(i, i + batchSize), data = await reads(batch.map(([addr]) => ({ addr, len: 4096 })), signal);
        for (let n = 0; n < batch.length; n++) {
          const [addr, list] = batch[n], bytes = data[n];
          done += list.length;
          if (bytes) {
            const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
            for (const old of list) {
              const offset = old.addr - addr;
              if (offset + widths[width] > bytes.length) { unreadable++; continue; }
              const value = readValue(view, offset, width);
              if (matches(options.kind, value, old.value, a, b)) entries.push({ addr: old.addr, value });
            }
          } else {
            // Some regions end inside a page; retry each candidate at its actual width.
            for (let j = 0; j < list.length; j += batchSize) {
              const group = list.slice(j, j + batchSize);
              const individual = await reads(group.map(e => ({ addr: e.addr, len: widths[width] })), signal);
              group.forEach((old, k) => {
                const item = individual[k]; if (!item) { unreadable++; return; }
                const value = readValue(new DataView(item.buffer, item.byteOffset, item.byteLength), 0, width);
                if (matches(options.kind, value, old.value, a, b)) entries.push({ addr: old.addr, value });
              });
            }
          }
        }
        notify({ completed: done, total: session.entries.length, unit: "hits" });
      }
    }
    if (await target(signal) !== identity) { sessions.delete(id); throw new EchoError("TargetChanged", "Echo target changed during the scan"); }
    checkCancelled(signal);
    if (sessions.get(id) !== session) throw new DOMException("Scan cancelled", "AbortError");
    session.target = identity; session.width = width; session.entries = entries; session.truncated = truncated; session.unreadable = unreadable;
    return result(session, options.limit ?? 1000);
  } catch (e) {
    if ((!oldSession || e instanceof EchoError && e.code === "TargetChanged") && sessions.get(id) === session) sessions.delete(id);
    throw e;
  } finally { if (session.controller === controller) session.controller = undefined; }
}
```

`app/src/lib/signatures.ts`:

```ts
// Signature Doctor resolver engine over Echo's live-memory socket.
// Supports echo-reverse's compact recipe fields and Signature Doctor's
// catalog checks (readable, bytes, range, in_module, alignment).

import { echoRequest } from "./echo";

export type SignatureCheck =
  | { type: "readable"; size: number }
  | { type: "bytes"; pattern: string }
  | { type: "range"; dataType: string; min: string; max: string }
  | { type: "in_module"; module: string }
  | { type: "alignment"; value: number };

export type SignatureItem = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  module: string;
  kind: "signature" | "rva" | "pointer";
  pattern?: string;
  rva?: string;
  addend?: string;
  offsets?: string[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  /** Legacy compact relative-resolution form: displacement byte offset. */
  rel32?: number;
  /** Signature Doctor relative-resolution form. */
  relative?: { offset: number; instructionSize: number };
  pointerSize?: 4 | 8;
  alignment?: number;
  readable?: number;
  moduleOnly?: boolean;
  valueCheck?: { width: 1 | 2 | 4 | 8; signed?: boolean; min?: string; max?: string };
  checks?: SignatureCheck[];
  notes?: string;
};

export type SignatureResult = {
  id: string;
  status: "valid" | "moved" | "ambiguous" | "missing" | "error" | "disabled" | "pending";
  address?: string;
  rva?: string;
  candidates?: string[];
  message: string;
  evidence?: string[];
  durationMs?: number;
};

type Module = { name: string; base: string; size: number };
const hex = (n: bigint) => n < 0n ? `-0x${(-n).toString(16)}` : `0x${n.toString(16)}`;
const number = (value: string): bigint => {
  const text = value.trim();
  if (!/^-?(?:0x[0-9a-f]+|[0-9]+)$/i.test(text)) throw new Error(`invalid number ${value}`);
  return text.startsWith("-") ? -BigInt(text.slice(1)) : BigInt(text);
};

const read = async (addr: bigint, size: number, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Uint8Array> => {
  const reply = await echoRequest<{ data?: string; success?: boolean }>({ type: "read", address: hex(addr), size }, signal);
  if (reply.success === false || typeof reply.data !== "string" || !/^(?:[0-9a-f]{2})*$/i.test(reply.data) || reply.data.length !== size * 2) {
    throw new Error(`read failed at ${hex(addr)}`);
  }
  return Uint8Array.from(reply.data.match(/../g) ?? [], (byte) => parseInt(byte, 16));
};

function patternBytes(pattern: string): Array<number | null> {
  const tokens = pattern.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (!tokens.length || tokens.length > 256) throw new Error("signature pattern must contain 1–256 bytes");
  let concrete = 0;
  const out = tokens.map((token) => {
    if (token === "?" || token === "??") return null;
    if (!/^[0-9a-f]{2}$/i.test(token)) throw new Error(`invalid pattern byte ${token}`);
    concrete++;
    return parseInt(token, 16);
  });
  if (!concrete) throw new Error("signature pattern needs at least one concrete byte");
  return out;
}

function bytesMatch(actual: Uint8Array, pattern: string): boolean {
  const expected = patternBytes(pattern);
  if (actual.length !== expected.length) return false;
  return expected.every((byte, index) => byte === null || byte === actual[index]);
}

const rangeTypes: Record<string, { width: number; signed: boolean }> = {
  u8: { width: 1, signed: false }, i8: { width: 1, signed: true },
  u16: { width: 2, signed: false }, i16: { width: 2, signed: true },
  u32: { width: 4, signed: false }, i32: { width: 4, signed: true },
  u64: { width: 8, signed: false }, i64: { width: 8, signed: true },
  f32: { width: 4, signed: true }, f64: { width: 8, signed: true },
};

function decodeInteger(bytes: Uint8Array, type: string): bigint {
  const info = rangeTypes[type];
  if (!info) throw new Error(`unsupported range type ${type}`);
  let value = 0n;
  for (let i = bytes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) value = (value << 8n) | BigInt(bytes[i]);
  if (info.signed) value = BigInt.asIntN(info.width * 8, value);
  return value;
}

export async function resolveSignature(item: SignatureItem, baseline?: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<SignatureResult> {
  if (item.enabled === false) return { id: item.id, status: "disabled", message: "disabled" };
  const started = performance.now();
  const evidence: string[] = [];
  try {
    const { modules = [] } = await echoRequest<{ modules?: Module[] }>({ type: "modules" }, signal);
    const mod = modules.find((m) => m.name.toLowerCase() === item.module.toLowerCase());
    if (!mod) return { id: item.id, status: "missing", message: "module not loaded", evidence };
    const base = number(mod.base);
    evidence.push(`module ${mod.name}: ${hex(base)}`);
    let addr: bigint;

    if (item.kind === "signature" && item.pattern) {
      const reply = await echoRequest<{ results?: string[] }>({ type: "sig_scan_ida", module: item.module, pattern: item.pattern, find_all: true }, signal);
      const hits = reply.results ?? [];
      if (!hits.length) return { id: item.id, status: "missing", message: "no match", evidence };
      if (hits.length !== 1) return { id: item.id, status: "ambiguous", message: `${hits.length} hits`, candidates: hits, evidence };
      addr = number(hits[0]);
      evidence.push(`signature: ${hex(addr)}`);
    } else if ((item.kind === "rva" || item.kind === "pointer") && item.rva !== undefined) {
      addr = base + number(item.rva);
      evidence.push(`RVA ${item.rva}: ${hex(addr)}`);
    } else {
      throw new Error("unsupported kind or missing fields");
    }

    if (item.relative !== undefined) {
      const { offset, instructionSize } = item.relative;
      if (!Number.isInteger(offset) || offset < 0 || offset > 60 || !Number.isInteger(instructionSize) || instructionSize < 1 || instructionSize > 64 || offset + 4 > instructionSize) {
        throw new Error("invalid relative instruction range");
      }
      const at = addr + BigInt(offset);
      const bytes = await read(at, 4, signal);
      const displacement = BigInt(new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength).getInt32(0, true));
      addr = at + BigInt(instructionSize) + displacement;
      evidence.push(`relative ${hex(at)} + ${instructionSize}: ${hex(addr)}`);
    } else if (item.rel32 !== undefined) {
      if (!Number.isInteger(item.rel32)) throw new Error("rel32 offset must be an integer");
      const at = addr + BigInt(item.rel32);
      const bytes = await read(at, 4, signal);
      const displacement = BigInt(new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength).getInt32(0, true));
      addr = at + 4n + displacement;
      evidence.push(`rel32 at ${hex(at)}: ${hex(addr)}`);
    }

    if (item.addend !== undefined) {
      addr += number(item.addend);
      evidence.push(`addend ${item.addend}: ${hex(addr)}`);
    }

    if (item.kind === "pointer") {
      if (!item.offsets?.length || item.offsets.length > 32) throw new Error("pointer chain must have 1–32 offsets");
      const pointerSize = item.pointerSize ?? 8;
      if (pointerSize !== 4 && pointerSize !== 8) throw new Error("pointerSize must be 4 or 8");
      for (const offset of item.offsets) {
        const at = addr;
        const bytes = await read(at, pointerSize, signal);
        let pointer = 0n;
        for (let i = bytes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) pointer = (pointer << 8n) | BigInt(bytes[i]);
        if (!pointer) throw new Error(`null pointer at ${hex(at)}`);
        addr = pointer + number(offset);
        evidence.push(`pointer ${hex(at)} + ${offset}: ${hex(addr)}`);
      }
    }

    if (addr < 0n || addr > 0xffffffffffffffffn) throw new Error("address outside 64-bit range");

    if (item.alignment !== undefined) {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(item.alignment) || item.alignment < 1 || addr % BigInt(item.alignment) !== 0n) throw new Error("alignment check failed");
      evidence.push(`aligned to ${item.alignment}`);
    }
    if (item.moduleOnly) {
      if (addr < base || addr >= base + BigInt(mod.size)) throw new Error("address outside module");
      evidence.push("inside module");
    }
    if (item.readable !== undefined) {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(item.readable) || item.readable < 1 || item.readable > 4096) throw new Error("readable must be between 1 and 4096");
      await read(addr, item.readable, signal);
      evidence.push(`${item.readable} readable bytes`);
    }
    if (item.valueCheck) {
      const { width, signed, min, max } = item.valueCheck;
      if (![1, 2, 4, 8].includes(width) || (min === undefined && max === undefined)) throw new Error("value check requires a width and minimum or maximum");
      const bytes = await read(addr, width, signal);
      let value = 0n;
      for (let i = bytes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) value = (value << 8n) | BigInt(bytes[i]);
      if (signed) value = BigInt.asIntN(width * 8, value);
      if ((min !== undefined && value < number(min)) || (max !== undefined && value > number(max))) throw new Error(`value ${value} outside configured range`);
      evidence.push(`value ${value} within configured range`);
    }

    const checks = item.checks ?? [];
    if (checks.length > 16) throw new Error("too many validation checks");
    let explicitReadable = false;
    for (const check of checks) {
      switch (check.type) {
        case "readable": {
          if (!Number.isSafeInteger(check.size) || check.size < 1 || check.size > 65536) throw new Error("readable check size must be 1–65536");
          await read(addr, check.size, signal);
          explicitReadable = true;
          evidence.push(`${check.size} readable bytes`);
          break;
        }
        case "bytes": {
          const expected = patternBytes(check.pattern);
          const actual = await read(addr, expected.length, signal);
          if (!bytesMatch(actual, check.pattern)) throw new Error("byte pattern check failed");
          evidence.push(`bytes match ${check.pattern}`);
          break;
        }
        case "range": {
          const info = rangeTypes[check.dataType];
          if (!info) throw new Error(`unsupported range type ${check.dataType}`);
          const actual = await read(addr, info.width, signal);
          const value = decodeInteger(actual, check.dataType);
          const min = number(check.min), max = number(check.max);
          if (value < min || value > max) throw new Error(`value ${value} outside configured range`);
          evidence.push(`value ${value} within configured range`);
          break;
        }
        case "in_module": {
          const target = modules.find((m) => m.name.toLowerCase() === check.module.toLowerCase());
          if (!target) throw new Error(`module ${check.module} is not loaded`);
          const targetBase = number(target.base);
          if (addr < targetBase || addr >= targetBase + BigInt(target.size)) throw new Error(`address outside ${check.module}`);
          evidence.push(`inside ${check.module}`);
          break;
        }
        case "alignment": {
          if (!Number.isSafeInteger(check.value) || check.value < 1 || check.value > 65536 || (check.value & (check.value - 1)) !== 0) throw new Error("alignment must be a power of two");
          if (addr % BigInt(check.value) !== 0n) throw new Error("alignment check failed");
          evidence.push(`aligned to ${check.value}`);
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (!explicitReadable && item.readable === undefined) await read(addr, 1, signal);

    const rva = hex(addr - base);
    const status = baseline !== undefined && baseline !== rva ? "moved" : "valid";
    return { id: item.id, status, address: hex(addr), rva, message: status === "moved" ? `moved from ${baseline}` : "resolved", evidence, durationMs: performance.now() - started };
  } catch (e) {
    return { id: item.id, status: "error", message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e), evidence, durationMs: performance.now() - started };
  }
}
```

`app/src/lib/snapshots.ts`:

```ts
import { echoRequest } from './echo';
import { hexAddr } from './mem';
import { currentTargetGeneration } from './rpc';

export type Snapshot = { name: string; address: number; size: number; target: string; captured: string; data: string };
const key = 'echo-memory-snapshots-v1';
const maxSize = 1024 * 1024;

export function listSnapshots(): Snapshot[] {
  try {
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) ?? '[]');
    return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((s): s is Snapshot => s && typeof s.name === 'string' && Number.isSafeInteger(s.address) && Number.isInteger(s.size) && s.size > 0 && s.size <= maxSize && typeof s.data === 'string' && /^[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(s.data) && s.data.length === s.size * 2 && typeof s.target === 'string' && typeof s.captured === 'string') : [];
  } catch { return []; }
}
export function removeSnapshot(name: string): void {
  localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(listSnapshots().filter(s => s.name !== name)));
}
export async function captureSnapshot(name: string, address: number, size: number, target: string): Promise<Snapshot> {
  if (!name.trim() || name.length > 100 || !Number.isSafeInteger(address) || address <= 0 || !Number.isInteger(size) || size < 1 || size > maxSize || !Number.isSafeInteger(address + size)) throw new Error('Provide a name, address and size from 1 byte to 1 MiB');
  const generation = currentTargetGeneration();
  let data = '';
  for (let offset = 0; offset < size; offset += 65536) {
    const n = Math.min(65536, size - offset);
    const result = await echoRequest<{ success?: boolean; data?: string }>({ type: 'read', address: hexAddr(address + offset), size: n });
    if (generation !== currentTargetGeneration()) throw new Error('Target changed during capture');
    if (!result.success || !result.data || result.data.length !== n * 2 || !/^[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(result.data)) throw new Error(`Memory read failed at ${hexAddr(address + offset)}`);
    data += result.data.toLowerCase();
  }
  const snapshot = { name: name.trim(), address, size, target, captured: new Date().toISOString(), data };
  const items = listSnapshots().filter(s => s.name !== snapshot.name);
  localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify([...items, snapshot]));
  return snapshot;
}
export function compareSnapshots(a: Snapshot, b: Snapshot, limit = 10000, afterByte = '') {
  if (a.address !== b.address || a.size !== b.size) throw new Error('Snapshots must cover the same address and size');
  if (afterByte && !/^[0-9a-f]{2}$/i.test(afterByte)) throw new Error('Byte filter must be two hex digits');
  const changes: Array<{ address: string; before: string; after: string }> = [];
  let count = 0, matched = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.size; i++) {
    const before = a.data.slice(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), after = b.data.slice(i * 2, i * 2 + 2);
    if (before !== after) { count++; if (!afterByte || after.toLowerCase() === afterByte.toLowerCase()) { matched++; if (changes.length < limit) changes.push({ address: hexAddr(a.address + i), before, after }); } }
  }
  return { before: a.name, after: b.name, count, matched, changes, truncated: matched > changes.length };
}
```

`app/src/lib/source2.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/source2.ts
// Source 2 (CS2, Dota 2, Deadlock) over Echo reads, cs2-dumper style:
// - interfaces: every module exporting CreateInterface keeps a linked list of
//   InterfaceReg { CreateFn, name, next }; CreateInterface loads its head with a
//   rip-relative mov, each CreateFn is usually `lea rax, [instance]; ret`.
// - schema: the schema compiler emits SchemaClassInfoData statically into each
//   module, recognisable by its self pointer followed by name and module strings,
//   so classes and field offsets come from scanning the module's data, not from
//   walking SchemaSystem's hash tables (whose layout changes between builds).
// shortcut: no enums, metadata (MNetworkEnable, ...) or static fields.

import { echoRequest } from "./echo";
import { Mem, hexAddr, num, readMany, ripTarget, u32, u64 } from "./mem";
import { exportsOf, modules, readPe } from "./rpc";

export type Interface = { module: string; name: string; instance: number | null; create: number };
export type SchemaField = { name: string; type: string; offset: number };
export type SchemaClass = { module: string; name: string; address: number; size: number; base: string | null; fields: SchemaField[] };

const plausible = (p: number) => p >= 0x10000 && p < 0x7fffffffffff;
const i32 = (b: Uint8Array, o: number) => u32(b, o) | 0;
const ident = (s: string) => /^[A-Za-z_][\w:<>,* ]{0,200}$/.test(s);

async function first(va: number, size = 16) {
  const r = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ address: string; length: number; text: string }> }>({
    type: "disassemble", address: hexAddr(va), size,
  }).catch(() => null);
  return (r?.results ?? []).map((i) => ({ va: num(i.address), length: i.length, text: i.text }));
}

/** C strings at many addresses at once, "" where unreadable or not text. */
async function strings(addrs: number[], len = 96): Promise<string[]> {
  const reads = await readMany(addrs.map((addr) => ({ addr, len })));
  return reads.map((b) => {
    if (!b) return "";
    const end = b.indexOf(0);
    return end < 0 ? "" : new TextDecoder("latin1").decode(b.subarray(0, end));
  });
}

export async function interfaces(progress?: (m: string) => void): Promise<Interface[]> {
  const out: Interface[] = [];
  const mem = new Mem();
  for (const m of await modules()) {
    const base = num(m.base);
    const exps = await exportsOf(base);
    const create = [...exps].find(([, n]) => n === "CreateInterface")?.[0];
    if (!create) continue;
    progress?.(`interfaces of ${m.name}…`);
    // the first rip-relative load in CreateInterface is s_pInterfaceRegs
    const insns = await first(create, 32);
    const regs = insns.map((i) => (/^mov /.test(i.text) ? ripTarget(i.va, i.length, i.text) : null)).find((t) => t !== null);
    if (!regs) continue;
    const head = await mem.bytes(regs, 8);
    for (let reg = head ? u64(head, 0) : 0, guard = 0; plausible(reg) && guard < 2048; guard++) {
      const r = await mem.bytes(reg, 0x18);
      if (!r) break;
      const [name] = await strings([u64(r, 8)]);
      const fn = u64(r, 0);
      const lea = (await first(fn)).find((i) => /^lea rax/.test(i.text));
      out.push({ module: m.name, name, create: fn, instance: lea ? ripTarget(lea.va, lea.length, lea.text) : null });
      reg = u64(r, 0x10);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Where the field count, field array and base class sit in SchemaClassInfoData, found by what reads sanely. */
async function classLayout(samples: Array<{ addr: number; b: Uint8Array; size: number }>) {
  let best = { count: 0x1c, fields: 0x28, score: -1 };
  for (const count of [0x1c, 0x1e, 0x20]) {
    for (const fields of [0x28, 0x30, 0x20, 0x38]) {
      let score = 0;
      const probe = samples.filter((s) => (s.b[count] | (s.b[count + 1] << 8)) > 0 && plausible(u64(s.b, fields))).slice(0, 16);
      const heads = await readMany(probe.map((s) => ({ addr: u64(s.b, fields), len: 0x20 })));
      const names = await strings(heads.map((h) => (h ? u64(h, 0) : 0)));
      probe.forEach((s, i) => { if (heads[i] && ident(names[i]) && i32(heads[i]!, 0x10) >= 0 && i32(heads[i]!, 0x10) < Math.max(s.size, 1)) score++; });
      if (score > best.score) best = { count, fields, score };
    }
  }
  return best;
}

export async function schema(progress?: (m: string) => void, only?: string): Promise<SchemaClass[]> {
  const out: SchemaClass[] = [];
  for (const m of await modules()) {
    if (only && m.name.toLowerCase() !== only.toLowerCase()) continue;
    const base = num(m.base);
    const mem = new Mem();
    const pe = await readPe(mem, base).catch(() => null);
    if (!pe) continue;
    // SchemaClassInfoData: self pointer, name, module name; the self pointer is the cheap filter
    const candidates: Array<{ addr: number; b: Uint8Array }> = [];
    for (const s of pe.sections.filter((x) => !x.exec)) {
      progress?.(`scanning ${m.name} ${s.name} for schema classes…`);
      const { bytes } = await mem.image(base + s.rva, s.vsize);
      for (let o = 0; o + 0x50 <= bytes.length; o += 8) {
        if (u64(bytes, o) === base + s.rva + o) candidates.push({ addr: base + s.rva + o, b: bytes.slice(o, o + 0x50) });
      }
    }
    if (!candidates.length) continue;
    const names = await strings(candidates.map((c) => u64(c.b, 8)));
    const mods = await strings(candidates.map((c) => u64(c.b, 0x10)), 64);
    const classes = candidates
      .map((c, i) => ({ ...c, name: names[i], module: mods[i], size: i32(c.b, 0x18) }))
      .filter((c) => ident(c.name) && /\.(dll|so)$|^[a-z_]+$/i.test(c.module) && c.size >= 0 && c.size < 0x1000000);
    if (!classes.length) continue;
    progress?.(`${m.name}: ${classes.length} schema classes, reading fields…`);
    const L = await classLayout(classes);
    const byAddr = new Map(classes.map((c) => [c.addr, c.name]));

    for (const c of classes) {
      const count = Math.min(c.b[L.count] | (c.b[L.count + 1] << 8), 4096);
      const fa = u64(c.b, L.fields);
      const raw = count && plausible(fa) ? await mem.bytes(fa, count * 0x20) : null;
      const fields: SchemaField[] = [];
      if (raw) {
        const fnames = await strings(Array.from({ length: count }, (_, k) => u64(raw, k * 0x20)));
        const types = await readMany(Array.from({ length: count }, (_, k) => ({ addr: u64(raw, k * 0x20 + 8), len: 0x10 })));
        const tnames = await strings(types.map((t) => (t ? u64(t, 8) : 0)));
        for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) fields.push({ name: fnames[k], type: tnames[k], offset: i32(raw, k * 0x20 + 0x10) });
      }
      // base class: a pointer to { offset, SchemaClassInfoData* } whose class we already know
      let baseName: string | null = null;
      for (let o = 0x30; o < 0x50 && !baseName; o += 8) {
        const p = u64(c.b, o);
        const bi = plausible(p) ? await mem.bytes(p, 0x10) : null;
        if (bi && byAddr.has(u64(bi, 8)) && u64(bi, 8) !== c.addr) baseName = byAddr.get(u64(bi, 8))!;
      }
      out.push({ module: m.name, name: c.name, address: c.addr, size: c.size, base: baseName, fields: fields.sort((a, b) => a.offset - b.offset) });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** cs2-dumper-style header: namespace per module, one per class, constexpr offsets. */
export function schemaHeader(classes: SchemaClass[]): string {
  const lines = ["// generated by echo-reverse from live memory", "#pragma once", "#include <cstddef>", ""];
  for (const mod of [...new Set(classes.map((c) => c.module))]) {
    lines.push(`namespace ${mod.replace(/\W/g, "_")} {`);
    for (const c of classes.filter((x) => x.module === mod)) {
      lines.push(`    // size 0x${c.size.toString(16)}${c.base ? `, parent ${c.base}` : ""}`);
      lines.push(`    namespace ${c.name.replace(/\W/g, "_")} {`);
      for (const f of c.fields) lines.push(`        constexpr std::ptrdiff_t ${f.name} = 0x${f.offset.toString(16).toUpperCase()}; // ${f.type}`);
      lines.push("    }");
    }
    lines.push("}", "");
  }
  return lines.join("\n");
}
```

`app/src/lib/staticAnalysis.ts`:

```ts
// Static analysis passes that run on decoded instructions or raw bytes.
// All synchronous — no Echo calls needed except for byte-level passes.

import type { Insn } from '@/store/disasm';
import { searchCapture, type RuntimeCapture } from './runtimeCapture';

export type RopGadget = { address: number; insns: string[]; kind: 'ret' | 'jmp_reg' | 'call_reg' };
export type AntiDebugHit = { address: number; pattern: string; text: string };
export type IndirectBranch = { address: number; text: string; kind: 'call' | 'jmp' };
export type XorDecryptor = { address: number; text: string };
export type CryptoHit = { address: number; name: string; matchBytes: string };
export type XrayResult = {
  ropGadgets: RopGadget[];
  antiDebug: AntiDebugHit[];
  indirectBranches: IndirectBranch[];
  xorDecryptors: XorDecryptor[];
  cryptoHits: CryptoHit[];
  entropy: number | null;
  score: number; // 0-100 suspicion score
};

// ── instruction-level passes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Sequences of 1–3 instructions ending in ret / jmp reg / call reg. */
export function findRopGadgets(insns: Insn[]): RopGadget[] {
  const gadgets: RopGadget[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) {
    const text = insns[i].text.toLowerCase().trim();
    let kind: RopGadget['kind'] | null = null;
    if (/^retn?(\s|$)/.test(text)) kind = 'ret';
    else if (/^jmp\s+(rax|rbx|rcx|rdx|rsi|rdi|rbp|r\d+)$/.test(text)) kind = 'jmp_reg';
    else if (/^call\s+(rax|rbx|rcx|rdx|rsi|rdi|rbp|r\d+)$/.test(text)) kind = 'call_reg';
    if (kind) {
      const start = Math.max(0, i - 3);
      gadgets.push({ address: insns[start].va, insns: insns.slice(start, i + 1).map(x => x.text), kind });
    }
    if (gadgets.length >= 500) break;
  }
  return gadgets;
}

const ANTI_DEBUG: Array<{ re: RegExp; name: string }> = [
  { re: /^cpuid$/, name: 'CPUID — VM/hypervisor probe' },
  { re: /^rdtsc(p?)$/, name: 'RDTSC — timing side-channel' },
  { re: /^int3$/, name: 'INT3 — software breakpoint trap' },
  { re: /^int\s+0x2d$/i, name: 'INT 2Dh — kernel debugger probe' },
  { re: /^int\s+1$/i, name: 'INT 1 — single-step trap' },
  { re: /^icebp$/, name: 'ICEBP — ICE breakpoint' },
  { re: /\bgs:0x60\b/, name: 'gs:[60h] — PEB access (BeingDebugged)' },
  { re: /\bfs:0x30\b/, name: 'fs:[30h] — PEB access (TEB)' },
  { re: /\bgs:0x30\b/, name: 'gs:[30h] — TEB (x64 TEB)' },
  { re: /^in\s+eax,\s*0x64$/i, name: 'IN EAX,64h — VMware I/O port check' },
  { re: /^in\s+eax,\s*0xa$/i, name: 'IN EAX,0Ah — VMware backdoor check' },
  // Trap-flag manipulation
  { re: /^pushf$/, name: 'PUSHF — possible trap-flag check' },
];

export function detectAntiDebug(insns: Insn[]): AntiDebugHit[] {
  const hits: AntiDebugHit[] = [];
  for (const insn of insns) {
    const t = insn.text.trim();
    for (const { re, name } of ANTI_DEBUG) {
      if (re.test(t)) hits.push({ address: insn.va, pattern: name, text: t });
    }
  }
  return hits;
}

/** Calls and jumps with no resolved static target — likely obfuscated dispatch. */
export function findIndirectBranches(insns: Insn[]): IndirectBranch[] {
  const result: IndirectBranch[] = [];
  for (const insn of insns) {
    if (insn.target !== undefined) continue; // direct — skip
    const t = insn.text.toLowerCase();
    if (t.startsWith('call ')) result.push({ address: insn.va, text: insn.text, kind: 'call' });
    else if (t.startsWith('jmp ') && !t.includes('0x')) result.push({ address: insn.va, text: insn.text, kind: 'jmp' });
  }
  return result;
}

/** XOR instructions excluding register self-zeroing idioms. */
export function findXorDecryptors(insns: Insn[]): XorDecryptor[] {
  const result: XorDecryptor[] = [];
  for (const insn of insns) {
    const t = insn.text.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!t.startsWith('xor ')) continue;
    // Skip: xor reg, reg (zeroing idiom)
    if (/^xor\s+(\w+),\s*\1$/.test(t)) continue;
    result.push({ address: insn.va, text: insn.text });
    if (result.length >= 200) break;
  }
  return result;
}

// ── byte-level passes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function shannonEntropy(bytes: Uint8Array): number {
  if (bytes.length === 0) return 0;
  const freq = new Uint32Array(256);
  for (const b of bytes) freq[b]++;
  let h = 0;
  for (const f of freq) {
    if (f > 0) { const p = f / bytes.length; h -= p * Math.log2(p); }
  }
  return h;
}

const CRYPTO_MARKERS: Array<{ pat: string; name: string }> = [
  { pat: '63 7c 77 7b f2 6b 6f c5', name: 'AES S-box' },
  { pat: '52 09 6a d5 30 36 a5 38', name: 'AES inverse S-box' },
  { pat: '67 e6 09 6a', name: 'SHA-256 init H0 (big-endian)' },
  { pat: '6a 09 e6 67', name: 'SHA-256 init H0 (little-endian)' },
  { pat: '67 45 23 01', name: 'MD4/MD5/SHA-1 init A' },
  { pat: 'ef cd ab 89', name: 'MD4/MD5/SHA-1 init B' },
  { pat: '98 ba dc fe', name: 'MD4/MD5/SHA-1 init C' },
  { pat: '61 c8 94 d6', name: 'ChaCha20 "expa" constant' },
  { pat: '3b 20 64 6e', name: 'ChaCha20 "nd 3" constant' },
  { pat: '04 c1 1d b7', name: 'CRC32 IEEE polynomial' },
  { pat: 'b8 1f 85 1f', name: 'XTEA delta constant (0x9E3779B9)' },
  { pat: 'b9 79 37 9e', name: 'XTEA delta (alt endian)' },
  { pat: 'c6 ef 37 26', name: 'TEA/XTEA sum constant' },
  { pat: '8d 01 00 00', name: 'Possible CRC table seed' },
];

export function scanCryptoConstants(capture: RuntimeCapture): CryptoHit[] {
  const hits: CryptoHit[] = [];
  for (const { pat, name } of CRYPTO_MARKERS) {
    const matches = searchCapture(capture, pat, 5);
    for (const m of matches) hits.push({ address: m.address, name, matchBytes: m.match });
  }
  return hits;
}

// ── combined pass ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function xrayInsns(insns: Insn[], rawBytes?: Uint8Array, capture?: RuntimeCapture): XrayResult {
  const ropGadgets = findRopGadgets(insns);
  const antiDebug = detectAntiDebug(insns);
  const indirectBranches = findIndirectBranches(insns);
  const xorDecryptors = findXorDecryptors(insns);
  const cryptoHits = capture ? scanCryptoConstants(capture) : [];
  const entropy = rawBytes ? shannonEntropy(rawBytes) : null;

  // Simple suspicion score: sum weighted signals, cap at 100
  let score = 0;
  score += Math.min(ropGadgets.length * 2, 30);
  score += Math.min(antiDebug.length * 8, 30);
  score += Math.min(indirectBranches.length, 20);
  score += xorDecryptors.length > 10 ? 10 : 0;
  score += cryptoHits.length > 0 ? 10 : 0;
  if (entropy !== null && entropy > 7.2) score += 20; // packed/encrypted
  score = Math.min(score, 100);

  return { ropGadgets, antiDebug, indirectBranches, xorDecryptors, cryptoHits, entropy, score };
}
```

`app/src/lib/strings.ts`:

```ts
// String classification and export helpers shared by the Strings workspace
// and MCP clients. Categories mirror web-mv's quick filters, but operate on the
// strings already extracted from Echo's live module image.

export type StringCategory = "url" | "path" | "cmd" | "rtti" | "other";

export function classifyString(value: string): StringCategory {
  const lower = value.toLowerCase();
  if (lower.includes("http://") || lower.includes("https://") || lower.includes(".com/") || lower.includes("/api/")) return "url";
  if (
    value.includes("/") ||
    value.includes("\\") ||
    /\.(lua|vfx|png|json|dll|exe|cfg|txt|bin|dat|xml|wav|mp3|ogg|bmp|tga|dds|pfb)$/i.test(value)
  ) return "path";
  if (
    value.includes("%s") || value.includes("%d") || value.includes("%f") || value.includes("%x") ||
    value.startsWith("cmd_") || value.startsWith("sv_") || value.startsWith("cl_") || value.startsWith("cvar_")
  ) return "cmd";
  if (
    value.startsWith("class ") || value.startsWith("struct ") || value.startsWith("namespace ") ||
    value.includes("::") || value.startsWith("type_info")
  ) return "rtti";
  return "other";
}

export type ExportedString = { address: string; text: string; utf16: boolean; category: StringCategory };

export function exportStrings(rows: ExportedString[], format: "csv" | "json" | "txt"): string {
  if (format === "json") return JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2);
  if (format === "txt") return rows.map((r) => `${r.address}\t${r.utf16 ? "utf16" : "ascii"}\t${r.category}\t${r.text}`).join("\n");
  const cell = (value: string) => `"${value.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  return ["address,type,category,text", ...rows.map((r) =>
    [cell(r.address), cell(r.utf16 ? "utf16" : "ascii"), cell(r.category), cell(r.text)].join(","),
  )].join("\n");
}
```

```ts
// Echo AngelScript templates: the relay scripts (ext is the full echo-reverse.as) plus echo-ai-toolkit's game

import agent from "../../echo/echo-reverse-agent.as?raw";

import basic from "../../echo/templates/basic.as?raw";

import menu from "../../echo/templates/menu.as?raw";
import misc from "../../echo/templates/misc.as?raw";

import render from "../../echo/templates/render.as?raw";
import ue5Sdk from "../../echo/templates/ue5-sdk.as?raw";
import unityIl2cpp from "../../echo/templates/unity-il2cpp.as?raw";
import valorant from "../../echo/templates/valorant.as?raw";
import webMv from "../../echo/templates/web-mv.as?raw";

export const templates: Record<string, string> = {
  agent, ext, basic, memory, menu, render, radar, aimbot, misc, loot,
  "esp-bones": espBones, "esp-preview": espPreview, fortnite, valorant,
  "ue5-sdk": ue5Sdk, "unity-il2cpp": unityIl2cpp, "web-mv": webMv,
};

export const templateFile = (kind: string) =>
  kind === "ext" ? "echo-reverse.as" : kind === "agent" ? "echo-reverse-agent.as" : `${kind}.as`;

// The template's own target exe (PROCESS_NAME, GAME_EXE or the first
// process::attach literal) is swapped for the attached process everywhere.
export function withProcess(src: string, process?: string): string {
  const exe = /(?:PROCESS_NAME = |GAME_EXE = |process::attach\()"([^"]+\.exe)"/.exec(src)?.[1];
  return process && exe ? src.replaceAll(`"${exe}"`, JSON.stringify(process)) : src;
}
```
