`app/src/lib/unreal.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/unreal.ts
// Dumper-7-style Unreal Engine SDK dump done purely through Echo reads: find
// GObjects and GNames by layout, detect UStruct/FField/FProperty/UEnum/UFunction
// offsets from objects every game has (CoreUObject.Vector, Object, Actor,
// Transform) the way Dumper-7's OffsetFinder does, then walk properties.
// Covers UE5 and UE4.25+ (FNamePool, chunked GObjects, FField properties) and
// older UE4 (TNameEntryArray, flat GObjects, UProperty objects).
// shortcut: no TPair<FName, uint8> enums (pre-4.15) and no 32-bit games.

import { Mem, readMany, u16, u32, u64 } from "./mem";

export type Section = { name: string; rva: number; vsize: number; exec: boolean; writable: boolean };

export type UeLayout = {
  gobjects: number;
  gnames: number;
  /** FUObjectArray holds one flat FUObjectItem array instead of 64K chunks (pre-4.20) */
  objectsFlat: boolean;
  itemStride: number;
  /** TNameEntryArray behind a pointer instead of an FNamePool (pre-4.23) */
  namesLegacy: boolean;
  nameStride: number;
  nameHeader: number;
  /** legacy FNameEntry: where the characters start */
  nameString: number;
  /** properties are UProperty objects in UStruct::Children (pre-4.25) */
  propsLegacy: boolean;
  super: number;
  childProps: number;
  structSize: number;
  ffClass: number;
  ffNext: number;
  ffName: number;
  arrayDim: number;
  elemSize: number;
  propFlags: number;
  offset: number;
  /** sizeof(FProperty): where StructProperty::Struct, ObjectProperty::PropertyClass, ... live */
  propBase: number;
  /** UEnum::Names, TArray<TPair<FName, int64>> */
  enumNames: number;
  /** UFunction::Func, the native thunk */
  funcExec: number;
};

export type UObj = { index: number; addr: number; name: string; cls: string; outer: number };

type Image = { base: number; sections: Section[] };

// UObject fields are stable from UE4.0 through UE5.x
const kObjIndex = 0xc;
const kObjClass = 0x10;
const kObjName = 0x18;
const kObjOuter = 0x20;
const kChunkItems = 0x10000;
const kLegacyNameChunk = 16384;
const CPF_Parm = 0x80n;
const CPF_OutParm = 0x100n;
const CPF_ReturnParm = 0x400n;
const CPF_ConstParm = 0x2n;
const CPF_ReferenceParm = 0x8000000n;

const plausible = (p: number) => p >= 0x10000 && p < 0x7fffffffffff && p % 8 === 0;
const i32 = (b: Uint8Array, o: number) => u32(b, o) | 0;
const u64n = (b: Uint8Array, o: number) => BigInt(u32(b, o)) | (BigInt(u32(b, o + 4)) << 32n);
const hex = (n: number) => `0x${n.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(4, "0")}`;

/** Scan writable image sections 64 KiB at a time, overlapping so a struct can't straddle chunks. */
async function* scanData(mem: Mem, base: number, sections: Section[]) {
  for (const s of sections.filter((x) => x.writable && !x.exec)) {
    for (let off = 0; off < s.vsize; off += 0x10000 - 0x40) {
      const len = Math.min(0x10000, s.vsize - off);
      const b = await mem.bytes(base + s.rva + off, len);
      if (b) yield { addr: base + s.rva + off, b };
    }
  }
}

export class Unreal {
  private mem = new Mem();
  private blocks: number[] = [];
  private names = new Map<number, string>();
  readonly objs: UObj[] = [];
  readonly byAddr = new Map<number, UObj>();
  layout: UeLayout;
  readonly image?: Image;
  /** GObjects came from the Valorant 7-state encrypted-globals cipher (Dumper-7-VGK). */
  readonly valorant: boolean;

  private constructor(layout: UeLayout, image?: Image, valorant = false) {
    this.layout = layout;
    this.image = image;
    this.valorant = valorant;
  }

  /** Locate GObjects and GNames in the main module and index every object. */
  static async open(base: number, sections: Section[], progress: (msg: string) => void, overrides?: { gobjects?: number; gnames?: number }): Promise<Unreal> {
    const mem = new Mem();
    progress("searching for GObjects and GNames…");
    let gobjects = overrides?.gobjects ?? 0;
    let flat = 0;
    let gnames = overrides?.gnames ?? 0;
    const pointers = new Map<number, number>(); // .data qword -> where it lives, for the legacy name search
    for await (const { addr, b } of scanData(mem, base, sections)) {
      if (gobjects && gnames) break;
      for (let o = 0; o + 0x30 <= b.length; o += 8) {
        // FUObjectArray: 16 bytes of gc bookkeeping, then FChunkedFixedUObjectArray
        if (!gobjects) {
          const max = i32(b, o + 0x20), cnt = i32(b, o + 0x24), maxC = i32(b, o + 0x28), numC = i32(b, o + 0x2c);
          if (cnt > 0x100 && cnt <= max && max <= 0x4000000 && plausible(u64(b, o + 0x10))
            && maxC === Math.ceil(max / kChunkItems) && numC === Math.ceil(cnt / kChunkItems)) {
            if (await objectArrayValid(mem, u64(b, o + 0x10), false)) gobjects = addr + o;
          }
          // or pre-4.20 FFixedUObjectArray: Objects, MaxElements, NumElements
          const fmax = i32(b, o + 0x18), fcnt = i32(b, o + 0x1c);
          if (!flat && fcnt > 0x100 && fcnt <= fmax && fmax <= 0x1000000 && plausible(u64(b, o + 0x10))) {
            if (await objectArrayValid(mem, u64(b, o + 0x10), true)) flat = addr + o;
          }
        }
        // FNamePool: lock, CurrentBlock, CurrentByteCursor, Blocks[]
        if (!gnames) {
          const cur = u32(b, o + 8), cursor = u32(b, o + 0xc);
          const end = o + 0x10 + (cur + 1) * 8;
          if (cur > 0 && cur < 8192 && cursor > 0 && cursor < 0x40000 && end + 8 <= b.length
            && plausible(u64(b, o + 0x10)) && plausible(u64(b, end - 8)) && u64(b, end) === 0) {
            if ((await noneOffset(mem, u64(b, o + 0x10))) > 0) gnames = addr + o;
          }
          if (plausible(u64(b, o)) && !pointers.has(u64(b, o))) pointers.set(u64(b, o), addr + o);
        }
      }
      if (gobjects && gnames) break;
    }
    if (!gnames) {
      progress("no FNamePool, looking for a TNameEntryArray…");
      gnames = await findLegacyNames(mem, pointers);
    }
    let valorant = false;
    if (!gobjects) {
      progress("looking for encrypted (Valorant-style) GObjects…");
      const decrypted = await findValorantGObjects(mem, base, sections, progress);
      if (decrypted) { gobjects = decrypted; valorant = true; }
    }
    if (!gobjects) gobjects = flat;
    if (!gobjects) throw new Error("GObjects not found (encrypted or non-standard FUObjectArray?)");
    if (!gnames) throw new Error("GNames not found (neither an FNamePool nor a TNameEntryArray)");
    return Unreal.openAt(gobjects, gnames, progress, { base, sections }, overrides?.gobjects !== undefined ? undefined : gobjects === flat, valorant);
  }

  /** Index objects from known GObjects / GNames addresses (e.g. from a previous run or Dumper-7). */
  static async openAt(gobjects: number, gnames: number, progress: (msg: string) => void, image?: Image, flat?: boolean, valorant = false): Promise<Unreal> {
    const mem = new Mem();
    const none = await noneOffset(mem, (await readPtr(mem, gnames + 0x10)) ?? 0);
    const legacy = none <= 0 ? await legacyNameString(mem, gnames) : -1;
    if (none <= 0 && legacy < 0) throw new Error("GNames points at neither an FNamePool nor a TNameEntryArray");
    if (flat === undefined) {
      const h = await mem.bytes(gobjects + 0x10, 0x20);
      flat = !!h && !(i32(h, 0x14) > 0 && i32(h, 0x18) === Math.ceil(i32(h, 0x10) / kChunkItems) && i32(h, 0x1c) === Math.ceil(i32(h, 0x14) / kChunkItems));
    }
    const u = new Unreal({
      gobjects, gnames, objectsFlat: flat, itemStride: 0x18,
      namesLegacy: legacy >= 0, nameStride: none === 2 ? 2 : 4, nameHeader: Math.max(0, none - 2), nameString: legacy,
      propsLegacy: false, super: 0, childProps: 0, structSize: 0, ffClass: 8, ffNext: 0, ffName: 0,
      arrayDim: 0, elemSize: 0, propFlags: 0, offset: 0, propBase: 0, enumNames: 0, funcExec: 0,
    }, image, valorant);
    await u.loadNames(progress);
    await u.loadObjects(progress);
    progress("detecting struct and property offsets…");
    await u.detectLayout();
    await u.loadSupers();
    return u;
  }

  // ── names ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async loadNames(progress: (msg: string) => void): Promise<void> {
    if (this.layout.namesLegacy) {
      // the global holds a pointer to Chunks[128], NumElements, NumChunks
      const array = (await readPtr(this.mem, this.layout.gnames)) ?? 0;
      const h = await this.mem.bytes(array, 128 * 8 + 8);
      if (!h) throw new Error("can't read TNameEntryArray");
      const chunks = Math.min(i32(h, 128 * 8 + 4), 128);
      this.blocks = Array.from({ length: chunks }, (_, i) => u64(h, i * 8));
      for (let i = 0; i < chunks; i++) {
        progress(`reading name chunk ${i + 1}/${chunks}…`);
        await this.mem.prefetch(this.blocks[i], kLegacyNameChunk * 8);
      }
      return;
    }
    const h = await this.mem.bytes(this.layout.gnames, 0x10);
    if (!h) throw new Error("can't read FNamePool");
    const cur = u32(h, 8);
    const ptrs = await this.mem.bytes(this.layout.gnames + 0x10, (cur + 1) * 8);
    if (!ptrs) throw new Error("can't read FNamePool blocks");
    this.blocks = Array.from({ length: cur + 1 }, (_, i) => u64(ptrs, i * 8));
    // one pass over the pool beats a page fault per name
    for (let i = 0; i <= cur; i++) {
      progress(`reading name block ${i + 1}/${cur + 1}…`);
      await this.mem.prefetch(this.blocks[i], i === cur ? u32(h, 0xc) : this.layout.nameStride * kChunkItems);
    }
  }

  private async legacyEntry(index: number): Promise<number> {
    const chunk = this.blocks[Math.floor(index / kLegacyNameChunk)];
    return chunk ? (await readPtr(this.mem, chunk + (index % kLegacyNameChunk) * 8)) ?? 0 : 0;
  }

  private decodeLegacy(b: Uint8Array): string | null {
    const wide = (u32(b, 0) & 1) === 1;
    const s = b.subarray(this.layout.nameString);
    let end = 0;
    if (wide) { while (end + 1 < s.length && (s[end] || s[end + 1])) end += 2; if (end + 1 >= s.length) return null; }
    else { end = s.indexOf(0); if (end < 0) return null; }
    return new TextDecoder(wide ? "utf-16le" : "latin1").decode(s.subarray(0, end));
  }

  /** Legacy names live in separate heap entries, read the ones a batch of objects needs together. */
  private async preloadNames(indices: number[]): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.layout.namesLegacy) return;
    const want = [...new Set(indices)].filter((i) => !this.names.has(i));
    const entries = await Promise.all(want.map((i) => this.legacyEntry(i)));
    const reads = await readMany(entries.map((e) => ({ addr: e, len: this.layout.nameString + 64 })));
    want.forEach((i, k) => { const b = reads[k]; const s = b ? this.decodeLegacy(b) : null; if (s !== null) this.names.set(i, s); });
  }

  async name(index: number, number = 0): Promise<string> {
    let s = this.names.get(index);
    if (s === undefined) {
      s = "";
      if (this.layout.namesLegacy) {
        const entry = await this.legacyEntry(index);
        const b = entry ? await this.mem.bytes(entry, this.layout.nameString + 2048) ?? await this.mem.bytes(entry, this.layout.nameString + 256) : null;
        s = (b && this.decodeLegacy(b)) ?? "";
      } else {
        const block = this.blocks[index >>> 16];
        if (block) {
          const entry = block + (index & 0xffff) * this.layout.nameStride + this.layout.nameHeader;
          const hb = await this.mem.bytes(entry, 2);
          if (hb) {
            const header = u16(hb, 0);
            const wide = (header & 1) === 1;
            const len = Math.min(header >> 6, 1024);
            const b = await this.mem.bytes(entry + 2, wide ? len * 2 : len);
            if (b) s = new TextDecoder(wide ? "utf-16le" : "latin1").decode(b);
          }
        }
      }
      this.names.set(index, s);
    }
    return number > 0 ? `${s}_${number - 1}` : s;
  }

  // ── objects ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async loadObjects(progress: (msg: string) => void): Promise<void> {
    const L = this.layout;
    const h = await this.mem.bytes(L.gobjects + 0x10, 0x20);
    if (!h) throw new Error("can't read GObjects");
    const array = u64(h, 0);
    const count = L.objectsFlat ? i32(h, 0xc) : i32(h, 0x14);
    L.itemStride = await itemStride(this.mem, L.objectsFlat ? array : (await readPtr(this.mem, array)) ?? 0);
    const stride = L.itemStride;

    const ptrs: Array<{ index: number; addr: number }> = [];
    for (let c = 0; c * kChunkItems < count; c++) {
      progress(`reading object chunk ${c + 1}/${Math.ceil(count / kChunkItems)}…`);
      const chunk = L.objectsFlat ? array + c * kChunkItems * stride : await readPtr(this.mem, array + c * 8);
      const n = Math.min(kChunkItems, count - c * kChunkItems);
      const items = chunk ? await this.mem.bytes(chunk, n * stride) : null;
      for (let i = 0; items && i < n; i++) {
        const addr = u64(items, i * stride);
        if (plausible(addr)) ptrs.push({ index: c * kChunkItems + i, addr });
      }
    }

    const heads = await readMany(ptrs.map((p) => ({ addr: p.addr, len: kObjOuter + 8 })), (done) =>
      progress(`reading objects ${done}/${ptrs.length}…`));
    await this.preloadNames(heads.flatMap((b) => (b ? [u32(b, kObjName)] : [])));
    const classOf = new Map<UObj, number>();
    for (let i = 0; i < ptrs.length; i++) {
      const b = heads[i];
      if (!b) continue;
      const o: UObj = { index: ptrs[i].index, addr: ptrs[i].addr, name: await this.name(u32(b, kObjName), u32(b, kObjName + 4)), cls: "", outer: u64(b, kObjOuter) };
      classOf.set(o, u64(b, kObjClass));
      this.objs.push(o);
      this.byAddr.set(o.addr, o);
    }
    for (const [o, cls] of classOf) o.cls = this.byAddr.get(cls)?.name ?? "";
  }

  /** "/Script/Engine.Actor" */
  path(o: UObj): string {
    const parts = [o.name];
    for (let p = this.byAddr.get(o.outer), guard = 0; p && guard < 32; p = this.byAddr.get(p.outer), guard++) parts.unshift(p.name);
    return parts.join(".");
  }

  find(path: string, cls: string): UObj | undefined {
    return this.objs.find((o) => o.cls === cls && this.path(o) === path);
  }

  // ── layout detection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async field(addr: number): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
    return this.mem.bytes(addr, 0x120);
  }

  private async fieldName(f: Uint8Array): Promise<string> {
    return this.name(u32(f, this.layout.ffName), u32(f, this.layout.ffName + 4));
  }

  private async detectLayout(): Promise<void> {
    const L = this.layout;
    const vector = this.find("/Script/CoreUObject.Vector", "ScriptStruct");
    const object = this.find("/Script/CoreUObject.Object", "Class");
    const actor = this.find("/Script/Engine.Actor", "Class");
    const transform = this.find("/Script/CoreUObject.Transform", "ScriptStruct");
    if (!vector || !object) throw new Error("CoreUObject.Vector / Object not found, names or GObjects are off");
    const vs = await this.field(vector.addr);
    if (!vs) throw new Error("can't read CoreUObject.Vector");

    // ChildProperties and FField::Name: the first property of Vector is X
    find: for (let c = 0x30; c <= 0x80; c += 8) {
      const x = u64(vs, c);
      // a UObject here is a pre-4.25 UProperty, handled below
      const xf = plausible(x) && !this.byAddr.has(x) ? await this.field(x) : null;
      if (!xf) continue;
      for (const n of [0x28, 0x20, 0x18, 0x30]) {
        if ((await this.name(u32(xf, n), u32(xf, n + 4))) === "X") { L.childProps = c; L.ffName = n; break find; }
      }
    }
    if (!L.childProps) {
      // pre-4.25: X is a UProperty object hanging off UStruct::Children
      for (let c = 0x30; c <= 0x80 && !L.childProps; c += 8) {
        if (this.byAddr.get(u64(vs, c))?.name === "X") { L.childProps = c; L.propsLegacy = true; L.ffName = kObjName; L.ffClass = kObjClass; }
      }
    }
    if (!L.childProps) throw new Error("property layout not recognized");

    const x = u64(vs, L.childProps);
    const xf = (await this.field(x))!;
    for (const n of L.propsLegacy ? [0x28, 0x30, 0x20] : [0x20, 0x18, 0x28, 0x10]) {
      const y = u64(xf, n);
      const yf = n !== L.ffName && plausible(y) ? await this.field(y) : null;
      if (yf && (await this.fieldName(yf)) === "Y") { L.ffNext = n; break; }
    }
    if (!L.ffNext) throw new Error("FField::Next not found");

    const xyz = [xf];
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) xyz.push((await this.field(u64(xyz[i], L.ffNext)))!);
    // Offset_Internal: X=0, Y=s, Z=2s with s=4 (float) or 8 (UE5 double)
    for (let o = 0x30; o < 0x90; o += 4) {
      const s = i32(xyz[1], o);
      if (i32(xyz[0], o) === 0 && (s === 4 || s === 8) && i32(xyz[2], o) === 2 * s) { L.offset = o; break; }
    }
    if (!L.offset) throw new Error("FProperty::Offset_Internal not found");
    const step = i32(xyz[1], L.offset);
    for (let o = 0x30; o < 0x90; o += 4) {
      if (o !== L.offset && xyz.every((f) => i32(f, o) === step) && xyz.every((f) => i32(f, o - 4) === 1)) { L.elemSize = o; L.arrayDim = o - 4; break; }
    }
    const os = (await this.field(object.addr))!;
    for (let o = 0x40; o < 0x90; o += 4) {
      if (i32(vs, o) === 3 * step && i32(os, o) === 0x28) { L.structSize = o; break; }
    }
    if (actor) {
      const as = (await this.field(actor.addr))!;
      for (let o = 0x30; o < 0x60; o += 8) if (u64(as, o) === object.addr) { L.super = o; break; }
    }

    // sizeof(FProperty): StructProperty Transform.Translation points at Vector
    if (transform) {
      const ts = (await this.field(transform.addr))!;
      for (let p = u64(ts, L.childProps), guard = 0; plausible(p) && guard < 16; guard++) {
        const f = (await this.field(p))!;
        if ((await this.fieldName(f)) === "Translation") {
          for (let o = L.offset + 4; o < 0x118; o += 4) if (o % 8 === 0 && u64(f, o) === vector.addr) { L.propBase = o; break; }
          break;
        }
        p = u64(f, L.ffNext);
      }
    }

    await this.detectFunctions(xf);
    await this.detectEnums();
  }

  /** PropertyFlags: CPF_Parm set on every function parameter and clear on Vector.X; UFunction::Func points into code. */
  private async detectFunctions(vectorX: Uint8Array): Promise<void> {
    const L = this.layout;
    const fns = this.objs.filter((o) => o.cls === "Function").slice(0, 200);
    const firstParams: Uint8Array[] = [];
    for (const fn of fns.slice(0, 40)) {
      const s = await this.field(fn.addr);
      const p = s ? u64(s, L.childProps) : 0;
      const f = plausible(p) ? await this.field(p) : null;
      if (f) firstParams.push(f);
    }
    const align8 = (n: number) => Math.ceil(n / 8) * 8;
    for (const o of [align8(L.elemSize + 4), L.elemSize + 4, L.elemSize + 8]) {
      if (firstParams.length && firstParams.every((f) => (u64n(f, o) & CPF_Parm) !== 0n) && (u64n(vectorX, o) & CPF_Parm) === 0n) { L.propFlags = o; break; }
    }

    const code = (this.image?.sections ?? []).filter((s) => s.exec).map((s) => [this.image!.base + s.rva, this.image!.base + s.rva + s.vsize]);
    if (!code.length || !fns.length) return;
    const heads = await readMany(fns.map((f) => ({ addr: f.addr, len: 0x120 })));
    let best = 0, bestHits = 0;
    for (let o = 0x60; o < 0x120; o += 8) {
      const hits = heads.filter((b) => b && code.some(([lo, hi]) => u64(b, o) >= lo && u64(b, o) < hi)).length;
      if (hits > bestHits) { best = o; bestHits = hits; }
    }
    if (bestHits >= fns.length / 2) L.funcExec = best;
  }

  /** UEnum::Names: a TArray whose entries are (FName, small int64), the first value 0. */
  private async detectEnums(): Promise<void> {
    const enums = this.objs.filter((o) => o.cls === "Enum").slice(0, 8);
    if (!enums.length) return;
    const heads = await Promise.all(enums.map((e) => this.field(e.addr)));
    for (let o = 0x30; o <= 0x80; o += 8) {
      let ok = true;
      for (const h of heads) {
        const data = h ? u64(h, o) : 0, num = h ? i32(h, o + 8) : 0, max = h ? i32(h, o + 12) : 0;
        const first = plausible(data) && num > 0 && num <= max && max <= 0x10000 ? await this.mem.bytes(data, 16) : null;
        if (!first || !(await this.name(u32(first, 0))) || u64n(first, 8) !== 0n) { ok = false; break; }
      }
      if (ok) { this.layout.enumNames = o; return; }
    }
  }

  /** Super pointers for every class and struct, so A/U prefixes are right before a class is dumped. */
  private async loadSupers(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.layout.super) return;
    const structs = this.objs.filter((o) => o.cls === "Class" || o.cls === "ScriptStruct");
    const sup = await readMany(structs.map((o) => ({ addr: o.addr + this.layout.super, len: 8 })));
    structs.forEach((o, i) => { const b = sup[i]; if (b) this.supers.set(o.addr, u64(b, 0)); });
  }

  // ── SDK ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private fieldClassNames = new Map<number, string>();

  private async fieldClass(f: Uint8Array): Promise<string> {
    const cls = u64(f, this.layout.ffClass);
    if (this.layout.propsLegacy) return this.byAddr.get(cls)?.name ?? "";
    let n = this.fieldClassNames.get(cls);
    if (n === undefined) {
      const b = await this.mem.bytes(cls, 8);
      n = b ? await this.name(u32(b, 0)) : "";
      this.fieldClassNames.set(cls, n);
    }
    return n;
  }

  private cppName(o: UObj | undefined): string {
    if (!o) return "void";
    if (o.cls === "ScriptStruct") return `F${o.name}`;
    if (o.cls === "Enum") return o.name.startsWith("E") ? o.name : `E${o.name}`;
    return `${this.isActor(o) ? "A" : "U"}${o.name}`;
  }

  private supers = new Map<number, number>();
  private deps = new Map<number, Set<number>>();
  private functionsOf: Map<number, UObj[]> | null = null;

  private isActor(o: UObj): boolean {
    for (let c: UObj | undefined = o, guard = 0; c && guard < 64; c = this.byAddr.get(this.supers.get(c.addr) ?? 0), guard++) {
      if (c.name === "Actor" && this.path(c) === "/Script/Engine.Actor") return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /** C++ type of a property; by-value struct members go into deps so the SDK can order them. */
  private async typeOf(f: Uint8Array, deps?: Set<number>): Promise<string> {
    const L = this.layout;
    const cls = await this.fieldClass(f);
    const at = (o: number) => this.byAddr.get(L.propBase ? u64(f, L.propBase + o) : 0);
    const inner = async (o: number) => {
      const p = L.propBase ? u64(f, L.propBase + o) : 0;
      const pf = plausible(p) ? await this.field(p) : null;
      return pf ? this.typeOf(pf) : "uint8";
    };
    switch (cls) {
      case "Int8Property": return "int8";
      case "Int16Property": return "int16";
      case "IntProperty": return "int32";
      case "Int64Property": return "int64";
      case "UInt16Property": return "uint16";
      case "UInt32Property": return "uint32";
      case "UInt64Property": return "uint64";
      case "FloatProperty": return "float";
      case "DoubleProperty": return "double";
      case "BoolProperty": return "bool";
      case "NameProperty": return "FName";
      case "StrProperty": return "FString";
      case "TextProperty": return "FText";
      case "ByteProperty": { const e = at(0); return e ? this.cppName(e) : "uint8"; }
      case "EnumProperty": { const e = at(8); return e ? this.cppName(e) : "uint8"; }
      case "StructProperty": { const s = at(0); if (s) deps?.add(s.addr); return `struct ${this.cppName(s)}`; }
      case "ObjectProperty":
      case "ObjectPtrProperty": return `class ${this.cppName(at(0))}*`;
      case "ClassProperty":
      case "ClassPtrProperty": return "class UClass*";
      case "WeakObjectProperty": return `TWeakObjectPtr<class ${this.cppName(at(0))}>`;
      case "LazyObjectProperty": return `TLazyObjectPtr<class ${this.cppName(at(0))}>`;
      case "SoftObjectProperty": return `TSoftObjectPtr<class ${this.cppName(at(0))}>`;
      case "SoftClassProperty": return "TSoftClassPtr<class UObject>";
      case "InterfaceProperty": return `TScriptInterface<class ${this.cppName(at(0))}>`;
      case "ArrayProperty": return `TArray<${await inner(0)}>`;
      case "SetProperty": return `TSet<${await inner(0)}>`;
      case "MapProperty": return `TMap<${await inner(0)}, ${await inner(8)}>`;
      default: return "";
    }
  }

  /** The property chain of a struct or function; legacy Children also holds functions, skip those. */
  private async *props(s: Uint8Array): AsyncGenerator<Uint8Array> {
    const L = this.layout;
    for (let p = u64(s, L.childProps), guard = 0; plausible(p) && guard < 4096; guard++) {
      const f = await this.field(p);
      if (!f) return;
      if (!L.propsLegacy || (await this.fieldClass(f)).endsWith("Property")) yield f;
      p = u64(f, L.ffNext);
    }
  }

  /** A UFunction as a C++ declaration with its native thunk. */
  private async dumpFunction(fn: UObj): Promise<string[]> {
    const L = this.layout;
    const s = await this.field(fn.addr);
    if (!s) return [];
    let ret = "void";
    const params: string[] = [];
    for await (const f of this.props(s)) {
      const flags = L.propFlags ? u64n(f, L.propFlags) : CPF_Parm;
      if ((flags & CPF_Parm) === 0n) continue;
      const type = (await this.typeOf(f)) || `uint8[${hex(i32(f, L.elemSize))}]`;
      if (flags & CPF_ReturnParm) { ret = type; continue; }
      const out = (flags & CPF_OutParm) !== 0n && (flags & CPF_ConstParm) === 0n;
      const ref = (flags & CPF_ReferenceParm) !== 0n;
      params.push(`${(flags & CPF_ConstParm) && ref ? "const " : ""}${type}${out ? "*" : ref ? "&" : ""} ${await this.fieldName(f)}`);
    }
    const exec = L.funcExec ? u64(s, L.funcExec) : 0;
    const where = exec ? `  exec 0x${exec.toString(16).toUpperCase()}${this.image ? ` (rva 0x${(exec - this.image.base).toString(16).toUpperCase()})` : ""}` : "";
    return [`\t// Function ${this.path(fn)}${where}`, `\t${ret} ${fn.name}(${params.join(", ")});`];
  }

  /** One class or struct as Dumper-7-style C++, with its functions. */
  async dump(o: UObj): Promise<string> {
    const L = this.layout;
    const s = await this.field(o.addr);
    if (!s) return `// ${this.path(o)}: unreadable\n`;
    const deps = new Set<number>();
    const sup = L.super ? this.byAddr.get(u64(s, L.super)) : undefined;
    if (sup) deps.add(sup.addr);
    const size = i32(s, L.structSize);
    let at = sup ? i32((await this.field(sup.addr)) ?? s, L.structSize) : 0;
    const lines = [
      `// ${o.cls} ${this.path(o)}`,
      `// 0x${(size - at).toString(16).toUpperCase()} (0x${size.toString(16).toUpperCase()} - 0x${at.toString(16).toUpperCase()})`,
      `${o.cls === "ScriptStruct" ? "struct" : "class"} ${this.cppName(o)}${sup ? ` : public ${this.cppName(sup)}` : ""}`,
      "{",
      "public:",
    ];
    for await (const f of this.props(s)) {
      const name = await this.fieldName(f);
      const off = i32(f, L.offset);
      const elem = i32(f, L.elemSize);
      const dim = Math.max(1, i32(f, L.arrayDim));
      if (off > at) lines.push(`\tuint8 Pad_${at.toString(16).toUpperCase()}[${hex(off - at)}];`);
      const type = await this.typeOf(f, deps);
      const decl = type ? `${type} ${name}${dim > 1 ? `[${dim}]` : ""}` : `uint8 ${name}[${hex(elem * dim)}]`;
      const note = type ? "" : ` ${await this.fieldClass(f)}`;
      // bitfield bools share a byte, only the first one advances the cursor
      if (off >= at) lines.push(`\t${decl}; // ${hex(off)}(${hex(elem * dim)})${note}`);
      else lines.push(`\t// ${decl}; ${hex(off)} bitfield/overlap${note}`);
      at = Math.max(at, off + elem * dim);
    }
    if (size > at) lines.push(`\tuint8 Pad_${at.toString(16).toUpperCase()}[${hex(size - at)}];`);
    if (o.cls === "Class") {
      if (!this.functionsOf) {
        this.functionsOf = new Map();
        for (const f of this.objs) if (f.cls === "Function") this.functionsOf.set(f.outer, [...(this.functionsOf.get(f.outer) ?? []), f]);
      }
      const fns = this.functionsOf.get(o.addr) ?? [];
      if (fns.length) lines.push("", "public:");
      for (const fn of fns) lines.push(...(await this.dumpFunction(fn)));
    }
    lines.push("};", "");
    deps.delete(o.addr);
    this.deps.set(o.addr, deps);
    return lines.join("\n");
  }

  /** A UEnum as an enum class. */
  async dumpEnum(o: UObj): Promise<string> {
    const L = this.layout;
    const h = L.enumNames ? await this.field(o.addr) : null;
    const data = h ? u64(h, L.enumNames) : 0;
    const num = h ? Math.min(i32(h, L.enumNames + 8), 4096) : 0;
    const b = num > 0 ? await this.mem.bytes(data, num * 16) : null;
    const values: Array<[string, bigint]> = [];
    for (let i = 0; b && i < num; i++) {
      const full = await this.name(u32(b, i * 16), u32(b, i * 16 + 4));
      values.push([full.slice(full.lastIndexOf("::") + 1 || 0).replace(/^:/, ""), BigInt.asIntN(64, u64n(b, i * 16 + 8))]);
    }
    const max = values.reduce((m, [, v]) => (v > m ? v : m), 0n);
    const min = values.reduce((m, [, v]) => (v < m ? v : m), 0n);
    const base = min >= 0n && max <= 0xffn ? "uint8" : min >= -0x80000000n && max <= 0x7fffffffn ? "int32" : "int64";
    return [`// Enum ${this.path(o)}`, `enum class ${this.cppName(o)} : ${base}`, "{",
      ...values.map(([n, v]) => `\t${n} = ${v},`), "};", ""].join("\n");
  }

  /** Every enum, then every class and struct ordered so supers and by-value members come first. */
  async sdk(progress: (done: number, total: number) => void): Promise<string> {
    const enums = this.objs.filter((o) => o.cls === "Enum");
    const all = this.objs.filter((o) => o.cls === "Class" || o.cls === "ScriptStruct");
    const out = new Map<number, string>();
    let done = 0;
    const total = enums.length + all.length;
    const enumText = [];
    for (const e of enums) { enumText.push(await this.dumpEnum(e)); progress(++done, total); }
    // a few dumps in flight keep the relay busy without flooding Echo
    const worker = async (start: number) => {
      for (let i = start; i < all.length; i += 8) {
        out.set(all[i].addr, await this.dump(all[i]));
        progress(++done, total);
      }
    };
    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => worker(i)));

    // dependency order, GObjects order among equals; cycles fall back to GObjects order
    const emitted = new Set<number>();
    const ordered: string[] = [];
    let pending = all;
    while (pending.length) {
      const next = pending.filter((o) => [...(this.deps.get(o.addr) ?? [])].some((d) => !emitted.has(d) && out.has(d)));
      const ready = next.length === pending.length ? pending : pending.filter((o) => !next.includes(o));
      for (const o of ready) { ordered.push(out.get(o.addr)!); emitted.add(o.addr); }
      pending = next.length === pending.length ? [] : next;
    }
    return [...enumText, ...ordered].join("\n");
  }
}

async function readPtr(mem: Mem, addr: number): Promise<number | null> {
  const b = await mem.bytes(addr, 8);
  return b ? u64(b, 0) : null;
}

/** Offset of "None" in the first name block (2 for a 2 byte header), or -1. */
async function noneOffset(mem: Mem, block: number): Promise<number> {
  if (!plausible(block)) return -1;
  const b = await mem.bytes(block, 0x40);
  if (!b) return -1;
  const text = new TextDecoder("latin1").decode(b);
  const at = text.indexOf("None");
  return at >= 2 && at <= 6 && text.includes("ByteProperty") ? at : -1;
}

/** For a global holding a TNameEntryArray*, where entry strings start ("None" in entry 0), or -1. */
async function legacyNameString(mem: Mem, global: number): Promise<number> {
  const array = await readPtr(mem, global);
  const chunk = array && plausible(array) ? await readPtr(mem, array) : null;
  const slots = chunk && plausible(chunk) ? await mem.bytes(chunk, 16) : null;
  if (!slots) return -1;
  const [none, byte] = await Promise.all([mem.bytes(u64(slots, 0), 0x40), mem.bytes(u64(slots, 8), 0x40)]);
  if (!none || !byte) return -1;
  const at = new TextDecoder("latin1").decode(none).indexOf("None\0");
  return at >= 8 && at <= 0x18 && new TextDecoder("latin1").decode(byte).startsWith("ByteProperty", at) ? at : -1;
}

/** Old games: a .data pointer to a TNameEntryArray, recognised by its NumElements/NumChunks tail. */
async function findLegacyNames(mem: Mem, pointers: Map<number, number>): Promise<number> {
  const targets = [...pointers.keys()];
  const tails = await readMany(targets.map((t) => ({ addr: t + 128 * 8, len: 8 })));
  for (let i = 0; i < targets.length; i++) {
    const t = tails[i];
    if (!t) continue;
    const num = i32(t, 0), chunks = i32(t, 4);
    if (num > 0x100 && num <= 128 * kLegacyNameChunk && chunks === Math.ceil(num / kLegacyNameChunk)) {
      if ((await legacyNameString(mem, pointers.get(targets[i])!)) >= 0) return pointers.get(targets[i])!;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

/** FUObjectItem size: the stride where item i's object has InternalIndex i. */
async function itemStride(mem: Mem, items0: number): Promise<number> {
  for (const stride of [0x18, 0x10, 0x20, 0x28]) {
    const items = await mem.bytes(items0, stride * 4);
    if (!items) break;
    let ok = true;
    for (let i = 1; i < 4 && ok; i++) {
      const o = await mem.bytes(u64(items, i * stride), 0x10);
      ok = o !== null && u32(o, kObjIndex) === i;
    }
    if (ok) return stride;
  }
  return 0x18;
}

// ── Valorant-style encrypted globals (Dumper-7-VGK) ─────────────────────────
//
// Valorant keeps GObjects behind a 7-state rotating cipher. The 0x2545F4914F6CDD1D
// magic is inlined into every accessor; walking back from a hit finds the LEA
// that names the state struct. Dumper-7-VGK documents the 7 cases and the two
// struct layouts used across builds, both handled here. Validating the result
// as an FUObjectArray is what keeps false positives out.

const kValorantMagic = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1Dn;
const k64 = 0xffffffffffffffffn;
const kMagicBytes = [0x1d, 0xdd, 0x6c, 0x4f, 0x91, 0xf4, 0x45, 0x25];

const rol64 = (v: bigint, n: number): bigint => {
  const s = BigInt(n & 63);
  const x = v & k64;
  return s === 0n ? x : ((x << s) | (x >> (64n - s))) & k64;
};
const ror64 = (v: bigint, n: number): bigint => {
  const s = BigInt(n & 63);
  const x = v & k64;
  return s === 0n ? x : ((x >> s) | (x << (64n - s))) & k64;
};
const stage1 = (v: bigint): bigint => ((v >> 1n) ^ (((v >> 1n) ^ (v << 1n)) & 0xaaaa_aaaa_aaaa_aaaAn)) & k64;
const stage2 = (v: bigint): bigint => ((v >> 2n) ^ (((v >> 2n) ^ (v << 2n)) & 0xcccc_cccc_cccc_ccccn)) & k64;
const stage3 = (v: bigint): bigint => ((v >> 4n) ^ (((v >> 4n) ^ (v << 4n)) & 0xf0f0_f0f0_f0f0_f0f0n)) & k64;
const stage4 = (v: bigint): bigint => ((v >> 8n) ^ (((v >> 8n) ^ (v << 8n)) & 0xff00_ff00_ff00_ff00n)) & k64;
const bitrev64 = (v: bigint): bigint => ror64(stage4(stage3(stage2(stage1(v)))), 32);

/** The GObjects variant of the cipher (sub_EA1980 / sub_3638AC0). */
export function decryptValorantGObjects(key: number, state: bigint[]): bigint {
  const k = BigInt(key >>> 0);
  const mix = (k ^ ((k ^ (k >> 15n)) >> 12n) ^ (k << 25n)) & 0xffffffffn;
  const hash = (kValorantMagic * mix) & k64;
  const hi = Number(hash >> 32n) >>> 0;
  const idx = Number(hash % 7n);
  let v = state[idx] & k64;
  switch (idx) {
    case 0: v = (v ^ BigInt(hi)) & k64; break;
    case 1: v = (BigInt((hi + idx) >>> 0) + rol64(v, ((hi + 2 * idx) % 63) + 1)) & k64; break;
    case 2: v = ((~v & k64) - BigInt((hi + idx) >>> 0)) & k64; break;
    case 3: v = ror64(bitrev64(v), ((hi + idx) % 63) + 1); break;
    case 4: v = (v + BigInt((hi + 2 * idx) >>> 0) + BigInt((hi + idx) >>> 0)) & k64; break;
    case 5: v = rol64(stage1(v), ((hi + idx) % 63) + 1); break;
    case 6: v = ror64(BigInt((hi + 2 * idx) >>> 0) + v, ((hi + idx) % 63) + 1); break;
  }
  return (v ^ k) & k64;
}

async function findValorantGObjects(
  mem: Mem, base: number, sections: Section[], progress: (msg: string) => void,
): Promise<number> {
  let budget = 48 * 1024 * 1024;
  let hits = 0;
  for (const s of sections.filter((x) => x.exec)) {
    if (budget <= 0) break;
    const len = Math.min(s.vsize, budget);
    budget -= len;
    for (let off = 0; off + 8 <= len; off += 0x100000 - 8) {
      const n = Math.min(0x100000, len - off);
      const b = await mem.bytes(base + s.rva + off, n);
      if (!b) continue;
      for (let i = 0; i + 8 <= b.length; i++) {
        if (!kMagicBytes.every((x, j) => b[i + j] === x)) continue;
        if (++hits > 256) return 0;
        const hit = base + s.rva + off + i;
        // walk back to the RIP-relative LEA that points at the state struct
        const back = await mem.bytes(hit - 0x80, 0x80 + 7);
        if (!back) continue;
        for (let p = 0x80 - 7; p >= 0; p--) {
          // REX.W LEA (0x48..0x4f: any destination register), modrm RIP-relative
          if ((back[p] & 0xf8) !== 0x48 || back[p + 1] !== 0x8d) continue;
          if ((back[p + 2] & 0xc7) !== 0x05) continue;
          const disp = (back[p + 3] | (back[p + 4] << 8) | (back[p + 5] << 16) | (back[p + 6] << 24)) | 0;
          const candidate = hit - 0x80 + p + 7 + disp;
          if (candidate < 0x10000) continue;
          const g = await tryValorantStruct(mem, candidate);
          if (g) {
            progress(`decrypted GObjects at 0x${g.toString(16)}`);
            return g;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

async function tryValorantStruct(mem: Mem, candidate: number): Promise<number> {
  for (const layout of [{ state: 0x40, key: 0x78 }, { state: 0x0, key: 0x38 }]) {
    const kb = await mem.bytes(candidate + layout.key, 4);
    if (!kb) continue;
    const key = u32(kb, 0);
    if (key === 0) continue;
    const sb = await mem.bytes(candidate + layout.state, 7 * 8);
    if (!sb) continue;
    const state = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => u64n(sb, i * 8));
    const ptr = decryptValorantGObjects(key, state);
    if (ptr <= 0n || ptr > BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) continue;
    const fuoa = Number(ptr); // FChunkedFixedUObjectArray, i.e. FUObjectArray + 0x10
    if (!plausible(fuoa)) continue;
    // The same header field checks Dumper-7-VGK's FindGObjects() runs: counts
    // are the cheapest way to reject a wrong key/state before touching pointers.
    const h = await mem.bytes(fuoa, 0x20);
    if (!h) continue;
    const max = i32(h, 0x10), count = i32(h, 0x14), maxC = i32(h, 0x18), numC = i32(h, 0x1c);
    if (count < 0x100 || count > max || max > 0x4000000 || numC < 1 || numC > maxC || maxC < 1 || maxC > 0x800) continue;
    const chunks = u64(h, 0);
    if (!plausible(chunks)) continue;
    // FUObjectArray header starts one FChunkedFixedUObjectArray before it.
    if (await objectArrayValid(mem, chunks, false)) return fuoa - 0x10;
  }
  return 0;
}

async function objectArrayValid(mem: Mem, array: number, flat: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
  const items = flat ? array : await readPtr(mem, array);
  if (!items || !plausible(items)) return false;
  const first = await readPtr(mem, items);
  const o = first && plausible(first) ? await mem.bytes(first, 0x10) : null;
  return o !== null && u32(o, kObjIndex) === 0;
}
```

```ts
// Background call-graph / xref index for the attached module.
// Streams through all functions via Echo disassembly and builds bidirectional maps:
//   callerMap: target_va -> [caller_va, ...]
//   calleeMap: caller_va -> [callee_va, ...]

import { call } from './rpc';

type Fn = { va: number; size: number; name?: string };

let _callerMap = new Map<number, number[]>();
let _calleeMap = new Map<number, number[]>();
let _indexKey = '';
let _busy = false;
let _progress = 0;
let _total = 0;
let _error = '';

export type XrefIndexStatus = {
  busy: boolean;
  progress: number;
  total: number;
  built: boolean;
  key: string;
  error: string;
  callers: number;
};

export function xrefIndexStatus(): XrefIndexStatus {
  return { busy: _busy, progress: _progress, total: _total, built: _callerMap.size > 0, key: _indexKey, error: _error, callers: _callerMap.size };
}

export async function buildXrefIndex(
  fns: Fn[],
  key: string,
  onProgress?: (done: number, total: number) => void,
): Promise<void> {
  if (_busy) throw new Error('Index build already in progress');
  if (_indexKey === key && _callerMap.size > 0) return; // already built
  _busy = true; _progress = 0; _total = fns.length; _error = '';
  _callerMap = new Map(); _calleeMap = new Map();

  try {
    const BATCH = 10;
    for (let i = 0; i < fns.length && _busy; i += BATCH) {
      const batch = fns.slice(i, i + BATCH);
      await Promise.all(batch.map(async fn => {
        try {
          const { instructions } = await call<{ instructions: Array<{ va: number; flow: string; target?: number }> }>(
            'disasm', 'disassemble', { addr: fn.va, count: 4000 },
          );
          const callees: number[] = [];
          for (const insn of instructions) {
            if (insn.va >= fn.va + fn.size) break;
            if (insn.flow === 'call' && insn.target !== undefined) {
              callees.push(insn.target);
              const callers = _callerMap.get(insn.target) ?? [];
              if (!callers.includes(fn.va)) callers.push(fn.va);
              _callerMap.set(insn.target, callers);
            }
          }
          if (callees.length > 0) _calleeMap.set(fn.va, callees);
        } catch { /* skip unreadable function */ }
      }));
      _progress = Math.min(i + BATCH, fns.length);
      onProgress?.(_progress, _total);
      // yield to the event loop between batches
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0));
    }
    _indexKey = key;
  } catch (e) {
    _error = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
  } finally {
    _busy = false;
  }
}

export function stopXrefIndex(): void { _busy = false; }

/** Addresses that call into `target`. */
export function xrefTo(target: number): number[] { return _callerMap.get(target) ?? []; }

/** Addresses that `caller` calls into. */
export function xrefFrom(caller: number): number[] { return _calleeMap.get(caller) ?? []; }

export function clearXrefIndex(): void {
  _callerMap = new Map(); _calleeMap = new Map(); _indexKey = ''; _busy = false;
}
```

`app/src/lib/xrefs.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/xrefs.ts
// "Who references this address", IDA-style, over Echo reads. The module image
// is read once and scanned locally for rel32 call/jmp/jcc and rip-relative
// operands landing on the target, and for 8-byte pointers to it in data
// sections (vtables, function tables). Rip-relative hits are confirmed by
// disassembling them through Echo, so a stray byte pattern doesn't count.
// shortcut: short (rel8) branches and register-indirect calls aren't found,
// they need a full disassembly index.

import { echoRequest } from "./echo";
import { Mem, hexAddr, num } from "./mem";
import { currentTargetGeneration, modules, readPe, type Pe } from "./rpc";

export type Xref = { from: number; kind: "call" | "jump" | "cond_jump" | "rip" | "data"; text: string; function?: number };

type Image = { base: number; pe: Pe; sections: Array<{ va: number; bytes: Uint8Array; exec: boolean }> };
let cached: { key: string; image: Image } | null = null;

async function image(base: number, size: number, progress?: (m: string) => void): Promise<Image> {
  const key = `${base}:${size}`;
  if (cached?.key === key) return cached.image;
  const generation = currentTargetGeneration();
  const mem = new Mem();
  const pe = await readPe(mem, base);
  const sections = [];
  for (const s of pe.sections) {
    progress?.(`reading ${s.name}…`);
    const { bytes } = await mem.image(base + s.rva, s.vsize);
    sections.push({ va: base + s.rva, bytes, exec: s.exec });
  }
  if (generation !== currentTargetGeneration()) throw new Error("Target changed while reading xrefs");
  cached = { key, image: { base, pe, sections } };
  return cached.image;
}

/** Drop the cached module image, e.g. after the target unpacked or patched code. */
export function clearXrefCache(): void {
  cached = null;
}

async function insnAt(va: number): Promise<{ length: number; text: string } | null> {
  const r = await echoRequest<{ results?: Array<{ address: string; length: number; text: string }> }>({
    type: "disassemble", address: hexAddr(va), size: 16,
  }).catch(() => null);
  const first = r?.results?.[0];
  return first && num(first.address) === va ? first : null;
}

export async function xrefsTo(
  target: number,
  opts: { module?: string; limit?: number; functions?: Array<{ va: number; size: number }>; progress?: (m: string) => void } = {},
): Promise<Xref[]> {
  const mods = await modules();
  const m = opts.module
    ? mods.find((x) => x.name.toLowerCase() === opts.module!.toLowerCase())
    : mods.find((x) => target >= num(x.base) && target < num(x.base) + x.size) ?? mods[0];
  if (!m) throw new Error(`module ${opts.module ?? ""} not loaded`);
  const img = await image(num(m.base), m.size, opts.progress);
  const limit = opts.limit ?? 500;
  const out: Xref[] = [];
  const ripCandidates: Array<{ disp: number; imm: number }> = [];

  for (const s of img.sections) {
    const b = s.bytes;
    const v = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.byteLength);
    if (s.exec) {
      for (let p = 1; p + 4 <= b.length && out.length < limit; p++) {
        // displacement that would land on the target from the end of this field
        const want = target - (s.va + p + 4);
        if (want < -0x80000000 || want > 0x7fffffff + 4) continue;
        const disp = v.getInt32(p, true);
        if (disp === want) {
          const op = b[p - 1];
          if (op === 0xe8 || op === 0xe9) {
            out.push({ from: s.va + p - 1, kind: op === 0xe8 ? "call" : "jump", text: `${op === 0xe8 ? "call" : "jmp"} ${hexAddr(target)}` });
            continue;
          }
          if (p >= 2 && b[p - 2] === 0x0f && op >= 0x80 && op <= 0x8f) {
            out.push({ from: s.va + p - 2, kind: "cond_jump", text: `j?? ${hexAddr(target)}` });
            continue;
          }
        }
        // [rip+disp32]: modrm mod=00 rm=101, an immediate of 0/1/2/4 bytes may follow the displacement
        if ((b[p - 1] & 0xc7) === 0x05) {
          for (const imm of [0, 1, 2, 4]) if (disp === want - imm) ripCandidates.push({ disp: s.va + p, imm });
        }
      }
    } else {
      for (let p = 0; p + 8 <= b.length && out.length < limit; p += 8) {
        if (Number(v.getBigUint64(p, true)) === target) out.push({ from: s.va + p, kind: "data", text: `dq ${hexAddr(target)}` });
      }
    }
  }

  // the instruction starts 2..7 bytes before its displacement (prefixes, rex, 0f escapes, opcode, modrm)
  for (const c of ripCandidates) {
    if (out.length >= limit) break;
    for (let k = 2; k <= 7; k++) {
      const insn = await insnAt(c.disp - k);
      if (insn && insn.length === k + 4 + c.imm) { out.push({ from: c.disp - k, kind: "rip", text: insn.text }); break; }
    }
  }

  const fns = opts.functions ?? [];
  for (const x of out) x.function = fns.find((f) => x.from >= f.va && x.from < f.va + f.size)?.va;
  return out.sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from);
}
```

`app/src/store/aiChat.ts`:

```ts
// Persistent AI chat store — conversation history in localStorage.

import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { ChatMessage } from '@/lib/llm';
import { getDefaultModel } from '@/lib/llm';

export type Conversation = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  model: string;
  messages: ChatMessage[];
  createdAt: number;
  updatedAt: number;
};

const kStorage = 'echo-reverse-ai-conversations';
const kActive  = 'echo-reverse-ai-active';
const kSystem  = 'echo-reverse-ai-system-prompt';

const DEFAULT_SYSTEM = `You are an expert reverse engineer and vulnerability researcher.
You have access to a live game process via the Echo hypervisor backend, which can read memory,
disassemble code, scan signatures, emulate code with Unicorn, and enumerate RTTI/exports.
When given disassembly listings, help analyze the code, identify algorithms, find bugs,
suggest better names for functions and variables, and answer questions concisely.
Respond in markdown with code blocks where appropriate.`;

function load(): Conversation[] {
  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(kStorage) ?? '[]') as Conversation[]; }
  catch { return []; }
}

function save(convs: Conversation[]) {
  try { localStorage.setItem(kStorage, JSON.stringify(convs)); }
  catch { /* quota full */ }
}

function makeId() {
  return Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6);
}

type AiChatStore = {
  conversations: Conversation[];
  activeId: string | null;
  systemPrompt: string;

  activeConversation: () => Conversation | null;
  newConversation: (model?: string) => string;
  selectConversation: (id: string) => void;
  deleteConversation: (id: string) => void;
  renameConversation: (id: string, title: string) => void;
  clearAll: () => void;

  addMessage: (id: string, msg: ChatMessage) => void;
  appendToLast: (id: string, token: string) => void;
  setSystemPrompt: (prompt: string) => void;
  setModel: (id: string, model: string) => void;
};

const _initialConvs = load();
const _initialActive = localStorage.getItem(kActive) ?? null;
const _initialSystem = localStorage.getItem(kSystem) ?? DEFAULT_SYSTEM;

export const useAiChat = create<AiChatStore>((set, get) => ({
  conversations: _initialConvs,
  activeId: _initialActive,
  systemPrompt: _initialSystem,

  activeConversation: () => {
    const { conversations, activeId } = get();
    return conversations.find(c => c.id === activeId) ?? null;
  },

  newConversation: (model) => {
    const id = makeId();
    const conv: Conversation = {
      id,
      title: 'New chat',
      model: model ?? getDefaultModel(),
      messages: [],
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    };
    const next = [conv, ...get().conversations];
    save(next);
    localStorage.setItem(kActive, id);
    set({ conversations: next, activeId: id });
    return id;
  },

  selectConversation: (id) => {
    localStorage.setItem(kActive, id);
    set({ activeId: id });
  },

  deleteConversation: (id) => {
    const next = get().conversations.filter(c => c.id !== id);
    save(next);
    const newActive = next[0]?.id ?? null;
    if (newActive) localStorage.setItem(kActive, newActive);
    else localStorage.removeItem(kActive);
    set({ conversations: next, activeId: newActive });
  },

  renameConversation: (id, title) => {
    const next = get().conversations.map(c => c.id === id ? { ...c, title } : c);
    save(next);
    set({ conversations: next });
  },

  clearAll: () => {
    localStorage.removeItem(kStorage);
    localStorage.removeItem(kActive);
    set({ conversations: [], activeId: null });
  },

  addMessage: (id, msg) => {
    const next = get().conversations.map(c => {
      if (c.id !== id) return c;
      const messages = [...c.messages, msg];
      // auto-title from first user message
      const title = c.messages.filter(m => m.role === 'user').length === 0 && msg.role === 'user'
        ? msg.content.slice(0, 60).replace(/\n/g, ' ')
        : c.title;
      return { ...c, messages, title, updatedAt: Date.now() };
    });
    save(next);
    set({ conversations: next });
  },

  appendToLast: (id, token) => {
    set(state => {
      const next = state.conversations.map(c => {
        if (c.id !== id) return c;
        const messages = [...c.messages];
        const last = messages[messages.length - 1];
        if (last?.role === 'assistant') {
          messages[messages.length - 1] = { ...last, content: last.content + token };
        } else {
          messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content: token });
        }
        return { ...c, messages, updatedAt: Date.now() };
      });
      save(next);
      return { conversations: next };
    });
  },

  setSystemPrompt: (prompt) => {
    localStorage.setItem(kSystem, prompt);
    set({ systemPrompt: prompt });
  },

  setModel: (id, model) => {
    const next = get().conversations.map(c => c.id === id ? { ...c, model } : c);
    save(next);
    set({ conversations: next });
  },
}));
```

`app/src/store/dataTypes.ts`:

```ts
// Global registry of reusable structs and enums. The definitions are local
// metadata (like web-mv's registry) and can be reused by the Memory workspace
// and exported as JSON or a C++ header.

import { create } from "zustand";
import {
  sanitizeRegistry,
  validateRegistry,
  type DataTypeRegistry,
  type PrimitiveTypeId,
  type StructField,
} from "@/lib/dataTypes";

const kStorageKey = "echo-reverse-data-types-v1";

function load(): DataTypeRegistry {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(kStorageKey);
    return raw ? sanitizeRegistry(JSON.parse(raw)) : { structs: [], enums: [] };
  } catch {
    return { structs: [], enums: [] };
  }
}

let sequence = Date.now();
const freshId = (prefix: string) => `${prefix}_${(++sequence).toString(36)}`;

function uniqueName(registry: DataTypeRegistry, base: string): string {
  const names = new Set([...registry.structs, ...registry.enums].map((x) => x.name));
  if (!names.has(base)) return base;
  let i = 1;
  while (names.has(`${base}_${i}`)) i++;
  return `${base}_${i}`;
}

type DataTypesStore = {
  registry: DataTypeRegistry;
  activeStruct: string | null;
  setRegistry: (registry: DataTypeRegistry) => string[];
  importJson: (text: string) => string[];
  addStruct: (name?: string) => string;
  renameStruct: (id: string, name: string) => void;
  removeStruct: (id: string) => void;
  addField: (structId: string) => void;
  updateField: (structId: string, fieldId: string, patch: Partial<StructField>) => void;
  removeField: (structId: string, fieldId: string) => void;
  addEnum: (name?: string) => string;
  renameEnum: (id: string, name: string) => void;
  removeEnum: (id: string) => void;
  setEnumUnderlying: (id: string, underlying: PrimitiveTypeId) => void;
  addEnumMember: (enumId: string) => void;
  updateEnumMember: (enumId: string, index: number, patch: Partial<{ name: string; value: number }>) => void;
  removeEnumMember: (enumId: string, index: number) => void;
  setActiveStruct: (name: string | null) => void;
};

export const useDataTypes = create<DataTypesStore>((set, get) => ({
  registry: load(),
  activeStruct: null,

  setRegistry: (registry) => {
    const clean = sanitizeRegistry(registry);
    const errors = validateRegistry(clean);
    if (!errors.length) set({ registry: clean, activeStruct: null });
    return errors;
  },

  importJson: (text) => {
    try {
      const clean = sanitizeRegistry(JSON.parse(text));
      const errors = validateRegistry(clean);
      if (!errors.length) set({ registry: clean, activeStruct: null });
      return errors;
    } catch (e) {
      return [e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)];
    }
  },

  addStruct: (name = "NewStruct") => {
    const registry = get().registry;
    const id = freshId("struct");
    const actual = uniqueName(registry, name);
    set({ registry: { ...registry, structs: [...registry.structs, { id, name: actual, fields: [] }] } });
    return id;
  },

  renameStruct: (id, name) => set((state) => ({
    registry: { ...state.registry, structs: state.registry.structs.map((s) => s.id === id ? { ...s, name: name.trim() || "unnamed" } : s) },
  })),

  removeStruct: (id) => set((state) => ({
    registry: { ...state.registry, structs: state.registry.structs.filter((s) => s.id !== id) },
    activeStruct: state.activeStruct && state.registry.structs.find((s) => s.id === id)?.name === state.activeStruct ? null : state.activeStruct,
  })),

  addField: (structId) => set((state) => ({
    registry: {
      ...state.registry,
      structs: state.registry.structs.map((s) => s.id === structId ? {
        ...s,
        fields: [...s.fields, { id: freshId("field"), name: `field_${s.fields.length}`, kind: "primitive", typeId: "int32" }],
      } : s),
    },
  })),

  updateField: (structId, fieldId, patch) => set((state) => ({
    registry: {
      ...state.registry,
      structs: state.registry.structs.map((s) => s.id === structId ? {
        ...s,
        fields: s.fields.map((f) => f.id === fieldId ? { ...f, ...patch } : f),
      } : s),
    },
  })),

  removeField: (structId, fieldId) => set((state) => ({
    registry: {
      ...state.registry,
      structs: state.registry.structs.map((s) => s.id === structId ? { ...s, fields: s.fields.filter((f) => f.id !== fieldId) } : s),
    },
  })),

  addEnum: (name = "NewEnum") => {
    const registry = get().registry;
    const id = freshId("enum");
    const actual = uniqueName(registry, name);
    set({ registry: { ...registry, enums: [...registry.enums, { id, name: actual, underlying: "int32", members: [] }] } });
    return id;
  },

  renameEnum: (id, name) => set((state) => ({
    registry: { ...state.registry, enums: state.registry.enums.map((e) => e.id === id ? { ...e, name: name.trim() || "unnamed" } : e) },
  })),

  removeEnum: (id) => set((state) => ({
    registry: { ...state.registry, enums: state.registry.enums.filter((e) => e.id !== id) },
  })),

  setEnumUnderlying: (id, underlying) => set((state) => ({
    registry: { ...state.registry, enums: state.registry.enums.map((e) => e.id === id ? { ...e, underlying } : e) },
  })),

  addEnumMember: (enumId) => set((state) => ({
    registry: {
      ...state.registry,
      enums: state.registry.enums.map((e) => e.id === enumId ? {
        ...e,
        members: [...e.members, { name: `MEMBER_${e.members.length}`, value: e.members.length }],
      } : e),
    },
  })),

  updateEnumMember: (enumId, index, patch) => set((state) => ({
    registry: {
      ...state.registry,
      enums: state.registry.enums.map((e) => e.id === enumId ? {
        ...e,
        members: e.members.map((m, i) => i === index ? { ...m, ...patch } : m),
      } : e),
    },
  })),

  removeEnumMember: (enumId, index) => set((state) => ({
    registry: {
      ...state.registry,
      enums: state.registry.enums.map((e) => e.id === enumId ? { ...e, members: e.members.filter((_, i) => i !== index) } : e),
    },
  })),

  setActiveStruct: (activeStruct) => set({ activeStruct }),
}));

// Persist the registry without coupling the editor to React's render cycle.
useDataTypes.subscribe((state) => {
  try { localStorage.setItem(kStorageKey, JSON.stringify(state.registry)); }
  catch { /* private mode or quota */ }
});
```

`app/src/store/disasm.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/disasm.ts
// the shared analysis session, a binary opened here is the binary an agent sees

import { create } from "zustand";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";

export type FunctionRow = {
  va: number;
  size: number;
  symbol?: string;
  name?: string;
  blocks?: number;
  callconv?: string;
  loops?: number;
  noreturn?: boolean;
};

export type Insn = {
  va: number;
  len: number;
  text: string;
  flow: string;
  target?: number;
  rip_rel?: number;
};

export type ImageFormat = "pe" | "macho";
export type ImageArch = "x86" | "x64" | "arm" | "arm64";

export type LoadedImage = {
  ready: boolean;
  // Optional for engines predating Mach-O and IPA support.
  format?: ImageFormat;
  arch?: ImageArch;
  encrypted?: boolean;
  warning?: string;
  bundle?: {
    app_dir: string;
    executable: string;
    executable_path: string;
    bundle_id: string;
    version: string;
    build: string;
    min_os: string;
  };
  name?: string;
  path?: string;
  base?: number;
  entry_va?: number;
  functions?: number;
  strings?: number;
  hype?: { available: boolean; ready?: boolean; progress?: number; error?: string };
};

export type StringHit = { va: number; text: string; utf16: boolean };

type DisasmStore = {
  image: LoadedImage;
  functions: FunctionRow[];
  total: number;
  selected: number | null;
  insns: Insn[];
  /** True when the listing ran past the function bounds (unreliable size). */
  linear: boolean;
  filter: string;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  /** Last hyperion-ready state seen on the event stream, for edge detection. */
  hypeReady: boolean;

  setFilter: (v: string) => void;
  refreshLoaded: () => Promise<void>;
  loadFile: (path: string) => Promise<void>;
  unload: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshFunctions: () => Promise<void>;
  /** Fed by the engine's `hype.progress` stream (see store/engine.ts). */
  onHypeProgress: (ready: boolean, hasImage: boolean) => void;
  select: (va: number) => Promise<void>;
  gotoAddress: (va: number) => Promise<void>;
  rename: (va: number, name: string) => Promise<void>;

  strings: StringHit[];
  stringsTruncated: boolean;
  loadStrings: (minChars: number, includeExec: boolean) => Promise<void>;
};

/** `sub_0000000140001000`, matching the ImGui listing's unnamed-function label. */
export function functionLabel(fn: FunctionRow): string {
  return fn.symbol ?? fn.name ?? `sub_${hex(fn.va)}`;
}

export function hex(va: number, pad = 16): string {
  return va.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(pad, "0");
}

export const useDisasm = create<DisasmStore>((set, get) => ({
  image: { ready: false },
  functions: [],
  total: 0,
  selected: null,
  insns: [],
  linear: false,
  filter: "",
  busy: false,
  error: null,
  hypeReady: false,

  setFilter: (filter) => set({ filter }),

  refreshLoaded: async () => {
    try {
      const image = await call<LoadedImage>("disasm", "loaded");
      const was = get().image.ready;
      set({ image });
      if (image.ready && !was) await get().refreshFunctions();
      if (!image.ready) set({ functions: [], insns: [], selected: null, total: 0 });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    }
  },

  loadFile: async (path) => {
    // A fresh image restarts analysis; clear the ready edge so its completion
    // re-pulls the function list (see onHypeProgress).
    set({ busy: true, error: null, hypeReady: false });
    try {
      await call("disasm", "load", { path });
      await get().refreshLoaded();
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: false });
    }
  },

  unload: async () => {
    await call("disasm", "unload");
    set({
      image: { ready: false },
      functions: [],
      insns: [],
      selected: null,
      total: 0,
      hypeReady: false,
    });
  },

  onHypeProgress: (ready, hasImage) => {
    // The engine streams background-analysis status. At load time the function
    // list is seeded from the fast native index, which for a .NET/IL image
    // holds only the entry stub — every managed method surfaces only once
    // hyperion analysis finishes. Re-pull the listing (and the loaded summary)
    // on the not-ready -> ready edge so the panel isn't stuck on that stale,
    // native-only view.
    const wasReady = get().hypeReady;
    set({ hypeReady: ready });
    if (ready && !wasReady && hasImage && get().image.ready) {
      void get().refreshLoaded();
      void get().refreshFunctions();
    }
  },

  refreshFunctions: async () => {
    set({ busy: true });
    try {
      const res = await call<{ functions: FunctionRow[]; total: number }>(
        "disasm",
        "functions",
        { limit: 10000 },
      );
      const functions = res.functions ?? [];
      const total = res.total ?? functions.length;
      set((state) => ({ functions, total, image: { ...state.image, functions: total } }));
      // Land on the entry point (or the first function) so the pane is never
      // blank after a load
      const current = get().selected;
      if (current === null && functions.length > 0) {
        const entry = get().image.entry_va;
        const start = functions.find((f) => f.va === entry) ?? functions[0];
        await get().select(start.va);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: false });
    }
  },

  select: async (va) => {
    set({ selected: va });
    const fn = get().functions.find((f) => f.va === va);
    // Ask for more than the function should need, then trim: the engine
    // disassembles linearly and will happily run past the end into the next
    // function, which made the header's byte count disagree with the listing
    const size = fn?.size ?? 0;
    const count = Math.min(4000, Math.max(64, Math.ceil(size / 2)));
    try {
      const res = await call<{ instructions: Insn[] }>("disasm", "disassemble", {
        addr: va,
        count,
      });
      const all = res.instructions ?? [];
      const inRange = size > 0 ? all.filter((i) => i.va < va + size) : all;
      // A function index can under-report size (tail merging, jump tables). If
      // trimming leaves almost nothing, show the linear sweep instead of a
      // misleadingly empty function
      const clamped = inRange.length >= 4;
      set({ insns: clamped ? inRange : all, linear: !clamped });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ insns: [], error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    }
  },

  gotoAddress: async (va) => {
    // Prefer the enclosing function so the listing keeps its context
    const fn = get().functions.find((f) => va >= f.va && va < f.va + f.size);
    await get().select(fn ? fn.va : va);
  },

  rename: async (va, name) => {
    // Echo's socket has no symbol-write verb. Names are a local workspace
    // annotation and are shared with MCP callers through the disasm store.
    set((s) => ({
      functions: s.functions.map((f) => (f.va === va ? { ...f, symbol: name || undefined } : f)),
    }));
  },

  strings: [],
  stringsTruncated: false,

  loadStrings: async (minChars, includeExec) => {
    set({ busy: true });
    try {
      const res = await call<{ strings: StringHit[]; truncated: boolean }>(
        "disasm",
        "strings",
        { min_chars: minChars, include_exec: includeExec, limit: 10000 },
      );
      set({ strings: res.strings ?? [], stringsTruncated: res.truncated === true });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ strings: [], error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: false });
    }
  },
}));

```

`app/src/store/dotnet.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/dotnet.ts
// The managed (.NET/CLI) assembly explorer, dnSpy-style: a namespace -> type ->
// member tree over the shared image, plus per-type C# and per-method C#/IL from
// the `dotnet` MCP tool. Everything the UI shows here an agent can pull too.

import { create } from "zustand";
import { call, ToolError } from "@/lib/rpc";

export type TypeCounts = {
  fields: number;
  properties: number;
  events: number;
  methods: number;
  nested: number;
};

export type TreeType = {
  token: number;
  token_hex: string;
  name: string;
  full_name: string;
  kind: string;
  visibility: string;
  base?: string;
  interfaces?: string[];
  counts: TypeCounts;
  nested?: TreeType[];
};

export type Namespace = { name: string; types: TreeType[] };

export type FieldInfo = {
  token: number;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  visibility: string;
  static: boolean;
  const?: boolean;
  readonly?: boolean;
  value?: string;
};

export type PropertyInfo = {
  token: number;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  get: boolean;
  set: boolean;
};

export type EventInfo = { token: number; name: string; type: string };

export type MethodInfo = {
  token: number;
  token_hex: string;
  name: string;
  signature: string;
  visibility: string;
  ret: string;
  static: boolean;
  abstract?: boolean;
  virtual?: boolean;
  ctor?: boolean;
  pinvoke?: boolean;
  special?: boolean;
  has_body: boolean;
  il_count: number;
  entry?: number;
};

export type TypeDetail = {
  token: number;
  name: string;
  namespace: string;
  full_name: string;
  kind: string;
  visibility: string;
  abstract: boolean;
  sealed: boolean;
  static: boolean;
  base?: string;
  interfaces?: string[];
  attributes?: string[];
  fields: FieldInfo[];
  properties: PropertyInfo[];
  events: EventInfo[];
  methods: MethodInfo[];
  nested?: { token: number; name: string; kind: string }[];
};

export type IlLine = {
  offset: number;
  offset_label: string;
  va: number;
  size: number;
  mnemonic: string;
  operand?: string;
  flow: string;
  target?: number;
};

export type MethodDetail = {
  token: number;
  name: string;
  full_name: string;
  signature: string;
  decl_type: string;
  visibility: string;
  ret: string;
  static: boolean;
  max_stack: number;
  code_size: number;
  entry?: number;
  params: { type: string; name: string }[];
  locals: { index: number; type: string }[];
  handlers: {
    kind: string;
    try_offset: number;
    try_length: number;
    handler_offset: number;
    handler_length: number;
    catch_type: string;
  }[];
  il: IlLine[];
  il_text: string;
  csharp: string;
  csharp_structured: boolean;
};

export type Status = {
  managed: boolean;
  assembly?: string;
  runtime?: string;
  il_only?: boolean;
  types?: number;
  methods?: number;
  fields?: number;
  properties?: number;
  events?: number;
  note?: string;
};

/** What the code pane is currently showing. */
export type Selection =
  | { kind: "type"; token: number; title: string }
  | { kind: "method"; token: number; title: string }
  | null;

type DotNetStore = {
  status: Status | null;
  namespaces: Namespace[];
  /** Type detail cache, keyed by TypeDef token, for lazy member expansion. */
  details: Record<number, TypeDetail>;
  expandedNs: Set<string>;
  expandedType: Set<number>;
  selection: Selection;
  /** Rendered code for the current selection. */
  csharp: string;
  ilText: string;
  method: MethodDetail | null;
  view: "csharp" | "il";
  filter: string;
  busy: boolean;
  loadingCode: boolean;
  error: string | null;

  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
  reset: () => void;
  setFilter: (v: string) => void;
  setView: (v: "csharp" | "il") => void;
  toggleNs: (name: string) => void;
  toggleType: (token: number) => Promise<void>;
  selectType: (token: number, title: string) => Promise<void>;
  selectMethod: (token: number, title: string) => Promise<void>;
};

const kEmpty = {
  status: null,
  namespaces: [] as Namespace[],
  details: {} as Record<number, TypeDetail>,
  expandedNs: new Set<string>(),
  expandedType: new Set<number>(),
  selection: null as Selection,
  csharp: "",
  ilText: "",
  method: null as MethodDetail | null,
  error: null as string | null,
};

export const useDotnet = create<DotNetStore>((set, get) => ({
  ...kEmpty,
  view: "csharp",
  filter: "",
  busy: false,
  loadingCode: false,

  reset: () => set({ ...kEmpty }),

  setFilter: (filter) => set({ filter }),
  setView: (view) => set({ view }),

  refresh: async () => {
    set({ busy: true, error: null });
    try {
      const status = await call<Status>("dotnet", "status");
      if (!status.managed) {
        set({ ...kEmpty, status, busy: false });
        return;
      }
      const tree = await call<{ namespaces: Namespace[] }>("dotnet", "tree", {
        limit: 20000,
      });
      set({
        status,
        namespaces: tree.namespaces ?? [],
        details: {},
        expandedNs: new Set<string>(),
        expandedType: new Set<number>(),
        busy: false,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      // A non-managed image fails the guarded actions; treat as "not managed"
      // rather than a hard error so the tab can show a clean empty state.
      const managed = !(e instanceof ToolError && /not a managed/.test(e.message));
      set({
        ...kEmpty,
        status: { managed: false },
        error: managed ? (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)) : null,
        busy: false,
      });
    }
  },

  toggleNs: (name) =>
    set((s) => {
      const next = new Set(s.expandedNs);
      next.has(name) ? next.delete(name) : next.add(name);
      return { expandedNs: next };
    }),

  toggleType: async (token) => {
    const open = get().expandedType.has(token);
    set((s) => {
      const next = new Set(s.expandedType);
      open ? next.delete(token) : next.add(token);
      return { expandedType: next };
    });
    if (open || get().details[token]) return;
    try {
      const detail = await call<TypeDetail>("dotnet", "type", { token });
      set((s) => ({ details: { ...s.details, [token]: detail } }));
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    }
  },

  selectType: async (token, title) => {
    set({ selection: { kind: "type", token, title }, loadingCode: true, method: null });
    try {
      const res = await call<{ csharp: string }>("dotnet", "source", { token });
      set({ csharp: res.csharp ?? "", ilText: "", view: "csharp", loadingCode: false });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e), loadingCode: false });
    }
  },

  selectMethod: async (token, title) => {
    set({ selection: { kind: "method", token, title }, loadingCode: true });
    try {
      const m = await call<MethodDetail>("dotnet", "method", { token });
      set({
        method: m,
        csharp: m.csharp ?? "",
        ilText: m.il_text ?? "",
        loadingCode: false,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e), loadingCode: false });
    }
  },
}));
```

```ts
    const monitor = async () => {
      try {
        const fpsInfo = await getFPS();
        updatePerformance(fpsInfo.fps, fpsInfo.frametime, fpsInfo.foreground);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Failed to get performance info:", error);
      }
    };
    
    const intervalId = setInterval(monitor, interval);
    
    // Initial fetch
    monitor();
    
    return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
  }, [updatePerformance, getFPS, interval]);
```

`app/src/store/engine.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/engine.ts
// Connection state driven by polling ping instead of a C++ sidecar event stream.

import { create } from "zustand";
import { invalidateTargetCaches } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { emit } from "@/lib/events";
import { echoReachable, echoRequest, getRelayUrl } from "@/lib/echo";
import { resolveEndpoint } from "@/lib/endpoint";

export type BootStage = {
  stage: number;
  total: number;
  label: string;
  done: boolean;
};

export type TargetState = { attached: boolean; pid?: number; name?: string; base?: number };
export type LaneState = { core: boolean; ext: boolean; ui: boolean; app: boolean };

export type HypeState = {
  has_image: boolean;
  image: string;
  present: boolean;
  ready: boolean;
  running: boolean;
  progress: number;
  error: string;
};

type EngineStore = {
  connected: boolean;
  boot: BootStage;
  backend: { badge: string; kernel: boolean };
  lanes: LaneState;
  target: TargetState;
  hype: HypeState;
  quitting: string | null;
  startupError: string | null;
  start: () => Promise<void>;
  reconnect: () => Promise<void>;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
};

const kDone: BootStage = { stage: 6, total: 6, label: "ready", done: true };
const kConnecting: BootStage = { stage: 1, total: 6, label: "connecting", done: false };
const kInitialHype: HypeState = {
  has_image: false, image: "", present: false, ready: false, running: false, progress: 0, error: "",
};

let starting: Promise<void> | undefined;
let refreshing: Promise<void> | undefined;
let identity: string | undefined;
let lastRelay = "";
let lastGenerations: string | undefined;

async function probe(): Promise<{ connected: boolean; target: TargetState; generations?: string; lanes?: LaneState }> {
  const alive = await echoReachable();
  if (!alive) return { connected: false, target: { attached: false }, lanes: { core: false, ext: false, ui: false, app: false } };
  try {
    const ping = await echoRequest<{ attached?: boolean; pid?: number; base?: string }>({ type: "ping" }, AbortSignal.timeout(3000));
    let target: TargetState = { attached: false };
    if (ping.attached && ping.base) {
      const mods = await echoRequest<{ modules?: Array<{ base: string; name: string }> }>({ type: "modules" }, AbortSignal.timeout(3000)).catch(() => ({ modules: [] }));
      const base = Number(BigInt(ping.base));
      const main = mods.modules?.find(m => { try { return BigInt(m.base) === BigInt(ping.base!); } catch { return false; } });
      target = { attached: true, pid: ping.pid, base, name: main?.name };
    }
    const status = await fetch(getRelayUrl().replace(/\/rpc\/?$/, "/status"), { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3000) })
      .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null).catch(() => null);
    const generations = status?.lanes ? `${status.lanes.core?.generation ?? "-"}:${status.lanes.ext?.generation ?? "-"}` : undefined;
    const lanes: LaneState = {
      core: status?.core === true,
      ext: status?.ext === true,
      ui: status?.ui === true,
      app: status?.app === true,
    };
    return { connected: true, target, generations, lanes };
  } catch {
    return { connected: true, target: { attached: false }, lanes: { core: false, ext: false, ui: false, app: false } };
  }
}

export const useEngine = create<EngineStore>((set, get) => ({
  connected: false,
  boot: kConnecting,
  backend: { badge: "echo", kernel: false },
  lanes: { core: false, ext: false, ui: false, app: false },
  target: { attached: false },
  hype: kInitialHype,
  quitting: null,
  startupError: null,

  start: () =>
    (starting ??= (async () => {
      set({ startupError: null, boot: kConnecting });
      await resolveEndpoint();
      await get().refresh();
      if (get().connected) {
        set({ boot: kDone, backend: { badge: "echo", kernel: false }, startupError: null });
      } else {
        set({
          connected: false,
          boot: { stage: 0, total: 6, label: "relay unreachable", done: false },
          startupError: `Echo relay unreachable at ${getRelayUrl()}. The desktop app hosts it on port 9000; in a browser, run web-mv's relay, then reconnect.`,
        });
      }
    })().catch((err: unknown) => {
      starting = undefined;
      set({ startupError: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
    })),

  refresh: () => refreshing ??= (async () => {
    const relay = getRelayUrl();
    const { connected, target, generations, lanes } = await probe();
    if (relay !== getRelayUrl()) return;
    if (relay !== lastRelay) { lastRelay = relay; lastGenerations = undefined; }
    if (generations !== undefined) lastGenerations = generations;
    const next = `${relay}:${connected}:${target.attached}:${target.pid ?? "-"}:${target.base ?? "-"}:${lastGenerations ?? "unknown"}`;
    if (identity !== undefined && next !== identity) {
      invalidateTargetCaches();
      emit("target.changed", target);
    }
    identity = next;
    set({ connected, target, lanes: lanes ?? { core: false, ext: false, ui: false, app: false } });
  })().finally(() => { refreshing = undefined; }),

  reconnect: async () => {
    starting = undefined;
    set({ boot: kConnecting, startupError: null });
    await get().refresh();
    if (get().connected) set({ boot: kDone, backend: { badge: "echo", kernel: false }, startupError: null });
    else set({ boot: { stage: 0, total: 6, label: "relay unreachable", done: false }, startupError: `Echo relay unreachable at ${getRelayUrl()}.` });
  },
}));
```
