```ts
// app/src/store/engines.ts
// Unity (IL2CPP) and Source 2 sessions, kept across rail switches like store/unreal.ts.

import { create } from "zustand";
import { openIl2Cpp, type Il2Cpp } from "@/lib/il2cpp";
import { currentTargetGeneration } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { interfaces, schema, type Interface, type SchemaClass } from "@/lib/source2";

type Busy = { busy: boolean; progress: string; error: string | null };

type EnginesStore = {
  unity: Il2Cpp | null;
  unityState: Busy;
  openUnity: () => Promise<void>;
  source2: { classes: SchemaClass[]; interfaces: Interface[] } | null;
  source2State: Busy;
  scanSource2: (module?: string) => Promise<void>;
};

const idle: Busy = { busy: false, progress: "", error: null };

export const useEngines = create<EnginesStore>((set) => ({
  unity: null,
  unityState: idle,
  openUnity: async () => {
    const generation = currentTargetGeneration();
    set({ unityState: { busy: true, progress: "looking for global-metadata…", error: null } });
    try {
      const unity = await openIl2Cpp((progress) => { if (generation === currentTargetGeneration()) set({ unityState: { busy: true, progress, error: null } }); });
      if (generation !== currentTargetGeneration()) return;
      set({ unity, unityState: { ...idle, progress: `metadata v${unity.version}, ${unity.types.length} types` } });
    } catch (e) {
      if (generation === currentTargetGeneration()) set({ unityState: { ...idle, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) } });
    }
  },
  source2: null,
  source2State: idle,
  scanSource2: async (module) => {
    const generation = currentTargetGeneration();
    const progress = (p: string) => { if (generation === currentTargetGeneration()) set({ source2State: { busy: true, progress: p, error: null } }); };
    progress("walking interface registries…");
    try {
      const ifaces = await interfaces(progress);
      const classes = await schema(progress, module || undefined);
      if (generation !== currentTargetGeneration()) return;
      set({ source2: { classes, interfaces: ifaces }, source2State: { ...idle, progress: `${classes.length} classes, ${ifaces.length} interfaces` } });
    } catch (e) {
      if (generation === currentTargetGeneration()) set({ source2State: { ...idle, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) } });
    }
  },
}));
```

`app/src/store/memory.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/memory.ts
// Live memory browsing for the hex editor, regions plus paged reads and writes
// through the Echo backend

import { create } from "zustand";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";

export type Region = {
  base: number;
  size: number;
  protect: number;
  state: number;
  type: number;
};

/** Page size for one read. 4 KiB keeps a scroll responsive over loopback. */
export const kPageBytes = 0x1000;

type MemoryStore = {
  regions: Region[];
  cursor: number;
  bytes: Uint8Array;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;

  loadRegions: () => Promise<void>;
  readAt: (addr: number) => Promise<void>;
  writeBytes: (addr: number, data: Uint8Array) => Promise<void>;
  reset: () => void;
};

function hexToBytes(hex: string): Uint8Array {
  const clean = hex.replace(/[^0-9a-fA-F]/g, "");
  const out = new Uint8Array(clean.length >> 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] = parseInt(clean.substr(i * 2, 2), 16);
  return out;
}

function bytesToHex(data: Uint8Array): string {
  let s = "";
  for (const b of data) s += b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0").toUpperCase();
  return s;
}

/** PAGE_* protection constants, rendered the way the region table shows them. */
export function protectName(protect: number): string {
  const base = protect & 0xff;
  const names: Record<number, string> = {
    0x01: "NOACCESS",
    0x02: "R",
    0x04: "RW",
    0x08: "WC",
    0x10: "X",
    0x20: "RX",
    0x40: "RWX",
    0x80: "XWC",
  };
  let out = names[base] ?? `0x${protect.toString(16)}`;
  if ((protect & 0x100) !== 0) out += "+G";
  if ((protect & 0x200) !== 0) out += "+NC";
  return out;
}

export const useMemory = create<MemoryStore>((set) => ({
  regions: [],
  cursor: 0,
  bytes: new Uint8Array(0),
  loading: false,
  error: null,

  loadRegions: async () => {
    try {
      const res = await call<{ regions: Region[] }>("target", "regions");
      // MEM_COMMIT only: reserved and free ranges are not readable, and listing
      // them just gives the user rows that always fail
      const regions = (res.regions ?? []).filter((r) => r.state === 0x1000);
      set({ regions, error: null });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ regions: [], error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    }
  },

  readAt: async (addr) => {
    set({ loading: true, cursor: addr });
    try {
      const res = await call<{ hex?: string }>("memory", "read", {
        addr,
        len: kPageBytes,
        format: "hex",
      });
      set({ bytes: hexToBytes(res.hex ?? ""), error: null });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ bytes: new Uint8Array(0), error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ loading: false });
    }
  },

  writeBytes: async (addr, data) => {
    await call("memory", "write", { addr, hex: bytesToHex(data) });
  },

  reset: () => set({ regions: [], bytes: new Uint8Array(0), cursor: 0, error: null }),
}));
```

```ts
// app/src/store/motion.ts
// motion preference, the os reduced motion setting is the default not the law

import { create } from "zustand";

export type MotionPref = "on" | "auto" | "off";

export const kMotionOptions: readonly { id: MotionPref; label: string; hint: string }[] = [
  { id: "on", label: "On", hint: "always animate" },
  { id: "auto", label: "Auto", hint: "follow the Windows animation setting" },
  { id: "off", label: "Off", hint: "no animation" },
];

const kStorageKey = "reverse-slop.motion";

function initial(): MotionPref {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(kStorageKey);
  return saved === "on" || saved === "auto" || saved === "off" ? saved : "on";
}

/** CSS reads `data-motion` on <html>; see the motion section of app.css. */
function apply(pref: MotionPref): void {
  document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-motion", pref);
}

/** Whether the OS currently asks for reduced motion, for the Settings hint. */
export function osPrefersReduced(): boolean {
  return window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
}

type MotionStore = {
  motion: MotionPref;
  setMotion: (pref: MotionPref) => void;
};

export const useMotion = create<MotionStore>((set) => {
  const motion = initial();
  apply(motion);
  return {
    motion,
    setMotion: (pref) => {
      apply(pref);
      localStorage.setItem(kStorageKey, pref);
      set({ motion: pref });
    },
  };
});
```

`app/src/store/output.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/output.ts
// output pane, lines live in the engine ring so a reconnect replays what was
// missed via the seq cursor

import { create } from "zustand";
import * as events from "@/lib/events";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";

export type OutputLine = { seq: number; ms: number; text: string };

const kMaxLines = 4096;

type OutputStore = {
  lines: OutputLine[];
  revision: number;
  clear: () => Promise<void>;
  attach: () => () => void;
  replayFrom: (revision: number) => Promise<void>;
};

export const useOutput = create<OutputStore>((set, get) => ({
  lines: [],
  revision: 0,

  attach: () => {
    const offOutput = events.on("output", (line) =>
      set((s) => {
        // Out-of-order or duplicate frames (reconnect overlap) are dropped by
        // sequence rather than deduplicated by text
        if (line.seq <= s.revision) return s;
        const lines = [...s.lines.slice(-(kMaxLines - 1)), line];
        return {
          lines,
          revision: line.seq,
        };
      }),
    );

    const offClear = events.on("output.cleared", () => set({ lines: [], revision: 0 }));

    // On (re)connect the engine tells us where its ring is; pull the gap
    const offHello = events.on("hello", ({ output_revision }) => {
      if (output_revision < get().revision) set({ lines: [], revision: 0 });
      void get().replayFrom(get().revision > 0 ? get().revision : Math.max(0, output_revision - kMaxLines));
    });
    return () => { offOutput(); offClear(); offHello(); };
  },

  replayFrom: async (revision) => {
    try {
      const res = await call<{ revision: number; lines: OutputLine[] }>(
        "app",
        "output",
        { since: revision },
      );
      if (res.lines.length === 0) return;
      set((s) => {
        const merged = [...s.lines, ...res.lines.filter((l) => l.seq > s.revision)];
        return {
          lines: merged.length > kMaxLines ? merged.slice(-kMaxLines) : merged,
          revision: res.revision,
        };
      });
    } catch {
      // Nothing to show is better than a thrown error in a log pane
    }
  },

  clear: async () => {
    await call("app", "output_clear");
    set({ lines: [], revision: 0 });
  },
}));

```

`app/src/store/scanner.ts`:

```ts
import { create } from "zustand";
import { cancelScanSession, clearScanSessions, deleteScanSession, runScanSession, type ScanWidth, type ScanProgress, type ScanResult } from "@/lib/scanSessions";

export type Hit = ScanResult["hits"][number];
export const kWidths = ["i8", "u8", "i16", "u16", "i32", "u32", "i64", "u64", "f32", "f64"] as const;
export const kFirstKinds = ["exact", "unknown"] as const;
export const kNextKinds = ["exact", "between", "bigger", "smaller", "increased", "decreased", "changed", "unchanged"] as const;
type Fields = { width: string; kind: string; value: string; value2: string; start: string; end: string; maxResults: string; maxBytes: string; protection: "writable" | "readable" | "executable" | "all"; hits: Hit[]; total: number; truncated: boolean; unreadable: number; hasState: boolean };
type ScannerStore = Fields & {
  sessions: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>; sessionId: string; busy: boolean; progress: ScanProgress | null; error: string | null;
  set: (patch: Partial<Pick<Fields, "width" | "kind" | "value" | "value2" | "start" | "end" | "maxResults" | "maxBytes" | "protection">>) => void;
  refreshState: () => Promise<void>; scan: (next: boolean) => Promise<void>; reset: () => Promise<void>; cancel: () => void;
  selectSession: (id: string) => void; newSession: () => void; removeSession: () => void; invalidate: () => void;
  compareSession: (id: string) => { common: number; onlyCurrent: number; onlyOther: number; limited: boolean };
};
const initial = (): Fields => ({ width: "u32", kind: "exact", value: "", value2: "", start: "", end: "", maxResults: "100000", maxBytes: "4294967296", protection: "writable", hits: [], total: 0, truncated: false, unreadable: 0, hasState: false });
let serial = 1;
const saved = new Map<string, Fields>();
function fields(s: Fields): Fields { const { width, kind, value, value2, start, end, maxResults, maxBytes, protection, hits, total, truncated, unreadable, hasState } = s; return { width, kind, value, value2, start, end, maxResults, maxBytes, protection, hits, total, truncated, unreadable, hasState }; }
export const useScanner = create<ScannerStore>((set, get) => ({
  ...initial(), sessions: [{ id: "1", name: "Scan 1" }], sessionId: "1", busy: false, progress: null, error: null,
  set: patch => set(patch), refreshState: async () => {},
  scan: async next => {
    const s = get();
    if (s.busy) return;
    set({ busy: true, error: null, progress: null });
    try {
      const r = await runScanSession(s.sessionId, next, { width: s.width as ScanWidth, kind: s.kind, value: s.value, value2: s.value2, start: s.start, end: s.end, maxResults: Number(s.maxResults), maxBytes: Number(s.maxBytes), protection: s.protection }, p => set({ progress: p }));
      set({ ...r, hasState: true, kind: s.kind === "unknown" ? "exact" : s.kind });
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof Error && e.name === "AbortError") set({ error: "Scan cancelled. Previous completed results were kept, if available." });
      else set({ error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e), ...(e instanceof Error && "code" in e && e.code === "TargetChanged" ? { hits: [], total: 0, hasState: false, truncated: false } : {}) });
    } finally { set({ busy: false, progress: null }); }
  },
  cancel: () => cancelScanSession(get().sessionId),
  reset: async () => { if (get().busy) return; deleteScanSession(get().sessionId); set({ ...initial(), error: null }); },
  selectSession: id => { const s = get(); if (s.busy || s.sessionId === id || !s.sessions.some(x => x.id === id)) return; saved.set(s.sessionId, fields(s)); set({ ...(saved.get(id) ?? initial()), sessionId: id, error: null }); },
  compareSession: id => { const current = get(), other = saved.get(id); if (!other || !current.hasState || !other.hasState) throw new Error('Both sessions need completed scans'); const a = new Set(current.hits.map(h => h.addr)), b = new Set(other.hits.map(h => h.addr)); let common = 0; for (const address of a) if (b.has(address)) common++; return { common, onlyCurrent: a.size - common, onlyOther: b.size - common, limited: current.total > current.hits.length || other.total > other.hits.length || current.truncated || other.truncated }; },
  newSession: () => { const s = get(); if (s.busy) return; saved.set(s.sessionId, fields(s)); const id = String(++serial); set({ ...initial(), sessionId: id, sessions: [...s.sessions, { id, name: `Scan ${id}` }], error: null }); },
  invalidate: () => { clearScanSessions(); saved.clear(); set({ ...initial(), sessions: [{ id: "1", name: "Scan 1" }], sessionId: "1", error: "Target or agent connection changed; scan results were cleared." }); },
  removeSession: () => { const s = get(); if (s.busy) return; deleteScanSession(s.sessionId); saved.delete(s.sessionId); const remaining = s.sessions.filter(x => x.id !== s.sessionId); if (!remaining.length) { const id = String(++serial); set({ ...initial(), sessions: [{ id, name: `Scan ${id}` }], sessionId: id, error: null }); } else { const id = remaining[0].id; set({ ...(saved.get(id) ?? initial()), sessions: remaining, sessionId: id, error: null }); } },
}));
```

`app/src/store/targets.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/targets.ts
// process list and attach flow, refresh is explicit and the target mirror
// arrives over events

import { create } from "zustand";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";

export type ProcessRow = {
  pid: number;
  name: string;
  arch: string;
  path?: string;
  elevation?: string;
};

export type ModuleRow = {
  name: string;
  base: number;
  size: number;
  path?: string;
};

type TargetsStore = {
  processes: ProcessRow[];
  modules: ModuleRow[];
  filter: string;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  setFilter: (v: string) => void;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshModules: () => Promise<void>;
  attach: (target: number | string) => Promise<boolean>;
  detach: () => Promise<void>;
};

export const useTargets = create<TargetsStore>((set, get) => ({
  processes: [],
  modules: [],
  filter: "",
  loading: false,
  error: null,

  setFilter: (filter) => set({ filter }),

  refresh: async () => {
    set({ loading: true, error: null });
    try {
      const res = await call<{ processes: ProcessRow[] }>("target", "list");
      const processes = [...(res.processes ?? [])].sort((a, b) =>
        a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, { sensitivity: "base" }),
      );
      set({ processes, loading: false });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ loading: false, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    }
  },

  refreshModules: async () => {
    try {
      const res = await call<{ modules: ModuleRow[] }>("target", "modules");
      set({ modules: res.modules ?? [] });
    } catch {
      set({ modules: [] });
    }
  },

  attach: async (target) => {
    try {
      await call("target", "attach", typeof target === "number" ? { pid: target } : { name: target });
      await Promise.all([get().refreshModules(), useEngine.getState().refresh()]);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
      return false;
    }
  },

  detach: async () => {
    await call("target", "detach");
    set({ modules: [] });
    await useEngine.getState().refresh();
  },
}));

/** Name-or-pid substring match, same rule as NameFilterMatch() in the ImGui view. */
export function matchesFilter(row: ProcessRow, filter: string): boolean {
  if (filter === "") return true;
  const needle = filter.toLowerCase();
  return row.name.toLowerCase().includes(needle) || String(row.pid) === needle;
}
```

`app/src/store/unreal.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/unreal.ts
// The indexed Unreal session lives here so it survives switching rail panels.

import { create } from "zustand";
import { call, currentTargetGeneration } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { Unreal, type Section } from "@/lib/unreal";

type UnrealStore = {
  ue: Unreal | null;
  base: number;
  module: string;
  progress: string;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  open: (gobjectsRva?: number, gnamesRva?: number) => Promise<void>;
  exportSdk: () => Promise<string | null>;
};

export const useUnreal = create<UnrealStore>((set, get) => ({
  ue: null,
  base: 0,
  module: "",
  progress: "",
  busy: false,
  error: null,

  open: async (gobjectsRva, gnamesRva) => {
    const generation = currentTargetGeneration();
    set({ busy: true, error: null, ue: null, progress: "reading the main module…" });
    const progress = (p: string) => { if (generation === currentTargetGeneration()) set({ progress: p }); };
    try {
      const pe = await call<{ image: string; image_base: number; sections: Section[] }>("disasm", "pe");
      const ue = await Unreal.open(pe.image_base, pe.sections, progress, {
        gobjects: gobjectsRva === undefined ? undefined : pe.image_base + gobjectsRva,
        gnames: gnamesRva === undefined ? undefined : pe.image_base + gnamesRva,
      });
      if (generation !== currentTargetGeneration()) return;
      set({ ue, base: pe.image_base, module: pe.image, progress: `${ue.objs.length} objects` });
    } catch (e) {
      if (generation === currentTargetGeneration()) set({ error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e), progress: "" });
    } finally {
      if (generation === currentTargetGeneration()) set({ busy: false });
    }
  },

  exportSdk: async () => {
    const { ue } = get();
    const generation = currentTargetGeneration();
    if (!ue) return null;
    set({ busy: true, error: null });
    try {
      const result = await ue.sdk((done, total) => { if (generation === currentTargetGeneration()) set({ progress: `dumping ${done}/${total}…` }); });
      if (generation !== currentTargetGeneration()) throw new Error("Target changed during SDK export");
      return result;
    } catch (e) {
      if (generation === currentTargetGeneration()) set({ error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
      return null;
    } finally {
      if (generation === currentTargetGeneration()) set({ busy: false, progress: `${ue.objs.length} objects` });
    }
  },
}));
```

```ts
// app/src/store/updater.ts
// Signed self-update from the github release (latest.json): checked on start,
// downloaded in the background, installed when the user picks restart

import { create } from "zustand";
import { check, type Update } from "@tauri-apps/plugin-updater";
import { relaunch } from "@tauri-apps/plugin-process";
import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";

type UpdaterStore = {
  status: string;
  busy: boolean;
  /** downloaded and verified, waiting for install */
  ready: Update | null;
  /** installation completed, but the app still needs to restart */
  installedVersion: string | null;
  check: (installWhenReady?: boolean) => Promise<void>;
  install: () => Promise<void>;
};

const message = (e: unknown) => (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));

export const useUpdater = create<UpdaterStore>((set, get) => ({
  status: "",
  busy: false,
  ready: null,
  installedVersion: null,
  check: async (installWhenReady = false) => {
    if (!isTauri() || get().busy || get().ready || get().installedVersion) return;
    set({ busy: true, status: "Checking for updates…" });
    let update: Update | null = null;
    try {
      update = await check({ timeout: 30_000, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-cache" } });
      if (!update) return set({ status: "Up to date" });
      set({ status: `Downloading ${update.version}…` });
      let total = 0;
      let received = 0;
      const version = update.version;
      await update.download((event) => {
        if (event.event === "Started") total = event.data.contentLength ?? 0;
        if (event.event === "Progress" && total > 0) {
          received += event.data.chunkLength;
          set({ status: `Downloading ${version}… ${Math.min(100, Math.floor(received / total * 100))}%` });
        }
      }, { timeout: 300_000 });
      set({ ready: update, status: `Version ${update.version} is ready to install` });
    } catch (e) {
      await update?.close().catch(() => {});
      const text = message(e);
      set({ status: `${update ? "Update download" : "Update check"} failed: ${text}` });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: false });
    }
    if (installWhenReady && get().ready) await get().install();
  },
  install: async () => {
    const { ready: update, installedVersion, busy } = get();
    if (busy || (!update && !installedVersion)) return;
    set({ busy: true, status: installedVersion ? "Restarting…" : `Installing ${update!.version}…` });
    try {
      if (update) {
        // Windows exits after starting the installer; on Linux installation returns.
        await update.install({ restartAfterInstall: true });
        set({ ready: null, installedVersion: update.version, status: "Update installed. Restarting…" });
        await update.close().catch(() => {});
      }
      await relaunch();
    } catch (e) {
      set({ busy: false, status: `${get().installedVersion ? "Restart" : "Install"} failed: ${message(e)}` });
    }
  },
}));

```

`app/src/store/watch.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/watch.ts
// watchlist mirror, the list lives in core and the app tick services it, a
// watch added over mcp shows up here and vice versa

import { create } from "zustand";
import * as events from "@/lib/events";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";
import type { WatchEntry, WatchValue } from "@/lib/events";

type WatchStore = {
  entries: WatchEntry[];
  values: Map<number, WatchValue>;
  attached: boolean;
  attach: () => () => void;
  load: () => Promise<void>;
  add: (addr: number, width: string, label?: string) => Promise<void>;
  remove: (id: number) => Promise<void>;
  setFreeze: (id: number, freeze: boolean) => Promise<void>;
  poke: (id: number, value: string) => Promise<void>;
  clear: () => Promise<void>;
};

export const useWatch = create<WatchStore>((set) => ({
  entries: [],
  values: new Map(),
  attached: false,

  attach: () => {
    const offList = events.on("watch.list", ({ entries }) => set({ entries }));
    const offValues = events.on("watch.values", ({ attached, values }) =>
      set({ attached, values: new Map(values.map((v) => [v.id, v])) }),
    );
    return () => { offList(); offValues(); };
  },

  load: async () => {
    const res = await call<{ entries: WatchEntry[]; values: WatchValue[] }>(
      "memory",
      "watch_list",
    );
    set({
      entries: res.entries ?? [],
      values: new Map((res.values ?? []).map((v) => [v.id, v])),
    });
  },

  add: async (addr, width, label) => {
    await call("memory", "watch_add", { addr, width, ...(label ? { label } : {}) });
  },

  remove: async (id) => {
    await call("memory", "watch_remove", { id });
  },

  setFreeze: async (id, freeze) => {
    await call("memory", "watch_set", { id, freeze });
  },

  // Text form so f32/f64 and signed widths round-trip through the same
  // parse_value_text() the scanner's value box used
  poke: async (id, value) => {
    await call("memory", "watch_set", { id, value });
  },

  clear: async () => {
    await call("memory", "watch_clear");
  },
}));

```

```css
/* --- scrollbars ----------------------------------------------------------- */
/* WebView2 ships Chromium's default chunky light scrollbar, which reads as a
 * different application bolted onto the side of the panels. Thin, dark, and
 * accent-on-drag instead. `scrollbar-gutter: stable` keeps content from
 * shifting sideways when a list crosses the overflow threshold */

* {
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--border) transparent;
}

.panel-body,
.modal-body,
.code-area {
  scrollbar-gutter: stable;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  background: transparent;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  /* Border trick: a transparent border with background-clip gives the thumb
     inset padding without a wrapper element, so it floats clear of the edge */
  background: var(--border);
  background-clip: padding-box;
  border: 3px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: background-color 120ms ease-out;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: var(--text-faint);
  background-clip: padding-box;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:active {
  background: var(--accent);
  background-clip: padding-box;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-corner {
  background: transparent;
}

/* Chromium draws these as blank squares once the thumb is restyled */
::-webkit-scrollbar-button {
  display: none;
}

/* --- motion --------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* One timing scale for the whole app so nothing feels out of step. Short
 * enough that a workbench never feels like it is waiting on an animation */

:root {
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --fast: 90ms;
  --med: 190ms;
  --slow: 260ms;
}

@keyframes view-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(7px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}

/* Panels slide in from the rail side rather than upward, the horizontal motion
   reads as "this replaced the thing next to the rail" */
@keyframes panel-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-10px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}

@keyframes pop-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.97);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}

@keyframes tip-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(3px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}

 * (2-3%), enough to feel mechanical, not enough to look bouncy */

}

}

   so the highlight tracks the cursor instead of trailing it */

}

/* The rail's active marker grows from the centre rather than popping in */

  transform: scaleY(0);
  transition: transform var(--med) var(--ease);
}

  transform: scaleY(1);
}

/* The tab underline slides its width in from the active edge */

  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: center;
  transition: transform var(--med) var(--ease);
}

.tab[data-active="true"]::after {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  /* Only when the user has not explicitly asked for motion. This machine's
     Windows animation setting is off, which Chromium reports here, honouring it
     unconditionally meant the app could never animate at all */
  html:not([data-motion="on"]) *,
  html:not([data-motion="on"]) *::before,
  html:not([data-motion="on"]) *::after {
    animation-duration: 1ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 1ms !important;
  }
}

html[data-motion="off"] *,
html[data-motion="off"] *::before,
html[data-motion="off"] *::after {
  animation-duration: 1ms !important;
  animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
  transition-duration: 1ms !important;
}
```

`packaging/apt/build-repository.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
repo=$1
package=$2
public_key=$3
mkdir -p "$repo"
version=$(dpkg-deb --field "$package" Version)
name=$(dpkg-deb --field "$package" Package)
architecture=$(dpkg-deb --field "$package" Architecture)
[[ "$name" == echo-reverse && "$architecture" == amd64 ]] || { printf 'Unexpected package: %s %s\n' "$name" "$architecture" >&2; exit 1; }
for old in "$repo"/*.deb; do
  [[ -f "$old" ]] || continue
  old_version=$(dpkg-deb --field "$old" Version)
  if dpkg --compare-versions "$old_version" gt "$version"; then
    printf 'Refusing to replace newer repository version %s with %s\n' "$old_version" "$version" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
cp "$package" "$repo/$(basename "$package")"
cp "$public_key" "$repo/repository-key.asc"
(
  cd "$repo"
  dpkg-scanpackages --multiversion . /dev/null > Packages
  gzip -n -9 -c Packages > Packages.gz
  rm -f Release InRelease Release.gpg
  apt-ftparchive -o APT::FTPArchive::Release::Origin='echo-reverse' \
    -o APT::FTPArchive::Release::Label='echo-reverse' \
    -o APT::FTPArchive::Release::Architectures='amd64' release . > Release
  gpg --batch --yes --armor --detach-sign -o Release.gpg Release
  gpg --batch --yes --clearsign -o InRelease Release
  keyring=$(mktemp)
  trap 'rm -f "$keyring"' EXIT
  gpg --dearmor < repository-key.asc > "$keyring"
  gpgv --keyring "$keyring" InRelease >/dev/null
)

```

`packaging/shell/echo-update.ps1`:

```ps1
# Dot-source from a PowerShell profile. Set ECHO_REVERSE_EXE for portable installs.
Remove-Item Alias:echo -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
function global:echo {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Position = 0, ValueFromPipeline = $true)] $InputObject,
        [Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments = $true)] [object[]] $Remaining
    )
    process {
        if (-not $MyInvocation.ExpectingInput -and $InputObject -ceq 'update' -and $Remaining.Count -eq 0) {
            $exe = if ($env:ECHO_REVERSE_EXE) { $env:ECHO_REVERSE_EXE } else { Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'echo-reverse\echo-reverse.exe' }
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)) {
                Write-Error "echo-reverse not found at $exe. Set ECHO_REVERSE_EXE to its executable path."
                return
            }
            Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList '--update'
        } else {
            Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility\Write-Output -InputObject $InputObject
            if ($Remaining.Count) { Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility\Write-Output -InputObject $Remaining }
        }
    }
}
```

`tools/build_frontend_binary.ps1`:

```ps1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$SkipTests,
    # also build the nsis setup.exe; with a version (release tags) it is signed
    # for the updater, which needs TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY in the environment
    [switch]$Bundle,
    [string]$Version,
    [switch]$Preview
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$appDir = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'app'
Push-Location $appDir
try {
    # Replace the resource map with an empty array (not an empty map, which
    # JSON merge-patch would merge). Sidecars arrive only in the packaging job.
    # All runtime settings, permissions, icons and embedded web assets stay intact.
    $config = Join-Path $appDir 'src-tauri\tauri.build.conf.json'
    $override = @{ bundle = @{ resources = @(); createUpdaterArtifacts = [bool]$Version } }
    if ($Version) { $override.version = $Version }
    if ($Preview) { $override.plugins = @{ updater = @{ endpoints = @('https://github.com/NetVar1337/echo-reverse/releases/download/preview/latest-preview.json') } } }
    $override | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $config
    if (-not (Test-Path 'node_modules')) {
        & npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'npm ci failed' }
    }
    # CI: tests run in their own parallel lane, never on the compile path
    if (-not $SkipTests) {
        & npm test
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'frontend tests failed' }
    }
    if (Test-Path 'src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis') {
        Remove-Item -Recurse -Force 'src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis'
    }
    $bundleArgs = if ($Bundle) { @('--bundles', 'nsis') } else { @('--no-bundle') }
    & node node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli/tauri.js build @bundleArgs --config $config -- --locked
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'frontend compilation failed' }
    if (-not (Test-Path 'src-tauri/target/release/echo-reverse.exe')) {
        throw 'frontend binary missing after compilation'
    }
} finally { Pop-Location }

```

`tools/bump-version.mjs`:

```mjs
import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';

const root = resolve(process.argv[2] || '.');
const files = ['app/package.json', 'app/package-lock.json', 'app/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json', 'app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml', 'app/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'];
const contents = await Promise.all(files.map(file => readFile(resolve(root, file), 'utf8')));
const version = JSON.parse(contents[0]).version;
const match = /^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)$/.exec(version);
if (!match) throw new Error(`Expected a stable semantic version, got ${version}`);
const next = `${match[1]}.${match[2]}.${Number(match[3]) + 1}`;

const packageLock = JSON.parse(contents[1]);
if (packageLock.version !== version || packageLock.packages[''].version !== version || JSON.parse(contents[2]).version !== version) {
  throw new Error('Version files are out of sync');
}
const replaceOne = (text, pattern, label) => {
  let count = 0;
  const result = text.replace(pattern, (_, prefix) => { count++; return `${prefix}${next}`; });
  if (count !== 1) throw new Error(`Expected one ${label} version, found ${count}`);
  return result;
};
const escaped = version.replaceAll('.', '\\.');
const updated = [
  replaceOne(contents[0], new RegExp(`("version"\\s*:\\s*")${escaped}(?=")`), 'package'),
  replaceOne(replaceOne(contents[1], new RegExp(`("version"\\s*:\\s*")${escaped}(?=")`), 'lock root'), new RegExp(`(""\\s*:\\s*\\{\\s*"name"\\s*:\\s*"[^"]+"\\s*,\\s*"version"\\s*:\\s*")${escaped}(?=")`), 'lock package'),
  replaceOne(contents[2], new RegExp(`("version"\\s*:\\s*")${escaped}(?=")`), 'Tauri'),
  replaceOne(contents[3], new RegExp(`(\\[package\\][\\s\\S]*?\\nversion\\s*=\\s*")${escaped}(?=")`), 'Cargo'),
  replaceOne(contents[4], new RegExp(`(name = "reverse-slop-ui"\\r?\\nversion = ")${escaped}(?=")`), 'Cargo lock'),
];
await Promise.all(files.map((file, index) => writeFile(resolve(root, file), updated[index])));
console.log(next);

```

`tools/publish_release.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# CI: uploads build outputs to a github release instead of actions artifacts
# (release assets don't count against the account's artifact storage quota).
# A version tag goes to that tag's draft release, which the release job
# publishes once latest.json is written; main goes to the rolling "preview"
# prerelease under fixed names, so each push replaces the previous build.
set -euo pipefail

if [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" = tag ]; then
  tag=$GITHUB_REF_NAME
  # the other build job may create it first, so a failed create is fine if it now exists
  gh release view "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
    gh release create "$tag" --draft --title "$tag" --generate-notes --verify-tag ||
    gh release view "$tag" >/dev/null
  gh release upload "$tag" "$@" --clobber
else
  gh release view preview >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
    gh release create preview --prerelease --title "Preview (main)" --target "$GITHUB_SHA" --notes "Rebuilt on every push to main." ||
    gh release view preview >/dev/null
  # Versioned assets keep the previous manifest usable while both jobs publish.
  gh release upload preview "$@" --clobber
  dir=$(mktemp -d)
  for f in "$@"; do
    [[ "$f" != *.sig ]] || continue
    # echo-reverse_0.1.1_amd64.deb -> echo-reverse-preview_amd64.deb, echo-reverse.exe -> echo-reverse-preview.exe
    cp "$f" "$dir/$(basename "$f" | sed -E 's/^echo-reverse(_[0-9][^_]*)?/echo-reverse-preview/')"
  done
  gh release upload preview "$dir"/* --clobber
  gh release edit preview --notes "Preview builds from main. Signed update manifests are published after both builds pass."
fi

```

`tools/verify-update/src/main.rs`:

```rs
use base64::{engine::general_purpose::STANDARD, Engine};
use minisign_verify::{PublicKey, Signature};
use std::{error::Error, fs, path::Path};

fn verify(config: &Path, artifact: &Path, signature: &Path, version: &str) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let config: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(config)?)?;
    let key = config["plugins"]["updater"]["pubkey"].as_str().ok_or("missing updater public key")?;
    let key = String::from_utf8(STANDARD.decode(key)?)?;
    let signature = String::from_utf8(STANDARD.decode(fs::read_to_string(signature)?.trim())?)?;
    let signature = Signature::decode(&signature)?;
    PublicKey::decode(&key)?.verify(&fs::read(artifact)?, &signature, true)?;
    if !signature.trusted_comment().split_whitespace().any(|part| part == format!("version:{version}")) {
        return Err(format!("signature does not match release version {version}").into());
    }
    println!("verified {} for {}", artifact.display(), version);
    Ok(())
}

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let args: Vec<_> = std::env::args_os().collect();
    if args.len() != 5 { return Err("usage: verify-update CONFIG ARTIFACT SIGNATURE VERSION".into()); }
    verify(Path::new(&args[1]), Path::new(&args[2]), Path::new(&args[3]), args[4].to_str().ok_or("invalid version")?)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use semver::Version;

    #[test]
    fn preview_build_numbers_increase_in_updater_order() {
        let version = |s| Version::parse(s).unwrap();
        assert!(version("0.2.0+preview.24") > version("0.2.0+preview.23"));
        assert!(version("0.2.0+preview.100") > version("0.2.0+preview.99"));
        assert!(version("0.2.1+preview.1") > version("0.2.0+preview.100"));
    }
}
```
